result.description: Fires on " to" right after "how" (how to + verb), and on " maintain" after "while" (while maintaining). Silent on " to" after nouns like "attention to" or "approach to". Members detect how, while, maintain.
result.label: "how to" and "while maintain"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' ending the word "phonemic" (also "epistemic"), after word pieces like phon-em. Silent on 'ic' in "proficiency" or "acoustic".
result.label: 'ic' in phonemic/epistemic

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ow' completing the word "shallow" (after "shall"). Weakly fires on 'ier' in "heavier". Members detect 'shall' before it and 'ow' tokens. Silent on other contexts without that word.
result.label: 'ow' in "shallow"

result.description: Fires on the 'ol' piece at the start of "cholesterol" (a document-initial 'ol' before "esterol"). It stays quiet on 'ol' inside other words such as phospholipid, accolades and violins.
result.label: 'ol' in cholesterol
' Way' in proper names
result.description: Fires on the token ' Way' when it ends a proper name such as "Milky Way" or "Silent Way". It fires weakly on ' feedback'. Members include ' Way' and ' Mil' detectors.

Fires on the tokens ' engines' and ' pop'/' Pop' (pop music), with a few weaker hits like 'Grand'. Members are mostly detectors of these specific tokens plus related topic words (jazz, solar, engineering).
result.label: ' engines' and ' pop' token detector
Word-piece 'ores'/'os' in expl-ores, phil-os
result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ores' in "expl|ores" and 'os' in "phil|osopher", plus 'it'. It depends on the preceding word fragment (expl-, phil-), completing a specific word.
Fires on the token ' Swift' as a name (e.g. Jonathan Swift, Swift's), in all 64 peak examples. Driven mainly by a single layer-0 attention member that copies the ' Swift' token itself.
result.label: ' Swift' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' terra' (as in terrace) and ' vertical' (vertical farming/integration), mostly at the start of such words. Members are detectors of these two tokens. Weak activity on a few other tokens.
result.label: ' terra' and ' vertical' tokens

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' permut' (permutation) and on ' bus', with weak activity on a few other word beginnings. Members are mostly detectors of ' permut' and ' bus' tokens plus assorted unrelated words.
result.label: ' permut' and ' bus' token pieces
"sets" after "data"
result.description: Fires on " sets" (also " set") right after the word "data", as in "data set(s)". It is weaker on "data points" and "intricate details". Members detect "data" and "set" tokens. It stays silent on the one-word "datasets".

Fires on scattered function words (' and', ' the', ' or') and word pieces like ' stem', ' p', 'issue' in academic or explanatory text. Peaks are mixed and the contrast shows ' and' silent in other contexts. Evidence is thin and unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words, academic text

result.description: Fires on the word " range" (also " ranges") in many contexts: vocal range, economic ranges, statistical range, "a range of". Members are mostly detectors of range and near-synonyms such as span and spectrum. The one contrast text is silent, but it doesn't show a condition.
result.label: ' range' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' directly after 'plement' (implementing). It stays silent on 'ing' after other verb stems like avoid-, employ-, maintain-, collect-. Members are 'plement' detectors.
result.label: 'ing' after 'plement'

result.description: Peaks are scattered: ' locate' most often, plus 'fish', ' submit/submission', and odd tokens like 'complete' and ' who'. Logits favor answer/candidate/exact/bound words. Members are mostly token detectors with low specificity, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered 'locate' and answer-seeking tokens

result.description: Fires on the token right after "good" (mostly "ness", also " and", " thing", " for") when the word "good" is being continued. It stays silent on "ness" after other words like fair or robust. Members detect "good" and "ness".
result.label: Continuation after "good"

result.description: Fires on " Effect"/"effect" and "influ" (influence), most strongly on "Effect" in named physics effects like Zeeman, Kerr, Faraday, Doppler Effect. Weaker on "effectiveness" and "Effective".
result.label: Effect / influence word detector

result.description: Fires on astronomy and physics word pieces such as galax-, Earth, astronom-, gravit-, and cos-, in science text about space and gravity. Members are mostly detectors of these same tokens. It is silent on a gravitational-wave passage that lacks those words.
result.label: Astronomy/space term pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'le' completing "mantle" (Earth's mantle, geology), and weakly on other word endings like 'ending' or 'phere'. Silent on 'le' in "puzzle" or "Aristotle", so it needs the mant- prefix.
result.label: 'le' ending of "mantle"

result.description: Fires on the first word pieces of technical science words, especially 'Ferr' and the following 'im' in "Ferrimagnetic", and on mid-word pieces like 'orm' in "hormones". Peaks are mixed and the logits are not clear.
result.label: Ferrimagnetic and technical word pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ational' (also 'ations') when it completes the word "conversational"/"conversations", after the piece 'convers'. Silent on 'ational' in other words like "organizational".
result.label: 'ational' in conversational

result.description: Fires on specific word pieces: 'ema' in "Schema"/"noema" and 'uclidean' in "Euclidean", occasionally ' notation'. Mostly token-specific, driven by 'ema' and 'uclidean' detector members, in technical or abstract text.
result.label: ema / uclidean word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' differenti' (start of "differentiable/differentiability") in math text, peaking on that token. Weak activation on a few other word-start pieces like ' Compet' and ' familiar'.
result.label: ' differenti' word piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "yth", mainly at the start of "Pythagoras" and related words, and weakly in "rhythm/rhythmic". It pushes towards continuations like "mic", "agoras" and "onian".
result.label: "yth" in Pythagoras

result.description: Fires on the 'oz'/'o' piece inside geological era names like Paleozoic, Mesozoic and Cenozoic, after a Pale-/Mes-/Cen- start. It also fires weakly on 'oz' in 'Mozart'. Silent on 'Paleogene'.
result.label: -ozoic era name piece

result.description: Fires on the token 'im' in the word piece sequence "Arch|im|edes" (Archimedes, Archimedean, Archimides). It stays silent when 'im' starts a text without the preceding "Arch".
result.label: 'im' inside Archimedes

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe used as a possessive marker directly after a noun or name (Egypt', Raphael', art') in art and history text, just before an 's'. It stays silent on apostrophes at the start of a text and after some other word pieces.
result.label: Possessive apostrophe after noun

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' ris' (of risks, risky) and ' invest' (investors, investments), mostly in finance or business text. Members detect these pieces, with some separate 'risk' and 'ks' detectors. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: ' ris' and ' invest' word starts

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'm' and 'las' in the middle of split words like cytoplas-m, Plexig-las, neoplas-ms. Silent on 'm' as a standalone abbreviation, such as in (mRNA). Logits favor '-ology' style continuations.
result.label: -plasm / -glas word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires on the token " arts" (as in visual arts, fine arts, culinary arts, arts education), at full strength in lists of art fields and a bit weaker in "culinary arts". Members mostly detect " arts" and related art or culinary words.
result.label: ' arts' token detector

result.description: Fires on 'blue', 'green' and 'key' as the second element of hyphenated or paired terms (blue-green deployment, symmetric-key/asymmetric-key, color mixing). Members are detectors of blue, green, key, color and colors.
result.label: blue / green / key in compounds

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces (ver, c, ce, j, struct) right after a "con" prefix, as in convergence, conjunctions, concavé, constructive. Members detect "con" and related pieces. It stays silent on "ver" in other words like "adver".
result.label: Word piece after con- prefix

result.description: Fires on the token " activation", mostly in "activation energy" (chemistry) and also immune activation. Weakly fires on " identification". Silent on general chemical-reaction text without that word.
result.label: ' activation' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "control" (Control, control, controls), strongest in "Traffic Control Systems" and as a noun or verb in technical or management text. Members are mostly token detectors for control variants.
result.label: Control word detector

result.description: Fires on hedging or intensifying adverbs such as " essentially", " simply", " literally" and " merely", often in a run of such adverbs in abstract explanatory text. Members are detectors of each adverb.
result.label: Essentially/simply/merely adverbs

result.description: Fires on the 'er' piece in the split word "res-er-voir" (after "res"). It stays silent on 'er' in other words like maker, polymer, bearer. Members detect "res" and "voir" pieces.
result.label: 'er' inside "reservoir"

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Systems' after "Traffic Control" in title-like phrases, and on scattered word-piece endings like 'ic', 'ol', 'le'. It is silent on 'ic' in words like proficient or athleticism. The peaks are mixed and the evidence is thin.
result.label: Control Systems title; scattered suffixes

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'able' (and 'ably') when it completes the word "undeniable". It stays silent on 'able' in other words such as "undependable" and "unmistakable". Members detect 'und' and 'eni' pieces before it.
result.label: 'able' in "undeniable"

result.description: Fires on varied technical or academic terms in layer 0, most strongly ' Binding' at the start of "Binding Theory", and also ' Set', ' interact', ' remain', 'server', 'js'. Members are mostly token detectors for unrelated words. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered technical terms, 'Binding' peak

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ness' when it completes a word such as compactness, closedness or boundedness, mostly in topology and analysis text. Members detect 'ness' and preceding stems like compact, closed and act.
result.label: 'ness' suffix after word stem

result.description: Fires on single capital letters (O, U, H, X, V) in the middle of all-caps words or acronyms, especially after "LE" (FLEXIBLE, ALLEVIATE, LEXRank). Weak elsewhere; the logits predict word-continuation pieces.
result.label: Capital letter inside all-caps word

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece 'antly' at the start of a text (sentence-initial adverb like "Importantly,"), and weakly on ' currency' and ' derivatives' in finance contexts. Fires on a few specific tokens, not on a shared meaning.
result.label: 'antly' plus currency/derivatives tokens

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ary" (also "ons") completing the word "solitary"/"solitons", after the " solit" piece. Members include a " solit" detector and an "ary" detector. Silent on "aries" in other words.
result.label: "ary" in solitary/solitons

result.description: Fires on ' stage' and ' theatre' (stage designers, theatre types) in performing-arts text; weak firing on a few other nouns like plate or sandy. Driven by token detectors for stage/theatre plus topical members like fiction, jazz, ancient.
result.label: stage / theatre word detector
' defense' in biological/security text
result.description: Fires on the token ' defense' (all 64 peaks), mostly in biological or immune defense contexts such as 'passive defense', 'defense mechanisms'. Driven mainly by an attention latent that detects 'defense/defence' itself, plus weak security/mechanism members.

Fires on abstract nouns of doubt or discord, mostly ' uncertainty', also ' confusion', ' conflicts' and 'Conf'. Members are detectors of these words (uncertainty, confusion, conflict, ambiguity) plus some generic context members.
result.label: uncertainty / confusion / conflict nouns

result.description: Fires on word-final or mid-word fragments completing a longer word, mostly 'in' in "Gauguin", also 'os' in "pilus" and 'images' in "pilgrimages". Silent on 'in' in other words like "refinement" or "strain".
result.label: Word-piece endings in Gauguin/pilgrimages

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside "decentralized/decentralization" ('ral' after 'decent'), on ' random' before "-ness/-ization", and weakly on ' fund' in "fundament". Silent on 'ral' in "centralized", so it needs the 'decent' prefix.
result.label: decent-ral, random, fund word pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix token 'ism' (as in -ism words such as idealism, pragmatism), including when it appears as a standalone piece. Driven mainly by a detector attention member for 'ism'. Weaker on 'ism' ending longer words like imperialism.
result.label: 'ism' suffix token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' inner', most strongly in "inner product (space)" in math text; only weakly (about 38%) on the ordinary sense, as in "inner workings" or "inner motivation". Mainly driven by an attention latent that detects ' inner'.
result.label: ' inner' in inner product

result.description: Fires on generic container nouns like " content", " item", " text", " items", especially as the head noun after "the" or "each" (e.g. "each item", "the content of"). Silent on unrelated sentences. Members are mostly detectors of these same tokens.
result.label: Content/item/text noun detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' design' when it starts a word or phrase (design, designing, designers) as a standalone word. It stays silent when ' design' follows a prefix word, as in "ship design" or "process design", or follows "to". Predicts suffixes like -ing, -er, -or.
result.label: ' design' as standalone word start

result.description: Fires on the piece 'i' in the middle of the word "idioms" (after "id"), and more weakly on 'iom' in "idiomatic". Members detect the preceding "id" piece.
result.label: 'i' inside "idioms"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'hr' (e.g. in "Phrase", "Bohr"), mostly when it starts or sits inside a word like "Phrase". Members are mainly detectors of 'hr' itself, plus a few related word-piece detectors.
result.label: 'hr' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces of "safeguarding" (mainly "arding" and "egu" after "safegu"), with weaker firing on "protecting" or "protective". Members detect the "egu" and "arding" pieces and protect-related tokens.
result.label: safeguarding word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' tools' when it follows a modifying word or phrase in technology or education text (e.g. "digital tools", "software tools", "range of tools"). It stays silent when ' tools' starts the text with no preceding context.
result.label: ' tools' after a preceding word

result.description: Fires on the word piece "bi" (' bi'/'bi') at the start of bio- words such as biomes, biology, symbiotic, biogenic. It pushes toward continuations like 'ological', 'otic', 'ology'. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: bi- piece in bio words

result.description: Fires on assorted word pieces such as 'TO' (WTO), 'ie' in names (Lucie, Curie), 'eu', and ' JOIN' in SQL. They are mostly mid-word fragments or uppercase tokens, with no single shared meaning. Logits favour word-completion pieces.
result.label: Mixed word fragments: TO, ie, eu, JOIN

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pid' at the start of "pidgin(s)" or "pidginisation" in text about language contact. Members are mostly weak attention latents on linguistic and academic words, plus one ' pid' detector.
result.label: ' pid' in pidgin

result.description: Fires on the word piece "refix" (as in prefix, prefixes) and on " prefix"/" suffix", in text about affixes and word formation. Weak on related linguistic words. Silent on other language-structure text.
result.label: prefix word piece 'refix'

result.description: Fires on the token 'red' as a word-ending piece, as in verbs ending in -red (e.g. "...red the development"). It stays silent when 'red' sits inside "ingredients". Weaker on 'med' in "medicine".
result.label: 'red' suffix piece, not ingredients

result.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis ' (' after a term, mostly in math, logic or technical text, where it introduces an example, symbol or gloss like "(one)" or "(~)". Silent on some parentheses in plain prose.
result.label: Opening parenthesis in technical text

result.description: Fires on name pieces ' Graham' and 'neg'/'ie' in 'Carnegie' (Graham Bell, Carnegie). Mostly token detectors for these name pieces, with weak activation on a few unrelated words.
result.label: Graham / Carnegie name pieces
' reci' word-piece (reciprocity)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' reci' at the start of words like reciprocal, reciprocity and reciprocating. It also fires weakly on 'reci' in recipe. Members are mostly detectors of ' reci' and 'pro' pieces.

Fires on the piece "it" (and "itate", "ating", "ates") inside "facilitate" and its forms (facilitating, facilitator). It stays silent on "it" in other words such as audit, prioritize and competitiveness.
result.label: "it" inside facilitate

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'id' or 'ym' right after the prefix 'ox' (oxidation, oxymorons), mostly in the middle of those words. It stays silent on 'id' without a preceding 'ox', as in word-initial 'idation' or 'multidimensional'.
result.label: 'id'/'ym' after 'ox' prefix

result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after the word "power" (e.g. "the power of a test"). It stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like "consequences of" or "form of". Weaker on "powered". Members detect "power" and "System" tokens.
result.label: ' of' right after "power"

result.description: Layer-0 latent that fires on a few specific tokens: 'ender' in "Gender", ' consent', ' Crow' and ' Jim' (as in Jim Crow). It looks like a mixed token detector with weak consistency, driven by token-specific attention members.
result.label: Gender / consent / Jim Crow tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' little' in all its uses, such as 'a little bit', 'a little slow' and 'little-known'. It is driven mainly by a layer-0 attention detector for ' little' itself, with the other members adding small contributions.
result.label: ' little' token detector
Word-start 'li' / 'lipid' pieces
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' li' and the following pieces 'pid'/'pop' in words like lipid, lipoprotein, and liability. It is strongest in lipid biochemistry text. It stays silent on unrelated general text.

Fires on the word piece 'ap' (as a start of words like 'aporation', 'apotransp', 'apifying', or in 'Heap', 'leap', 'gap'). Driven by two attention latents that detect 'ap' itself. Weaker on 'leap' and 'gap'.
result.label: 'ap' word piece detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' conversion', mostly when it starts a sentence or clause as the subject (e.g. "conversion process involves…"). It stays silent when 'conversion' follows a noun, as in "energy conversion" or "the conversion of".
result.label: Sentence-initial ' conversion'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' che' at the start of "chef(s)" and "cheese" in cooking text. It stays silent on some ' che' tokens, e.g. "chewing" and some "chefs" contexts. Members are token detectors for che/fs and culinary words.
result.label: ' che' in chef/cheese words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " anth" (anthem, anthology, anthropo-), where a longer word is being spelled out. Weakly fires on other word-start fragments like " ast" and " mach". Predicts word continuations such as 'ust', 'ry', 'rop'.
result.label: " anth" word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the piece 'in' (also 'if', 'id', 'il') right after the prefix 'mult' in words like multinomial, multiumiality, multidisciplinary. Silent on 'in' elsewhere, such as standalone 'in' or after a period.
result.label: 'in' after 'mult' prefix

result.description: Fires on a few specific tokens: ' highway'/' Highway' and SQL ' JOIN' (e.g. after FULL, OUTER, using), with an occasional ' Rob'. Weak firing elsewhere; members are mostly generic attention detectors.
result.label: highway and JOIN tokens

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uv' in fluvial/fluvially (fl+uv+ial), a layer-0 token detector; also rarely on 'APP'. Driven mainly by an attention latent that detects 'uv' itself, with 'ial' and 'fl' pieces as support.
result.label: 'uv' in fluvial

result.description: Fires on the word piece "amp" inside "damp" words (damping, damped, overdamped). It weakly fires on "amp" in other words like "stamps" and "ramparts". Members are mostly detectors of "amp" in the previous-layer attention.
result.label: "amp" in damping/damped
Word-start fragments: tra, obser, exer
result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces such as ' tra' (traits, trainer), ' obser' (observers), ' exer' (exercises) and ' pros', where a suffix is expected next. It is silent on ' tra' at the very start of a document.

Fires on the token " note" (musical note, note header) and on word pieces like "ocity" (velocity) and "ody"/"ythm". Several members detect these tokens directly. Weak, mixed evidence on what else it needs.
result.label: ' note' and 'ocity' token pieces

result.description: Fires on the word right after "significant" (adv-, progress, period, impact, use, contributions), where a noun of change or development is expected. Members detect "significant" and change/period nouns. Silent on ' adv' without a preceding "significant".
result.label: Word following "significant"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " cross" (also " heter") at the start of a compound like cross-validation, cross-temporal or crossroads. It stays silent when " cross" follows "of", "into" or "and" before a hyphenated cross-cultural or cross-linguistic term.
result.label: " cross" compound prefix

result.description: Fires on the token ' Music' when it appears as a topic or heading in lists of subjects or courses (e.g. 'History of Music', 'Music Licensing'). Weakly on ' musical'. Silent on similar list items like ' Media'.
result.label: ' Music' in topic lists

result.description: Fires on the contraction piece 'll (as in "they'll") right after an apostrophe, with weaker firing on 's. Members detect apostrophes and 'll tokens. The contrast text has no contraction.
result.label: 'll contraction suffix

result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces and mid-word tokens (e.g. 'ic' in "Gloster-ic", ' Maxim', ' Column', 'ort'), mostly early-layer token detectors for varied rare words. Silent on 'ic' in common words like "strategic". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered rare word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ch' (mostly the start of "chord", also in "chocolate"), with a few hits on ' right'. Driven by members that detect ' ch' and ' right' on the current token.
result.label: ' ch' piece, as in chord

result.description: Fires on scattered, unrelated tokens (word pieces like 'term', 'diverse', 'to', 'had', 'early', 'round') in academic-style text. No dominant token or pattern; members are diffuse layer-0 attention latents. Likely a weak layer-0 mix of token detectors predicting open-ended continuations.
result.label: Scattered mixed-token layer-0 latent

result.description: Fires on the piece 'voir' in "reservoir" and on the token 'FS' (as in BFS/DFS), with weaker firing on ' below'. Driven by token-specific attention detectors for 'FS' and 'voir'.
result.label: 'voir' in reservoir and 'FS'

result.description: Fires on 'ieve' in "sieve" (Sieve of Eratosthenes/Atkin) and on ' composite' (composite numbers/materials), mostly when the word repeats or is already established in the passage. Weak on a few other technical nouns.
result.label: sieve / composite word detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the ' $' token opening inline LaTeX math (e.g. "$P$", "$f$"), with minor firing on word pieces like ' pas' and ' bin'. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Dollar sign opening inline math

result.description: Fires on the token 'CT' (as in CT scans, PET/CT, SPECT, RCTs, acronym pieces). Driven mainly by an attention member that detects 'CT' itself. Peaks on every 'CT' example; weak elsewhere.
result.label: CT acronym token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " derivative" (finance or calculus senses, also plural) and on " repeated", as in "repeated games". Members are mostly token detectors for derivative and repeated, plus financial-word context.
result.label: derivative / repeated word detector

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer words split into pieces: 'ram' in trigram/pyramid/unigram, ' Er' in Eratosthenes, ' Jud' in Judgment/Judith. Needs the specific word context; silent on other names in lists.
result.label: Word fragments: ram, Er, Jud

result.description: Fires on a few specific words: "depends"/"depend", "intercept(s)" and "attacks", mostly in technical or logical text such as security or argument discussions. Upstream members are mainly token detectors for depend, attack and related words.
result.label: depend / intercept / attacks words

result.description: Fires on the token ' Re' when it is the start of "Reality" right after "Virtual" in repeated "Virtual Reality" lists. It stays silent on other words like "Real-time". Weak activity on a few other tokens.
result.label: ' Re' after Virtual (Reality)

result.description: Fires on the token " edges", mostly in graph-theory text (edges, vertices, faces) and also for physical edges like sharp edges. Members detect " edges"/" edge" and related graph words such as vertices and boundaries.
result.label: ' edges' token (graph theory)

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece ' dis' at the start of words like "disruption", and occasionally on 'de' in "crude" or '-' in "COVID-19". Seems to detect word-initial prefix pieces that precede a continuation. Members include several ' dis' detectors.
result.label: ' dis' prefix in disruption

result.description: Fires on the token ' establishment' (and ' establish'), mostly when it is not directly preceded by 'the'. It stays silent on 'the establishment of ...' in history and finance text. Members are detectors of establish-words.
result.label: ' establishment' without preceding 'the'

result.description: Fires on the token ' raw' (as in raw materials, raw meats, raw data), mostly driven by attention members that detect earlier ' raw' tokens. It predicts nothing clear next. It fires weakly on ' hard'.
result.label: ' raw' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ble' when it ends a word split into pieces, such as Hub|ble, Wob|ble, integra|ble and hum|ble. Members detect the preceding piece (Hub, integra) and 'ble' itself.
result.label: 'ble' suffix after split word

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'or' in "rhet-or-ic" (and 'rag' in "pragmatics") when the word is split into pieces. It needs the preceding "rhet" piece. It stays silent on 'or' in other splits, such as "Oxymorons" or "Rhetor-ical" after a capital.
result.label: 'or' in split word rhetoric

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of a rare or multi-piece word, most strongly 'hip' in "Entity-Relationship" and also 'ie', 'ua', 'jar' in names. Silent on 'hip' in "Partnership", so it needs the specific word.
result.label: 'hip' in Entity-Relationship

result.description: Fires on uppercase word-piece endings in all-caps text (LE in PEOPLE/PROBLEM, Y in ANYTHING, CE, BC in dates). Mostly capital fragments inside words, plus BC after years.
result.label: All-caps word-ending fragments (LE, Y, BC)

result.description: Fires on ' kitchen' (mostly when it recurs after earlier kitchen context), and on ' Nations' in 'United Nations' / 'Wealth of Nations'. Also fires weakly on a few other tokens like 'TO'. Silent on a kitchen that starts the text.
result.label: kitchen and Nations tokens

result.description: Fires on the 'ym' piece in "Polymer" and on ' polym' in polymer-related text, especially in polymer topic headings. Weakly fires on 'zym' in enzyme. Silent in other biology/materials headings.
result.label: Polymer word pieces (polym/ym)

result.description: Fires on word pieces in rare or foreign-looking terms, mostly the end of "Art Nouveau" (nouveau, au), plus "SQL", "Bau" and "Ga" in Gaudí. Predicts word-suffix continuations. Peaks are scattered across tokens, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Art Nouveau and rare word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " signal" (also satellite, audio, recording) in lists of technical fields like telecommunications, imaging and signal processing. Silent on a similar passage without such a word.
result.label: signal in telecom/imaging lists

result.description: Fires mostly on ' cup' (and 'set') in measuring-cup contexts like "1/4 cup" or "cup set", with weaker hits on ' fun' and a few other word pieces. Logits suggest word-suffix continuations. Mixed evidence.
result.label: measuring cup token

result.description: Fires on scattered, unrelated tokens: ' Dynam' (Dynamics), ' Vietnam', 'ME' repeats, LaTeX braces, and mid-word pieces. Members are mostly single-token detectors for these. No shared meaning; the evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Mixed token detectors (Dynam, Vietnam, ME)

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on scattered, unrelated tokens: 'ent' in "authentically", ' values', 'eness', ' reject', ' density'. Peaks are mixed, with only 12% consistency. Weak evidence of an existentialism/philosophy flavor; members are diffuse token-level attention latents.
result.label: Mixed word-piece peaks, diffuse

result.description: Fires on ' levels' (and ' rates') as the head noun after a quantity-like noun or modifier, e.g. "CO2 levels", "inflation levels", "interest rates". Silent on text without these words. Driven by ' levels' and ' rates' token detectors.
result.label: levels/rates after measured quantity

result.description: Fires on the word piece " exam" (also " scr") at the start of verbs like "examines" in academic text, mostly after a subject such as "examination" or "section". It pushes towards continuations like "ines" or "ined".
result.label: " exam" verb stem start

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ist' or 'ism' right after 'national' (nationalist, nationalism). Silent on the same suffixes after Social, commun, capital. Members detect 'national' and 'ism' tokens.
result.label: -ist/-ism after 'national'

result.description: Fires on technology-modifier words like " mobile", " tele", " electronic" (and occasionally " kin", " domestic") that precede a noun such as phone, communication, or waste. Members include token detectors for mobile, tele and electronic.
result.label: mobile/tele/electronic modifier words

result.description: Fires on ' and' that follows a closing parenthesis or comma-separated clause in technical or grammatical prose, joining a new clause or item. It stays silent on 'and' joining simple adjacent nouns, like "rise and fall" or "subject, object, and".
result.label: ' and' after parenthetical or clause

result.description: Fires on the token 'aft' in 'shaft' and on ' loads'/' load' in mechanical engineering text (shafts, bearings, structural loads). Mostly driven by token detectors for 'aft' and 'loads'. Weakly pushes toward words like rotation and motion.
result.label: shaft 'aft' and 'loads' in engineering

result.description: Fires on the word " agents" / " agent" (AI agents, chemical agents, literary agents), pushing the next token toward agent-like words. Built from layer-0 attention heads that detect agent tokens, plus some weak shared context heads.
result.label: ' agent(s)' token detector

result.description: Fires on the tokens ' letters' (alphabet or character letters) and ' hair', with a weaker response on ' dye'. It is driven mostly by token detectors for 'letters' and 'hair'. Silent on a logographic-script passage with no such token.
result.label: ' letters' / ' hair' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' project' (rarely ' projects'), mostly in project-management text, including repeated 'project project' sequences. Driven by attention members that detect earlier ' project' tokens. Silent on a contrast passage that does not contain the word.
result.label: ' project' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on " Imperial" (also "ial" in "martial", " Self"), as in "Imperial Russian Army" or "Imperial China". The members are mainly token detectors for Imperial/imperial. The contrast gives no clear condition.
result.label: Imperial token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'od' when it follows 'mel' in melodic words (melodic, melodies, melodically). It stays silent on 'od' in other words such as 'embodied' or at the start of a text. Members detect 'mel' and 'od' pieces.
result.label: 'od' inside 'mel-od-' words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ital', mostly in "revitalize/revitalization" and also in "orbital". Predicts suffixes like -ization, -izing, -ized. It stays silent on related physics text that lacks the 'ital' piece.
result.label: 'ital' piece in revitalize/orbital

result.description: Fires on word endings (-ating, -ate, -ation, -ates) only when they complete the word "anticipate" and its forms. The same suffix after other stems (animating, investigating, navigating) stays silent.
result.label: Suffix of "anticipate" forms

result.description: Fires mostly on the '{' that follows a LaTeX \vec inside \( \) math in physics text (e.g. \vec{F}). Also weakly on scattered words like ' dictionary', 'MAN' and ' above'.
result.label: LaTeX \vec{ opening brace

result.description: Fires on the token 'GB' as a piece of an acronym, mostly the end of RGB, also AGB (asymptotic giant branch), and 'GB's' at the start. Driven mainly by a 'GB' token-detector attention member.
result.label: 'GB' acronym token

result.description: Fires on the token "word" (also " word", " Word"), especially as a second piece in compounds like "subword", "word-word" or "multiword", in NLP and linguistics text. Members are mostly detectors of word tokens.
result.label: "word" token in NLP compounds

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "intellectual" (journey, movement, and, thought, exploration, or pieces like ' purs'), when "intellectual" is the preceding word. Silent on ' purs' after "the".
result.label: Token following "intellectual"

result.description: Fires on " it" as the object right after a form of "make/making/made" (e.g. "making it challenging", "makes it suitable"), before an adjective. Silent on " it" as a subject. Members detect make/making tokens.
result.label: " it" after make/making

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'st' (e.g. in "stamas", "brushstrokes", "substantial", "21st") and on ' zeit' in "zeitgeist", mostly as a word-initial or mid-word fragment. Members are mostly layer-0 detectors of these pieces.
result.label: 'st' and 'zeit' word fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " Among" when it opens a document or sentence ("Among the many types…"). It is mostly driven by an Among-detector and document-start attention members. It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Sentence-initial " Among"

result.description: Fires on the verb " require" (also the "stub" piece in "stubborn"), mostly with a subject like algorithms or areas that need something. Members are token detectors for require/requires/necessitates.
result.label: ' require' verb token

result.description: Fires on improvement/simplification verbs, mainly " optimize", also " simplify", " validate" and " improve", in technical or engineering prose where the verb follows "to" or "and". Members are detectors of these verbs.
result.label: optimize/simplify verbs in technical text

result.description: Fires on the token " protein" (weaker on "prote" in "proteins"), mostly in biology or biochemistry text. It is driven by attention members that detect "protein" and "prote" tokens. It is silent in food and cuisine text.
result.label: ' protein' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments (er, an, m, at) completing a split word after a "ram"/"Cram"-like prefix, e.g. Cram[er], dram[at]iker. Silent on 'er' in ordinary words like foster or richer.
result.label: Mid-word piece after 'ram'

result.description: Fires on a few specific nouns, mostly ' hands' (e.g. washing hands), also ' pressure', ' stroke' and ' smoke'. Members are mostly detectors of those same tokens. It is silent on thermodynamics text.
result.label: hands / pressure / smoke noun tokens

result.description: Fires on the token 'ci' when it starts a word, as in "ci|ans" (a people name, e.g. Sicilians/Mycenaeans-style). It stays silent when 'ci' is in the middle of a word such as glaciers, speciation or decipher.
result.label: word-initial 'ci' token
'ly' piece in scientific word fragments
result.description: Fires on the token 'ly' when it is a word fragment inside technical words (hydrolysis, glycolysis, cyclic terms like -lysis, -clys). It stays silent on 'ly' as an adverb suffix (singly, mistakenly).

Fires on the word piece ' ep' (start of words like epic, epistemic, epigenetic), mostly in "epic" contexts. Driven by attention members that detect ' ep'/' Ep' tokens. It was silent on one 'epistemic' example, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' ep' word-piece (epic, epistemic)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ru' when it is the start of a longer word such as dis-ru-ptions, Inter-ru-ptions, Inst-ru-ments or -ru-ence. It is silent where the 'ru' piece is missing. It predicts word continuations.
result.label: 'ru' piece inside longer words

result.description: Fires on the token " gained" (e.g. "gained popularity", "gained access", "gained momentum"). The circuit is mostly token detectors for "gained" and "gain" in early attention latents. The contrast has no "gained", so it gives no condition.
result.label: ' gained' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and hyphens that likely continue into a longer word or compound (Tar|ski, Fern|ande|z, noise-reducing, email correspond|ence). Peaks are scattered across tokens and consistency is low; the same '-' stays silent in other compounds.
result.label: Word-continuation pieces and hyphens

result.description: Fires on words about ensuring or securing, such as "protected", "sure" (make sure), "managed", "ured" and "ensure", mostly in security or system-management text. Members include detectors for "sure", "protected", "secure" and "managed".
result.label: ensure/protect/manage verbs

result.description: Fires on the capitalized token ' Three', mostly in titles and names like "Three-Body Problem", "Three Mile Island", "Three Dimensions". Driven mainly by a ' Three' token detector in layer 0 attention.
result.label: Capitalized ' Three' in titles

result.description: Fires on word pieces ('-', 'ity', 'ist', 'istic') that directly follow the word "human", as in "human-centered", "humanity", "humanist". Silent on hyphens after other words like avant-, self-, Pre-.
result.label: Suffix or hyphen after "human"

result.description: Fires on word pieces following the prefix "aff" (aff-able, aff-ix, aff-inity, aff-irm), the continuation after "aff". Members include detectors of " aff" and of the suffix pieces.
result.label: Word piece after "aff-"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " collabor" (collaborate, collaborative, collaborating) and on " collaboration". Members are mostly detectors of the same token plus related words like " team". It is silent on related group-work text that lacks the word.
result.label: collabor- word detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'la' completing the name Isabella (after "Isabel"), as in Isabella I of Castile or Isabella of France. Silent on 'la' in other words such as "enslaved".
result.label: 'la' in Isabella

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (comma, 'man', ' in', ' as') in text around the name "Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar"; peaks look like pieces of that name or the passage. Other commas stay silent. Evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Chandrasekhar name passage, scattered tokens

result.description: Layer-0 latent peaking on varied tokens: 'line' in 'streakline', ' of', ' a', ' that', 'ant', ' pole'. It seems to fire on word-final pieces completing a compound or technical term, but silent on 'streamline' as a verb. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Technical compound word endings

result.description: Fires on a few specific word starts that mean altered or non-standard: " irregular", " fro" (frost/frozen), " modified", " narrow", " alter". Members are mostly detectors of each of these tokens. Predicts suffix pieces like -ing, -able.
result.label: irregular/fro/modified token set
'les' ending 'ensembles'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'les' completing the word "ensembles" (after 'emb'), mostly in music text. It stays silent on 'les' in "jungles". Weaker on similar word-piece endings such as 'ices'.
Fires on the word piece ' d' when it starts "dough" in cooking and baking text (rolling, folding, preparing dough). It is weaker on other d- words like dining or dishes in culinary contexts.
result.label: ' d' starting "dough" in cooking

result.description: Fires on the token ' civil' itself, in civilization, civilized, civil war, civil liberties and civil rights. Members are mostly ' civil' and ' Civil' token detectors in layer 0 attention.
result.label: ' civil' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' when it completes the word "Critical" (after the piece "Crit"), e.g. in titles like "Introduction to Critical Listening". It stays silent on 'ical' in philosophical or empirical.
result.label: 'ical' completing "Critical"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "jection" (in objection, rejection, introjection), and weakly on " views" or " sees". Layer-0 attention members detect "jection", " ob" and "jections" tokens.
result.label: "jection" word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'icult' in "multiculturalism"/"multicultural", mainly when it starts a token after "mult". Driven by an 'icult' token detector and a following 'ural' detector. Weakly fires on "that" in lists of demonstratives.
result.label: 'icult' in multicultural

result.description: Fires on ' repository' most often, plus scattered word-start pieces like ' TH', ' SY', 'READ', ' management' in titles or all-caps text. Mixed and weakly consistent; members are mostly detectors of earlier-token words.
result.label: ' repository' plus scattered word pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces meaning replace/eliminate/service, such as ' replacing', ' serv' (servicing), ' elimin' (eliminating), and ' seg'. Seems mostly early-layer token detection of these specific pieces, in technical or database text.
result.label: Replace/eliminate/service word pieces

result.description: Fires on a few specific word-start pieces, mostly ' Par' (Paradox, Parallel, Paréto), also ' brut' (brutal/brutality), ' violence' and ' duplicate'. Members are per-token detectors for these pieces; it is silent on plain structural text.
result.label: Par-/brut-/violence word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces ' Ph' and 'on' (and 'en', 'er') in the word-start "Phon-"/"Phen-"/"pher-" family, mostly "Phonetics", when the preceding Ph piece is present. Members detect Ph/ph tokens and phonetic/linguistic context.
result.label: Ph-/Phon- word-piece in phonetics

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Arch' at the start of a word, such as Archimedes, Archer or Architectural. It fires weakly on ' Er' at word starts. It is driven mainly by members that detect ' Arch' itself.
result.label: ' Arch' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on scattered word-start pieces (' conj', ' strateg', ' propag', 'F', 'AL') in early positions of a text, often after a preceding word. Silent on ' conj' in some contexts. Members are mostly generic document-start and prior-token attention latents. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word-start fragments, mixed

result.description: Fires on the word " geometric" (occasionally "geomet" in "geometrical"), fairly regardless of context. Members include detectors of "geometric" and "geometry" tokens in earlier positions, plus some generic shared context.
result.label: ' geometric' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece right after the prefix "un" (un-re-, un-le-, un-int-, un-met, un-c), when a word is being built from "un". It stays silent on "int" after hyphens, as in "carbon-intensive" and "well-intentioned".
result.label: Word piece after "un" prefix

result.description: Fires on the final capital letter of an acronym, mostly the 'T' in "IoT" (also the W in EDW, M in EDM), after the preceding acronym piece such as Io or ED. It stays silent on ordinary text.
result.label: Acronym-final letter, IoT

result.description: Fires on a mix of words like " help", " consult(ation/ant)", " means", and " Institute"/" Agency" in organization names. Peaks are varied, with no single dominant token; members are mostly per-token detectors for these words.
result.label: help/consult/means/Institute word mix

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on a mixed set of specific tokens (' stroke', 'sun', ' verse', ' Range', ' feeling', 'Song'). Members mostly detect individual topical nouns; no common context or construction is evident.
result.label: Scattered tokens: stroke, Range, verse
' compreh' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compreh' (start of "comprehensive"/"comprehension"), mostly before "-ensive". Driven by attention latents that detect ' compreh' itself. It predicts continuations like 'ension' and similar understanding-related pieces.
Fires on the word piece 'ass' inside split words such as 'seagrass', 'agrass', or 'encompassing'. It weakly fires on 'agr', 'und', 'ang' pieces. Members detect these pieces, especially after 'agr'.
result.label: 'ass' word-piece after 'agr'

result.description: Fires on the word " factors" (also " factor"), strongest when it starts a sentence or follows another factor-type noun, as in "factors influence" or "environmental factors". Members mostly detect the same token.
result.label: ' factors' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece ' trom' (trombone, trombonists), and weakly on ' Riemann', ' Group' at a heading start, and 'bon'. A mix of a few specific tokens, each detected by its own token-specific upstream latent.
result.label: ' trom' (trombone) plus Riemann/Group

result.description: Fires on the token 'icians' (the plural -icians ending) when it appears on its own, for example at the start of a text. It stays silent when 'icians' completes a word such as mathemat|icians or mus|icians.
result.label: Standalone 'icians' token

result.description: Fires on the plural token ' electrons' (also 'rons' in neutrons) in physics/chemistry text. Silent on singular 'electron' in the contrast. Members are mostly detectors of ' electrons' and ' electron'.
result.label: plural ' electrons' token

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al' when it follows the word 'institution' (institutional, institutionalizing). It stays silent on 'al' in other words like instrumental or bilateral, or at the start of a text.
result.label: 'al' after 'institution'

result.description: Fires on function words or word pieces (' and', ' to', ' of', 'ing', 'ely') that directly follow "speaking" or "convers-" words. It stays silent on ' and' after other nouns. Members detect speaking, conversation and language tokens.
result.label: Token after speaking/conversation words

result.description: Fires on ' playing' and related forms (' play', ' game', ' games', ' player') across contexts. Members are mostly detectors of play and game tokens. Silent on unrelated text such as grammar.
result.label: play / playing / game token

result.description: Fires on the pieces of "encompass" (the "ass" in encomp-ass-ing, and the endings -es/-ed/-ing after encompass), and weakly on the following " the". Needs the word to be a form of "encompass".
result.label: encompass word pieces

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces 'ing'/'ING'/'ed' in "blanching"/"blanched" (after 'anch'), plus 'bean' in Caribbean, in cooking text. Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like maintaining or cooking.
result.label: Suffix after 'anch' (blanching)

result.description: Fires mainly on 'ik' in "Rubik's" and on particles after "take/taking" (out, up, into, place). Mixed peaks; members include an 'ik' detector and a take-verb detector.
result.label: Rubik's 'ik' and take-particles

result.description: Fires mainly on the token ' zoom' (zoom lenses, zooming in/out) and on ' Energy' (e.g. Dark Energy). Members include a ' zoom' detector and a ' Dark' detector. Fits a small set of specific tokens.
result.label: ' zoom' and ' Energy' tokens

result.description: Fires on word pieces following "el" in words like eliciting, elucidation, elude, elusive, elasticity, elution (uc, ic, it, iting, ud, us). Members detect "el" and "astic/ution" pieces. It needs the "el-" prefix.
result.label: Pieces after el- (elicit, elucidate)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer, rarer words (Quattro-cent-o, emanci-pat-ory, parab-ola, underdog bre-ed), where more word pieces are expected next. Peaks are scattered and the members are mostly generic first-layer token detectors, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of rare words

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after the word "center" (center of electron density, center of gravity, center of commerce). Weaker on "cent-ers" pieces. Silent on 'of' after other nouns like top, middle, details.
result.label: ' of' after "center"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Sem' / ' sem' (Semantic, semicolons, semiconductor), most strongly at the start of a line in a list of "Semantic ..." headings. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' Sem' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after part/component/constituent nouns (parts of, constituents of, half of, component of). Silent on ' of' after abstract nouns like understanding, pace, control, moments.
result.label: ' of' after part/component nouns

result.description: Fires on the token right after "health" (suffixes like -y, -ier, -ful, or following words like care, and, measures). Members detect " health" and "care" in the previous position.
result.label: Token following "health"

result.description: Fires on word pieces in historical linguistics text about reconstructing ancestral languages (ancest-, reconstruct, languages, past). Peaks vary across related words in this topic; it weakly pushes toward families/populations.
result.label: Ancestral language reconstruction words

result.description: Fires on the words support / assist / assistance (and Support, assistants, supportive) as noun or verb meaning help. Members include detectors for support, assist, aid tokens. Silent on contrast with no such word.
result.label: support / assist help words
astr- word-start piece (gastro/astronomy)
result.description: Fires on the word piece "astr" (also "astro"), mostly in "gastronomy", "gastric", "gastrointestinal" and "astronomy". Early-layer token detector, backed by attention members that detect "astr"/"astro" themselves.
Fires on the piece 'an' completing the name "Raman" (as in Raman scattering/spectroscopy), after the ' Ram' token. Members detect ' Ram' and 'an' in this word; silent on other spectroscopy text.
result.label: 'an' in Raman

result.description: Fires on the words " hand" and " table"/" Table" (periodic table, data table, hand disinfection, "on the other hand"), mostly as the token itself. Members are mainly token detectors for table, Table, hand and Period. Silent on hash-table text with no such word.
result.label: hand / table token detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside proper names of ancient peoples and places, such as Akk-ad, Az-te(c), and Moh-and. Silent on 'ad' in unrelated words like 'cradles'. Members detect name-start pieces like Az and kk.
result.label: Name-ending pieces: Akkad, Aztec

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ings' completing "recordings" (also the hyphen in "record-keeping"), after the word piece "record". Weakly fires on "catalog-ing". Members detect "record" and nearby context.
result.label: 'ings' in "recordings"

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'itter' (jitter, litter), with weaker peaks on a few other tokens like ' mine', ' smoke', ' processed', ' raw'. Mostly a detector of the 'itter' piece, mixed on the rest.
result.label: 'itter' word piece (jitter, litter)

result.description: Fires mostly on " Space" in mathematical vector-space terms (Null Space, Normed Space, Vector Space), and weakly on pieces like "Dim" or "-". Members include " Space" detectors. Logits are unclear.
result.label: " Space" in math space terms

result.description: Fires on the token ' because' (all peaks), including repeated 'because' in lists and clause-initial uses. Members are mostly ' because' detectors plus ' due' detector. The contrast text has no 'because'.
result.label: ' because' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'u' in "fiduciary", 'uck' in "pluck", 'ten' in "maintenance", and 'ability' in "profitability". It needs the piece to follow a specific word start (e.g. "fid"), as "fluctuating" stays silent.
result.label: Mid-word piece in fiduciary, maintenance

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'el' piece inside "Mandelbrot" (after ' Mand'), with weaker firing on other mid-word pieces like 'ag', 'ji', 'aring'. Members detect the preceding ' Mand' token.
result.label: 'el' in Mandelbrot

result.description: Fires on the word ' both' in mid-sentence, after a verb or preposition (master both, through both, led both), where it introduces a pair. It stays silent on sentence-initial 'Both'. An earlier ' both' detector feeds it.
result.label: Mid-sentence ' both'
'urd' piece in "absurd"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'urd' in "absurd" (absurdism, absurdity). It is driven by members that detect 'urd' and the preceding 'abs' piece. It fires only weakly on a few other words.

Fires on mid-word pieces like 'king' in Hawking, 'tr' in filtration, and hyphen/'ed' after 'buffer'. It seems to be a token-piece latent for word continuations, with weak, mixed evidence for a single trigger.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: Hawking, filtration, buffer

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'astic' (monastic), 'anti', 'orph', and on repeated ')(' or '[' punctuation in dense formula strings. Peaks are mixed; it seems to respond to word-piece tokens that start or continue a longer word.
result.label: Word fragments and bracket strings

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of rarely split words, mainly ' Pon' (Modus Ponens), ' Op' (Opus/Opéra), ' Christ', ' Ca'. Members are mostly single-token detectors for these pieces. Layer-0 token-piece detector with weak consistency.
result.label: Word-start fragments Pon/Op/Christ/Ca

result.description: Fires on the token ' era', mostly when it starts a clause or subject (e.g. "era's", "era set the stage"). It is weaker when "era" follows "the". Two members detect ' era' directly. The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' era' token detector

result.description: Fires on the beginning-of-document token <s> at the very start of a text. It stays silent on <s> tokens that appear after a preceding passage, such as after a period in a concatenated document.
result.label: Document-start token
' clear' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token " clear" (adjective, as in "clear objectives", or the start of "clearing"). Driven mainly by attention latents that detect " clear" itself; weaker on "the clear winner" and "clear directions".

Fires on the word piece ' ste' at the start of "steering" or "stewardship". It weakly fires on the following 'ering', 'er' and 'ward' pieces. The members are mostly detectors of ' ste' and 'ering'. It pushes towards 'ward' and 'er'.
result.label: ' ste' word-start (steering/steward)

result.description: Fires on the token ' objects' in mid-sentence, in technical or grammatical discussions (direct/indirect objects, programming objects). Silent on the one example where it begins the text, so it needs a preceding context.
result.label: ' objects' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'arch' (in hier-arch-ies, Eury-arch-aeota), 'min' (cul-min-ating, three-min-ute) and ' ve' in the middle of multi-piece words. Silent on name-initial lists. Members are detectors of these specific pieces.
result.label: Mid-word pieces arch/min/ve

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'an' as a fragment inside names or longer words (e.g. 'Wan', 'anan', 'ancial'), not on the standalone article. Silent on ordinary text. Members are mostly 'an' token detectors.
result.label: 'an' word-piece fragment

result.description: Fires on the hyphen (and 'sh' in 'workshops') right after the word "work", as in work-life or work-energy. Silent on hyphens after other words like AI-, well-, open-, mid-. Members detect 'work' and the hyphen.
result.label: Hyphen after 'work'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' when it completes the word "ecological" (after the piece 'ecolog'). It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like "analytical" or "biochemical".
result.label: 'ical' in ecological

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'iv' in "individual/indivisible" and 'or' in "absorbing", plus '/' in slash-separated lists. It is silent on 'iv' in "pivotal", so it needs particular word contexts.
result.label: Mid-word fragments iv/or in words

result.description: Fires on the token " Golden" (Golden Rice, Golden Age, Islamic Golden Age), mostly capitalized. Driven by attention latents that detect " Golden" itself. Weakly fires on lowercase "golden". Predicts " Age" as next token.
result.label: ' Golden' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' bal' (ballet, balloon), ' leg' (legatus) and ' scr' (scrutiny) that begin a longer word and need a continuation. Silent when ' bal' starts "balances". Members are detectors of those pieces.
result.label: Word-initial pieces bal / leg / scr

result.description: Fires on the comma (sometimes ' of') right after the word "example" in "for example," or "in this example,". Members mostly detect the preceding ' example' token. Other commas stay silent.
result.label: Comma after "for example"

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces: 'elf' in "shelf", ' pay' (pay, paying), and ' raised'. Members are detectors of these tokens plus 'sh'/'ave' pieces. No single shared meaning.
result.label: elf / pay / raised token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' insight', strongest when it is the sentence subject (e.g. "insight provides greater insight into…"), and weaker when it is the object after "gain" or "unique". Predicts ' into' next. Members include ' insight' and ' into' detectors.
result.label: ' insight' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " second"/" Second", most strongly in "second derivative (test)" in math contexts. It is weaker for "second" in other uses such as "second-most" or "second time". Members are mostly detectors of "second".
result.label: ' second' token, esp. second derivative

result.description: Fires on the piece 'atic' completing the word "pragmatic" (after "pragm"). It stays silent on 'atic' in other words such as "idiomatic". Members detect 'rag' and 'atic' pieces.
result.label: 'atic' in "pragmatic"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of longer words split into tokens (e.g. 'ract' in protracted, 'ing' in refracting, 'led' in dicotyledons, 'aching'), plus a few odd tokens like '\)'. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the circuit is diffuse and failed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of split words

result.description: Fires on the 'erson' piece in "Ford-Fulkerson" (the maximum flow algorithm name), helped by earlier detectors for Ford, F and ulk. Silent on other names like Vygotsky. Weak on a few odd tokens.
result.label: Fulkerson 'erson' piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Kan' at the start of words like Kanji, Kanban, Kana, mostly in Japanese-script or Kanban text. Weaker on 'ton' in cotton. A Kan-token detector circuit.
result.label: ' Kan' word-start token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'esian' completing "Bayesian" (after ' Bay'). Weak activation on 'antic' in "romantic" and ' semantic'. Members detect ' Bay' and 'esian' pieces.
result.label: Bayesian 'esian' suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' art' / ' Art', mainly when it begins "artistic" (split as Art+istic) or precedes an "-istic/-work" continuation, as in lists of "Artistic ..." headings. It stays quiet on 'art' as a plain noun after modifiers like digital, geometric or abstract.
result.label: ' art' as start of artistic

result.description: Fires on the word " share" (also " Share", weaker on " sharing"), mostly as a noun at the start of a text about shares or shareholders. Driven mainly by a layer-0 attention head detecting the same token.
result.label: Token ' share'

result.description: Fires on the piece "ought" inside "drought" (mostly in drought monitoring/control titles) and, more weakly, on " contrast"/"contrasting". Members detect "ought", "contrast" and "dr" prefixes.
result.label: "ought" in drought; "contrast"

result.description: Fires on a few scattered tokens, mainly ' support'/' supports' and ' patron', also ' Exit' (in "Late Exit") and word pieces like 'evangel'. Peaks are mixed, and the contrast does not show what else is needed.
result.label: support / patron / Exit mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ud' in "pudding", after a preceding 'p' (e.g. "plum pudding", "molten pudding"). Members detect 'ud', 'p' and 'ding' pieces. Weak activation on a few other word fragments.
result.label: 'ud' piece in pudding

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on scattered, unrelated tokens (' context', '3', ' poll', ' space', ' damage', word-start pieces) with no shared meaning; consistency is low and members are mostly token detectors. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered early-layer token mix

result.description: Fires on word pieces in real-time/computing text, mainly " dead" (deadline), " interrupt" (interrupt service routine), and "start". Early layer, so it mostly detects these tokens; weaker on "delay" and "lay".
result.label: dead(line) / interrupt in computing

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside surnames or rare proper names, mainly 'kal' in Kruskal and ' Wiener' (as in Wiener filter), plus occasional pieces like 'ch' in Elchetski. Looks like a layer-0 detector of name fragments, with mixed members.
result.label: Surname fragments: Kruskal, Wiener

result.description: Fires on the piece 'st' when it completes "amidst" (after ' amid'). It stays silent on 'st' in other words like "frost" or "overstated". Members detect ' amid' and 'st' pieces.
result.label: 'st' in "amidst"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'amma' in "gamma" (radiation, rays) and on 'zone' in "ozone", with a few weaker word-piece hits. Members are detectors of those specific tokens. It stays silent on other science text such as 'diamond'.
result.label: gamma / ozone word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ros' in "neuroscience" (split as neu|ros|cience), after the ' neu' piece. It also weakly fires on 'chem' in "neurochemical". The members detect 'ros' and 'neu' pieces.
result.label: 'ros' in neuroscience

result.description: Fires on plural abstract nouns like "functions", "structures", "systems" ending a math/technical noun phrase (e.g. "generating functions", "algebraic structures"). Silent on "functions" after adjectives like "linear" or "complex", so it needs the mathematical-theory context.
result.label: Mathematical "functions/structures" noun heads
Anthropocene word pieces (Anth, ene)
result.description: Fires on the word pieces of "Anthropocene", mainly the final "ene" and the initial " Anth". It also fires weakly on "ene" in "entrepreneurship" and on "ens" in "Athens". Members are detectors of Anth, anth, rop and ene pieces.

Fires on word-start fragments like ' sequ', 'continu', 'isson', ' scal', ' avail', where a longer word is being spelled out. Likely predicts suffix pieces such as 'ance', 'ential'. Members mostly detect these same fragments.
result.label: Word-start fragments (sequ, continu, avail)

result.description: Fires on determiners (mostly ' the', also such/their/an) directly after the preposition 'under'. Members are detectors of 'under' (including under- word pieces). It stays silent on 'the' after other words like undermine, like, understanding.
result.label: Determiner right after 'under'

result.description: Fires on the token 'Q' when it appears inside an acronym after 'CA' (e.g. CAQI, CAQA, CAQC), not on a standalone 'QA' at the start of a document. Members detect the 'CA' prefix.
result.label: Q after CA in acronyms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' integr' (as in "integrals"), mostly at the start of a text about calculus integrals. It predicts the continuation 'als'. Weakly fires on 'integrating' and 'integrate'. Several members are detectors of ' integr' itself.
result.label: ' integr' token (integrals)
'um' ending in petroleum
result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'um' completing a split word, mostly "petroleum" (also "petrole|um", "role|um"). Weak activation on other mid-word pieces like 'am' or 'gry'. Silent on the contrast text.

Fires on the adverb ' fully' (e.g. "engage fully", "fully appreciate"), especially when it follows a verb or repeats in a passage. Predicts participles like appreciated, understood, addressed. Members include attention detectors of ' fully' and ' truly'.
result.label: adverb ' fully'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' manip' (as in manipulation/manipulate), and also on ' Micro' in "Electron Microscopy" and sometimes ' prepar'. Members are mostly detectors of manip/micro pieces.
result.label: ' manip' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token " air" (also " Air" as in Airways) across meteorology, airport and pollution contexts. Driven mainly by an attention latent that detects " air" itself. Silent on sound-wave text without the word.
result.label: ' air' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' systems' when it follows a technical noun such as "power", "transport" or "communication" in engineering text. It stays silent when ' systems' starts the text or follows "avionics".
result.label: ' systems' after engineering noun

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in expository text (e.g. 'ctions' in reproductions, ' interactive', ' govern', ' injured', ' Aud', ' George'). Peaks are heterogeneous; likely predicts nouns like plans, schema, documents. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and noun-modifier tokens

result.description: Fires mostly on the German noun suffix piece 'ung' (Betrachtung, Ordnung, Überprüfung), with a few weaker hits on ' Warren', ' lake' and other scattered tokens. Members are mostly token detectors of 'ung', ' lake' and ' Warren'.
result.label: German 'ung' suffix detector

result.description: Layer-0 latent peaking on mixed tokens: ' various', ' the', ' in', and the pieces ' Confeder'/'ative'. Mostly function words or modifiers before a noun, with no consistent pattern. Members are diffuse attention latents; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed early-token modifiers (various, the, Confeder)

result.description: Fires on the token ' rest' (including the start of 'restoration', 'restructuring', and 'at rest'). It is driven mainly by attention members that detect ' rest' itself. It predicts continuations like 'ruct', 'raint' and 'oration'.
result.label: ' rest' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the odd token '!.' ending a sentence before a document break, and on ' hands' (e.g. "all hands", "backs of hands"), with a few word pieces like ' resol' and ' tu'. Mixed peaks; the circuit is mostly token-detector and generic members.
result.label: '!.' token and ' hands'

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'en' piece in "Enlightenment" (after En/light pieces), and weakly on ' Statistics' and 'more'. Predicts suffixes like 'ment'. Silent on 'en' in other words like "zenith".
result.label: 'en' in Enlightenment

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ud' in "feud-" words (feudalism, feudic...), and weakly on other mid-word fragments like 'us' in "luscious". Silent on 'ud' in "post-feudal", so it needs the particular word context.
result.label: 'ud' piece inside feud- words

result.description: Fires on the word piece " techn" (also " Techn", " technology"), mostly as the start of words like technological or technoscience. Silent on unrelated text. Supported by an attention member that detects " techn" itself.
result.label: techn- word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces or first pieces of multi-token technical words and names (hydro-logical, Mat-rices, Éd-ou-ard, Ni-ño), mostly in academic text. Silent on 'cial' in 'crucial'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Word-fragment pieces in technical words

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 's' attached to a grammatical or linguistic term (pronoun-s, homonym-s, synonym-s, noun-s) in text about language. Silent on verb or other 's' endings and word-initial 's'.
result.label: Plural -s on linguistics terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece "mon" (' mon', 'mon', ' Mon') when it starts or sits inside words like monomer, monastic, monology, monitor, Ammonia. Members are mostly detectors of the "mon" token itself. Predicts continuations like 'opol', 'ster', 'et'.
result.label: "mon" word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on digits and word pieces inside hyphen-or-dash separated lists of affixes or numbers, like "-2 -3 -4 -5 -6" or "-s, -ed". Members detect the hyphen/dash and preceding list digits.
result.label: Hyphenated affix/number list items

result.description: Fires on the token ' down', strongest in the phrasal verb "breaking/breaks down" (e.g. breaking down complex tasks). Weaker for "slowing down" and the "breakdown" piece. Members detect ' down', ' breaking' and ' break'.
result.label: ' down' after break

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Dar' (as in Darwin) at the start of a document or a title-like context, plus 'GT' and 'perimental'. It stays silent on ' Dar' after 'Charles' or mid-sentence, so it seems to need an early or heading position.
result.label: ' Dar' at document start

result.description: Fires on the word piece "circ" (also " circuit", "uits") as in circuits, circadian, and circuitry. Its members include several detectors of "circ" and "circuit" tokens. Contrast text has no such token.
result.label: circ / circuit word piece

result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces that begin or continue words like "Sc"-ore/Scandinavian/Scrubric, "custom", and "fine". Early-layer token detectors (Sc, custom, fine) feed it; no single shared meaning.
result.label: Sc-/custom/fine word-piece mix

result.description: Fires on the digit '3' inside long digit strings and numbers, such as IDs, codes and years like 1913. Members are mostly digit detectors; it stays silent on the contrast passage, which has other numbers.
result.label: Digit '3' in numbers

result.description: Fires on "ieval" in "Medieval" and on " medieval", mostly when the word is already being built or repeated in text about the Middle Ages. Members detect " Med", "ieval" and " medieval" tokens.
result.label: Medieval word detector

result.description: Fires on social-bonding nouns and verbs such as "belonging", "connections", "connect", "communication", "expression", "sense" in text about music or media fostering community. Peaks are mixed words sharing a social-connection role.
result.label: Social connection words in music/community text

result.description: Fires on capitalized ' Function' in title-case headings or topic lists (e.g. "Probability Density Function(s)"). Stays silent on lowercase "function" in running text. Driven by a ' Function' attention detector.
result.label: Capitalized ' Function' in titles

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' activ' (activist, activate, activism), and more weakly on ' initi' (initiate, initiatives) and ' concentr'. It is a token-level detector of these word-start pieces, driven mainly by an ' activ' attention member.
result.label: ' activ' word-start piece detector

result.description: Fires on 'root'/'roots' (plant-root context), and on word pieces like 'ation' in 'vegetation', and 'off' in 'runoff'. These appear in plant, soil and water text. It stays silent on 'ation' in conservation, degradation and elevation.
result.label: root words and vegetation/runoff pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " phase" and its variants (" phases", " stages", " Stage"), including repeated "phase" lists and "phase of development" text. Members are mostly detectors of earlier "phase" tokens.
result.label: phase token detector

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of rare capitalized words that continue into a longer word, mainly ' Rod', ' Prop' (Propulsion, Propellant), ' Font', and 'ri'. The member latents are mostly detectors of these fragments themselves.
result.label: Word-start fragments: Rod, Prop, Font

result.description: Fires on the token ' robust', most strongly at the start of 'robustness' and in other uses. Layer-0 members mostly detect ' robust' itself. It pushes the next token towards 'ness' and ' against'.
result.label: ' robust' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces right after the prefix "co" inside words like cooperative, coevolution, coexistence, coadaptation, coercion (oper, e, ex, ada, erst). Members detect " co" and "ating" tokens preceding it.
result.label: Word piece after "co-" prefix

result.description: Fires on the curly closing quote ’ that ends a single-quoted word or phrase mentioned as a word, such as ‘have’ or ‘until’, in text about language and grammar. It stays silent on an opening ’ at the start of a text.
result.label: Closing curly quote after quoted word

result.description: Fires on the word piece after "catal" (mostly "yz" in "catalyzed/catalyzing", also "yt" in "catalytic"). Members detect "catal", "yz", "yt" and "yst" pieces, so it needs the token to sit inside a catal- word.
result.label: catal-yz piece in "catalyzed"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' math' (before -ematician/-ématicians), 'SN', 'indu', and ' #', mostly early in a document or at an incomplete word piece. Predicts continuation pieces. Members detect math/science topic words.
result.label: ' math' and other word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the preposition ' at' after a verb or noun (occur at, produced at, event at), often before a location, point, rate or level. The contrast has no ' at', so the condition is not shown. Two members detect ' at' tokens.
result.label: Preposition ' at' detector

result.description: Fires mostly on ' $' opening inline LaTeX math (variables like $P$, $T$), and also on ' looks', ' someone', '£'. Mixed token set; the math-dollar case dominates.
result.label: Inline math dollar sign, plus looks/someone

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'els' completing the word "fuels" (e.g. fossil fuels, alternative fuels). It stays silent on 'els' in "panels". Members detect the preceding 'fu', 'fuel', 'foss', 'comb' pieces and energy context.
result.label: 'els' ending "fuels"
' my' token detector (layer 0)
result.description: Fires on the token ' my', including as a word piece in words like 'myofibrils' and 'myriad'. It is driven mainly by attention-based detectors of ' my' itself. The next-token logits are mixed, with no clear prediction.
Fires on the token " front" / "front" (as in frontier, Eastern front, front and rear), with weaker firing on Robin in "Round Robin" and Knight. Predicts suffixes like "ier", "iers", "line".
result.label: front token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'rane' when it completes the word 'membrane' (memb|rane). Members are attention latents that detect the preceding 'memb' piece and similar word-piece completions.
result.label: 'rane' ending 'membrane'

result.description: Fires on a mid-word piece ('us', 'm', 'ach', 'ou') inside a rare surname split into pieces, mainly Br-us-ilov and Kol-m-ogorov. Silent on 'us' ending Latinized names like Claus-ius, Linus, Malthus.
result.label: Mid-word piece in rare surnames

result.description: Fires mostly on the digit '1' beginning a year or number (16S, 1977, 1987) in text about Woese, Fox and 16S rRNA. It stays silent on '1' in other year contexts, such as 1770 or the 16th century.
result.label: Digit '1' in Woese 16S context

result.description: Fires on a verb-start piece such as ' enh' (also ' impact', ' stream') right after the adverb "significantly". It is silent on ' enh' after "can" or "and". Members detect "significantly" and "greatly" earlier in the text.
result.label: Verb after 'significantly' (enh-ance)

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix "-specific" after a hyphenated modifier (species-specific, genre-specific), and also on "uries" in "injuries" and "string". It looks like a few token detectors combined, not one clear concept.
result.label: "-specific" suffix, plus uries/string

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer split words, mainly ' Mi' (as in Miocene) and 'oc', plus Arabic 'و' and a few other pieces. The peaks are mixed and the circuit is mostly layer-0 attention members, so no single clear condition shows.
result.label: Word-initial fragments ' Mi', 'oc', Arabic 'و'

result.description: Fires on the 'c' piece inside "reconciliation" (after "recon"). Weaker on "-inary" in "multidisciplinary" and "pection" in "introspection". Silent on 'c' in transcending or intercultural.
result.label: 'c' in reconciliation

result.description: Fires on capitalized title-case words like " Exchange" in "Foreign Exchange Markets", and on " Direct" or " Foreign", at the start of a heading or topic phrase. Members detect the preceding word (Foreign, Direct) and finance or global terms.
result.label: Foreign Exchange / Direct title words
