result.description: Fires on ' evol' (as in "evolves") and on ' society' or the word right after it, such as "society evolves" or "society's". It stays quiet on "evol" after other subjects like science or philosophy. Members are mostly detectors of the word 'society'.
result.label: 'evolves' after 'society'

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "strong" (e.g. "strong acids", "strong and", "strong interaction", "strong-"), with "est" and "force" also peaking. Members mostly detect "strong" in the preceding context.
result.label: Token following "strong"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' spons' (sponsors, sponsorships, sponsoring), the start of "sponsor" words. Predicts continuations like 'ors', 'or', 'ored'. Driven mainly by attention latents that detect ' spons' itself.
result.label: ' spons' token (sponsor words)

result.description: Fires mainly on the token ' weight' (also 'aven' in 'leavening' and a couple of odd byte pieces). Members are mostly token detectors for ' weight', 'aven' and similar pieces. The contrast gives no clear extra condition.
result.label: ' weight' token detector

result.description: Fires on the digit token '6' in numeric strings, often at the start of a document or after another 6 (e.g. 666, 1660s). Weak on a '6' ending a year or number. Silent on non-numeric text.
result.label: Digit 6 token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mo' when it starts "moisture" (also "moist"), split into ' mo' + 'isture'. Layer-0 attention members detecting ' mo' drive it. The logits favor suffix pieces rather than whole words.
result.label: ' mo' piece in moisture

result.description: Fires on the period in the abbreviation "vs." (after " vs"), as in "character vs." or "Sequential vs." It stays silent on ordinary sentence-ending periods.
result.label: Period after "vs"

result.description: Fires on the capitalized token ' Active', mostly at the start of a document or title (e.g. "Active Listening"). It is weaker on sentence-initial "Active voice". Members include ' Active' and ' active' token detectors plus document-start attention heads.
result.label: ' Active' at text start

result.description: Fires on the lone token 'n' (also 'endent'), mostly mid-word as in super-n-ova, Car-n-ivores, Leib-n-iz, condem-n-ation, and on math variable n. Silent on contrast text without it.
result.label: Letter 'n' token mid-word

result.description: Fires on the token ' Lucas' in mathematical text about Lucas numbers/sequence and Édouard Lucas. Silent on the contrast, which has no 'Lucas' token. The main member is a Lucas token detector.
result.label: ' Lucas' in Lucas numbers

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oid' inside science/math words like solenoids, toroids and ellipsoid. It is silent on other tokens, such as the 'ino' in 'inospheric'. A same-token 'oid' attention detector drives it.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in solenoid/ellipsoid

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'onomy' (also 'ic', 'onom') completing "gastronomy"/"gastronomic" after "gastr". It is silent in unrelated cooking text, so it needs the word-start "gastr" piece.
result.label: gastr-onomy word completion

result.description: Fires on capitalized title-like words such as " Field" (Electric Field, Conformal Field), "osed" (Closed), " General" (General Relativity), and "ansion" in physics/math topic headings. Predicts word-continuation suffixes.
result.label: Physics/math term heads: Field, Closed, General

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ron" completing "neutron" (neut|ron), mostly in nuclear physics text. It weakly fires on "ron" in other words like "acronyms" and "Byron".
result.label: "ron" in "neutron"

result.description: Fires on the word " permissions" or " permission", mostly in computing and file-access text such as read/write/execute permissions. Members include detectors for permission(s) and file, plus many weak shared context members.
result.label: permission(s) token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'unk' (as in 'chunking'-style splits, e.g. 'unking'), and more weakly on name-final 'sky' (Mussorgsky, Chomsky). Driven mainly by an 'unk' token detector.
result.label: 'unk' word piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces like 'oring', 'izing', 'ical' and some words like ' Theory', ' of', ' graph' in academic text. Members detect word-start fragments (alleg-, Col-). It is silent on 'oring' after 'expl'.
result.label: Academic word suffix pieces (oring, izing)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and suffixes like 'able' in "predictable", 'reg' in "segregation", ' stable', across science-text passages. Peaks are scattered, and the same 'able' stays silent in other words (formable, unattainable, sustainable). Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word pieces in science text

result.description: Fires on the word " comfort" (as a noun, e.g. "audience's comfort", "longer term comfort"). Weak activation on a few other pieces such as " ut" and " refresh". Members include token detectors for " comfort" and " ut".
result.label: ' comfort' token detector
' you' as clause subject
result.description: Fires on the token ' you', mostly when it begins a clause as the subject (e.g. "you move", "you say", "you thought"). It stays silent when ' you' follows a relative or embedded word like "everything", "what" or "much". Weak response to ' Mexico'.
Fires on the token ' entity' (as in database or abstract entities), including at document start. The strongest member is an ' entity' token detector; the rest is mostly diffuse context.
result.label: ' entity' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece ' decor' (decorations, decorative, decorum, home decor), with weaker hits on ' credit', ' laugh', ' humor', ' memor'. It predicts suffixes like -able, -ative, -ains, so it fires on incomplete word stems.
result.label: ' decor' word stem

result.description: Fires on the pieces ' pr' and 'icing' that split the word "pricing", mainly in lists of pricing strategies (competitive pricing, skimming pricing). Weak on related words like "strategy" or "pricing purposes".
result.label: Split word "pricing" pieces

result.description: Fires on the token " air" (also " Air", and occasionally " coffee" or word pieces like " cas", " ar"), mostly in atmospheric or airline contexts. Silent on unrelated text. Members are mainly detectors of " air" itself.
result.label: ' air' token detector

result.description: Fires on the middle word pieces of the name "Brahmagupta" (mainly 'agu', also 'as' in "Brahmasphuta"), after "Brahm"/"hm". It also fires weakly on a few other name fragments, such as the "ach" in Banach.
result.label: Brahmagupta name fragment 'agu'

result.description: Fires on the word " from" when it begins a phrase (often at the start of a clause or document, or after a noun like "arise"), not after motion or transition verbs like "came from" or "transitioning from".
result.label: ' from' starting a phrase

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' circul' (as in circulation, circulatory, circulate), the start of the word split into pieces. It fires weakly on a few other word-initial fragments like ' sent' and ' bu'. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: ' circul' word-piece detector
' points' after math terms
result.description: Fires on the token ' points' (also ' point') in mathematical text, especially calculus phrases like "critical points" and "inflection points". Members detect 'point' and 'critical' tokens in earlier context.

Fires on the word "root"/"roots" (also root-, -ems in "stems", "derived"), mostly in linguistic or mathematical senses such as word roots and polynomial roots. Silent in the contrast text, which has no root token. Members are mostly detectors of root token variants.
result.label: root / roots token detector

result.description: Fires on a few specific words, mainly ' bread' (also in sourdough) and ' timing', with a few other tokens like ' evening'. Members are mostly detectors of those same tokens, so it looks like a token-identity latent over a mixed set of words.
result.label: bread / timing word detector

result.description: Fires on the word " both" (e.g. "both the...", "both a particle and"), with 100% consistency across peaks. Driven mainly by two attention latents that detect " both"; the other members are weak shared context.
result.label: ' both' token detector

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces like 'es' (also 'ing', 'er', 'en') ending a word, strongest on the plural 'es' of "dashes" in punctuation text. Silent on 'es' in other words like themes or climaxes. Members detect the preceding word piece 'dash'.
result.label: plural 'es' after 'dash'

result.description: Fires on items in comma-separated lists of abstract nouns or fields (e.g. "coord", "etc", "literature", "strateg", " in", " non") following a comma. Silent on ' in' used as a preposition in ordinary clauses.
result.label: Items in comma-separated topic lists

result.description: Fires on the bare token 'b' when it is a word-initial or standalone fragment (biosis, bined, bial, bebop), pushing toward continuations like 'ond', 'amb', 'ear'. Stays silent on ordinary full words.
result.label: Standalone 'b' word fragment

result.description: Fires on abstract mental or social nouns such as "feelings", "perception", "belief" and "power", mostly in social-science style text before "of". Members are diffuse layer-0 attention latents with no sharp discriminators. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Abstract mental/social nouns (feelings, perception)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " administr" (and the following "ators") in "administrators", especially as sentence subject ("administrators can/need to..."). Weak activation on "soci-" word pieces like sociolinguistic.
result.label: administrators word piece

result.description: Fires mainly on ' till' (glacial till, sediment), also ' mill' and ' throughout'. Peaks on these specific tokens in geology or engineering text, with a few unrelated weak hits like 'ould' and 'partici'. Mixed and partly noisy.
result.label: ' till' and ' mill' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of proper names or compound words, mostly 'undred' in "Hundred Years' War", and also on odd pieces like 'EL', 'tern', ' brother'. Peaks are mixed; the circuit is mostly diffuse layer-0 attention members, with the ' Years' member the strongest.
result.label: Hundred (Years' War) and name fragments

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' scal' (scalability, scalloped, scalene), ' equ' (equity) and ' ded' (deductive) when they appear mid-text. It stays silent when the fragment is the first token of the document.
result.label: scal/equ/ded word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ieval" as in "Medieval", especially when it begins a text window (e.g. "ieval societies"). It fires only weakly in "retrieval". Upstream attention members are mostly "ieval" detectors. Logits favour "ages".
result.label: "ieval" piece of medieval

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in math/code-like text (exponent '2', '≠', 'ε', underscores, 'differential', 'Month'); stays quiet on '2' in dates and 'type 2'. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Mixed math-symbol tokens, layer 0

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of specific words, mainly 'si' in "Celsius" and 'olation' in "Violation". Members detect the preceding piece (' Cel', ' Vi'), so it needs that earlier piece.
result.label: 'si' in Celsius, 'olation' in Violation

result.description: Fires mostly on the exponent caret '^' in math expressions, and also on word pieces like ' Serge' (before 'i'), ' puzz' (puzzle) and ' arrang'. A mixed set of token-specific pieces rather than one meaning.
result.label: Caret '^' and Serge/puzz pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ial' ending a word, such as factor-ial, inert-ial, celest-ial, microb-ial. Members detect 'ial' and the preceding stem pieces (factor, inert, cel).
result.label: 'ial' suffix after word stem

result.description: Fires on the color word " grey"/" gray" (e.g. grey-field testing, grayscale), with a few weaker hits on other word pieces like "alled". Members include gray/grey and white/box detectors.
result.label: grey/gray color word

result.description: Fires on ' years' after a large number like "million" or "billion" in geological or deep-time dating (e.g. "252 million years ago"). Weaker on "thousands of years". Silent on the contrast text, which has no such quantity.
result.label: ' years' after million/billion
Mixed word pieces in legal/civic names
result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word pieces and name tokens (Luther in Martin Luther, constitution-al, Esp-ion-age, 'of' in Act of), often in civil-rights or legal/historical text. Peaks are inconsistent; evidence is mixed.

Fires on a small set of optimization and game-theory words: " optimization", " optimized", " optimize", " simulate", " Game". Layer-0 detectors for each word feed it. It stayed silent on one " optimization" at the start of a document.
result.label: optimize/simulate/game word detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces following "car" (car|ving, car|b|ohydrate, car|ved, car|bo), i.e. continuation tokens of words beginning with "car". Silent on -ving after other stems like del-, deser-, obser-.
result.label: word pieces after "car"

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'ag', 'ak', 'ask', 'av' inside transliterated Indian names after 'Bh' (Bhagavad, Bhakti, Bhaskara). Silent on 'ag' in Greek-derived words like Pythagoras or pedagogy.
result.label: Syllable after Bh- in Indian names

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ingu" (and weakly " lingu") in words like sociolinguistic, psycholinguistic and Linguistic, right before "istic". Members are detectors of "ingu", " lingu" and " L" pieces.
result.label: "ingu" in linguistic words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' aggreg' (start of aggregate/aggregation/aggregating), at every occurrence. Weaker on the full word ' aggregate'. Driven mainly by attention members that detect ' aggreg' and 'ates' earlier in the text.
result.label: ' aggreg' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on emphasis adverbs like " particularly", " specifically" and " especially" that introduce a focused or highlighted item, mostly in academic or technical prose. Members include detectors of these adverbs; contrast text without them is silent.
result.label: Particularly/specifically emphasis adverbs

result.description: Fires on closing punctuation that ends a quoted, bracketed or parenthesized span, mostly a closing quote plus period (".), also ]. and ). and !!, often right before a line break or document end. Members detect punctuation tokens.
result.label: Closing quote/bracket plus period

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "consist" (consist of / consisting of), and weakly on related endings like consist-ant/-antly or compris-ing. Silent on " of" in other uses such as "type of" or "regulation of".
result.label: " of" after "consist"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'or' (also 'oration', 'ores', 'ored') inside forms of "explore" (explorers, explorations, explores). Silent on 'or' in unrelated words such as "sonorities".
result.label: 'or' inside "explor-" words

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'lock' (and 'ick') when it completes a word after a prefix, most strongly in "deadlock". It is silent on 'lock' at the start of a word or document, such as "locks".
result.label: 'lock' piece after prefix (deadlock)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ify' (amplify, magnify, -ify verbs) and on 'core' (hard-core, -core), mainly as a suffix-like piece in words. Supported by token detectors for 'ify' and 'core'. Predicts 's' or 'the' next.
result.label: 'ify' and 'core' word pieces
Scattered single letters and word pieces
result.description: Fires weakly on varied single letters and word fragments (G, y, h, F, 'learn', 'ud'), often variable names or mid-word pieces in technical or math text. Peaks are inconsistent and the members are mostly generic token detectors, so the pattern is unclear.
Fires on the word " ready" (e.g. "get ready", "be ready", "ready-made"), weakly on " prepared". Members are token detectors for ready/prepared, plus "-for/to" and "-iness" pieces.
result.label: ' ready' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' el' and following pieces ('astic', 'ution', 'uc') in words like elasticity, elution, elucidation. It needs the el- word-start context; members detect ' el'/'astic' tokens.
result.label: el- word pieces (elasticity, elution)

result.description: Fires on the 'ical' piece completing "pharmaceutical" (after "pharmaceut"/"armaceut"). It is weak on "ethical" and silent on 'ical' in statistical, chemical, ecological.
result.label: 'ical' in pharmaceutical

result.description: Fires on ' possible' or ' up' (also ' of', ' from') right after a form of "made"/"make", as in "made possible by" and "made up of". Silent on "up" after other verbs like tidy, toast or led.
result.label: "made" + up/possible

result.description: Fires on the ending pieces 'cies'/'cy' of "fallacies"/"fallacy" (logical fallacies). Silent on 'cies' in "inconsistencies", so it needs the preceding "falla-" piece. Members are mostly detectors of 'alla'.
result.label: fallacy/fallacies word ending

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on scattered tokens: ' Level', 'AS', ' two', ' (', and mid-word pieces in technical or acronym-heavy text. Peaks are inconsistent, and members are mostly token-specific attention detectors, so no single trigger emerges.
result.label: Scattered technical tokens, acronyms and levels

result.description: Fires on the token 'DE' as the ending piece of the abbreviations PDE/ODE (differential equations), after a P or O prefix. Silent on a differential-equation passage without the abbreviation. Driven mainly by a 'DE' token detector.
result.label: DE in PDE/ODE abbreviations

result.description: Fires on ' resource', ' habit'/' habitat' (also ' problem') as a noun modifier in ecology/resource-management text, e.g. "common resource", "habitat modification". Members are mostly detectors of those same tokens repeated earlier in the context.
result.label: resource/habitat noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the token ' lever' when it begins the word "leveraging"/"leverages" (always the verb form). Weaker when it follows "often" or "and". The circuit is led by a ' lever' token detector.
result.label: ' lever' in "leveraging"

result.description: Fires on the token ' vocal' (vocal techniques, vocal health, vocal cord) in voice and singing text. Layer-0 attention members that detect ' vocal' itself drive it. The contrast has no ' vocal' token.
result.label: ' vocal' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' tub' (tubule, tubes, tubas, tubular), mostly as a fragment that starts a longer word. Layer-0 attention members include a ' tub' token detector. Next-token logits favour suffixes like 'es', 'er', 'ers'.
result.label: ' tub' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' review' (also 'revis'), mostly as a verb or stem before suffixes like -ed/-ers, e.g. 'editors review(ed) papers', 'committee review(ers)'. Predicts suffixes such as 'ed', 'ers', 'ing'. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' review' word stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ige' in "pigeon"/"pigeonhole" (pigeonhole principle), after "P"/"p". It is silent on 'ige' in other words like "ingenious".
result.label: 'ige' in pigeon(hole)

result.description: Fires on the word " drawing" and " draw" (including "draws"), in senses like drawing on or drawing from something, and drawing a card. Early-layer circuit with token detectors for draw/drawing. Silent on unrelated text like "objects appear closer".
result.label: draw / drawing token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "ulsion" (also "uls", "oll", "ens") inside words like propulsion and repulsion, in physics and engineering text. Members are mostly token detectors for various technical word pieces. The circuit is weak and mixed.
result.label: -ulsion in propulsion/repulsion

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " static", also " Democratic", " Dynamic", " dynamic" and " regime". Several members are static/dynamic token detectors, so it is mostly a lexical detector for these adjectives, often in static-vs-dynamic contrasts.
result.label: static / dynamic / Democratic token

result.description: Fires on the "t" of "doesn't" and on "notation" (as in "connotation"), plus scattered tokens like "reads". Silent on "'t" after don't/can't, so it seems tied to "doesn't"-type contexts and the word piece "notation".
result.label: doesn't 't and connotation

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ries' ending plural nouns, such as strawber-ries, past-ries, indust-ries. Supported by members detecting 'ries' and ' indust' tokens. Silent on unrelated text without it.
result.label: 'ries' plural word ending

result.description: Fires on tokens of organization/institution names and acronyms (NE in NEC, PA in NEPA, EU, Union), mostly the end of a regulatory or political body name. Weak firing on some other nouns. Members are mostly token detectors.
result.label: Organization and acronym name tokens

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ffic' piece of "Traffic" when it appears as a repeated heading in lists of engineering topic titles; weaker on 'abil' and 'Comple'. Silent on other engineering headings, so it depends on the Tra-ffic word piece.
result.label: 'ffic' in Traffic topic headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "que" (Romanesque, aqueous) and on " pivot" (pivot row/element in linear algebra). Mostly layer-0 attention members detecting those tokens; the contrast text without them is silent.
result.label: 'que' piece and 'pivot'

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces, mainly ' cyl' (cylinder) and 'rust' in "antitrust", plus 'ureau', 'ints' (complaints) and ' pip'. Mostly a layer-0 token-piece detector for these word beginnings or fragments, with no clear shared meaning.
result.label: cyl / antitrust word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word fragments, odd pieces and garbled characters (' dell', ' SY', ' IN', apostrophes, 'ry' in polyacrylamide). Peaks are inconsistent, and the members are mostly generic attention latents, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word-fragment tokens

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside multi-piece words, mainly 'lic' (bib-lic-al), 'pos' (Pre-pos-itions), and 'r'/'es', after an earlier word piece. Members are detectors of the preceding piece and the fragment itself.
result.label: Mid-word fragments lic/pos

result.description: Fires on the token ' recovery' across contexts (oil recovery, disaster recovery time, economic or stress recovery). Mainly driven by a member detecting ' recovery' itself, plus a few members for 'recovery' in the preceding context.
result.label: ' recovery' token detector

result.description: Fires on digit tokens, mostly '9' and '0', inside long digit strings, repeated-digit runs, and numeric sequences. It stays silent on '9' in ordinary year numbers like 1920 or 1893. Members detect digits and slashes.
result.label: Digits 9/0 in digit strings

result.description: Fires on a hyphen (or word like "management") directly after the word "water", as in "water-wise", "water-based", "water-saving". Stays silent on hyphens after other words like "decision-" or "time-".
result.label: Hyphen after "water"

result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces, such as 'LETE' in DELETE, 'malloc', ' grant', and Cyrillic fragments like 'ну'. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. Members are mostly generic layer-0 token detectors.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments, mixed

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also ' or', ' upon', ' and') directly after large-number words like "millions" or "billions", as in "millions of years". It stays silent on ' of' after ordinary nouns such as "distribution of" or "process of".
result.label: 'of' after millions/billions

result.description: Fires on the token 'fall' as a word piece, most strongly in "Waterfall Model" and also in "Rainfall" and "pitfalls". It is silent on other tokens such as "scapes". Members are mostly 'fall' token detectors.
result.label: 'fall' in compounds (waterfall)

result.description: Fires on the word " every" (peaking at the start of a phrase or repeated parallel clauses like "every cut, every..."). Members are mostly detectors of "every"/"each". Weak activation on other tokens.
result.label: ' every' token detector

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "policy" (policy-makers, policy-making), and more weakly after "decision" (decision-making). Stays silent on hyphens after other words like real-, well-, socio-, data-.
result.label: Hyphen after "policy"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words split into pieces, such as ' exp' (expenses), ' marg' (marginal), ' fragment', and ' dup' (duplicate). It predicts suffix pieces completing the word. Members are mostly detectors of these specific pieces.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (exp, marg, dup)
territory / territorial word family
result.description: Fires mainly on ' territory', ' territorial' and ' territ-' pieces, especially in text about territorial behavior. It also fires weakly on ' Public' at document start. Members include token detectors for territorial and territ.
Fires mostly on ' CI' (Travis CI, CI workflows) in software tooling text, and also on ' integral' and ' evaluate'. Mixed small token set, driven by token detectors for CI and integral.
result.label: ' CI' / ' integral' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ic'/'istic' right after 'Art' or 'art' (Artistic, articulate), with weaker firing on ' of' and ' and' in title-like lists. Silent on 'ic' in other words (proficiency, strategic, elicit).
result.label: 'ic'/'istic' after 'art' stem

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words split into pieces, mostly ' Entre' (Entrepreneur), also ' fra' (fractions), ' vol' (volatility), ' Mediter'. Predicts the continuation piece of the word, such as 'omial' or 'atile'.
result.label: Word-start fragment before continuation (Entre-)

result.description: Fires on the token ' density' (also weakly on 'dens-' pieces), mostly at the start of a text about physical density. Upstream members are mainly ' density' token detectors in layer-0 attention.
result.label: ' density' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ron', 'ut', 'rom' inside "macronutrients"/"micronutrients" (mic-ron-utrients), after the mac/mic prefix. Members detect mic/mac/ron/ut pieces. Silent in other food text.
result.label: micro/macronutrient word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the adverb " usually" (also " typically", " corresponds", " tor", " perfectly") at the start of a descriptive clause about general patterns in technical or explanatory text. Members include "usually" and "typically" detectors.
result.label: "usually" habitual adverb in explanations

result.description: Fires on the token ' computing' when it follows a modifier such as cloud, quantum, distributed or ubiquitous. It stays silent when ' computing' starts the text with no preceding modifier. Members detect 'cloud', 'cloud-based' and 'computing'.
result.label: ' computing' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on the token ' virtue', both in 'virtue ethics' and in 'by virtue of'. Driven mainly by an attention member that detects an earlier ' virtue' token. Predicts ' of' next. The contrast text has no ' virtue'.
result.label: ' virtue' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " software" (and " Software"), in running text and headings. Circuit is mostly layer-0 attention latents, including a software-specific detector plus many generic word-detector members. Logits are not informative.
result.label: software token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' note' (also ' notes'), in both the musical sense and the general sense of a note or remark. Members are mostly detectors of ' note'/' notes' plus some music-related context. Silent on contrast text without the word.
result.label: ' note' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' Writing' when it follows 'Creative' (the phrase "Creative Writing"). It stays silent on ' Writing' at the start of a sentence. Members include a 'Creative' detector and a 'Writing' attention member.
result.label: Writing after Creative

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ual' completing "ritual" (after 'rit'), especially in ritual/religious-practice text. It stays silent on 'ual' in other words, such as 'it|ual|istic'.
result.label: 'ual' ending 'ritual'

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ved' completing words like "curved" and "conserved", right after a stem such as "cur" or "conser". Barely active on other text.
result.label: 'ved' suffix in curved/conserved
' Conf' word-start piece (Conflict)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Conf' at the start of a word, mostly "Conflict" in outline-style headings. It also fires weakly on Conf-/conf- in Confucianism and confusing. It pushes toward continuations like 'lict' and 'gression'.

Fires on a spaced hyphen or en dash (' -', ' –') used as a dash, list marker, minus sign or affix dash, mostly in messy or technical text. Members are mainly detectors of the hyphen token. Silent on plain prose without such dashes.
result.label: Spaced hyphen/dash token

result.description: Fires on the plural agent-noun suffix pieces 'ors' and 'ators' (communicators, orators, estimators), but stays silent on 'ors' in "compressors" (a different word). Members detect these suffix tokens.
result.label: Plural -ors / -ators suffix

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces (' capac', ' empir', ' Er', ' Pil', ' Appro'), where the rest of the word comes next. It also fires on odd punctuation runs. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Word-initial fragments of split words

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ic' in "genotypic" (after "genotyp"), in genetics text contrasting phenotypic and genotypic traits. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as "genomic", "ecotrophic" and "metabolic".
result.label: 'ic' ending genotypic

result.description: Fires on the word " various" (rarely " numerous"), typically after a preposition like "in", "across" or "from" before a plural noun. Members mostly detect " various", " numerous" and " many" at the same position.
result.label: ' various' quantifier detector

result.description: Fires on the token "for" in many uses (duration, purpose, cause, "for example", and the "for" piece of "forcement"). Layer-0 attention members detecting "for" and "rein" drive it. The contrast text lacks "for" entirely.
result.label: Token "for" detector
' layer' token detector
result.description: Fires on the word " layer" (and " layers"), strongest in network/neural-network and OSI contexts such as "input layer" or "transport layer". It is weaker in physical uses like a thin layer of fluid. Members are mainly layer-token detectors.

Fires on the 'om'/'m'/'oms' piece inside words like sympt-om-atic, blo-om-ery, blooms, and snow-m-elt. It is quiet on 'm' in other words like dis-m-antling. Members detect 'sympt', 'snow' and 'oms' tokens.
result.label: om/m piece in symptom, bloom words

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece ' mascul' (masculinity/masculine), and also on a few other word-start fragments such as ' Mont', ' bon' and ' marry'. Several fragments are split mid-word, so it looks like a word-start piece detector with mixed peaks.
result.label: ' mascul' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on word pieces (re, s, st, sh) directly following the prefix "out"/"over"/"under" inside words like outreach, outsourced, overstated. Silent on 're' elsewhere. Members detect " out" and "break" tokens.
result.label: Piece after out-/over- prefix

result.description: Fires on the token ' del' (the start of 'delicate', 'delineating'). It is strong where ' del' opens the text with no preceding context. It is silent on the same token in mid-sentence contrast examples.
result.label: ' del' word-piece at text start

result.description: Fires on the ordinal word " third" (occasionally " fourth" or " second") across music intervals, lists and laws. Members are mostly detectors of ' third', ' second', ' fourth' and ' Third'. The contrast shows no ordinal.
result.label: Ordinal 'third' detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ols' ending words like soil orders (Gelisols, Histosols), alcohols (isopropanols) and 'pools'. Weakly fires on 'acter' in bacterium/bacteria. Members detect prior word fragments such as 'alco', 'chem' and 'eth'.
result.label: 'ols' word-ending piece
Apostrophe after "today"
result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in "today's" (e.g. "in today's world"). Silent on apostrophes after other words such as era's, 1970's or names. Members detect the preceding "today" or "modern".

Fires on the plural 's' completing "wavelength" (wavelength-s), as in "shorter wavelengths". It is silent on 's' after other words such as rays. Members detect the wavel/ength pieces. Weaker on "wavelength" and "wavelength of".
result.label: plural 's' of wavelength

result.description: Fires on the piece completing "indu-" words, mainly "ced" in "-induced" (laser-induced, climate-induced), also "ce"/"ces" after "indu" and the hyphen in "Hindu-Arabic". Silent on "ced" in "deduced" or "unpreced-".
result.label: Suffix 'ced' after 'indu' (induced)

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'edge' (as in hedge, cutting-edge) and 'ator'/'ators' (creator, narrator, estimators), plus occasionally ' lie'. Members are token detectors for these endings and for cre- word starts.
result.label: -edge and -ator word endings

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ou' in Raoult, 'emble' in Ensemble, 'ffect' in effective, mostly in capitalized technical terms or titles at the start of a document. Members detect these word pieces, such as ' Ra', 'ou' and 'ffect'.
result.label: Word-internal pieces: Raoult, Ensemble, ffect

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' ske' (skeleton, skewness, skeptic), and weakly on ' append' and '-ology' pieces, especially in anatomy text such as "axial skeleton" or "appendicular skeleton". Members are detectors of ske, append and verte.
result.label: ' ske' word-start piece (skeleton)

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' hydro' and ' precip' (hydrochloric, hydrobromic, precipitation), predicting a continuation of the word such as 'itate'. Members are mostly token detectors for hydro, precip and acid.
result.label: hydro / precip word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' classification' itself, strongest when it starts a phrase like "classification system". Driven mainly by attention latents that detect the same token. It nudges the next token toward ' system'.
result.label: ' classification' token detector

result.description: Fires on "readers"/"reader" (also audience, author), mostly as the object after verbs like help, enable, allow, strengthen in writing/reading advice text. Silent on narrative-theme text without such a word.
result.label: readers as object of help/enable

result.description: Fires on the word right after "more" (and, than, or, effectively), as in "more and more" or "more than". Silent on "and" elsewhere. Members are mostly detectors of the preceding " more".
result.label: Word following "more" (more and/than)
'ible' after 'tang'
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ible' completing "tangible" (after 'tang'). It weakly fires on other 'tang' continuations like 'led' and 'ent'. Members detect 'tang' and 'ible' pieces.

Layer-0 latent peaking on a few specific tokens: ' immediate' (as in "immediate surroundings"), and the pieces 'Gött'/'ingen' in Göttingen, plus occasional 'output'. Members are mostly token detectors, so it looks like a mixed token-specific feature.
result.label: immediate / Göttingen token mix

result.description: Fires on the token ' being' (gerund/participle, e.g. "being considered", "technology being available"). Members are mostly layer-0 attention heads that detect ' being' itself. Silent on text without that token.
result.label: ' being' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' coast' (mostly as the stem of "coastal" or "coastline") in text about coastal landforms and erosion. Members are mainly attention-layer detectors of ' coast' itself, plus marine and sea context.
result.label: ' coast' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside longer words, mainly 'yp' in "prototyping"/"stereotyped", also ' bo' (boiling, boom), ' mess' (messaging), ' gam' (gameto-). Needs the fragment to be mid-word, continuing a longer word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: yp, bo, mess

result.description: Fires on the token ' E' (capital E, often as a word-initial piece or a letter in strings like "E =" or "Efficiency"), with a few weaker hits on ' two'. Members are mostly ' E' detectors.
result.label: Capital ' E' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' device' (occasionally ' setup' or ' chamber'), as in "device drivers" or "each device". Early-layer members mostly detect ' device'/' devices' directly. The contrast text has no such word, so nothing else is clearly required.
result.label: ' device' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token "related", mostly as a hyphenated suffix after a noun (group-related, age-related, health-related). The contrast text doesn't contain "related", so it gives no evidence of a further condition.
result.label: hyphenated "-related" suffix

result.description: Fires on the word " fundamental" in all windows, whether as an adjective ("The fundamental principles", "a fundamental discipline") or in "fundamental group". Members include detectors of the same token. The contrast text has no such token.
result.label: ' fundamental' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " demand" (and " demanded"), most strongly in the economics sense, e.g. "demand is elastic" or "demand curve". It is weaker for "consumer demand". Driven mainly by attention latents that detect the token " demand" itself.
result.label: ' demand' token detector

result.description: Fires on the "uling" piece of "scheduling" and on " sched" (also "Round Robin", "task") in computing/OS scheduling text. Boosts next-token predictions like sched, schedule, tasks, queue.
result.label: scheduling word pieces (sched/uling)

result.description: Fires on gerunds of achieving/building/creating (mostly "ieving" in "achieving") after "in" or "for", in abstract teamwork or communication text about goals and relationships.
result.label: achieving/building gerund after "in"

result.description: Fires on weather words, mainly ' storm' and ' cloud(s)', in text about weather or atmosphere. Members are detectors of storm, cloud, weather, wind and rain tokens. Contrast text on an unrelated topic is silent.
result.label: Storm and cloud weather words

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "frame" (hyphen, " narr", "of", "defines", "during"), as in frame-of-reference or frame-based. It stays silent on hyphens after other words like multi-, well-, non-.
result.label: Token following "frame"

result.description: Fires on the pieces of "Hammurabi" (Hamm, ur, abi), especially 'ur' and 'abi' after "Hamm". Silent on 'ur' in Ashur or Babur, so it needs the Hammurabi word context.
result.label: Hammurabi name pieces

result.description: Fires on ' demand' (also ' needs') as the end of a noun phrase in economics/business text, such as "consumer demand" or "meet the demand". Members detect economic words like demand, supply, market and consumer.
result.label: Demand/needs in business economics

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'as' in "persuasive" (and 'or' in "sponsorship"), a word-piece in the middle of a longer word. It is silent on a bare "u-as-ive" fragment, so it needs the "persu" prefix before it.
result.label: 'as' inside "persuasive"
"enger" in "messenger"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "enger"/"engers" after "mess", mainly in "messenger" (second messenger, messenger RNA). Weakly on "mess|aging". Members detect "mess", "enger" and "aging" pieces. Predicts channel/send/messages.
Fires on the word-piece 'as'/'ases' completing "phr-" in "phrase(s)" and "phrasal", mostly in grammar text. Upstream members detect the " phr" piece and "ases" tokens.
result.label: phr-ases word completion

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' completing the word "tangent" (also tangents, tangency-related pieces), in geometry text. It stays silent on 'ent' in other words such as congruent or inherent.
result.label: 'ent' in "tangent"

result.description: Fires on 'rian' in "Precambrian" and on ' billion' in geological-time spans (e.g. "4.5 billion years ago"). Members detect 'rian', ' billion' and ' million' tokens. Silent on a geological passage without these tokens.
result.label: Precambrian 'rian' and 'billion' in deep time
improve/enhance verb suffix endings
result.description: Fires on the ending pieces (-ves, -ving, -ance, -ances) of the verbs "improve" and "enhance" after the stem piece (impro-, enh-). Members detect those stems. It nudges toward words like "understanding" or "academic".

Fires on the token " Management" at the end of a heading-like noun phrase (e.g. "Quality Management", "Human Resource Management") in lists of topics. Silent on other list headings such as "Public Relations".
result.label: Management in topic headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' civ' (mostly before 'ic', as in civic pride or responsibility), with weaker firing on ' chron' (chronological). Predicts a suffix like 'ic' next. The circuit is led by a ' civ' token detector.
result.label: ' civ' word-start (civic)

result.description: Fires on the token " perfect" (also "fect" pieces), strongest in grammar text about perfect tenses (past perfect, future perfect), and more weakly in "the perfect setlist". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' perfect' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "prompt" and its pieces (prompt, prompts, prompting, promptness), mostly in writing-prompt contexts. Weaker on "promptly" or "prompt action". Silent on related creative-writing text without the word.
result.label: the word "prompt"

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces in the middle of a noun phrase or word (e.g. 'ge' in zeitgeist, ' systems', 'ics', ' carry') in abstract topical prose. Members are mostly detectors of earlier topical tokens such as relay, zeit, solar, jazz. Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Mixed word pieces after topic words

result.description: Fires on the 'ver' piece in "nonverbal" (after "non"), with weaker hits on similar mid-word pieces like 'ter' in "subterranean". Members detect 'non', '-', 'linear' and 'ver' tokens earlier in the word.
result.label: 'ver' in nonverbal

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " historic" (and its variants), with scattered weak firing on Arabic or Japanese word pieces. Members are detectors of historic/historical and related word pieces such as -ism and -istic.
result.label: " historic" token detector
word-final 'le' piece
result.description: Fires on the token 'le' (also 'cle') as the ending of a word such as Puzzle, mantle, soluble, nucleotide. It stays silent on 'le' in 'subtle'. Members include 'le' detectors and document-start/context heads.

Fires on word-ending pieces (-ies, -istic, -y) completing "monopol-/oligopol-/duopol-" words in market-structure economics text. Silent on the same "ies" ending in other words like strategies or economies.
result.label: monopoly/oligopoly word endings

result.description: Fires on the token 'ber', strongest when it starts a word as in "cyberpunk" or "cybersecurity" (likely "cyber" split). Weaker in "fiber". Boosts next tokens like 'security', 'attack', 'punk'-style continuations.
result.label: 'ber' token, cyber- prefix

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ier', mostly in the surname Navier (Navier-Stokes), and more weakly on ' systems' and the 'z' of 'freezers'. Members detect ' Nav' and 'ier' pieces.
result.label: 'ier' in Navier

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ism" ending a word, especially in headings or lists of philosophical isms (Dualism, Monism). Members include several "ism" detectors and a few previous-token cues like " Property".
result.label: "ism" suffix token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lear" in "Nuclear" (split as Nuc|lear), always at that token. Members detect "lear", "uc" and "nuclear" earlier in the context. It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "lear" in Nuclear

result.description: Fires on the token ' work' in the sense of employment, labor or occupation (workplace, work performed, workday). It stays silent when 'work' is the physics sense (work and energy, doing work) or means a creative work.
result.label: ' work' as labor/employment

result.description: Fires on the final 'M' of the acronym "SCM" (supply chain / software configuration management), after "SC". It stays silent on 'M' in other acronyms such as SPM or CM, so it depends on the preceding SC.
result.label: 'M' in SCM acronym

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens inside longer words: gerund 'ing' endings (multitasking, whisking, plumbing) and the 'Mic'/'Micro' start of microscopy/microscope. Silent on many other 'ing' endings, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ing, Micro-

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ishing', as in 'vanishing', 'diminishing', 'distinguishing', and when it starts a text. Members are mostly 'ishing'/'ish' token detectors in layer 0. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: 'ishing' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: ' Media' as a repeated list heading (Media Research, Media Strategy), plus ' wave' and ' Vel' in physics text. Mixed, low-consistency peaks; the Media case is in a list of topic headings.
result.label: Media list headings, wave, Vel

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on mixed word pieces that start or sit inside longer words (' future', ' det', 'outer', 'oting', ' Equ', 'oder'). No single token dominates; ' future' is the most common peak, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed word pieces, often ' future'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ix' (also ' suffix', 'fix') in linguistics text about affixes, such as aff-ix-es and inf-ix-es. Members detect 'ix' pieces and morphology words like morph, prefix and consonants.
result.label: 'ix' in affix/infix words

result.description: Fires on ' use' as a noun right after "the" (e.g. "the use of ..."), predicting " of". Stays silent on ' use' as a verb or after adjectives like "practical" or "masterful".
result.label: noun "use" after "the"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in long academic or technical words (e.g. 'ular', 'al', 'ist', 'trans', 'ive') where the word continues or is a suffix. Silent on 'ular' in some words like tubular and extracellular. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Word-piece fragments in technical words

result.description: Fires on the token ' version', mostly in software version control and versioning text. Members detect ' version'/' Version' and related words like copies, branch, and cluster. The contrast text has no ' version' token.
result.label: ' version' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix or fragment tokens (eness, ing, ic, ically, ist) in the middle of multi-piece words, especially after "polit" and "refr"; the word is still unfinished. Weak on rhetor-/framing pieces.
result.label: Mid-word suffix pieces after polit-/refr-

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ability"/"abilities" completing a word, strongest in "Probability" (Prob|ability) at the start of headings in math/statistics text; weaker in "capability" and "liability". Silent on the full word "probability".
result.label: -ability suffix in Probability

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'del' in "Gödel" (surname after "Gö"), plus occasional ' Step'/' step' and odd byte tokens. Silent on a standalone 'del' without the "Gö" prefix. Early-layer circuit with many name-fragment detectors.
result.label: 'del' in Gödel

result.description: Fires on the token " measure" (also " gauge") as a noun, especially in mathematical contexts such as angle measure, Lebesgue measure, and measure theory. It is silent on nearby geometry text that lacks the word.
result.label: measure / gauge token detector

result.description: Fires on the word ' rather' when it introduces a contrast, as in "X rather than Y". Members detect ' rather', ' instead', ' versus' and similar contrastive words. Silent on text lacking that word.
result.label: ' rather' in contrast phrases

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ility" completing a word, most strongly in "mobility" after " mob". Members detect "ility" and " mob" tokens. It is weaker on "ity" in "ethnicity".
result.label: "ility" suffix in mobility

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' e' when it starts "ecology/ecological" and is followed by 'colog'/'cos' continuations. It is a layer-0 token detector for this fragment, with weak activation on 'e' in 'eating'.
result.label: ' e' start of ecology words

result.description: Fires on the token " identity" (national, cultural, brand, sexual identity), with a few weak hits on other tokens. Members are mostly detectors of identity, Identity and ident. The contrast text, which lacks the word, stays silent.
result.label: identity token detector

result.description: Fires on ' example' (and sometimes ' instance') right after "for", as in "for example" / "for instance". It stays silent when ' example' starts a sentence with no preceding "for".
result.label: "for example" / "for instance" token

result.description: Fires on the token ' consider' and its variants (consideration, considerations, Consider), mostly as the piece before '-ations' or in 'careful consideration'. Silent on related text without the word. Pushes toward 'ations' and 'consideration'.
result.label: consider / consideration token detector

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' constitu', ' pill' (pillow/pillars), ' hub', and 'corner' (cornerstone), where the word continues with a suffix. Layer-0 token-piece detectors dominate the circuit.
result.label: Word-start pieces: constitu, pill, hub

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'ater', 'ang', 'ine' directly after 'bil' in words such as bilateral, bilinear, bilingual. It stays silent on 'ater' after 'il' or 'multil', so it needs the 'bil' prefix.
result.label: Word piece after 'bil' (bilateral)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cling' at the end of 'recycling' and 'upcycling' (also weakly 'cycling'). Several members detect 'cling' directly. The contrast text has no such token.
result.label: 'cling' in recycling/upcycling
Academic text word pieces, mixed
result.description: Fires on varied tokens in academic or scholarly prose, such as 'lished' in "co-published", ' EM', ' philosoph', ' academic' and ' perspective'. No single token dominates, and the evidence for what else it needs is thin.
Fires on the 'ment' piece in "Augment" (as in Augmented Reality), at the start of the word. It stays silent on 'ment' in words like assessment and investment. It fires weakly on 'ed' after "augment".
result.label: 'ment' in Augment(ed)

result.description: Fires on the word ' balance' as a noun after a determiner or modifier (this balance, its balance, height balance). It stays silent when ' balance' is the first token of a text. Members are balance/bal/equilibrium token detectors.
result.label: ' balance' noun token

result.description: Fires on the word " rising" (and weaker on rise, falling, increasing, rose), especially in lists or phrases like "flat, falling, rising" and "rising action". Members are token detectors for rising/rise/increase/falling.
result.label: ' rising' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token 'W' completing the acronym DAW (Digital Audio Workstation), right after 'DA'. It stays silent on 'W' in 'DW', where the 'DA' prefix is missing.
result.label: W in DAW acronym

result.description: Fires on the token 'ical' when it stands as its own word piece, usually at the start of a text or after a break, as in "ical praktisity". It stays silent when 'ical' ends a longer word such as "critical", "ethical" or "fantastical".
result.label: Standalone 'ical' token, not word-final

result.description: Fires on the word " physical" (also "Phys-") when it begins a sentence or phrase or follows "The" or "In". It stays quiet on "physical" after "include", "other" or "of" in material/forces text.
result.label: ' physical' at phrase start

result.description: Fires on the word ' focus' (noun or verb, e.g. "a focus on", "shifts the focus", "focus groups"). It is silent in one case where ' focus' starts the text with no preceding context. Members detect focus and similar words such as emphasis.
result.label: ' focus' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " literally" (also weakly on similar adverbs like " essentially"), including when it is mentioned as a word. Members are detectors of "literally"/"literal" plus other adverb-like pieces.
result.label: ' literally' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'apes' completing words like landscapes, cityscapes, soundscapes. Weaker on other suffix pieces such as 'ours' in contours and 'cs' in arcs. The circuit is mostly detectors of the 'apes' piece.
result.label: 'apes' suffix in -scapes words

result.description: Fires on the word ' host' (organism hosting a parasite or virus, also a server hosting something), mostly in host–pathogen text. Built from early-layer detectors of ' host', plus virus-related and other weak members.
result.label: ' host' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word ' technique' itself, mostly as a sentence or clause subject (e.g. "technique is...", "technique, termed..."). It is silent in one case, "this technique" after a demonstrative. Layer-0 token detectors for 'technique' and similar words drive it.
result.label: ' technique' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " raised" (also "raising", "raise", and the piece "etes"), in uses like "ethically raised meat" or "raised concerns". Members are mostly detectors of " raised" plus a few other word pieces.
result.label: ' raised' word detector

result.description: Fires on the word " net" as an adjective meaning after deductions, mostly in trade and economics text (net trade, net exports, net lender/seller). Weak on "net" as a physical object or in "Networks".
result.label: " net" in economic usage

result.description: Fires on the piece 'or' inside words, especially in "rhetoric/rhetorical", and at the start of text. It stays silent on 'or' in names like "Shor" and "investor".
result.label: 'or' piece in rhetoric
' e' starting "ecolog-/ecosystem" words
result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' e' when it begins words like ecologist, ecology, ecosystem, ecological. It predicts continuations such as 'cos' and 'colog'. It stays silent on other tokens, including later pieces of the word.

Fires on the word ' feedback' (occasionally ' tone' or ' voice') in text about communication and feedback types, usually after an adjective like positive or delayed. Members are mostly detectors of 'feedback'.
result.label: 'feedback' (and tone) word

result.description: Fires on word pieces that continue a split word, mostly after "hist" (hist-og-ram, hist-ot-opic), and sometimes on other mid-word fragments such as Edmond-s or Kur-at-owski. Silent on a bare "og" at the start of a document.
result.label: Mid-word piece after "hist"

result.description: Fires on the 'es' piece completing the plural "genes" (after "gen") in genetics text. It stays silent on 'es' in other words like "bioinformatics" or "lifespan". Members are gen-prefix and genetics detectors.
result.label: 'es' in "genes"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that often start or join compounds, mainly ' side', also ' front', ' box', ' neck', 'western'. Likely predicts a joining suffix or '-'. Peaks are mixed, and members are mostly single-token detectors.
result.label: Compound-forming side/front/box tokens

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ating, -ations, -at, -ative) when they continue the word "alloc-" (allocating, allocations, allocative). Silent on the same -ating suffix in other words like overstating or mitigating.
result.label: Suffix after "alloc" (allocating/allocations)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ised' (British -ise past tense), most strongly in "poised" and also in "praised" and "revolutionised". Members are 'ised' detectors plus the ' po' piece.
result.label: 'ised' suffix token (poised)

result.description: Fires on the token ' Dr' (title) at the start of a line in a list of names, e.g. repeated "Dr. Johnson. Dr. Williams." lines. Members are mostly ' Dr' detectors. Silent on lists of names without the title.
result.label: ' Dr' title in name lists

result.description: Fires on the word "service" (also Service, delivery, services) mostly in lists of service-management terms like service design, service transition, service operation. Silent on unrelated kitchen/staff text.
result.label: "service" word in service-management terms

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes 'ic' (and 'ational', 'ial') at the start of a word or after a word break, where a longer word like "-icians/-ologists" is continuing. It stays silent when 'ic' ends an adjective like "strategic" or "Arabic".
result.label: 'ic' / 'ational' word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on " resources"/" resource" when it follows "natural" (natural resources). It stays quiet on the same word after other words such as "vital", "managing", "and" or "of".
result.label: "resources" after "natural"

result.description: Fires on the token ' open', most strongly in topology text about open sets, and more weakly in 'openness'. Members are mostly detectors of ' open' itself. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' open' token detector
'est' piece in aesthetic words
result.description: Fires on the token 'est' when it is a word fragment, mostly the start of "aesthetic(s)" split as a-est-hetic, and also in "estimation". It is silent on other text. Layer-0 'est' detectors drive it.

Fires on the ' C' piece right after "James" in the name "James Clerk Maxwell" (physics context). It also fires weakly on other name-piece continuations like James-Stein or Mc-Keon. It stays silent on ' C' in other contexts such as Cotton or Clavier.
result.label: C in James Clerk Maxwell

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens (' export', ' defines', ' impact', ' Canada', ' joins'), mostly early-layer word-level features. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, so no clear shared meaning emerges.
result.label: Diffuse mixed-token layer-0 feature

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' constit', 'iat', ' irre', ' instit' (constitute, institution, irrelevant), where the word is still incomplete. Predicts continuation pieces such as 'itut'. Weak firing on ' purposes'. Members are diffuse early-layer token detectors.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (constit-, instit-)

result.description: Fires mainly on " labor" in economics text (labor market, unit of labor), and weakly on "DP" (GDP), " over" in "production over time", and " =" in formulas. Mostly a labor-token detector with economics context.
result.label: Labor in economics text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Hels" at the start of "Helsinki" (Helsinki Accords), with weaker firing on "ente" and "throughout". Mostly a token detector for Hels- in the Helsinki context.
result.label: Hels- of Helsinki

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' when it completes the word "pharmaceutical" (also biopharmaceutical, radiopharmaceutical). It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like analytical, economical, biochemical. Members detect the 'arma' piece and pharma context.
result.label: 'ical' ending pharmaceutical

result.description: Fires on the word "history" (also "History", "culture"), most strongly in title-like phrases such as "The Role of X in History" and in "throughout history". Members detect history, historical and culture tokens.
result.label: "history" / "culture" noun token

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verbs " has" and " have" after a plural or singular subject noun, in perfect-tense constructions, and predicts "been" or an adverb next. Silent when " has" starts the text with no subject before it.
result.label: has/have after subject (perfect aux)

result.description: Fires on the pieces of "Babylonian" (' Bab', 'yl', 'onian'), strongest on ' Bab' at the start of the word. It is weaker on later pieces, and it stays silent on other ancient-civilization text such as Egyptians. Next-token logits favor 'onian'.
result.label: Babylonian word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' intersection' in all contexts shown. It is driven mainly by token-detector members for ' intersection', and it also fires, more weakly, in 'the intersection of X and Y'. Logits favour 'al' and 'between'.
result.label: ' intersection' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ount' in "discounting" (hyperbolic discounting), also ' grat' in "gratification" and some other mid-word fragments. It seems to need the word-start context, such as "disc" before 'ount'.
result.label: 'ount' in discounting, mid-word pieces
' Cy' as start of 'cycle'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Cy' that begins a split word, mostly 'Cycle' as in 'Life Cycle' or 'Krebs Cycle'. It predicts 'cle' next. Members are mainly detectors of Cy/cy tokens.

Fires on a word piece right after the word-start fragment "Sh" (Sh|a, Sh|el, Sh|ap, Sh|u), i.e. the second piece of a split word beginning with Sh. Silent on the same pieces in other words like "ling|u|istic".
result.label: Second piece after "Sh"

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "process" (or "processes"), as in "the process of X". It stays silent on " of" after other nouns such as example, terms or aspect. Logits favor production and manufacturing words.
result.label: " of" after "process"

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also '-' or suffixes) directly after the word "form"/"forms", as in "form of" or "form-". The same ' of' after other nouns like "means" or "exploration" stays silent.
result.label: ' of' or '-' after "form"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "much" (of, as, more, about, was, part), as in "much of Europe", "much as", "much more than". Silent on "of" after other words. Members detect "much" in previous positions.
result.label: Word following "much"
'it' as word piece
result.description: Fires on the token 'it' when it is a fragment inside longer words (il-it-ator, it-rogen, aud-it, prior-it-ize, expend-it-ures), not on the standalone pronoun. Members are mostly layer-0 'it' token detectors.
Fires on word-ending suffixes ('ness', 'ization', 'ized') right after the word 'random', as in randomness and randomization. It stays silent on 'ness' after other stems like 'robust'.
result.label: random + suffix (randomness/randomization)

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside grammar terminology, like "ad-ject-ives", "ad-verb-s", "ext-rem-ely", "pro-bably", in text about adverbs and parts of speech. Silent on logic or quantification text.
result.label: Grammar terms: adverb/adjective pieces

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces, mainly " absolute", " Princi" (of Principle), and " truth", often at the start of a multi-token term or phrase. Members are detectors of these tokens. It has no clear single trigger.
result.label: absolute / Princi / truth tokens

result.description: Fires on the word " integer" in mathematical text about number theory, polynomials and modular arithmetic. It also fires weakly on nearby math tokens such as " Q" or " mod" after "integer". It is mostly driven by the layer-0 MLP latent for the same token.
result.label: ' integer' in math text
Net suffix in model names
result.description: Fires on the piece "Net" at the end of neural network model names such as GoogLeNet, VGGNet, ResNet and ImageNet. It is mostly silent on ordinary text, and weakly active on a few other tokens such as " Jones".
Fires on the slash '/' in long strings of slash-separated digits (e.g. 7/5/6/7, score-like lists). It is weaker for '/' between words such as quality/opportunity.
result.label: Slash in numeric slash sequences

result.description: Fires on the token ' adult' (adult, adults) in academic text about development and language. Members are mostly ' adult' token detectors in layer 0. Only weak firing on ' background'.
result.label: ' adult' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' wear' as a noun in materials/tribology text (adhesive wear, wear resistance, wear mechanisms). Weakly fires on ' migration'. Members are mostly detectors of ' wear' itself.
result.label: ' wear' in materials science

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'pe' inside longer words, such as thera-pe-utic, pe-ptides, tra-pe, im-pe-ccable, scra-pe. It is silent when 'pe' starts a word, as in 'pezoids'.
result.label: 'pe' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on correlative/quantifier words "either", "neither", "both" (also "merely"), especially when listing conjunctions or in either/neither...nor and both...and constructions. Members detect each of these words separately.
result.label: either/neither/both correlatives

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Elect' at the start of electro- words (Electrode, Electrochemical, Electrolytes), mostly in title-like or heading text. Weakly on other word-start pieces like ' Met' or ' Elect' in Electrical.
result.label: Elect- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in rare technical words, mainly 'ige' in "pigeonhole/pigeons" and 'agnet' in "diamagnetism/ferrimagnetic", plus a few others like 'é'. Members are mostly detectors of the 'ige' piece.
result.label: Rare word pieces: ige, agnet

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Integr" (start of Integration/Integrated), once at the start of the word. Predicts suffixes like -ation, -ity and -ics. Weakly fires on "Thermod-ynam". Members are detectors of integr- and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' Integr' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word "machine" (and "mach-", "Machine", "machines"), mostly in "machine learning", "machine vision" or "machine translation" after a preceding word. It stayed silent when "machine learning" began the text, with no word before it.
result.label: "machine" token detector

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe (or hyphen) right after the word "speaker" (speaker's, speaker-speaking). It stays silent on apostrophes after other nouns like practitioner or audience.
result.label: Apostrophe after "speaker"

result.description: Fires on the token ' professional' in mid-text, mostly before nouns like settings, communication, or relationship. It stays silent when the word is the very first token of the document.
result.label: ' professional' mid-text

result.description: Fires on a bare space token that precedes a digit string in a year or decade, as in "the early 1980s" or "the 1930s". It stays silent on some similar cases such as "between the 193…" and "the 195…".
result.label: Space before year digits

result.description: Fires on the adverb " truly" (occasionally "stand", "amaz"), mostly before a verb like collaborate, engage, connect or appreciate. Members detect "truly"/"really"/"genuinely" and similar intensifiers; logits favour verbs such as appreciate and exist.
result.label: Adverb "truly" before verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece "endency", most strongly in "Central Tendency" (t|endency) and also in "Dependency". It predicts "endency/endencies" continuations. The contrast "pre…" context stays silent.
result.label: "endency" in Tendency

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens in technical text, most often " Linux", " LI", "Order" and " Bash". The peaks are scattered, and the logits favour word-ending suffixes. The evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Scattered technical tokens (Linux, Order)

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' sw' (mostly) and ' sm'/' Sm' when the word is split into pieces, e.g. sw|aps, sw|arms, sm|udging. It predicts word-continuation suffixes. It is silent on whole-word text without such a split.
result.label: Split-word 'sw'/'sm' prefix piece

result.description: Fires on digit tokens (mostly 1, 0, 2, 3) in the middle or end of a multi-digit number, such as years, codes and identifiers. It stays silent when the digit starts the number or begins a year.
result.label: Digits inside multi-digit numbers

result.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces such as 'ior' (Superior), 'RE' (EXTREME), 'DER' (FREDERICK), and ' Army'. These are word fragments inside longer words, mostly in capitalized or title-like text. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ior, RE, DER

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments and apostrophes, such as the apostrophe in "won't", 'el'/'il' pieces, and the 's' in "unlocks". The apostrophe fires after "won" but stays silent after "don" and "let". The pattern is mixed and token-specific.
result.label: Word fragments and apostrophe in won't

result.description: Fires on " for" directly after "allow/allows" (allows for X). Stays silent on " for" after adjectives like crucial, essential, responsible, or after nouns. Members include "allow" detectors and " for" token detectors.
result.label: "for" after allows

result.description: Fires on the word " dialect" (also dialects, dialectal), mostly mid-sentence in linguistic text. Weakly on " hair" and "dialectic". It stays silent on a sentence-initial capitalised "Dialects" at the start of a document.
result.label: dialect token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'empt', mainly in "pre-empt-ive" (preemptive scheduling). It also fires weakly in "att-empt-s". Members are detectors of the same piece and of similar mid-word pieces such as 'pos' in "prepositional".
result.label: 'empt' piece in preemptive

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "production" (e.g. "production engineering", "production is", "production planner"), whatever word follows. Members detect "production" itself in the previous position.
result.label: Token following "production"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that precede a suffix or continue a word, such as 'fold', 'oppos', 'su', and 'most' in 'rightmost'. It looks like a mix of word-start fragments, with the logits favouring suffixes like 'ly', 'ing' and 'ness'.
result.label: Word fragments awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on the token ' no' (negation/quantifier), including when it is repeated or begins words like "noisy" or "noetic". Weaker on "no matter". Pushes towards words like sole, any, alone. Silent on text without ' no'.
result.label: Token ' no' detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " component" (also "vital", "strength"), often in "A vital component of..." at the start of a document. Members detect component, element, part and attribute words. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: " component" word, "vital component of"

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start fragments (trou-, cr-, Mak-, wind-, heaven-) where a suffix is expected, such as -badour, -ust, -ers, -ly. Weak, mixed evidence; silent on one 'trou' example, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Word-start fragments awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on the token ' stream', especially as the first piece of words like streamline(s), stream function, and stream-of-. It also fires weakly on the following 'lin'/'lines' pieces. Members are mostly ' stream' detectors.
result.label: ' stream' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' up' in all examples, including 'up, down', 'made up of' and 'opened up'. Members are mostly ' up' detectors, plus a few word-piece detectors. The one contrast example is silent, but it lacks a clear difference.
result.label: ' up' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' simple' (mostly as in "present simple", "simple closed curve") and on the name-start piece ' Gott' (Gottfried), with weaker hits on ' Mer' and ' straightforward'. Layer-0 token detectors for these tokens.
result.label: ' simple' and ' Gott' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces following "da" (mainly "iry" in "dairy", also "un" in "daunting", " V" in "da Vinci"). Silent in "non-dairy", where the hyphen breaks the "da" + piece pattern.
result.label: piece after "da" (dairy, daunting)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'atience' in the word "patience", mostly when "patience" starts a sentence (e.g. "Patience is key"). Weaker when the word follows other text. Layer-0 token detectors for 'atience' drive it.
result.label: 'atience' piece of "patience"

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens in the middle of a longer, split word or acronym, such as 'ER' in capitalized strings, ' Fin' in Finance, and ' RO' in ROUGE. It looks like a first-layer piece detector, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ER, Fin, RO

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'IA', mostly in the acronym EIA (Environmental Impact Assessment) and its plural 'IAs'. It also fires weakly on 'lo' in 'overexploitation' and on 'IA' in CIA.
result.label: 'IA' piece in EIA acronym

result.description: Fires on relative/complementizer words, mainly " who" and also " that", " though", " how", introducing a clause. Silent on " who" directly after a noun like "authors who" or "someone who", so it seems to need a particular construction.
result.label: Clause-introducing 'who' / 'that'
'hi' in Gandhi
result.description: Fires on the token 'hi' as the final piece of the name Gandhi (Gand|hi). It also fires on 'hi' at the start of a document. Weak activation appears on a few other word-final pieces.

Fires on mid-word pieces after a capitalized initial like "Val" (Valuation, Valence, Valdez) and on symbols after "Q" (Q^T, Q-in). Silent on lowercase "valence" in chemistry, so it needs the capitalized or Q-initial context.
result.label: Word pieces after Val- or Q

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on a grab-bag of specific tokens (' exposed', ' Clay', ' acid', ' MS', ' trial'). Members are mostly single-token detectors for these words, with no shared context or meaning.
result.label: Mixed token detectors: exposed, Clay, acid

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens with no clear shared meaning: ' longest' before 'path', 'sl' in 'landslides', quotes, ' delivered', ' original'. Peaks are inconsistent and members are mostly token-specific layer-0 detectors, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Scattered mixed tokens, 'longest' peak

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment " cont" (contour, contaminated, contemplation, contributes), a split-off prefix before the rest of the word. Weaker on " emb" and "object". Silent on the whole word "cartography" contexts.
result.label: ' cont' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token " compiler" in programming/compiler-design text, e.g. "compiler design" and "production compiler". Members include compiler-token detectors and software-related tokens. The contrast text, which uses "compilation" instead, stays silent.
result.label: compiler token detector

result.description: Fires on the modal ' can' after a noun-phrase subject (e.g. "feedback can", "aid can") in academic-style text, predicting a verb such as "be", "help" or "enhance". Silent when ' can' starts the text with no subject before it.
result.label: modal ' can' after subject noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ogn' in words like "cognitive", "cognizing", "recognize", at the start of the piece. Several MLP members are detectors of 'ogn'. Weak activation on 'cogn' and rare other tokens.
result.label: 'ogn' word piece (cogn-/recogn-)

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings like 'ing' in "long-last|ing", and on 'in' in "August|in", plus the hyphen in "long-". It stays quiet on 'ing' in ordinary verbs such as "deliver|ing". It looks tied to the "long-lasting/standing" compound.
result.label: Suffix 'ing' in long-lasting

result.description: Fires on the token " phase" itself, strongest in repeated lists like "phase 9 phase 10 phase" and in project or development stage uses. It fires more weakly on physical phase ("solid-liquid phase"). Mostly a token detector.
result.label: ' phase' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "construct" (constructing, reconstructed) at the start of a word, and on " Cultural" in a repeated heading list. Predicts suffixes like -ing/-ed. Silent on "structuralism" text.
result.label: "construct" word piece (early layer)

result.description: Fires on word-piece continuations inside "displacement" and related split words (disp-lacement, disp-laced, disp-ersion), mainly the 'lacement' piece after "disp". Weaker on other split words like "jet ski-ing" and "Compton scatter-ing".
result.label: 'disp-lacement' word piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ant' completing a word, most strongly in "determinant" in linear algebra text. Also fires weakly on other suffixes like 'ive'. Members are 'ant'-detectors plus a ' determin' detector.
result.label: 'ant' suffix in determinant

result.description: Fires on the newline/paragraph-break token that ends a line in a list of short topic headings (e.g. "Network Automation."), and on the document-start token. It is silent on newlines in other lists, so what separates them is unclear.
result.label: Newline after list-of-headings entries

result.description: Fires on the word "struggle" and its split piece "strugg" (as in "struggles"), mostly in discussion of characters, conflict and narrative. Layer-0 token detectors for strugg/struggle drive it, and it pushes toward struggle-like continuations.
result.label: struggle / strugg token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' stra' when it begins "strain" (shear strain, oblique strain, strain gauges) in mechanics/materials text. It is a layer-0 token detector, with members for stra, stress and other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' stra' piece in "strain"

result.description: Fires on the word " rank" (also " ranking", " ranks") in technical text, such as matrix rank or ranking methods. It also fires weakly on "ness" in "fitness". Members are mostly detectors of "rank".
result.label: rank / ranking token detector
