result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'ct' and 'pt' (also 'umps', 'stick') inside longer words like Sculpture, Leptons, junction, convective. It predicts word-continuation suffixes such as 's', 'ive', 'ure'.
result.label: Mid-word 'ct'/'pt' fragments

result.description: Fires on the given names ' Julius' and ' Robert' in name sequences like "Julius Robert Mayer" or "Gaius Julius Caesar". It weakly fires on other first names of scientists (Wolfgang, Thomas), in early-layer name contexts.
result.label: Julius / Robert first names

result.description: Fires on a few specific tokens, mainly ' tap' (heel tap, ball tap), also ' Card' and ' Berg', weakly on ' horizon' and ' Nash'. Peaks are mixed; members are mostly single-token detectors with no clear shared theme.
result.label: tap / Card token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " at" in all 64 peaks, in locative or point-of-reference uses ("at some point", "at noon", "at both ends", "function at a point"). Members are mostly " at" detectors in layer 0.
result.label: ' at' preposition detector

result.description: Fires on the token "DP", mostly at the start of a document as the bare acronym for GDP, and more weakly on the "DP" piece inside "GDP". Driven by a "DP" token detector in layer 0.
result.label: DP token (GDP acronym)

result.description: Fires on function words, suffixes and punctuation (' to', ' and', ',', ' from', 'ant') directly following the word "resistance"/"resistant" in text about physical resistance (fluid, frictional, corrosion). Silent on ' to' in unrelated engineering text.
result.label: Token after "resistance" (resistant, to, comma)

result.description: Fires mostly on " inspired" (e.g. "inspired by") and on a few word pieces like "rug", "chart" in "Uncharted", and "expl" in "unexplored". Members detect "inspired"/"insp" and similar participles.
result.label: "inspired" and odd word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token 'ful' when it stands as its own word-start or standalone piece (e.g. "ful application", "fulness"). It stays silent when 'ful' is a suffix attached to a stem, as in pain-ful, meaning-ful, mind-ful.
result.label: standalone 'ful' token
'quency' in 'frequency'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'quency' completing 'frequency', as in 'Radiofrequency' or 'high-frequency'. It is carried by members detecting 'quency' and 'fre'. It is silent on unrelated text.

Fires on the token " game" (also " Game"), including in game theory, game tree, game environments and game testing. It is weaker in "the game of love". The circuit is led by game-token detectors in layer 0.
result.label: ' game' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'c' in "recon|c|iliation" (the split after "recon"). It stays quiet on 'c' in other words like "trans|c|ends" or "inter|c|ultural". Members detect 'c'/'cil' and "recon" pieces.
result.label: 'c' inside "reconciliation"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ried" in "dried", mostly in "dried herbs" in cooking text. It fires weakly on a few other culinary or language word pieces and stays silent on other cooking text without "dried".
result.label: "ried" in "dried herbs"

result.description: Fires on the opening curly brace '{' in LaTeX math commands such as \vec{E}, \mathbf{k} and \mathbf{r}, right after the command name. It stays silent on plain numeric math like exponents. A few weak hits on 'yl' and 'aki'.
result.label: LaTeX command opening brace

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'in' in succ-in-yl, 'ric' in cit-ric or paramet-ric, inside multi-piece technical words (mostly biochemistry/science terms). Silent on ordinary whole words in plain text.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in technical terms

result.description: Fires on the token " Error" (also weakly " defect") as a term or heading in technical text, such as error correction, detection, or Type I/II error. Members include detectors of error/errors and defect tokens.
result.label: Error token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ind' right after 'rem' (rem|ind|er, rem|ind|s), a word-piece in 'reminder'/'remind'. Weaker on other 'rem' continuations like 'ed' and 'in'. Members detect 'rem' and 'ind' pieces.
result.label: 'ind' after 'rem' (reminder)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "blem" inside "emblem" (emblem, emblematic, emblems). Members detect the preceding "em" piece and related word fragments. Weak activation on a few unrelated tokens.
result.label: "blem" in emblem

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces in technical or security text, mostly ' alert', also ' sever' (severity), ' dead', ' fault', ' vulner', ' eyes'. Peaks are mixed word-starts rather than one word; many members detect single tokens like alert, sever, ull.
result.label: Alert/severity word pieces in technical text

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 'es' completing "isotop-es" (also radioisotopes), and weakly on similar split words like chromosomes. Silent on 'es' in other words such as "excesses" or "focuses".
result.label: 'es' ending of isotopes

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' diagn' (in "diagnosis") and on 'osis' completing it, mostly in medical text. Members are detectors of diagn/diagnostic/-osis pieces. Weak activation on a few unrelated word pieces like 'Nav' and 'uit'.
result.label: diagnosis word pieces (diagn/osis)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'clic' (as in "cyclic loading", "cyclical"), at the start of the token after 'cy'. Mainly driven by a 'clic' token detector; pushes towards cycle/sequence words.
result.label: 'clic' piece of cyclic

result.description: Fires on the token ' trees', mostly as the plural head noun of data-structure terms (binary search trees, AVL trees, Red-Black trees). It is silent on "Trees" in the capitalized title-case "Avl Trees" contrast.
result.label: ' trees' in data-structure text

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ize'/'izes'/'is' completing "emphasize/emphasizes/emphasis", after the ' emphas' piece. Silent on 'ize' in other words like "utilize".
result.label: emphas-ize suffix

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'ho' / 'oting' / 'ot' inside "troubleshooting" (after "troubles"), with weaker firing on 'ho' in names like Khoikhoi or Fraunhofer. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: troubleshooting word pieces ho/oting

result.description: Fires on varied abstract adjectives/nouns (spatial, temporal, subjects, authentic, observer) in art and perspective-related text, often as a modifier before a noun. Peaks are scattered with low consistency; members include art and spatial token detectors.
result.label: Art-context abstract modifier words

result.description: Fires on a standalone 's' token, often a split-off fragment or word-initial piece (e.g. 's' before 'ines', 'ian'). Silent on plural or contraction 's' attached to a preceding word. Also weakly on ' their'.
result.label: Standalone 's' fragment token
'cies' after 'ica' (intricacies)
result.description: Fires on the token 'cies' when it completes "intricacies" (preceded by 'ica'). It is weak in "Democracies" and silent in "discrepancies". The circuit relies on detectors of the preceding 'ica' piece.
Fires on the token "war" as a word piece, mostly in "interwar", "postwar" and "-war" prefix or compound forms. It is weakly active on "dwar(f)" and "Kh-war-izmi". It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "war" in interwar/postwar compounds

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside surname-like or technical names, especially Navier-Stokes (Nav, Sto, ière, Louis) and names like Moholy-Nagy. Members detect name fragments and physics/math terms. Peaks are mixed, so it looks like a name-fragment detector.
result.label: Name fragments in Navier-Stokes-like names

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' d' (a lowercase d with leading space), as in "dining", "drier", "dH = dQ + dW", "d-orbit", "timesdilation". Its own d-detecting members dominate; the contrast has no ' d'.
result.label: Space-prefixed ' d' token

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (c in Edu-c-ated, et/rag, -ention in Retention) inside the first words of capitalized heading-like lines after a paragraph break; predicts word completions such as -ission or -usion. Silent on 'c' in a surname.
result.label: Mid-word piece in heading words

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'rier' completing "barrier" (mostly physics barrier contexts), and less on 'wed' in "skewed" and 'cur' in "incur"/"inaccurate". Predicts word-ending suffix pieces. Silent on unrelated physics text.
result.label: 'rier' in barrier, plus skewed/incur

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside particular compound words: 'agram' (Diagram, Instagram), 'umann' (von Neumann), and 'ground' (underground, battleground). Mostly a within-word suffix detector, with token-specific upstream members.
result.label: Suffix pieces: agram, umann, ground
' Arch' word-start piece (Archimedes)
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Arch', mostly at the start of Archimedes-like names and misspellings. It is a layer-0 token detector, supported by members for Arch, Archimedes, architect and similar word-initial pieces.

Fires on word-start or mid-word pieces 'ced' (in antecedent, receded, placed), ' Sem' (Semantic...) and ' Sc' (Scanning, Score), mostly in linguistics or technical headings. Members detect these specific pieces.
result.label: Sem / Sc / ced word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token 'on' when it starts a document or sits in a repeated "on" sequence, as in "onons" or "ononions". It stays silent on 'on' ending phonon-like words (phonon, pon-on).
result.label: 'on' at start, not in phonon

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments of rare words (Lev-, Cour-, Mor-, Liber-, -ander, aut-) where the word continues in the next token. Predicts a suffix piece like 'ander'. Peaks are scattered, with mostly token-specific detector members.
result.label: Rare word-start fragments (Lev, Cour, ander)

result.description: Fires on a standalone space token ' ' that comes before digits, especially the start of a year or number (199…, 196…, 0 to), and sometimes ' late' before a decade. It stays silent after "During the" / "Throughout the" before 21st/20th.
result.label: Space token before digits/years

result.description: Fires on varied tokens: ' relevant' after "stay", suffix pieces like 'ing'/'es', and ' on'. Many peaks follow stay/strive/thrive-type words. Contrast ' on' stays silent in other constructions. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: stay/strive word continuations, mixed

result.description: Fires on the token " von" in German-style personal names (Klaus von Klitzing, John von Neumann). Weaker activation on the piece "medi" inside words like "intermediate" or "mediated". Members include " von" and " van" detectors.
result.label: ' von' in personal names

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'osa', mainly in "mosaic" (m-osa-ic) and also at the start of words like "osaur". Members include 'osa' token detectors and the preceding ' m' piece.
result.label: 'osa' piece in mosaic

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " fl"/" Fl" when it starts a longer word split into pieces (flour, flute, flame, flora, fluid). Needs the piece to be a word start, not a full word; the cello contrast stays silent.
result.label: " fl" word-start piece (flour, flute)

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ners' (in partners, superpartners, manners) and on ' characters'/' partners' tokens. Strongest on 'ners' after 'part', predicting 'hips' continuation. Mixed token set, so a loose family of related pieces.
result.label: 'ners' and 'characters' tokens

result.description: Fires on the noun ' work' (labor, workplace, work done) in the middle of a phrase, e.g. "modern work place", "remote work", "work done by forces". Silent on the verb "work together". Predicts compound continuations like place, force, load.
result.label: noun ' work' before compounds

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ed, -ing, -s) completing the word "intercept" in circle-geometry text (intercepted arc, inscribed angle). Silent on -ed after other verbs in similar geometry text.
result.label: Suffix after "intercept" in geometry

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' or 'ed' right after the stem 'sow' (sowing, sowed), and on the word ' sow' itself. Mostly silent on 'ing' after other stems like craft, uncover, predict.
result.label: Suffix after 'sow' (sowing/sowed)

result.description: Fires on the object right after a form of "save" (mostly " money", also " saving", " save", " your", " the"), as in "save energy, save money". Silent on "money" in other uses, such as "enough money".
result.label: Object after "save" (money)

result.description: Fires on 'SA' in the acronym RCSA (after 'RC'), and more weakly on ' and'/' or' joining two nouns in technical text. It stays silent on 'SA' inside parentheses "(RCSA)".
result.label: RCSA 'SA' and noun-joining 'and'

result.description: Fires on early word-fragment tokens such as 'lig' (in oligopoly), ' entr', ' Compet', and dash runs, mostly in economics and competition text. Looks like a layer-0 token-piece detector; the logits favour no clear next word.
result.label: Word-start fragments like 'lig', 'entr'

result.description: Fires on the token ' Joy' at the start of the name Joyce (and weakly on 'ce' in James Joyce, or 'Joy' in 'Joyous'). Members include Joy and 'ce' detectors plus literary-context hints.
result.label: Joy in Joyce

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' app' (appliances, app store, appetizer), a layer-0 token detector. It fires on the first fragment of a longer word and also when it stands alone as "app". Predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' app' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Bar' at the start of words like Baroque, Barcoque and Barthes, with a weaker response to ' Dutch'. Mostly layer-0 token detectors for ' Bar' and ' Dutch'.
result.label: ' Bar' word-start (Baroque) detector

result.description: Fires on the token right after "accurate" (mostly " and", also " forec", " bud", " model", " data"), as in "accurate and reliable". Stays silent on " and" in other contexts, such as lists or after other words.
result.label: Token following "accurate"

result.description: Fires on the token " Australia" (also " Australian"), and weakly on Canada/Canadian. Supported by an Australia-specific attention member and an Australian-word MLP member, plus other country-name members.
result.label: Australia token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' bu' (as in buying, buyer) and sometimes ' purch' (purchasing), mostly in economics or commerce text. It predicts suffix pieces like 'ers' and 'able'.
result.label: ' bu' of buying/buyer

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word or a word that continues (' Syl' in syllogism, ' disag', ' deliber', ' fal', ' synd', ' permut') and on ' without'. Members are mostly detectors of these individual word starts.
result.label: Word-start fragments and 'without'

result.description: Fires on ' is' after a noun-phrase subject (e.g. "your audience is", "communication is") in expository text, as the main verb of a definition or claim. Silent on ' is' after "it" or in "it is essential" constructions.
result.label: ' is' after noun subject

result.description: Fires on ' while' and ' those' (also weakly ' knowing'), mostly where ' those' is followed by 'very', or ' while' begins a clause. It is silent on ' while' in 'while also/maintaining' after a comma or clause, so it needs a specific construction.
result.label: ' while' / ' those' clause openers

result.description: Fires on the piece "ader" completing "broader" (also " wider" and " bro"), the comparative meaning "wider in scope". Members detect " bro" and "ader" tokens directly, and it stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "broader" comparative piece 'ader'

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated words, mainly " Order" (in "Partial Store Order"), " followed", " reign" and " times" (e.g. "access times", "at all times"). The members are mostly single-token detectors, so the pattern is a mixed set of words.
result.label: Order / followed / reign / times

result.description: Fires on the piece "ort" inside "distortion" (also weakly on other pieces after "dist-" such as "ill", "orted", "ra"). Members detect the "ort" piece and related word fragments.
result.label: "ort" in "distortion"
Capitalized " Model" in named models
result.description: Fires on the capitalized token " Model" when it ends a named model, such as "Waterfall Model" or "Transactional Model of Communication". Members mostly detect " Model"/"model" tokens. The contrast text contains no " Model" token.
Fires on the token right after "play" in play-compounds: "ing" in "role-playing", " of" or " between" after "interplay", and "mechan" after "gameplay". Silent on ordinary " of" after other nouns.
result.label: Suffix or link after "play" words

result.description: Layer-0 latent with mixed peaks: closing braces in LaTeX math (e.g. '}' after \vec{B), ' Menu', Arabic letter pieces, ' summer'. No single token or context dominates; the evidence looks polysemantic.
result.label: Mixed LaTeX braces, Menu, Arabic pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ape' in 'tape' (magnetic tape, tape recording), with occasional weak firing on 'control'. It appears to depend on 'ape' being the end of 'tape' rather than a standalone word.
result.label: 'ape' in 'tape'

result.description: Fires on short word-start pieces or symbols such as 'm', 'θ', 'x', 'sh' in math and physics formulas (m_e c, cos(θ), kx) and in split words (U-shaped). It is silent on 'm' ending 'realm'. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Short symbols/fragments in formulas

result.description: Fires on the token ' punk' (music genre, including in compounds like skatepunk, punky), regardless of context. Weak activation on other music genre words such as rock. Driven mainly by a ' punk' token detector.
result.label: ' punk' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' mob' when it begins "mobility" (e.g. geographic mob-ility, limited mob-ility), predicting a suffix like -ility. Members are mostly ' mob' detectors, plus other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' mob' start of 'mobility'

result.description: Fires on the instrument words " guitar" and " piano" (rarely " keyboard"), mostly in music text listing instruments or bands. Members are mostly token detectors for guitar and piano, plus music-context members. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: guitar / piano instrument words

result.description: Fires on the token ' minor' (also 'ity' in 'minority'), in music-interval contexts like "minor chord" and in the adjective sense "minor actions". Driven mainly by its own-token detectors in layer 0.
result.label: ' minor' token detector

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on varied word-initial fragments (' germ', ' Douglas', ' Population', ' mac', 'ser', 'inhab', 'sem') that are likely to continue into a longer word. Logits favor suffixes like 'ination'/'ining'. No single token dominates.
result.label: Word-start fragments awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on 'consideration', 'consider', 'considering' and 'reward' (especially in reinforcement learning text), with weaker pull from related benefit/pay/pleasure words. The contrast silence is unexplained, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: consider/consideration and reward words

result.description: Fires on capitalized ' Field' as a title-case word, especially in "Quantum Field Theory" and similar names. Silent on the contrast text, which has no ' Field' token. Members include ' Field' and ' field' detectors plus 'Quant' and 'um' pieces.
result.label: Capitalized ' Field' token

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces ('ful', 'in', 'ation', 'ant') that complete a word split into pieces, especially 'ful' in "Successful". Silent on 'ful' in "meaningful", so it depends on the specific word stem.
result.label: Word-final suffix pieces, e.g. -ful

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ga' inside the word "Reggae" (Reg-ga-e), in both capitalised and lowercase forms. Only weak activation on 'emy' in other words; silent on other music-genre text.
result.label: 'ga' in Reggae

result.description: Fires on the 'ge' piece in "Lar-ge" within the phrase "Law of Large Numbers". Members detect 'ge' and ' Lar' tokens. It is silent on the related Central Limit Theorem contrast.
result.label: 'ge' in Law of Large Numbers

result.description: Fires on determiners (the, our, their) right after "behind", as in "driving force behind our moral...", "behind the scenes". Silent on 'the' after other words like "if" or "that". Driven by 'behind' detector members.
result.label: Determiner right after "behind"

result.description: Fires on the token ' visual', mostly at the start of a text or phrase (e.g. "visual presentation", "visual and auditory"). It stays silent when ' visual' follows words like "just", "both", "for" or a comma mid-sentence.
result.label: ' visual' at phrase start

result.description: Fires on the piece 'sect' inside 'dissect' (dissective, dissecting, dissects), after 'dis'. It is silent on other text such as 'touches the curve'. It is driven by 'sect' token detectors and a preceding ' dis' detector.
result.label: 'sect' in dissect

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' manif' (start of "manifold"), and weakly on ' Hamiltonian', in math/physics text. It is mostly a token detector for ' manif', with no clear extra requirement.
result.label: ' manif' (manifold) token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " activation" in the chemistry phrase "activation energy" (often at the start of a text). It is weaker in other uses. Members include detectors for " activation" and " energy".
result.label: "activation" in activation energy

result.description: Fires on the token ' fields' (plural), mostly as subject of a sentence about academic or scientific fields (e.g. "fields encompass", "fields are interconnected"). Weaker in "in diverse fields". Silent on singular "field's" in electromagnetism text.
result.label: Plural ' fields' token detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces in cell-division (mitosis/meiosis) text: ' chrom' in chromatids/chromosomes, ' pol' in poles, ' II' after phase names. Predicts biology word endings. Silent in physics/abstract text.
result.label: Cell division terms (chrom, pol, II)

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "face" in "face-to-face". Weaker on "face" as a verb followed by "the" or "such". Silent on hyphens after other words (non-, eye-, snail-).
result.label: hyphen in face-to-face

result.description: Fires on the token ' however', mostly as a sentence-initial adverb followed by a comma. It is weaker after a semicolon or in a mid-clause use. Layer-0 detectors for ' however' drive it.
result.label: ' however' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "rop" inside "crop" (c|rop), as in crop rotation or crop breeding, and more weakly in "anthropogenic". Silent on agriculture text without this split-token piece.
result.label: "rop" piece in "crop"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ptions' as the ending of split words, mostly 'disru|ptions', also 'interru|ptions', 'eru|ptions' and 'descri|ptions'. Silent on unrelated text. Members detect 'ptions' and the preceding 'ru'/'descri' pieces.
result.label: 'ptions' suffix piece (disruptions)

result.description: Fires on the word " everyone" in running text, often as the subject after words like "because", "imagine", "ensuring" or "not". Members detect " everyone", "everything", "every" and "all". It predicts " everyone" again.
result.label: ' everyone' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments (' sh', ' sp', ' fill', ' wed', ' quad', ' bl') and ' filled' where the word is incomplete or continues; pushes toward suffix pieces like 'aped', 'elve', 'gar'. Mixed tokens, little context requirement.
result.label: Word-start fragments sh/sp/filled

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iqu' inside words like "etiquette" and "ubiquinone", usually after 'et' or 'ub'. It predicts suffix pieces such as 'ette' or 'ettes'. It fires weakly on 'tt' in "Bretton".
result.label: 'iqu' piece in etiquette/ubiquinone

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in a layer-0 mix: 'ers' in "composers", 'ord' in "chord", 'primit', 'rond', Arabic letters. Silent on 'ers' in performers, holders, listeners, gardeners. Music and technical contexts partly dominate; peaks are scattered.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments, e.g. composers

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on a few specific word tokens (' past', ' faith', ' conv', ' dream', ' trad') that are the first piece of a noun or word stem. Strongest on "past" in "past perfect". Members are token detectors for these words.
result.label: past/faith/dream word-stem detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'phere' completing atmospheric layer names (stratosphere, mesosphere, thermosphere), and weakly on 'eros' in aerosol and other mid-word pieces like 'ME'. Needs the preceding atmospheric word fragment.
result.label: -sphere suffix in atmosphere words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ission', mainly as the end of 'fission' (nuclear fission, binary fission), also at the start of a document. Members are mostly detectors of this token piece.
result.label: 'ission' piece in fission
'sc' in microscopy/spectroscopy
result.description: Fires on the token 'sc' inside words like micro-sc-opy and spectro-sc-opy, in scientific technique lists (microscopy, NMR spectroscopy). It needs the word-piece context before 'sc'; silent in unrelated text.

Fires on ' to' after a noun or term that takes a "to" complement (corresponds directly to, representation to, connecting X to, dequeue to), including range and infinitive uses. It stays silent on some ' to' after approach, helps, essential or contribute.
result.label: ' to' after relational words

result.description: Fires on the word " Bell" (mainly in Alexander Graham Bell, Bell Numbers) and on " joint" (anatomical/fibrous joints), with weak activation on "economic growth". Members are mostly token detectors for Bell and joint.
result.label: Bell and joint token detector

result.description: Fires on "domain" in signal-processing phrases like "time-domain" and "frequency domain", with a weaker response on Laplace "Trans". Several members detect "domain" itself. It stays silent in unrelated math text.
result.label: time/frequency "domain" in signals

result.description: Fires on the token ' warm' (as in warm spectrum, warm tones, warmth), mostly describing colour, light or tone qualities. Driven mainly by token-detector members for ' warm'. Silent in the contrast text, which has no ' warm' token.
result.label: ' warm' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' if' when it is followed by 'all' (e.g. "if all plants were", "if all else fails"). It stays silent on ' if' before 'they' or 'you'. Members detect ' if', ' though', ' like' and ' as'.
result.label: ' if' before 'all'

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'amp' in damping, 'Pod' in Podolsky, 'agh' in spaghetti and 'ish'. These are word pieces inside longer words. Peaks are scattered with low consistency, so this looks like a layer-0 word-piece detector.
result.label: Mid-word fragment pieces (amp, Pod, agh)

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings like 'iction' and 'ict' after 'conv' (conviction, convict), and weakly on a few other suffix pieces. It needs the preceding 'conv' piece; 'friction' fires through separate members.
result.label: conv-iction / conv-ict suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'chan' inside "mechanics"/"mechanical" (me-chan-ics, biome-chan-ics). It is silent on other text, and weakly active on math symbols. Members detect 'chan' and related word pieces.
result.label: 'chan' in mechanics/mechanical

result.description: Fires on the word piece " orth" (also " Orth", " orthogonal") at the start of words like orthogonal, orthonormal, orthography. It is weaker on orthodox. It pushes the next token towards "ogonal" or "on".
result.label: orth- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token " looks", strongest in "looks at ..." (e.g. "looks at what happens"). It fires more weakly on "looks" meaning "appears" (looks good). Members are detectors of look/looks/at and similar verbs such as examine.
result.label: ' looks' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' fit' as a word start, mostly before 'ness' (fitness, inclusive fitness, Darwinian fitness). Members are detectors of 'fit' and nearby words like matching and comfort. Predicts suffix pieces such as 'ness'.
result.label: ' fit' before -ness (fitness)

result.description: Fires on the final piece "unity" in the word "immunity" (innate, adaptive, humoral, cell-mediated immunity). Members detect the "imm" + "une/un" pieces. The contrast is silent when the word is not split like this.
result.label: "unity" piece of "immunity"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ology' (also 'ologies', 'ideals') when it completes the word "ideology" after the piece 'ide'. It stays silent on 'ology' in other words like sociology, phenomenology, narratology.
result.label: 'ology' in "ideology"

result.description: Fires on word pieces in chemistry/molecular-structure terms (VSEPR's 'PR', Aufbau's 'bau', 'mo|let|ional', Lewis 'structures'), mainly at the end of a split technical word. Predicts molecule-related continuations like 'cules' and 'configurations'.
result.label: Chemistry bonding-term word pieces
'iger' in refrigeration
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iger' in "refr|iger|ation" and related forms (refrigerant, refrigerating) in technical text. Weak activation on a few other word pieces such as 'force' in workforce and ' reci' in reciprocity.
Fires on ' the' (also ' these', ' of') directly after the preposition 'of' (e.g. 'one of the', 'of the key'), in noun-phrase chains. Silent on ' the' after verbs or at clause start.
result.label: 'the' right after 'of'

result.description: Fires on the word or preposition right after "basis" (of, for, vectors, and), e.g. "basis of the subspace", "basis for". Stays silent on "of" after other nouns like "set of" or "aspect of".
result.label: Function word after "basis"
Suffix after 'employ' (-er/-ers/-ment)
result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces 'er', 'ers', 'ment' completing "employ" words (employers, employer, employment). Silent on 'er' in other words like "foster" or comparatives like "richer".

Fires on word endings (apostrophe, -ian, -ic, n) right after "Euler" or similar stems, e.g. Euler's, Eulerian, athletic. Silent on apostrophes after Newton, Polya, Cook, so it mostly depends on Euler-like stems.
result.label: Euler suffix: 's, -ian, -ic

result.description: Fires on the token ' objective' (noun or adjective), strongest when 'objective' was just seen or repeated in the context (e.g. "both objective and objective"). Weaker on "key/primary objective". Members are mostly detectors of ' objective' and near-synonyms such as goal and intention.
result.label: ' objective' token detector
' disturb' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' disturb' (as in "disturbance"), always at that piece. Members are detectors of disturb, perturb, conflict and rupt-type tokens. Fires on every occurrence in the evidence.

Fires on the token ' Henry', both as a first name (Henry Bragg, Joseph Henry) and in "King Henry Henry VIII". Members are mostly Henry detectors plus other first-name and 'VIII' pieces. It stays silent on other first names in lists.
result.label: ' Henry' name token

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'it' inside the split word "capacitance"/"capacitor" (after "capac"). It stays silent on 'it' in other words like "exploit", "necessitates" and "exhibit".
result.label: 'it' inside "capac-it-ance"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'opol' inside "oligopoly/oligopolistic", after "olig". It stays silent on 'opol' in "monopoly/monopolistic", so it needs the preceding "olig" piece.
result.label: 'opol' in oligopoly

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'oc', 'rop', 'ene' inside the word "Anthropocene"/"Anthropological" (also weakly on '-ation' endings). Members detect these word pieces such as 'rop' and 'oc'.
result.label: Anthropocene word-piece 'oc'/'rop'

result.description: Fires on the token 'LP' as an acronym piece, strongest at the start of a text or after F, and weaker in NLP or LPDs. Members are mostly 'LP' token detectors.
result.label: 'LP' acronym token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' at the start of a word (quiring, queries, quaintances, quencianism). It stays silent when 'qu' sits mid-word (Acquiring, unequivocal, earthquake) or in the whole word 'quite'.
result.label: word-initial 'qu' piece

result.description: Fires on the letter 'J' (and nearby pieces like 'ag', 'uly') at the start of a word, acronym or name, such as January, JIT, JTs, JPEG. Silent on other acronyms like LLF.
result.label: Capital J token detector

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "Treaty" (Treaty of Versailles/Neuilly), and on word pieces like "ang" in "bilangility" and "ol"/"s" in treaty or law-related and multi-piece words. Silent on ordinary ' of' such as "part of", "one of".
result.label: "Treaty of" and treaty-word fragments

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in lists of abstract qualities or virtues (achievements, performance, simplicity, humility, "and", commas), mostly in general or motivational prose. Silent on technical "performance" such as database or energy performance. Low consistency.
result.label: Abstract quality lists, non-technical performance

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces (-cles, -les, -aries, -ices, -ays) completing a word in short list-style headings, e.g. "Circles.", "Angles.", "Boundaries." Low consistency; mixed suffix tokens in outline-like lists of topics.
result.label: Plural suffix in topic lists

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' condition' (including conditionally) and ' tick' (tickets, ticking), plus a few others like 'antage' in disadvantage. Mostly a layer-0 token detector for a small set of word stems that are often followed by suffixes.
result.label: condition / tick word-stem detector

result.description: Fires on the word pieces of "Gradient" (' Grad' and 'ient'), mostly in math/ML text such as gradient operators or gradient descent. Members detect Grad/ient pieces, with weak extra firing on a few other tokens.
result.label: Gradient word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " web" (web design, development, pages), with minor peaks on "laration" in "Declaration" and " array". Members are layer-0 detectors of web/Web, network, online and similar words.
result.label: " web" token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " human" / " Human", including as the start of words like humanism, humanity, humanistic. Members are mostly detectors of "human" itself. Output pushes towards humanitarian, dignity, natural.
result.label: ' human' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'red' as a suffix inside words like non-barred, spurred, blurred, and "redients/reditation" fragments, plus 'ame' in "flame". Silent on 'red' in "ingredients".
result.label: 'red' suffix piece (not ingredients)

result.description: Fires mostly on the token " Marine", especially at the start of a line in lists of academic subject headings (Marine Ecology, Marine Pollution). Weaker on a few name pieces like "rico" and "rost". Members are detectors of marine/ocean words.
result.label: Marine at line start

result.description: Fires on the token " thoughts" in abstract text about thinking, feelings and expression. Early-layer members detect " thoughts" itself. Pushes toward mind-related nouns like soul and body.
result.label: ' thoughts' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' of' or ' and' directly after the word "efficiency" (e.g. "efficiency of", "efficiency and"). Silent on ' of' after other nouns like adoption, implementation, concept. Members detect 'efficiency' in the previous token plus generic of/and tokens.
result.label: of/and right after "efficiency"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "too" (mostly " much", also " many", " little", " short", " small", " cost"), marking an excess degree. Silent on "as much" and "so much". Members detect "too" and "much".
result.label: Word after "too" (too much)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'in' completing "basin" (after "bas"), and weakly on other suffix pieces after "bas" or similar stems (ics, al). Silent on 'in' in "vein".
result.label: 'in' completing "basin"

result.description: Fires on the token "section" (as in "Intersection Theory", "cross-section") at the start of a document or heading. Members detect "section" itself plus word pieces like "travers" and "Pre" that precede it. Weaker on "subsection" and "dissection".
result.label: "section" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sol' at the start of words like solubility, solvent and solute, mostly in chemistry text on solutions. Silent on the whole word 'solution'. Members mostly detect ' sol' itself.
result.label: ' sol' word-start piece (solubility/solvent)

result.description: Fires on the quantifier/determiner words " both" and " either" (including repeated or "neither/either" constructions), mostly where they introduce a pair of alternatives or items. Members are mostly detectors of " both" and " either".
result.label: both / either pair words
'ple' after 'de' prefix
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ple' (also 'ci') directly after the prefix 'de', as in de-ple-tion and de-ci-bels. Members detect 'de' plus following pieces like 'ple', 'ci', 'h'.

Fires on the token " gradient", especially when it repeats right after a preceding "gradient" or gradient-related term (e.g. "concentration gradient gradient"). Weak activation on repeated words like "pattern" or "route". Members mostly detect gradient and other repeated tokens.
result.label: Repeated " gradient" token

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "well" in "well-" compounds (well-crafted, well-known, well-defined). Stays silent on hyphens after other words such as fine-, world-, resolution-, cook-.
result.label: Hyphen after "well"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Fut"/" fut" at the start of "futures" or "Futurist(s)", in both finance and art-movement contexts. It predicts continuations like "ures" and "ris".
result.label: " Fut" word-start (futures/futurist)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cent' inside words like in-cent-ive and user-cent-ric (also techno-cent-ric). It stays silent on 'cent' in 'reminiscent'.
result.label: 'cent' in incentive / -centric

result.description: Fires on varied tokens that are non-initial pieces of topic or heading words in list-like outlines (e.g. "Power System Control", "Dia-lect-ology", "Language isolates"). The peaks are scattered, with no single token or topic.
result.label: Scattered tokens in outline-style lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'atures' in "temperatures" (mostly) and on 'amil' in "Tamil". Two separate word-piece detectors, each tied to its specific word.
result.label: 'atures' in temperatures; 'amil' in Tamil

result.description: Fires on the token ' defined' in all its uses (passive "is defined by", "defined benefit/contribution", "defined within"). Members are mostly detectors of defined/define/describes and similar words like identified.
result.label: ' defined' token detector

result.description: Fires on " function" (also point/points, rate, derivative) as a noun in calculus-style math text, e.g. "differentiable function", "second derivative of the function". Silent on "function" as a verb or in non-calculus senses.
result.label: Calculus 'function' noun

result.description: Fires on the token ' August' when it starts a name like August-Louis (Cauchy) or Augustan, i.e. as a name piece. The contrast is silent on a list of names without it. Next-token logits favor name continuations like Christian.
result.label: ' August' as a name piece

result.description: Fires on the token right after the prefix "after" (mostly "math", also "-" as in after-school/after-effects, and " nation"), completing an "after…" compound. Weaker on "the" after "Following"/"after".
result.label: Continuation after "after" prefix

result.description: Fires on several unrelated word-start fragments in layer 0, mainly 'liqu' (liquid), ' aqu' (aquifer), 'iration' (inspiration), ' integra', and ' necessary'. Members are token detectors for each piece; it is a mixed set of word pieces, not one meaning.
result.label: Mixed word pieces: liqu, aqu, iration
' lock' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' lock' (locking, lock-based, type of lock), mostly in computing/concurrency text. It is driven mainly by the layer-0 MLP and attention latents that detect ' lock' itself. Predicts words like 'in', 'doors', 'keys'.

Fires on varied word pieces in technical or academic terms, such as 'ctor' in functor, ' metric', ' Geography', ' Political' in academic topic headings, and ' Norm'. Members are mostly detectors of individual tokens, with no single shared role.
result.label: Technical academic term pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " Information" / " information", mostly as a modifier or head in technical phrases like "Quantum Information Theory" or "information theory". Predicts nouns like theory, needs, technology, databases next. The contrast text does not contain the word.
result.label: Word 'information' in technical phrases

result.description: Fires on the 'ur' piece in the split-up name "Maclaurin" (also 'ze', 'pping' pieces in other split words). It depends on the preceding pieces "Mac"/"la" in that word; other 'ur' contexts stay quiet.
result.label: 'ur' in Maclaurin

result.description: Layer-0 latent with mixed peaks: Arabic word pieces (ة, ال, diacritics) plus scattered odd tokens like 'ũ', ' editing', ' Müller', ' Boy'. Low consistency; no clear shared meaning, mostly token-level detectors in early layer.
result.label: Arabic word pieces, mixed odd tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' ens' (the start of "ensures") and on ' ensure', mostly in technical or explanatory text where something "ensures that" an outcome. The silent contrast has no such word.
result.label: "ens" in ensure/ensures

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'abol' in met-abol-ic/ism/ite and 'organ' in micro-organ-isms (also in-organ-ic), mid-word before a suffix like -ism/-ic. Predicts suffixes such as 'isms', 'ics', 'ism'.
result.label: metabol- / microorgan- word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-initial prefix fragments such as desc, pre, cont, dec, sub, pred when they begin a longer word split into pieces (e.g. contaminating, precedented, predation). Members detect the individual prefixes. Predicts a word continuation.
result.label: Word-initial prefix fragments (pre, cont, dec)

result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces early in a word or name, mainly LaTeX 'mathbf', 'dx', ' pid', and name starts like ' Mik' or ' Laur'. It looks like a first-layer mix of token detectors with no single shared meaning.
result.label: Scattered LaTeX and name-fragment tokens

result.description: Fires on word pieces following "compound"/"bound"/"ground" stems: "ary" in Boundary, " words" after compound, and "-" in compound-hyphen constructions. Silent on hyphens after other words (higher-, form-, in-situ).
result.label: compound/bound word continuation pieces

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'ale' appearing as a word fragment (e.g. "aleph", "aleen", "kaleidoscope", "whale"). It is mostly a layer-0 token detector, with a self-named MLP latent and attention latent driving it.
result.label: 'ale' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'u' in "individuation" (also 'g' / 'ging' in "acknowledgement/acknowledging"), a word piece before the word continues. Silent on a capitalized sentence-initial "Individuation" in the contrast.
result.label: Mid-word 'u'/'g' in individuation, acknowledge

result.description: Fires on the token " Studies", mostly in title-like or field-name phrases (e.g. "Comparative Studies", "Studies in ..."). The contrast text lacks the token. Members include a " Studies" detector and many token-level pieces.
result.label: ' Studies' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' space' or ' white' when it follows or is part of the colour "white" (white space, white balance, white objects). Silent on ' space' meaning outer space or physical space.
result.label: white / white space

result.description: Fires on the token ' unity', mostly as a subject or abstract noun in essay-style text about art or cooperation. It is driven by ' unity' detectors and weakly by related words like collaboration and coherence. Silent on other text.
result.label: ' unity' token detector

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'z' (also 'n', 'berg') inside a long name being spelled out, mainly "Schwar-z-schild" and variants. It stays silent on 'z' at the end of "Lorentz". Predicts word continuation pieces.
result.label: Mid-word 'z' in Schwarzschild

result.description: Fires on commas (occasionally semicolons, periods, or '),') in early-layer text, but stays silent on many commas that precede clauses such as 'while', 'including', 'which', or 'and'. The contrast does not make clear what separates the two cases.
result.label: Comma punctuation, selective

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'em' inside longer words, such as epist-em-ic, dysph-em-ism, se-em-ing. It is a layer-0 token detector for 'em' as a mid-word fragment. The contrast text lacks this piece.
result.label: 'em' word-piece in epistemic

result.description: Fires on ease/availability adverbs and adjectives such as " easily", " easy" and the " abund" piece of "abundant", plus occasionally "diam". Members detect easy/easier, fast, hard, abund and similar degree words.
result.label: easily / easy / abundant words

result.description: Fires on the token ' error' (weaker on ' errors'), mostly in technical text about error correction or detection, e.g. quantum or numerical error. Members are mostly detectors of 'error' and related words like correction.
result.label: ' error' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token piece "cart" in "Descartes" (René Descartes), strongest after "Des" and weaker when "cart" starts a sentence. It stays silent on the misspelling "Kartes". Members are mostly "cart" detectors.
result.label: cart in Descartes

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside particular words, mainly 'ive'/'ives' in "perceive/perceived" and 'c'/'cement' in "announcement". Silent when 'ive' starts a fresh word after a sentence break.
result.label: -ive/-cement pieces in perceive, announcement

result.description: Fires on the piece "an" inside the word "Financial" (Fin|an|cial), mostly in repeated finance headings. It stays silent on "an" at the start of a token or after a period or digit, as in "an|ies" or "2.an|cial".
result.label: "an" in Fin-an-cial

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes (-al, -iour, -istic, -ist) that complete "behavior" words such as behavioral, behaviourists and behavioristic. It is silent on 'al' in unrelated words like disposal or commensalism.
result.label: Behavior word suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' son' at the start of words like sonnet, sonar, sonority, sonorant, mostly in music, poetry or language text. It predicts continuations such as 'ic' or 'net'. A few weaker hits fall on related poetic or musical words.
result.label: ' son' word-start piece (sonnet, sonar)

result.description: Fires mainly on the plural token ' fragments' (also ' traces'), especially after DNA or similar scientific nouns. A few stray Arabic letter pieces also fire. Members are fragment/piece/segment token detectors.
result.label: ' fragments' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces ('ing', 'ed', 'ure', 'ural', 'ic') completing a word, strongest on 'ing' after "script" (scripting languages). Silent on 'ing' in other words like maintaining or adopting.
result.label: Suffix after 'script' (scripting)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ue' completing the word "dialogue", mostly in writing-craft text. It also fires weakly on 'ue' in Virtue and Emanuele. Members include 'ue' detectors and a ' dialog' detector.
result.label: 'ue' ending "dialogue"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' Har' (Harvest, Harland), ' sur' (surplus, surge), ' har' and ' fle' that begin a longer word. Predicts continuation pieces; mostly a token-piece detector with several different prefixes.
result.label: Word-start prefixes Har/sur/fle

result.description: Fires on the standalone word ' intersection' (math sets, lines, or 'intersection of fields'), mostly after 'the'. It stays silent when the word is the start of 'intersectionality' at document start. Driven by intersection token detectors.
result.label: word 'intersection'

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens like 'm' in "pragmatic"/"paradigm", 'ch' in "etching"/"tech"/"crochet", and 'ther' in "ethernet", mid-word pieces that are followed by further word pieces. Members are detectors of these fragments.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'm', 'ch', 'ther'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' nucle' (nucleus, nucleic) and on ' cards' after "deck of". Layer-0 members detect nucle/nuc/card/dice tokens. The two peaks share little meaning beyond token identity, so it is a mixed token detector.
result.label: nucle- and cards token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "ming" ending a word (Programming, overwhelming, warming, farming), and weakly on "ogy" endings. It appears to be a suffix detector for word-final pieces inside multi-token words.
result.label: Word-final 'ming' suffix piece

result.description: Layer-0 target firing on scattered tokens (apostrophe after a name, 'and', word fragments like 'ulse', 'ics', 'an') in academic text. Peaks are inconsistent and the members are mostly token-specific detectors; it likely predicts a word continuation such as Econom.
result.label: Scattered tokens in academic text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ys' at the start of a word split into pieces (ys-regulated, ys-osomal, geophys-ical). It predicts word-completion suffixes like 'ical' and 'ics'. Weak on 'ys' in surveys.
result.label: 'ys' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments right after "sm" (sm|ell, sm|iling, sm|oking, sm|ud), plus a few other mid-word pieces like "ell" in stellar or intracellular. Needs the piece to sit inside a longer word.
result.label: Mid-word pieces after "sm"

result.description: Fires on the token ' extra', strongest when it begins a word like extravagant, extraction or extravagance, and more weakly when it is a standalone adjective ('extra food'). Members include ' extra' detectors and 'ction' detectors.
result.label: ' extra' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the noun " implementation" (also " installation", occasionally " future") as the head of a process noun phrase, where "of" is likely next. Members detect implementation/execution/deployment-type words.
result.label: implementation / installation noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' tra' when it begins "traits" (also "Traffic"/"traitor"), after an adjective like "negative", "somatic" or "phenotypic". It is silent when ' tra' starts the text.
result.label: ' tra' start of "traits"

result.description: Fires on the token ' icon' (as in iconic, iconography), mainly at the start of words like iconic/iconography. Driven by detectors for ' icon' itself; it boosts ' icon', ' icons' and ' Icon' as next tokens.
result.label: ' icon' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' lived' and ' exist' (as in 'existentialist'), with an occasional ' Ray'. Layer-0 token-level detection; predicts suffix pieces like 'ential'. Contrast on a different token is silent.
result.label: ' lived' / ' exist' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in a few specific words: 'ament' in "Fundamentals", 'mu' in "Langmuir", and ' Pascal' in Pascal's Triangle. It is silent on 'ament' in "testament" or after "1.".
result.label: Fundamentals / Langmuir / Pascal pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ful' (also 'fully') in "delightful", mainly after "delight". It stays silent on 'ful' in playful, successful and colourful. Members detect delight, pleasure and enjoy words plus 'ful' pieces.
result.label: 'ful' suffix in delightful

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sch' at the start of scholar-type words (scholars, scholasticism). Members are mostly ' sch' token detectors; weaker on later positions in a passage.
result.label: ' sch' in scholar words

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ile' when it completes the word "tactile" (after the piece 'tact'). It stays silent on 'ile' in other words such as "fertile".
result.label: 'ile' ending "tactile"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ure' completing "fracture" (as in fracture mechanics/toughness), after the piece 'ract'. It stays silent on 'ure' in other words like pressure and composure.
result.label: 'ure' in "fracture"

result.description: Fires on ' listening' (and ' training') when it begins a sentence as a subject noun, as in "listening training can help" or "training is crucial". It stays silent on 'listening' after 'active' or 'actively', or after 'by'.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'listening'/'training' subject

result.description: Fires on the token 'last' when it is a word piece inside a longer word, mainly osteoblasts, osteoclasts and thermoplastics. It also fires on 'aged' in 'damaged'. It fires weakly on the standalone 'last' in 'the last decade'.
result.label: 'last' piece in -blast/-clast words

result.description: Fires on the word ' artist' (and less on ' art') as a noun, mostly when it starts a clause or subject, e.g. "artist created", "artist's". It is silent when 'artist' follows "the", "an" or "between" in abstract art-theory text. Predicts suffixes like -ic and -ally.
result.label: artist token, subject position

result.description: Fires on the word piece " scar" at the start of "scarce" or "scarcity", mostly in resource-allocation and economics text. It is silent on unrelated tokens in the contrast text.
result.label: ' scar' in scarce/scarcity

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces ('ic', 'ity', 'ak', 'ation') completing words in spiritual, philosophical or humanities text (awakening, clarity, humanistic, contemplation). Silent on 'ic' in literary/art-style words like symbolic or Gothic.
result.label: Word-ending suffixes in spiritual/humanities prose

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ative" (also "atively") when it completes the word "iterative", after the "iter" piece. It stays silent on "ative" in other words such as innovative, comparative and creative.
result.label: "ative" in "iterative"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lect' when it starts a word, as in 'lects', 'lectics' or 'lectuels', and weakly on nearby pieces such as 'ive' and 'ic'. It is silent on the contrast text, which lacks that piece. Promotes suffixes like 's' and 'elli'.
result.label: 'lect' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word "database" and "databases" (weaker on "dataset" and "data") in technical text about database systems. Members are mostly detectors of database, data, system and similar computing words.
result.label: database token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' budget' (mostly as a noun after a modifier like traditional, zero-based, performance). Weaker on a few other words such as ' direction'. Members are mostly budget detectors in layer 0.
result.label: ' budget' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'taire', the ending of "Voltaire", in mentions of the Enlightenment philosopher. Members include 'taire' token detectors plus Enlightenment context cues such as Renaissance, ideals, reform and monarch.
result.label: Voltaire 'taire' token

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' in "synchronization", especially in concurrency/computing text. It stays silent on 'ization' in other words like utilization, visualization and tokenization. Members detect 'synchron', 'concurrency' and 'ization' pieces.
result.label: synchron-ization suffix
Capital ' I' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' I' when it appears as a standalone letter or numeral, e.g. in strings of capital letters, Roman numeral "Type I", and at the start of text. Weak on pronoun "I". Driven by layer-0 ' I' detectors.
Fires on the piece 'ance' when it completes the verb "enhance" (enh+ance). It stays silent on 'ance' in other words such as consonance and resonance.
result.label: 'ance' in "enhance"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that begin a longer word, mostly ' comprom' (compromise), also ' jest', ' imp', ' directly', ' ham', ' lev'. Early-layer token pieces needing completion; no clear shared meaning, so a mixed set.
result.label: Word-initial fragments, esp. ' comprom'

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments, often uppercase pieces like 'SE', 'DER', 'MO', in all-caps or mid-word splits, where the word continues into a longer word. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Uppercase word-fragment pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' Bell' when it starts a name, as in Bell (person) or Bellman, apparently at the start of the text or as a subject. It stays silent on ' Bell' after 'the', as in 'the Bell inequalities' or 'the Bellman-Ford'.
result.label: Bell name token, not after 'the'

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'ma' and 'har' inside "dharma"/"karma" (Dhar-ma, har-ma, har-va), mostly in Indian-religion text. Weakly fires on other mid-word pieces like car-bo-hydrate.
result.label: dharma/karma word pieces

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ude' (also 'udes') in "amplitude", after the 'plit' piece, in physics/signal text. Weaker on other mid-word pieces of technical words. Silent on the misspelled "amples".
result.label: 'ude' ending of amplitude

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'atory' (also 'ators') when it completes the word "regulatory"/"regulators", after the 'regul' piece. Silent on 'atory' in other words like discriminatory or mandatory.
result.label: regul-atory word ending

result.description: Fires on the token ' concurrent', mainly in computing contexts like "concurrent programming" or "concurrent computing". Weaker on "concurrently" and non-computing uses. Members include a ' concurrent' token detector plus parallel/collabor/multip word-piece detectors.
result.label: ' concurrent' token detector

result.description: Fires on present-perfect auxiliaries (" has", " have", " been", " since") after a singular or plural subject noun in academic-style text, anticipating a participle like "been" or "led". Silent on some "has" after "also" or relative clauses.
result.label: Present-perfect "has/have been" auxiliary
'core' token piece detector
result.description: Fires on the token 'core' (e.g. "-core", "multi-core", "hard-core", "unders|core"), mostly as a suffix piece attached to a prefix. Weak activation on a few verbs like traverse and navigate. Predicts word continuations.

result.label: -ruction suffix after reconst/Inst
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ruction' completing words like "Reconstruction" and "Instruction", after a prefix piece such as 'reconst', 'Inst' or 'const'. Weaker on similar endings like '-itution'.

Fires on the word piece ' En' (space-prefixed), mostly at the start of words like Enlighted/Enlightenment. Weaker on ' En' in other words such as Entrench. Members are ' En' detectors plus an 'light/eden' piece detector.
result.label: ' En' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word "advent" (and its pieces like "ur" in "adventurous") and on the " of" or " or" right after "advent", as in "the advent of the internet". Other "X of" phrases leave it silent.
result.label: "advent" and following "of"

result.description: Fires on the token ' government' in economic or policy text (budget, spending, intervention). Mostly driven by layer-0 detectors of ' government' itself, with weak economic-topic helpers. Predicts words like 'depart', 'officials', 'federal'.
result.label: ' government' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb or function word right after plural "-isms" nouns (organisms, mechanisms), e.g. "organisms use", "mechanisms allow". It stays silent on "use" after other subjects such as plants or scientists.
result.label: Verb after organisms/mechanisms

result.description: Fires on the token 'NP' in the abbreviation "NPV" right after "Net Present Value (", the start of the acronym. Silent on finance text without this acronym. Members are mostly token detectors (NP, Value, Pay) plus finance/economy context.
result.label: NP in NPV acronym

result.description: Fires on ' Vol' in the name Alessandro Volta, after 'Alessandro' (an 'andro' detector member feeds in). It predicts 'ta' continuation. It stays quiet on other contexts such as Faraday; weaker on 'Volt' in a list of scientists.
result.label: Vol in Alessandro Volta

result.description: Fires on the piece 'pos' when it sits inside a longer word such as pre-pos-itions, contra-pos-itive or com-pos-ition. It stays silent when 'pos' starts the word, as in 'positional'. It pushes towards continuations like 'itions'.
result.label: 'pos' inside prepositions/contrapositive
'se' ending in glimpse
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'se' completing a split word, mostly the second piece of "glimpse" (also Morse, prose). It stays silent on 'se' in "intense", so it needs the specific preceding word piece.
Fires on the suffix 'ness' when it follows "open" (openness, as in openness vs closedness). It stays silent on 'ness' after other stems like fair, compact, conscious and weak.
result.label: 'ness' in "openness"

result.description: Fires on positive-emotion nouns such as happiness, joy and pleasure, with weaker firing on 'growth'. Members are mostly detectors of these individual words. Predicts continuations like ' in'.
result.label: Happiness, joy, pleasure nouns

result.description: Fires on the ' O' in "Big O" complexity notation, right after "Big". It stays silent on ' O' in "O(n log...)" after other words, so it needs the preceding "Big".
result.label: "O" after Big (Big O notation)

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'apest' in "tapestry/tapestries", and weaker on word endings like 'ies' and 'phony' inside longer words. Members are mostly detectors of word pieces such as 'apest', 'ies', 'ody'.
result.label: 'apest' in tapestry word piece

result.description: Fires on the token " meaning" (occasionally " definition") as a noun in discussions of linguistics and semantics, such as connotation or literal meaning. Members are mostly detectors of meaning and related words like purpose, context and mean.
result.label: ' meaning' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token right after "capture" (" the", " and", " this") and on "iv" inside "captivating/captivate". Silent on " the" after other words, so it needs the capture/capt- context.
result.label: After "capture" and "capt-iv-"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ig' (pigment, enigmatic, Higgs), 'estr' (orchestration), 'onders' (wonders) and ' medic', where the word is unfinished. It pushes toward suffixes like 'ation' and 'ination'.
result.label: Word-fragment before -ation suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'etic' (as in genetic, epigenetic) at the start of a document or passage, in science text about variation and populations. Driven mainly by token-specific 'etic' detectors in layer 0, plus suffix detectors like 'ology'.
result.label: 'etic' suffix token
Mixed word pieces: iac, uba, performance
result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: the word piece 'iac' (cardiac), 'uba' (tuba), and ' performance'/' jazz'. Members are token detectors for these pieces plus music words. Evidence is mixed with no single shared condition.

Fires on the word-start token ' f' (a space plus f), strongest in technical or mathematical text such as f(a) and f(b) and "fuzzy", and weaker in "fission". It is silent in the emotional prose of the contrast.
result.label: Word-initial ' f' token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ello' (mainly in 'cello') and also 'cience' in 'neuroscience'. Layer-0 token-piece detectors for 'elli'/'ello' drive it; it stays silent on other string-instrument text such as 'violinists'.
result.label: 'ello' piece in cello

result.description: Fires on the word " or" joining alternatives in a list or pair (e.g. "redo or return", "strings or brass"). Members are mostly detectors of " or" itself. Output nudges toward "even", "chestra" and similar continuations.
result.label: Coordinating " or" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'fill' inside words like landfill, fulfill(ment), and weakly on 'b' in words like carbonyl or viscibility. Mostly a mid-word fragment detector, predicting suffixes such as 's', 'ing', 'ment'.
result.label: 'fill' piece in landfill/fulfill

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ool' (as in wool, coolant, tooling) and on repeated '++' in dashed/plus separator lines. Mostly a layer-0 token-piece detector; weak on a few other word fragments.
result.label: 'ool' word piece and '++' runs

result.description: Fires on a few specific tokens, mainly ' accessible' (also after 'handicap' or 'more'), plus ' parsing' and ' Vienna'. Members are detectors of these individual tokens. Logits favour ' enough' and grammar-like continuations.
result.label: ' accessible' / ' parsing' / ' Vienna'

result.description: Fires on the token " interactions" (and " interaction"), mostly as a sentence-initial plural subject. Pushes next-token predictions toward "between" and "among". Members are mainly token detectors for interactions, plus a few related words such as relationships and structures.
result.label: ' interactions' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " quad" at the start of "quadrilateral(s)", in geometry text. Members detect quad/ril pieces plus geometry words like angle, geomet, poly, verte.
result.label: ' quad' in quadrilateral

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings 'imes' in "primes" (also 'ulo' in "modulo"), mostly in math/number-theory text. It is quiet on a similar math context without these word pieces, so it depends on being inside those words.
result.label: 'imes' in primes, 'ulo' in modulo

result.description: Fires on the word " adjust" and its forms (adjusting, adjustment), nearly always at that token. Several members are " adjust" detectors. Predicts parameter-like continuations such as sizes and parameters.
result.label: adjust token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'mp' in the name Ampère (Ampere's), at the start of the possessive name. Weak activation on other physicist-name pieces like Faraday. Silent on generic electromagnetism text without the name.
result.label: 'mp' in Ampère

result.description: Fires on the word piece " sens" (sensors, sensory) and " sense", with weaker firing on "vision" and "view". Members are mostly detectors of " sens" and " sense". Likely predicts word continuations such as "ors" or "ory".
result.label: sens / sense word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on ' from' after "derived"/"comes"-type words (derived from, comes from) and on ' derived' itself, predicting ' from'. Silent on ' from' after ordinary nouns like "metrics from" or "differences from".
result.label: "derived from" source phrase

result.description: Fires on the word ' these' when it is followed by abstract plural nouns like concepts, funding streams, fundamentals. It is silent on ' these' in other spots, such as after verbs or 'how' and before 'elements/structures/variables'. The condition is unclear.
result.label: ' these' demonstrative (context-dependent)

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces of academic/technical terms (' permut', ' inheritance', ' Morgan', ' anth', ' combin', ' deriv') in math, genetics and science text, often before a suffix like -ation. Peaks are mixed.
result.label: Academic term stems (permut, inheritance)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ries" at the end of "inqui|ries" (after "inqui"). Members detect "ries" and "qui" pieces. Other "ries" words (strawberries, symmetries) are not shown in the windows, so the dependence on the preceding piece is only partly clear.
result.label: "ries" in "inquiries"

result.description: Fires on "fiction" (and "fi" in sci-fi) when it names a genre in a list of genres, e.g. "science fiction", "sci-fi". Weaker on "work of fiction". Silent in general writing-craft text without the genre-list use.
result.label: Fiction as genre name

result.description: Fires on negative word-beginning prefixes such as " mis", " dis", " ill" and " misunder" when they start a longer word (misinformation, disorders, illness). Members are detectors of these prefix tokens.
result.label: mis-/dis-/ill- word prefixes

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix piece "atable" (as in "relatable"), and also on "from" and "or" used as words in grammar or linguistic discussion of prepositions and conjunctions. Evidence is mixed and the logits are not informative.
result.label: "atable" suffix, "from"/"or" mentions

result.description: Fires on the token ' sensitive' (occasionally ' drug'), in phrases like 'sensitive information', 'highly sensitive', 'culturally sensitive'. Silent on unrelated text such as the quantum cryptography contrast. Members detect sensitive/sensitivity-related tokens.
result.label: ' sensitive' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces ' coord' (coordination), ' mol' (molarity/moles) and similar incomplete word starts like ' coordin', ' liquid', which are likely continued by a suffix such as 'ity' or 'ination'. Mostly detectors of these specific pieces.
result.label: coord/mol word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'chn' in "-technology/-technical" words split as "ote|chn" (nanotechnology, biotechnology, geotechnical). It predicts a continuation like "ology".
result.label: 'chn' inside -technology words

result.description: Fires on the token ' mid' as a prefix, as in "mid-1980s" or "midi controller". Members are mostly ' mid' token detectors plus a few detectors for similar word-start pieces. The contrast text has no ' mid'.
result.label: ' mid' prefix token

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ors' (also 'ments') completing the word "investors" or "investments" after the "invest" stem, in finance text. Stays silent on general portfolio text without that word-ending.
result.label: invest + suffix (-ors/-ments)

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ive' / 'ively' ending a word, most strongly after "progress" (progressive, progressively). It stays quiet on 'ively' after "act" (actively), so it seems to depend on the preceding stem.
result.label: -ive/-ively suffix after progress
' dem' word-piece (democracy)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dem' that starts words like democracy, democratic, democratization and demographic. Members are mostly ' dem' token detectors at layer 0. Weaker on demographic and similar.
Fires on the word "based" (Based, based, -based) in compound or "based on" uses, such as "-Based Systems" or "is based on". It pushes the next token toward "on". Weak on a few other words.
result.label: "based" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ocrat' in words like democratization, "-ocratics" and "-ocratizing". It stays silent on 'ocrates' (Socrates), so it needs the democracy/-ocracy sense rather than the name. Supported by 'ocr' and ' dem' detector members.
result.label: 'ocrat' piece in democr- words

result.description: Fires on the token "water", mostly as the end of a compound word (freshwater, wastewater, rainwater, groundwater). Members are mostly detectors of "water" and related pieces like rain and hydro. Silent on text without water.
result.label: water token, esp. in compounds

result.description: Fires on ' virtue' and the start of ' eth' (ethics, ethical, ethos), especially in philosophy/ethics text such as "virtue ethics". Mostly layer-0 token detectors for virtue and eth.
result.label: virtue / eth- token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments completing a multi-piece word, mainly 'ies' in royalt-ies and 'arm' in Sw-arm, also 'inn' and 'im'. Silent on 'ies' in 'colonies', so it depends on the specific word being completed.
result.label: Word-ending fragments: royalties, swarm

result.description: Fires on a mix of word pieces, mostly ' households', also ' Labor' (in Laboratory), ' consum', ' purchase', 'estion', ' populated'. Seems to be an early-layer mix of economy/population-related tokens, with weak consistency.
result.label: households, consum-, Labor word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token 'ray' as a word piece, mainly inside "portrayal(s)", also in "Brayton" and "X-ray". Layer-0 detectors of 'ray' drive it. The contrast has no 'ray' token, so no extra condition shows.
result.label: 'ray' piece in portrayal

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces 'ing'/'ed' when attached to the stem 'borrow' (borrowing, borrowed) in text about linguistic borrowing. Other 'ing' endings after different stems stay silent.
result.label: Suffix after 'borrow' stem

result.description: Fires on the token ' soul' (including in 'soulful' and 'soul-stirring' contexts) in philosophical, spiritual and music text. Supported by members detecting ' soul', ' spirit', and music words. Fires on the word wherever it appears.
result.label: ' soul' token detector
'uit' in 'pursuit'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'uit' when it completes 'pursuit' (after ' purs'), typically in 'pursuit of X'. Members detect 'uit' and ' purs' pieces; it is weakly active on related words like 'pursued'.

Fires on the token ' neutral' (including as the start of 'neutralizer' or 'neutralizing') in science and language text. It predicts word-completion suffixes such as 'ity'. Members are mostly ' neutral' token detectors.
result.label: ' neutral' token detector

result.description: Fires on the ending piece 'us' (or 'ian') of the name Columbus / Columbian, after the 'Columb' piece. It stays silent on 'us' elsewhere, such as in Gerardus or a standalone 'us'.
result.label: Columb-us name ending

result.description: Fires on the noun ' skills' (also ' hands', as in "hands-on") in educational text about knowledge and practical abilities. Silent on general organizational or career text lacking these words.
result.label: skills / hands (practical abilities)

result.description: Fires on the token ' adapt' (adapting, adaptive, adaptation stems) at the start of the word. Members are mostly detectors of ' adapt' and related pieces like ' Ada'. It predicts suffixes such as 'ability', 'ive', 'ing' and ' to'.
result.label: ' adapt' token detector

result.description: Fires on a few specific words, mainly " criticism", " relief", " critique", and the piece "hal", plus odd cases like "manuel" in Immanuel. It is a layer-0 word-level detector with no clear shared context. Silent on nearby text without these words.
result.label: criticism / relief word detector

result.description: Fires on " the" right after the copula "is" in definitional statements, such as "E is the electric field" or "L is the…". It stays silent on " the" after prepositions like "in", "for" and "of".
result.label: " the" after "is" in definitions

result.description: Fires on "Trade" and the following "off" in "Trade-off" (especially Bias-Variance Trade-off), plus "trade"/"offs" pieces. Silent on "off" in "turn-off", so it needs the trade-off compound.
result.label: Trade-off compound
"no longer" – ' longer' after "no"
result.description: Fires on ' longer' in the phrase "is no longer", where the previous token is "no". Members detect ' longer'/' long' and ' no' tokens. It is silent on unrelated text.

Fires on the word piece ' unw' (start of "unwanted"), most strongly when "unwanted" has already appeared or is being repeated, as in noise-removal text. Members detect ' unw' and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' unw' of "unwanted"

result.description: Fires on " that" right after "ensures" (also "ensuring"), plus some other tokens like " such" and " are" in texture/structure text. Members detect "-ures"/"ens" pieces of "ensures". Silent on " that" after other verbs or nouns.
result.label: " that" after "ensures"

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing mostly on ' landscape', also ' society', 'Date', ' Cover', and similar scope or setting nouns (environment, world, horizon, scope). Members are token detectors for these nouns. Mixed, weak evidence of a shared context.
result.label: Landscape and society-type nouns

result.description: Fires on the plural noun ' methods' and, less often, ' techniques' or ' approaches', mostly as a subject in technical or scientific text (numerical methods, statistical techniques). It is quiet on the singular 'method'.
result.label: ' methods' / ' techniques' plural nouns

result.description: Fires on the noun right after "daily" (mostly " rout" in "daily routines", also "routine", "activities", "life", "lives"). Driven by "daily"/"everyday" detectors and a "rout" token detector. Silent in "balanced life" without "daily".
result.label: Noun after "daily" (routines)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'zi' completing "Hanzi" (after ' Han'). Weaker firing on similar pieces like 'ai' in Hokusai or Daiichi. Members detect ' Han' and 'zi'/'ai' pieces.
result.label: 'zi' in Hanzi

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (or a hyphen) directly after the word 'clear', as in 'clearing' or 'clear-cutting'. Stays silent on 'ing' after other verb stems. Members detect 'clear' and its variants.
result.label: 'ing' or '-' after 'clear'

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ector" ending "detector" (smoke detector, edge detector). It needs the preceding "det" piece; the contrast with other word pieces is silent. Members are mostly detectors of "ector"-like endings.
result.label: "ector" in "detector"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'istic' when it completes the word "Hellenistic". It stays silent on 'istic' in "artistic" and "linguistic", so it needs the Hellen- prefix.
result.label: 'istic' in Hellenistic

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ctions' when it completes the word "constructions" (split as constru|ctions). It stays silent on 'ctions' in other words like "distinctions", so it needs the construct- stem before it.
result.label: 'ctions' in "constructions"
