result.description: Fires on the digit '0' inside a year, mainly as the second digit after '2' (2016, 2013, 2003, 2000s). It stays silent on '0' later in the year, such as 1980, 1990 or 2020. Also fires weakly on ' concentration'.
result.label: Zero in 2-0-xx years

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' emb' when it begins a longer word such as embroidery, embellishments or embryo. It stays silent on 'embraced', where the piece forms a different word. Early members are mostly ' emb' detectors.
result.label: ' emb' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' as' in comparative "as ADJ as" constructions, especially the first/second as after "can be/seem/being" (e.g. "as thrilling as"). Silent on "such as" examples.
result.label: ' as' in comparative "as…as"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer abstract or scientific words, mainly ' simultane' (relativity of simultaneity), also ' inher', ' contra', ' inner'. Predicts a suffix continuation such as 'ous'. Also weakly fires on garbled or odd-character tokens.
result.label: Incomplete word stems like simultane-
'ings' and ' looking' token pieces
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ings' (especially in "recordings", "matchings") and on " looking"/" looks", with weaker firing on other word pieces like 'orb' and 'inn'. Fires on a few specific token forms rather than on one meaning.

Fires on a colon after a short label or item in list-like text (word-class lists, language lists, schedule times like 5:45, "Who: whiz"), where a definition or value follows. Silent on ordinary scientific prose without such colons.
result.label: Colon after list label or time
' time' as modifier noun
result.description: Fires on the word ' time' (or ' Time') when it follows a modifier and acts as a compound-noun head, as in "logarithmic time", "solar time", "time zone". It predicts compound continuations like frame, series, or zone.

Fires on the word piece "inction" completing "extinction" (e.g. "mass extinction", "Permian-Triassic extinction event"). It depends on the preceding "ext" piece; members detect "ext" and extinction-related ecology context.
result.label: "inction" in "extinction"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ability' completing a word, most strongly in "avail-ability" (availability engineering, reliability contexts). Weaker on usability or accessibility. Silent in "interoperability", so it depends on the word being formed.
result.label: 'ability' suffix in availability

result.description: Fires on the verb ' convey' in mid-sentence, typically after "to" or a modal, as in "to convey emotions". It stays silent when ' convey' is the first token of the text.
result.label: ' convey' verb mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: 'le' in "Role", ' entire', 'atus' in "apparatus", 'ers', and ' overall'. Often mid-word pieces or whole/entirety words; no single shared context is clear.
result.label: Mixed: Role, entire, apparatus pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " other" in lists or comparisons, mostly after "and" or "or" ("and other related activities", "or other factors"). Weakly fires on " another". Members are mostly detectors of " other".
result.label: " other" after and/or in lists

result.description: Fires on the word " personal" (as in personal space, personal life, personal experience), mostly in workplace and communication text. Members are mainly detectors of " personal" and its variants like personalized.
result.label: ' personal' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ois" in the name Lavoisier (Lav|ois|ier), after "Lav". Upstream members detect "Lav" and "ois" pieces. Weak activation on a few other word pieces like "ase".
result.label: "ois" in Lavoisier

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ing, -ive, -or, -ors) completing the word "predict" (predicting, predictive, predictor). Silent on -ing after other stems like model-, collect-. Upstream members detect the "predict" stem and its suffix.
result.label: Suffix after "predict" stem

result.description: Fires on ' are' in the existential construction "there are", right after "there". It stays silent on ' are' following an ordinary plural subject (e.g. "virtues are") or at the start of a text.
result.label: ' are' in "there are"

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also '-' or ' and') right after the word "type(s)" (e.g. "types of", "type-"), and weakly after "set of". Silent on ' of' after other nouns like use, array, behavior.
result.label: "of" after "type(s)"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "agement" completing "engagement" (split as eng+agement), and weakly on "age" in "engage". Needs the preceding "eng" piece; members detect eng+agement/age pieces.
result.label: "agement" in "engagement"

result.description: Fires on the word " eager" (including before "-ly"), as in "eager to" or "eagerly waiting". Weak activation on " still", " willing" and " able". Members include detectors for eager, wanting, seeking.
result.label: ' eager' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verbs " begins" and " starts" when a subject noun (a process or stage) is said to begin, typically before "with" or "to". Silent when " begins" opens the text with no subject before it.
result.label: Process 'begins/starts' verb after subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece " attend" (as in attendance, attend a concert), mostly in event, festival and venue contexts. It is driven by festival and "-ance" detectors. Silent on nearby text about footfall and parking without the word.
result.label: ' attend' in event attendance

result.description: Fires on scattered, unrelated tokens (ū, www, Philip, Cyrillic or Arabic pieces, function words), often mid-word or in multilingual text. No coherent meaning; the members are mostly token-piece detectors, and the logits are weak.
result.label: Scattered mixed-token early-layer latent

result.description: Fires on the word right after "includes"/"include" (activities, including, topics, having), where a list of items begins. Members detect "include(s)" and list-like words such as range, items. Silent on " including" after a comma.
result.label: Word following "includes" list opener

result.description: Fires on the token " due", mostly in causal "due to" / "partly due" / "largely due" phrases after a verb or adverb. Members include several " due" detectors from early layers and a few " because" detectors.
result.label: ' due' in causal phrases

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix 'ened' after a stem, especially in "heightened" (also "deepened"). Weaker on ' coll', ' bra', and 'enhance'-type pieces. Members are 'ened' detectors, mostly in "heightened".
result.label: 'ened' suffix in heightened

result.description: Fires on the word piece " pres" (preservation, preservative, prescriptive) and also on " try"/" trying" and "end". Mostly early-layer token detectors for "pres" feed it; the logits are a mixed set of sacrifice-related tokens.
result.label: " pres" word-start piece, try

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in title-like headings, mainly 'iffer' in "Differential Equations" and 'ender' in "Gender and X". It seems to work on the first piece of a heading word, with the rest of the word still to come.
result.label: Heading word pieces: Gender, Differential

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ute' in "flute", 'utes', and 'мо' inside garbled Cyrillic text. It is strongest on 'ute'/'uct' pieces after 'fl'. It is silent when 'utes' starts a word or sentence.
result.label: 'ute' piece inside words (flute)

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ys' ending of "valleys" (plural of valley) in geography text, with weaker hits on ' Sur', ' ref' and 'war'. Silent on 'ys' in other words like "journeys" or "adshockeys". Members include valley and 'ys' detectors.
result.label: 'ys' in "valleys"
' kn' word-start piece (knot)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' kn' at the start of words like knot, knotted, knives, knighted. Strongest in knot-theory text. It is silent on ' kn' at the start of a document (knife). Members are early-layer ' kn' detectors.
Fires on the piece 'ological' when it completes the word "biological" (after "bi"), as in "biological systems/data". It stays silent on 'ological' in other words like epidemiological.
result.label: 'ological' in "biological"

result.description: Fires on ' to' as an infinitive marker of purpose or function, often after a noun or verb in scientific or biological text (e.g. "proteins to translate", "rush to relay"). It stays silent on prepositional 'to' after verbs like "contributed to" or "belonging to".
result.label: Infinitive 'to' of purpose

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mostly " rough" (roughness, roughened), also "m" in dismantlement or Pragmatic, and " Catal" in Catalan. The next token is expected to complete the word.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (rough, m, Catal)

result.description: Fires on degree/level adjectives like "high", "upper", "low", "lower" before a measured quantity (pressure, voltage, unemployment, bounds). Members detect high/higher tokens and level-related words.
result.label: High/low level modifiers

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of rare, multi-token words, mostly 'ff' or 'dor' in "Hausdorff" (math topology text) and 'emon' (as in "ceremon-"). Members are mostly word-piece detectors, not a single meaning.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: Hausdorff, emon

result.description: Fires on the token ' design' as a noun, mostly after "the" or in technical/engineering text (the design phase, design elements). Silent in the one contrast example, where it follows a hyphenated modifier ("-based design principles").
result.label: ' design' noun in engineering text

result.description: Fires on the piece "anning" in "spanning" (e.g. "spanning tree"), after the "sp" piece. It stays silent on "anning" in "Planning", so it needs the sp- word start.
result.label: "anning" in "spanning"

result.description: Fires on the token ' such' when it follows a noun or noun phrase and sets up an example list ("such as"), e.g. "factors such as". Members are mostly ' such' detectors that boost ' as'.
result.label: ' such' introducing examples

result.description: Fires on the 'ch' token piece, strongest in "crochet"/"crocheting" (cro|ch|et), and weakly in other words like merchandise or Epoch. It stays silent on 'ch' in "ever-changing".
result.label: 'ch' piece in crochet

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "anning" in "spanning" (spanning tree), and weakly on other mid-word pieces like " arc", "fect", " travers", "anging". Needs a preceding "sp"-like prefix, mostly in graph theory text.
result.label: "anning" in spanning tree

result.description: Fires mostly on " angles" in geometry text, after a modifier like "complementary" or "vertical". It stays silent when "angles" starts the text or sits in other contexts. Minor peaks on "ized", "intellect" and "exper".
result.label: ' angles' after geometry modifier

result.description: Fires on the word " theory" right after a field name, mainly "music theory" and "color theory". Members detect "theory"/"Theory" tokens plus music and art context. Weaker on "music notation".
result.label: "theory" after music/color

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' ending "Layering" in the heading "Dough Layering", where the stem is "Layer". It stays silent on 'ing' in other words such as Cook-ing, mimick-ing and master-ing. Weak activation on ' surv' and 'cies'.
result.label: 'ing' completing "Layering"

result.description: Fires on the word "model"/"models" as a standalone noun (e.g. "dynamic models", "static models"). It stays silent when "model" is the start of "modeling". Members mostly detect "model" tokens and neighbouring modeling or ML vocabulary.
result.label: word "model/models" as noun

result.description: Fires on " thinking" right after "critical" in educational/philosophical text. It stays silent on "creative thinking" and "innovative thinking", so it needs the "critical" context. Members detect thinking/reasoning words and philosophy terms.
result.label: "thinking" after "critical"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'bo' inside 'carbohydrate' (after 'car'), and on 'writ' in 'songwriters'. It stays silent when 'bo' starts the text or follows a period with no 'car' before it.
result.label: 'bo' in car-bo-hydrate

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ics' completing "kinetics" (reaction kinetics). It stays silent on 'ics' in other field names such as Mathematics, Thermodynamics and Electrodynamics, so it needs the 'kinet' piece before it.
result.label: 'ics' in "kinetics"

result.description: Fires on ' specific' (and ' particular') as a modifier, plus 'ot' in 'Robot'/'Robotics'. Members detect 'specific', 'special', 'certain', and 'Rob'. Mixed trigger; fires on these tokens without a clear extra condition.
result.label: 'specific' modifier and Robot 'ot'
'ary' ending of vocabulary
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ary' completing "vocabulary" (also 'scop' in microscopes). Silent on 'ary' in other words like planetary or evolutionary. Members are 'ary' and 'vocab' piece detectors.

Fires on the token ' frames' (plural), mostly after a modifier like global, local, time or reference, as in reference frames. Members include detectors of ' frame' and ' frames'. The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' frames' token detector

result.description: Fires on a few different noun endings, mostly 'ism' in "activism" and ' sessions' after "Q&A"/"webinar"/"breakout". It stays silent on 'ism' in words like colonism, nationalism and bilingualism, so it needs the specific word.
result.label: 'ism' in activism; ' sessions'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'os' inside the word "erosion" (er|os|ion), mostly in soil and water erosion text. It stays silent on 'os' as a standalone token or in "pathos".
result.label: 'os' in "erosion"
' energy' after 'internal'
result.description: Fires on the token ' energy' when it directly follows "internal" (internal energy, thermodynamics context). It stays silent on ' energy' after words like "the", "all" or "for", so the preceding word matters.
Fires on the 'stal' piece in 'crystal' / 'crystallography' (mid-word after 'cry'), with a few weaker hits on ' month' in 'monthly'. Members detect 'stal' and 'cry' pieces.
result.label: 'stal' in crystal words

result.description: Fires on "export" and the "ing" in "exporting" (also "exports") in trade-balance text about exports versus imports. It stays silent on "ing" in other words like "exceeding" or "sloping".
result.label: export / exporting in trade text
Development token in headings
result.description: Fires on the word "Development" (or "development") as the final word of a noun phrase or heading, such as "Software Development" or "Agricultural Development". Weaker on lowercase "the development of". It is silent on other heading words like "Policy".

Fires on the token " Direct" (also " direct") as a word or word start, such as "Directed Graphs" and "Directive". It is weaker on "to direct". It stays silent on related words like "direction" and "undirected" in the contrast.
result.label: "Direct" word token

result.description: Fires on the token "is" when it is a word piece inside a longer word (cis, sisal, Gelisols, Landis, debris) or the quoted Python keyword. Silent on "is" as a normal verb.
result.label: "is" as word piece

result.description: Fires mainly on 'lock' completing "deadlock" (computing/concurrency text), with weaker peaks on other word-piece endings like 'toire' and 'art' in Mozart. Mostly a within-word detector for 'lock' after 'dead'.
result.label: deadlock 'lock' word piece

result.description: Fires on the token " economy" as a noun, mostly in phrases like "the economy" or "an economy" in economics text. Members include economy/economic token detectors and early-layer economics features.
result.label: Token ' economy'

result.description: Fires on the "ed" ending of "witnessed" when a period or era is the subject ("the period also witnessed the rise of..."). Stays silent on "ed" in other verbs like thrived or reacted.
result.label: "witnessed" with era as subject

result.description: Fires on the capitalized nouns ' Code' and ' Law' ending title-like headings or list items (e.g. "International Trade Law", "Code Review"), plus some suffix pieces like 'ation'. Silent on similar "Policy" headings.
result.label: Code / Law in headings

result.description: Fires on 'ova' in supernova and on ' star' in astrophysics text about massive stars and stellar evolution. Members detect 'ova', 'star' and stellar/cosmic words. Silent on a nucleosynthesis passage without those tokens.
result.label: supernova 'ova' and 'star' in astrophysics

result.description: Fires on ' of' in a few specific positions: after a demonstrative "those" (those of A), after "made", or after a technical noun like "sine" or "product". It stays silent on ' of' after many abstract nouns such as "significance" or "protector".
result.label: ' of' after those / technical nouns

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like 'ogy' (mostly in "Ecology"), also 'ios' in symbiosis and 'ples', in ecology/science-style text. Members detect 'col' and 'ogy' pieces plus ecology/habitat topic words.
result.label: Ecology word-ending 'ogy' suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'se' completing "immerse" (also 'ers' in "immersive"), mostly in "immerse yourself". Silent on other 'se' pieces such as in "Morse" contexts.
result.label: 'se' in "immerse"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'inu' (in "continuous"/"continuum") and 'gru' (in "congruent"), plus weakly ' ambigu' in "ambiguity". These are mid-word fragments of specific words; the members are detectors of those pieces.
result.label: inu / gru mid-word fragments

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ization' completing a technical word, especially 'Polymerization' in chemistry and materials text. Also weakly on ' reson' in 'resonance'. Members detect 'ization' and polymer or material words.
result.label: 'ization' suffix in polymerization

result.description: Fires on capitalized ' Electron' at the start of a heading or title (e.g. "Electron Configuration", "Electronegativity", "Electronics"). Weakly fires on lowercase ' electron'. Members are Electron/electronic detectors.
result.label: Capitalized ' Electron' in headings

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces completing science/physics terms such as "electromagnetic radiation", "finger-print", "reson-ant/ance". Peaks are mixed, and the members are mostly generic previous-token detectors across topics.
result.label: Technical term completions (radiation, resonance)
'son' ending Carson (name piece)
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'son' completing a split name, mainly 'Car|son' (Rachel Carson), and on ' Kre' in 'Krebs'. It stays silent on 'son' at the start of a document or as a standalone word.

Fires on the word-piece ' cla' (start of "clauses") after a grammar modifier such as subordinate, main, independent, dependent or noun. It stays silent when ' cla' starts a text with no grammar context.
result.label: ' cla' of "clauses" in grammar

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dialog' (the start of "dialogue"), mostly after "in" or similar prepositions in writing-craft text. It pushes the next token toward the completion "ue". Silent on contrast text without the word.
result.label: ' dialog' token before "ue"

result.description: Fires on names of major bodies of water, mostly ' Atlantic', also ' Pacific', ' Sea', ' River', typically in lists of oceans or regions. Weakly on similar proper-name nouns like Channel. Silent on non-water geography text.
result.label: Ocean/sea names, mainly Atlantic

result.description: Fires on the token " exposed" (and occasionally "poses" in "exposes"), including repeated or odd contexts. Early-layer detectors of "exposed" and "poses" feed it; no clear extra condition appears.
result.label: ' exposed' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word ' until' as a temporal or limit conjunction/preposition (persisted until, detected until, repeat until). Weakly on 'before' and 'till'. Silent on date-range text like 'from about 1400 to around 1600'.
result.label: ' until' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'oper' in "co-oper-ative" (cooperative game theory, cooperative behavior). Weaker on 'abor' in "collaborative". Needs the "co" prefix before it to form "cooperative".
result.label: 'oper' in cooperative

result.description: Fires on the open parenthesis ' (' that begins an enumerated label or inline annotation, like "(1)", "(a)", "(for example", "(O(1))", often after a colon or list lead-in. Silent on ordinary prose without such parentheses.
result.label: Open parenthesis starting enumerations

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'id'/'il'/'ity' right after the prefix "equ" (equidistant, equilateral, equity), in math/geometry text. Silent on 'id' in "rigid", so it needs the "equ-" start.
result.label: 'equ' + id/il word piece

result.description: Fires on ' that' used as a relative pronoun right after a noun (strategy that, path that, way that), introducing a clause describing that noun. Silent on complementizer 'that' after verbs or adjectives (believed that, ensure that, clear that).
result.label: Relative-pronoun 'that' after noun

result.description: Fires mainly on "Each"/"each" (also "every"), especially at the start of a document or phrase, plus odd pieces like "est" and "ary" at the start of a document. Members mostly detect "each" tokens.
result.label: "Each" distributive determiner

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' completing the word "ambiguity" (also weakly on 'ambiguous' and ' interpretation'). Silent on 'ity' in other words like proximity, diversity, continuity, validity. Relies on members detecting the ' ambigu' piece.
result.label: 'ity' in "ambiguity"

result.description: Fires on the token "for", both as a standalone word (quoted "for", "for all x") and as a word piece inside "reinforcement/reinforcing". Members detect "for" and "rein" pieces. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "for" token, esp. in reinforcement

result.description: Fires on the word " evolution" (and " evol" pieces), especially in "evolutionary" contexts and after words like "molecular". It stayed silent in one case after "biological". It predicts "-ary" continuations.
result.label: evolution token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece "one" when it completes the word "bone" (b + one), in bone biology text such as bone matrix, structure and formation. Members detect "one" after "b" in the first layer.
result.label: "one" in "bone"

result.description: Fires on the token " over" in technical or abstract text, as a preposition between nouns (integral over, circulation over, autonomy over) or as a prefix in compounds like "overlays" and "overview". Members are mostly " over" detectors.
result.label: ' over' token in technical text

result.description: Fires on the token ' messages' in text about communication theory (sender, receiver, I-messages, conveying intent). Weakly fires on ' communicate'. Members are detectors of message/communication/signal words.
result.label: ' messages' in communication text

result.description: Fires on 'ize' in "revolutionize" and on function words (could, and, in) following technology/innovation phrases in futuristic-tech text. Silent on 'ize' in other verbs like emphasize, utilize, prioritize.
result.label: revolutionize / technology advancement context

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mostly 'venue' in 're-venue', also 'ores' in 'magnetoresistance', 'its' in 'profits', 'ol' in 'scholars'. Appears to be a word-piece detector for specific split words.
result.label: Mid-word piece 'venue' in revenue

result.description: Fires on the token " radical" in chemistry text about free radicals, especially in "radicals" or "radical" as a noun after words like "new" or "two". It stays silent on other chemistry text without that word.
result.label: ' radical' in chemistry text

result.description: Fires on the token " access" (also " Access"), mostly as a noun after a modifier such as direct, sequential, random, indexed, user or privileged, in computing and memory-access text. Members are mainly detectors of the word access.
result.label: the word "access"

result.description: Fires on the word " atom" (also atoms, atomic, nucleus) in physics/chemistry text about atomic structure, often in "the atom's ..." phrasing. Silent on loosely related science text without atom words.
result.label: atom word in atomic-structure text

result.description: Fires on ' European' as an adjective inside a sentence, after a modifier or preposition (e.g. "the European diet", "southern European"), in historical or political text. Silent when it starts the text. Weakly fires on ' medieval'.
result.label: ' European' mid-sentence adjective

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "concept" (e.g. "the concept of Diversity"), introducing the named idea. It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "rate of", "structure of" or "behavior of".
result.label: " of" after "concept"

result.description: Fires mainly on the prefix ' meta' (meta-analysis, metafiction), with weaker firing on ' activities' in some contexts. Members are mostly ' meta' prefix detectors plus assorted word-piece detectors.
result.label: ' meta' prefix token

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ot' inside "homotopy" / "homotopic" (after "hom"), in algebraic topology text. It stays silent on 'ot' in other words such as "knot".
result.label: 'ot' in homotopy

result.description: Fires on the token " concrete" (both the adjective "concrete examples/objects" and the material "reinforced concrete"). Weak activation on a few word pieces like "ensional" and "ining". Supported by layer-0 detectors of " concrete".
result.label: " concrete" token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments that begin or continue a longer word, mainly 'du' in 'transducer', 'AP' in 'SAP', and ' histor'. It stays quiet when 'du' starts a new word after a full stop. Its peaks are mixed and inconsistent.
result.label: Mid-word fragments du / AP / histor

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ions' completing the plural noun "interventions", mostly in behavioral/economic intervention text. It stays silent on 'ions' in "proportions" and "notions", and fires weakly on other plural endings like 'gs' and 'ies'.
result.label: 'ions' ending of "interventions"

result.description: Fires on the token ' interval' (singular, strongest), including in statistics and music contexts; plural ' intervals' fires about half as strongly. Members include ' interval' token detectors from layer 0 plus statistics-topic members.
result.label: ' interval' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining two abstract topic nouns in short title-like lists (e.g. "Education and diversity", "Music and Mathematics"), where a second academic/abstract concept follows. Silent on 'and' in ordinary clauses or name lists.
result.label: 'and' between abstract topic nouns

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mainly ' icon' (iconography, iconic), ' aff' (affixes), ' symbol' and ' spons'. It fires on the incomplete piece before the word continues, so it needs the token to be a word-start piece.
result.label: Word-start pieces: icon, aff, symbol

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ion' completing "corrosion" (corros|ion) in materials/corrosion text, and more weakly on ' factors' after an adjective. Stays silent on 'ion' in erosion, cohesion, adhesion.
result.label: 'ion' ending corrosion

result.description: Fires on the word piece " employ" (as in employment, employers) in economics and labor-policy text, expecting a suffix to follow. Silent when " employ" begins a document, as in "employer, on…".
result.label: ' employ' stem in economic text

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that start a longer word, mainly ' ev' (evaporation), also ' sch' (scholars), ' sty', ' hab', ' fib' (fibers). The word is split mid-way, so the token needs its continuation.
result.label: Word-start fragments (ev, sch, sty)

result.description: Fires on the word " sorting", mainly in computer-science text about sorting algorithms. It stays silent on other algorithm text that doesn't involve sorting. It has minor weak activations on " to" and word endings.
result.label: ' sorting' in algorithm text

result.description: Fires on the token ' branches' (plural), seen in version-control text (feature/release branches) and in divisions of a group or field. Members are mostly detectors of ' branch'/' branches' tokens.
result.label: ' branches' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'ow' piece inside the split word "vowel" (v-ow-els), and weakly on other mid-word fragments like 'ent', 'bu', 'qu'. Members are mostly 'ow' detectors and word-start pieces like v-.
result.label: 'ow' fragment in vowel

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' odd' (as in odds ratio), and also on ' cardinal' in cardinality and ' cos' in cosine/cosmic. These are word fragments that continue into math or science terms. Mostly ' odd'.
result.label: ' odd' / cardinal / cos fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece " macro" when it begins a split word such as macroscopic or macrostate, mostly in statistical-mechanics text. Members detect " macro", "micro" and "scop" pieces, plus economy terms.
result.label: ' macro' word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the single letters 'g' or 'f' as a word piece right after a prefix like over-, under- or out- (over|f|itting, under|g|one). It is quiet on ordinary text without such a split-word prefix.
result.label: f/g piece after over-/under- prefix

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' sed' that begins "sediment", "sedimentary" and related words. It is driven by upstream ' sed' detectors in layer 0. It also fires weakly at some document starts.
result.label: ' sed' start of sediment words

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' s' (sometimes 'z') when it starts a new word right after another word or piece, as in "Brun s|ieve" or "categorical s|yllogisms". It stays silent on a normal whole word like "semantics".
result.label: Word-initial ' s' fragment

result.description: Fires on the plural piece 'es' completing "themes" (split as them+es), mostly in art and literature discussion. It stays silent on verb-ending 'es' such as "encompasses" or "discusses". Weaker on other plural endings like 'atives' and ' settings'.
result.label: 'es' ending of "themes"

result.description: Fires on the token "line" completing the compound "storyline" in writing and narrative text. Members detect "line" or "lines" pieces and narrative and story words such as plot, characters and narrative.
result.label: "line" in "storyline"
' demand' in economics text
result.description: Fires on the token ' demand', most strongly in economic contexts such as "supply and demand" curves. Members are mostly ' demand' and ' prices' detectors plus economics context. Weaker on "demand-side" and "awareness and demand".
Fires on word pieces 'ach' (as in Approaches), ' approach' and ' ser' (serif, serfs), mostly in 'approach' words. Silent on 'ach' in 'breach', so it needs the word-piece context.
result.label: approach / ser word pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ics' completing "Thermodynamics" (headings like "Laws of Thermodynamics"). It stays silent on 'ics' in "mechanics" and is weaker on "kinetics", so it depends on the word.
result.label: 'ics' ending Thermodynamics

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in negative contractions after a noun subject, as in "doesn't" (e.g. "laughter doesn't", "waiter doesn't"). It stays silent on apostrophes in "don't", "it's" and "you'll". Members are mostly apostrophe detectors.
result.label: Apostrophe in "doesn't" after noun

result.description: Fires on varied tokens that end or continue a word or title, such as 'ership' in "Leadership" headings, ' commands', ' World', and 'ants'. The peaks are mixed and the circuit is a diffuse set of token-level detectors, so no single trigger stands out.
result.label: Mixed word-ending tokens, 'ership'

result.description: Fires mostly on the final letters P or D after "ER" (ERP, ERD acronyms), and weakly on " preferred" and a few other word pieces. Members detect "ER" plus capital-letter fragments. The peaks are mixed, so the evidence is thin.
result.label: ER-acronym final letters (ERP/ERD)

result.description: Fires on the word after a form of "take/taking" (mostly " into" in "take into account/effect", also "taken", "a", "this"). Silent on "into" after nouns like "insight into" or "research into", so it needs the take-verb construction.
result.label: "take into" after take-verb

result.description: Fires on ' identity' and on 'ities' when it completes 'identities' (e.g. "ident|ities"), mostly in social or cultural identity text. It stays silent on 'ities' in other words such as realities, similarities and opportunities.
result.label: identity / identities word ending

result.description: Fires on a few specific words in technical science text, mainly " repair" (DNA repair), " differential" (differential equations), "ize" and " transmit". Peaks are a mixed handful of tokens, with no single dominant one.
result.label: repair / differential technical words

result.description: Fires on the noun-forming suffix pieces 'ability' and 'ness' completing a word, especially in physical-property terms like permeability and thickness. Members are mostly detectors of 'ability' and 'ness' tokens, plus material/property context.
result.label: -ability / -ness suffix endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mechan' (start of mechanics/mechanisms), most strongly after a physics modifier such as classical, statistical, quantum or fluid. It predicts suffixes like 'isms' and 'ics'. Silent on general science text without it.
result.label: ' mechan' word piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'inter' right after the prefix 'mis', as in 'misinterpretation'. It stays silent when 'inter' starts a word or document. It is weaker on other 'mis'+piece words such as miscommunication.
result.label: 'inter' after 'mis' prefix

result.description: Fires on ' light' and ' reflect' (reflected, reflectivity) in optics text about reflection of light. Quiet on unrelated text such as safety goggles and vision. Members are detectors of 'light' and 'reflect' tokens.
result.label: light / reflect in optics

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' An' (as in "Ancient") at the start of a line or document in list-like headings, with weaker firing on ' Ch', ' No' and ' A'. Fires on capitalised first tokens of title-like items; silent in other list items.
result.label: Line-initial ' An' of Ancient

result.description: Fires on the word " styles" (rarely " style"), most strongly after a noun like "communication" or "expression" in passages about communication styles. Members are detectors of "styles" and similar words such as genre and range.
result.label: " styles" after communication noun

result.description: Fires on "ating" in "plating" (presentation and plating, culinary context), and weakly on "plates" or "culinary". It stays silent on other "-ating" words such as eating, captivating and elevating. Members detect the "pl" prefix and "ate/ag" pieces.
result.label: "plating" word-piece in culinary text

result.description: Fires on ' that' used as a relative pronoun right after a noun (key that, rules that, equations that), mostly in technical or academic text. It stays silent on 'so that'.
result.label: Relative 'that' after noun
valence 'ence' piece in science text
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ence' completing "valence" (as in valence electrons/band) in solid-state and chemistry text. Weaker on ' unit' in "unit cell". Silent on 'ence' in other words like essence or repellence.
Fires on the word piece 've' inside longer words (concave, convection, convey, valve), and also on ' Ch' in 'Supply Chain' and 'ust' in 'Sustainability'. Silent on 've' at the end of 'dissolve'.
result.label: 've' word piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lic' inside a split word, mostly 's|lic|ing' (network slicing), after an initial 's'. It is silent when 'lic' starts the text with no preceding piece. Members detect other mid-word fragments such as 'yl', 'cul' and 'lap'.
result.label: 'lic' piece in 'slicing'

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of a title-like heading word (Symbol, Represent, Draw, Search), especially in short outline or list headings such as "Colors as Symbols". Predicts a suffix like -ing or -ism next.
result.label: Heading-initial Symbol/Represent/Draw word
'ic' in 'deficit'
result.description: Fires on the token 'ic' when it is the middle piece of "deficit" (def|ic|it), in economics and budget text. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as "Indicators" or "attic".
Fires mainly on the 'agram' piece of "Instagram" in lists of social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram). Weaker firing on " such" in "such as" example lists.
result.label: Instagram 'agram' in platform lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of Arabic and Russian (Cyrillic) words, such as single letters or word pieces inside longer words. Peaks are scattered with low consistency. Weak activation on some English function words.
result.label: Non-Latin mid-word fragments

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: 'st' inside "crystallization" (not in "21st century"), and ' territorial'/' national' in geopolitical text like "national territorial claims". Mostly early-layer 'st' detectors and law/country members; the pattern is mixed.
result.label: crystallization 'st' and territorial/national

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ox' (in Redox, superoxide) and 'neg'/' Neg' (negation, Carnegie), mid-word fragments that begin or continue a longer word. Weaker on other word fragments like 'pr', 'arg'.
result.label: ox / neg word fragments

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ation' and 'ated' when they complete "saturation"/"saturated" (after 'satur'). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like sensation, experimentation, isolation.
result.label: -ation/-ated in saturate words

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'itive' (also 'ious', 'otic') ending a word split into pieces, as in Contrapos-itive, Pos-itive, compet-itive, cogn-itive. It stays silent when 'itive' starts a new word after a full stop.
result.label: '-itive' suffix piece in split words

result.description: Fires on the token " vector" (also "Vector", rarely " bearing"), mostly in linear algebra text where it modifies a following noun such as "space" or "sequences". Silent when " vector" starts the text.
result.label: ' vector' in math text

result.description: Fires on the word after "has" in present perfect constructions, mostly " been" (also " its", " also", " found"), as in "has been shown/used". Members detect " has" and the following participle slot. Silent on "cases have been reported".
result.label: Word after "has" (has been)

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces (life, all, liber, harm, right) in abstract philosophical or spiritual text, especially Buddhist/yoga teachings about paths and liberation. Often mid-word or in list-like enumerations. Peak tokens are scattered.
result.label: Spiritual/philosophical abstract word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' apart', both as an adverb (move farther apart, stands apart) and as the first piece of 'apartments'. Weak activation on a few other word pieces such as 'ises' and 'ger'.
result.label: ' apart' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on ' stability' (e.g., in power-system stability types) and on word-ending pieces like 'ity', 'ence', 'ctic', plus scattered pieces such as 'h' in pronoun lists. Peaks are mixed and the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' stability' and word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on " ahead" (e.g. "plan ahead"), also on "al" in "Environmental" and occasionally " apart" or odd word pieces. Early-layer token detector with a mixed secondary set of tokens.
result.label: ' ahead' after plan, plus 'al'

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after "waiting" (or waiting times), where it introduces what is being waited on. It stays silent on ' for' after adjectives like "essential", "crucial", "forgiven" or "down".
result.label: ' for' after 'waiting'

result.description: Fires on word-piece 'ism' or 'i' inside words like "seismic" and "physiology", and on "-ism" in other words. It stays quiet on "-ism" in words like "feudalism" and "paleomagnetism", so it depends on the surrounding word.
result.label: 'ism'/'i' inside seismic, physiology

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ism' in "Cubism" (after "Cub"). It stays silent on 'ism' in other movement names such as Impressionism and Fauvism, or when 'ism' starts the text.
result.label: 'ism' in Cubism

result.description: Fires on ' and' directly after the word "safe" (e.g. "safe and effective", "safe and health"). Stays silent on ' and' after other words such as nouns in lists. A discriminative member detects ' safe'.
result.label: ' and' after 'safe'

result.description: Fires on the word piece "iah" in "Josiah", in the name Josiah Willard Gibbs. Weakly fires on "ial" in "bacterial"/"microbial". Members detect the name's pieces (Will, Gib) and name-like fragments.
result.label: "iah" in Josiah (Gibbs)

result.description: Fires on the word "plant" (Plant/plants), both the factory sense in "nuclear power plant" and the botany sense as in "Plant Pathology" or plant growth. Members are mostly plant-token detectors plus power/nuclear context.
result.label: Word "plant" in any sense

result.description: Fires on a hyphen after "long", "low" or similar short modifiers, where a compound adjective like long-lasting, long-term, low-density comes next. Stays silent on hyphens after other words such as decision-, non-, ever-, component-.
result.label: Hyphen after long/low compounds

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside particular words, mainly 'ise' in "merchandise" and 'auss' in "Gauss". Silent on 'ise' in "compromise", "Weise", "Blaise", so it depends on the specific word.
result.label: 'ise' in merchandise, 'auss' in Gauss

result.description: Fires on " from" that begins a new "from X to Y" range phrase, usually after a semicolon or comma in a list of ranges. It stays silent on " from" after verbs or adjectives like change, exempt, remove, or different.
result.label: "from" opening a from-to range

result.description: Fires on " the" right after the preposition "in" (also "during"), especially in historical or period phrases like "in the 12th century" or "in the mid-9…". It stays silent on "the" after "during", "saw" or "through" in other contexts.
result.label: "the" after "in" in time phrases

result.description: Fires on ' products' and ' customers' (rarely ' goods') in business/marketing text, especially in "products or services" and customer-purchase phrasing. Silent on non-commercial text.
result.label: products/customers in marketing text

result.description: Fires on a comma (often with a quote, as in ',' or "',") that separates items in an enumerated list of examples, such as quoted words or "e.g.," lists. Members detect list commas.
result.label: Comma in example lists

result.description: Fires on the word after "external" (-ities, -ity, factors, circumstances), mainly in economics text on externalities. Stays silent on -ities endings in other words like identities or personalities.
result.label: Word completing "external…" (ities/factors)

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ial' and 'ary' completing astronomy words, such as celest-ial and planet-ary, in orbital mechanics text. It stays silent on 'ial' in other words like inertial.
result.label: celestial/planetary word endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ceptor" in "receptor" (e.g. enzyme-linked receptor, G-protein coupled receptor). It stays silent when "ceptor" starts the text with no "re" before it.
result.label: "ceptor" in "receptor"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of rare or technical words split into pieces (Zer-oth, Eu-cl-id, Polym-er, Dar-win), mostly in science and math text. Peak tokens are varied sub-word pieces; the evidence for a single trigger is weak.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of technical terms

result.description: Fires on process nouns like "creation", "app", "production" right after "the" when they head a following "of" phrase (e.g. "the creation of"). It stays silent on "job creation", where no "the" comes before it.
result.label: "the" + creation/production noun

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "bers" ending "Numbers" in lists of named number sequences (Fibonacci, Stirling, Bell Numbers), and weakly on "ition" and similar mid-word endings. Needs the preceding "Num" piece.
result.label: "bers" in "Num|bers" headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ther" or "Ther" at the start of "therapy" (e.g. gene therapy, music therapy), and more weakly on "day"/"daily". Members detect ther/apy pieces plus healthcare words.
result.label: "Ther" piece of therapy

result.description: Fires on the token ' thought' used as a noun for ideas or intellectual tradition (modern thought, schools of thought, free thought). Members detect ' thought' and related philosophy/thinking words.
result.label: ' thought' as noun (ideas)

result.description: Fires on the verb "go" and its forms (go, goes, falls, falling), including repeated "go, go, go" and "goes beyond". Members are mostly detectors of go/move-type tokens. Weak spillover onto unrelated tokens.
result.label: go / goes / falls verb forms

result.description: Fires on the first word of a capitalized title or heading, mostly ' Health' (Healthcare...) and ' Saf' (Food Safety), also ' Cost', at the start of document or list-item headings. Weak on word fragments mid-word.
result.label: Health/Safety heading-initial words

result.description: Fires on the word ' television' (62 of 64 peaks), mostly as a modifier or object in media-studies prose. Weak response to ' TV'. The contrast shows no peak token, so no extra condition is evident.
result.label: ' television' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " Language" when it begins a line as a title-case heading in a list of topic headings (e.g. "Language Promotion.", "Language Rights."). Weak on lowercase "language" in running text.
result.label: Line-initial heading "Language"

result.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split word, mostly 'actor' after 'F' (Factor, Factoring), and also 'og', 'ill', '/' in other split words. It needs the word-start fragment before it, often in technical or math text.
result.label: 'actor' piece after F (Factor)

result.description: Fires on the token 'if' (including the piece inside words like 'bifurcation' and 'drifters'), whether a standalone conditional word or a word-internal fragment. Members are mostly 'if' token detectors.
result.label: 'if' token piece

result.description: Fires on an opening quote mark (' or ") that begins a quoted word in a list of example words, such as pronouns or prepositions ("to," "from,"). It is quiet on apostrophes inside ordinary prose.
result.label: Opening quote in quoted word lists

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in a contraction of "is" ('s) after a relative or pronoun-like word such as "that", "what" or "who". It stays silent on apostrophes in n't, 're, and sentence-initial 's.
result.label: Apostrophe in that's/what's contraction

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of longer words, mostly 'res' in "genres", also ' categor' and 'ur'. Strongest in titles about music genres and academic-style text. The word-piece peaks are mixed, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Mid-word piece, 'genres' / 'categor'

result.description: Mixed target peaking on mid-word pieces like 'rop', ' anni', and Arabic or garbled byte characters inside words, plus some function words. Members are mostly generic word-piece and Arabic detectors, so the evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, Arabic letters

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'se' as the ending of "pulse" (also in Morse), mostly in technical or scientific text. It stays silent on 'se' in "intense".
result.label: 'se' ending of "pulse"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of rare multi-piece words, mostly 'xt' in "juxtaposing", 'es'/'ion' in "cohesion", and similar pieces like 'ters' and 'ch'. It needs the word to be split into pieces, with the fragment inside a particular word.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: juxtapose, cohesion

result.description: Fires on drama/theatre words, mainly ' dialog' (before 'ue'), also ' dram' (before 'atic'), ' theatre' and ' drama', in scriptwriting and stage text. Members are detectors of these tokens.
result.label: Dialog/drama/theatre word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'unci' inside "pronunciation" (pron-unci-ation). Members include detectors of 'unci' and of 'pron'/'oun' pieces; it fires only on this piece, not elsewhere.
result.label: 'unci' in pronunciation

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ives" when it completes the word "knives" after the "kn" fragment. It weakly fires on "ographic" after "orth". Members detect "kn" and "ives".
result.label: "ives" completing "knives"

result.description: Fires on the word "map" and its variants (maps, mapping), in both geographic and mathematical or graphics senses. Members are mostly detectors of "map"/"maps"/"mapping" tokens. The contrast text, which has no "map" token, is silent.
result.label: map / maps / mapping token

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ive' completing the word "predictive" (e.g. predictive analytics/models). It stays silent on 'ive' in other words such as adaptive and automotive.
result.label: 'ive' in "predictive"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'am' inside multi-token words like infl-am-matory (also tok-am-ak, am-ong), not on 'am' in words like cream. Peaks in "pro-/anti-inflammatory".
result.label: 'am' piece in inflammatory

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece (lines, line, lets) completing "streak" in streaklines/streaklets in fluid-flow text. It is silent after "stream" or "stretch", so it needs the preceding "streak" piece.
result.label: Suffix after "streak" (streaklines)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece "elect" (and "hydro") when it begins a longer technical word such as electrical, electromagnetic, electrification or hydrological. Members are mostly detectors of "elect" and electric words.
result.label: elect-/hydro- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on affix-related word pieces: "refix", " suffix", and "-able/-ability" endings, strongest in text about prefixes and suffixes in morphology. It stays silent on "able" in words like sustainable or unimaginable.
result.label: Affix words: prefix, suffix, -able

result.description: Fires on the token ' production' in all peak examples (language production, production economics, industrial production). Members are mostly detectors of production/output/generation tokens; weak activation on near-synonyms like output and success.
result.label: ' production' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' instead' (rarely ' rather'), mostly right after a conjunction like "but" or "and" and before "of". Weakly fires on "but also". Members include ' instead' token detectors and ' but' detectors.
result.label: ' instead' after but/and

result.description: Fires on ' for' directly after a noun like "Respect" (also "basis", "possibilities"), where 'for' introduces the object or beneficiary. It stays quiet on ' for' after nouns like "standards", "preparation" or "competition".
result.label: ' for' after 'Respect'-type nouns

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start a longer word, mostly 'head' (subheading, Whitehead) and ' spell' (spellchecker), also 'pton' and ' grad'. It fires on these pieces inside compounds or names, so the next piece is expected.
result.label: Word-piece 'head'/'spell' inside compounds

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ot' in the middle of multi-piece words (mezzotint, knot, Robot, isotope, cyclotron), where the word continues with another piece. Weakly on 'et' and 'vised'.
result.label: 'ot' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the hyphen in the Arabic name prefix "Al-"/"al-" (e.g. "Al-Kitab", "al-Hasan") in algebra or history-of-mathematics text. It stays silent on hyphens in other places, such as a leading hyphen or "Hindu-Arabic".
result.label: Hyphen after Arabic "al" prefix

result.description: Fires mostly on " phrase" (also "alt" in "waltzes", "amp", "her" in "adheres"), especially in "phrase-structure" or "this phrase". Silent on "noun phrases" in a grammar-listing context. Members detect phrase, clause, word and sentence tokens.
result.label: ' phrase' token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece completing a plural or compound noun in academic/philosophical titles and phrases, such as "Possible Worlds", "alternative worlds" and "Moral Dilemmas". Peaks on ' world', 's' and 'as'. Silent in "worldly".
result.label: Plural ending in philosophy topics

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'itar' and 'ram' inside longer words like egalitarian, authoritarian, utilitarianism and pyramids. It is silent when 'itar' begins the text, with no preceding word piece.
result.label: Mid-word 'itar'/'ram' pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece 'uz' in the word "fuzzy" (f-uz-zy), mostly in fuzzy logic/sets text. Members are mainly detectors of 'uz' and 'zy' pieces.
result.label: 'uz' in "fuzzy"
' to' after "response"
result.description: Fires on ' to' directly after "response" or "respond" (in response to, response to X). It stays silent on other uses of ' to', such as "due to", "led to", "designed to" and "from X to Y".

Fires on scattered mid-word fragments such as 'ice', 'Maxim', 'isen', 'ek', 'la', 'ogn'. These are pieces inside longer or rare words. Members are generic token detectors, and the evidence is mixed and thin.
result.label: Mid-word fragment pieces

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ry' (or 'met') completing "asymmetry" / "symmetry", also "asymmetrical". Stays silent on 'ry' in "metry" without the asym- prefix context.
result.label: asymmetry word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' bro' and ' tr' that begin a split word like "broadened" or "trends", mostly after "broader" or adjective contexts. Silent in other text. Weaker on similar fragments such as ' reg' and ' g'.
result.label: ' bro' / ' tr' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the 'ge' piece completing "surge", mostly in "a surge in X" (growth or popularity). Members are mainly 'ge' token detectors, plus some token-specific ones such as 's' in "exceeds".
result.label: "ge" in "surge"

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a relative pronoun right after a noun (e.g. "keys that are", "service that we"), introducing a restrictive clause. Silent on complementizer 'that' after verbs like believe/suggests, and on demonstrative 'that'.
result.label: Relative 'that' after noun

result.description: Fires on the word "festivals" (the ' festiv' piece and the following 'als'), especially in discussion of festival length or size. It stays silent on 'als' in other words such as "rehearsals".
result.label: festivals word piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "as" inside "Me|as|uring" (Measuring), after the split-off "Me". It is quiet on other words in similar contexts, and weakly active on a few other mid-word pieces.
result.label: "as" in Measuring

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'olds' piece of "Reynolds" (as in Reynolds number), with weaker firing on other mid-word pieces like 'e' in names, ' regul' and 'ist'. It depends on the preceding word piece 'Reyn'.
result.label: Reynolds 'olds' word piece

result.description: Fires on ' continued'/'continue'/'continues' (and ' IT') when a trend or process is described as persisting, often just before 'through' or 'into'. Weak on 'further' and 'rather'.
result.label: continue/continued verbs, and IT

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'ions' in "emotions" and 'through' in "breakthroughs", plus a few other pieces. It stays silent on 'ions' in "inventions". Members detect emot-/ional and break-through pieces.
result.label: emot-ions / break-through word endings

result.description: Fires on the word " low" as a scientific or technical modifier in a high/low contrast or pairing (low pressure, low Reynolds numbers, low variance). It stays silent when "low" begins a document or sentence without such a contrast.
result.label: ' low' in high/low contrasts

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'gebras' in "Lie algebras", 'ut' in "absolutist"/"statutory", and 'ian' in academic text on philosophy, math and law. Peaks are scattered across word fragments in abstract or scholarly vocabulary.
result.label: Word fragments in academic terms

result.description: Fires on the token " under", most strongly as a preposition meaning "under conditions/stress/loading" in technical text, and also on "under" as a prefix in words like underlie or underpinnings. Members are mostly detectors of "under".
result.label: ' under' token detector

result.description: Fires in calculus/math text on tokens like "of" after "derivative", "function", and "able" in "differentiable", where a function or derivative is being discussed. Silent on "able" in non-math words like "manageable".
result.label: Calculus derivative-of-function tokens

result.description: Fires on the word "return" and its variants (returns, returned, returning), in noun and verb uses such as asset returns, returned goods and return points. Silent on nearby logistics text that lacks the word.
result.label: return / returns / returned word

result.description: Fires on ' Dr' at the start of a line in a list of names of doctors (one "Dr. Name" per line). Silent in lists of names without the title, such as photographers.
result.label: ' Dr' starting list entries

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " List" when it is split from a following "ening" (as in "Attentive List|ening"), and weakly on "List" in "Lists" and "day" in "everyday". Silent on the whole word "listening".
result.label: Split " List" before "ening"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'il' in "Soil", 'rom' in "chromatography", 'enc' in "pencils", and ' longer' in "longer-term". It looks like a word-piece completion latent with mixed peaks, and the evidence is thin.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: Soil, chromatography

result.description: Fires on the word ' for' when it follows a noun and introduces its purpose or target (filters for reducing, respect for, sourcing for raw materials). Members are mostly layer-0 detectors of ' for'. Silent on contrast text without ' for'.
result.label: ' for' after noun (purpose)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' coord' (start of "coordination"), almost always. Weakly also on ' flu' (fluids, fluency). Members are mostly ' coord' token detectors plus motor/skill-related context latents. The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' coord' word-start detector

result.description: Fires on ' section' (also ' chapter', ' Old') when it refers back to the current text, as in "this section", "finish the section", "end that section". It stays silent when ' section' opens a document.
result.label: Self-referential 'this section' mentions

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: the hyphen in "long-term", the word " plot", and word pieces like "ap" in "juxtaposing". Strongest on "long-" before "term"; silent on a bare "-term" with no "long" before it.
result.label: long-hyphen, plot, juxtaposing pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (or 'isation') right after the piece 'mechan', as in "mechanization" of production/industry. It stays quiet after other stems like modern, visual, or revolution.
result.label: 'ization' in 'mechanization'
' influ' piece before 'ences'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' influ' when it follows a preceding modifier (e.g. "ecological influ|ences", "Norman influ|ences") and the word continues as "influences". Silent when ' influ' starts the text with no preceding context.

Fires on the first word piece of a physics or science word after "a/an" (elect-, electric, spin, rot-, lever, manifest-), mostly in electromagnetism and mechanics text. Likely predicts a continuation of the word, e.g. "-ural", "-ter".
result.label: Physics word stem after a/an

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'met' inside split words such as 'non-metalous' or 'asymmetry', and weakly on other mid-word pieces like 'cer' in 'concerto' and 'pp' in 'grappled'. It needs a partial word that is still to be completed.
result.label: Mid-word piece 'met' in split words

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces ('s', 'ing', 'ed', 'ly') attached to the word stem "prompt" (prompts, prompting). Silent on 's' after other nouns like catalysts or protocols. Members detect the 'prompt' token.
result.label: Suffix after 'prompt' stem

result.description: Fires on ' sentences' (or ' sentence') when it follows a sentence-type modifier, such as compound-complex, complex or active, in grammar and writing text. It stays silent when the word follows 'and' or 'or' in a list of units.
result.label: ' sentences' after sentence-type modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece "row" when it is the start of "growth"/"growing" split into g+row, as in step-growth and chain-growth polymer. Weakly fires on a few other mid-word pieces.
result.label: "row" piece in g-row-th

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' h' and ' vis' (also ' cam') when the token is the start of a longer word split into pieces, such as h-inder, h-ushed, vis-ually. Silent when ' h' stands alone at the start of a text.
result.label: Word-start fragments ' h' / ' vis'

result.description: Fires on the Cyrillic piece 'но' (also 'тно', 'ко') inside garbled or pseudo-Russian word strings, usually mid-word. Weak firing on a few English word stems. Members are mostly Arabic and Cyrillic fragment detectors.
result.label: Cyrillic 'но' inside garbled words

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in contractions right after the pronoun "we" (we'll, we're). It stays quiet on apostrophes after other words such as someone's, It's, wouldn't, and fires only weakly after "today".
result.label: Apostrophe after "we"

result.description: Fires mainly on " Sir" as a title before a name, and on " Right" in repeated "Right X" list items (Eightfold Path), plus a few word pieces like "idor". Silent on plain person-name lists.
result.label: Sir title and list-item Right

result.description: Fires on the token " services", most strongly in "ecosystem services" text. Members are mostly detectors of " services"/"service" itself. The contrast has no example of the token, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' services' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'active' (reactive, proactive) and 'als' (metals), mostly in chemistry-related text, as the suffix completing a multi-piece word. Silent on the generic problem-solving contrast text.
result.label: Suffix pieces 'active'/'als' in chemistry words

result.description: Fires on a digit (mostly 3, 2, 7, 0) in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as phone numbers, years, or digit strings, after earlier digits. Members are mostly digit detectors. Logits are not informative.
result.label: Digit inside multi-digit numbers

result.description: Fires on " like" (occasionally " as") when it introduces examples after a plural category noun, as in "platforms like SoundCloud" or "tricks like vivid imagery". It is quiet where no such example-introducing construction appears.
result.label: "like" introducing examples

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' util' (as in utilize/utilizes/utilized), usually as a verb after a subject noun like "technique" or "approach". Members are mostly detectors of ' util' and similar pieces.
result.label: ' util' in utilize

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expect' when it begins "expectations", as a split word. It stays silent on "unexpected". Members are mostly ' expect' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: ' expect' in 'expectations'

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces (-ging, -ger, -ges, -gers) completing "mer-" in "merge/merger/merging", mostly in corporate or technical text about combining entities. Weakly fires on merge/blend verbs.
result.label: Suffix after "mer-" in merge words

result.description: Fires on opening brackets or braces (like '{', '_{', '(', '[') inside LaTeX or math notation, such as \mathbf{, \vec{, or \Psi(. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Opening brackets in LaTeX math
' cons' in "consolidation" (synaptic)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cons' at the start of "consolidation", mostly after "synaptic" or "phases of" in memory-neuroscience text. Weak activation on ' intent'. Members are mostly ' cons' token detectors.

Fires on ' experiments' and pieces of collision-related words (coll-isions, mergers) in particle physics text, especially after "collision". Silent on ' experiments' at the start of a document without that context.
result.label: collision experiments in particle physics

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' eng' when it begins "engagement" or "engage" mid-sentence, usually after a noun like employee, customer or listener. It stays silent when "eng" starts the text or follows "an".
result.label: ' eng' in engagement

result.description: Fires on the word ' about' in mid-sentence, especially as a preposition meaning "concerning" after verbs or copulas ("was about", "think about", "just about"). Silent when ' about' starts the text. Members are mostly ' about' token detectors.
result.label: ' about' preposition token

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'idence' (as in Incidence, Confidence Interval) and 'ar' in a repeated heading word "Stellar". Mostly word-internal fragments of longer words in title-like headings.
result.label: Word fragments 'idence' and 'ar'

result.description: Fires on the word " boundaries" (rarely " boundary"), mostly after an adjective like cultural, linguistic, political or ethnic. Members are mainly detectors of the same token, plus some unrelated generic hubs.
result.label: ' boundaries' token detector

result.description: Fires on commas (also hyphens or "to") separating numbers in lists, year sequences and numeric ranges, e.g. "1958, 1967," or "8, 9,". Silent on commas in ordinary prose clauses.
result.label: Separators between numbers in sequences

result.description: Fires on "to" after "proportional" and "of" after "square" in physics/math proportionality statements (inverse square law, directly proportional to). Silent on other "of" uses like "product of" or "measurement of".
result.label: proportional to / square of

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ure" completing "sculpture" (split as sculpt|ure), occasionally "etic". Members detect the "sculpt" piece and the art/sculpture context.
result.label: "ure" ending of sculpture

result.description: Fires on the verb ' operate' (occasionally 'operation(s)' or 'execute'), mostly after 'to' or 'can' when describing how systems or businesses function. Members include several ' operate' token detectors.
result.label: ' operate' verb detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' re' when it starts a word after a preceding word, especially in science text such as "redox re|actions", "RBMK re|actor", "cytoplasmic re|ceptor". Silent on sentence-initial or verb-like ' re' (e.g. "may re|define").
result.label: ' re' word-start piece in chemistry

result.description: Fires on the verb "manifest" (manifest, manifests, manifesting), including the suffix "s" after it, when describing how a phenomenon or condition shows itself, mostly in scientific text. Weak on words like "display".
result.label: Verb "manifest" (shows itself as)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'umes' completing "legumes" (after "leg"), with a few weaker hits on suffix pieces like 'ased' and 'ified'. Silent when 'umes' appears without the preceding "leg".
result.label: legumes: 'umes' after leg

result.description: Fires on 'ological' completing "technological" (also 'made' in "man-made"), predicting nouns like advances or progress. Silent on 'ological' in other words like "epistemological", so it needs the techn- prefix.
result.label: techn-ological word completion

result.description: Fires on the second or later capital-letter piece of an uppercase acronym split into tokens (P-ET, M-CC, M-MC, H-HC), after an initial capital letter. Silent on ordinary words.
result.label: Capital-letter acronym continuation pieces

result.description: Fires on verbs of supplying, mainly ' offer', also ' providing', ' provides', ' provide', typically after a plural subject noun (platforms, venues, suppliers) and before the thing supplied. Members detect provide/offer tokens.
result.label: offer/provide verbs

result.description: Fires on the 'road' piece completing "railroad" (after "rail"), and weakly on ' rail' itself. Members detect 'rail' and transport/road word pieces that precede it.
result.label: 'road' in railroad

result.description: Fires on the word " systems" (also " System"/" system"), mostly as the head noun after a modifier in technical text, e.g. "life support systems", "wellpoint systems", "control systems". Silent on text without that word.
result.label: "systems" after technical modifier

result.description: Fires on the abstract noun " equality" and " inequality" (e.g. "income inequality", "idea of equality") in social, economic or philosophical discussion. Members detect equal/inequal pieces, difference, justice and discrimination words. Silent on the nearby word "Fairness".
result.label: equality / inequality noun

result.description: Fires on the piece 'it' when it appears inside a longer word (Ant-it-rust, F-it, aud-it, facil-it-ator, prior-it-ize), not on the standalone pronoun 'it', where it stays silent.
result.label: 'it' as word-internal piece

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated word pieces: LaTeX ' \' in fractions, ' north' in magnetic north, ' alloc', ' az'. Mostly technical or math text; the peaks share no single meaning, and the logits are mixed.
result.label: Mixed tokens: LaTeX backslash, north, alloc

result.description: Fires mainly on ' page' in operating-system memory text (page table, page frame, page fault), and weakly on word pieces like 'cla'/'uses', 'icol', 'crit'. Silent on general OS text without 'page'.
result.label: 'page' in virtual memory paging

result.description: Fires on the word-initial token ' D' (capital D with a leading space) at the start of a word that continues, such as Drug, Dravidian, Dough or Dwight. Members are mostly ' D' detectors. The contrast text has no ' D'.
result.label: Word-initial ' D' token

result.description: Fires on ' based' right after a noun, in the "X based on Y" construction (classification based on, splits based on). It is weaker on 'depending on'. It is silent on other text without that construction.
result.label: ' based' in "based on"

result.description: Fires on the hyphen directly after "high" in compounds like high-pressure, high-temperature, high-level, high-intensity. It stays silent on hyphens after other words such as "real-world" or "real-time".
result.label: Hyphen after "high"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ims' inside "whimsical" / "whimsically" / "whimsy" (wh + ims). Early-layer token-piece members for 'ims', 'ist' and 'isk' after 'wh' feed it. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'ims' in whimsical

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' anom' (in anomaly/anomalies) and 'va' (Bra-va, la-va), i.e. mid-word fragments needing the rest of the word to follow. Mostly the ' anom' token in data-science text.
result.label: ' anom' and 'va' word fragments

result.description: Fires on nouns like "transfer", "exchange", "transmission" following "data" (or similar), as in data transfer/exchange in networking and computing text. Silent on general network text without such a noun.
result.label: data transfer/exchange noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lo' inside "exploitation" (especially "overexploitation"), where it follows "exp". Almost always this one word; weak activation elsewhere.
result.label: 'lo' in exploitation

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ode' (also 'odes', 'de') inside multi-piece words such as bi-ode-gradable and cath-ode. Members are detectors of 'ode' and of similar mid-word pieces ('ote', 'om').
result.label: 'ode' mid-word piece

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ik' in "Rubik's cube", and weakly on other mid-word fragments like ' ill' in "illusion" and ' subst' in "substances". It is a word-piece detector for the start of a longer word.
result.label: Rubik's 'ik' word piece

result.description: Fires mostly on " University" in "University of X" after "the" or an institution name in academic bios. It also fires weakly on academic-field word pieces like "ics" and "acoustic", which push towards field names such as logic and algebra.
result.label: University in academic institution names

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments in physics/fluid and optics text (' stre' in streamlines, ' ray', ' Vel', ' Bern', ' Ray'leigh, nan'osc'), where the word is incomplete and continues with a suffix. Silent on generic headings from non-science text.
result.label: Physics word-start fragments (stre, ray, Vel)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of technical terms, mainly 'auch' in Cauchy and 'ar' in radar, plus occasional other pieces like 'ation' and 'for'. Fires on the word piece inside specific words, not on other contexts.
result.label: Cauchy/radar mid-word pieces

result.description: Fires on 'chn' in "Biotechnology"/"nanotechnology" and on ' engineering'/' Engineering' in field-name headings. Silent on 'chn' in "geotechnical", so it needs the technology-word context.
result.label: Biotechnology 'chn' and Engineering

result.description: Fires on a few specific words, mainly " responsible" and " ordered" (also " ideal", some suffix pieces like "es"). Peaks are mixed; members include " responsible" detectors. Weak evidence for any further condition.
result.label: ' responsible' / ' ordered' word detector

result.description: Fires on the final 'y' of "sovereignty", completing the word after pieces like "sovereig" or "sovereignt". Weakly fires on 'y' ending other abstract nouns (philosophy, hyponymy); silent on 'y' in "empathy".
result.label: Final 'y' of sovereignty

result.description: Fires on the digit token '5' inside multi-digit numbers, mostly years and dates (508/507, 559, 554, 5000). It also fires weakly on 'SD' in SDG and on ' upon'. Members are mostly digit detectors.
result.label: Digit '5' within numbers/years

result.description: Fires on word pieces such as 'uting' (in contribute/distributing) and ' er' in 'sheet erosion' or 'wind erosion'. Mixed evidence: it appears to be a set of word-piece detectors tied to 'contribut-' and 'erosion' words.
result.label: 'uting' and ' er' (erosion) pieces

result.description: Fires on a hyphen joining a single-letter or short label to the next part, as in chord names (F-A-C), note names, or B-cell. Silent on hyphens in compound words like look-up or key-value.
result.label: Hyphen after letter labels

result.description: Fires on the word-initial fragment ' w' (and sometimes ' am') when it is a split-off start of a longer word like wavelength, wail, wool, widespread, and predicts continuations such as 'avel', 'ired', 'ield'.
result.label: Word-initial ' w' fragment

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe directly attached to the end of a noun or name (Moore', Korea', Giacometti') where a possessive 's or contraction is expected. Silent on apostrophes used as opening or closing quote marks around words.
result.label: Apostrophe after name (possessive)

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' completing the word "equity" (after "equ"), mainly in finance contexts. It stays silent on 'ity' in other words such as liquidity, commodity, diversity and prosperity.
result.label: 'ity' ending of "equity"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ter' inside 'arteries', 'arterial' and 'arterioles', where it follows 'ar'. Weaker on other mid-word pieces. Silent on ordinary text without it.
result.label: 'ter' in 'artery' words

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces that complete a word, mostly 'liance' in "compliance", also 'ction' in contraction, 'itch' in stitch, 'rop', and ' atomic'. Mostly a compliance-word completion, with a few other mid-word endings.
result.label: Word-ending piece, mainly 'compliance'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ith' inside words starting with "l" + "ith" such as lithography, lithium, megalithic. Weakly fires on other word-start pieces like 'mar' in marble. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: 'ith' in lith- words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'unction' in "conjunction" (and "junction"), mainly in grammar-lesson text about conjunction types. Pushes towards linking/joint-type words.
result.label: 'unction' in conjunction

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'r' in "Schrödinger" (the piece after "Sch"), and on ' personal' in "more personal"/"personalized". Silent on 'r' in other words like "nutrition", so it needs the Schrödinger word piece.
result.label: 'r' in Schrödinger, ' personal'

result.description: Fires on the token ' language' (also ' Language') in academic text about linguistics, philosophy and language study. Silent when it opens the text with no preceding context. Members detect language/linguistic tokens.
result.label: ' language' in linguistic discussion

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'ig' and 'nt' inside the split word "sovereignty" (sovere-ig-nt-y), mostly on 'nt'. Silent on related political words that are not this word.
result.label: sovereignty word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' able', mostly in "were/are able to" constructions. It also fires weakly on 'capable'. Members include several ' able' detectors and other word-piece detectors. The contrast offers no clear condition.
result.label: ' able' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' waves' in physics or seismology text (seismic, electromagnetic, gravitational waves). Members are mostly detectors of 'wave(s)' tokens. Silent on the contrast text about reflection and refraction, which has no ' waves' token.
result.label: ' waves' token detector
