result.description: Fires on the piece 'ot' inside words where it is followed by -ype/-ypes/-opes (genotype, phenotypic, isotopic, homotopy, Cyclotron). Silent on 'ot' in other words such as Robotics or ecotrophic, or when 'ot' starts the text.
result.label: 'ot' in -otype/-otope words

result.description: Fires weakly and diffusely on varied mid-sentence tokens (job, action, by, useful, combining) in academic or technical prose. Peaks have low consistency and the logits are mixed, so no clear trigger or condition emerges.
result.label: Diffuse academic-prose mid-phrase tokens

result.description: Fires on the document-start/newline token (shown as ¶) when it follows a short list-item line, such as a topic or field name in a list of titles. It stays quiet on the same token after ordinary prose sentences.
result.label: Document-start token after list items

result.description: Fires on ' point' (also 'ceases', 'function') in math text about continuity of a function "at a point"; silent on 'point' in generic location or path senses.
result.label: 'point' in continuity at a point

result.description: Fires on economics quantity nouns, mainly " income", also " consumption", "expenditure" and " demand", in macroeconomic text about spending, taxes and aggregate demand. Silent on the contrast text that opens with "Consumer".
result.label: Economic income/consumption nouns

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ance' when it completes the word "substance" (subst|ance), as in philosophy of substance or a mysterious substance. Members detect 'subst' and the 'ance' suffix. It is silent in unrelated text.
result.label: 'ance' in "substance"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mostly 'met' in symmetry/asymmetry, 'fe' in infections, 'pher' in peripherals, 'stru' in obstructions. Needs an incomplete word piece in technical or academic text; the completion is predicted next.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, mainly 'met' (symmetry)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' land' (land use, landforms, landscapes), and sometimes on ' pop' in music contexts. Members are mostly detectors of ' land' as a word start. Silent on other environmental text lacking that token.
result.label: ' land' word-start token

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ar' completing "Stellar" (after "Stell"/"ell"), as in "Stellar Clusters/Binaries". Members detect the 'ell' piece and 'ar' itself. Weaker on "weight" and "stellar flares".
result.label: 'ar' in "Stellar"

result.description: Fires on the document-start/newline token (¶) that comes right after a short list item (e.g. a topic or person name ending in a period) in a list of terse entries. It stays silent when the preceding text is full prose.
result.label: Document-start token after list items

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ory' when it completes a word, most strongly in "invent|ory" (inventory management), and also in words like allegory and sensory. Members are mostly 'ory' detectors.
result.label: 'ory' ending, esp. inventory
Fantasy/mythical word endings 'ical', 'asy'
result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ical' (in myth-ical, empir-ical) and 'asy' (fant-asy) in fantasy/fiction-themed text. It is silent on 'ical' in other words like polit-ical and histor-ical.

result.label: Capital 'U' as a symbol
result.description: Fires on the single capital letter 'U' used as a variable or symbol, such as a unitary matrix U, U decomposition, d[U]/dQ, or U1,U2. It also fires weakly on a few word pieces like 'fer'. It stays silent in prose about matrices without a 'U' token.

Fires on the word piece " scr" (as in scrutiny/scrutinizing), mostly in abstract analytical or academic text. Members mainly detect " scr" and similar word-start pieces. The contrast shows no clear differing condition.
result.label: ' scr' in scrutiny
'ctic' word-piece in Arctic/symplectic
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ctic' completing words like Arctic and Symplectic (occasionally ' settlement' or 'ae'). Members include 'ctic' detectors and prefix pieces; it is silent on unrelated text.
Fires on the digit token '0' inside numeric strings such as matrices, ranges, decimals and years. Members are mostly '0' detectors. Silent on the contrast text, which has no zero digit.
result.label: Digit zero in numbers

result.description: Fires on ' lines'/' line' as the end of fluid-dynamics compounds like streaklines, streamlines, pathlines. Silent on general fluid dynamics text without these compound words.
result.label: streak/stream/path-line suffix

result.description: Fires mainly on the token "scale" (micro-scale, large-scale, human-scale) and on " adult", usually when it follows a hyphenated or compound prefix. Members are detectors of "scale" and "adult" plus first-piece word fragments.
result.label: "scale" and "adult" word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' cycle' and ' loop' (also 'ubble', 'ression') as nouns for repeating processes, e.g. while loop, water cycle, Carnot cycle. Silent on unrelated text about memory access.
result.label: cycle / loop process nouns

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ated' (also 'ies', 'ody') inside "saturated/unsaturated" in fat and chemistry text. Silent on 'ated' in other words like concentrated, mediated, hydrogenated.
result.label: 'ated' in (un)saturated

result.description: Fires on 'ires' completing "wires" (esp. "Quantum wires") and on ' grid' in technical grid/mesh-generation text. Stays silent in nanoparticle/biomedical text. Members are mostly detectors of word pieces (ire, avel, elf).
result.label: 'wires' ending and 'grid' in technical text

result.description: Fires mainly on the closing markdown bold marker '**' after a bolded term or title (e.g. after a variable, a list item or a heading), with weaker firing on a few word pieces such as 'ization'. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Closing bold marker '**'

result.description: Fires on plural-set quantifier/distributive modifiers such as "respective", "different", "corresponding", "various", "related" before a plural noun, expecting a category-like noun next. Silent on the contrast text, which lacks such a modifier.
result.label: Distributive modifiers: respective, various, different

result.description: Fires on ' or' joining two parallel alternative nouns or adjectives (positive or negative, gold or silver, strings or brass). It stays quiet on ' or' that joins clauses or phrases, or comes after numbers like "hundreds or thousands".
result.label: ' or' between paired alternatives

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece ' puzz' (as in puzzle) mid-word, with weaker hits on other word-start pieces like 'rac', 'or'/'ors' (flavor). Members include puzz-detectors and other partial-word piece detectors.
result.label: ' puzz' word-piece in puzzle

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "wards" (as in "onwards", "rewards"), and less on the "s" of decade names like "1950s". Members detect "ward/wards" pieces and digit tokens in decade strings.
result.label: "wards" suffix, decade "s"

result.description: Fires on the quantifier ' multiple' (also ' several') when it modifies a following noun or in 'least common multiple'. Members detect multiple/numerous/various/several. It is silent on one document-initial ' multiple'.
result.label: ' multiple' / 'several' quantifier

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " cult" when it begins "cultures" (e.g. "In various cultures", "Western cultures"), plus a few scattered pieces. Members are detectors of culture/cultural tokens. It is silent on unrelated environmental text.
result.label: " cult" in "cultures"

result.description: Fires on the hyphen (occasionally "hand") right after the word "first", as in first-person, first-order, first-come, first-hand. Stays silent on hyphens after other words like face-, maze-, real-.
result.label: Hyphen after "first"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens, mostly ' measurements', ' direction', ' measured' and Arabic 'ى', in geodesy/measurement-style technical text (latitude, longitude, reference, datums). Silent on ' measurements' at the start of a document. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Measurement/geodesy terms, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on ' example' in the phrase "for example", right after "for"/"For". It stays silent when ' example' appears alone, as in "example of such a".
result.label: "example" in "for example"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'yst' at the end of "catalyst" (split as catal+yst), including in "catalyst" used metaphorically. It stays silent when 'yst' starts a text without the preceding 'catal'.
result.label: 'yst' in catalyst

result.description: Fires on the token " symbol" (as a noun or stem before -ize/-ism/-ic), mostly in text about cultural or literary symbolism. Members are mainly symbol-token detectors plus culture/art/myth topic features.
result.label: ' symbol' token in symbolism text

result.description: Fires on the word " plays" (also weakly "play"), mainly in "X plays a role" or theatre senses. Members include detectors of play/plays/playing and "role". The contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: ' plays' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "at" in the middle of a longer technical word, such as onom-at-opoeia, Geom-at-ics and chrom-at-ography. It stays silent on the ordinary preposition "at". It tends to predict suffix pieces like "icans" or "ital".
result.label: "at" inside split words

result.description: Fires on a standalone space token that comes right before a digit, especially in number sequences or lists (e.g. "4, 5, 6") and before years. It predicts that a number follows. Silent on a space at document start.
result.label: Space before a digit
'und' piece in tundra/gerund
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'und' inside words split into tokens, mainly 'ger|und' (gerund phrases) and 't|und|ra'. Early-layer 'und' token detectors and the preceding 'ger' piece drive it. Quiet on unrelated text.

Fires on ' safety' (and 'idents' in 'accidents') in regulatory or workplace-safety text about standards, audits and prevention. It stays silent on 'personal safety' in a risk-list context, so it seems to need an institutional safety-policy setting.
result.label: Safety in regulatory/policy text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ug' inside words, mainly after 't' (tug, tug-of-war, tugging) and in 'Conjugation'. Weakly on similar mid-word pieces like 'pituitary' fragments. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'ug' piece in tug / conjugation

result.description: Fires on the possessive " our" in abstract, reflective prose (our identity, our surroundings, our understanding), often after a preposition or conjunction. Members are mostly detectors of " our"/" your". Predicts nouns that follow a possessive.
result.label: possessive " our" detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside longer words, mostly 'ed' in "multifacet-ed", also 'ism' in "autism", 'rac' in "intracellular", 'ases' in "diseases". Silent on ordinary participle 'ed' like "aimed" or "respected".
result.label: Mid-word fragments, esp. multifaceted 'ed'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' aber' at the start of "aberration" and its variants (aberrant, aberrations), mostly in optics and imaging text. Rare weaker hits on 'omo' and 'ut'.
result.label: ' aber' in aberration

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cons' when it starts a longer word such as consolidation or consensus, mid-sentence. It is silent when ' cons' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' cons' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token right after "thought" (the "-" in thought-provoking, "ful" in thoughtful, " of"/" to" in "thought of/to"). Silent on hyphens after other words like open-, well-, bridge-.
result.label: Suffix or link after "thought"
Mixed: 'into', 'est', 'd' fragments
result.description: Fires on a mix of tokens: ' into' (especially after 'released back' or transformation verbs), and word pieces like 'est' in 'digest', 'd' in 'fold'. Peaks are heterogeneous; no single clean pattern.

Fires on mid-word fragments in rare multi-piece words, mainly 'plex' in perplexity/perplexing and 'igu' in intrigued/iguana, plus occasional 'ound' and 'uc'. Needs the fragment inside its specific word.
result.label: Word-piece 'plex' and 'igu'

result.description: Fires on the token " measures" (plural noun, as in security measures or types of measures). Members are mostly detectors of "measures"/"measure" plus related words like steps, actions, methods. The contrast doesn't show what suppresses it.
result.label: ' measures' token detector

result.description: Fires on early word pieces of a few specific words: ' anx' (anxiety), 'imm' in autoimmune/autoimmunity, ' li' (liver), occasionally 'dev-ast', 'capt-iv'. Mostly medical/biological terms, with mixed members.
result.label: anx / imm / li word-start pieces
'iger' in refrigerant/refrigeration
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iger' inside "refrigerant" and "refrigeration" (after 'refr'). Weaker activation on a few other mid-word pieces such as 'ane' in "instantaneously" and ' continu' in "continuum".

result.label: 'ase' in polymerase
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ase' completing enzyme names, most strongly in 'DNA polymerase' in molecular biology text. Members detect 'ase' pieces, DNA and biology word pieces. It is weak on 'force' in physics text.
Fires on the article ' A' / ' An' (or letter 'A') at the start of a document or sentence, e.g. 'An|cient' headings or 'A significant...'. Silent in mid-text math prose. Predicts adjectives next.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'A'/'An'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing "recombination" (after "recombin", with genetics context). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like innovation, mutation, experimentation.
result.label: 'ation' in recombination

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' al' that starts a longer word (alloy, alliance, aluminum, alphabet) or an Arabic name particle (al-). Members are mostly ' al'/' Al' token detectors. Predicts continuations like 'loy' and 'umin'.
result.label: ' al' word-initial fragment

result.description: Fires on the 'i' piece inside the word "axioms" (ax-i-oms), after "ax". Members include 'ax' detectors and other 'i' detectors; predicts "oms"-type continuation. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'i' inside "axioms"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'on' (also 'et', 'em', 'olog') inside "Phonetics"/"phonology"-type words, after the 'Ph' or 'phon' start. It stays silent on 'on' in unrelated words like "harmonous" or a word-initial 'onetic'.
result.label: 'on' inside Phonetics

result.description: Fires on the word " actions" (also " action") as a noun, across philosophy, grammar and general text. Members are detectors of action/actions and near-synonyms such as steps, measures and activities.
result.label: ' actions' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' K' (also ' k') as a standalone letter or word-initial piece, such as list items, variables, and names like Kara or Kesh. Members are mostly K-token detectors. It pushes toward continuations like 'inet', 'ine' and 'ust'.
result.label: Letter K token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " from", most strongly after nouns or verbs of distance, source or separation (distance from, row from, subtracting from). Many members are detectors of " from". The contrast text has no " from".
result.label: ' from' after distance/source words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' in "earthquake(s)", where it follows "earth". It stays silent on 'qu' in "infrequently". Members are mostly 'qu' detectors.
result.label: 'qu' in earthquake

result.description: Fires on a hyphen after a first word piece like "end", "catch", "Agenda" or "present", where a compound continues (end-of-life, catch-up, Agenda-Setting). It stays quiet on hyphens after "long", "user" or "tug".
result.label: Hyphen after "end"/"agenda" compounds

result.description: Fires on word-final or mid-word pieces such as 'es', 's', 'ech' (in Spe-ech), 'itte' (committ-ees) that complete a word, mainly plural endings. Silent on verb-ending 'es' (focuses, challenges, expresses).
result.label: Word-completing 'es'/'s'/'ech' suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces: " compression", "vers" (as in "conversely"), and "overy"/" recovery" in technical text such as recovery time objectives. Mixed token set; the contrast stays silent on generic database text.
result.label: compression / vers / recovery pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'att' inside split words such as megawatts or Superlattices, plus occasional ' CP' and other mid-word fragments. Predicts word continuations like 'ices' or 'ages'.
result.label: 'att' word fragment mid-word

result.description: Fires on the word right after "being" (present, good, an, fully, part, able), where a predicate complement follows. Silent on "present" as a noun or time word, as in "at present".
result.label: Word after "being"

result.description: Fires on social media platform names (YouTube, Facebook, especially in lists like "Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube") and on the word "updates"/"updated". Members detect Facebook/Twitter/YouTube and "updates" tokens separately. Mixed peaks, so a loose word set.
result.label: Social media names and "updates"

result.description: Fires on physics-related terms in math/science text: ' physics', 'astrophysics', and especially ' scalar' in linear algebra contexts, with weaker firing on ' quantum' and 'energy'. Circuit members are detectors for physics, scalar and energy tokens.
result.label: physics and scalar terms

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ement'/'ements' (occasionally 'able') when completing the word "achievement(s)", after the ' achiev' piece. Boosts goal/accomplishment-type next tokens. Members include achiev-detectors and -ement suffix detectors.
result.label: achiev-ement suffix

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in specific rare words: "ament"/"amental"/"ate" after "orn" (ornamental, ornate) and "i" in "axioms". Silent on "i" in "concerti". Mixed token pieces tied to particular words.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: ornament, axiom
'oss' piece in Lossy/Lossless
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oss' right after 'L' in "Lossy", "Lossless" and similar split words. It is carried by upstream 'oss' token detectors. Silent on other compression text that lacks this piece.

Fires on " resources" (also "resource"/"Resources") when it follows "human", as in "human resources". It stays silent on "resources" after verbs like deploy or allocating, and fires weakly on "renewable resources".
result.label: "human resources" resources token

result.description: Fires on uppercase word fragments 'TE' and 'CH' inside capitalized or formula text (INTEGER, TEMOLOGIC, CH3COOH, geoTECHNIC), where an all-caps piece starts or continues a word. Silent on other all-caps text.
result.label: Uppercase TE/CH word fragments

result.description: Fires on 'play' and ' choice' (also ' selection') when they end a compound after "word" (wordplay, word choice). Silent on "words" in other constructions. Members detect "word" prefixes and selecting/choice tokens.
result.label: word-compound endings: wordplay, word choice

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside "expenditure/expense" (e.g. 'it' in expend-it-ures, 'ense' in exp-ense, 'end'), predicting the ending 'iture'. Silent on 'it' in other words like hospitals, prioritize, necessitates.
result.label: Pieces of "expenditure/expense"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' deb' when it is the start of "debt" (national, public, gross debt), split into ' deb' + 't'. Predicts continuations like 't', 'ts', 'unk'. Silent on text without that piece.
result.label: ' deb' piece in "debt"

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing a word that begins with "sal" (salinity, salts, salary, Salam, Salva), after the "sal" prefix. It stays silent on "inity" in other words like "vicinity".
result.label: Word endings after "sal" prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uz' in "fuzzy" (fuzzy logic, fuzzy sets), where it follows 'f'. It predicts a continuation like "zy". Members are mostly 'uz' and 'zy' token detectors.
result.label: 'uz' in "fuzzy"

result.description: Fires on " reduction" (also " reducing"), most strongly in redox chemistry after "oxidation or". It fires more weakly in other uses such as anxiety reduction or power reduction. The circuit includes oxidation and chemistry detectors plus reduction-token detectors.
result.label: reduction (redox chemistry)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' color' / ' colour' / ' colours', especially when it is followed by a suffix like -ing or -ation, as in graph coloring (edge coloring, vertex coloring). Many members are color-token detectors.
result.label: ' color' word piece

result.description: Fires on the word " Visual"/" visual", mostly in "visualization" or "visual aids" contexts, often at the start of a title or document. Members include visual-token detectors from layer 0.
result.label: Visual token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'av' inside multi-piece words, mainly in "concavity" (also excavation/excavators). Upstream members detect 'av' and similar mid-word fragments.
result.label: 'av' piece in concavity

result.description: Fires on the token ' credit' in finance and lending text (credit score, credit exposures, credit standards). Members are mostly ' credit' token detectors plus finance-related word detectors. Silent on non-finance technical text.
result.label: ' credit' in finance text

result.description: Fires on the token ' knowledge' in philosophical or epistemology-style text, often after a preposition or quantifier (into, of, all, acquiring). Members are mostly ' knowledge' token detectors. Silent on the contrast text lacking the word.
result.label: ' knowledge' token detector

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces in abstract or academic text (' new', 'itions', ' anal', ' aggregate', ' composite', ' conception'), often mid-noun-phrase where a technical or abstract noun is expected. Peaks are scattered with low consistency.
result.label: Abstract academic noun-phrase modifiers

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' emp' (empire), ' econ' (econometric), and 'regional/National/province', mostly polity or economy-related word beginnings. Silent on generic geography/social text without these pieces.
result.label: emp-/econ- word starts (empire, economy)

result.description: Fires on mixed word pieces after an initial 'e'/'E' or in lists: hyphens in "2e-3e-4e", 'ol' in "Aeolian", 'vol', 'cos', 'conom', and the period in "e.g."/"i.e." It looks like a fragment-continuation feature; peaks are scattered.
result.label: Word fragments after initial 'e'

result.description: Fires on " Empire" right after a name of a historical empire (Byzantine, Roman, Persian, Ottoman, British). Weak activations on a few other tokens. Silent on generic political-system text without the word.
result.label: Empire after empire name

result.description: Fires on the word piece " lever", mostly the start of "leveraging"/"leveraged", and weakly on " engines"/" engine". Members are mainly detectors of " lever" in layer 0.
result.label: " lever" in "leveraging"
'ae' in archaea/archaeology
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ae' inside words like Archaea, archaeological and Thaumarchaeota, after 'arch'. It pushes towards suffixes such as 'ological' and 'olog'. It stays silent on other text.
Fires on the final piece 'e' completing the word "gaze" (eye gaze, fixed gaze). It stays silent on 'e' in "eye" or "dese-", so it needs the gaz- prefix before it.
result.label: 'e' ending "gaze"

result.description: Fires on the word " study" used as a noun modifier, especially in "study design(s)" after adjectives like robust or rigorous, in research and science text. Members are detectors of study/research tokens.
result.label: " study" as modifier in "study design"

result.description: Fires on the word after "Harmonic"/"harmonic" (Oscillators, oscill-, Analysis, motion), driven by detectors of the "onic" piece. It stays silent on "oscill" in other contexts such as "countless oscillatory".
result.label: Word following "Harmonic"

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces (-ous, -actions, -vement, -ation, 'model', 'hypothesis') inside multi-token academic terms, in theory or model descriptions. Weakly predicts 'explanation/explain/belief'. Silent on 'ous' in ordinary words like continuous or ubiquitous.
result.label: Suffix pieces in academic theory terms
Suffix of 'evolve' forms
result.description: Fires on the ending piece (-ving, -ves, -ve, -ved) of the word "evolve" and its inflections, after the 'evol' piece. It stays silent on 'ving' in other words such as "improving".

Fires on verbs of fighting or struggle (fighting, fight, fought, protest, competed) in conflict or political-struggle narratives, often just before "against" or "for". Members include protest/activist and military-word detectors.
result.label: Fighting/struggle verbs in conflict contexts

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rog' inside "interrogative" (also weakly on 'ative' in it). Members are detectors of 'rog' and 'ative' pieces; contrast is unrelated text.
result.label: 'rog' in "interrogative"

result.description: Fires on "random" and its variants (" randomly", " random", "Random" in "randomized"), mostly in technical text about sampling, algorithms, statistics or genetics. Members include several detectors of "random" plus statistics and sampling context.
result.label: "random" / "randomly" word

result.description: Fires on abstract quality nouns like -ability suffix (vulnerability, reliability), integrity, confidence, stability, and weakly precision/accuracy, in lists of virtues or traits. Quiet on 'availability' in a technical list of operational factors.
result.label: Abstract quality nouns (-ability, integrity)

result.description: Fires on ' turns' (and 'ists' in 'twists') in plot-twist/narrative contexts, e.g. "unexpected turns", "twists and turns". Members detect turn/tw tokens plus literary words like plot and characters.
result.label: Plot twists and turns

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ile' right after 'host' (hostile), and also on 'aje' in 'Sarajevo'. It is silent on 'ile' in other words like 'fertile'. Weaker on a few other tokens after 'hot' or 'stable'.
result.label: 'ile' in 'hostile' word piece

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'ap'/'aph' inside "metaphor" (metaphors, metaphorically, metaphory), mostly in text about figurative language. Members detect 'ap'/'aph' pieces after "met". Weakly fires on 'ap' in Sapir.
result.label: 'ap'/'aph' inside "metaphor"

result.description: Fires on the word ' even' used as an intensifier or additive adverb, often after "perhaps", "or", "and" (e.g. "or even billions", "perhaps even practice"). Members are mostly ' even' detectors plus possibly/perhaps detectors.
result.label: ' even' as intensifier adverb

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'apest' in 'tapestry'/'tapestries' (after 't'), literal or metaphorical. Weak activation on a few other mid-word pieces. Next-token logits are not informative.
result.label: 'apest' piece of tapestry

result.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment that begins a longer word or term, mainly " Plant" in a list of plant-science topics, plus " veget" (vegetables) and " mobile". Logits suggest it predicts a word continuation or suffix. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Plant/veget/mobile word-start tokens

result.description: Fires on the word "literature" (also "Liter" in "Literary", and occasionally "scene") when it is used as a noun for the body of written works, usually in discussions of eras, genres or the arts. Members detect literature, literary, fiction and writing.
result.label: Literature word detector

result.description: Fires on the token completing or following "religious", "spiritual" or "divine" (e.g. 'ity' in spirituality, ' ge' in religious geography, ' realms', ' nature'). It stays silent on 'ity' in other words like humanity or ambiguity.
result.label: Word after religious/spiritual/divine
Word-initial 'il' token
result.description: Fires on the token 'il' when it stands as its own piece at the start of a word or segment (e.g. 'il'ateral, 'il' pH). It stays silent when 'il' sits inside a word after another piece, as in multilateral, equilateral, vigilance.

Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of longer words, mainly 'ut' (absolutism, macronutrients, pollutants), 'rit' in Sanskrit, and ' tact' in tactics. It seems to anticipate a suffix like 'ics' or 'ism' completing the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments ut / tact / rit

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' Qu' (before "ality") and 'chni' (in "Techniques"), where the word is split into pieces and a specific completion is expected. Predicts continuation pieces like 'tern' and 'chni'. Weak on other fragments.
result.label: Qu / chni word-fragment tokens

result.description: Fires on the "ance" piece in "enhance"/"enhances" (after "enh"), mostly in essay-style text about writing, art or music improving something. It stays silent on "ance" in other words like resonance, relevance, reliance.
result.label: "enh|ance" word piece

result.description: Fires on the word " being", mainly where it introduces "being both X and Y" (a predicate adjective pair). It stays silent on " being" in passives and progressive uses like "ended up being" or "just being".
result.label: " being" before "both"

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 'es' completing "dashes" (after " dash") in text about punctuation. It stays silent on 'es' in other words like rhymes, pauses, heroes, and on a document-initial "Dash"+es.
result.label: 'es' ending "dashes"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ification"/"ifications", mainly in "certification(s)". Members detect the "cert" prefix and the "ification" piece. Weak activation on "-ing" endings after a stem such as "fund" or "prepar".
result.label: "-ification" suffix in certification

result.description: Fires on the word ' that', both as a demonstrative ("at that point", "within that system") and as a relative pronoun after a noun ("objects that hold"). Windows are mostly math or technical text, and the next token is a verb like allows or reflect.
result.label: ' that' token detector
'uit' in pursuit/circuit
result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'uit' in "pursuit" (also "circuit"), with weaker firing on ' spons' in "sponsors" and ' vend'. Members are detectors of 'uit' and ' purs'.

Fires on the suffix piece 'ability' (also 'able', 'ate') completing a word, most strongly in "permeability" after the 'perme' fragment. It stays quiet on 'ability' in suitability, availability and variability.
result.label: -ability suffix in permeability
'ost' piece in "compost"
result.description: Fires on the token piece 'ost', mainly in "comp-ost" (compost, composting) and also in AdaBoost-like splits. It needs the word-initial 'comp' context. Weakly fires on other word pieces like 'est' in "deforestation".

Fires on word-final pieces like 'ite', 'ites', 'ition' and 'ge' completing words, most strongly in "ign-" words (ignite, ignition) and "sur-ge". Weaker on other word-ending fragments such as 'emer-ges'.
result.label: Word-final suffix after ign-/sur-

result.description: Fires on words meaning breadth or extent (broader, broad, range, wide) after "a/an", where a noun like "range of" or "understanding" is expected. Weaker on "a sense", "an understanding". Members are mostly generic token fragments.
result.label: Breadth words: broader, range, wide

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'acci' in "Fibonacci", and on ' Lucas' in Lucas numbers, in text about number sequences. Weakly on 'lic' in "sliced". Members include Fibonacci and Lucas token detectors.
result.label: Fibonacci 'acci' / Lucas numbers

result.description: Fires on the word " using" (also " used"/"use") when it follows a noun phrase and introduces a method, tool or technique, mostly in craft, printing and technical process text. It is silent when " using" starts the text.
result.label: " using" introducing a method

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " conf" (as in confinement, confined), especially in plasma/fusion physics text such as "inertial conf-". Predicts word continuations like "ined" or "inement".
result.label: " conf" word-start in confinement

result.description: Fires on ' not' in the "not only"-style slot, e.g. "not carefully planned/crafted", where it starts a negated adverb or contrast phrase. It stays silent on ' not' after modals ("should not", "may not") and inside words like "notions".
result.label: ' not' starting contrast phrase
'ential' suffix in Existential
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ential', most strongly in "Existential" (quantifiers, quantification). It fires more weakly on 'ential' in words like consequential and influential. It stays silent on nearby text that lacks the piece.

Fires on the token " artists", mostly when it begins a sentence or clause as the subject (e.g. "artists created…"). It stays silent when " artists" follows a comma or "for"/"by" mid-sentence. Members are mostly generic early-layer features plus a few " artists" token detectors.
result.label: " artists" as clause subject

result.description: Fires mostly on " depth" (as in depth of field, depth maps), with weaker hits on similar nouns like execution, precision, detail after "in" or "with". Several members detect " depth" directly.
result.label: depth token (depth of field/maps)

result.description: Fires on the modal verb " can" after a subject noun or "which" in expository, technical or academic text, where a verb like "be" or another action is expected next. Silent on some "can" cases in the contrast, with no clear difference visible.
result.label: Modal "can" in expository text

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining two bare academic-subject nouns in a title or topic-list line (e.g. "Music and Religion", "Education and democracy"), right after a short single-word subject at line start. Silent on 'and' in ordinary clauses and lists.
result.label: 'and' in subject-pair headings

result.description: Fires on the piece "ca" in "circa" when used before an approximate date, after "cir" in parentheses following a civilization or period. Members mostly detect "ca" and "cir" tokens, and some ancient-history context.
result.label: "ca" in "circa" dates

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ated' completing "unsaturated" or "saturated" in chemistry text (solutions, fats). Silent on 'ated' in other words like "narrated" or "sophisticated". Logits favour solution/soil.
result.label: 'ated' in (un)saturated

result.description: Fires on commas inside a running list of parallel nouns or verbs (e.g. "color, shape, form, texture,"), where another list item is expected next. It stays quiet on commas in other constructions, such as after short lists or in clauses about algorithms.
result.label: Comma in long item lists

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings (ic, um, add, and, esses, ata) directly after the "str" prefix, as in str-um, str-addles, str-ands, str-icter, str-esses. It stays silent on "ic" after other stems like organ- or prof-.
result.label: Suffix piece after "str" prefix

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ical" in "ethical" and "logical", and on " moral", in ethics/logic contexts. It stays quiet on "ical" in "philosophical" and "ecological". Logits lean towards responsibility, safety and interests.
result.label: ethical/moral word endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' exam' at the start of "examine/examining/examination", especially in academic or analytical prose. Members are mostly ' exam' token detectors from early layers.
result.label: ' exam' in examine/examination

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (also 'ending') completing the word "Cooking", mainly in cooking class/event titles. It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs like maintaining or adopting.
result.label: 'ing' ending "Cooking" in titles

result.description: Fires on the token " beginning" in every example, mostly as a noun after "the" (the beginning of, marks the beginning). Members include detectors for beginning/start/begin/starting and stage/step words.
result.label: ' beginning' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' and' directly after the word "trust" (trust and respect/transparency), supported by trust-word detectors (worth, trusting). Stays silent on ' and' after other nouns like creativity, integration, privacy.
result.label: ' and' right after "trust"

result.description: Fires mainly on "ission" in "fission" (nuclear fission), and on words like " waste" and " daughter" in nuclear/radioactive contexts. It predicts nuclear-related nouns such as material, fragments and shell.
result.label: Nuclear fission word pieces

result.description: Fires on the 'back' piece completing the word "flashback(s)" (also "flashbacked", "flashing"), after the "flash" piece in narrative/literature text. Predicts continuations like ' flash'.
result.label: 'back' in flashback

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside "reflection"/"reflect-" words (' Ref', 'lect', 'lection') in optics text such as reflection, reflectance and reflected rays. Silent on 'lection' in a different context.
result.label: Reflection word pieces in optics

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'clar' (as in clarification, clarity, clarify), a word-start fragment that predicts suffixes like -ity or -ation. Members are detectors of similar word-start fragments (clar, lear, au, proxim, organiz).
result.label: 'clar' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word " algorithms" (rarely filters/filtering/encryption), mostly after an adjective or noun modifier like "advanced" or "traditional". It stays silent in one case where "learning algorithms" starts the text. Its output boosts " algorithms".
result.label: algorithms token

result.description: Fires on the word "show" and close variants (shows, showed, showing, Show, displayed, display), including as the start of "showcase". Predicts continuations like "case"/"cases". Members are detectors of show/display/demonstrate words.
result.label: show / display word, showcase

result.description: Fires on word pieces after the prefix "her" (her|b, her|ed, her|ac, her|edit), mainly the 'b' in "herb". Needs the "her" word-start context; silent elsewhere.
result.label: Word piece after "her-" (herb)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ess' inside words, especially the '-ness' noun suffix split as 'n'+'ess' (completeness, Agreeableness, bitterness) and also mid-word as in quintessence or Montessori. Silent on 'quintety'.
result.label: 'ess' word piece in -ness words

result.description: Fires on "moment" (and "tor" in torque) after "the" in physics contexts about torque, moment of force, or moment of inertia. It stays quiet in momentum and collision text, so it needs the rotational-mechanics sense.
result.label: Moment/torque in rotational mechanics

result.description: Fires on the word-ending pieces 'les'/'le' completing "ripples" (after 'ripp'), and weakly on similar endings like 'led' or 'es'. Members detect the 'ipp' fragment and 'led/ling' endings.
result.label: ripp-les word ending

result.description: Fires mainly on " became" and also " more" after "became", where a predicate describing a changed state follows (e.g. "became less abstract", "became popular"). Several members are detectors of the " became" token.
result.label: ' became' change-of-state verb

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces ending a technical term or name: ' units' in "processing units", 'gram' in Telegram, 'MT' (NMT, SMT, BMT), 'encies'. Mixed token set, with no clear shared context.
result.label: Units, gram, MT word endings

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens inside a longer word that is still incomplete, such as 'umb' in crumb, 'uff' in shuffling, ' gate' and ' pe'. The next piece is likely a suffix like 'les' or 'ing'. The evidence is mixed across tokens.
result.label: Mid-word fragments umb/uff/gate

result.description: Fires on the token "value" as the end of a compound or hyphenated term, such as p-value, Min_value or Original_value, in statistics and data contexts. It is silent on unrelated analysis prose.
result.label: "value" in p-value / Min_value

result.description: Fires on noun-forming suffixes -ization/-ation/-tion ending a technical term (Segmentation, Polymerization, Decolonization), mostly in scientific or technical titles. Silent on some -ization words like formalization, crystallization, visualization.
result.label: Technical -ization/-ation suffix

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' when it completes a word like "quotation" or "punctuation", mostly in text about quotation marks and punctuation. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like "narration" or "pronunciation".
result.label: 'ation' in quotation/punctuation

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uc' in "el|uc|idate/idation/idating", right after the piece 'el'. Weaker on other 'el' + fragment words like eliciting and elusive. Silent in unrelated contexts.
result.label: 'uc' in elucidate

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Kin'/' kin' at the start of kinetic/kinematic, and on ' motor' (motor neurons, motor skills). Predicts continuations like 'etic' or 'ematic' style pieces. Mostly token detectors for these pieces.
result.label: Kin- and motor word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " binding" (also " partial", " indirect", " internal") as a modifier word, e.g. "internal binding" in a linguistics passage about pronoun binding or "binding energy". Silent in a general energy/pressure passage.
result.label: "binding" and similar modifiers

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer, multi-piece words (e.g. 'ine' in labyrinthine, 'ys' in odyssey, 'pt' in tiptoeing, Arabic mid-word letters). It is not tied to one token, and it stays silent on 'ine' in 'clandestine'.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of split words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ud' in "feudal/feudalism" (and 'undred' in Hundred Years' War) in medieval-history text. It stays silent on 'ud' in other words such as Tudor.
result.label: 'ud' in feudal (medieval history)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of capitalized or title-like words, mostly ' Conf' (before "lict"), also ' Sebastian', ' Deb' (Debye), ' cogn'. It fires where a word is split and continues in the next token.
result.label: Conf word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' where' introducing a relative clause after a noun or after "is" (e.g. "is where", "a world where"). It stays quiet in text without this word. Earlier-layer ' where' detectors drive it.
result.label: relative clause ' where'

result.description: Fires on the first word piece (e.g. ' auth' of 'authentically', 'pre', 'nu') right after 'more', where a comparative adverb or adjective is being started. Members detect 'more' and push ' than' or '-ly' endings.
result.label: Word start after 'more'

result.description: Fires on the preposition ' at' (at rest, at the party, at an event, at high resolution), mostly after a noun or verb. Members are mainly layer-0 ' at' detectors. Predicts continuations like ' least'. Contrast evidence is thin.
result.label: preposition ' at'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' retre' (as in "retreat", e.g. glacial retreat), expecting a following suffix piece like "at". Weak activation on "accordingly" and "separation". Members detect ' retre' and glacier-related tokens.
result.label: ' retre' word-start (retreat)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'par' at the start of a word, as in parable, paration, parency. It is weaker when 'par' sits inside 'transparency'. Early-layer 'par' token detectors drive it.
result.label: 'par' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces 'ic', 'atic', 'es' completing a word, most strongly 'ic' in "Strategic" at the start of a heading/title. Silent on 'ic' in "symbolic" or "attic". Logits are not informative.
result.label: Suffix 'ic'/'es' in Strategic

result.description: Fires on the token 'ets' when it stands alone as a word-initial fragment at the start of a document or passage (e.g. "ets explored", "ets rely on"). It stays silent when 'ets' ends a word such as poets, rockets or markets.
result.label: Standalone 'ets' at text start

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rupt' in "disrupt", "disruptive", "disrupting", "disruptors". Early-layer detectors of 'rupt' drive it. It predicts suffix continuations such as -ive, -ion and -s.
result.label: 'rupt' in disrupt- words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'pus', mainly in 'corpus' (e.g. "corpus-based", "language corpus"), and weakly on ' heap'. The members are mostly 'pus' detectors from early layers.
result.label: 'pus' in corpus

result.description: Fires on the word " reference" (also "frames", " point") as a modifier or noun, as in "reference frames", "pronoun reference", "vertical reference". Members mostly detect the token "reference" itself. Predicts reference-related continuations.
result.label: "reference" word detector

result.description: Fires on the adjective " appropriate" (also " relevant", " immediate") when it comes before a noun or complement, as in "select appropriate instruments". Members are early-layer detectors of appropriate/suitable/proper-type adjectives.
result.label: ' appropriate' adjective detector
'ming' in "farming"
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ming' completing "farming", mostly in agriculture text (industrial farming, farming practices). Weaker on "far" followed by other endings (farmers, far from). Silent on other agricultural text without that word.

result.label: 'ye' piece in dye
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ye' in "dye" (dyeing, tie-dye, dye options), mostly textile/dyeing text. Members are 'ye' detectors in early layers. Weak activation on a few unrelated word pieces like 'ation' and 'low'.

Fires on the word " figures" (and " figure"), especially in repeated runs of the word and in the sense of notable people or shapes. Mostly driven by token detectors for "figure(s)"; weaker on "important figure".
result.label: " figures" token detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings 'ating' (he-ating, m-ating) and 'othing' (cl-othing), plus occasional 'its'/'ise'. Silent on 'ating' in communicating/incorporating, so it needs particular word stems like heating, mating, clothing.
result.label: 'ating'/'othing' endings in heating, clothing

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('ific', 'al', 'pon') after 'Sign' or similar word starts, such as Significance, Signal and Eponym, and on ' Major'. Members detect 'Sign' and 'ific' pieces. It pushes toward word continuations.
result.label: Sign-ific/Sign-al word continuation pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " scenes" (also " scene"), mostly in writing-craft or storytelling text. It boosts the same word as the next token. Upstream members are detectors of scene/scenes tokens.
result.label: scenes token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing "fixation" in "carbon fixation" (photosynthesis text). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like alteration, sequestration, regeneration, mutation.
result.label: 'ation' in carbon fixation

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings like 'th' in ordinal centuries (15th to), 'ree' in 'degree', and ' centuries'. Silent on some 'th' before 'century' (17th century), so it seems to need a particular ordinal/range slot. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Ordinal 'th' and 'degree' endings

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (ments, ary, ed, ing, ation) completing the word "complement" (complements, complementary, complemented), and weakly on the word " complement" itself. Needs the word-start "comple-" or "complement" stem.
result.label: Suffix of "complement" words

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start fragments ' orch', ' tail', ' res' (and similar) that need a continuation like -estra, -ored, -ilience. Mostly a handful of specific word pieces, mid-word.
result.label: Word-start fragments orch/tail/res

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' inside long numbers with repeated zeros, such as 1,000,000 or 0.00010. It stays silent on '0' in years like 1990s or 20th, or after a plus sign.
result.label: Zero in long zero strings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ney" completing "kidney" (kid|ney), as in kidney disease, function or stones. Members include detectors of the " kid" piece that precede it.
result.label: "ney" in "kidney"

result.description: Fires on capitalized word-start pieces such as ' Per' (in Perfect), ' Sub', ' Memory', ' Vol' in title-like list or heading text, often right after a heading or line break; predicts continuations like ' Sub', ' perf'.
result.label: Capitalized heading-initial word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ne" ending "-borne" (waterborne, vector-borne, food-borne), after "bor". Weaker on other word fragments like "Stir|ling". Early-layer token detectors for "ne" feed it.
result.label: "ne" in "-borne" compounds

result.description: Fires on the token 'x' as a function argument variable in calculus or math text, such as u(x), f(x), g(x). It stays silent in chemistry formula text. Weak activity appears on 'x' inside words like Netflix and paradox.
result.label: 'x' as function variable

result.description: Fires on indefinite pronoun/object words like "anything", "something", "things" and "what" after verbs or prepositions, where a modifier like "else" or "specific" may follow. Also fires weakly on stray tokens such as dash runs and word endings.
result.label: Indefinite pronouns: anything/something/things

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'acc' inside 'vaccine(s)/vaccination', right after 'v'. Members are mostly 'acc' detectors from early layers, plus a few 'v'-prefix piece detectors. Weak activity on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'acc' piece in vaccine

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces 'aments' (in fil-aments) and 'osis' (in diagn-osis, cytosis), also 'ament' in fund-ament-als. It needs the preceding word fragment, completing a multi-token word.
result.label: Suffix pieces -aments / -osis

result.description: Fires on the word piece "itive" ending words like "competitive", "cognitive", "transitive". Strongest at the start of a text window where the word is split; weaker after "cogn". Quiet on other tokens.
result.label: "itive" suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the token right after a form of "make/making" (makeup, make it, make informed, make decisions), the slot after the verb. It pushes towards objects or complements like decisions, choices, easier. Silent on "dec" after "and".
result.label: Token following "make/making"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " rever" at the start of "reverberation" (acoustics text), before the continuation "ber". Weak activation on a couple of unrelated tokens. Members include detectors of rever and "ber".
result.label: rever- of reverberation

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces like -aging, -ives, -ful, -ces ending adjectives or verbs (engaging, inclusive, thoughtful, provokes) in abstract essay text about literature, society and discussion. Silent on a similar analytic sentence without such word endings.
result.label: Suffix pieces in literary-essay prose

result.description: Fires on word pieces following "chord" (progress, types, -lets, pro-gression) in music/chord-theory text, i.e. the continuation slot after a chord noun. Also weakly on "ord" + pro. Predicts continuation like "-ions".
result.label: Chord progression/types continuation piece

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "patient" (hyphen in "patient-centered", " out" in "patient outcomes", " care"), in healthcare text. It stays silent on hyphens after other words like "high-", "AI-", "decision-".
result.label: Token following "patient"

result.description: Fires on ' management' (also 'Management') when it follows a modifier noun naming the thing managed, as in "waste management", "fault management", "memory management". Silent on other headings like "Public…". Predicts words like strategies and practices.
result.label: management after a modifier noun

result.description: Fires on a word piece (for, cert, break, fe) right after the prefix "un" inside un- words like uncertainties, unforeseen, unbreakable. It predicts a suffix such as "atable" or "able". It stays quiet on the same pieces without the un- prefix.
result.label: Word piece after un- prefix

result.description: Fires on " analysis" when it ends a compound method name, like "discourse analysis", "SWOT analysis" or "cost-effectiveness analysis". It stays quiet when " analysis" starts the text or follows "qualitative".
result.label: ' analysis' after a method name

result.description: Fires on the word ' complex' (adjective, as in complex systems, complex variable, complex plane) in mathematical or technical text. Members include complex-token detectors and 'intricate' pieces, plus math-term context.
result.label: ' complex' in math/technical text

result.description: Fires on the token " Art" (also " art") at the start of a word or heading, such as "Gothic Art" or "Artistic ...", where it is often the first piece of "Artistic" or "Artists". Stays quiet on other subjects such as Music headings.
result.label: " Art" token

result.description: Fires on word pieces such as ' mole', 'ole', 'ys', ' mob' that start or sit inside longer words (molecular, Sobolev, polysemy, geophysics), where the word is still incomplete. Mixed pieces, so the evidence is only partly consistent.
result.label: Mid-word fragments mole/ole/ys

result.description: Fires on the word " case" when it follows a modifier and names a kind or instance of case (recursive case, next case, grammatical case, best case). It stays silent when " case" begins the text or a sentence ("Case illustrates...").
result.label: ' case' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on ' online' and ' electronic' as modifiers in digital/commerce/advertising text (online delivery, electronic banking). Members detect online, digital, media and marketing words. Quiet on e-commerce contrast text.
result.label: online / electronic modifier

result.description: Fires on the token ' virtue', mostly in virtue ethics and moral-philosophy text, including repeated or garbled occurrences. Weak firing on ' role' after 'key/crucial'. Members are virtue-token detectors plus philosophy context.
result.label: ' virtue' token in ethics text

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: Cyrillic 'н' inside words, ' NAT' in lists of NAT types (Static/Dynamic NAT), 'YS' in a name, ' Linked'. Peaks are scattered, so it looks like a polysemantic latent with weak coherence.
result.label: Mixed: Cyrillic н, NAT types

result.description: Fires on contrastive conjunctions " yet" and " but" (also " while") linking two adjectives or clauses, as in "humorous yet poignant" or "smaller but more". Also fires on "but" as a piece of "butter". Silent elsewhere.
result.label: Contrastive 'yet' / 'but' conjunction

result.description: Fires on ' Hall' in "Quantum Hall" (Effect/States) in physics topic lists, and occasionally on 'd' in "Coupled Plasma". It stays silent on "the Hall conductance" in running prose.
result.label: Quantum Hall ' Hall' token

result.description: Fires on time/aspect-related words like " perfect" (especially in "past perfect", "present perfect"), also " finished", " next", " last". Strongest in grammar-tense discussion; the circuit relies on " perfect" and " past" detectors.
result.label: Tense word 'perfect' after past

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'edy' in "Greedy" and 'clusion' in "Inclusion-Exclusion", in algorithm and math/CS text. Mostly two specific word-piece endings, with weak firing on "-atic" in "democratic".
result.label: Greedy / Inclusion-Exclusion word endings

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "pop" in music-genre text (pop culture, pop-pop, pop and, popcorn), peaking on " culture". It stays silent on " culture" in general cultural or social contexts.
result.label: Token following "pop" (pop culture)

result.description: Fires on "has"/"have" as auxiliary right after a singular technology-like subject noun (e.g. "technology has", "CRISPR-Cas9 has"), predicting "been", "also", "seen". Silent on the contrast text, which lacks that construction.
result.label: "has/have" after technology subject

result.description: Fires on the '-ulat-' suffix piece (ulation, ulating, ulate) in "regulate" and "manipulate" words, i.e. controlling or adjusting something. Silent on 'ulation' in "insulation" and "accumulation".
result.label: -ulate in regulate/manipulate

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' comp' when it follows a modifier and starts "compounds" (phenolic, hyphenated, closed, ionic compounds). Silent when ' comp' begins the text with no preceding word. Predicts 'ounds'.
result.label: ' comp' starting 'compounds'

result.description: Fires on the word pieces of "pirate" (' pir', 'ate', 'ates', 'ater'), mainly at the start of the word. Top members are detectors of ' pir'. Logits favour pil/voyage/captain.
result.label: pirate word pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ass' inside a word, most strongly in "brass" (instruments), and more weakly in "encompass" or "unassuming". It needs the preceding word piece, such as "br".
result.label: 'ass' piece in "brass"

result.description: Fires mostly on " not" after a copula ("is not just", "has not just"), anticipating "just/only/merely"; also on "like" and "just" in similar slots. Silent on some " not" cases, so the exact needed context is unclear.
result.label: "not" before "just/only" construction
' routing' in networking text
result.description: Fires mostly on " routing" in networking contexts (routing protocols/algorithms), with a few other rare pieces like "ppet" in Puppet and " Tang". Members are token detectors for routing, routes and rou-.

Fires on single letters inside hyphen-separated spelled-out sequences (e.g. 'F-r-r-r-r', 'e-n-d-o-l'), where letters are spelled one by one. Not silent-letter 'a' in normal prose; the contrast shows 'a' after a dash in a normal sentence stays quiet.
result.label: Letters in hyphen-spelled sequences

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'os' in porosity, 'ular' in granular, 'od' in aerodynamics, in materials/soil/physical-science words. Silent on 'os' in erosion or cryosphere, so it needs particular words.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in porosity/granular

result.description: Fires on the piece 'hed' inside "tetrahedron/tetrahedral" and on the word ' critical' (critical thinking, critical points). Two unrelated tokens; the 'hed' case is driven by tetra- detector members.
result.label: 'hed' in tetrahedra, and ' critical'

result.description: Fires on the capital letter 'O' as a standalone token, most strongly in Big-O notation like "linear (O(n))". Weaker on 'O' in O(n) group notation, list markers, and inside uppercase words. Members are 'O' token detectors.
result.label: Letter O token (Big-O notation)

result.description: Fires mostly on the verb " appreciate", with weaker firing on a few other verbs like " win", " enjoy" and " honor". It also fires on stray Arabic letters and repeated "\,". Members are mainly detectors of "appreciate" and "appreci-".
result.label: " appreciate" verb detector

result.description: Fires on word endings or pieces such as 'ing', 'ams', 'ability' and on ' predict', mostly in predict-related words (predicting, predictability) and in technical or scientific text. It is silent on many other 'ing' endings.
result.label: predict- word pieces, technical text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' continu' (continuity, continuously) at the start of a document or passage-initial position. It stays silent on the same token in mid-sentence math lists such as "convergence, boundary, and continuity".
result.label: ' continu' word piece

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word pieces and names (' III', 'dan', 'hol', ' Andy', 'nehmen', 'John') with no common token or context. Members are mostly layer-0 token detectors, many Arabic pieces. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments, unclear

result.description: Fires on the standalone word 'and', especially when it is mentioned or listed as a conjunction (e.g. 'and', 'or', 'but' in discussions of grammar or logic). Silent on 'and' inside words like 'shorthand'.
result.label: Standalone 'and' as conjunction

result.description: Fires on nouns like "validation", "data", "operations", "execution" that follow a data/computing modifier in software and data-processing text (e.g. "robust data validation rules"). It predicts process-type nouns such as streams, checks and quality.
result.label: Data-processing noun after computing modifier

result.description: Fires on ' codes'/' code' (error-correcting, computer codes) and on the piece 'ar' in 'Stellar'. Mostly a token-detector mix of 'code(s)' and word-piece 'ar', with weaker firing on 'mar' in maritime.
result.label: 'codes' and 'ar' word pieces
Surname fragments Bo / Otto (Boer, Bohr)
result.description: Fires on word pieces of proper names like ' Bo' (Boer, Bohr), ' Ott'/' Otto' (Otto cycle), and sometimes ' Vietnam'. Peaks are mixed, with the strongest on Otto-cycle text; the Bo members are discriminative.

Fires mostly on the token " mill" (mill, miller, milling, grinding mill) and occasionally on other word-start fragments like " cou" in "coulometry" or "att". Mostly a detector of " mill" as a word piece, with some weaker word-fragment hits.
result.label: ' mill' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' invest' (investing, investment, investor) in finance text. It is mostly silent when ' invest' starts a document or sentence, and members are mostly ' invest' token detectors.
result.label: ' invest' word piece in finance

result.description: Fires on the word " through" in all its uses: passing through a medium, spanning a range ("Europe through Labor Day"), or means ("insight through practice"). Members are mostly " through" detectors. The contrast gives no clear extra condition.
result.label: ' through' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb " finds" (also "find", "drawn"), mostly with a singular subject like "mind", "sector" or "it", often in the idiom "finds its way/home/place". Members are detectors of find/finding/findings tokens.
result.label: verb "finds" detector
Hyphen in proper-name compounds
result.description: Fires on the hyphen inside a proper-name compound, such as Tully-Fisher or Al-Khwarizmi, where a second name part comes next. It stays silent on hyphens in ordinary compounds such as half-reactions, then-pioneered or internet-driven.

Fires on the token ' person' in literary-analysis text, including as a word start in personify/personality and in 'third person'. Members are mostly ' person' token detectors. The contrast text has no ' person' token.
result.label: ' person' token in literary text

result.description: Fires on the suffix -ization/-ized/-izing, most strongly in "democratization", and weakly on "-crat" word pieces. It stays silent on -ized in "revolutionized" and "standardized", so it needs the democrat- stem.
result.label: -ization suffix after "democrat"

result.description: Fires on the piece right after "break" (break-up hyphen, "w" in breakwater, "break" in breakers, "down" in break down), i.e. the continuation of a break- compound. Silent on hyphens after other words like real-, mid-, data-.
result.label: Continuation after "break" compounds
Labyrinth 'inth' and ' tap' pieces
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'inth' in "labyrinth" and on ' tap' (tap dance, taproot). It also fires weakly on 'riddle' and 'ze' (maze). Members are detectors of those specific tokens.

result.label: Mid-word piece 'ult' in cultural
result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens inside longer academic words, mostly 'ult' in "socio-cultural"/"cross-cultural", also 'Class' in "Neoclassicism" and 'list' in "stylistic". It predicts a suffix continuation such as "ural" or "ic".

Fires on the word " what" introducing a free-relative or embedded clause ("what we say", "what resonates", "between what..."). Weaker on sentence-initial "What". Members detect " what" and " how" tokens.
result.label: ' what' in embedded clauses
Word-initial fragments ' lad', ' neg', 'yr'
result.description: Fires on word-start pieces that begin a longer word, mainly ' lad' (ladles, ladder), ' neg' (negator, negation) and 'yr'. The next piece is expected to complete the word. Weak activity on a few verbs such as complement and differ.

Fires on ' of' after a quantity or operation noun (volume, sum, calculation, manipulation) in technical or mathematical text, where a measured thing follows. Silent on ' of' after nouns like means, type, or appreciation.
result.label: ' of' after quantity/operation nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mi' when it begins "mixtures" (also "mixture"), and on ' chamber' after "combustion", in chemistry/engine text. Predicts continuations like 'xt'/'es'. Weaker on 'ib'/'ub' pieces.
result.label: 'mi' of mixtures; combustion chamber

result.description: Fires on the token ' energy' (rarely ' effect') when it begins a noun phrase or clause, as in 'energy carriers' or 'energy level'. It stays silent when 'energy' follows a verb or preposition, as in 'stores energy', 'form of energy' or 'govern energy'.
result.label: ' energy' at phrase start

result.description: Fires on ' shortcut' (especially "cognitive shortcut") and on the ' pr' piece starting "pricing" (psychological/penetration pricing). Weak elsewhere. Mostly detects these two tokens in explanatory text; the contrast shows no clear extra condition.
result.label: shortcut and pr(icing) tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' members' as a plural noun for people belonging to a group (all members, team members, crew members), mostly in inclusion or teamwork text. Members are mostly detectors of 'member(s)'.
result.label: ' members' group-membership noun
' text' as start of textile/texture
result.description: Fires on the token ' text' (or ' Text') when it is the first piece of a longer word such as textures or textiles. It pushes the next token towards 'ile', 'ures', 'ual' and 'ured'. It stays silent on unrelated text.
Fires on the token piece "ps" inside "ellipses/ellipsoids" (also DevOps, bps), after "elli". Members are "ps" detectors plus an "elli" detector. Weak activations on other word endings.
result.label: "ps" in ellipses/ellipsoids

result.description: Fires on the word piece "rel" inside words such as squirrel, non-relational, correlation and unrelenting. It is a detector of that token fragment, and the members are mostly "rel" detectors.
result.label: "rel" word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' on', 'ers', ' of', ' for', ' organizations') that follow 'care' or a head noun/verb expecting a complement, e.g. "depend on", "care of", "careers". Silent on many other ' on' cases such as "emphasis on". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Tokens after 'care' / depend-on

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' dep' (in depreciation, depicted) and 'pre' (in Comprehension), where the word continues in later pieces. Mostly the ' dep' piece before 'reciation'.
result.label: dep/pre word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece "vir" at the start of or inside virus-related words (viruses, retrovirus, Herpesviridae, viral), predicting continuations like "al", "uses". It also weakly fires on "vir" in other words such as environmental.
result.label: "vir" word piece (virus words)

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like 'gs', 'sections', 'ances', 'ves' that complete a plural noun after a word stem (dru|gs, inter|sections, appli|ances). Members detect the stems and the 'gs'/'sections' pieces.
result.label: Plural word-ending fragments after stems

result.description: Fires mostly on the plural noun " awards", especially after "literary" or "many". It also fires weakly on some word-start fragments such as "aph" and " h". Members are mainly token detectors for "awards" plus assorted word pieces.
result.label: ' awards' token detector

result.description: Fires on the indefinite pronouns " others" and " another" (also "other"), mainly in contrastive "while others..." or "another form/way" constructions. Members are detectors of these tokens. Logits are not informative.
result.label: "others" / "another" pronoun

result.description: Fires on "concerned" and related words (concern, concerns, "concerned about/with"), the notion of worry or subject-matter concern. Weaker on "safety concerns" or "environmental concerns". Mostly detector members for "concerned" and similar tokens.
result.label: concerned / concern word family

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' ins' (as in insights, insulators) when it starts a word with a space before it. It stays silent when ' ins' follows a word like "uncover", "gathering" or "new" plus "ights", so it needs a standalone word start.
result.label: word-initial ' ins' token

result.description: Fires on the particle after "stand" (stand out, standout, stand-up, stand up), i.e. the word right after a form of "stand". Silent on "out" after other verbs like try, map or even.
result.label: particle after "stand" (stand out)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " opera" (and "ardo" in Leonardo, rarely "chestra"), in text about the arts and opera. Members are mostly layer-0 detectors of " opera" plus art, music and literature tokens.
result.label: opera word (and Leonardo)

result.description: Fires mainly on "win" completing "Darwin" (after "Dar"), and on "Herbert" in "George Herbert Mead"; weaker on game/games. It needs the name-completion context, since a bare "win" at text start stays silent.
result.label: Darwin 'win' / George Herbert name piece

result.description: Fires on the word " stars" (also " Stars") in astronomy text, especially after adjectives like young, metal-rich, or higher-mass. Members include star and stellar detectors. It is silent on astronomy text that lacks the word.
result.label: Word 'stars' in astronomy text

result.description: Fires on plural suffix pieces ('es', 'its', 'ures', 'ons') completing a split plural noun such as hero|es, hab|its, fo|es. Silent on 'es' in other words (themes, guesses, edifices), so it depends on the particular word.
result.label: Plural ending after split noun

result.description: Fires on the piece 'isms' completing the word "mechanisms" after "Mechan"/"mechan". It stays silent when 'isms' appears without the preceding "mechan" piece. Members detect 'mechan' plus 'isms'.
result.label: 'isms' in "mechanisms"

result.description: Fires on words after cultural/religious/ancient modifiers (ancestral, religious, spiritual, Mayan), often the start of a word like "trad-itions", "rit-ual", "cer-emonies". Appears in cultural heritage and ancient-civilization text.
result.label: Cultural tradition and ritual word starts

result.description: Fires mostly on 'laration' in "Universal Declaration of Human Rights" and similar Declaration titles, plus weaker on 'International' or 'Code' in formal institutional/document names. Members are mostly generic word-piece detectors.
result.label: Declaration of Human Rights 'laration'

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments, mainly ' h', 'at', ' am', ' tong', where a longer word is being spelled out in pieces (h|ug, am|ines, sp|at|ulas). It predicts continuation pieces of the word.
result.label: Incomplete word fragments, ' h' and 'at'

result.description: Fires on forms of the verb "make" (make, made, making, makes), including "made from", "make up", and "making" as a participle. Members are mostly detectors of these verb forms. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Forms of the verb "make"

result.description: Fires on the token " language" as a modifier or noun in sociolinguistic and language-policy text (e.g. "shape language practices", "formal language standards"). It is silent in machine-translation and NLP text. Logits favor " policy" as next token.
result.label: ' language' in language-policy text
Mid-word suffix pieces in names/terms
result.description: Fires on word-piece endings or fragments such as 'ative' in "commutative", 'ak' in "Guru Nanak", ' Ang' in "Guru Angad", and ' S' in Sanskrit. It is silent on 'ative' in "innovative" and "figurative". The evidence is mixed.

Fires on the suffix 'ing' (or 's') right after the verb 'maintain' (maintaining/maintains), predicting words like integrity, consistency, symmetry. Silent on 'ing' after other verbs such as paying or expressing.
result.label: suffix after 'maintain'

result.description: Fires on the "er" piece completing the word "laser" (las|er), predicting laser-related continuations like beam, cutting, guns. It stays silent on "er" in other words such as "polymer".
result.label: "er" ending "laser"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' mill', ' pip', ' Bron', ' jug' that begin longer words (miller, pipelining, millennia, Bronze). Mostly the ' mill' piece, plus a few other incomplete word starts. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-start pieces: mill, pip, Bron

result.description: Fires on pieces of "discipline/interdisciplinary" (inary, ines, ine, cipl) and on "study"/"field of study" in academic-field descriptions. Predicts next tokens like science, discipline, studies, focus.
result.label: Interdisciplinary / academic discipline words

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al' (also 'ing') completing the word "disposal"/"disposing", mostly in waste-management text. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as "accidental" or a bare "al".
result.label: Suffix 'al' in "disposal"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' combin' (as in combinatorial/combinatorics) in math text, and weakly on pieces like 'ination' and 'in' inside words such as determinants or determination. Needs the mid-word position before the rest of the word.
result.label: combin- word piece in math

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings such as "ishing" in "distinguishing" (also "ate", "ling/lings" in "sibling"), mostly where the word precedes "between". The peak tokens are mixed, so this is a loose set of suffix pieces.
result.label: distinguishing / sibling suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the continuation piece after the word-start "Am" (Am|id in "Amidst", Am|end in "Amendment", Am|ides, Am|bro-se). Silent on "idst" without the preceding "Am".
result.label: Piece after "Am" (Amidst, Amendment)

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ists' (also 'ist') when it completes the word "twists", mostly in "plot twists". Members detect the "tw" + "ist" pieces and narrative/plot context. It is silent on narrative text lacking the word.
result.label: "twists" word ending (plot twists)

result.description: Fires on the word-final piece 'os' at the end of a word like "ratios" or "pathos", in lists of terms (financial ratios, rhetorical modes). Silent on 'os' in "logos" at the start of a text and in some names.
result.label: word-final 'os' (ratios, pathos)

result.description: Fires on nouns like security, response, vulnerability, detection, recovery in incident/risk-management and cybersecurity discussion. It stays silent on "security" in "To perform security audits", so it seems to need an incident-handling or risk framing, and it predicts words like prepared, risk, assess.
result.label: Incident response and security terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' neg' (negating, negation, negatives, negotiation), and weakly on ' preced' (precede) and ' auxili'. Strongest in logic/grammar text about negation. Members are mostly ' neg' token detectors.
result.label: ' neg' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires mostly on " initial" (e.g. "initial conditions", "initial stage") in technical or scientific text. It also fires weakly on word pieces like "ynamic" in aerodynamic and thermodynamic, and on "numerical" and "sudden".
result.label: " initial" in technical text

result.description: Fires on the 'ical' piece completing "ethical" (also ' eth' and 'ics' in ethics), predicting moral/responsibility words. Silent on 'ical' in other words like biomedical or philosophical.
result.label: 'ical' in "ethical"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' intr' (before "icate"/"iguing"), 'gra' (Sgraffito) and ' avant', predicting the word's continuation. Mostly in art and intricate-design text; silent on ' intr' at document start.
result.label: Word-start fragments intr/gra/avant

result.description: Fires on the word " system" (and " System"), especially as a head noun or modifier like "system call" or "system boundaries". Members are mostly detectors of " system"/" systems". Silent on the plural "systems" in the contrast text. Boosts "atic"/"atically" as next tokens.
result.label: ' system' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' norm' (norm, norms, normative, normations), both in math contexts and as the start of words like 'normative'. Early-layer ' norm' detectors dominate. It stays silent on unrelated math text without that token.
result.label: ' norm' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' real' as the start of a longer word or compound, such as realistic, real-time, real-life or realm. It is mostly driven by detectors of ' real' itself, and the strongest examples are in simulation and VR text.
result.label: ' real' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like 'cal' and 'abor' (as in "Collaboration"), usually at the start of a document or title. It is silent on 'cal' inside words such as "de-escalation" and "intercalary". Members detect 'cal', 'bin' and ' Coll' pieces.
result.label: Word-initial 'cal' / 'abor' fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' calculus', as in "integral calculus", "differential calculus" or "theorem of calculus". It is driven by early-layer detectors of ' calculus' plus math-term members such as equation and function. It is silent on generic technical text.
result.label: ' calculus' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' stra' when it begins "strain" (normal strain, shear strain, head strain), after a preceding word. Early-layer members detect the ' stra' token itself. Predicts "in" continuations weakly.
result.label: ' stra' as start of "strain"

result.description: Fires on the word after a comparative "more"/"less"/"too" (e.g. "more about", "less so", "more than", "too much"), where a comparison continues. Silent on "about" after verbs or nouns like "thinking about".
result.label: Word after comparative more/less
