result.description: Fires on the token " watching", most strongly in "like watching TV/a baker" comparisons. It also fires more weakly on "watching closely" and "involves watching". Members include watching/watch token detectors.
result.label: ' watching' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " trade" (the noun, as in trade barriers, trade policy, balance of trade) in economics and policy text. It is silent when " trade" starts the text with no preceding context.
result.label: Word "trade" in economic text

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces in engineering/materials text, mostly "weight" in "lightweight", also "bine" in turbine and "el" in diesel. Predicts fuel/engine-related continuations. Silent on general materials text without these words.
result.label: lightweight / turbine word endings

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix 'ism' ending "journalism" (also on ' reach' in "within reach"/"to reach"). Silent on other media-communication text, so it needs the word-final piece of a specific word.
result.label: 'ism' in journalism, and 'reach'

result.description: Fires on the word " step" (and " steps") in contexts like "first step", "half step, whole step" and "step-by-step". Upstream members mostly detect the token " step" itself. Predicts continuations like toward/away.
result.label: Token ' step'

result.description: Fires on mid-name word pieces in proper names, mainly 'ulk' in Ford-Fulkerson and ' Kil' in Jack Kilby, where a suffix like 'er'/'ers' is expected next. Members detect 'Ford' and 'Kil' tokens.
result.label: Name fragment before suffix (Fulkerson, Kilby)

result.description: Fires on function words (" the", " in", " through", " of") that follow a verb or adjective like "instrumental", "demonstrated", "established", in academic or historical prose, where a noun phrase comes next. Silent on many other " the" tokens.
result.label: Function words after instrumental/established

result.description: Fires on a standalone space token ' ' that is followed by a digit, such as in number lists, before a day-of-month, or before a number like "3D". It predicts '1', '2' or 'August'. It stays silent on spaces before year digits like 196/195.
result.label: Space token before digits
'lement' in entanglement
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lement' completing "entanglement" (occasionally 'ang' in "entangled"). Members detect 'lement'/'ang' pieces and quantum-related tokens; it stays silent elsewhere.

Fires on the words " difficulty" and " difficulties" (and weakly on near-synonyms like challenges or struggle), typically as a noun in technical or expository text. It is built from earlier detectors of those words, and the output favors " in" next.
result.label: difficulty / difficulties noun

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'la' and 'in' inside multi-piece words, especially Maclaurin (Mac-la-urin, Maclaur-in) and similar split words like troponin or myosin. Members detect 'la' and 'in' pieces.
result.label: Word-piece 'la'/'in' in Maclaurin

result.description: Fires on the token " visibility" in all its uses (network visibility, improved visibility, sponsor visibility). Weak activation on " manifest". Members include a visibility token detector plus many unrelated word-piece detectors.
result.label: ' visibility' token

result.description: Fires on a few specific word starts, mainly " Mathemat" (before "ical"), " parent" (parent-child nodes), " leaf", and " botan". These are word pieces that usually continue into a suffix like "-ical" or a compound. Peaks are mixed and low-consistency.
result.label: Mathemat / parent / leaf word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ot' ending "knot" (also in "Robot"), and weakly on other mid-word pieces like 'hal', 'ical', 'ont'. Strongest in knot theory text. Logits are mixed and unclear.
result.label: 'ot' in knot / robot

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ibly' in "incredibly" (as in "incredibly important/challenging"), before an adjective. Members are 'ibly' detectors plus adverb-suffix detectors.
result.label: 'ibly' in incredibly

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (also 'is') when it completes the word stem 'prov' (proving, provisional). Other 'ing' endings after different stems, like furthering or highlighting, stay silent.
result.label: 'ing' after 'prov' stem

result.description: Fires on the noun ' shift' (a change or transition, as in paradigm shift, Compton shift, significant shift), across topics. Members detect ' shift' and related words like changes, move and pivot.
result.label: noun ' shift' (change)

result.description: Fires on the adjective " deeper" (occasionally " underlying" or " detailed") when it modifies an abstract noun like meaning, connections or understanding, or follows verbs like delve or reveal. Members detect "deep"/"deeper" and comparatives.
result.label: "deeper" before abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Fund' (and less on ' ess') when it begins a longer word like "Fundamentals"/"Fundamental", mostly in titles and headings. It is silent on the whole word "foundation". Predicts suffixes like 'al'.
result.label: Fund- start of "Fundamental(s)"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lor' inside "chlor-" words (chlorophyll, chloroplast, chlorochlorella, polyvinyl chloride). Members are mostly 'lor' detectors, with some biology word-piece context.
result.label: 'lor' in chlor- words

result.description: Fires on the word " pitch", mostly in the sense of sound or voice frequency (e.g. "higher pitch"). It is weaker for the sales-pitch sense. It is driven by upstream detectors of the " pitch" token.
result.label: ' pitch' token (sound frequency)

result.description: Fires on the final 'ity' piece of "relativity", especially in "theory of relativity" and "general relativity". It stays silent on 'ity' ending other words such as simultaneity or Parity.
result.label: 'ity' in "relativity"

result.description: Fires mostly on the document-start token, and on 'ium' in words like Medium and premium. It stays silent on mid-text paragraph-break tokens, so it needs a true document start. The circuit is weak and mixed.
result.label: Document-start token, 'ium' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " commerce" (e.g. "mobile commerce", "international commerce"), mostly after a modifier. Members include commerce token detectors plus trade, sector and marketing-word features.
result.label: ' commerce' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-ending piece 'mic' in "logarithmic" (also "arithmic"), and occasionally on similar endings like 'ms' or 'm'. It needs the preceding 'logarith'/'arith' fragment, so it is a within-word suffix detector in math text.
result.label: 'mic' suffix in logarithmic

result.description: Fires on the final surname token of a famous person's name in a list of names, mainly " Smith" after Adam and "ick" in Crick. It predicts further surnames. It is silent on other names in similar lists.
result.label: Surname ending in famous-name lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'apt' inside "synaptic" (syn-apt-ic), as in synaptic cleft or vesicles. It is silent when 'apt' starts a document with no 'syn' before it.
result.label: 'apt' in synaptic

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'istic' (also 'ism', 'etic') when it completes "Art" at the start of a heading like "Artistic Techniques". Members are art-related word-start detectors. Silent when 'istic' appears alone without the art stem.
result.label: Artistic/aesthetic suffix after art stem

result.description: Fires on the word "sound" / "Sound" across senses: acoustics, soundproofing, audio topics, and the adjective meaning valid or sensible. Members are mostly detectors of "sound" plus audio and music words.
result.label: Word "sound" (all senses)

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens after a "re" or similar prefix inside a longer word, mostly "do" in "redox" and "reg" in "segregation/regulated". Weaker on pieces like "egu" in "safeguarding" and "idel" in "guidelines".
result.label: Mid-word fragment 'do' in redox

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "cription" in "transcription" and on "double"/" Double", with weaker hits on a few unrelated tokens. Members are detectors of "cription" and "double".
result.label: "cription" and "double" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Quant' (also ' Man', ' Un') at the start of a list item, especially a new line in a list of "Quantum ..." topic headings. Predicts a continuation like "um".
result.label: Quant at list-item start

result.description: Fires on the token " processes" (plural noun), mostly after a modifier like manufacturing, production, natural or cognitive. Members include detectors for "process(es)" plus workflow and manufacturing-themed context members.
result.label: ' processes' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word ' contract' (noun, as in contract law, implied contracts), at the token itself. Members are mostly ' contract' token detectors plus legal/financial context. Weak firing on ' interact'. Silent on unrelated political-philosophy text.
result.label: ' contract' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word pieces after "vis" that complete "viscosity"/"viscous" (cos, c, cer, con), i.e. the continuation piece in vis-c words. Stays silent on general fluid text without this word-piece.
result.label: Word pieces completing "viscosity"

result.description: Fires on the word-ending piece 'iders' completing words such as "colliders" and "providers". It follows the stem pieces (coll-, prov-). Members detect 'iders'/'ider' and related stems.
result.label: 'iders' suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' util' at the start of "utilitarian", "utilizing" and "utilize". It is driven by members that detect ' util' itself, plus a few detectors for related words such as leverage, employ and usage. It predicts continuations like 'itar' and 'ize'.
result.label: ' util' word-start (utilize/utilitarian)

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: mostly " evil" after "of" in abstract discussion, plus "ther" in "music therapy" and a few others like "hosts" and " satisfaction". No single shared trigger is clear.
result.label: ' evil' and 'ther' mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the word " behind" when it follows an abstract noun and means "underlying", as in "the driving force behind", "the psychology behind" or "the why behind". It is silent on other uses of the word.
result.label: "behind" as underlying reason

result.description: Fires on the token ' end' (including as the start of words like endocrine, endurance, endpoints, endangered), usually after "the". Predicts continuations such as 'uring', 'game', and 'definit'.
result.label: ' end' token after "the"

result.description: Fires on month names and the leading digit of a year inside date ranges (e.g. "July 1st to November of 1916", "November 18", "13 October"), where an end date or month is expected. Silent on '1' in plain years like "in 1861".
result.label: Month/year in date ranges

result.description: Fires on ' supply' (supply chain, supply and demand, supply curve) and on ' Dev' in DevOps, predicting continuations like chain or word completions. Silent on unrelated text. Mostly a token-level detector for these word beginnings.
result.label: ' supply' and ' Dev'(Ops) word starts

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ities' (and 'abilities') completing words like "inequalities" and "Disabilities", especially after "inequal". Silent on 'ities' in "discontinuities" and "realities". Members detect "qual"/"ination" word pieces.
result.label: 'ities' ending of inequalities

result.description: Fires on ' equation' and related math-solving words (formula, calculate, solution) in algebra and math-system text, predicting math nouns like formulas, calculations, substitution. Silent in non-algebraic matrix text.
result.label: Equation and formula words in math

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of multi-piece words, mainly 'aven' in "leaveners", also 'ffic' in "Traffic", 'uls', 'iffer'. Members are detectors of these word pieces (aven, pt, tz, ough).
result.label: Mid-word piece: leaveners, Traffic

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'als' in "numerals" (also 'ation', 'US'), in math/number-system text. Silent on 'als' in "decimals" and "integrals", so it seems tied to the word "numer-als" and similar.
result.label: 'als' ending of numerals
Suffix 'ful' after word stem
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ful' attached to a preceding stem (art-ful, skill-ful, color-ful, play-ful, mind-ful). Weaker on 'istic' after 'art'. Members are mostly 'ful' detectors in early layers.

Fires on ' Dark' (as in Dark Matter/Energy), ' black', and word-start pieces like ' nuc' (nuclei) in science-leaning text. Peaks are mixed; the Dark and black detector members are discriminative, and the physics-flavored context members are shared.
result.label: Dark / black / nuc- word starts

result.description: Fires on "ing" word endings and "and" in lists of techniques or methods (e.g. "adopting", "implementing", "ing and"), in how-to or practice text. It is silent on many other "ing" tokens, so the extra condition is unclear.
result.label: -ing / and in technique lists

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'sky' in the name Chomsky (Noam Chom|sky), in passages about linguistics and academic theory. Members include 'sky' detectors and word-piece detectors for split words.
result.label: 'sky' in Chomsky

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ative' or 'ation' completing the word "summative"/"summation" after the piece "summ". It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like evaluation, enumeration, elaboration, derivation.
result.label: summ-ative / summ-ation suffix

result.description: Fires on plural nouns for technical parts or things, mainly " devices", " components" and " parts", often after a modifier such as "electronic" or "mechanical". Fires in hardware and engineering text and stays silent in generic integration-process text.
result.label: devices/components/parts plural nouns

result.description: Fires mainly on ' of' right after "Battle" (Battle of Verdun), plus scattered word-piece tokens like 'se', 'or' after "steel", and 'ation' in "international". Silent on ' of' after other nouns such as needs, aspects, moments.
result.label: "Battle of" and scattered word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces ('ic', 'a', 'iy', 'ation') in names and adjectives tied to Islamic or regional culture and history (Kufa, Islamic, Slavic), but stays silent on 'ic' in words like algorithmic, symbolic, ceramic.
result.label: Word-final suffix in cultural-history terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'it' in "facil|it|ating/ator" and on 'ator' in "medi|ator", i.e. mid-word pieces of facilitate/mediator. Silent on 'it' in other words like necessitates, prioritize, knit.
result.label: facilitate / mediator word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Dynam" at the start of "Dynamics" (Fluid, Molecular, Atmospheric, Microsoft Dynamics), predicting the completion "ics". Upstream members detect " Dynam" and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' Dynam' start of Dynamics

result.description: Fires on " in" right after "increase" or "decrease" (a change in some quantity: "increase in pressure"). It stays silent on " in" after "result", as in "result in", and after "ushered".
result.label: "in" after increase/decrease

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' foss' (start of "fossil/fossils") wherever it appears, and predicts a continuation like "il". Members are mostly ' foss' token detectors.
result.label: ' foss' fossil word-start

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' In' and ' Standard' (e.g. "the In-tricacy", "Standard Model", "Standard In-flationary"), where the word continues into a longer word or compound. Members are detectors of ' In' and ' Standard' tokens.
result.label: ' In' / ' Standard' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ge' as the start of geo- words (geography, geologists, geodesic, geotextiles, geonets). Members are mostly detectors of ' ge'/'Ge' tokens in layer 0 and 1.
result.label: ' ge' geo- word beginning

result.description: Fires on a few specific tokens: ' sod' (as in sodium), ' naturally' (often repeated, as in "naturally occurring"), and occasionally 'erves' or Arabic word pieces. Evidence is mixed, with little shared meaning beyond these token detectors.
result.label: sod- and naturally token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ical' (also 'ic', 'os') when it completes the word "ethical"/"ethics"/"ethos" after the 'eth' piece. It stays silent on 'ical' in other words such as "philosophical" or "unethical".
result.label: 'ical' suffix in "ethical"

result.description: Fires on the word " individuals" (rarely " people") as a plural noun for persons, often as the subject or object in abstract or academic text. Early-layer members detect "individuals" and similar group nouns.
result.label: " individuals" token detector

result.description: Fires on " labor" (also " industrial", " labour") in text about labor relations, economics and industrialization. It stays silent when " labor" starts the text with no preceding context, so it needs a preceding context.
result.label: labor / industrial in economic-history text

result.description: Fires on " scheme" in the idiom "the grand scheme of things/history". It is silent on "structure" in a salon seating context. Members detect "grand" and "schemes".
result.label: "grand scheme" idiom

result.description: Fires on the word " identification" (also " ident" and, more weakly, " recogn" or " acknowled") in process-style text. Predicts verb-suffix continuations like "ise/ising". Several members are detectors of the same token.
result.label: identification token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " transl" (translator, translations) at the start of the word, before the suffix. Members are mostly " transl" token detectors; a weaker response appears on " relationships" and " un".
result.label: " transl" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word pieces right after an initial "o" in a word being split into tokens (o|ven, o|ste-ocelets, o|var-ies, o|og-onia, o|vers-ight, o|ce-ans). The piece is the second token of an o-initial word.
result.label: Second piece after word-initial "o"
'cor' word-piece fragment
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cor' in the middle or start of split words (uncorrupted, mycorrhizal, ectomycorrhizae, undercoring), and weakly on ' blow' in 'blow molding'. Pushes towards continuations like 'por', 'rh', 'hab'.

Fires on the word piece " copy"/" Copy" (also "inc" in "incidents") when it is the start of a word like "copyright", predicting "right" as the next piece. Members detect "copy" and "right" tokens in copyright contexts.
result.label: " copy" before "right"

result.description: Fires on the word " late" when it starts a period of time, such as "late 19th century" or "late medieval". It predicts a following number or period word. Fires weakly after "the".
result.label: "late" before a century or era

result.description: Fires on the word " translation" (language translation and biological protein translation), occasionally " manual" before it. Silent on the contrast text, which uses "translating" and "Machine Translation" forms. Members are mostly detectors of " translation" plus language-related pieces.
result.label: ' translation' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " will" in abstract technical or academic prose, especially when it follows a plural noun subject and begins a future-tense verb phrase (will detail, will mean). Stays quiet after some noun-phrase subjects such as "techniques will open".
result.label: ' will' future auxiliary in technical prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'br' in the middle of a word, after a prefix like air-, cere-, Verte-, as in cerebral, vertebrata, airbrushes. It predicts a continuation such as 'ille', 'acu' or 'al'.
result.label: mid-word 'br' piece

result.description: Fires on runs of hyphens/dashes (e.g. '--------', '----') in separator lines or dash-separated lists, and occasionally on a digit within a dash-separated number sequence. Mostly dash-run tokens, in dashed-line formatting.
result.label: Dash-run separator tokens

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after a comma, often in a list or clause-opening position. It stays silent on ' the' after prepositions or a comma following a short intro phrase, so it seems to need the comma-plus-the pattern.
result.label: ' the' after a comma

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ive" completing the word "adhesive" (adhes|ive), especially in materials/coatings text. It stays silent on "ive" in other words such as protective, selective, invasive and preventive. Predicts material nouns like film, gel, cloth.
result.label: "ive" ending of "adhesive"

result.description: Fires on the preposition " within" (all 64 peaks), in spatial, abstract or temporal uses like "hidden within" or "within days". Members are mostly early-layer detectors of " within" and similar prepositions (into, throughout). Silent on the contrast text, which lacks the token.
result.label: Preposition ' within'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (rarely 'ized') when it completes "digit" as in "digitization". It stays silent on 'ization' in other words like "computerization" and "revitalization".
result.label: digit-ization suffix

result.description: Fires on scope words meaning worldwide or across nations: " international", " global", and "-wide" (worldwide, Earth-wide). Members detect those tokens plus countries, treaties and legislation context. Silent on a passage about treaties that lacks these words.
result.label: international / global / worldwide scope words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vin' in "Calvin" (Calvinism, Calvinist, John Calvin). Silent on other word pieces such as 'va' in the contrast. Upstream members are mostly 'vin' token detectors.
result.label: 'vin' in Calvin

result.description: Fires on capitalized word-initial fragments (' Sp', ' Cl', ' N', ' Mor') in title-like text, where the word is split and the next piece completes it (Spaces, Closed, Narration). Logits are unclear.
result.label: Split title-case word starts

result.description: Fires on the token ' considering', most strongly when it starts a participial phrase introducing an object like "alternative forms" or "the potential benefits". Weaker after "are" or "involves". Members are mostly detectors of consider-/consideration tokens.
result.label: ' considering' token detector
'vent' piece in interventions
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vent' inside words like "interventions" (also "solvent"), after the prefix "inter". Members are mostly 'vent' detectors plus inter- prefix pieces. Weak activation on "big data".

Fires on the token '1' (occasionally 'an' or 'ary') when it starts a year-like number, such as 1815 at the start of a text. It stays silent on '1' after words like "from", "to" or an apostrophe in the middle of a text.
result.label: Leading '1' of year at start

result.description: Fires on the token ' all' as a quantifier or determiner (e.g. "not all", "that all data", "for all guests"). It is silent on a sentence-initial ' all' after an ellipsis. Members are mostly ' all' token detectors.
result.label: ' all' quantifier token

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' (also 'ing') completing the word "temptation"/"tempting", after the stem 'tempt'. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like inflation, sensation, distillation, miscommunication.
result.label: -ation in temptation

result.description: Fires on the word right after "long" (long time, long term, long as, long way, long periods), where "long" is the previous word. It also fires on "history" in similar slots. Members detect "long-" and hyphens.
result.label: Word following "long"

result.description: Fires on ' of' after abstract nouns like "awareness/appreciation/understanding/truth/indices" that take an "of" complement. Stays quiet on ' of' after concrete or partitive nouns like "impact", "building block", "exchange", "form".
result.label: ' of' after abstract cognition nouns

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ast' (also 'asts', 'asted') when it directly follows 'ro' to spell 'roast'. It stays silent on 'ast' in other words such as 'taste', 'toasting' and 'forecast'.
result.label: 'ast' in 'roast'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece "Spe"/"spe" when it begins "speech" or "speaking", often at the start of a line in speech-topic outlines. It predicts continuations like "ty", "speaking" and "spe".
result.label: Spe- start of "speech/speak"

result.description: Fires on varied technical or group nouns and verbs (coefficient, server, member, packet, collected, percentage) in technical or statistical text. The peaks are mixed, and the members are mostly generic word-level detectors, so the evidence is thin.
result.label: Mixed technical nouns (coefficient, server, packet)

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a split rare word or name, such as ' conject' (conjecture), ' Haw', ' Schwar' and ' Lag', and on odd mid-word fragments in multilingual or garbled text. Likely predicts a word continuation. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-start fragments of rare words

result.description: Fires on the word "maps" (also "mapping", "map", "charts") as a noun or gerund for mapmaking and cartography, e.g. "charts and maps". Also fires on "overy" in "Discovery". Upstream members are mostly map-token detectors.
result.label: maps / mapping word detector

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like " sa", "ut" in sautéed/sautéing, "ste"/" Ste" (steering, steel, steep), and "era" in therapeutic, i.e. an incomplete word piece awaiting a specific continuation. Sautée-related pieces are strongest.
result.label: sa/ut/ste word-start fragments
'ematic' piece in mathematician
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ematic' (also 'ém'), mostly in 'mathematician' and similar words like 'Kinematic'. It is driven by upstream detectors of ' math' / ' Mathemat' and 'ematic' pieces, and it pushes toward completing the word.

Fires on "extends"/"extend" and "beyond" (also "far" in "extends far beyond"), where something is said to reach past a limit or scope. Members are detectors of "extends" and "beyond" tokens. Predicts "beyond".
result.label: extends / beyond scope words

result.description: Fires on the word " that" when it introduces a relative or complement clause after a noun or verb (e.g. "characteristics that best reflect", "knowledge that chefs"). Predicts a following verb. Silent on some " that" tokens in similar contexts.
result.label: relative/complement " that"

result.description: Fires on the token ' variable' (e.g. "independent variable", "dependent variable") in statistics or math text. Members are mostly detectors of 'variable(s)' plus related math and technical terms.
result.label: ' variable' in statistics/math text

result.description: Fires on the 'acci' piece in "Fibonacci", mostly in math text on Fibonacci numbers. It weakly fires on 'recursive' in discussions of recursive sequences. Members are mainly 'acci' detectors.
result.label: Fibonacci 'acci' token
'ulation' in 'regulation'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ulation' completing 'regulation' in governance and economics text. It stays silent on 'ulation' in 'formulation'. Members detect 'reg', 'regulatory' and legislation-related words.

Fires on incomplete word-start fragments or mid-word pieces (fort-, fis-, yg, inge, print) in academic text, where a continuation is expected. Peak tokens are varied and consistency is low. Predicts suffix-like continuations such as 'tion' and 'ped'.
result.label: Word-fragment stems awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on the word " systems" (also "Systems"/"system") when it follows a modifying noun in technical phrases like "database systems", "information systems", "numeral systems". Members detect "systems" and preceding technical modifiers.
result.label: "systems" after a noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ists" completing "scientists" (and sometimes the following " and" in "scientists and engineers"). Silent on "ists" in other words like "Ecologists", so it needs the scientist word.
result.label: "scientists" plural suffix

result.description: Fires mostly on the word " bridge" (network bridge, bridge design, railroad bridge), and more weakly on " table" and "-ology/-ological" endings. Members include bridge-token detectors. It is silent on "topological" in the contrast.
result.label: " bridge" word detector

result.description: Fires on the 'icing' piece of "pricing" after the split-off "pr", mostly in business pricing strategy text (cost-plus, dynamic, skimming pricing). Weak on other pr- word pieces like "pristine".
result.label: 'icing' in 'pricing'
'licate' word-piece (complicate/replicate)
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'licate' inside words like complicate, replicate and duplicate. It is weakly active on 'bre' in 'groundbreaking'. The circuit's members are mostly detectors of word-piece endings.

Fires on suffix pieces (-istic, -ization, -ized, -ist, -ism) completing words built on "real" (unrealistic, self-realization, unrealized). Silent on the same suffix after other stems, such as "uncharacteristic".
result.label: Suffixes after "real" stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece "aching" in "poaching" (cooking method), peaking after "po". Weakly fires on "cos" in "viscosity". Early-layer "aching" token detectors drive it.
result.label: "aching" in "poaching"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " react" when it begins a word like reactor(s) or reactant, in chemistry and nuclear engineering text. Weaker on " interact". Members are mostly detectors of " react" itself.
result.label: ' react' in reactor/reactant

result.description: Fires on the word " blood" in physiology and circulatory-system text (oxygenated blood, blood vessels, blood flow). Occasionally on other tokens like " funds" or "pan". Silent on a hemostasis passage that lacks the word itself.
result.label: ' blood' in circulatory text

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces: " So" at the start of "Soil" headings, "PE" in JPEG/MPEG/SPEC, and " acceler". Mostly early-layer token detectors for these pieces, with a weak push toward continuations like "il".
result.label: So / PE / acceler word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'но' (and 'мо') inside garbled Cyrillic strings, with weaker hits on ' Great', ' alive' and mid-word pieces like 'racle'. Evidence is mixed; the circuit mostly reflects word-piece features.
result.label: Cyrillic 'но' word-piece in garbled text

result.description: Fires on "communication" / "Communic" (start of "Communication"), strongest in repeated "Group Communication ..." heading lists. Weaker in "verbal and non-verbal communication"; silent after "effective communication" in running prose.
result.label: Communication in repeated headings

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " snow" (also occasionally " my" or " rain"), especially where it may begin a compound like snowfall or snowflakes. Layer-0 snow detectors drive it. The few contrast examples don't show what else it needs.
result.label: ' snow' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces of "utilize" (util-izing, -ized, -ization, -izes) after "util", and weakly on "use"/"application". It stays silent on other -izing words such as "optimizing" and "oxidizing".
result.label: utilize word suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the token " online" (also " Online"), in phrases like "online gaming", "online communities" and "online menus". Members include " online" detectors and related digital/internet words such as digital, apps and YouTube.
result.label: ' online' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the verb "lead" (also "require", "leads") right after a modal like "may" or "can", as in "may lead to errors". Weak on the modal itself. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "lead" after modal verb

result.description: Fires mostly on ' IS' in all-caps text (e.g. "THAT IS", "THERE IS A"), and weaker on ' click' and word-piece splits in caps. The logits are unclear.
result.label: All-caps ' IS' token

result.description: Fires on the token ' orbit' (and orbit pieces like orbit-als, orbit-ing), including repeated orbit text. Predicts suffixes such as 'als' and 'ing'. Members are mostly orbit/orb detectors plus electron-orbital context.
result.label: ' orbit' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ging' at the end of a word split into tokens (tag-ging, hed-ging, brid-ging, diver-ging). It relies on the preceding word piece and on detectors of 'ging' and of the stem before it.
result.label: 'ging' suffix word piece

result.description: Fires on thermodynamic quantity words (energy, entropy, enthalpy's "py") in physics/chemistry contexts such as Gibbs free energy equations. Silent on "energy" in general collision/distribution text.
result.label: Thermodynamic energy/entropy/enthalpy terms

result.description: Fires on a few technical noun tokens like " click", " noise", " volume" and "sync" when they act as a modifier or head noun in technical text (click consonants, noise types). Predicts "reduction"/"control" next. Mixed evidence.
result.label: click/noise technical nouns

result.description: Fires on ' more' used as a quantity or degree word, mostly after verbs or nouns, as in "mean more opportunities", "costs more", "much more". It stays silent on "more + adjective" after "of", "for" or "and" in technical text.
result.label: ' more' after verb or noun

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " casting", especially metal casting techniques in sculpture and art lists (lost-wax casting, sand casting). Weak activity on a few other tokens like "ism". Silent on conservation text without the word.
result.label: ' casting' in sculpture techniques

result.description: Fires on odd word-piece fragments like 'ordin' (not in 'subordinating'), 'criv', 'ogn', 'chni', and long dash-line separators. The evidence is mixed. Silent on 'ordin' after 'sub'. Members are generic token-fragment detectors.
result.label: Rare word fragments 'ordin', 'criv'

result.description: Fires on the word right after "should" (mostly " be", also " not", " also", " always"), in normative or instruction-style text. It is quieter after "must", "to" or "can". It pushes toward " be" and " consider".
result.label: Word after "should" (be/not/also)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "cal" in "Fiscal" (as in "Fiscal Policy"), with weaker firing on "enses" in "expenses". Members detect "cal" plus economics context (economy, expenditure, policy).
result.label: "cal" in "fiscal"

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside longer or rare words and names, mainly 'iss' (also 'ip', 'ner', 'im'), as in Dissipation, Mössbauer-like names, or assimilation. It predicts 'iss'-type continuations. Members are mostly token-piece detectors.
result.label: 'iss' mid-word fragment

result.description: Fires on the piece 'et' inside "multifaceted" (multifac-et-ed). It stays silent on 'et' in other words such as "onetics". Members detect 'et' pieces, 'multi'/'mult' and 'ac' fragments.
result.label: 'et' in multifaceted

result.description: Fires on ' language' (also -ism, -istic, 'intelligence', 'identity') in academic philosophy/social-theory text, where the next word is likely a topic noun like debate or philosophy. Silent on 'language' in some spoken/processing contexts.
result.label: language in academic theory text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' spell' (spelling, spellcheck, to spell) in text about spelling and language. Silent on unrelated text such as math. Supported by spell/check and language-related members.
result.label: ' spell' word piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' datasets', mostly right after a size adjective like "large" or "vast". Members include detectors of dataset/database/data tokens. The singular ' dataset' fires only weakly.
result.label: ' datasets' after large/vast

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece after "supplement" (mostly "ary" in "supplementary", also "s" and "ed"), i.e. when the word being completed is a form of supplement. Silent on "ary" in other words like monetary or varying.
result.label: Suffix after "supplement"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " epo" at the start of "epoch/epochs", especially in historical or era-themed text. It is the same token each time, with weak activation on " era" and similar period words.
result.label: " epo" in epoch

result.description: Fires on collective nouns like " groups" and " classes" (also " communities") when they name sets or categories of things, often in abstract or academic text. Members detect group/cluster/range-type words.
result.label: Plural group/class nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece " fit" when it starts "fitness" (genetic algorithms, evolutionary fitness), with weaker firing on " trace" and " form". Members are mostly detectors of " fit" and of "ness" after it.
result.label: " fit" in "fitness"

result.description: Fires on the "1" starting a year (1975, 1973) and on commas or periods in text about Helsinki and the Helsinki Accords. Silent on "1" in other years like 1962 or 1980. Members detect "Hels" and Cold War terms such as arms.
result.label: Helsinki Accords year "1" token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ledge', the ending of 'knowledge', when it starts a sentence or phrase, as in "knowledge producers". It stays silent when 'ledge' follows a sentence-ending period directly.
result.label: 'ledge' piece of 'knowledge'

result.description: Fires on scientific word-start fragments like 'phys', 'chem', 'elect', 'scop' inside incomplete technical words (e.g. electrochemical, physical, petrochemical), predicting the word's continuation pieces.
result.label: Science word-start fragments (phys/chem)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " empir" (empirical, empiricism), predicting the continuation "ical". Members are detectors of " empir" plus philosophy and evidence words. Weak activation on other split word pieces like pseudo and phen.
result.label: ' empir' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces completing a term after a stem: 'lines'/'lined' after 'stream', and plural 's' after acronyms like CDF/PDF. Silent when 'lines' starts a sentence or follows other stems like 'streak'.
result.label: stream-lines / acronym plural suffix

result.description: Fires on the token " performance" in technical or management text (algorithms, networks, metrics, reviews). Members are mostly detectors of "performance" itself. The contrast text lacks the word, so the evidence shows no extra condition.
result.label: ' performance' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' Ge' or ' Gra' that start a split word, such as Geoid, Geomorphology, Gravity, mostly at the start of a list item or heading in geoscience text. It predicts a continuation piece.
result.label: Ge/Gra word-start fragments in headings

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' des' (in "desires", or the French/German article "des"), ' dispos', ' rev', ' conc', where the token begins a longer word and a suffix is expected. Weaker on other prefix pieces.
result.label: Word-start fragment ' des' / ' dispos'

result.description: Fires on the word "resource"/"resources", most strongly in computing or scheduling text about resource allocation and management (e.g., "optimize resource allocation"). It is weak on related words such as "efficiency".
result.label: resource(s) in allocation contexts

result.description: Fires on the word " market" in business and economics text, usually as a modifier or noun in phrases like "market research", "market power" or "financial market". It is quiet in a monopolistic-competition passage that lacks the word.
result.label: " market" in business/economics text

result.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces like 'xt' in "fixtures" and "juxtaposing", plus 'ivari', 'EM' and 'lu'. These are fragments inside longer split words, often technical ones. Members mostly detect 'xt' and other word fragments.
result.label: Mid-word fragment 'xt' (fixtures)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ator'/'ators' completing the word "actuator(s)", mostly after the 'actu' piece. Weak on other -ator words such as communicators. Silent on 'ators' in simulators, where the preceding piece differs.
result.label: -ator suffix in actuator

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like 'hing' (washing, hashing) and 'al' (oral, modal), plus a few others like 'atory'. It mainly marks the end of a word split into pieces; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-ending suffix pieces (hing, al)

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment " br" / " Br" (as in brush, bristle, Brusil), mostly at the start of a word split into pieces. Early-layer " br" detector members drive it; it is silent on text without this fragment.
result.label: ' br' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on nouns like stories, tales, characters, struggles in discussions of storytelling and fiction (authors, characters, narratives). It pushes toward story-related continuations such as ' stories', ' insp', ' reson'. Silent on non-literary text.
result.label: Story/tale nouns in literary discussion

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside the word "viscosity" (vis-c, vis-co, -ity) in fluid-mechanics text, and weakly on other physics word fragments. Silent on -ity in words like "proportionality" or "centrality".
result.label: Pieces of "viscosity" in fluid text

result.description: Fires on the token "in" when it is the piece right after "mar" inside "marinating/marinade" words. It stays silent on "in" in other words or at word starts, and weakly fires on other "mar-" pieces.
result.label: "in" inside "mar-in-ating"

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "reduc-" words (redu-ction, decre-asing, redu-cing), mainly in oxidation-reduction chemistry. It stays silent on "ction" in "extraction", so it needs the reduction/decrease word, not just the ending.
result.label: Reduction word endings (redox)

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside "bil-" words such as bil|ine|ar, bil|ateral, bil|ing|ual (mostly 'ine', 'al', ' bil'). Silent on 'al' in other words like oral, functional, skeletal. Members detect 'bil' and 'ater'.
result.label: Pieces of "bilinear/bilateral" words

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece ' numer' (numeral, numeration, Roman numerals), especially after Arabic/Roman/Indian in text about number systems. Weak firing on 'math' and 'highlights'. Members are mostly ' numer' detectors.
result.label: ' numer' in numeral words

result.description: Fires on the period inside a decimal or section number (1.6, 2.1.2, 1.10), between digits. It stays silent on sentence-ending periods after names or words.
result.label: Period inside numbers

result.description: Fires on word pieces after "rel" (rel-ent-less, rel-ates, rel-ational) and on " he" in "heating" after rapid/contact. Silent on 'ent' in other words like intelligent, unrelenting, prevalent.
result.label: Word piece after "rel" (relentless, relates)

result.description: Fires on varied tokens ending abstract nouns or word pieces, mostly ' of' after nominalizations (distribution of, synthesis of, process of), '-ation', and 'm'. Silent on many ' of' tokens elsewhere. Evidence is mixed and logits are not clear.
result.label: Nominalization endings before 'of'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'elling' completing the word "storytelling" (storyt|elling). It stays silent on 'elling' in "compelling" and "spelling", so it needs the story-telling word context.
result.label: 'elling' in storytelling

result.description: Fires on the middle of a multi-piece term like "Term" in "Long Short-Term Memory", and on "mem"/"Memory" pieces. Also weakly on other mid-word fragments. Seems to predict a continuing word piece.
result.label: Term/Memory in Long Short-Term Memory

result.description: Fires mainly on " animal" (also "life" in wildlife, "sampling") as a modifier or noun in environmental/biology-type text, with animal-detector members upstream. Weaker hits on scattered other tokens; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: animal / wildlife word detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ersion' (in "dispersion"), also 'ans', 'anc' (advancements), 'ro'. Strongest on 'ersion' after "disp"; the contrast is a different word with no such piece.
result.label: 'ersion' in dispersion, word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' common' (as in "common problem", "common ion effect", "common mistakes"), across topics. Members are mostly ' common' detectors plus error/mistake-related words. The contrast does not contain ' common'.
result.label: ' common' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' e' when it begins "ecosystem" or "ecological" (the following 'cos'/'colog' piece is predicted), mostly in ecology or biology text. It is silent on 'e' at document start.
result.label: ' e' starting ecosystem/ecology
Statist- / statistical word piece
result.description: Fires on ' Statist' (start of "Statistical") and ' statistical'/'statist' pieces, mostly in statistical mechanics or statistics text. Members are mainly detectors of statistics-related tokens. Weak activation on 'regression'.

Fires on word pieces in the middle of academic words, mainly 'soci' (dissociation, sociologist) and 'ologist' in psychologist/sociologist, with weaker firing on ' electron' and 'cian'. Predicts word-completing suffixes such as 'ologist'.
result.label: soci- / -ologist word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ature" completing "curvature" (curv|ature), mostly in math/geometry text on surfaces and tensors. It is silent on other geometry text without that word piece.
result.label: "ature" in curvature

result.description: Fires on 'able' or '-' suffix/joiner directly after the word "action" (actionable, action-value, action-reaction). Silent on 'able' in other words like inexorable or comparable.
result.label: 'able' or '-' after "action"

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "life" in compounds like life-saving, life-preserving, life-support, life-world. Other hyphens (bridge-, blue-, cost-, resource-) leave it silent, so it needs the preceding word "life".
result.label: Hyphen after "life"

result.description: Fires on ' Dr' at the start of a line in a list of names (e.g. "¶ Dr. Smith"), right after a document start or line break. Silent on ' Dr' in other positions, such as inside names like Jean Drèze.
result.label: Line-initial ' Dr' in name lists

result.description: Fires on the word-final piece 've' completing "conducive" (as in "conducive to"), with weaker firing on a few other word pieces like 'il' and 'ward'. It stays silent on 've' in "conveying".
result.label: 've' ending "conducive"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rom' when it is a fragment inside longer words such as a-rom-atic, Ch-rom-atography and mac-rom-olecule. It is silent on 'rom' in other words, such as 'resonant'. It pushes toward continuations like 'atic' and 'etry'.
result.label: 'rom' fragment in aromatic/chromatography

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-phrase tokens (and, ideas, digital, see, C, verified) in technical or expository text, often just before a word continuation. Peaks are inconsistent and the members are mostly word-piece detectors, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered mid-phrase tokens in technical prose

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ments' completing "treat|ments" (medical treatments). It stays silent on 'ments' in "develop|ments", so it needs the preceding 'treat' stem. It weakly fires on similar endings like "treat|ies".
result.label: 'ments' after treat- stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' in the middle of a word, especially 'Se|qu|ences' (also earth|qu|ake, ade|qu|ately). Weak or silent on 'qu' in 'qubits'.
result.label: 'qu' inside Sequences

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "gress" inside "aggressive", and weakly on other mid-word pieces like "iv" in "pivotal" or "progressivism". It needs the word-internal position after a prefix such as "ag".
result.label: "gress" in "aggressive"

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ic' completing the word "mosaic" (also 'malleability'). It is silent on 'ic' in other words like Islamic or prehistoric, so it needs the 'mosa' prefix.
result.label: 'ic' ending "mosaic"

result.description: Fires on the piece "archy" completing "monarchy" (political-system text), with weaker firing on "rule", "fundamental", "principle". Silent on "monarch" without the "-archy" piece. Members detect "mon-" prefixes and "archy".
result.label: 'archy' in monarchy

result.description: Fires on the token ' ocean' (and 'ocean' in 'oceanography') and on the piece 'il' inside words like 'soil', 'fossil', 'multilanguage'. Two token detectors share one latent; the contrast text with 'oceans' stays silent.
result.label: ' ocean' and 'il' word pieces
Small number words (two, four)
result.description: Fires on small cardinal number words, mainly " two" and " four" (also three), often after "into" or "to" and before a hyphenated compound like "three-carbon" or "two-dimensional". Members are number-token detectors.

result.label: ' ur' word-start piece (urgent)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ur' at the start of a split word, mainly 'urgent' (also urgency, urine), especially in the Eisenhower-matrix 'neither urgent nor important' text. Members are mostly ' ur' token detectors.
Fires on the token ' quality', mainly as a head noun in "the quality of X" or "tonal/statistical quality". It stays silent after "product" and at the start of a text.
result.label: ' quality' as head noun

result.description: Fires on the token ' fan' (as in fan engagement, fan culture, fan communities), usually as a modifier right before a noun like base, community or involvement. Predicts nouns like norm, values, appreciation.
result.label: ' fan' as noun modifier
Suffix after "culmin" (culminate/culmination)
result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces -ate/-ation/-ated/-ates completing "culmin-" (culminate in, culmination of). Stays silent on -ation in other words like preparation, anticipation, experimentation. Members detect "culmin" and stage/end-of-process words.

Fires on ' power' right after "the" in "the power of ..." (harness the power, the power of words). It stays silent on 'power' in compounds or after modifiers like "solar power" and "interpersonal power".
result.label: "the power" after determiner

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start fragments like ' capac' (capacitor/capacitance) and ' grad' (gradients), where the word continues in the next token. Weaker on ' spe', ' var'. Members are detectors of these specific fragments.
result.label: capac/grad word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on ' million' when it ends the second number of a numeric range or pair ("23 million to 53 million"), in a list of quantities. Weakly fires on "well-" hyphens. Silent on ordinary text without such numbers.
result.label: ' million' in numeric ranges

result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix "ers" (occasionally "ors") when it completes a person-noun like researchers, employers, buyers, designers. Strongest on "researchers"; silent on "speakers" in a linguistics context.
result.label: Agent-noun suffix "ers" (researchers)

result.description: Fires mostly on the digit '0' inside long runs of zeros (e.g. lakh 1,00,000 or binary strings), plus occasional 'such' in 'such as' and ' usually'. It stays quiet on a '0' in short numbers like 180° or 10.
result.label: Zeros in long digit strings

result.description: Fires on the first word-piece of a multi-token word (pres, inst, pl, cre, cont) that comes right after an opening parenthesis or quote in a list of examples. The word is incomplete and continues next.
result.label: Word-start fragment inside parenthetical examples

result.description: Fires on the adverb ' locally' (mostly before sourced/grown/produced), and weaker on other manner adverbs like ' purely', ' dynamically', ' rather'. Members are mostly 'local' detectors plus generic word-piece features.
result.label: Adverb 'locally' and similar adverbs

result.description: Fires on the noun ' point' (and ' moment') as a head noun for a specific location or time, as in "starting point", "turning point", "first moment". Silent on general period or time text without these words.
result.label: point / moment as head noun

result.description: Fires on ' solution' / ' solutions' as a noun, mostly after a modifier like "closed form", "exact", "particular", "optimal" or "series". Members include solution-token detectors and math/equation context. The contrast, an ODE passage with no such word, is silent.
result.label: solution(s) noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on the token ' possible' itself, in modal-logic and "possible worlds" text and in "made possible". Silent on related words like possibility/impossibility in the contrast. Members are mostly ' possible' and ' potential' detectors from layer 0.
result.label: ' possible' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " diameter" in geometry-style text about circles and radius, often after "the". Members include detectors of "diameter", "radius" and "circle". Weak firing on a few other measure words.
result.label: diameter token in circle geometry

result.description: Fires on digit tokens '2', '3', '0' inside long, repetitive digit strings or code-like numeric sequences (e.g. 332B223, 222-232). It stays quiet on a digit starting a year like 2010 or in normal dates.
result.label: Digits 2/3/0 in digit strings

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' Log' (Logic/Logical), ' Ont', 'X' at the start of a title or heading line, where the next piece completes an academic term. Strongest on ' Log' beginning list items of logic topics.
result.label: Log/Ont word-start in topic headings

result.description: Fires on the token ' wave' (physics wave mechanics, wave equations, wave-particle), with weak activity on related words like 'river'. Supported by members detecting wave/waves tokens.
result.label: Physics ' wave' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-completion suffix pieces (ate, ential, eries, acy, ately) right after a split-off stem like "qu" or "adequ", completing words such as adequate, queries, inadequacy. Silent on 'ate' in other words like mitigate or elaborate.
result.label: Suffix after 'qu'/'adequ' stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' chrom' at the start of words like chromatography, chromatin, chromosome and chromium. Members are mostly ' chrom' token detectors from layer 0, with some other word-piece detectors.
result.label: ' chrom' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ra' (also 'i', 'rag') right after 'suff' in "suffragettes/suffragists". Members detect ' suff' and similar word-start fragments; weak firing on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'ra' in suffragette

result.description: Fires on ' optimized' (also ' custom', ' intellig') when it opens a noun phrase as a modifier, like "optimized supply chain". Silent when it follows "be"/"is" as a predicate or after another adjective.
result.label: ' optimized' as attributive modifier

result.description: Fires on the word "structure"/"structures" (and "struct" pieces), mostly in academic text about social, linguistic or organizational structures, e.g. "existing structures of power". Members are mainly detectors of the same token.
result.label: "structure(s)" word detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ant' when it appears inside a longer word, such as Bantu, implantation, secant, resonant, univariant. Members are mostly 'ant' token detectors from early layers.
result.label: 'ant' word piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the token 'ed' when it is a standalone verb suffix ending a past-tense verb, just before 'the' plus an abstract noun (toolkit, influence, emergence). It stays silent on 'ed' inside other words or after certain stems like slic-ed, challeng-ed, spark-ed.
result.label: 'ed' verb ending before 'the'

result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix "ers" ending a person-noun like think-ers, philosoph-ers, research-ers, especially in lists of intellectual or professional groups. Stays quiet on "ers" in words like followers or centers.
result.label: "-ers" ending thinker-type nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ined' ending words like unconfined, confined, coined, predetermined. Strongest in the hydrogeology "confined/unconfined aquifers" context. Early-layer 'ined' token detectors drive it; it is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: 'ined' suffix piece (confined)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " neur" at the start of "neurons"/"neuronal" in neuroscience text, with weaker firing on related pieces like "uro" and "N". It stays silent on "nervous". Upstream members are neur-token detectors.
result.label: neur- piece in neuron words

result.description: Fires on a word that is followed by a suffix or compound completion, mainly ' Bank' in "Money and Banking", ' Model' after "Waterfall", and 'fall'. It predicts word-ending pieces like 'ing' and 'fall'.
result.label: Bank/Model/fall compound-word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' val' (valve, valence, valves), predicting a continuation such as 've', 'ence' or 'ued'. Members mostly detect ' val' and similar word-start fragments. It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' val' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on varied words in business/social-science research-methods text (e.g. "via", "analysis", "digital", "hand") where a method or data-collection term like observational, survey or exploratory could come next. Peaks are scattered.
result.label: Research-methods text, predicts method words

result.description: Fires on ' he' (also ' she', surnames like Wilson/Davis) as the subject pronoun in biographical profile text about a person, especially after a clause such as "promised himself he". Silent in bare name lists.
result.label: Subject pronoun 'he' in biographies

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' invent' as the start of a longer word, mostly 'inventory' in supply-chain and business text. It is weaker in 'inventor' and 'invented'. Many members are detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' invent' word-piece (inventory)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' manip' at the start of manipulate/manipulation/manipulative, predicting continuations like 'ulative'. Members are mostly detectors of manip-/manipulate tokens. Rare weaker firing on 'artificial' and 'imbalance'.
result.label: ' manip' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on varied function words (for, of, down, solving, accurate) in technical numerical-methods and engineering text, such as finite element methods, where a method or technique is being applied. It stays silent on 'essential for' in other math contexts. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Function words in numerical-methods text

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (and, commas, suffixes like -ation/-iation, nouns) in lists of incident-response or security procedures, where a next item like a response action is expected. Silent on sentence-final periods. Circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Incident-response procedure list items

result.description: Weak, mixed target peaking on scattered tokens (' like', ' simply', 'ies', ' in', a comma) mid-sentence, often after a subject and before a predicate or complement. Contrast shows ' like' silent in similar contexts. Evidence is thin; the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered mid-sentence function tokens

result.description: Fires on function words and verbs in the middle of a clause (using, with, their, of, many) where a means or method object is expected, in technical or business text. Peaks are scattered and it also stays silent on 'using' in some contexts, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Method-introducing function words, weak

result.description: Fires on scattered function and filler words (the, of, involves, creating) inside definitional text about stippling and art techniques. Silent on near-identical "involves the" contexts elsewhere, so the evidence is mixed. Members are art/create/technique detectors.
result.label: Art technique description function words

result.description: Fires weakly on scattered function words (".", " to", " of", " they", " that") in abstract academic text, especially math and science. No consistent token or construction; the logits are noisy and the contrast is silent on the same tokens.
result.label: Scattered function words in academic text

result.description: Fires on " growth" right after "economic"/"Economic", especially as the subject at the start of a document about economics. It stays quiet on growth after other modifiers (organic, potential) or outside that economic framing.
result.label: economic growth subject

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer target firing on varied tokens (dashes, 'and', 'the', word pieces) often within quoted words or lists of examples. Members are generic and non-discriminative; the circuit failed, so the evidence is thin.
result.label: Diffuse quoted-example tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires in short documents about pitch/sound and acoustics, on words in the "Pitch is a(n) fundamental/essential/crucial concept" slot and on 'the' before a sound-property noun. Silent on 'fundamental' in other sentences, so it needs the pitch intro context.
result.label: Pitch-intro evaluative adjectives

result.description: Fires on function words and commas (",", " of", " by", " saw") in text about the Pleistocene, ice ages and geological periods, as the next word in a sentence on climate or geology is expected. Evidence is mixed, and the contrast shows the same commas staying silent.
result.label: Function words in ice-age text

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' of', ' the', ' while', ' into') and some nouns inside definitional passages about statistics and programming. Peaks are mixed and the contrast shows silence on ' of' after nouns like 'class' or 'range'. Evidence is thin.
result.label: Function words in technical definitions

result.description: Fires on 'lying' in "Applying" (the piece after "App") at the start of a document, as in "Applying principles/techniques". It stays silent on 'lying' in "multiplying". Members detect apply/applying/application-of words.
result.label: "App-lying" word piece, apply-sense

result.description: Fires on varied function words and prepositions (' (', ' of', ' for', ' with', ' through') after a noun in marketing, communication or business-style expository text. Peaks are inconsistent, and it stays silent on ' (' after some management terms.
result.label: Prepositions in marketing/communication prose

result.description: Fires on varied connective tokens (' suggests', ' suggesting', ' in', ' and') in philosophy text about ethical theories like emotivism, and members mostly carry philosophy context. The circuit failed faithfulness, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Philosophy-text connectives, 'suggests'

result.description: Fires on "first" (and "Firstly") in a document-opening enumerating phrase like "First things first," or "Firstly,". It stays silent on "first" mid-sentence in phrases such as "the first time" or "a first step".
result.label: Opening "First things first" / "Firstly"

result.description: Fires weakly on scattered function words (' an', ' of', ' in', ' integrate', a comma) mid-sentence in expository text. Members are unrelated token detectors, and the target is silent on ' an' in similar contexts, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words, unclear

result.description: Fires weakly on varied function words (of, (, ;, or, through) after a noun phrase, but stays silent on "range of". Members are mostly word-ending and punctuation-predicting pieces. Low consistency, failed circuit; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed function words after noun phrases

result.description: Fires on function words and punctuation (commas, "of", "in", "and", ";") inside academic text about listening, communication and methods. It is silent on many commas in similar text, so the evidence is mixed. Next-token logits are not clear.
result.label: Function words in academic communication text

result.description: Fires on function words and modifiers (' certain', ',', ' and', 'ized', ' the') in text about jargon, specialized terminology and professional or social-group language, where a noun like 'skill' or 'word' may follow. Silent on ' certain' in other uses.
result.label: Jargon and specialized terminology context

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer latent firing on varied function words and word pieces (the, between, a, and, examining) in mathematical or technical explanatory text. Peaks are inconsistent, and the circuit is a poor fit.
result.label: Diffuse function words in math text

result.description: Fires on prepositions (' in', ' of', ' by', ' the') following a verb or noun in economic/historical text, especially about the dot-com bubble. It is silent on the same ' in' in other economic contexts, so the pattern is inconsistent.
result.label: Prepositions in dot-com economic history

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (and, with, of, in, think) after abstract nouns in expository text about communication, feedback and personal growth. Peaks are inconsistent and the target is often silent on the same tokens; the evidence is weak.
result.label: Function words after abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on varied function words (of, to, use, by, periods) in passages about contrast in art and design, often right after the word "contrast" or its discussion. Silent on many ' of' tokens in similar art text, so the circuit is poorly defined.
result.label: Function words in art contrast text

result.description: Fires on connectors and opening quotes inside lists of quoted question words like 'what', 'why', 'when', 'how' (e.g. the 'what' and 'when'), at the slot where the next quoted question word comes. Weak and mixed evidence.
result.label: Quoted question-word lists
facilitate: 'it' piece in facilitates
result.description: Fires on the 'it' piece inside "facilitates/facilitating" (and occasionally the word right after "facilitate"). It stays silent on some other "facil-it-ates" cases, so the extra requirement is unclear. Members are facil- piece detectors.

Fires on varied tokens (ical, of, that, commas, periods) inside passages defining or discussing mathematical formalism, as the philosophy of mathematics. Silent on similar tokens in realism or logic passages. Members are mostly math and philosophy context detectors.
result.label: Formalism in philosophy of mathematics

result.description: Fires on varied tokens shortly after "playing" (e.g. "playing chess with", "a game of", "plays a crucial role"), in the slot where the object of playing, such as a game or role, is being completed. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Tokens following "playing" (game/role)

result.description: Fires on varied function words and connectors (of, to, a, on, within, commas) in abstract academic or technical expository text, mainly math, linguistics and theory. It is silent on 'of' in temporal or spatial phrases. Logits are weak and mixed.
result.label: Function words in academic exposition
