result.label: ' Bron' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' int' and ' eng' when they begin a word being repeated or continued, as in "intimate int|imate" or "reader eng|agement". Silent when ' int' opens the text. Seems to fire on the repeat of a word just seen.
result.label: Repeated word-start ' int'/' eng'

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces -aging, -age, -agement, -ages when they complete "engage/engaging/engagement". It stays silent on the same suffix in "managing", so it needs the "eng-" prefix.
result.label: engage/engaging/engagement suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ith' inside words like lithium, lithography and megalithic, with weaker hits on 'cop'/'scop' and similar mid-word pieces ('ym' in lymphatic). Silent on the full word 'lithium' later in text.
result.label: 'ith' piece in lithium/lithography

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' arrang' (start of "arrangements") and on 'xt' in "juxtaposition", where the word is incomplete and continues with a suffix. Mostly the first piece of these multi-token words.
result.label: arrang- / juxt- word-piece

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix piece 'cies' ending "fallacies" in texts about reasoning errors, with weaker hits on ' assumptions', 'oration' and 'pal'. Members detect 'falla' and 'cies' pieces.
result.label: 'cies' in fallacies

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ership", mainly at the end of "Leadership" in a heading-like list of leadership styles. Weaker on " leadership" and "speakership". Supported by token detectors for "ership" and leader/leadership words.
result.label: "ership" suffix in Leadership

result.description: Fires on the word " cost" (also " costs", " trade", " production") mostly as the first part of a compound or noun phrase like "cost control", "cost allocation", "free trade". Members are mostly detectors of " cost"/" costs" in business and finance text.
result.label: ' cost' in business phrases

result.description: Fires on the word " reality", mostly in "augmented reality" and "virtual reality" in tech text. It stays silent when " reality" starts a document or phrase with no preceding "virtual" or "augmented". It also fires weakly on "machine learning".
result.label: augmented/virtual reality

result.description: Fires on the word ' new' (also novel/innov variants) when it is an adjective before a plural or abstract noun, often after "of", "with", "to" or a verb. Members are mostly ' new' detectors.
result.label: ' new' adjective before noun

result.description: Fires mainly on the degree adverb " too" (too many, too close, too much), occasionally on " very" or a colon. Members are mostly " too" detectors from early layers. The contrast text has no such adverb.
result.label: Degree adverb "too"

result.description: Fires on the word "state"/"states" in physics and thermodynamics text, such as quantum states, density of states, state functions, boundary states. It stays quiet on nearby thermodynamic words that are not "state".
result.label: "state(s)" in physics contexts

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'strateg' (and 'ateg', 'econom', 'forec', 'anticip') in game-theory and economics text, where the word is incomplete and a suffix like -ic or -ies follows. It is silent on some 'strateg' tokens, such as after "dominant" or "non-combat".
result.label: strateg- word-piece in game theory

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ural' when it completes the word "plural" (after 'pl'), mostly in grammar text. It is much weaker on 'ural' in other words such as "structural" or "cultural", and on a few other word endings.
result.label: 'ural' in "plural"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' st' when it is a split-off start of a word, mostly in stakeholder-related text (e.g. 'st' + 'akeholders'). It stays silent on ' st' at the very start of a document.
result.label: ' st' fragment in stakeholder text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " re" that begins "reactor" or "reactions" in chemistry and nuclear-engineering text, after words like batch, redox, or nuclear. It predicts "actions" or "actor" next. It stays silent on "re" in "rejection".
result.label: "re" before -actor/-actions

result.description: Fires on a standalone space token that comes right before a number (year, century, list item, or digits). It is silent when the space is at the very start of a text.
result.label: Space token before a number

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'conom' in (socio/macro)economic, also 'ure' in procurement/sculpture. It needs these pieces inside particular multi-piece words, not elsewhere.
result.label: 'conom' and 'ure' word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' Field' (also weakly ' field') in physics and math terms like "Quantum Field Theory". Members are mostly detectors of Field/field tokens in early layers. Weak firing on the surname Fielding.
result.label: ' Field' in Quantum Field Theory

result.description: Fires on the capital letter 'H' when it stands for hydrogen or appears in chemical or scientific notation (NH3, pH, T_H1, H+). It stays quiet on 'H' in ordinary prose.
result.label: H in chemical formulas

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ush" in "brush"/"brushes", especially in painting-technique text, and weakly on "al" in "lateral". It is silent on "ush" at the start of a text, with no "br" before it.
result.label: "ush" in "brush"
'log' piece in Hydrolog-
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'log' inside "Hydrology/Hydrological", right after "Hydro". Members detect 'hydro' pieces, water words and 'log' pieces. Weak activation on other word pieces such as 'ky' in "risky".
Fires on the 'inger' piece in "Schrödinger", mainly in "Schrödinger Equation" and physics text. It needs the preceding "Schröd" piece, and members detect 'inger' and 'Schröd' contexts.
result.label: Schrödinger 'inger' token

result.description: Fires on the word " Customer" (mostly capitalized), typically at the start of a document or heading such as "Customer Engagement" or "Customer Service". Weakly fires on " customers" and "user". Members are mainly Customer detectors.
result.label: Customer heading token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sk' when it begins a longer word, mostly 'skilled' (skilled workers/labor). Weakly fires on 'lement' in 'supplement'. Silent on the complete word 'skills'.
result.label: ' sk' piece of 'skilled'

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece ' ref' when it begins a longer word (reflexive, refinement, refraction), and occasionally on 'y' in Philosophy. Members are mostly ' ref' detectors, so it predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' ref' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the piece 'iv' in "p-iv-otal" (pivotal), after "p". It also fires weakly on 'iv' in other words like carnivores or structivism, and it predicts the continuation "otal".
result.label: 'iv' in "pivotal"

result.description: Fires on 'cial' completing "Glacial" (glacial topics such as erosion, moraines), and weakly on other word endings like 'ation' and ' dynamics'. Silent on 'cial' in "crucial", so it needs the glacier word context.
result.label: Glacial 'cial' word piece

result.description: Fires on verb suffix pieces like 'ing', 'ating', 'ated' after stems such as rot-, align-, comple-, occupy-, mostly in physics/science text (rotation, polarization). Silent on 'ing' in social or psychology text (paying, responding).
result.label: -ing/-ating suffix in physics text

result.description: Fires on " recent", mostly in "in recent years", and weakly on a few word pieces such as "ouve" and "through|put". Members detect "recent" and "years" tokens directly. The contrast text has no "recent" and stays silent.
result.label: ' recent' in "in recent years"

result.description: Fires on the 'ys' or 'yn' piece right after the 'pol' prefix, as in pol-ynomial, pol-ysemy and pol-ysian. It stays silent on 'ys' in other words like 'employs'.
result.label: 'ys'/'yn' after pol- prefix

result.description: Fires on a hyphen inside a multi-part hyphenated compound, strongest in "out-of-order", "best-case", and chained hyphens, where more hyphenated pieces follow. Weaker for "well-defined". Silent on hyphens after "Second", "Third", "data", "high".
result.label: Hyphen in compound words

result.description: Fires on the token "UN" (or " UN"), the abbreviation for United Nations, including as a prefix in UNHCR/UNEP/UNESCO. Members detect UN, "Conference", "Nations" and related United Nations context.
result.label: UN abbreviation token

result.description: Fires on the token ' action' (and ' Action'), as in "philosophy of action", "in action", "action potential". Members are mostly detectors of action/actions plus some philosophy-topic context. Silent on text without the word.
result.label: ' action' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'll' piece inside "syllable(s)" after "sy", in linguistics/phonology text. Silent when 'll' starts the text without the preceding "sy".
result.label: 'll' in syllable

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of specific words: 'osh' in Photoshop and ' accept' in acceptance, with weaker hits on 'ust' and 'age' (patronage). Mostly a word-piece detector, with a few unrelated pieces.
result.label: Photoshop 'osh' / acceptance word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Enc' (start of Encoding/Encryption/Encoded), especially after "One-Hot" or at the start of a heading. Weak on a few other word-start fragments. Silent on unrelated data text.
result.label: ' Enc' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word pieces like ' analyt' (in "data analytics") and ' scient' after data-related words. It stays silent on ' analyt' after "predictive" or "descriptive", so it seems to need a preceding "data" context.
result.label: 'analyt' after data context

result.description: Fires on the token ' discuss' (as in "When discussing…" at the start of a document). Members detect discuss/discussion/conversation words and the opening "When it comes". The contrast has no ' discuss' token.
result.label: ' discuss' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ol' when it completes the name "Mongol" (Mongol, Mongolian, Mongolianism). It stays silent on 'ol' in other words such as "rhizolic" or at word start.
result.label: 'ol' in Mongol

result.description: Fires on the word " beyond" (extends/goes/applies beyond X), mostly in abstract or academic text. Upstream members are mainly " beyond" detectors, plus similar words like "outside" and "transcend". The target is silent on text without that word.
result.label: ' beyond' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token "dimensional" in hyphenated compounds like two-dimensional, three-dimensional and infinite-dimensional. Members detect "dimensional" itself plus the preceding hyphen and number prefix. Silent on unrelated contrast text.
result.label: hyphenated "-dimensional" token

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes such as 'an' (mostly in "Raman"), also 'ly' (jelly), 'ent', 'ful', when they complete a split-up word or name. Silent on 'an' in other words like "Nano" or the article "an".
result.label: Suffix 'an' in Raman

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' du' when it starts a longer word (ductility, duality, ducks). Members are mostly detectors of ' du' and of other word-initial fragments (' st', ' stra', ' lat', ' card').
result.label: ' du' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on math-field nouns (geometry, equations, algebra, mathematics) at the end of a phrase, especially in history-of-mathematics text (Babylonian mathematics, algebra and geometry). Silent on "geometry" in physics or differential-geometry contexts.
result.label: Math field nouns in math history

result.description: Fires on the capital ' Y' piece that starts "Yoga" when it is split into tokens (e.g. "Purpose of Yoga", "Jnana Yoga"). It also fires on a few other word-initial pieces like ' UI' and ' U'. Weak on ' liquid'.
result.label: Y- in split word Yoga

result.description: Fires on the word " hard" (also hard- word starts like hardness, hardened) and weakly on " easy"/" easier"/" difficult". Members detect "hard" and its derivatives, mainly in materials-science contexts.
result.label: ' hard' and easy/difficult adjectives

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' enh' (start of enhance, enhancement, enhances), mostly in "to enhance" or "enhancements". Members are mainly detectors of ' enh' and similar prefixes like ' ref'. It is silent on texts about efficiency without that word piece.
result.label: ' enh' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the word " my" (also " myself") when it is mentioned or listed as a word, plus long runs of dashes and some markdown markers. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is only partly faithful.
result.label: ' my' / ' myself' word mentions, dash runs

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "oe" inside rare words like onomatopoeia and thermoelectric, with a weaker case on "and" in "Demand". Mostly a within-word piece detector.
result.label: "oe" inside onomatopoeia/thermoelectric

result.description: Fires on the token "line" as a word ending in compounds (frontline, punchline, streakline, headline). Members are mostly "line"/"lines" detectors in early layers. It stays silent on text without such a word piece.
result.label: "line" ending compound words

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ysis' after a word stem such as 'Catal' in catalysis, and on plural 's' ending 'Conjunctions'. Silent when 'ysis' starts a document with no stem before it.
result.label: -ysis suffix and plural -s

result.description: Fires on a scattered set of tokens (' integration', ' dynamic', ' enabled', ' vast', 'ew', 'ell') with no shared meaning. Members mostly detect odd word pieces from early layers. Silent on 'seamless integration', so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Scattered word pieces, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ive' completing "express|ive" (expressive), mostly after the piece "express". It stays silent on 'ive' in other words like "subjective". Members detect 'ive' endings and 'express' stems.
result.label: 'ive' in "expressive"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' Cla' (as in Clause/Clauses/Clausing) in grammar-related text, with weaker firing on ' normal' (normal forms), ' cer' and 'second'. Mostly a detector of the ' Cla' prefix before 'use'.
result.label: ' Cla' prefix of Clause

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' that begins a four-digit year (e.g. 1958, late 1970s), where the next token is likely '9'. It stays silent on '1' in other positions, such as the third digit of 20[1]0 or 200[1]s.
result.label: Leading '1' of 19xx year

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'land' (also 'lands') when it follows 'g' to spell 'gland', as in 'glandular' or 'gland cells', in endocrine and biology text. Silent on other contexts, including the contrast text about exocrine functions.
result.label: 'land' piece in 'gland'

result.description: Fires on the adjective " modern" (also " Modern", " contemporary"), mostly before a noun such as computing, systems or processors. Members are detectors of modern/contemporary/era words. The contrast text has no such word.
result.label: modern / contemporary adjective

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'ni' (in omnipresent) and 'lic' (in garlic, slicing), plus occasionally ' prof'. Members detect word-start pieces like 'gar', 'om', and 'lic', so it needs the specific partial-word context.
result.label: Word fragments 'ni' and 'lic'

result.description: Fires on ' nas' (nasal) and on fragments of rare multi-byte symbols such as subscript, math, or special characters (Aleph-null, braces, boxes). It also takes Arabic-script token inputs. The peaks are mixed and low in consistency.
result.label: ' nas' and rare symbol bytes
' sensitive' token detector
result.description: Fires on the word ' sensitive' (e.g. sensitive data, sensitive listening, sensitive approach). Members are mostly early-layer detectors of ' sensitive' plus security/vulnerability words. Silent on unrelated text about secure communication that lacks the word.

Fires on the word piece "chan" or " Mechan" in mechanic-/mechanism-type words (Mechanical, biomechanics, mechanisms), at the point where the word is incomplete. Members are detectors of mechan/chan pieces.
result.label: Mechan- word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' nan' (or ' Nan') when it begins nano- words such as nanotechnology, nanomaterial, nanoscale, in scientific materials text. Members detect ' nan' and materials/technology context.
result.label: nan- prefix of nano words

result.description: Fires on digit tokens (mostly 1, 3, 2) inside slash-separated lists of numbers, such as 3/4/4/11/10/15. It stays silent on digits starting years in prose, like "in 1980".
result.label: Digits in slash-separated number lists

result.description: Fires on the word " cost" (rarely " portion") when it starts a compound or modifier, such as "food cost percentage" or "cost-cutting", in restaurant and food-business text. Members are mostly cost/costs detectors plus cooking-topic ones.
result.label: ' cost' in food-cost compounds

result.description: Fires on the abstract noun right after "and" in a coordinated noun pair in organizational or HR-style text (e.g. "compensation and benefits", "management and feedback", "learning and growth"). It stays quiet on the same nouns outside that slot, such as "development" after an adjective.
result.label: Second noun in "X and Y" pair

result.description: Fires on linear-algebra vocabulary such as "basis", "independence", "dimensionality" and "vector", mostly in "a basis" or "linear independence" contexts. It stays silent on "basis" after "each" or "fundamental". Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Linear algebra terms (basis, independence)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ement' ending "Agreement", especially in "North American Free Trade Agreement" in treaty contexts. It stays silent on 'ement' in "refinement" and "confinement".
result.label: 'ement' in Agreement (treaties)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cul' (as in culinary, culminates) in the middle of a sentence. It is silent when ' cul' is the very first token of the text. Members detect ' cul' itself plus cooking and food context.
result.label: ' cul' piece (culinary)

result.description: Fires on the space token right after "ISO" (before standard numbers like ISO 14001), and sometimes on " Trans" in a title. It stays silent on spaces before years or other numbers, so it needs the ISO standard context.
result.label: Space after ISO before number

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'il', 'ic', 'ol' in the middle of a word, strongest on 'il' in "Soil" at the start of a heading-like line. Silent on 'ic' in other words such as Metabolic or Economic.
result.label: 'il' in Soil, word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on nouns of struggle and opposition (' struggle', ' conflict(s)', 'confront-ations') in analytical or historical/literary prose about ideological, psychological or military clashes. Members detect struggle, conflict, war and difficulty words.
result.label: struggle / conflict nouns

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ion' (also 'er', 'es') when it completes the word "cohesion" or the start of "coherence/coherent" after 'coh'/'cohes'. It stays silent on 'ion' in other words like "prevention".
result.label: Suffix in cohesion/coherence

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'icult' in "multicultural(ism)" and 'ational' in "organizational", before the word's ending. Silent on other culture-related words like "cultural" or "linguistic diversity".
result.label: multicult-/organiz-ational word pieces
Capitalized "Language" as list heading
result.description: Fires on the capitalized token ' Language' when it starts a heading or list item, such as "Language Assessment" or "Language Policy" in a series of topic headings. It is nearly silent on "Languages" as a list item, and only weakly active on lowercase "language".
Fires on the mid-word piece 'lin' in "pollination" and related words (pollinators, pollinated), after the 'pol' piece. It stays silent when 'lin' starts a word. Weaker on ' vs' and 'loyment'.
result.label: 'lin' in pollination

result.description: Fires on the word "Menu" (or "menu"), especially as a heading at the start of a line or document, such as "Menu Theme." or "Menu Balance." in restaurant menu-design outlines. Members are mostly "Menu" detectors.
result.label: Menu token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' fl' when it starts a longer word such as flour, flute, fluctuations or flourishes. Members are mostly ' fl' token detectors from early layers. Silent on text without this piece.
result.label: ' fl' word-start piece
'vere' in sovereignty
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vere' in "sovereignty" (so|vere|ignty), mostly in political or international-relations text. It fires weakly on ' strict' and 'dis'. Predicts word continuations such as 'ance'.

Fires on the word "cluster" (and the piece "clust" in "clustering") in technical text about star or galaxy clusters and clustering algorithms. Members mostly detect cluster/clust/clustering tokens. Silent on the contrast passage about galaxies.
result.label: cluster / clustering token

result.description: Fires on the word right after "imagine" (mostly " a", also " you", " this", " if"), as in "imagine a world where...". Silent on " a" in other constructions. Members detect "imagine".
result.label: Word after "imagine"

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' directly after a leading "2" in 21st-century years (2000, 2003, 2010, 2000s). It stays silent on '0' after 19x/198/195 (decade digits like 1990s).
result.label: Zero in 2000s years

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Spe" at the start of a line or heading, where the next piece is "ech" (e.g. "Speech Evaluation", "Speech Topics"). Weakly fires on other word-start fragments. Members are many "Spe" detectors.
result.label: Spe- start of "Speech" headings

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece ' med' when it begins "meditation"/"meditative" in yoga and spiritual-practice text. It also fires weakly on ' Indian' and ' conclus'. Members are mostly detectors of word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' med' in meditation

result.description: Fires on the word piece "itable" completing "equ|itable" (equitable), mostly before nouns like distribution or public transportation. Members detect the "equ" prefix plus "itable"/"ity" pieces. Silent on related fairness text without that word.
result.label: "equitable" suffix piece 'itable'

result.description: Fires on the newline/paragraph-break token (shown as ¶) that ends a short list item or heading line, such as "Language Promotion." in a list of topics. Silent on a break at the very start of a document.
result.label: Newline after short list item

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' bar' when it begins "barriers" (e.g. "high barriers", "barriers to entry"), predicting the continuation "riers". Members are mostly detectors of ' bar' and 'riers'.
result.label: ' bar' start of 'barriers'

result.description: Fires on the second piece of "woodcut"/"woodblock" ('cut', 'block') in printmaking text, after "wood". Weakly fires on other print terms such as silkscreen printing. Members detect 'wood', 'cut', and print/art words.
result.label: woodcut / woodblock printmaking

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of technical terms, mainly 'osph' in phosphate and 'ain' in "Supply Chain", also 'ric' and 'cyt'/'et' in biochemical words. Mostly chemistry/biology word fragments.
result.label: Word fragments: osph, chain

result.description: Fires on " bodies" as the head noun after "water" (water bodies). Weaker on other uses like "these bodies". Members include detectors of bodies/body and water-related words.
result.label: "bodies" after water

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ars' inside 'rehearsal(s)', the middle token of the split word. Members are mostly 'ars' detectors from early layers. Weak activation on a few other mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'ars' in rehearsal

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' rig' at the start of rigorous, rigidity or rigid, in academic and philosophical text. It also partly fires on the similar piece ' vig' in vigorous. Members detect ' rig' and 'orous'.
result.label: ' rig' in rigorous/rigid

result.description: Fires on the word " Law" in named scientific laws (Kepler's Third Law, Ampere's Law, Hooke's Law, Second Law). Weaker on lowercase "laws". Members are detectors of Law/law tokens.
result.label: Law in named physical laws

result.description: Fires on process nouns or noun-ending pieces (growth, differentiation, fertilization, replication, division, detection) in biology text about cell development and reproduction. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Biological process noun endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' emer' that begins "emergency", "emergence" or "emerging", mostly mid-sentence before "-gency". Members are mainly ' emer' detectors from early layers. The contrast text has no ' emer' token.
result.label: ' emer' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the 'NN' token in neural-network acronyms like RNN and CNN (R-NN, C-NN), in machine-learning text. Weak activation on a few other word-piece endings.
result.label: NN in RNN/CNN acronyms

result.description: Fires mainly on ' gates' (51 of 64 peaks), especially in "quantum gates" or "logic gates". It also fires weakly on a few unrelated word endings. Members include detectors for gate and quantum bits.
result.label: ' gates' in quantum/logic gates

result.description: Fires on Cyrillic word pieces like 'мо', 'ла', 'ско' and ' свои' inside garbled, scrambled Russian-like text. Weak elsewhere. Members are mostly Arabic and Cyrillic character detectors, so it looks like a noisy-text fragment feature.
result.label: Cyrillic fragments in garbled text

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' in', ' of', ' sub', 'ing', ' left') in academic or technical prose, often after a noun like "change in" or "consolidation of". Silent on many ' in' tokens, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Scattered ' in'/' of' in academic prose

result.description: Fires on the equals sign ' =' in mathematical or physics equations and assignments (E = hf, n = k, y' = y). It stays silent when '=' is missing and the equality is written in words.
result.label: Equals sign in equations

result.description: Fires on the word " from" right after a verb or noun of change or movement, such as "shift from", "shifted from", "transitioned from", "moved from". It marks the source in a "from X to Y" transition. It stays silent in text without this construction.
result.label: 'from' after shift/change words

result.description: Fires on ' Theorem' (also ' Law', ' theorem') ending a named result, e.g. "Stokes' Theorem", "Central Limit Theorem", "Antitrust Law". It needs a preceding name or modifier; the bare word in a summary context stays silent.
result.label: Named Theorem / Law ending

result.description: Fires on ' as' in the "such as" construction, introducing examples after a noun. It stays silent on other uses of ' as', such as "as well as", "emerged as" or the causal "as".
result.label: "as" in "such as"

result.description: Fires on the token ' news' (e.g. "consume news", "mobile news applications", "news reporting"), always in media-related text. Weak activation on 'emotion'. Upstream members are mostly ' news' token detectors plus media/information words.
result.label: ' news' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ities' completing the word "opportunities" (after "opportun"), strongest in phrases like "offer/provide opportunities for". Silent on 'ities' in other words such as "humanities".
result.label: 'ities' ending "opportunities"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'bo' in "hyperbole" (also "carbohydrate"), plus 'mos' and ' Napoleon'. It is a within-word piece detector for a few multi-token words; the evidence is mixed and the weaker contexts are unrelated.
result.label: 'bo' in hyperbole/carbohydrate

result.description: Fires on ' directed' (as in directed graph) and on word pieces like 'it' in 'epitaxial' or 'parasitic' and 'ed' endings. Mixed tokens; the ' directed' case is silent when it starts the text.
result.label: 'directed' and 'it'/'ed' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' polar' (as in polarization, polar solvents), mostly in physics and chemistry text. Members are mainly detectors of ' polar' and 'ization' tokens; the output pushes toward word completions such as -ized/-ity.
result.label: ' polar' word-start token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ament", mostly in "orn|ament|ation" (ornamentation) and similar words like fundamentals, filament, testament. Members detect "ament", "orn" and related word pieces.
result.label: "ament" piece in ornamentation

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside specific rare proper-name words, mainly 'antine' in Diophantine/Byzantine and 'anner' in Mannerist/Mannerism. It needs the preceding fragment of that word.
result.label: 'antine' / 'anner' word endings

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract head noun (legend, case, problem, idea, aspect) in academic or math text. It stays silent on ' of' after words like hints, instead, phase and seekers.
result.label: ' of' after abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the token " van"/" Van" (also the "van" in "vanishing"), typically as a surname particle before names like Gogh or Rijn. Predicts a following name piece. Weaker on a few unrelated words.
result.label: ' van' name particle

result.description: Fires on the token ' aircraft' in aeronautical engineering text (aircraft design, flow, behavior). Members detect aerospace words such as aircraft, space, astronaut and aerospace. Weak activation on ' Sold' is incidental.
result.label: ' aircraft' in aerospace engineering text

result.description: Fires on topical modifier or noun words like "environmental", "economic", "energy", and the "ain" in "sustainable", in science, energy and policy text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the exact trigger is unclear.
result.label: Energy/environment/economic topic words

result.description: Fires on begin/start verbs (' begins', ' starts', ' begin', ' Start'), mostly when they introduce a "begin with..." phrase or a first step or stage. Members detect begin/start tokens and "with" after them.
result.label: begin/start verbs

result.description: Fires on the token " addition" when used as a noun for the process or operation (e.g. addition polymerization, electrophilic addition, addition rule). Windows are mostly chemistry and math. Members are mostly detectors of " addition".
result.label: ' addition' as process noun

result.description: Fires on "wider" and "broader" (including the split piece "ader" after "bro"), and weakly on "broad(ens)". It marks comparative adjectives of breadth or extent that come before a noun like scope, range or distribution.
result.label: wider / broader comparatives

result.description: Fires on the 'bach' piece in the name "Goldbach" (Goldbach's Conjecture), after 'Gold'. Rare weaker firing on other mid-word pieces. Silent on the conjecture text without that name.
result.label: 'bach' in Goldbach

result.description: Fires on a sentence- or heading-ending period (or ").") that closes a short phrase or heading line, often before a newline and a new item. It stays silent on periods inside initials or names like "T." or "W.".
result.label: Sentence-final period after headings

result.description: Fires on the piece "ant" completing "Protestant" (e.g. "Protestant Ethic", "Protestant countries"). Members detect "Protest" and the "ant" token, plus Reformation and Church context. It stays silent on other religious text without that word.
result.label: "ant" in Protestant

result.description: Fires on enabling/facilitating verbs such as "enables", "helps", "helping", "enabling" (also "allows"), typically after a subject or clause and before an object that benefits. Members mostly detect enable/allow/help tokens.
result.label: enable/help verbs

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al'/'als' completing "numeral(s)", mostly in math-history text about Arabic or Indian numeral systems. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as "instrumental" and "positional".
result.label: numer-al suffix in numeral

result.description: Fires on a few adjective-like words, mainly " external" and " unexpected", also "ended" (unintended) and " concurrent". Members include detectors for external and unexpected. Peaks are mixed across words, with weaker firing on "external magnetic".
result.label: external / unexpected adjectives

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'io' inside "ultraviolet" (ultrav-io-let). Members detect 'io' and related mid-word fragments. Weaker firing on other mid-word pieces like "cel" in porcelain.
result.label: 'io' in ultraviolet

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' real' at the start of a longer word or compound (realm, realistic, realism, real-world, real-time). It predicts word continuations. It is silent on unrelated contrast text.
result.label: ' real' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word " number"/" Number" when it ends a technical compound term such as quantum number, Mach Number, Reynolds Number, prime number. Weaker on generic "a number of".
result.label: Technical term-final "number"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " probabil" (as in probabilistic, probabilities) when split into subword pieces. It is silent on the whole word "probability". Members detect " probabil" and similar word-start fragments such as relativ, lingu and permut.
result.label: ' probabil' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires mostly on ' of' (also ' to', ' in') right after abstract nouns of difficulty or challenge, like "complexity of", "difficulty of", "danger of". It stays silent on ' of' after nouns like "form", "member", "interplay".
result.label: ' of' after difficulty/challenge nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece " posit" at the start of "positivism", "positivists" and "positives", especially after "logical" or "true/false". It is silent on related philosophy text that lacks the piece.
result.label: " posit" word piece (positivism/positives)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words split into pieces, mainly ' coh' (cohomology, coherence), also ' strateg', ' rel' (relays), ' gre'. Fires mid-word, when more pieces are expected next.
result.label: Word-start fragments: coh, strateg, rel

result.description: Fires on the token piece "ios" right after "b" in "bios..." words, mainly "biosensors" and "biosensory". It is silent in other biology text, such as the citric acid cycle text in the contrast.
result.label: "ios" in "bio-" words

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' influ' (influences) and ' mus' (musicians), where the next piece completes the word. Weaker on whole-word starts. Silent on plain words in the contrast.
result.label: Word-start pieces influ- / mus-

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' bro' when it begins a longer word (broiler, broadening, broader, broth), anticipating a continuation piece. Members are mostly ' bro' and 'ader' detectors.
result.label: ' bro' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' property' in both senses (ownership/real property and attribute of a substance). Members are detectors of property/properties/material/premises tokens. Weakly fires on ' characteristic' and ' properties'.
result.label: ' property' token detector

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verb "has"/"have" (present perfect), including when the forms are mentioned in grammar discussion. Members detect has/have and predict "been", "always", "become" next. Silent on text about tenses that lacks the word.
result.label: Auxiliary has/have (present perfect)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ca' inside "concave" (Con-ca-ve, Bicon-ca-ve), the middle piece of the word. Weaker on other mid-word pieces after "con"/"c" prefixes.
result.label: 'ca' in concave

result.description: Fires on the token " questions" (plural), mostly after a modifier such as reflective, rhetorical, philosophical, probing or indirect. Members are mainly detectors of "question(s)" tokens. Silent on contrast text with no such token.
result.label: ' questions' after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'duct' inside "superconductor/superconductivity/superconducting". It stays silent on 'duct' in "semiconductor", so it needs the "supercon-" prefix.
result.label: 'duct' in superconductor words

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ien' in words like alienation and audiences, and 'y' in catchy. Members detect word pieces after 'al'/'aud' prefixes (loy, ph, ve, -). Silent on ordinary running text.
result.label: Mid-word 'ien' piece (alienation, audiences)
'ers' ending in "followers"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ers' completing the word "followers" (after "follow"). It is much weaker on other -ers/-ants words such as landowners and merchants, and silent on 'ers' in fosters, consumers or "umers".

Fires on the word-piece ' en' when it begins a longer word (enlargement, enriching, enzyme, enabling, encompasses). Members are mostly detectors of ' en' itself; output favors continuations like 'hanced', 'abling', 'velope'.
result.label: ' en' word-initial prefix

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'ots' in "grassroots" (also in knots) and 'es' in "challenges", after the preceding fragments 'grass'/'alleng'. Silent on 'ots' in "green shoots", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: grassroots / challenges word endings

result.description: Fires mostly on " ever" (e.g. "than ever before", "Will X ever", "ever-evolving") and on the "ro" piece at the start of "Electro-" words like electrode, electrolysis. Also weakly on " proportional".
result.label: " ever" and "Electro-" ro

result.description: Fires on the token 'BI' when it completes an acronym after a capital letter, as in "C[BI]" for Content-Based Instruction. It stays silent when 'BI' starts the text, with no preceding letter.
result.label: BI in acronym CBI
Memory as heading in computing topics
result.description: Fires mostly on " Memory" as a title or heading word in computer-architecture outlines (Cache Memory, Virtual Memory, Memory Management). Weaker on " mini" and "ic". Members are mostly detectors of "memory"/"Memory" tokens.
Fires on the plural suffix (-ts, -als, -ians, -s) completing a person-role noun like experts, professionals, historians, analysts, usually in lists of professions or groups of people.
result.label: Plural agent-noun endings (experts, professionals)

result.description: Fires on a mix of tokens: the suffix 'ous' inside words like "warehousing", and the words ' separate', ' distinct' and ' low'. The 'ous' peak is silent in "ambiguous" and "simultaneous". Peaks are mixed and the logits are not informative.
result.label: ous / separate / distinct mixed detector

result.description: Fires on the word " sentence" (occasionally " paragraph") in grammar and writing-instruction text, e.g. "topic sentence" or "sentence types". It is silent when " sentence" starts the text with no preceding word.
result.label: Grammar term " sentence"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ir" inside "squirrel"/"squirting" (after "squ"). Weaker on other mid-word pieces. Silent on "ir" in other words like "tiosir". Members detect "ir" and "squ" pieces.
result.label: "ir" in "squirrel"

result.description: Fires on ' algorithm(s)' / 'Algorithm' (including 'algorithmic'), especially in art-related text about algorithmic art. Silent on 'learning algorithms' in a machine-learning context, so it seems to need an art or creative-technique context.
result.label: algorithm in art contexts
'vent' piece in "solvent"
result.description: Fires on the token 'vent' when it completes "solvent" (sol|vent), mostly in chemistry or green-chemistry text. It weakly fires on 'vent' in "invention" and on a few other word pieces. Members are mostly 'vent' detectors.

Fires on the word " important" in the construction "it is important to...", where it introduces an infinitive. Weaker on "particularly important". Members are mostly detectors of " important" and similar words such as critical and essential.
result.label: "is important to" adjective

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside long or rare words, mainly 'th' in "plethora"/"plethysmography" and 'ic' in "Hyperbolic". Silent on 'th' in "20th" or "fostereth". Members detect earlier pieces like "ple", "bol", "bi".
result.label: Mid-word piece in rare words

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' as the first digit of a number at or near the start of a document or list item (e.g. "1.10", "10.", "11."). Weaker on '1' beginning years like 1837 or 18th; silent on '1' inside later positions of numbers like 2010 or 21st.
result.label: Leading digit '1' at number start

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "oring" in "Exploring", "ving" in "Delving", and "law" in "flawless", mostly at the start of a document or phrase as the opening of an explore/delve-into style title or sentence. Mixed suffix pieces.
result.label: Explore/delve word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on ' acid' (and 'ids') in chemistry text about acids, e.g. carboxylic, citric, acid dissociation. Also weakly on pieces like 'pect' in Respect and 'adj' in adjacency. Silent on 'acid rain' in a casual context.
result.label: Acid in chemistry contexts

result.description: Fires on the token ' error', most strongly in "quantum error correction", and weakly on 'errors' elsewhere. Predicts ' correction' next. Members include error-token detectors and quantum-context detectors.
result.label: 'error' in quantum error correction

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' completing "elasticity" (after "elast"/"astic"), in physics/economics text. It stays silent on 'ity' in other words like scarcity, viscosity, electricity and individuality.
result.label: 'ity' ending "elasticity"

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract or technical head noun (rule of, choreography of, powers of, points of) in academic or math/science text. It stays quieter after quantity or study nouns like 'sum of', 'number of', 'study of'.
result.label: ' of' after abstract head noun

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "replicate" forms (rep-lic-ating, -licated, -lication), mostly in DNA replication text. It stays silent on other "-ating" endings like facilitating or coordinating, so it needs the replic- stem.
result.label: replicating/replicated word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ather" in "Rather" at the start of a sentence (often "Rather than"), also in "Weather" and "gatherers". It stays silent in "feather". Weakly fires on " remain(s)".
result.label: "ather" piece, sentence-initial Rather

result.description: Fires on the token ' typing' in programming-language type-system discussion, as in "strong typing", "dynamic typing" and "static typing". Its inputs include several ' typing' detectors and programming-context members.
result.label: ' typing' in type systems

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' Liter', ' Roc', ' Art'/' art' that begin a topic or subject-list entry (e.g. "Literary ..." in lists of categories), mostly in art/literature heading lists. Silent on the plain "Art." list item.
result.label: Liter/Art word-start in topic lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Real" when it starts a longer word, as in Realism, Realists or Fantasy Realms. It is a word-start piece that needs a suffix to follow. Members mostly detect " Real" itself, plus other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' Real' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word ' large' (size adjective), mostly before nouns like datasets, numbers, or solution spaces in technical or computational text. Members detect large/massive/small/grand size words. Predicts quantity-type nouns next.
result.label: ' large' size adjective

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'ir' (Sap-ir, Stirling, Langmuir) and 'le' in "Role", i.e. word pieces within particular split words. Silent on ordinary text.
result.label: 'ir' and 'le' word pieces

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' achieved'/' achieve', 'ounded' in "Boundedness", 'ery', ' compatibility'. No shared meaning is evident, and the members are scattered word-piece and past-participle detectors.
result.label: Mixed: achieved, Bounded, -ery pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " nature" as an abstract noun after an adjective (dynamic, intermittent, variable nature), plus a few similar nouns like "ability", "inherent", "dependence". Many members are early-layer detectors of " nature". Silent where no such noun appears.
result.label: Abstract "nature" after adjective

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment " ex" (exerts, exposes, exaggerated, exoplanets), and occasionally on " c", " syn" or "en" in academic text. It predicts a continuation that completes the word, such as "poses" or "changes".
result.label: Word-initial " ex" fragment

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces, such as ' Hel' (Heliobacter, Helmut), ' rib' (ribosome) and ' Ab' (Abugida). It's a word-start piece that needs a continuation, and it stays silent on whole names.
result.label: Word-initial fragments Hel, rib, Ab

result.description: Fires on the verb " help" (also helps/helping) when it takes a subject like a technology or method and is followed by an object and a verb, as in "X can help cities reduce...". Members are mostly help/assist/enable detectors.
result.label: verb "help" before an object

result.description: Fires on the document-start/separator token (shown as ¶) when it comes after a finished short entry in a list of items, such as names or topics, with a new entry about to start. Silent when it is the very first token of the text.
result.label: Separator token between list entries

result.description: Fires on the token ' s' when it is a word-initial fragment starting a split word (s|yllogism, s|ieve, s|lip, s|aturation), not on 's' as an ordinary word. Predicts continuation pieces of the word.
result.label: Word-initial ' s' fragment
'al' in nasal word
result.description: Fires on the piece 'al' when it completes "nas|al" (nasal, nasalization), in linguistics text. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as reveal, lateral or consonantal.
Fires on the word piece "let" inside multi-piece words, mainly "Ske|let|al" (skeletal, exoskeletons), also wavelet and Ballet. Members are "let" detectors and word-start pieces.
result.label: "let" piece in skeletal

result.description: Fires on ' remote' (as in remote sensing) and on ' Aug' at the start of "Augmented Reality", a word-initial piece of a technical term. Weaker on other word fragments like "etic" and "ide". Members detect ' remote' and sensing-related tokens.
result.label: ' remote' and ' Aug' in tech terms

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "ivity" in "conductivity" and "chem" in "electrochemical"/"petrochemicals", within physical-science and chemistry terms. Silent on "ivity" in "connectivity" and "reactivity".
result.label: Conductivity / electrochem word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " creating" (also "creates"/"create"), mostly as a participle after a comma or "and" that introduces an effect or result, as in "creating tension". Members include detectors of create-type words.
result.label: ' creating' participle token

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments such as 'ao' (Daoism), 'al' in "Moral" at title starts, ' curv', and ' Sto', where the word is unfinished. The logits are mixed and give no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ao, al, curv

result.description: Fires on the token " Hand" (also "Hand"), mostly as a word-start piece in Handel, Handbook, Handling or Hand Washing. Weaker on " promise(s)" and " other". Members are mostly detectors of word-initial fragments.
result.label: Hand word-start piece

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "period" (e.g., "period of time", "Classical Period of music"). It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "advent", "pulse" or "redefinition".
result.label: " of" after "period"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' encou' (and ' encourag') in forms of "encourage", especially mid-word before "rage", as in "rates encourage borrowing". Predicts the continuation "rage". Also weakly fires on some stray tokens like ' \['.
result.label: encourage word-piece (encou-)

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'chn' and 'chem' inside bio- compounds such as biotechnology and biochemical, after a 'bio' or 'biote' prefix. It stays silent on 'chem' in electrochemistry.
result.label: chn/chem after bio- prefix

result.description: Fires on the ending piece 'ine'/'ines' completing the word "vaccine(s)", after the 'vacc' piece. It stays silent on 'ines' in other words such as "examines". Members detect 'vacc' and 'ine' pieces.
result.label: vaccine(s) word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' creation', typically as a noun in phrases like "content creation" or "the creation of". Members are mostly ' creation' detectors plus similar -tion nouns such as generation and separation.
result.label: ' creation' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "mathematics" (also "mathematical", "Mathemat-") as the noun naming the field, e.g. "foundations of mathematics", "modern mathematics". Members are token detectors for mathematics and related math terms.
result.label: Word "mathematics"

result.description: Fires on the single letter 'l' (or 'L') as a standalone token, often a mid-word fragment such as phytop|l|ankton, over|l|ays or the quantum number m_l. Members are mostly 'l' token detectors.
result.label: Isolated letter 'l' token

result.description: Fires on stray punctuation-like symbol tokens such as ' _', ' *', and ' \[' in garbled lists, markup or math fragments, often after commas. Members are mostly topic hubs for language and grammar text, plus Arabic piece detectors. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Stray underscore/asterisk symbols in lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces 'iqu' in "etiquette" and 'opher' in "philosopher", i.e. the middle or end of a specific multi-piece word after an 'et'/'philos' start. Members detect 'et' + piece fragments.
result.label: etiquette / philosopher word pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, most often 'ous' in "nervous (system)", also ' Vo', 'F', ' recip'. It is silent on 'ous' in "ubiquitous" and sometimes in "Central Nervous", so it depends on the specific word.
result.label: Word-piece 'ous' in nervous

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'as' in persuasive, 'qu' in tranquil, and 'ul'/'bul' in turbulent. These pieces sit inside longer, multi-token words, mainly "persuasive". Upstream members detect 'as' and ' persu'.
result.label: Mid-word piece in persuasive/tranquil

result.description: Fires on hyphens inside letter-by-letter spellings and mid-word fragments (s-f-l-o-w, 'ron' in micron, 'orous' in humorous). Silent on hyphens in ordinary compounds like high-performance or left-handed.
result.label: Hyphen in spelled-out words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uct' inside "deductive"/"deducing" (after "ded"), in logic and reasoning text. It stays silent when 'uct' starts the text with no "ded" before it.
result.label: 'uct' in "deductive"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ly' right after 'smooth' (smoothly), especially describing manner of motion. Silent on 'ly' in other words like 'unwittingly' or 'orderly'. Members detect 'smooth' and -ness/-ly suffixes.
result.label: 'ly' in 'smoothly'

result.description: Fires on the 't' token of negative contractions (n't: wasn't, can't, don't, didn't), after the apostrophe. Silent on 't' inside words like fine-tuning. Predicts continuations like "just".
result.label: Contraction n't 't' token

result.description: Fires on the adverb " greatly" (occasionally " significantly") as an intensifier before or after a verb like enhance, improve, contribute or affect. Members are detectors of greatly, significantly, substantial and similar degree adverbs.
result.label: ' greatly' degree adverb

result.description: Fires mostly on " West" (the West / West Germany / West Berlin) and on "MD" in abbreviations like HMDs, with a few stray tokens. Mixed word pieces; the contrast text only has "Western", where it stays silent.
result.label: ' West' and 'MD' token pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ho' in "Khoisan"/"Khoikhoi" and 'ased' in "unbiased". It depends on being inside those specific words, after a K- or unbi- prefix. Members detect 'ho' and name-fragment tokens.
result.label: 'ho' in Khoisan, 'ased' in unbiased
'ent' in 'inherent'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ent' completing 'inher-ent' (also 'trinsic'-type pieces like 'insic'), mostly in abstract academic text. Silent on unrelated text. Members are mostly 'ent' token detectors.
Fires on the word " sample" used as a modifier in statistics text (sample mean, sample data, sample size, sample to sample). Silent when " sample" starts a text fragment with no preceding context.
result.label: statistical " sample" modifier

result.description: Fires on the token " brand" in marketing text, as in brand performance, brand equity or brand loyalty. It is silent when "brand" starts a text with no marketing context before it.
result.label: ' brand' in marketing text

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'overy' (Discovery, Recovery) and sometimes 'l' in 'bowl', ' term', and similar mid-word fragments. Members mostly detect 'overy' and other word-start fragments.
result.label: 'overy' word-piece in Discovery/Recovery

result.description: Fires on the 'n' piece inside the word "remnants" (rem|n|ants), after the "rem" prefix. It stays silent on 'n' in other words such as supernova or cannibalism. Members detect "rem" word pieces.
result.label: 'n' in "remnants"

result.description: Fires on the copula ' was' (and ' were', weaker ' is') right after a noun-phrase subject, especially a sentence-initial or clause-initial subject like a topic noun. Silent after pronoun 'it' or in some other slots.
result.label: Copula 'was/were' after noun subject

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like plural 's', 'ing' at the start of grammar/error-themed text (conjunctions, Errors, Correcting). Silent on possessive 's. Members detect error words (mis, incorrect) and grammar terms.
result.label: Plural/suffix pieces in grammar-error text

result.description: Fires on the second word piece after a capital "A" at the start of a word or acronym (A|IC, A|est-hetic, A|do-pting, A|lib-aba), i.e. mid-word fragments following an initial "A". Predicts word continuations.
result.label: Word piece following initial "A"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Ag' (as in Agile, Agenda) when it begins a word, mostly in title-like text. Members are mainly ' Ag' token detectors. It pushes the next token toward suffix pieces like 'ics', 'pl', 'ic'.
result.label: ' Ag' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' mainly after "eth" (ethical), and weakly on 'able' in "sustainable". It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like philosophical, hierarchical, ecological.
result.label: 'ical' in "ethical"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'loy' inside 'unemployed' / 'employee' (after 'emp'), and more weakly on 'ment' in 'employment'. Needs the employment-word context; 'loy' in 'alloy' is not supported by the members.
result.label: 'loy' in unemployed/employee

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after a verb like "setting", "getting", or "reflect", especially in "setting the tone/pace". Stays quiet on ' the' after prepositions such as "of", "in", or "throughout".
result.label: ' the' after setting/verb

result.description: Fires on the nouns ' decision' (decision-making, decision fatigue) and ' independence' (esp. 'linear independence'). Members are detectors of these tokens and their variants. Silent on other linear algebra text.
result.label: ' decision' / ' independence' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Tra'/' tra' (start of Traffic, trait, traumatic), most strongly on ' Tra' beginning a line in a list of engineering topics such as "Traffic Safety". Mostly a token detector with an early-layer feel.
result.label: ' Tra' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the token "life" when it ends a hyphenated compound, most clearly "half-life", also "work-life" and "wildlife". Silent on unrelated text. Members mostly detect "life" itself at earlier layers.
result.label: "life" in hyphenated compounds (half-life)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "atable" in "relatable", and weakly on other mid-word fragments like "aint" in "uncertainties", "ations" in "Quotations" and "ie" in "Lucie". It needs the piece to sit inside a longer word.
result.label: "atable" suffix in relatable

result.description: Fires on the 'ass' piece (or 'agr') inside the word "seagrass"/"seagrasses", in marine ecosystem text. It stays silent on 'ass' in other words like "encompass" or "biomass".
result.label: 'ass' in seagrass

result.description: Fires on the word piece " fa" when it starts "facial" (as in facial expressions or action units). It predicts continuations like "cial", and the circuit leans on face and expression context plus " fa" detectors.
result.label: " fa" start of "facial"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'gar' in "Edgar" (also avant-garde), and weakly on ' built' and ' dot'. It is silent on 'gar' in "Medgar", so it needs the preceding "Ed" piece.
result.label: 'gar' in Edgar

result.description: Fires on " also" after a subject or auxiliary verb (is also, should also, can also, may also). Stays silent when "also" follows "while" or "but", or starts a sentence.
result.label: " also" after auxiliary or verb
Final 'I' of acronym AI
result.description: Fires on the final letter 'I' of the acronym "AI" (also 'L' in RL, 'T' in RT) when it ends a capitalised acronym, mostly in AI-related technical text. Silent on the spelled-out phrase "machine learning".
Fires on the word-piece ' div' (start of divide/divides/dividing), strongest in "cultural divides"; weakly on other split-word pieces like ' cons' and ' dep'. Predicts suffixes such as 'ides'.
result.label: ' div' word-piece before -ides

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "ine" in "decline" and "orient" in "-oriented", plus occasionally " hidden" or " invisible". Mostly a mid-word piece detector, with members detecting "ine" after "decl".
result.label: decl-ine / -orient word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word "demand"/"demanded" in economic contexts, and on the pieces "and" and "ly" completing "Demand and Supply" in a question about economics definitions. Members are mostly "demand" detectors plus economics context.
result.label: Economic "demand" and Demand/Supply

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces 'iation' (differentiation, negotiation, mediation, aviation) and 'y' ending abstract nouns like sovereignty or philosophy. Needs the preceding word stem to complete such a noun.
result.label: Abstract-noun suffix: -iation / -y

result.description: Fires on the token ' concept' (also 'concepts' and the 'concept' piece of 'conceptual/conceptualized'), mostly in academic, linguistic or philosophical text. Members are mainly detectors of 'concept' plus linguistics/philosophy context words.
result.label: ' concept' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix piece "ities" completing "externalities" (and "Securities"), and on " Des" at word start. Members detect "ities"/"ity" endings and the word " external". Weaker on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: "ities" suffix in externalities

result.description: Fires on scattered word fragments and mid-word pieces (ini, ohen, fug, az, boy) that begin or continue rare or multi-token words, with no single token dominating. Members are mostly token-level detectors of odd subword pieces.
result.label: Rare word-fragment pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " matrix" (occasionally " space") in linear algebra text, e.g. "square matrix", "inverse matrix", "vector space". Members are mostly matrix-token detectors plus math-topic context.
result.label: matrix in linear algebra
Mid-word pieces: tapest, hydroxide, heterogeneous
result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of specific multi-piece words, mainly 'apest' (tapestry), 'ogeneous' (heterogeneous/homogeneous) and 'x' in hydroxide, with a few weak function-word hits. Evidence is mixed and the contrast is not informative.
Fires mostly on the piece 'bad' inside 'troubadour(s)', with weaker firing on ' too' and 'ue' in 'venue'. Members are 'bad' detectors, so it is mainly a word-piece detector for 'troubadour'.
result.label: 'bad' in troubadour

result.description: Fires on the word piece " surv" at the start of survival/survive/surviving, mostly in survival analysis text. It also fires weakly on " capt" in "captiv". Members are detectors of surv and ival.
result.label: ' surv' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the capital letter 'Y' as a word piece inside uppercase or split words (ARYABHATIYA, COSY, PPHPHYZERCY, High-Yielding). Weak activation on ' body' in "the body's". Silent on ordinary text without such a piece.
result.label: Capital Y word-piece
Word-initial fragments Relig/Ro/Cir
result.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word near the start of a document or title, mainly ' Relig', ' Ro' (as in "The Role of"), and ' Cir'. It seems to predict the word's continuation. Members are mostly generic.

Fires mainly on the word piece "ach" in "Outreach" (also in other "ach" pieces such as Bhaskaracharya), with weaker firing on " fun" and " jo". Members are mostly detectors of "ach" and similar word pieces.
result.label: "ach" piece in Outreach

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of a document-initial title or heading, mainly ' Bi' in "Biomedical", also ' farm' and ' restaur'. Culinary-themed members contribute, but the peak is mostly the start-of-document ' Bi'.
result.label: Document-initial ' Bi' (Biomedical) token

result.description: Fires on ' concept' and ' notion' (also ' idea') as a head noun after "the", typically before "of X" in academic or scientific explanations. Silent when the word starts a sentence or is a prefix of "conceptualization".
result.label: concept/notion after "the"

result.description: Fires on the "ages" piece after "w" in the word "wages" (also "age" in "wage and hour"), mostly in labor-economics text. Weaker on other "w"-initial word pieces.
result.label: "ages" in "wages"

result.description: Fires on the word " legal" (adjective before nouns like procedures, regimes, documents) and on "utter" inside "shutter" in photography text. Two unrelated tokens share the latent; the contrast text has neither.
result.label: ' legal' and 'shutter' piece

result.description: Fires on " also" (rarely "accordingly", "thus") as an adverb placed before a main verb, as in "have also evolved" or "can also dampen". It stays quiet after "but also", "while also", or at the start of a sentence.
result.label: ' also' before a verb

result.description: Fires on "balance" as a word, either the word piece "ance" completing "Bal-ance" or the token " balance", as in "balance of trade". It stays silent on "ance" in other words such as finance, enhance and elegance.
result.label: Balance (Bal-ance) word

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ation' (sometimes 'ed') when it completes the word "relax" (relaxation, relaxed). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words such as motivation, reverberation and sensation.
result.label: 'ation' ending of relaxation

result.description: Fires on possessive determiners, mostly ' their' (also ' its', ' our'), after a verb or preposition in analytical text about characters and narratives. It predicts words like 'own' or 'respective'. Also fires on 'lict' in 'Conflict'. It stays quiet on some 'their' cases.
result.label: Possessive 'their' before noun

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' y' / ' Y' (word-initial y as in yoga, yarn, or the variable y). Members are mostly detectors of ' y' and ' Y' tokens; contrast text has no such token.
result.label: Word-initial ' y' / ' Y' token

result.description: Fires on the word " regression" (also pieces like "ate" in "Univariate Regression") in statistics and machine learning text, especially after "linear", "logistic" or "nonlinear". Members detect earlier "regression" tokens and statistics vocabulary.
result.label: statistical " regression" token

result.description: Fires on passive-participle verbs like "represented" or "expressed" after "can be/is", mostly in mathematical text (matrices, vectors, equations), where something is described as being represented by or as something else.
result.label: "can be represented/expressed" in math

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ess' (also 'ment', 'ze', 'y') when it appears as a fragment in a word being discussed, such as "ess" in "essential" or "non-ess-ential". It is silent on the suffix in "awareness".
result.label: 'ess' word-piece fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece " imped" (start of "impedance"), mainly in "acoustic impedance" in physics/engineering text. Members are detectors of "imped" and similar word-start pieces. The contrast "acousticism" is silent.
result.label: " imped" in impedance

result.description: Fires on recovery-related words such as "recover", "recovery", "lost" (as in "recovery of lost data") and "backup", in contexts about restoring or retrieving data or materials. Members are mostly "recovery" token detectors.
result.label: recover / recovery / lost words

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' mo' (as in "moisture") and ' Tem' (as in "Temporal", "Temperature"), where the next piece completes the word. Members are detectors of these specific fragments.
result.label: ' mo' / ' Tem' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on "commerce" in "e-commerce" (also m-commerce), occasionally "ail" in "retail", in online retail and business text. Weaker on "economy" after "circular". Mostly the token itself.
result.label: e-commerce token

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: word pieces like 'ulate', 'arding', ' cot', 'ction', and digit '1' inside year-like numbers. No dominant token or topic; the target is silent on '1' in other number contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Scattered word pieces and year digits

result.description: Fires on " present" as a noun/adjective in "the present" (the present moment, present perfect), mostly in English grammar and tense discussions. Members detect "present", "past", "perfect" and other tense words.
result.label: " present" in tense discussions

result.description: Fires on the adjective " global" (occasionally " international") before a noun such as temperature, sea levels, or supply chains. Strongest in climate and world-scale contexts. Members are mostly detectors of "global"/"Global" and similar scope words like national.
result.label: Adjective "global" before noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ness" completing "weakness(es)", and more weakly on " force" and similar word endings. Silent on "ness" in other words like "interconnectedness" or "harness". Members detect "weak" and "ness" pieces.
result.label: "ness" in weakness
compar-ative / compar-isons word piece
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ative' (and 'isons') when it completes the word "comparative"/"comparisons". It stays silent on 'ative' in other words such as narrative, investigative, performative, interrogative.
Fires on the word piece 'ob' in "aerobic"/"anaerobic" (and "anarobes"), in biology text about metabolism. It is quiet on unrelated text. Weak activity on other pieces like 'pun' and 'pr'.
result.label: 'ob' in aerobic/anaerobic

result.description: Fires on the word ' respect' in both senses: "with respect to" in maths and respect as a value (mutual respect, respectful). It is silent when 'respect' starts the text as a fragment ("respectful setting").
result.label: ' respect' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ial' (also 'al', 'istic', 'ism') ending a word, most strongly in 'factorial' within math/programming text. Weaker on other suffixes like 'ization' or 'ist'.
result.label: Word-ending suffix 'ial' (factorial)

result.description: Fires on the word "Urban"/"urban", mostly at the start of a document or heading (e.g. "Urban Planning"). Fed by upstream city/urban/cities detectors. Weak on "ambient" and "riv".
result.label: Urban word detector

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces: "om" in "chromosomes", "pon" in "Exponential", and the word " security". Mixed peaks with weak consistency; the circuit is made of token detectors for each of these pieces.
result.label: security / pon / om word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ues' completing "blues" (bl+ues), and weakly on similar endings like 'ips' or 'ass'. Members detect 'bl' + 'ues'/'ue' pieces, so it needs the preceding 'bl' fragment, mostly in music contexts.
result.label: 'ues' ending of "blues"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'od', 'urg', 'ive' inside longer words like mel-od-ies, lit-urg-ical, immers-ive, mostly in music/liturgy text. Members are 'od' token detectors plus music-word detectors.
result.label: Word-piece 'od'/'urg'/'ive' in music words

result.description: Fires on the 'W' token in the acronym "DAW(s)" (Digital Audio Workstations), right after "DA". Silent on a bare "W" or on "D W" written separately. Predicts continuations like 's' or punctuation.
result.label: W in DAW acronym

result.description: Fires on the piece 'al' in the split word "anom|al|ies" (data anomalies). It stays silent on 'al' in other words like "reveal" or "detrimental". Members detect 'anom' and 'ies' pieces around it.
result.label: 'al' inside "anomalies"

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a biochemical term (f-ruct, P-FK, Co-A, H-exokinase) in metabolic pathway text such as glycolysis and ATP reactions. It is silent in other biology text, such as apoptosis proteins.
result.label: Biochemistry term-start fragments

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens inside dates, numbers, and ordinals (digits, 'th' after century numbers, dashes in year ranges), but is silent on some ordinals like '19th'. Evidence is mixed and the peaks are diffuse.
result.label: Digits and dashes in dates

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes (mostly 'orial', also 'ive', 'ic', 'og') completing the split word "pict-" (pictorial, pictograms, pictive). Members detect 'ict' and 'og' pieces right before it.
result.label: Suffix after 'pict' (pictorial)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'c' inside a word after a prefix, as in cas-c-ades, ups-c-ale, trans-c-ends. It is silent on 'c' after 'un' in 'unclaimed'. It predicts word continuations like 'asc'.
result.label: 'c' inside words (cascade, upscale)

result.description: Fires mostly on ' year', ' years' and similar time-span words (period, decades, century) in phrases like "During the year" or "early years". It also fires weakly on scattered unrelated tokens, including Arabic word pieces. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Year / time-span words

result.description: Fires on the token ' genre' (all peaks), in any use such as genre mixing, genre-specific or musical genre. Weakly on 'genres' and related style words. Members are mostly detectors of genre/gen tokens plus music and literature context.
result.label: ' genre' token detector

result.description: Fires on the noun ' issue' (also ' problem', ' concern') when it names a topic or matter under discussion, often after "the", "major" or "important" and before "of" or "in". Members detect issue/problem/concern words.
result.label: issue/problem noun as topic

result.description: Fires on the word " algorithm" (or "Algorithm") as a standalone noun, typically after a named algorithm such as Bellman-Ford, Euclidean or Stein's. It stays silent on "algorithmic" and on text-initial "algorithm".
result.label: Named algorithm noun ' algorithm'

result.description: Fires on ' particularly' (also ' especially') when it follows a comma and introduces a narrowing example or qualifier, e.g. ", particularly in the North". It stays silent when the word is not after a comma, as in "time particularly beginning".
result.label: Comma-introduced 'particularly/especially'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'uk' inside a word after a preceding letter, as in e-uk-aryote or F-uk-ushima, and occasionally on 'ism' in Cubism. Silent when 'uk' begins the word (ukaryotic) with no prefix.
result.label: 'uk' mid-word piece (eukaryote)

result.description: Fires on the word " visual" (as in "visual arts", "visual aids", "visual language"), usually as an adjective after "the" or another modifier. Members are mostly detectors of "visual" and related word pieces.
result.label: " visual" token detector
'ado' piece in 'paradox'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ado' inside 'paradox' (par-ado-x). Weaker on mid-word pieces like 'nt' in 'sovereignty' and 'agog' in 'pedagogical'. Silent when 'ado' starts a text without 'par' before it.

Fires on nationality/ethnonym adjectives, mainly "American" (also Spanish, Scottish, German), especially in compounds like "Spanish-American" or "Native American". Silent on generic text about linguistic diversity without such a demonym.
result.label: Nationality adjective 'American' and similar

result.description: Fires on ' organization'/' organisation' as a business or institution noun in business/management text, and on 'ain' in 'Supply Chain' at a document start. Silent on "organization's" possessive-type contexts. Members detect supply, company and organization words.
result.label: organization / Supply Chain in business text

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces that need a continuation, mainly ' mil' (before "estone") mid-sentence, also 'co' in eco-, and ' streams' after "venue". Silent when ' mil' starts the text.
result.label: Word-start fragments: mil(estone), eco, venue streams

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ac' mid-word, mostly in "vernacular" (also 'ab', 'aking', 'ive'), in text about languages and history. Members detect 'ac' pieces and linguistic words.
result.label: 'ac' in vernacular

result.description: Fires on ' especially' (occasionally ' particularly') when it follows a comma and introduces a narrowing qualifier after a clause, e.g. ', especially in fields such…' or ', especially when…'. Members detect especially/particularly tokens.
result.label: ', especially' qualifier after clause

result.description: Fires on the word or connector right after "labor/labour" or "worked" in labor-economics text (e.g. "econom", "and", "-", "for"). Members are labor, worker and job detectors. It stays quiet on " un" in other contexts.
result.label: Token after "labor" in labor-economics text

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix 'ography' (chromatography, geography) and also on scattered tokens like ' wild' and 'abeled'. Members are detectors of 'ography'/'ographic' pieces, mixed with technique and science words.
result.label: -ography word suffix, plus wild/labeled

result.description: Fires on the indefinite articles ' a' and ' an' when they follow a verb or preposition and start a new noun phrase, such as "embarked on a", "maintaining a", "within an". It is silent after the copula "is a".
result.label: Indefinite article after verb/preposition

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'cient' (mostly in "Ancient" at the start of a heading), plus ' situ', ' Scient' and ' International'. It is mainly a token-piece detector, strongest on "Ancient" before a civilization name.
result.label: 'cient' in Ancient, situ, Scient

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word that is split mid-word (' Pol' before "lution", ' far', ' Supp', ' Fin', 'respons' in "irresponsibility"), often in list-like headings. It expects a word continuation. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-initial fragment before continuation

result.description: Fires mostly on " coding" (e.g. insecure coding, channel coding, network coding), and also on " seem" and "almost"/"become" as a weaker side trigger. Peaks are dominated by the token " coding" across subjects.
result.label: ' coding' token, plus ' seem'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' bre' (breeding, breaches, breathe, breasts), predicting a continuation like 'ached' or 'eding'. It fires on the token itself; the contrast text has no ' bre'.
result.label: ' bre' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the hyphen in "hands-on" (occasionally "on" after it), mainly in education contexts. It stays silent on hyphens in other compounds like real-world, problem-solving or self-improvement. Members detect "hands" and the hyphen after it.
result.label: hyphen in "hands-on"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' adv' when it begins "advancement(s)", especially after "technological". Early-layer members detect ' adv' and related progress/enhance pieces. Predicts continuation like "anc" (ancement).
result.label: ' adv' in "advancements"
'ers' ending of "researchers"
result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix 'ers' completing "researchers" (also weaker on astronomers, geologists), typically as the subject or object of a verb like "allow researchers to". Silent on 'ers' in other words such as engineers.
Fires on the word piece 'uten' in "gluten" and on ' rep' starting "replication"/"replica"/"repels". Two distinct word-piece detectors, mostly inside those specific words, in science or food text.
result.label: 'uten' of gluten, 'rep' of replication

result.description: Fires on the 'n' piece inside 'Car|n|ivore/carnivorous', after the 'car' prefix. It stays silent on 'n' in other words like 'omnivores' or 'needn't'.
result.label: 'n' in carnivore

result.description: Fires on the word-initial capital token ' W' (Wave, Waves, Woolf, W boson), as a split-off first piece before a continuation like 'ave' or 'oolf'. Silent on other names in contrast lists.
result.label: Word-initial ' W' token

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in a few specific words: 'isk' in whisk/whisking, 'ctu' in punctuation, ' liter' in literacy, and 'prise' in enterprise. Members are detectors of these word pieces.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: whisk, punctuation, literacy
