result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ci' inside "speciation" and related "speci-" words (speciatory, specid). Members mostly detect 'ci' itself. The contrast shows it silent on the ordinary word "specific".

Fires on plural abstract or technical nouns (values, coefficients, beliefs, effects, equations, species) ending a noun phrase in scientific or academic text. Logits weakly favour ' enough' and ' the', and suppress verbs like ' can' and ' may'.
result.label: Plural technical nouns in academic text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ain' in "att|ain" (attain, attainment, attainability). Members detect 'att' plus pieces like 'ent', 'rib', and 'ain' in other words such as "chain". It predicts suffix pieces.
result.label: 'ain' in "attain" words

result.description: Fires on an opening quotation mark (' " ' or " ' ") that starts a quoted word or title, especially in lists of example words or terms (e.g. "such as 'I',", "Animal sounds: 'roar'"). Silent on plain title text without quotes.
result.label: Opening quote before listed examples

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining a noun pair, especially "goods and" before services/technologies in trade and economics text. Silent on clause-joining ' and' after commas or semicolons (and vice versa, and hence).
result.label: 'and' after goods (noun coordination)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " prevent" (also weakly " avoid"), mostly as the stem of prevention/preventive/preventing, in risk, safety and maintenance text. Members detect prevent/avoid/minimize stems.
result.label: ' prevent' stem token

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' cre' (creep, creatures, creativity), where the word continues in the next token. Members are mostly ' cre' detectors, plus an ' innov' detector. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' cre' word-start piece

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece 'otic' ending words like "exotic" and "abiotic". It also fires weakly on 'ness' in "fairness" and 'be' in "globe". Upstream members detect 'otic' and similar mid-word fragments such as 'op' in "exoplanet".
result.label: 'otic' word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the piece "actions" completing the word "reactions" (split as re + actions), in chemistry text such as redox, displacement or complexation reactions. It stays silent on "actions" in non-chemical contexts.
result.label: "actions" in chemical "reactions"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'l' ending the word "carbonyl" (chemistry text). Members detect 'l' in many other words (ml, coulometry, bottlenecks), but the target mainly needs the 'l' following "carbony".
result.label: 'l' in "carbonyl"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'osc' in 'nanoscale' (nan|osc|ale), after 'nan'. It stays silent on other nano- words like nanophysics. Members detect word-piece fragments in technical, materials-science words.
result.label: 'osc' in nanoscale
Non- prefix at word start
result.description: Fires on the prefix " Non" (and weakly " non") at the start of a word or title, such as Nonlinear or Nonverbal, often at the start of a document or heading. Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same prefix.
Fires on the word piece 'oth' in the middle of a word, e.g. end-oth-ermic, is-oth-ermal, hyp-oth-esis, bo-oth-s. It stays silent when 'oth' begins the text or word.
result.label: 'oth' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the piece "ve" completing the word "evolve" (evol|ve). It stays silent on "ve" in "delve", so it needs the "evol" stem before it.
result.label: 've' ending of "evolve"

result.description: Fires mainly on " momentum", especially after "gained" (gained momentum) and in physics uses, with weaker firing on " of" after quantity nouns (abundance of, layers of) and "ance". Members mostly detect " momentum" itself.
result.label: momentum, esp. "gained momentum"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' inter' as a prefix starting words like interpersonal, interdisciplinary, interference, intersections. It is quiet on some ' inter' cases, such as 'interrelated' after 'how' and sentence-initial 'interplay'. Members are mostly ' inter' detectors.
result.label: ' inter' prefix token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (also 'izing') ending a gerund like "Uncovering" or "Discovering", mostly at the start of a title or heading. It stays quiet on 'ing' in mid-sentence words such as "drawing" or "investing".
result.label: Gerund -ing in uncover/discover titles

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces "wards" (re|wards) and "ments" (pay|ments), plus "reward"/"benefits", in economics, finance and incentive contexts. Silent on other text in the contrast.
result.label: reward/payment suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on plural noun endings 'ants'/'ors' completing technical words (react-ors, impl-ants, thyrist-ors) in science and engineering text. Silent on 'ants' in transplants, pollutants, assistants, so it depends on the specific word.
result.label: Plural suffix ors/ants in technical words

result.description: Fires on the token 'i' as a standalone variable index (player i, S_i) and as a mid-word piece in names and words (Gaugiugi, Bội, physiology, antibiotic). Quiet on whole-word name lists.
result.label: Letter 'i' token

result.description: Fires on the word " convergence" in mathematical analysis and topology text (pointwise, weak, uniform convergence of sequences). Upstream members mostly detect the same token plus math-context features. Only weak activation elsewhere.
result.label: ' convergence' token in math

result.description: Fires on the document-start/newline token (shown as ¶) that begins a new line or segment after a sentence or list item, such as lists of names or subjects. Silent on some document-start contexts, so it needs a specific position.
result.label: Line-break/document-start token after list items

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the word "target" (targeting), mostly in marketing text. It stays silent on 'ing' in other words like marketing, positioning or responding.
result.label: 'ing' in "targeting"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "od" inside "flo|od" (floodplain, flood activity, floods), and also in "Ge|od|etic". It needs the split-token form of the word. Weaker firing on " equ" pieces.
result.label: "od" piece in flood/Geodetic

result.description: Fires on the token ' datasets' (occasionally 'work' in 'groundwork' or 'it' in 'necessitates'), mostly after adjectives like large, vast or complex in machine-learning and data text. Members detect dataset, database and data tokens.
result.label: ' datasets' token detector

result.description: Fires on "topology" and its variants ("ologies", "ology") in mathematical text about topology, metric spaces and algebraic structures. Weaker on nearby math words like "metric" and "dimensions". Silent in generic math text such as subgroups.
result.label: Topology word in math text

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'emes' completing "morphemes" (and similar linguistic terms like lexemes) in linguistics text. Silent on 'emes' inside the unrelated "meth-emes" in the contrast.
result.label: 'emes' ending of morphemes

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cul' when it starts "culinary" mid-sentence, usually after "the", "and" or an adjective. It stays silent when ' cul' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' cul' in culinary, mid-text

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' w' (with a leading space) when it is a separate token, mostly in physics and economics text. It pushes towards continuations like 'avel', 'elf' and 'age'. It stays quiet when ' w' is at document start.
result.label: Word-initial ' w' fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ist' or 'ide' right after 'ep' inside words like epistemology, epistemic and epidemiology. It stays silent on '-ist' suffixes after other stems (foundationalist, contextualist).
result.label: ist/ide piece after 'ep-'

result.description: Fires on the 'ch' piece in "etching" (et|ch|ing), including plasma and art etching. It stays silent on 'ch' in other words such as "epoch". Members detect 'ch' and 'et' pieces.
result.label: 'ch' in "etching"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' pot' when it begins a longer word like potassium, potatoes or potentiometry. It is silent on a document-initial 'potentiometric', so it needs a preceding context word.
result.label: ' pot' as start of longer word

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in technical text about classifying things (organisms, animals, forms) and on closing parentheses of function notation like F(n). Members detect classification, species, math and statistics terms. Silent on many ')' tokens.
result.label: Classification nouns and function-notation parenthesis

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'onom' in "ergonomic/ergonomics", after "erg". Weakly fires on similar mid-word pieces like 'oust' in "acoustics". Members are detectors of 'onom' and of similar technical word fragments.
result.label: 'onom' in ergonomics

result.description: Fires mostly on ' their' (also possessive 's, apostrophes, ' this') in abstract text about rights, laws, and groups, where a possessive determiner precedes a noun. It is silent on some ' their' cases like 'aligned their sponsorship'.
result.label: Possessive ' their' in abstract text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " expect" when it begins "expectations" (e.g. "societal expectations"), mostly after an adjective or noun modifier. Members are mostly detectors of "expect" and related stems like expected and depend.
result.label: "expect" in expectations

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ing" completing the word "accounting" (after "account"), including in accounting standards or principles. It stays silent on "ing" in other words such as ensuing, keeping, or encouraging.
result.label: "ing" in "accounting"

result.description: Fires on the word "zero" (and "Zero"), in math contexts such as "zero-sum", "non-zero", and "times zero results in zero". Members are mostly detectors of the token itself. Silent on nearby text that doesn't contain it.
result.label: the word "zero"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' po' (poets, poetic) in literary-writing text about poetry and Romantic writers, and weakly on other incomplete word starts like ' Bla', ' cont', ' inher'. Predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' po' word-start in literary text

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' era' at the start of a document ("The era from..."), 'ides' in "strides", plural 's' after acronyms (EnPIs), and weakly hyphens. Silent on ' era' mid-sentence. Logits unclear.
result.label: era, strides, acronym plural s

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in the middle of longer, rarer words or names (mezz-ot-int, Arch-ib-ald, inter-war, Ma-o, sp-anning), where the word is not yet complete. Peak tokens are scattered and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of rare words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compet' (competitive, competitors, competencies) mid-sentence, predicting suffixes like 'itive' or 'itors'. It is silent when ' compet' begins the text, as in a heading.
result.label: ' compet' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the noun ' understanding' (also ' grasp') when it follows an adjective like deep, basic, intuitive or thorough and is the head noun of "understanding of X". It is silent when "understanding" is a verb-like gerund, as in "to understanding the nature".
result.label: noun 'understanding' after adjective

result.description: Fires on the digit '2' when it starts a number: at the start of a document, as the leading digit of a year (2000s, 2001, 21st), or in a section number. It stays silent when '2' is a later digit inside a number, as in 1820, 1927 or 1235.
result.label: Digit '2' starting a number

result.description: Fires on the single-letter token 'y' as a word-final or split piece, most strongly in linguistic terms like hyponymy, antonymy, meronymy. It stays silent on 'y' in other words such as Cauchy, mastery, controversy.
result.label: Word-piece 'y' in -onymy terms

result.description: Fires on ' for' directly after a noun or gerund head, as in a title or heading ("Preparing for", "Design for", "Respect for"), where it introduces a purpose or object. It stays quiet on ' for' after "allows" or "crucial".
result.label: ' for' after a noun/gerund head

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' rein' (before "forcement") and on ' R' starting repeated "Risk ..." list items, plus a few other word-start fragments like 'aneous'. Seems to mark an incomplete word-start piece or repeated list item.
result.label: ' rein' and ' R' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on ' On' (and sometimes ' At') as a capitalized word-initial piece at the start of a document or heading, e.g. "On June 1" or the start of "Onboarding"/"Atmospheric". Weakly fires on a document-initial ' In'.
result.label: Document-initial ' On' / ' At'
'es' in Trees, ' convey' in conveyance
result.description: Fires on the 'es' piece of "Trees" (mostly in binary/graph-theory tree headings) and on ' convey', especially in "conveyance". It stays silent on 'es' in other words like "necesses", "loves" or "sandwiches".
Fires on the word ' other' used as a determiner before a plural noun, after a preposition or conjunction ("with other", "and other", "for other"). It stays silent on the reciprocal "each other".
result.label: ' other' as determiner, not reciprocal

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ator'/'ators' (also 'ation') right after the word piece 'pred', as in predator/predators/predation. Members detect 'ator' and the 'pred' prefix. Weakly fires on ' drive'.
result.label: 'ator' in "predator"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' inside multi-piece words, mostly 'earth|qu|ake' and also 'anti|qu|ity' and 'Iro|qu|oian'. Weaker on a few other word fragments (osp, proxim). Members are mostly 'qu' detectors.
result.label: 'qu' piece in earthquake

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ed'/'ized' completing participial adjectives like "underrepresented", "marginalized", "endangered", mostly before a noun about groups or data. It stays silent on 'ed' in other words like "aimed", "witnessed", "renewed".
result.label: -ed ending of underrepresented/marginalized

result.description: Fires on the token " combinations" (and weakly " combination"), mainly in mathematical or counting contexts such as permutations and combinations. Members include detectors of combinations, selection, arrangement and pairs.
result.label: ' combinations' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Dat' when it starts "Datum/Datums" (e.g. "Horizontal Datum", "Datum A and Datum B"). Weak activation on a few other tokens like 'ions' and 'individuals'.
result.label: ' Dat' in Datum

result.description: Fires on the word piece " govern" (as in governance, governments, govern) when it is the start of a longer word, mostly in corporate or IT governance text. Members are mostly detectors of "govern" itself.
result.label: ' govern' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on a full stop that ends a sentence or heading-like phrase, often in abstract expository text, where a new sentence or section is about to start. It stays silent on periods inside abbreviations like "e.g." and "etc.".
result.label: Sentence-ending period, not abbreviations

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ough' in "tough-" words, mainly fracture toughness/toughity in materials engineering text. Members detect 'ough' (also in dough). Weaker on other mid-word fragments like 'ult' or 'ien'.
result.label: 'ough' in toughness

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' expl' at the start of explore/exploration/exploring, especially when the model must continue it as "-oration" or "-oring". Members are mostly ' expl' detectors, with a few for similar pieces (purs, elev, exam).
result.label: ' expl' piece of explore/exploration
Mid-word fragments 'it' and 'plan'
result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of longer words, mainly 'it' (hosp-it-als, Ant-it-rust) and 'plan' in 'interplanetary', plus ' Hash' in 'Hashing'. It needs a preceding word-start fragment.
Fires on ' tone' and ' voice' as nouns for a writer's or speaker's style or manner (narrative voice, formal tone). Silent on 'tone' in a list of nonverbal cues like gestures and tone variations.
result.label: tone / voice as style noun

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' c' (space plus lowercase c) as a split-off fragment, mostly in technical or scientific text such as 'c' before 'athodes' or 'ement', and also in variables like c1, c2, cn. It pushes toward completions like 'ater' or 'rav'.
result.label: Standalone ' c' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on abstract idea nouns (idea, assumption, notion, concept) right after "the", where a clause or "of/that" complement follows, mostly in academic or philosophical text. Silent when "idea" is used as a modified noun in a compound.
result.label: Abstract idea nouns after "the"

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'win' (in "Twin", "Darwin") and 'ry' (in "embryonic", "Dry", "Symmetry"), mid-word in a split word. Weak on other fragments like 'son' and 'les'.
result.label: Word-piece 'win' / 'ry' mid-word

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly in garbled Cyrillic-like pseudo-text (о, ство, ков, ре) and some word pieces like 'au', 'in', 'mark'. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low; the circuit is poorly faithful and unclear.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in garbled text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " organ" as the start of organic/organism/organic chemistry words (also a few "ational" in "Rational"). Members are mostly " organ" token detectors; the contrast text has no such piece.
result.label: " organ" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pr' when it begins a split word, mainly "pricing" after a pricing-strategy modifier (penetration, cost-plus, competitive, value-based). Predicts "icing" next. Weakly on other split pr-/opt- pieces.
result.label: ' pr' piece in "pricing"

result.description: Fires on the word ' view' (verb or noun, including 'viewing' and 'viewpoint') in academic discussion of differing opinions or perspectives, e.g. 'some view', 'another view'. Silent on text lacking the word.
result.label: ' view' as opinion/perspective
Word-piece 'eb' in eyebrow, ' Lap'lace
result.description: Fires on the mid-word pieces 'eb' (in eyebrow, eyeball) and ' Lap' (in Laplace), plus occasionally ' anom' in anomalies. It needs the piece to sit inside those particular words, where the word continues after it.

Fires on the word-final piece "ology" in academic field names such as musicology, ethnomusicology, sociology, microbiology and homology. Weakly fires on similar endings like "-istry". Silent on list headings without such a suffix.
result.label: "-ology" suffix in field names

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ize, -izing, -ities) completing the word "prioritize/priorities", with members detecting "prior-"/"it" and "priority" context. Silent on "ize" in other words like "minimize" or "optimize".
result.label: Suffix of prioritize/priorities

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' particip' (participate/participation) and 'val' in 'prevalence', where the word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. Silent on ' particip' at document start, so it needs preceding context.
result.label: particip- / preval- word fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' maintain' (including the stem in 'maintaining' and 'maintainability'), wherever it appears. Members are mostly detectors of the same token and its pieces, and the output boosts words like 'ing'.
result.label: ' maintain' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " changes" (also "modifications", "-ations") when it follows a preceding word or adjective such as "subtle", "important" or "structural" and is followed by "in/to". It is silent when "changes" starts the text.
result.label: ' changes' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece "function" when it is a prefix inside "non-functional" or "bi-functional", right before the suffix "-al". It also weakly fires on other word-start pieces such as "rot" or "irre". It stays silent on other text.
result.label: "function" before -al (non-functional)

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' et' (as in etching), ' fib' (fibers) and ' particle' that begin a longer word split into pieces, mostly in art or materials text. Silent on unrelated physics text.
result.label: Word-start fragments: et(ching), fib(ers)

result.description: Fires on the word ' where' when it introduces a relative clause after a noun or phrase (e.g. "fields where", "from finance where"). Members are mostly detectors of ' where' and similar wh-words like ' when'. The contrast text has no ' where'.
result.label: relative clause ' where'

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ent' in "prevalent" (e.g. "became more prevalent"). It stays silent on 'ent' in other words such as inherent, underwent, incumbent. Members detect the preceding "preval" piece and the 'ence'/'ent' endings.
result.label: 'ent' ending of "prevalent"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'inter' when it is a prefix inside a longer word, most strongly in "slope-intercept" and "y-intercept". It is silent on 'inter' in "interfaces". It predicts continuations like 'pret' and 'ferences'.
result.label: 'inter' in slope-intercept

result.description: Fires on the 'ff' piece in "graffiti" (also 'gra'+'in'/'pp' pieces) and on the word " both". Two distinct triggers; the 'ff' case needs the "gra" prefix.
result.label: 'ff' in graffiti, and ' both'

result.description: Fires on surname or name pieces (Johnson, Anderson, 'am') in lists of academic names like "Dr. Smith.¶ Dr. Johnson.", and on the period ending such entries. Members detect "Dr", "Professor David" and similar name pieces. Stays silent on periods after headings.
result.label: Names in Dr./Professor name lists
' of' after "form"/"mode"
result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after the noun "form" (or "mode"), as in "form of", "a form of communication". It stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like evolution, merging, example, advent.

Fires on " or" joining two adjectives or materials that are alternative options, like "synthetic or natural" or "cast iron or stainless", mostly in product, cooking or materials text. It is silent on "or" between food items or verbs.
result.label: " or" between alternative materials/adjectives

result.description: Fires on the word " sampling" in statistics and research-methods text (probability, random, stratified, cluster sampling). Members detect sampling, sample, population and random tokens.
result.label: ' sampling' in statistics methods

result.description: Fires on a hyphen or en dash separating items in a sequence of numbers or codes (e.g. 45-45-90, 4.5-1.4-2.5, chord letters). It stays quiet on hyphens inside prefixed compound words like semi-, half-, avant-.
result.label: Hyphen between numeric sequence items

result.description: Fires on the piece 'it' completing the verb "elicit" (elic|it), as in "capacity to elicit emotions". It is silent on 'it' in other words like "prioritize". Members detect the "el-/elic-" prefix pieces.
result.label: 'it' in "elicit"

result.description: Fires on adjective-forming suffix pieces like -able, -ous, -ual at the end of a word, especially in economics or abstract terms such as "non-excludable" and "non-rivalrous". Silent on "nebulous", so it depends on the word.
result.label: Adjective suffixes -able/-ous/-ual

result.description: Fires on the word " population" (also "populations"), most strongly in statistics and sampling text such as "sample representative of the population". Members mostly detect the token itself, plus statistics and sample context.
result.label: ' population' token, statistics context

result.description: Fires on the piece 'itation' completing the word "meditation", mostly in spiritual or yoga practice text. Weak activation on a few other word-final pieces like 'asing' and ' language'. Upstream members detect 'itation' and meditation-related pieces.
result.label: 'itation' in meditation

result.description: Fires on the prefix ' super' (also 'tele', 'Super') when it is a word-start piece that continues into a longer word like superposition, supernova, supervised or superconductor. Members are mostly detectors of this token.
result.label: 'super' prefix piece

result.description: Fires on the comparative adjective ' larger' (size comparisons, e.g. larger apertures, atoms, samples), mostly in technical or scientific text. Members detect size and comparative words like larger, smaller, more, greater, vast.
result.label: ' larger' size comparative

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: a '1' inside long binary or decimal digit strings, and word-piece endings like 'al' in 'viral', 'itudes' in 'attitudes', 'oses'. It stays silent on '1' in years. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed digit '1' and word-piece endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ent' in 'Pres-ent' (Present Simple/Continuous/Perfect grammar headings), and weakly on 'Endanger-ed'. Silent on 'ent' ending other words like imminent, prevalent, coherent.
result.label: 'ent' in Present (tense) split word

result.description: Fires on the word " success" (also "successes", occasionally "implementation(s)"), mostly in business or case-study text about achievements. Members are mostly detectors of success/successful and related words such as efficiency and fail.
result.label: ' success' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " approach" (also " approaches"), both as a noun for a method and as a verb meaning to get near, as in functions approaching a value. Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' approach' token detector
Algebra/math words like simpler, expressed
result.description: Fires on varied words in algebra and equation-solving text, such as "simpler", "expressed", "variable", "-able" endings and "expressions". Members are mostly math-topic detectors (algebraic, equation, solutions). Logits are unclear.
Fires on the suffix 'ing' in "trad|ing" (trading solutions, algorithmic trading, currency trading). It stays silent on 'ing' ending other verbs such as streamlining, spreading or disrupting.
result.label: 'ing' completing "trading"

result.description: Fires on economic-policy words (' tax', ' policy', 'intervention', ' government') in macroeconomics and Keynesian fiscal-policy text. It is silent on one ' tax' in a supply-side passage. Members are tax detectors and economy-topic latents.
result.label: Fiscal policy words in economics text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'it' in "Lim|it" of "Central Limit Theorem". It stays silent on 'it' inside other words such as facilitating, necessitating, or Fit, so it needs that specific word.
result.label: 'it' in Central Limit Theorem

result.description: Fires on the word "leadership" (and the "-ership" piece in "Leadership"), mostly in management or organizational text about leadership styles. Members are detectors of leadership/leader tokens.
result.label: Leadership word detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' part' when it follows a form of "be/become/as" and starts "part of" (e.g. "is part of", "as part of"). Members are mostly ' part' detectors plus similar words like subset and sort.
result.label: ' part' in "part of" after be

result.description: Fires on ' root' (also ' node', ' child', ' branch') as a part of a tree data structure, e.g. "the root node" or "smaller than the root". Weak on other tree-like terms. Silent in generic text about trees without these structure words.
result.label: Tree data structure root/node

result.description: Fires on ' word' (esp. "spoken word") and ' po' in "memory pools" (word-start piece before "ols"), plus a few 'words' and digits. Silent on 'word' in "a single word" or "worded". Mixed tokens, seemingly context-specific.
result.label: spoken 'word' and memory 'po'ols

result.description: Fires on adverb/adjective suffix pieces (-fully, -ly, -ively, -ed, -ful, -anned) ending a descriptive participle or adverb in marketing-style text, e.g. "thoughtfully organized", "powerfully executed", "well-planned".
result.label: Adverb/participle suffix in descriptive phrases

result.description: Fires on the word piece "con" in "misconceptions" (after "mis"), mainly in education or explanatory text. It stays silent on "con" at the start of a document or after "pre" in "preconceived".
result.label: "con" in "misconceptions"

result.description: Fires on varied function words and noun pieces (of, in, on, enses, simple) inside text about linguistics and grammar, especially verb tenses. Members are mostly language and grammar topic detectors. Silent on 'of' in other topics.
result.label: Linguistics/grammar text, tense passages

result.description: Fires on a hyphen (or en dash) joining the first part of a compound, especially after "decision" or "cap" (decision-making, cap-and-trade), plus occasionally " desired". Stays quiet on hyphens in other compounds like data-driven, well-received, long-term.
result.label: Hyphen after decision/cap compounds

result.description: Fires on the word piece "inary" completing "imaginary", mostly in math contexts where imaginary parts are paired with real parts. Weaker on other "-inary" or "-ic" endings such as "interdisciplinary" and "mosaic".
result.label: "inary" in "imaginary"

result.description: Fires on the 's' token of a possessive after a noun or name (Shakespeare's, Theme's, Orwell's), mostly in title-like text. It stays silent on plural 's' as in 1960s or depths.
result.label: Possessive 's after noun

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces and nouns (rice, pasta's 'a', cheese 'ese', reactors, 'ol', 'uring') that often end a first part of a compound or noun phrase, with food/cooking and technical terms. Peaks are scattered and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word pieces, food and technical

result.description: Fires on the opening parenthesis after a capitalized technical term or title, where an acronym is about to be given, e.g. "Virtual Reality (VR)", "Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)". Quiet on some similar cases such as "Internet of Things (IoT".
result.label: Paren introducing acronym after term

result.description: Fires on past-participle or adjective-like words (controlled, guaranteed, possible, -ured) that follow a noun or "made/under" and can take a "by" agent next. Members detect passive participles like identified and viewed.
result.label: Passive participles like controlled, guaranteed

result.description: Fires on the negating prefix " un" / " Un" as a separate token starting a word like unproven, unsupervised, unpredictable. Members are mostly " un" detectors. Silent on text without such a prefix.
result.label: Word-initial "un" prefix token

result.description: Fires on the word "market"/"Market" (any case), in business and economics text such as marketing strategy lists, "market share", "labor market". Members are mostly market-token detectors plus brand/competition context.
result.label: Word "market" in business text

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces: 'ars' in "seminars/webinars", ' ray' (cosmic ray, incident ray), and ' glo' in "globe". Silent on 'ars' in "bears" or "pulsars", so it needs the right word.
result.label: 'ars' in seminars/webinars, ray

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'omed' in "Biomedical" when the word is capitalized after "Bi" (e.g. document-start titles like "Biomedical Optics"). Silent when 'omed' starts a fragment without the "Bi" prefix.
result.label: 'omed' in Biomedical

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' s' when it begins a split word, mostly the 's' of "sophisticated" after "more" or "highly". It predicts continuations like 'oph'. It stays silent after verbs such as "explored".
result.label: ' s' starting "sophisticated" after more

result.description: Fires on the end of plural "challenges"/"obstacles"/"issues" (e.g. 'es', 'acles') after quantifiers like "numerous", "various", "several" in formal expository text about facing difficulties. Silent when "challenges" is the sentence subject without such a lead-in.
result.label: plural challenges/obstacles after "numerous"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that begin "conduct" (conductivity, conduction) and "aller" (allergy, allergen), plus ' through' in a conduction context. It predicts continuations like "duct". Weaker on a few mid-word fragments.
result.label: conduct- / aller- word onsets

result.description: Fires on nouns meaning scenarios or cases (' scenarios', ' cases', ' scenario'), especially after modifiers like best/worst/average/hypothetical, in analytical or algorithm-analysis text. Weaker on 'situations'.
result.label: scenarios/cases noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on quality adjectives after "more" (sophisticated, precise, accurate, robust), especially the "ated" of "sophisticated". Stays silent on "ated" in words like automated, calibrated, elevated.
result.label: Sophisticated/precise comparative adjectives

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'om' in "monomers" (also 'anch', 'ed') in technical chemistry words split into pieces. Silent on 'om' in "elastomers" or "omny", so it depends on the specific word, especially "mon-om-ers".
result.label: 'om' piece in monomers

result.description: Fires on the token " hash" (or " Hash") in computer-science text about hash functions, tables and maps. Members are mostly hash-token detectors plus data-structure context latents. The contrast is a different topic with no hash token.
result.label: ' hash' in hash tables

result.description: Fires on the token ' here', including when it is quoted or discussed as a word (e.g. "alone here", "here's"). It is also built from detectors of 'there' and 'again'. It stays silent on other deictic words like 'these' and 'those'.
result.label: Token ' here'

result.description: Fires on "sensitive" (and "sensitivity" pieces), mostly in "highly sensitive" instruments/detectors in scientific or technical text. It also fires more weakly on "sensitive data". It is silent on unrelated cryptography text.
result.label: "sensitive" / sensitivity token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "acc" in "vaccine/vaccination" (v-acc-ine), right after "v". Members are mostly "acc" detectors in the same vaccine contexts. The contrast, where the target is silent, has no "acc" token.
result.label: "acc" piece in vaccine

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ic' in "intricacy/intricately", 'inos' in "luminosity", and ' pian' in "pianos". It stays quiet on 'ic' in words like "hypnotic", "symbolic" and "magic". Members mostly detect 'ic' pieces.
result.label: Word-piece 'ic' in intricate/pianos

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ep" (Ep) as a prefix inside words like epic, epics, epitheses, epidemic, epistemic. It is silent on one "epistemic" example at the start of the text, so it may need a preceding word.
result.label: " ep" word-start piece (epic)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "onym" inside words like synonym, antonym and homonym, after a prefix such as syn-. It stays silent when "onym" starts the text with no preceding prefix.
result.label: 'onym' in synonym-type words
Mid-word pieces after "provided a/the"
result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split, fairly abstract word (catal-yz-ed, a p-ivotal, blue-print, sc-affolding, inst-illing) in formal expository text about policy or history, often after "a/the" or "provided". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.

Fires on the hyphen right after a single-letter "p" (p-norm, p-value, p-n junction), where a letter or variable is followed by a hyphen. It stays silent on hyphens after words like non-, double-, cross-.
result.label: Hyphen after letter "p"

result.description: Fires on the token " existence" (and weakly on pieces like "istence"), mostly in philosophical or logical text about being, existence theorems or God's existence. Members are mainly detectors of existence and related abstract nouns (presence, possibility, death).
result.label: ' existence' token detector

result.description: Fires on frequency/generality adverbs such as "typically", "generally", "frequently" and "usually" placed before a verb in expository, academic-style prose. These often come right after a plural subject, as in "systems typically include".
result.label: Frequency adverbs like typically

result.description: Fires on the token ' p' (a word-initial p piece with a space) when it follows a word like "the" or "as" and begins a longer word or a symbol, e.g. p-norm, pragmatism, pinnacle, pivotal, pH. It stays silent on ' p' at the start of a document.
result.label: ' p' word-start piece mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (also 'ized') when it completes "democratization". It stays silent on 'ization' after other stems such as commercial-, digit-, ideal- and personal-. Members detect the democrat- stem and the suffix.
result.label: -ization in "democratization"

result.description: Fires on the word " job" (rarely " jobs") used as a modifier before a noun, as in "job creation", "job search", "job market". The silent contrast text has no "job".
result.label: ' job' as noun modifier
'or' inside "rhetoric"
result.description: Fires on the piece 'or' in "rhet-or-ic" (rhetoric), in text about persuasion and writing. It stays silent on 'or' in other words like rigorously, theorems or moreover.

Fires on the word piece " turn" (also " thrust") when it is the first part of a compound like turnover or thrusters, and predicts a continuation such as "over" or "around". Members are mostly detectors of "turn" and its variants.
result.label: turn- / thrust- word start

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ced' in "unprecedented" (also 'par' in "transparency", 'pre'), where the word is unfinished and the next piece is a suffix such as -ented, -ency, -ity.
result.label: Mid-word 'ced' in unprecedented

result.description: Fires on the word "hash"/"Hash" in computer-science text about hash functions, hash maps and hash keys. Members include hash-token detectors plus data-structure and algorithm context such as tree, table, complexity and database.
result.label: "Hash" in data-structure text

result.description: Fires on "force" completing the word "workforce" (work + force), in business and planning text. Members detect "work" followed by a word piece, and "force" itself. Weak on a few unrelated word pieces.
result.label: 'force' in 'workforce'

result.description: Fires on word endings of "perception" forms: the plural 's' in "perceptions", and "ived" in "perceived" (also "ception"). Silent on plural 's' in other nouns like "norms" or "contexts".
result.label: Perception/perceived word endings

result.description: Fires on word pieces after "qu" or "At" in split words: "ark"/"arks" in quark(s) and "mos" in Atmospheric. Silent on whole words like "neutral currents". Members are detectors of "ark" and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: ark/mos mid-word pieces (quark, Atmospheric)

result.description: Fires on "reduced"/"reducing" and related reduction words (decreasing, minimize), mostly as a modifier or verb in technical or environmental text about cutting emissions, waste or costs. Predicts words like waste, greenhouse.
result.label: reduced / reducing words

result.description: Fires on the word " patterns" (also " behavior"/"iors") as a head noun after a scientific or technical modifier, such as flow patterns, behavioral patterns, wave behavior. Silent on unrelated science text without such a noun.
result.label: ' patterns' after technical modifier

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'elf' in "Welfare", 'ights' in "knights", and 'amp'/'ight', where the piece sits inside a longer word split into tokens. Silent on 'elf' in "oneself", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: Word-internal fragments: elf in Welfare

result.description: Fires on the word piece "avel" inside "wavelength(s)", after "w". Upstream members are mostly detectors of this same piece. It predicts the continuation "ength".
result.label: "avel" in wavelength

result.description: Fires on the word " attack" (also " threat", " attacks") in cybersecurity and threat-modeling text, e.g. "attack vectors", "attack scenarios", "threat modeling". Predicts plural/related noun continuations like " attacks".
result.label: attack/threat in security text

result.description: Fires on assorted rare word fragments and foreign-language pieces (e.g. 'ampa', ' Germania', ' dah', 'cito', ' où', 'std'), mostly early-layer token-piece detectors. No single token or meaning dominates; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Miscellaneous rare token fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ch' when it begins the word "chord" (geometry or music), e.g. "least ch|ord", "longest ch|ord". Weak elsewhere on other ch- starts like chase or chains. Silent on circle text without the piece.
result.label: ' ch' start of "chord"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " prefix" (and prefix-like pieces such as "refix", "ix" in suffix/infix) in text about affixes and word formation; weaker on " challeng" stems. Predicts suffix endings like -es, -ed, -ix.
result.label: prefix word piece (affix talk)

result.description: Fires on the word " attention", mostly in "pay (close) attention" and similar phrases about focus or listening. Members are mainly early-layer detectors of the " attention" token. Weak firing on " regard" and " distinction".
result.label: ' attention' token detector

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ureau' in 'bureaucracy/bureaucratic' (after 'b'), with a few other word-internal pieces like 'perm' in 'sperm'. Members detect word-piece fragments such as 'atic', 'hier', 'ag'.
result.label: 'ureau' in bureaucracy

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " red" (also "Red") in many contexts such as red-black trees, red flag and redshift, and on "break" in "outbreak". Two tokens dominate, with weak edge cases.
result.label: ' red' and outbreak 'break'

result.description: Fires on the word " effective" as a modifier, especially after "for" or "in" before a noun like communication or negotiation. It predicts communication-related nouns next. The one contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: " effective" before communication nouns

result.description: Fires on the suffix of review/examine/scrutinize-type verbs (review-ed, review-ing, scrutin-ize, investig-ating) and on "Study" or "review" in analysis-focused text. It stays silent on 'ed' in other verbs like "directed" or "aimed".
result.label: Review/examine verb endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ret' when it begins a word, especially after "memory" in "memory retention". Also fires weakly on other word-start pieces such as ' res' in "resilience". Mostly in cognition and brain-health text.
result.label: ' ret' word-start piece (memory retention)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of multi-piece words, such as 'emp' in unemployment, 'chni' in Techniques, ' Num', ' circum', and a backslash before a Greek letter in trig formulas. Mixed and weak; mostly word-start pieces needing a continuation.
result.label: Incomplete word-piece fragments (emp, chni)
'ment' in pigment
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ment' when it ends a split-up science word, mainly 'pigment' (also 'fermentation'), so it's the 'ment' piece in these words. It is silent on other text, including the contrast passage about algae.

Fires mainly on the word " concurrent" (as an adjective before systems, operations, garbage collection), with minor peaks on "iev" and "partial". Members detect concurrency/parallel computing words, such as "concurrency", "parallel" and "deadlock".
result.label: ' concurrent' in computing text

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' din' (diners) and ' ing' (ingredients) split into pieces, in food and cooking text. Silent on the whole word "dining". Members include cooking-topic and ' ing' detectors.
result.label: din-/ing- fragments in food text

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'es' completing a plural noun, mostly 'themes' in literary or mythological discussion. It stays silent on verb 's' endings like 'encompasses' or 'focuses' and on plural 'challenges'.
result.label: 'es' ending of 'themes' plurals

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ives' completing the word "perspectives" (after "perspect"). Also fires weakly on similar endings like "directives". Members are mostly 'ives' detectors.
result.label: 'ives' ending of perspectives
Digit 7 in 1700s year
result.description: Fires on the digit '7' as the hundreds or tens digit of a year or date range, mostly 17xx or 197x, as in "1727 to" or "1973-1". It stays silent on a final '7' in years like 1870, 1987 or 1847.
Fires on adjectives meaning "main/central" (' main', ' core', ' primary') placed after "the" or a number before a noun like idea, verb, or parts. It anticipates a head noun such as concept or notion.
result.label: "main/core" modifier before noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ance'/'ances' completing a noun like dissonance, consonance, sibilance, balance. It stays silent on 'ance' in the verb 'enhance'.
result.label: -ance noun suffix (dissonance)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ided' in "coincided" (as in "coincided with"), after "coinc". Members mostly detect 'ided' or ' coinc' tokens.
result.label: 'ided' in "coincided"

result.description: Fires on a function word (' in', ' of', ' to', ' that') right after "way(s)" or "means", introducing how/what something does ("ways in which", "way to", "means that"). Silent on ' in' after other words like "found" or "essential".
result.label: Preposition after "ways"/"means"

result.description: Fires on the token ' conscious' when it is the first piece of 'consciousness' (e.g. "nature of conscious|ness"), in philosophical or mind-related text. Members mostly detect ' conscious' itself in earlier layers.
result.label: ' conscious' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word "two" (also "two-" compounds) as a count modifier in technical or math text, e.g. "any two points", "two-dimensional". Predicts pair-like nouns such as points, ends, identical, consecutive.
result.label: "two" before paired things

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ody' completing "melody" (also weakly on "melod-ies"). Also fires on 'ody' in "prosody", so it mostly depends on the preceding word piece. Members are 'ody' detectors plus music-word members.
result.label: 'ody' in melody

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ually" in "mutually", mainly in "mutually exclusive" in probability text. Members detect "mut" plus "ual/ually/ation" pieces. It is silent on other contexts without this word.
result.label: "ually" in "mutually"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mainly ' ferm', ' Id' (Idioms), ' Reyn', ' therm'. Predicts continuations like 'od', 'os', 'ison'. Mixed tokens, with weak and varied members.
result.label: Word-start fragments (Id, ferm, therm)

result.description: Fires on ' outside' mostly, plus ' join' (as in SQL left/right join) and enter/entering. These are boundary or crossing words. Members detect outside, inside, external and within. Logits are unclear.
result.label: outside / join / enter words

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that are incomplete and likely continue into a longer word, mainly ' Disc' (before overy), 'ought' in "drought", and ' Jacques'. Peaks on varied pieces, with drought-in-title contexts strongest.
result.label: Word-start fragments: Disc, drought, Jacques

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'active' when it completes a prefixed word such as Inter-active, re-active, pro-active, radio-active or in-active. Members are mostly 'active' token detectors.
result.label: -active suffix after prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ure" inside "procurement" (also "Sculpture"), when mid-sentence after "proc". It stays silent on the same piece in some contexts, such as sentence-initial "Procurement" or a parenthesized list item.
result.label: "ure" in procurement

result.description: Fires mostly on " layers" (and nearby words like "of"/"within" after layer talk) in text about layering, e.g. art techniques, dough, neural networks. Predicts "layer(s)" next. Members are layer-token detectors.
result.label: layers token detector

result.description: Fires on the prefix token ' un' beginning an un- word (unparalleled, unforeseen, uncovering, unsupervised), especially after verbs like uncover/unlock/unveil or "previously". Quieter on unrelated tokens.
result.label: ' un' prefix token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' emp' (empowers, employs, empire), and weakly on ' consist' and ' accur', after a noun or conjunction in abstract or technical text. It predicts continuations like 'ower' and 'ately'.
result.label: ' emp' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on adjective suffixes, mostly 'ous' (strongest in "simultaneous"), also 'ive' and 'al', ending a word. Members detect 'ous' and concurrency-related pieces. It stays quiet on 'ous' in other words such as "advantageous" and "equidistanous".
result.label: Adjective suffix 'ous', esp. simultaneous

result.description: Fires on the token ' Monte', mainly in "Monte Carlo" (methods, simulation, casino). Members include detectors of Monte and Carlo plus assorted word-start pieces. Predicts name continuations such as Carlo.
result.label: ' Monte' in Monte Carlo

result.description: Fires on the word "Media" / "media", most strongly when it starts a line or heading in a list of media-planning steps (Media Measurement, Media Scheduling, Media Buying). Weaker on "media" in running text about PR or marketing.
result.label: Media as heading word

result.description: Fires on the word piece "eth" (also " eth") as a fragment inside words like bioethics, ethical, ethers, ethnic, methylation, polyethylene. It is silent on unrelated text, and predicts continuations like "nic", "yl" and "ical".
result.label: "eth" word-piece fragment
' addresses' after IP
result.description: Fires on the token ' addresses' (rarely ' handles'), mostly as the plural noun in networking contexts like "IP addresses". Members detect address/addresses tokens. Silent in the contrast, which has no such token.

Fires on ' the' after a preposition or "that" (e.g. "along the", "of the", "states that the") mostly in mathematical or physics-style text. Members are mostly ' the' detectors; it favours nouns like same, latter, first next.
result.label: ' the' after preposition, technical text

result.description: Fires on the word "area" (area/Area/areas), most strongly in geometry contexts like surface area or area of a segment, and more weakly for "areas" meaning regions. Members are mostly detectors of "area" tokens.
result.label: Word "area" token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " charge" (electric charge in physics text, e.g. "two types of charge", "point charge"). Members are mostly detectors of " charge" and " charges". Silent on other atomic-physics text without that word.
result.label: electric charge token

result.description: Fires on the standalone letter ' L' used as a symbol or variable, such as the Lucas number L(n), L1/L2 Lagrange points, or L_n in math formulas. It stays silent on the word "Lucas" in prose.
result.label: Letter L as math symbol

result.description: Fires mainly on the contrastive conjunction "while"/"whilst", especially after a semicolon introducing a contrasting clause. It also fires weakly on some Arabic word endings and separators. It pushes toward "also", "still" and "others".
result.label: Contrastive 'while' conjunction

result.description: Fires on 'ized' in "characterized" (as in "characterized by"), mainly in academic or scientific text. It stays silent on 'ized' in other words such as specialized, decentralized and urbanized.
result.label: 'ized' in "characterized"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " dec" when it starts a word that continues as "isions" (decisions), mostly after "managerial", "those", "economic" in business text. It predicts "isions".
result.label: " dec" start of "decisions"

result.description: Fires mostly on " genius" (including "geniuses"/"genioused" forms), and also on scattered pieces like "GO" in LEGO, "phony", "ematic". Peaks are mixed and the members are mostly generic token detectors.
result.label: ' genius' token plus scattered pieces
'person' in first-person narration
result.description: Fires on ' person' when it completes "first-person", "second-person" or "third-person" in talk of narrative point of view. Members are mostly detectors of 'person' after a hyphenated ordinal, plus narrative and writing context.

Fires on the word piece ' intent' (as in "intentional", "intention") and occasionally 'craft' in "Spacecraft". It predicts the continuation 'ional'/'ions'. Members are mostly detectors of intent/intention tokens.
result.label: ' intent' word-start before -ional

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ruit' in "recruitment" (rec|ruit|ment), after 'rec'. Members are mostly 'ruit' detectors plus recruitment/job-related context. It stays silent on talent-management text without that split word.
result.label: 'ruit' in recruitment

result.description: Fires on the word right after a "more/greater/larger/smaller than" comparison, where a quantity, unit or noun is expected (e.g. "greater than 180 degrees", "smaller than the vast bulk"). Silent on "degrees" outside comparisons.
result.label: Word completing "than" comparison

result.description: Fires on the piece 'sh' completing the word "harsh" (e.g. "harsh environments"). It stays silent on 'sh' in other words like "workshops", so it needs the 'har' prefix before it.
result.label: 'sh' in "harsh"

result.description: Fires on the adverb ending of continuity-type manner adverbs, mostly "continuously" (continu|ously), also "continually", "constantly", "quickly", before a verb like monitoring or evolving. Quiet on text without such adverbs.
result.label: Continuously/constantly adverb endings

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: 'gs' in Higgs, ' blue' (blue dwarfs, blue collar, blueberry), and 'ues' (as in blues). Mostly a mix of 'blue'/'Higgs' piece detectors; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Higgs 'gs' and 'blue' tokens

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'itory' in "auditory", 'cient' in "Ancient", and 'od' in "commodities". Members mostly detect 'itory'/auditory and hearing-related pieces. It is silent when 'itory' starts a text fragment without the preceding "aud".
result.label: 'itory' in auditory; word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on " LED" (also " mechanical", "rical") in technical/facilities text about lighting, energy and equipment, where the next word is likely a facility or system noun like "lighting". Members detect LED and light tokens.
result.label: LED lighting term

result.description: Fires on the later tokens of a short title or topic heading at the start of a document, such as "The Little Ice Age" or "The Scientific Revolution". It fires on the heading's last word or word piece. Evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Title-phrase tokens in headings

result.description: Fires on the token " II" as a Roman numeral label after a name or term, such as "Type II" errors or "Prophase II". Many members are detectors of " II" and similar numerals. Silent on contrast text with no such numeral.
result.label: Roman numeral II after term

result.description: Fires on nouns or word pieces such as "structure", "approaches", "techniques" and "-atives" that follow narrative or storytelling terms (frame story, narrative). Quiet on "structure" in a film-editing context. Members mostly detect story, narrator and character words.
result.label: Narrative-structure nouns in storytelling text

result.description: Fires on the word "health"/"Health" (including as the start of "Healthcare"), often at a document or list-item start or after words like "public" or "economic". Pushes the next token toward "care". Silent on other list-heading words like "Media".
result.label: health token, predicts "care"

result.description: Fires on US state and city names (Colorado, Florida, Philadelphia, York), mostly inside comma-separated lists of states or places. Some weaker firing on Arabic word pieces and nationality words. The contrast shows it silent on 'Erie' in a railway context.
result.label: US state names in lists

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' completing "cardinality" in set-theory text. It stays silent on 'ity' in other words like continuity, uniformity or modernity. It pushes towards set/space-related continuations.
result.label: 'ity' in cardinality

result.description: Fires on the 'ps' piece that completes "DevOps" (after Dev-O), in software and IT-process text. Supporting members detect Dev/O/ps pieces and related terms like code commits, release and continuous improvement.
result.label: 'ps' ending DevOps

result.description: Fires on the head noun after "the" in operating-system text, mainly " kernel", " OS" and "ernel", and sometimes other nouns like "vehicle" or "hole". It stays silent on general system-call text that doesn't name the kernel or OS.
result.label: OS kernel noun after "the"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "as much" (mostly the second " as", also " a", " of", " detail") in equative "as much X as" comparisons. Silent on other uses of "as" like "as easy as" or "as well as".
result.label: Token after "as much" comparison

result.description: Fires on scope-type adjectives like " native", " global", " local" and " International" that modify a following noun (native speakers, global datums, international trade). Members detect native/local/speak and language words. Silent on marketing headings.
result.label: Scope adjectives: native, global, international

result.description: Fires on ' with' right after "deal/dealing" (dealing with X), and also on word pieces like ' ancest' (ancestry/ancestors) and ' jour'. Silent on ' with' after nouns like "problems with".
result.label: "dealing with" and ancest- pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'zym' inside "enzyme"/"enzymes" (en-zym-e), mostly in biochemistry text on enzyme kinetics. Members include 'zym' detectors and biology-term members. Predicts the ending 'e'/'es'.
result.label: 'zym' piece in enzyme

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' in numerals, such as years (1910, 1859), version numbers (1.10.1) and list numbers. It boosts following digits like 9, 8 and 6. It stays silent on '3' in list items.
result.label: Digit '1' starting numbers

result.description: Fires on the word piece " comp" when it is a mid-text prefix following a modifier (e.g. "IT comp", "phenolic comp", "hyphenated comp"), predicting a continuation like "ounds" or "liance". Silent when " comp" starts the document.
result.label: ' comp' prefix after modifier

result.description: Fires on word pieces of humor and laughter words, mostly ' laugh' (laughter), also ' jo' (joke) and 'edic' (comedic), where the word is incomplete and a suffix follows. Members detect laugh/humor/comedy tokens.
result.label: Laugh/joke word beginnings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ur' inside "entrepreneur(ial/ship)", right after "entreprene". Silent on 'ur' in other words such as "heuristics". Predicts suffix continuations like 'ship' and 'ial'.
result.label: 'ur' in entrepreneur

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " mit" (as in mitochondria, mitosis, mitral, mitigation), when it begins a longer word. Members are mostly " mit" detectors. Weak activation on a few other word-start pieces like "aph".
result.label: word-initial " mit" piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ological" completing a word like biological, physiological, geological or technological, mostly in science text. It also fires weakly on " micro". Many members detect "ological" itself.
result.label: "ological" suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the word "zone" or "zones", especially plural, in climate or geography text such as "polar zones" or "these zones". It is silent on the contrast text, which has no zone token.
result.label: zone / zones token

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ens" in "ensured/ensures" (also " ensure", " requires", "must") when it begins the word after a space. It stays silent when "ens" follows a noun directly with no space, as in "principles ensures".
result.label: " ens" of ensure(s)/ensured

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'zym' inside "enzyme/enzymes/enzymatic", after "en". It is silent when 'zym' starts the text with no "en" before it. It predicts suffix pieces like 'ans', 'atic'.
result.label: 'zym' in enzyme

result.description: Fires on adjectives like physical, mental, functional, semantic that name a position in philosophy of mind or language (e.g. before -ism), predicting 'theory', 'school' or 'philosophy'. Silent on 'physical' in ordinary non-philosophical text.
result.label: Philosophy-of-mind adjective before -ism/theory

result.description: Fires on the word "both" (also "Both"), mainly when it introduces a pair of coordinated items or properties, e.g. "are both prominent examples". It stays silent in "function as both a…". Members are mostly "both" detectors.
result.label: the word "both"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start or sit mid-word in a longer word or name, such as ' Norman' (before Conquest/French), ' comb' (combustion), ' Cort' (Cortés) and 'ich' (clichés). It seems to predict a word continuation.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (Norman, comb, Cort)

result.description: Fires on the separate word-piece ' un' used as a negating prefix split from the following word (e.g. "unturned", "unannounced", "unattended"). Members are mostly ' un' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: Split ' un' prefix token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ete" in "Detection" (split as D-ete-ction), especially in "Intrusion Detection Systems". Members are detectors of the same "ete" piece plus other mid-word fragments.
result.label: "ete" in "D-ete-ction"

result.description: Fires on ' factors' and ' variables' (also ' parameters') when they follow a modifying adjective such as external, environmental, independent or controlling. It tends to predict "such"/"like" next, which introduces examples.
result.label: Factors/variables after modifier adjective

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'istic' in "linguistic", in texts about language, heritage and communities. Members include 'istic' detectors and language-word detectors (lingu, language). It stays silent on the words "language" and "languages" themselves.
result.label: 'istic' in "linguistic"

result.description: Fires on the token ' board' in corporate governance text (board members, board meetings, board effectiveness). Silent on a governance passage that doesn't contain the word. Members are mostly ' board' detectors.
result.label: ' board' in corporate governance

result.description: Fires on " responsibility" (occasionally " duty") in ethics and philosophy text, especially after "moral" or "ethics and". Members include responsibility/duty token detectors plus philosophy and ethics topic members. It pushes toward duties, obligations and similar words.
result.label: responsibility/duty in moral philosophy
'ition' in pract-ition-ers
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ition' in "pract|ition|ers" (also 'itime' in "maritime"), where the word continues into a suffix like -ers. It stays silent on 'ition' in "intuition". Predicts 'ers'.

Fires on the third digit ('4' or '6') of a year starting with 1, as in 1450, 1603 or the 14th century, in early modern or Renaissance history text. It stays quiet on digits in other positions or in other years, such as 1860, 1726 or 476 CE.
result.label: Third digit of 1400s/1600s years

result.description: Fires on mixed connecting words (' as', ' through', ' when', ' for', ' that') and word pieces like 'elling'/'ently', mostly in science or explanatory text, where they link a preceding noun phrase to a following clause. Peaks are inconsistent and the members are diffuse.
result.label: Mixed connectives in explanatory text

result.description: Fires on the token " fabric" (literal textile or figurative "fabric of society"), with minor firing on " elev" in "elevated" and similar word pieces. Members are detectors of fabric, thread, material and related textile words.
result.label: " fabric" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Protest" (as in Protestant/Protestantism), with a few hits on " Communic" and similar word-start fragments. Silent on related religious text without that piece.
result.label: Protest- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the prefix ' hyper' when it begins a word, especially before pieces like -bole, -box, -bolic or -parameter. Weakly fires on other word-start pieces such as 'ron' in macronutrients.
result.label: ' hyper' word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the word " machine" in technical and academic text, mostly as the start of "machine learning" after prepositions like "of", "in", "for". Weakly fires on " computer" in "field of computer science". Members are detectors of machine and ML terms.
result.label: ' machine' in machine learning

result.description: Fires on adjective/noun suffix pieces like 'ial', 'ical', 'ist', 'ural' that begin a word right after a sentence-ending period, apparently a word fragment starting a new sentence. Silent on ordinary sentence starts.
result.label: Suffix fragments after sentence end

result.description: Fires on the final piece "ence" in "adherence" (also "adhering"), in compliance text where "to" follows. It stays silent on "ence" in other words like "resilience".
result.label: adherence (adher-ence) before "to"

result.description: Fires on a hyphen inside a compound term, mainly after "Wi" (Wi-Fi) and "Cross" (Cross-Validation), predicting a capitalized continuation like "Fi". Silent on hyphens in other compounds such as higher-order or device-to-device.
result.label: Hyphen in Wi-Fi / Cross-Validation

result.description: Fires on connectors (" and", ",", " or") joining items in a pair or list, especially after bare nouns like titles or "X vs." lists in literary conflict types. Silent on many ordinary " and" tokens in running prose.
result.label: Coordinating and/comma between list items

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'ber' (as in cy-ber-security), 'мо', 'мен' inside words, often in garbled or Cyrillic text. Members detect security/attack terms and 'ber'. Output pushes toward 'security'.
result.label: 'ber' in cyber- word pieces
' una' before 'uthorized'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' una' (start of "unauthorized") in security text, usually after "against", "prevent", "from". It predicts the continuation 'ut' (uthorized). Members are mostly ' una' detectors plus security-topic features.
Fires on the word piece 'du' inside split words, mainly in "trans-du-ction", "trans-du-cers" and "-du-ality". Members are detectors of 'du' and similar mid-word pieces (bul, val, ra, cript).
result.label: 'du' piece in transduction

result.description: Fires on the word piece after "imm" (mostly 'ers' in immersive/immersed, also 'ort' in immortality), where the word is being built from "imm-". It stays silent on 'ers' in other words like fosters, listeners, philosophers.
result.label: 'imm' + ers/ort word piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' b', mostly as a variable name in math expressions (b0, b̂, a^3 - b^3, f(a, b)). Weaker on ' b' starting words like bite or bogs. Predicts word continuations like 'ating'.
result.label: ' b' variable token

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Rec" at the start of a capitalized title or heading word, such as Recovery or Recognition. It predicts a continuation like "overy" or "ogn". Silent on ordinary lowercase text.
result.label: ' Rec' word-start in titles
'ance' ending in consonance-type words
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ance' when it completes a noun like consonance, assonance, sibilance, resonance or transmittance. It stays quiet on 'ance' in 'enhance' and 'relevance'.

Fires on varied abstract nouns and function words in academic or abstract expository prose (e.g. "needs", "unity", "the", "various"), often after lists or "and". No dominant token. Silent on "and" inside plain lists of nouns.
result.label: Scattered tokens in abstract academic prose

result.description: Fires on the token ' P' (capital P with leading space), mostly as the probability symbol P(A|B) in math text, but also as a word-initial piece in names or phrases like "Noun P-hrase". Members are mostly ' P' token detectors.
result.label: Capital ' P' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dess' at the start of "dessert(s)", when it is split into pieces. Members include dessert-piece detectors and food/cooking context. The next-token logits are not informative.
result.label: ' dess' piece of dessert

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'et' (multifacet-ed, -etric, -etylene), 'anger' in endangered, and 'pler' in Kepler. Mostly sub-word pieces inside longer words; silent on 'et' in tapestry. Members are 'et' detectors.
result.label: Mid-word 'et'/'anger' fragments

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the protect/shield/respect family (' shield', ' protect', 'pect' in "Respect"), often mid-word before a suffix. Members detect protect/shield tokens; silent on related ethics text without these words.
result.label: protect/shield/respect word pieces
Word-start piece of lux-/prosper- words
result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' lux' (luxury, luxurious) and ' prosper' (prosperity), also ' east', ' kilom', where a suffix completes the word. Predicts word-ending pieces such as 'ury' and 'ity'.

Fires on the token piece "active" as a word ending, especially in "proactive", "reactive", "interactive" and "radioactive". It is weaker on standalone "active". Most members are detectors of "active" in earlier layers.
result.label: "active" word-ending piece

result.description: Fires mostly on the token " equipment" (also "ep" in "creep"), especially as a noun after modifiers like kitchen, protective or high-level. Members include several " equipment" detectors. Silent on unrelated food-hygiene text.
result.label: ' equipment' noun detector

result.description: Fires on the 'th' (or 'TH') ordinal suffix after a numeral, mainly in century expressions like "16th–17th century". It is silent on one "20th century" example, so what separates the cases is unclear.
result.label: Ordinal 'th' before century

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'il' inside words such as mercantilism, libilist, vigilance, resilient, quilters, and the start of "Soil". Members are mostly 'il' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: 'il' word piece

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' cy' (cytochrome, cycling, cyber) and ' gu' (guild, guidelines) when the word is split into pieces and more of the word must follow. Members are detectors of ' cy', ' Cy' and ' gu' tokens.
result.label: Word-start fragments ' cy' / ' gu'

result.description: Fires on "physical" and word-ending pieces like -ical/-ible (non-physical, tangible, Physical-ism) in philosophy-of-mind talk about physical versus mental. Silent on "-ical" in "philosophical". Predicts abstract nouns like existence, reality.
result.label: physical / tangible in mind-matter contexts

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' split off as a separate token after a verb stem (overflow-ing, sunbath-ing, bow-ing), often in gerund lists or noun-like uses. It stays quiet on 'ing' in some other words like recurring, mastering, posing.
result.label: Split-off 'ing' suffix after stem

result.description: Fires on abstract noun endings like ' duration', ' intensity', and 'ation' (e.g. exclam-ation, punctu-ation) in grammar and language-usage text, especially in lists of properties such as duration, frequency, intensity.
result.label: duration/intensity/-ation nouns in grammar text

result.description: Fires on the word right after "since" (mostly " the", also " its", " then", or a space before a year), where a time reference like a century or year is expected. Silent on " the" after other words.
result.label: Word after "since" (since the…)

result.description: Fires on the abstract-noun slot in flowery openers like "Within the intricate and multifaceted realm/canvas/landscape/world of...", at the start of a document. It is silent on "realm" later in a text.
result.label: Ornate "realm of" opener noun
'ce' inside pharmaceutical
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ce' in "pharma|ce|utical(s)", where the next piece is likely 'ut'. It also fires weakly on 'ce' in similar splits like sauce and Oceania, and on 'hr' in unusual names.

Fires on word-initial fragments in technical science text: 'bo' in carbohydrate, ' disp' in displacement/dispersion, ' cond'. Predicts continuations like 'lacement', 'ersion', 'ensed'. Needs the piece to be an incomplete word start.
result.label: Word-start fragments: bo, disp, cond

result.description: Fires on the piece after "Fin" in "finance"/"financial" ('an', 'ance'), mostly in finance text. It stays silent on 'ance' in other words such as "enhance" and "undance".
result.label: Fin- word piece in finance

result.description: Fires on the noun ' impact' when it is the head noun at the start of a phrase like "impact of X", and it predicts "on" or "upon". It stays silent when 'impact' is a verb or a plural form ("impacts").
result.label: noun ' impact' (impact of/on)

result.description: Fires on the token ' tender', especially when repeated or in lists of cooking descriptors (tender meat, tender vegetables). Members include cooking/food detectors and ' tender' token detectors. Weakly fires on ' colon' before 'ization'.
result.label: ' tender' in cooking text

result.description: Fires on varied function and generic words (changes, is, and, this) inside text about geological eras like the Paleozoic, Cambrian and Permian. Members detect earth-science and deep-time word pieces. Peak tokens are scattered, so evidence is mixed.
result.label: Geological era text, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on the word "motion" (also "Mot|ion") in physics and mechanics text, such as laws of motion, planetary motion and equations of motion. Members are mostly detectors of "motion", "velocity" and "Newton".
result.label: "motion" in physics contexts

result.description: Fires on the token " pressure" in physical or technical text (atmospheric, differential, hydrostatic pressure). Members are mostly detectors of " pressure"/"press" itself. Weakly fires on " equilibrium" in chemistry.
result.label: ' pressure' token detector
'cis' in 'exercises'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cis' in 'exer|cis|es', and less on 'ations' in 'Equations'. Members detect 'cis' and the following 'es' of 'exercises'. Weakly active on 'impre|cis|ible'.
Fires on ' to' right after "continue/continues/continued" (continue to + verb). It stays silent on ' to' after other words such as "leading to", "used to", "responding to".
result.label: 'to' after continue

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' h' when it starts a split word, mostly 'hormone/hormonal' after words like thyroid, steroid or producing. It also fires weakly on ' h' in 'hinges' and 'hug'. It is silent when the whole word 'hormone' is not split.
result.label: split ' h' starting hormone

result.description: Fires on the piece 'igen' inside "epigenetic/epigenetics/epigenome" after "ep". Silent on 'igen' in "tumorigenesis", so it needs the ep+igen word start.
result.label: 'igen' in epigenetic

result.description: Fires on the token ' vocal' in texts about singing and voice anatomy or technique (vocal cords, vocal technique, vocal instrument). Weakly on other music words like 'musical'. Silent on non-vocal music text.
result.label: ' vocal' in singing/voice text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ound' inside "surroundings" (system and its surroundings), with weak activation on 'ly' in "subtly". Members are detectors of 'ound' and related word pieces.
result.label: 'ound' in surroundings

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ending" (also "end", "ends") completing "bending" of light or sound waves in physics text. Mostly the "-ending" piece after "b"; silent on other physics contexts without this word.
result.label: "b-ending" word piece (bending)

result.description: Fires on the token 'a' without a leading space, used as a variable or symbol (e.g. f(a), x-a), a quoted letter, or a word-final 'a'. Silent on ordinary text without this token. Members are mostly 'a' token detectors.
result.label: Bare 'a' token (variable/letter)

result.description: Fires on the word right after a form of "made" (made it, made possible, made significant strides, made from/up of). Silent on "it" after other verbs like "making it" or "applied it".
result.label: Word following "made"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "atch" in "hatch/hatching" (art shading technique, e.g. cross-hatching), after "h". Members are mostly "atch" detectors plus art-related context.
result.label: "atch" in hatching

result.description: Fires on the token ' within' (as a preposition meaning inside or in the scope of something), mostly in abstract or mathematical text. Many members are earlier-layer ' within' detectors. Predicts units or limits such as seconds, specified, acceptable.
result.label: ' within' preposition detector

result.description: Fires on the token '2' that begins a year or century (2000, 2010, 20th) right after "late", "mid", "early" or "following the". It stays silent on '2' inside multi-digit numbers like 1823 or 1982.
result.label: Leading '2' of a year after late/mid/early

result.description: Fires on the word " new" (also " New") as an adjective before an abstract noun like perspectives, developments, opportunities or era, mostly in technology and progress text. It stays silent on a " new" at the start of a text fragment before a technical term.
result.label: ' new' before abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the last word piece of a noun phrase after "period(s) of" plus an adjective (e.g. "periods of cultural prosper-ity", "economic transformation", "global history"). Weak elsewhere; silent on "-ity" in words like diversity or clarity.
result.label: Noun ending after "periods of ..."

result.description: Fires on ' on' in "depending on" / "depends on" (varies depending on X). Weaker on "dependent on". Silent on ' on' after nouns like reliance, impact, or in other prepositional uses.
result.label: 'on' in "depending on"
