result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ities'/'ity' completing "dispar-" (disparities/disparity), in economic or social inequality text. Silent on 'ities' in other words such as "opportunities".
result.label: disparity suffix -ities/-ity

result.description: Fires on past-participle or adjective forms (-ured, detailed, included, defined, described) that follow an adverb or auxiliary in academic or technical prose. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak, with many shared members.
result.label: Participles in academic descriptive prose

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments mid-word, mainly 'clar' (as in clarification) and 'rac' in Terracotta, where a suffix such as -ification or -otta is expected. Members detect other word-start pieces (authentic, ctu, trans, Ke).
result.label: 'clar' / 'rac' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires mostly on " Berlin" in "Berlin Wall"/"Berlin Airlift" contexts, and on the word piece " au"/" Au" in "auctions". Members detect Berlin, Germany and Soviet tokens. It is silent on some "auction" contexts.
result.label: Berlin (Wall/Airlift) and au(ctions)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ersion' in "immersion" and 'al' in "focal", with weaker firing on ' its' and similar. Members detect these specific word pieces (imm-ersion, foc-al).
result.label: immersion / focal word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after "thanks" (and more weakly after "due"), i.e. the "thanks to" / "due to" prepositional phrase. Silent on ' to' after adjectives or nouns like "possible to", "ability to", "crucial to".
result.label: "to" in "thanks to" / "due to"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ulation' when it completes the word "modulation" (signal or voice modulation). It stays silent on 'ulation' in simulation and articulation, so it needs the "mod" prefix.
result.label: 'ulation' in "modulation"

result.description: Fires on the middle pieces of the split name "Kolmogorov" (mainly 'm' and 'og' after "Kol"/"Kolm"). Also fires on similar mid-name pieces (Schrödinger, Bernoulli, Manhattan). It stays silent when 'm' starts the word without "Kol" before it.
result.label: Kolmogorov name-piece 'm'/'og'

result.description: Fires on the token "order" in "first-order" and "second-order" logic, after a hyphen. It fires weakly on "order" inside "disorder" and in "order" linguistics. The circuit is mostly "order" detectors plus "logic" context.
result.label: "order" in second-order logic

result.description: Fires on ' following' (and ' beginning') right after "the", when it is a determiner-like word introducing what comes next ("the following", "the beginning"). Members detect following/followed, beginning/starting/introduction and given.
result.label: "the following" / "the beginning" after the

result.description: Fires on the token 'e' right after the prefix 'macro' (macro|economics, macro|economic). It is silent on 'e' after 'socio' or 'Bio', or at the start of a word. Members detect scale prefixes like macro/micro/Mac.
result.label: 'e' after 'macro' prefix

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and noun slots inside academic or technical terms (ism, ology, ferromagnetism, homogeneity, software, collection), often in math, science or philosophy text. It is silent on 'ism' in some -ism words such as realism and nationalism.
result.label: Academic term word-pieces, mixed

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ce' inside the word "oceans" (after "o"), and weakly on 'ce' in similar mid-word positions like "scarce". Silent when 'ce' starts a word or follows other pieces, as in "coalesce".
result.label: 'ce' inside "oceans"
Mid-word pieces of Greek-derived terms
result.description: Fires on word-internal fragments early in a long technical word, mainly 'omed' in "Biomedical" and 'phen' in "hyphenation"/"phenomena", where the next piece continues the word (e.g. 'ical'). Weaker on other mid-word fragments like 'ov' in "stereovision".

Fires on word-start fragments of longer words, mainly ' acc' (as in accents) and 'grad' (as in degradation), where a suffix is expected to complete the word. Members detect these fragments, plus similar ones like sc, pot, oscill, val.
result.label: Word-start fragments acc/grad

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' revel' (and ' reve') at the start of "revelation(s)" or "reveal", where the next piece is expected to complete the word. It is mostly seen in writing-craft or narrative text.
result.label: ' revel' piece in revelation

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings like 'ological' and 'cial' (Gla-cial) in earth-science text such as geology, glaciers and geomorphology. It stays silent on 'ological' in meteorological, biological, or geological contexts at other positions, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Earth-science word endings (ological, cial)

result.description: Fires on the word "modern"/"Modern" as an adjective in phrases like "modern atomic model", "modern era", "modern times". Members are mostly detectors of modern/current/contemporary. Silent on the synonym "contemporary".
result.label: word "modern"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ators" completing "indic|ators" (also " indicator"), as in economic or key performance indicators. It stays silent on "ators" in other words such as "Innovators".
result.label: "indicators" word ending

result.description: Fires on abstract-idea nouns ' notion', ' idea', ' concept' right after "the/The", typically introducing an "of ..." or "that ..." clause describing the idea. Members are detectors of these words.
result.label: notion/idea/concept after 'the'

result.description: Fires on single digit tokens (2, 3, 4, 5, 8) inside long runs of digits, such as number sequences or lists. It stays silent on digits within years like 1830s or 1923, which are in ordinary prose.
result.label: Digits inside long number strings

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized title-style word or heading (' List' in "Listening", ' Network', 'ayer', 'row') in title-cased lists of topics, where a word continues into a suffix. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Title-case word-start before suffix
Word-initial "Imp" piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Imp"/"imp" (Implication, Impact, Implicit, Impurities) when the word is split into pieces. It pushes toward continuations like "lications", "urity" and "act". Upstream members are mostly "imp" token detectors.

Fires on "orthogonal" (and the "ogonal" piece of Orthogonal) in linear algebra and functional analysis text, such as orthogonal vectors, bases or projections. Silent when the word appears at the very start of a text with no math context.
result.label: orthogonal in linear algebra
' Public' at list-item heading start
result.description: Fires mostly on ' Public' starting a new topic line in a list of academic or economics subject headings (e.g. "Public Sector Size"). Also weakly fires on word pieces like 'ur' and 'RAM'. Evidence is mixed.

Fires on the hyphen after "light" (light-dependent, light-emitting, light-year) and on suffixes like "-ism" in bilingualism, completing a compound or word. Silent on hyphens after other words (three-, wave-, ladder-).
result.label: Hyphen after "light"; -ism suffix

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces completing a noun after "green" or sustainability words (green chemistry, green economies, green technologies, futures). Silent on "chemistry" in ordinary science contexts. Members detect recycling/waste/green vocabulary.
result.label: Green/sustainability compound noun endings

result.description: Fires on the first letter or piece (f, c, m, dis, w) right after the prefix "inter" inside words like interfere, interface, intercultural, interdisciplinary, interwoven. Silent on "interaction" and "interconnectedness" where the next piece differs.
result.label: Word piece after "inter-" prefix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ass' inside longer words (pot-ass-ium, brass, comp-ass, agr-ass, Thal-ass-ia). Silent when 'ass' starts the text or in encompass mid-sentence. Members are 'ass' detectors.
result.label: 'ass' word piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Or' when it begins a word split into pieces, mainly "Orbital/Orbit" in headings after a number, '#' or colon. Silent when ' Or' is the very first token of the document.
result.label: ' Or' start of Orbital

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' transm' at the start of a split word like transmitted/transmitting, mostly after "are/be/for". Members are detectors of ' transm' and similar word-start fragments (convey, deliver, evol).
result.label: ' transm' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' English' in linguistic-history text, often after "into", "of", "in" or "Old/Middle". It stays silent when English follows "the" or "Early Modern", starts the sentence, or sits inside "Oxford English". Members are English/language-name detectors.
result.label: ' English' in language-history prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ph' when it starts a word such as phonetics, phonology or phonon. Most members are detectors of ' ph' itself. The contrast 'pythonous' is silent, so the piece's position in a word may matter.
result.label: ' ph' word-start piece (phonetics)

result.description: Fires on the word " about" as a preposition after nouns or verbs of discussion or topic (conversation about, educating about, more about, concerns about). Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of " about" itself.
result.label: ' about' preposition detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Sem" (as in Semantic/Semantics), mostly at the start of a document or heading. It is weaker on " of" in "array of" or "range of". Members detect Sem/sem and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' Sem' word-start piece (Semantics)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " cer" (also " Cer", " Vol") that begins a longer word such as ceramic or ceremony, where the next piece is still to come. Members detect "cer" and similar word-initial fragments.
result.label: Word-initial "cer" fragment (ceramic)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' est' at the start of "esters"/"esterification" (chemistry), a split-word fragment before the rest of the word. Upstream members detect ' est' and similar word-start fragments.
result.label: ' est' piece in ester words
Word-fragment ' ill' in 'illusion'
result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly ' ill' before "-usion" (illusion), also 'it' in pituitary and similar pieces of longer split words. It predicts word continuations such as 'usion' or 'umin'.
Fires on the piece 'ic' inside "telemedicine" (after "Telemed"), predicting the "ine" ending. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as chronic, therapeutic, genomic and robotic.
result.label: 'ic' in telemedicine

result.description: Fires on scattered conjunction and list-continuation tokens (" or", " and", ",") and word-piece fragments (e.g. "ue" in "venue") in music/audio and technical text. Peaks are mixed and the contrast is inconsistent, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Mixed conjunctions and word pieces

result.description: Fires on the digit '2' (occasionally 3, 4, 6) in the middle or end of long digit strings and numeric codes. It stays silent on '2' at the start of a year such as 2000 or 2005.
result.label: Digit '2' inside long numbers

result.description: Fires on a capital letter 'H' (occasionally S, T) that begins a word piece right after a hyphen or underscore, as in Austro-Hungarian, Denavit-Hartenberg, T_H. Silent in ordinary prose.
result.label: 'H' after hyphen or underscore

result.description: Fires on the token ' peak' used as a modifier before a measurement noun (peak size, peak area, peak flows, peak volume). Members are mostly ' peak' detectors plus related words like maximum and height.
result.label: ' peak' as measurement modifier

result.description: Fires on name pieces (surnames, first names, name fragments) inside lists of people's names, one per line. Peaks are varied (Johnson, Marg, Oscar, H), with a few weak non-name hits. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Name pieces in person-name lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece " develop" (start of "developments") when it follows "these"/"this" referring back to earlier developments. It stays silent when "develop" follows other words or starts a sentence or phrase.
result.label: "these develop(ments)" anaphoric develop

result.description: Fires on the verb "create" and its forms, mainly " creating" and " create", where a thing is being made (menus, images, art). Members are detectors of create/creating tokens. Predicts a following object noun or adjective.
result.label: create/creating verb

result.description: Fires on the token ' ideal' (and 'al' in 'Idealist'), mostly as the stem of idealism/idealist/idealized. It is strongest in philosophy contexts such as transcendental idealism, and also fires on 'ideal' as an adjective.
result.label: ' ideal' word-stem detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' indic' when it follows a preceding word, as in "natural indic|ators" or "economic indic|ators", predicting the suffix to come. Silent when ' indic' starts the text. Weakly fires on similar pieces like ' anal' and ' calcul'.
result.label: ' indic' piece before -ators

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' stir', as in stir-fry or stirring, with weak activation on a few other word starts like ' warm' and ' found'. Members are mostly ' stir' detectors plus cooking-related features.
result.label: ' stir' token (stir-fry)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Islam' when it is the start of "Islamic" (e.g. "the early Islamic ages", "Islamic Golden Age"), before the "ic" ending. Members detect Islam/Arab/Goth-like adjective stems that take -ic.
result.label: ' Islam' stem before -ic

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' di' when it starts a longer word (diaries, diode, diagnostic, dipole, diphthong), predicting continuations like 'agnostic'. Weakly on similar beginnings like ' equival'.
result.label: ' di' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces and symbols (hyphen in a math formula, ' Polit', 'dis', 'archy', digits) in academic or list-like text, often where a word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. No single token dominates; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed word-fragment tokens in academic text

result.description: Fires on the 'g' piece inside the name Gilgamesh (Gil-g-amesh), mostly when preceded by 'Gil'. Silent on 'g' in other words like 'undergone' or a standalone 'give'. Members are 'g' detectors plus epic/narrative context.
result.label: 'g' in Gilgamesh

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'roid' in "embroidery", where it continues the split word after "emb". It is silent on other text, such as knitting text without this word. Members detect mid-word pieces like 'roid', 'ery', 'od', 'ruit'.
result.label: 'roid' inside embroidery

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ino' (in amino) and ' prote' (in proteins), plus 'R' in RNA, inside molecular biology text. Members detect amino, protein, RNA, translation tokens. Weak firing on other word-start pieces like 'Char' and 'orig'.
result.label: amino / protein word pieces in biochemistry

result.description: Fires on the word piece "in" inside split words like "conf-in-ement" and "tropon-in". It stays quiet on "in" in other words such as Gaugu-in, fasc-in-ating and prom-in-ence.
result.label: "in" piece in confinement

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' eth' (before -ics/-ical), as in "applied ethics" or "ethical principles". Members detect ' eth' at earlier layers. It was silent on one case, "the ethical dimensions" after a dash.
result.label: ' eth' piece of ethics/ethical

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mil' when it starts 'milestone(s)', after a preceding word such as 'other', 'significant' or 'each'. It stays silent when 'mil' is the first token of the text.
result.label: 'mil' in milestone

result.description: Fires on the pronoun " them" as the direct object right after a transitive verb (avoid them, mitigate them, replace them). Weaker when after a preposition. Silent on the contrast passage, which has no such object pronoun.
result.label: " them" as verb object

result.description: Fires on the 'ving' piece at the end of "obser-ving" (observing someone/villagers), where an object of watching is expected next. It stays silent on 'ving' in "improving", so it needs the observe word.
result.label: 'ving' in "observing"

result.description: Fires on the comparative word " more" when it comes before an adjective, adverb or noun, as in "more efficient" or "more power". Members are mostly detectors of " more" itself. The contrast text has no " more".
result.label: comparative " more" before adjective

result.description: Fires on the word "by" (and "By", also the start of "Byzantine"), especially when it opens a method or means phrase ("by implication", "by connecting") or is mentioned as a word. It stays silent on passive-agent "by" ("illustrated by", "noticed by").
result.label: "by" as means/method preposition

result.description: Fires on " War" in "Cold War". It stays silent on " War" in "World War II" or "First World War", so it needs the word "Cold" directly before it.
result.label: War in "Cold War"

result.description: Fires on the word "private"/"Private", especially as a modifier or word start (privateering, private-sector, public-private). Silent on one "private settings" example, so the condition is unclear. Predicts word continuations like "ining".
result.label: Word "private" (privateering, sector)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ac' (or ' Ac') that starts "acids", mostly in chemistry/biochemistry text such as "amino acids", "monoprotic acids", "weak acids like acetic". Silent on ' ac' after "these".
result.label: ' ac' start of "acids"

result.description: Fires on the suffix "eties" completing "societies" (occasionally "communities", "society") in text about early human history, civilizations and historical transitions. It is silent on food-production text that lacks this word.
result.label: "societies" suffix in history text

result.description: Fires on the word " management" as the second part of a compound noun, such as memory management, process management or time management. It is strongest in computing and systems lists, and silent on "memory" alone.
result.label: management after a noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' def' when it begins a longer word such as deficit, deforestation, defying or deficient. Silent on the contrast text, which has no ' def' token.
result.label: ' def' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lo" (" lo" or "lo"), both as a word start (locks, looms, loans) and inside words (balloon, diploid, colloidal, parallelogram). Members are mostly "lo" token detectors.
result.label: "lo" word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "end" (especially "marked the end of", also "conclusion of", "fall of"), the ending/termination sense. It stays silent on "of" after other nouns like "departments of", "those of", "adoption of".
result.label: "of" after "end"

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces " hom", " Hom" and " heter" (homology, homotopy, homograph, heteroskedastic), where the word continues. It predicts continuations like "ogeneous" and "ogene". Members are mostly " hom" token detectors.
result.label: hom-/heter- word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the word "thermal" (and the final "al" of "Thermal" or "geothermal") in physics and materials-science text about heat transfer, expansion, and conductivity. Members detect heat, temperature, thermo- and thermal tokens.
result.label: Thermal (heat-related adjective)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ity' completing technical statistics/physics nouns like heteroskedasticity, elasticity, plasticity. It stays quiet on 'ity' in common words such as equity, austerity, diversity and fidelity.
result.label: -ity in technical science terms

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces like 'ant' (particip-ant, determin-ant, reson-ant), 'yp' in prototyping, 'ur' in slurry, and 'ery' in embroidery. It is strongest where a word is being completed, often 'particip-' words.
result.label: Word-ending pieces, esp. participant

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a relative pronoun right after "a way" / "ways" (e.g. "in a way that"), introducing a clause describing the manner. Weaker on other nouns followed by relative "that". Silent after "ease", "so that", or other nouns.
result.label: "that" after "a way"

result.description: Fires on the word " Type" in "Type I and Type II" error headings (statistics), and weakly on similar tokens like " oppon". Members detect " Type", " II", "alpha" and other "type" tokens.
result.label: "Type" in Type I/II errors

result.description: Fires mainly on " supply" in economics phrases like "balance between supply and demand", and sometimes on "Le" in "Leadership". It stays silent on "supply" in "our supply chain", so it seems to need the supply-and-demand context.
result.label: supply in supply-demand phrases

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' in "att-ent-ive/ively/iveness" (attentive, attentively), predicting the suffix 'ive'. Weaker firing on a few other pieces like ' to' and 'cer'.
result.label: 'ent' inside "attentive"

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes like 'ant', 'otic', 'ic' inside scientific terms (antibiotic, reactant, resonant, abiotic), mostly in biology/chemistry text. Silent on 'ant' in 'Significant'.
result.label: Scientific term suffix pieces (ant/otic)

result.description: Fires on an early word fragment in the middle of a rare or multi-piece word (e.g. 'pi' in epistemic, ' My' in Mycenaean, 'sk' in skill), where the word is not yet complete. The next piece is a continuation, so it is a word-start detector for split words.
result.label: Word-initial fragments of split words

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining noun phrases right after environmental/sustainability terms (e.g. "environmental issues and", "environmental conservation and"). It stays silent on ' and' after adjectives or other topics.
result.label: ' and' after environmental terms

result.description: Fires on the word "color"/"colors" (and "colour"), including as the stem of "coloring", across graph coloring, color theory and color charge. It is silent when the idea is expressed with other words, such as "hues".
result.label: color / colors word detector

result.description: Fires on the "-ing" suffix of a participle like underscoring, showcasing or highlighting, which introduces a clause about a following object ("their role"). It also fires on some '0' digits. It stays silent on "-ing" after analyzing or unraveling.
result.label: participle -ing before object phrase

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ske" at the start of words like skepticism, skew, skewness, and skew-symmetric. Upstream members mostly detect the same " ske" token or similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' ske' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "romagnet" in "electromagnetic/electromagnetism" (also ferromagnetic), a mid-word piece where a suffix like "ic" is expected. Members detect similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: "romagnet" in electromagnetic

result.description: Fires on the word piece "icular" in "particular" (particularly, Particular solutions, Particulars), also perpendicular. Supported by detectors of "icular" and of preceding word pieces.
result.label: "icular" in particular

result.description: Fires on the word ' space' (or ' Space') in technical or abstract phrases such as space complexity, auxiliary space, null space, vector space, white space. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. The logits favour 'craft' and similar suffixes.
result.label: ' space' token detector
Sentence-opening Due/When/With and -building
result.description: Fires on ' Due' (and ' When', ' With', ' As') at the start of a document or sentence, and on 'building' in compounds like world-building. Mixed set of tokens; members detect 'building' and sentence-initial function words.

Fires on the word "at" when it is quoted or discussed as a preposition (e.g. 'preposition "at" can indicate…'), and weakly on word pieces like Cub-, Col-, break-. Silent on "at" inside words such as versatility or Seurat.
result.label: Quoted preposition "at" in grammar talk

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces "Under"/"under" (Underfitting, Understanding, underneath) and some other word-start fragments like "Struct-ural", "scaff-", "ult-". Mostly a detector of the "under" prefix at word start, with a few similar beginnings.
result.label: Under- prefix and word fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " liquid" (as noun or adjective, e.g. "liquid-solid", "liquid form") in science and chemistry text. Weakly also on "solvent". Members detect liquid, fluid and related word pieces.
result.label: ' liquid' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer word, mainly ' deb' (before "t"), 'ness' in "harnessing", 'z' in "dozens", and 'nis' in "omniscient". It predicts a continuation of the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: deb, ness, z

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of a compound or split word (line, coll-age, spect-acles, thread-ing) where the word is likely to continue with a suffix or hyphenated part. Mostly in art and culture text. Silent on 'in line with'.
result.label: Mid-word piece before suffix, art text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'la' / ' Gla' at the start of "glacial/glacier" words (e.g. a document-initial "Glacial ..."), predicting the continuation 'cial'. Silent on 'la' in unrelated words like "interlacing".
result.label: Gla- piece of glacier words
'hel' fragment in helix/helium words
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'hel' (as in helix, helices, helium, helicase) in scientific text, especially after 'alpha-' or 'helix-turn-'. Members are detectors of 'hel' and similar split-word beginnings.

Fires on the word piece 'ular' as a suffix inside words like secular, modular, intercellular and vernacular. It is weaker on 'circular'. The members mostly detect 'ular' or the preceding piece such as 'sec' or 'Mod'.
result.label: 'ular' suffix in words

result.description: Fires on ' hole' / ' holes' right after 'black' in astrophysics text about black holes. Silent on vacuum/void text without 'black hole'. Members are detectors of black-hole context and of 'hole(s)' after 'black'.
result.label: hole(s) after 'black'

result.description: Fires on the 'CD' piece in 'GCD' (greatest common divisor), and less on word-internal pieces like 'b' in 'herb', 'ance' in 'importance', 'ed' in 'heredity'. Mostly a word-piece detector for 'CD' after 'G'.
result.label: CD in GCD (word pieces)

result.description: Fires on verb endings (-ize, -izing, -ing) or a verb like "present" in coordinated lists of verbs ("collect, analyze, and visualize"). Silent on -ize in other contexts like "prioritize rigorously" or "maximize".
result.label: Verb endings in coordinated verb lists

result.description: Fires on the token ' end' when it starts a word or compound (endogenous, endothelial, endangered, endpoints, end-group). It is most active in technical or scientific text and predicts word-continuation pieces.
result.label: ' end' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on 'cial' in "facial" (not in "crucial"), and on a few other tokens like ' arithmetic', 'UI' and ' Menu'. Members detect facial/gesture/expression words, so it mainly tracks "facial" in nonverbal-communication text.
result.label: facial 'cial' piece (not crucial)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ont" at the start of "ontology"/"ontological", predicting suffixes like -ology/-ological. Weak activity on similar word-start pieces such as "verte" and "tel".
result.label: "ont" piece of ontology

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ab' in the middle of a longer word, mostly 'voc|ab|ulary' and also 'syll|ab|aries' and 'di|ab|etes'. Members are detectors of this 'ab' piece.
result.label: 'ab' inside vocabulary

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after emerge/develop verbs (emerging as, emerged as, developed as), introducing the role or status something becomes. Stays silent on 'act as', 'serve as', 'such as', and 'as emphasized'.
result.label: ' as' after emerge/develop verbs

result.description: Fires on the last token of a noun-phrase item (e.g. 'scores', 'positioning', 'management', 'prediction') inside comma-separated lists of business or technical topics. It stays silent on 'ing' in verbs or 'marketing' within running text.
result.label: Final noun in topic lists
'ten' inside Incompleteness
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ten' in "Incompleteness" / "Completeness" (Gödel's theorem), predicting a following 'ess'. It stays silent when 'ten' starts a text with no preceding word piece, so it needs the preceding "Incomple" / "Comple" piece.
Fires on the word-piece ' ens' when it starts a word like "ensures" or "ensembles", mid-sentence after a preceding word. It is silent when ' ens' begins the document, as in "ensured".
result.label: ' ens' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'icle' in "wave-particle" (duality) and on 'verb' in "subject-verb" / "adverb", i.e. the end of a split technical word or hyphenated compound. Weak elsewhere on mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'icle' in particle, 'verb' pieces

result.description: Fires on the 's' token as a contraction of "is" (it's, that's, who's), often before a predicate like "not" or "just". Stays silent on possessive 's after nouns or names (spider's, Milnor's).
result.label: Contraction 's (is), not possessive

result.description: Fires on the verb ' take' (also takes/taking), especially in "let's take" and similar verb uses. Members are mostly detectors of take-forms in earlier layers. The contrast text doesn't contain the token, so no extra condition is evident.
result.label: verb 'take' detector
Plural ' maps' after a modifier
result.description: Fires on the token ' maps' when it follows a modifying word, such as 'Thematic maps', 'Political maps' or 'distribution maps'. It stays silent when ' maps' starts the text with no preceding modifier. Members are map, mapping and cartography detectors.

Fires on mid-word pieces inside longer, multi-token words, such as 'on' in 'Decolonization', 'ocrat' and 'overy' in 'Discovery', and on hyphens. It fires inside a word that is still unfinished, and is silent on 'on' inside other words (harmonies, phonologies).
result.label: Mid-word piece in split words

result.description: Fires on the verb ' benefit' after a subject (e.g. "sectors benefit", "Businesses can benefit"), where "from" is expected next. Weaker on 'benefits' and 'benefiting'. Silent on other text.
result.label: verb 'benefit' before 'from'
Hyphen after hands/eye compounds
result.description: Fires on the hyphen token after a first word like "hands", "eye" or "user", in technology and interface text (hands-free, eye-tracking, eye-based). It stays silent on hyphens after "self", "cross" or "le".

result.label: ' gr' word-start in grill words
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' gr' when it begins a split word, mostly 'grill/grilling/grate' in barbecue text. It predicts a continuation like 'ills' or 'ated'. Weak activity on other word-start fragments such as 'aber', 'tit' and 'Conf'.

Fires on scattered words, such as " since", " or", " System", " recognized" and " Search", often in technical or list-like text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, with no discriminative members. The pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function and term tokens

result.description: Fires on the token 'red' as a standalone word or suffix (Barred, shredded, red spiral) and on ' before' in temporal clauses. Silent on 'red' inside 'ingredients'. Two unrelated tokens share it.
result.label: 'red' and 'before' tokens

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'is' (Brava-is, Moll-is-ols), 'de' in attendees, and similar word fragments inside rare or multi-token words. Silent on 'is' in other words like cuisine.
result.label: Mid-word 'is'/'de' fragments in rare words

result.description: Fires on the word " encryption" (and its piece "ryption") in text about cryptography, especially after "symmetric", "public-key", "for" or "categories of". Members are encryption, crypt and key/security detectors.
result.label: encryption word detector
'ist' in whistleblower
result.description: Fires on the 'ist' piece inside "wh-ist-leblower" / "whistlebreaker" / "whistler", where the word is split into tokens. It stays silent on 'ist' as a suffix (reformist, industrialist) or in "twist".

Fires on plural endings (-s, -isms, systems, programs, channels) of institutional/procedural nouns like protocols, mechanisms, systems in risk-management or policy text. Silent on possessive 's and on plurals in other contexts such as contracts.
result.label: Plural policy/procedure nouns (protocols, mechanisms)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ra' in the prefix "ultra" (ultra-fast, ultra-compact, ultra filters), weakly on intensifiers like ' very' and ' highly'. Silent on 'ra' in other words such as "unravel".
result.label: 'ra' in "ultra" prefix

result.description: Fires on the token ' across' when it follows a noun or verb and introduces a range of items (periods, cultures, regions), as in "changes across different periods". Strongest in science or academic text. Members are mostly ' across' detectors.
result.label: ' across' before a range of items

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (and similar word pieces) when it completes a biology/molecular term such as "signaling" or "binding", especially after "signal". It stays silent on 'ing' in generic verbs like "discovering" or "maintaining".
result.label: -ing suffix in signaling/biology terms
Word-piece 'int' in Monoprint
result.description: Fires mainly on the subword 'int' inside "Monoprint(ing)", and weakly on other mid-word pieces like 'yz' in catalyzing and 'ible' in indelible. It seems to need an unfinished word where the piece sits mid-word, in art/printmaking text.

Fires on the word-piece ' qu' when it begins a split word such as quark, quilting, qubit or quenching. The contrast is knitting text without a split ' qu'. Upstream members are mostly ' qu' detectors.
result.label: ' qu' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the 'L' token completing "AVL" (as in AVL tree). It stays silent on 'L' when it starts a sentence or isn't preceded by "AV". Members are mostly 'L' detectors plus AV-context features.
result.label: 'L' in AVL tree

result.description: Fires on the word " expected", most strongly in the passive "X is/are expected to..." forecasting construction. It fires weakly on "expected return/value" and on "likely". Members are mostly detectors of "expected"/"expect".
result.label: " expected" in "is expected to"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Ne' (neuro-, neural) in neuroscience terms, and on 'lect' inside 'thermoelectric'. It predicts continuations like 'uro'/'ure'. It stays silent on ' Ne' in 'NeoClassical'.
result.label: Ne- / lect- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' steel' (e.g. stainless steel, steel sheets, iron and steel) in materials contexts. Weakly fires on other materials like coal or metal. Members detect steel, iron, metal and other material words.
result.label: steel token detector

result.description: Fires on adjectives describing defective or absent data, mostly " missing", also " irregular", " incomplete", " redundant", in data-cleaning and statistics text. It is silent on unrelated finance text.
result.label: missing/incomplete data adjectives

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ency" completing words like transparency, consistency, coherency, mostly in abstract-noun or principles text. It stays silent on "ency" in "agency", so it needs the word-piece context.
result.label: "ency" suffix in transparency
Suffix 'ic' in phenotypic/biology words
result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ic' ending a split technical word, especially biology terms like phenotyp-ic, and weakly on a few other suffix pieces. It stays silent on 'ic' in words like genomic, mosaic and intricacy.
Fires on the word piece "pher" in "atmospheric" (and sometimes "atmosphere", "apor"), in climate and atmospheric-science text. Weak on other earth-science words.
result.label: "atmos-pher-ic" word piece

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' integr' (also ' incorpor') when it is the start of a verb form like "integrating" or "incorporating", typically after "of" or "in". It is silent on "integr" in "integrals" or "integrates" after a subject.
result.label: ' integr' / ' incorpor' before -ating

result.description: Fires mostly on 'base' in "acid-base" chemistry text, and also on mid-word pieces like 'nis' in "omniscient" and 'ie' in "Trie". Members are mainly acid/base/pH chemistry detectors. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: acid-base 'base' plus word fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece "hom" at the start of "homogeneous/homogeneity", most strongly in "non-homogeneous" (math, differential equations). Members detect "hom" and "ogeneous" pieces and the "non-" prefix.
result.label: "hom" piece in non-homogeneous

result.description: Fires on the "'s" of "it's" and on "important"/"be" after "it is/it's/it'll", in impersonal evaluative frames like "it's important to". It stays silent on possessive "'s" after nouns.
result.label: Impersonal "it's important to" slot

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments of long technical words (compat-, copolym-, flex-, invent-) where the word continues into a suffix like -ibility or -ers. Mostly science and technical text; peaks are mixed pieces.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of technical words

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "deep" (deep-frying, deep-fried) and on "der" in "Ladder", with weaker hits on other word-internal pieces. Members detect "deep" and hyphens. Other hyphens (all-out, lipid-rich, non-) leave it silent.
result.label: Hyphen after "deep"; Ladder

result.description: Fires on the word piece "aping" in "shaping" (sh+aping), as in "shaping policy" or "shaping human knowledge". Members detect shape/shapes/shaping forms and the verb sense of influencing.
result.label: "aping" in "shaping"

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' stir' (stir-fry, stirring) and ' quot' (quotation), plus a few similar word-start fragments like 'vers' and 'position'. It fires on incomplete word beginnings that are expected to continue into a longer word.
result.label: stir / quot word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pie' when it starts "piezo-" words (piezoelectric, piezoelectricity, etc.), where the next piece is 'zo'/'za'. Its logits favour continuing the word. It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' pie' in piezo- words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'our' inside "sourcing/sourced" (s-our-cing), where it continues the word and predicts -cing/-ced. It stays silent on 'our' in "flavour" and "gourmet".
result.label: 'our' in sourcing

result.description: Fires on the token " development", mainly in "sustainable development" and similar modifier + development phrases (economic, inclusive). It stays silent on "the development of X" or "ongoing development" where no such modifier comes before it.
result.label: "sustainable development" development token

result.description: Fires on the token " applications" (or " application") as a noun for uses of a technology or property, usually after modifiers like "wide", "practical", "industrial" in scientific or technical text. Predicts "such as" or "in" next.
result.label: ' applications' noun in technical text

result.description: Fires on " spaces" (also " space") as the head noun of a mathematical space term, like Hilbert spaces, inner product spaces, vector spaces, null spaces. Weaker for other uses of the word.
result.label: Mathematical "spaces" after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece " optim" (optimizing, optimism, optimizer) in mid-sentence, usually after a preposition or verb. Silent when it opens the document. Members detect optim/maxim/minimal-type stems that precede "-ize" suffixes.
result.label: ' optim' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'du' inside words like trans-du-ction, trans-du-cer, and also ' dedu' and ' constru'. It predicts continuations such as 'cers' and 'ctions'. The peaks are mostly in transduction and signal-biology text.
result.label: 'du' piece in transduction

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a verb or preposition in technical/computing and science explanations (e.g. "decoding the", "for the", "includes the"), where a noun follows. Stays quiet on ' the' in abstract math/logic prose.
result.label: ' the' in technical explanations

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ing" completing "neighbor/neighbour" in "neighboring" (countries, nations, societies). It stays silent on "ing" in other verbs like "adhering" or "affecting".
result.label: "ing" in "neighboring"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ynam' in words like Thermodynamics, Electrodynamics and Aerodynamics, after a prefix such as Thermod or Aerod. It is weaker on 'Mechan' in Statistical Mechanics.
result.label: 'ynam' in -dynamics words

result.description: Fires on 'ph' inside lymph-type biology words (lym-ph-atic, hydro-ph-obic) and on ' So' at the start of a document ("Soil ..."). Silent on 'ph' in macrophage. Peaks mix word pieces rather than one token.
result.label: 'ph' in lymph words; initial 'So'

result.description: Fires on " only" / " just" (also "solely") right after "not" in "not only/just X but also Y" constructions. Silent on sentence-initial "only" in inverted "only does/is" constructions.
result.label: "not only/just" intensifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pre' / ' Pre' when it starts a word split into pieces, such as "prepositions", "preprocessing", "prevalence" or "prefetching". It is silent on "prepose" and on the whole word "preposition" in some contexts.
result.label: word-initial ' pre' piece

result.description: Fires on varied word-piece tokens (e.g. 'atic', repeated '0', 'chy', 'oney') in technical or academic text, often after linguistic or scientific terms. Peaks are scattered and inconsistent, and it is silent on 'atic' in enigmatic/operatic.
result.label: Scattered word pieces in technical text

result.description: Fires on ' service' right after 'customer' (customer service) in business text. It stays silent on 'service' in 'product or service' or 'after-sales service'. Members detect customer, loyal, and service tokens.
result.label: 'service' in 'customer service'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 've' inside split words, mainly 'con-ve-' (convection, conveying, convective) and also 'conca-ve'. Predicts continuations like 'ction' and 'ying'.
result.label: 've' piece in convection/convey

result.description: Fires on verb endings or verbs (propels, empowers, drives, inviting, enables) where a causal/influencing verb takes a person-like object next, such as "us" or "readers". It pushes toward " us" as the next token.
result.label: Influence verbs awaiting an object

result.description: Fires on the token " at" / " At", both as the preposition (at all levels, at rest, at work) and as the start of "Atmospheric" at a heading. Silent on "look at" in one example.
result.label: " at" / " At" token detector

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that starts a second term in a short Title-Case list heading, mostly after "Customer" (Ret-ention, Communic-ation, Ac-quisition). Peaks on word-start fragments that are likely to continue into a longer word.
result.label: Word-start after "Customer" in heading lists

result.description: Fires on the token ' gate', both in quantum gates (CNOT gate) and in 'gatekeeping/gatekeepers' where the word is split. Members are mostly detectors of ' gate' at earlier layers.
result.label: ' gate' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' exam' when it is the start of a verb form like "examining" or "examines" (e.g. "By examining"), expecting a suffix such as -ining or -ines. It stays silent on "examination".
result.label: ' exam' in examining/examines

result.description: Fires on the word " growing" used as an adjective meaning increasing, typically after "a", "the" or "their" before a noun such as demand or interest. Members detect growing, increasing and grow variants.
result.label: ' growing' as adjective

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'er' (also 'es') right after 'coh' in "coherence/coherent", mid-word, when the word is being completed. Members detect 'coh' prefixes and 'er' pieces.
result.label: 'er' after 'coh' (coherence)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' capital' when it begins a longer word, mainly 'capitalization/capitalisation', in text about writing, grammar and letter case. It predicts suffixes like 'ization', 'ized' and 'ise'. Weak on the financial noun.
result.label: ' capital' before -ization suffix

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a surname (Ber-keley, Fre-y, Bla-ke, Wol-fram) after a given first name in lists of writers, philosophers and artists. It predicts a surname continuation. Silent on lists of school subjects.
result.label: Surname start after first name

result.description: Fires on the middle piece 'igen' in "indigenous" (also 'ug' in subjugation, similar mid-word pieces) when it follows the "ind" prefix. Silent when 'igen' starts a word without "ind" before it.
result.label: 'igen' inside "indigenous"

result.description: Fires on the token " services" when it follows a preceding modifier noun, especially "streaming services". It stays silent when " services" starts the text with no preceding word. Members are mostly detectors of "services"/"service".
result.label: ' services' after a modifier noun

result.description: Fires on the word "Urban"/"urban", especially as a heading or section-title start and before nouns like planning, development or sprawl. Members are urban/city detectors across earlier layers.
result.label: Urban token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb "require" (also requires/requiring), usually after a plural or abstract subject in technical or analytical prose, where an object like "careful/advanced/robust X" follows. Members detect require, need, involve and necessitate.
result.label: verb "require" detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " corpor" (start of corporate/corporation) in legal and business text. Silent on some instances after "international", so it may depend on the preceding word or context.
result.label: ' corpor' word piece (corporate/corporation)
Token ' so' as word start
result.description: Fires on the token ' so' (also ' So'), both as a standalone word and as a word-start piece in sovereignty, socio-, sociolects, soapy. Its logits favour continuations like 'cio' and 'vere'.
Fires on the word-start piece ' compet' (before itor/itive) and on ' Te' in the heading "Techniques", both incomplete word beginnings that need a continuation piece. Mostly business competitor text.
result.label: ' compet' and ' Te' word-starts

result.description: Fires on a technical noun right after "and" in a coordinated pair of math/physics terms (e.g. "length and angle", "symmetry, and positive-definite"). Members are math-topic and "and"-list detectors. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Second noun in math term pairs

result.description: Fires on the word " tax" (or "Tax") mid-text, especially as a modifier or stem before "ation"/"es", as in "equitable tax", "sales taxes", "tax landscape". It is silent when "taxes" is the first token of the text.
result.label: tax token detector

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a complementizer introducing a clause after a reporting/cognitive verb (demonstrated, shown, revealed, states, ensure). Silent on relative-clause ' that' after nouns (tool that, tasks that).
result.label: Complementizer 'that' after reporting verbs

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after a verb like "stands", "emerged", "serve" (stand as a testament, emerged as), where 'as' means "in the role of". It stays silent on "such as" and comparative "as ... as".
result.label: ' as' after stand/emerge/serve

result.description: Fires on " to" right after a predicate adjective like "fundamental", "essential" or "key" in a "X is fundamental to Y" construction. It stays silent on "essential to" followed by a verb (infinitive) and on other uses of "to".
result.label: "fundamental/essential to" preposition

result.description: Fires on a hyphen after a prefix-like fragment (e.g. "semi-", "beta-") and on the "et" inside "Non-Parametric", where a word is being continued. It stays silent on hyphens in ordinary compounds like "high-temperature" or on date ranges.
result.label: Hyphen after word-fragment prefix

result.description: Fires on the adjectives " sweet" and " weak" (also "strong"-like quality adjectives, weakly on "R" in qPCR) as modifiers before a noun, e.g. "weak bases", "sweet seared meat". Members are detectors of sweet, weak and strong.
result.label: sweet / weak adjective modifiers

result.description: Fires on the period after a single-letter middle initial in a person's name within lists of names (e.g. "James W." or "Guy D."). It stays silent on sentence-ending periods.
result.label: Period after name initial

result.description: Fires on ' are' (occasionally ' been'/' be') right after a plural subject noun such as "artists" or "engineers", before a verb or adverb. It stays silent after "which", "dishes", "practices" and "ingredients" in food and sustainability text.
result.label: ' are' after plural subject noun

result.description: Fires on forms of "become" (became, becomes, become), occasionally "seem", as the verb after a noun subject, where a change-of-state complement like "more complex" or "increasingly" follows. Members are detectors of become/becoming/grow.
result.label: Verb "become" after subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ener" inside "regeneration/regenerative" (also degenerate, green-er words), mostly in biomedical or engineering text. It predicts suffix continuations like "ative" or "ation".
result.label: "ener" in regenerative/regeneration

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'ow' (shallow, Bronsted-Lowry, vowel) and 'at' (chromatography), where a word is split into pieces. Members detect these specific pieces. The contrast 'allow' is silent, so it needs the word-internal position.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'ow' and 'at'

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after "is" in a copular construction naming the central or foundational element of something ("the heart of X is the…", "the key element of a menu is the…"). It stays silent on ' the' after prepositions or verbs.
result.label: ' the' after "X is" (core element)

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' prem' (premise) and ' conclus' (conclusion) in logical reasoning text, plus 'red' in 'ingredient'. Silent when 'premises' starts the text, so it needs a preceding word in context.
result.label: Premise/conclusion word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on word-start or mid-word pieces of a longer word or compound, such as Work in "Audio Workstation", Appro in "Approach", viol in "violin", and the suffix ive. It seems to predict the next piece that finishes the word. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Incomplete word fragment awaiting continuation

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and word starts such as 'plus' in surplus, ' Conserv', ' Seg', ' analy', where a longer word is being built up. Peaks are mixed, and the members detect surplus/excess word pieces.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, mainly surplus

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' norm' (norms, Euclidean norm) and ' Equ' in "Differential Equations", i.e. an incomplete word piece awaiting a suffix, mostly in math contexts. Weak elsewhere.
result.label: ' norm' / ' Equ' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Vis"/" vis" (viscosity, viscous, viscometer, visually), where the next piece is expected to continue the word. Members are mostly detectors of " vis" and related word-start pieces.
result.label: Vis- word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the verb " perform" (as in "can perform complex tasks", "to perform calculations"), mostly after "to" or "can" with a machine or system as subject. Predicts task or calculation objects next.
result.label: verb "perform" before tasks

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' coll' at the start of collider/collision in physics text. Upstream members mostly detect ' coll' itself; weak activation on other word-start fragments like 'aer-ob'.
result.label: ' coll' piece in collision/collider

result.description: Fires on pieces inside ALL-CAPS text, such as ' IS', 'IT', ' HE', ' US', and mid-word fragments of capitalized words. Upstream members detect caps fragments like ' CON', 'ENT', 'CT'. Also fires weakly on LaTeX and underscore runs.
result.label: All-caps word fragments

result.description: Fires in LaTeX/math markup on opening math tokens such as ' \(' and '{' (e.g. \mathfrak{, subscripts) and on byte-fragment tokens inside formulas. Silent on plain prose. Members detect backslash/brace and math-word tokens.
result.label: LaTeX math delimiters and braces

result.description: Fires on " on" after a noun, meaning "regarding/applied to" (accuracy on training data, indexes on documents, dialogue on...). It stays quiet after verbs like "working on", "based on", "rely on" and "information on".
result.label: ' on' after noun (technical)

result.description: Fires on ' ticket' (esp. after "mobile" or in "ticketing") and on 'ver' in "adverbs"; both are word pieces that are often followed by a suffix such as -ing or -bs. Weak on a few other word stems.
result.label: ticket / ver word-stem pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' order', strongest in the purpose phrase "In order to" at the start of a sentence. It fires less on "in order for" and on other senses of order (sequence, taxonomic rank).
result.label: ' order' in "in order to"
Mid-word pieces in 'indispensable'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'isp' in "indispensable" (also 'il' in "fertilizers", and similar mid-word pieces). It needs to be inside those particular words, where the next piece is a fixed continuation such as 'ens'.

Fires on the token ' transaction' (also 'transactional', 'transactions'), mostly in technical or database text. It also fires weakly on 'ory' in 'allegory'. The circuit is mainly made of transaction-token detectors.
result.label: ' transaction' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " ones" used as a pronoun after an adjective or modifier (temporal ones, thicker ones, resistive ones), standing in for a previously mentioned noun. Silent on text without this construction.
result.label: Pronoun ' ones' after adjective

result.description: Fires on mid-word or next-word tokens inside short academic or topic-list headings (e.g. "Language Testing", "Music Festival Genres", "Merchandise") and some abstract noun phrases like "social interactions". Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Topic-list heading continuation tokens

result.description: Fires on the prefix " non"/" Non" (non-linear, non-negative, Non-homogeneous), especially in technical or scientific text, often at a word or document start. Members are detectors of non and similar prefixes such as self, pre, cross and micro.
result.label: Non- prefix detector

result.description: Fires on the present-tense copula ' are' (sometimes ' is') right after a plural subject noun, especially an industry or group in a trend sentence ("chefs are turning to", "businesses are adopting"). Silent on 'are' inside subordinate or passive clauses.
result.label: Plural subject + 'are' in trend sentences

result.description: Fires on the end of a noun naming an examination or study, such as "examination", "analysis", "termination" and chemical "-ate", often right after a title-like opener and before "of". Peaks are mixed, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Analysis/examination noun endings before "of"

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'cy' in "fallacy" (also "cies"), plus ' Web' in "Cosmic Web" and 'aire'. Mostly the final piece of a multi-token word; members detect fallacy-ending pieces.
result.label: Fallacy 'cy' word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires on the first piece of an artist's name (Rap|hael, Rem|brandt, Al, Bar) in lists of famous painters, right after "artists like/such as" or "and". Needs art-history context; silent on general Renaissance text.
result.label: Painter name start in artist lists
' cam' word-start piece (cameras)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cam' when it starts a split word, mainly 'cameras' (video cameras, film cameras, DSLR cameras). Members are detectors of ' cam' and similar word-start fragments like priv-, alt-, autonom-.

Fires on a word or word-piece right after "specific", "different" or "various", where a noun or word fragment is expected next (market, type, analyt-ical, disc-ourse). Silent on ' mole' in "molecular" after "the".
result.label: Word after specific/various/different

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " misunder" (before "standing/stood"), and less on " exclusive" after "mutually". Members detect "mis-" and "under" prefix pieces and other word-start fragments.
result.label: " misunder" word-piece before -stood

result.description: Fires on the nouns " orientation" and " direction(s)" as spatial or geometric concepts (vectors, gradients, angles, prepositions of direction). Members detect orientation, direction, axis, vector and degrees tokens. Weakly predicts " toward(s)".
result.label: orientation / direction nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece "cular" completing "molecular" (mole+cular, bimole+cular, intermole+cular), mainly in chemistry text. Members are mostly "cular" detectors plus a few detectors for the preceding "mole"/"mol" pieces.
result.label: "cular" in molecular

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ous" completing the word "ubiquitous" (after "ubiquit"), with weaker firing on "autonom-ous". The circuit's members detect "ous"/"ive"/"ence" word endings and "ubiquitous"-like pieces.
result.label: "ous" ending of ubiquitous

result.description: Fires on " banks" (also " bank") right after "central" in economic or monetary-policy text. It stays silent when " banks" begins the document with no preceding "central". Members detect bank/banks and economics words.
result.label: "banks" after "central"

result.description: Fires on the word " shape" (also "shapes") in all its uses, mostly as a verb ("can shape our perception") but also as a noun ("octahedral shape"). Members are detectors of shape/shapes/shaping tokens.
result.label: ' shape' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " lack" (mostly the noun, as in "a lack of"), weakly on "satisf" and "lacking". Members are detectors of lack, absence, and without, which feed the target.
result.label: " lack" token detector

result.description: Fires on varied word stems or pieces (' copying', ' document', 'on' in Decolonization, 'aking') that are mid-word or verb stems expecting a suffix like -ing/-ization. Peaks are mixed; the pattern is weak and low-consistency.
result.label: Verb stems awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on the 'oust' piece inside the split word "acoustic/acoustical" (ac-oust-ic). It is silent when 'oust' starts the text without the "ac" before it.
result.label: 'oust' in ac-oust-ic

result.description: Fires on ' not' directly after a noun subject (e.g. "approach not only enhances"), in the "not only" construction. It stays quiet after a verb or copula such as "is not" or "may not".
result.label: ' not' after noun, "not only"

result.description: Fires on ' are' as the main verb right after a plural subject noun that begins a definitional sentence (e.g. "plateaus are…", "grids are…"). It stays quiet for ' are' in relative clauses, after "and", or after some compound subjects.
result.label: ' are' after plural subject noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'arch' inside "hierarchy/hierarchical" (split as hier+arch). It stays silent on 'arch' in "anarchic", and members mostly detect 'arch' after hier-like prefixes.
result.label: 'arch' in hierarchy

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iter' inside "alliteration" / "alliterative", in writing about literary devices. Members are detectors of 'iter' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'iter' in alliteration

result.description: Fires on the piece 'etic' when it completes "kin" in "kinetic" (as in kinetic energy). It is silent on 'etic' at the start of a document with no "kin" before it. It also fires weakly on "kinematic".
result.label: 'etic' in "kinetic"

result.description: Fires on the token " peak" when it is used as a modifier in analytical chemistry/chromatography text (peak height, peak area, peak shape), predicting the next measurement word. Silent on the contrast text, which is about chemistry but has no "peak".
result.label: "peak" in chromatography measurements
Article ' an' after comma or sentence start
result.description: Fires on the article ' an' / ' An' (also 'Ancient' starts) when it begins a new clause or appositive, e.g. after a comma, semicolon or sentence break. It stays quiet on ' an' after a verb like 'see', 'provided', 'marking'.

Fires on the piece 'est' in the split spelling "a|est|hetic" (aesthetic/aesthetics), after the "a" piece. Silent on some other 'est' occurrences of the same word, so the dependence on context is partly unclear.
result.label: 'est' in split "aesthetic"

result.description: Fires on passive past participles (supported, facilitated, hindered, backed) after a subject and auxiliary, where a 'by' agent phrase is expected next. Members detect participles like identified, accompanied, inspired, fueled.
result.label: Passive participle before 'by'

result.description: Fires on the token " research" (noun or modifier, often before "ers", "study", "design") in scientific or methodology text. Members mostly detect " research" itself, plus sample and experiment words.
result.label: ' research' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' necess' at the start of "necessitate/necessitating", typically after a subject or clause. Members detect similar word-initial pieces (facil-, pos-, exhib-, necess-) that precede "-it-" endings.
result.label: ' necess' in necessitate

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Sp"/" sp" when it starts a word split into pieces (oil sp-ill, Sp-aces, sp-elling, Sp-itzer). Silent on whole words like "Series". Predicts continuations such as -anning, -elling, -aces.
result.label: Split-word ' sp' / ' Sp' start

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'li' inside "unreliable" (also 're-li-able', 'appliances'), and weakly on ' Te' and similar mid-word pieces. Members are mostly detectors of 'li' as a token fragment.
result.label: 'li' piece in unreliable

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'io' (in raviolet, Dispositio) and 'rial' (in terrestrial, industrial), a word-piece in the middle of longer words. Members are detectors of these pieces and of word-start fragments.
result.label: Mid-word pieces 'io' and 'rial'

result.description: Fires on the indefinite articles ' a' and ' an' when they introduce a predicate or object noun phrase, often after verbs like "leaves", "providing" or "creating", or after "akin to". It is silent on 'a' after "just", "of" or "as".
result.label: Indefinite article a/an in object slot

result.description: Fires on the word " classic" used as an adjective before a noun (e.g. "a classic example", "classic literature"). Upstream members detect related words such as classical, traditional, conventional, famous and ancient.
result.label: Adjective " classic"

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: sentence-initial " When", word pieces like "ich" in Carmichael, "ti" in Bhakti, and " Path" in Eightfold Path. No single meaning is clear, and the contrast does not isolate a condition.
result.label: Mixed: When, name fragments, Path

result.description: Fires on ' it' (also ' of', ' they') right after a "not just / more than just / beyond mere" contrast, where the clause continues the point (e.g. "more than just a sum of", "imports more than it exports"). Silent on ordinary ' it' in other clauses.
result.label: 'it' after "more than just" contrasts

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe that directly follows sentence-final punctuation (after a period) and begins a contraction-like "'s", "'ll" or "'re". It stays silent on apostrophes after a word, such as "it's" or "Let's", and on a leading apostrophe at the document start.
result.label: Apostrophe after sentence-ending period

result.description: Fires on ' not' right after "Although" at the start of a document (concessive "Although not always..."). Silent on ' not' in other slots, such as after modals, "not only", or inside "notation".
result.label: ' not' after opening "Although"

result.description: Fires on the word " our" when it follows a verb or preposition such as "shapes", "shape", "framing" or "of", in abstract passages about human experience and cognition. Members are detectors of "our" and similar possessives.
result.label: "our" after verbs, abstract human experience

result.description: Fires on verbs like "exhibit" (it), "display", "undergo", "experience" that follow a plural abstract subject and precede an expected object such as "remarkable differences" or "significant changes". Silent on "it" inside words like "geopolitical".
result.label: Exhibit/display-type verb after subject

result.description: Fires on the word " analysis" when it follows a modifier noun naming a method or data type, such as "data analysis" or "sentiment analysis". It stayed silent on "critical analysis" in the contrast.
result.label: ' analysis' after data/method noun

result.description: Fires on infinitive ' to' that introduces a verb after words like "ability", "able", "is", "how", "attempting", "expected". Silent on prepositional ' to' (similar to, listening to, with respect to) and after "not".
result.label: Infinitive 'to' before a verb

result.description: Fires on ' organized' (occasionally ' arranged') as a passive participle after a noun or 'is/are', as in 'elements are organized in...'. Members detect organized/ordered/arranged-type words.
result.label: ' organized' passive participle

result.description: Fires on the word " process", most strongly in "iterative process". It stays quiet after compound modifiers like "development process", "design process" and "response process", or when the word starts a sentence.
result.label: ' process' after "iterative"

result.description: Fires on the token ' search' (noun or verb, as in search engines, binary search, search costs, to search). Members are mostly detectors of ' search' at earlier layers. Contrast text lacks the word.
result.label: ' search' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ity" completing "divers|ity" (biological, genetic, linguistic diversity). It stays silent on "ity" in other words such as minority, vitality and humanity.
result.label: "ity" in "diversity"

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside biochemistry abbreviations and terms, such as Co in acetyl-CoA, AD in NAD(P)+, and P in RuBP. It sits in metabolism text (ATP, Krebs, Calvin cycle) and predicts a suffix-like continuation.
result.label: Biochemical abbreviation fragments (CoA, NAD)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " layout" (e.g. facility layouts, process layout), with a few hits on " break". Silent when "layout" opens the text with no preceding modifier noun. Members are mostly layout detectors.
result.label: ' layout' after modifier noun
Hydrolog-ical suffix piece
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ical' (occasionally 'or', 'ci') when it completes the split word 'hydrological'. It stays silent on 'ical' in ecological, analytical or geotechnical, so it needs the hydrolog- stem.

Fires on the middle piece 'aren' inside the word "awareness" (aw|aren|ess), mostly after "raising/spreading/promote". Silent when the word is absent. Members are detectors of 'aren' and of similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'aren' in awareness

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' astronom' (astronomy, astronomers, astronomical) in every example. Members are mostly detectors of the same piece plus nearby science words such as atmos, galax and phys.
result.label: ' astronom' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires mainly on " regardless" (usually after a comma, before "of"), with a few hits on " Right" in a list of Buddhist path factors and " Liv". Members detect words like without, even, equality, everyone, due and because.
result.label: " regardless" after a comma

result.description: Fires on the word " multimedia", mostly as the object after verbs like incorporating, utilizing or integrating. Supported by members for media-related words (video, audio, interactive, Media). Silent on the contrast text about digital art.
result.label: ' multimedia' after incorporating verbs

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' inside long digit strings (repeated zeros, decimals) and on the final '0' of decade years like 1940, 1980, 2030. Silent on '0' in forms like 20th or 1807, or in the middle of a year.
result.label: Digit 0 in numbers and decades

result.description: Fires on the verb piece ' adopt' (adopting) and on 'ield' in 'wield'. Both are transitive verbs of taking up or using something (a practice, power). Members are token detectors for adopt and ield.
result.label: adopt / wield verb pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'omb' in Coulomb's Law and on ' absence', plus other word fragments (ro, ib). Mixed set of unrelated tokens; members are detectors of individual word pieces.
result.label: Coulomb 'omb' and 'absence' pieces

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes like 'ular' mainly in "cellular", also 'mp' in Ampere and 'inger' in Schrödinger. Silent on 'ular' in "intercellular", so it seems to need 'ular' directly after "cell".
result.label: 'ular' in "cellular"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' exer' (the start of "exercises") in educational text, such as "listening exercises". Members are mostly detectors of the same piece, with a few other word-start pieces.
result.label: ' exer' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the conjunctions ' or' and ' and' joining items in economics or monetary and fiscal policy text, such as government spending or tax reductions. It stays quiet on 'or' in other lists, such as ' fixed or variable' and 'economics, or'.
result.label: Conjunctions in economic policy lists

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ency' completing "consist|ency", mostly in computing text such as data or memory consistency models. It also fires weakly on similar pieces like 'Coher|ency' and 'conc|urrency'.
result.label: 'ency' in consistency

result.description: Fires on the word "Cloud"/"cloud", mostly in cloud computing contexts (e.g. "basics of Cloud Computing"), and also for weather clouds. Driven by upstream cloud-token detectors.
result.label: Cloud token detector

result.description: Fires on adverb-forming suffix pieces (-ally, -ically, -ibly) and ' locally' after a stem, especially in sustainability/food-sourcing text (environmentally, locally sourced). Silent on 'additionally' or a bare 'ally' at the start of a text.
result.label: adverb suffix -ally / locally

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'on' inside "Ionization" (I|on|ization), predicting a suffix like -ize. It stays silent on 'on' in words like phonon, phenomenon and photonics.
result.label: 'on' in Ionization

result.description: Fires on ' accounts' (as in "accounts for", "main accounts") and on ' Aug' at the start of "Augmented Reality". Members mostly detect account/accounts/reporting tokens. Weak activation on a few other nouns like energy and tongue.
result.label: accounts and Aug(mented) token

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: the digit '5' inside long digit strings, hyphens, and fragments of Devanagari/Arabic multi-byte characters. Silent on '5' in ordinary years or decimals. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Digit 5 in digit strings, byte fragments

result.description: Fires on ' into' (also ' in') after an incorporated/integrated object, as in "incorporate X into their dishes". Silent on transformation "turn X into" or "delves into". Cooking and sustainability context members support it.
result.label: incorporate X into

result.description: Fires on a closing parenthesis ')' that ends a short parenthetical, variable argument, or list label such as (1), (d), C(n), especially in technical or math-like text. Silent on one N(x) example.
result.label: Closing parenthesis after short item

result.description: Fires on the word "cost"/"costs" as a noun in economics and business text, especially after modifiers like social, private, marginal, external or overhead. Members detect cost, price and overhead tokens.
result.label: cost/costs in economics text

result.description: Fires on the word " there" as an existential subject ("there is/are") right after an introductory clause and comma, or at a sentence start. Members are mostly detectors of " there".
result.label: existential " there" after clause

result.description: Fires on the opening parenthesis right after a full technical term or noun phrase (e.g. "Artificial Intelligence (", "Geographic Information Systems (") where an acronym or abbreviation is about to follow. Silent on parentheses after ordinary clauses.
result.label: Open paren before acronym

result.description: Fires on the modifier words " online" and " digital" (also "virtual", "electronic") before a noun like platforms, genres, or age, mostly in text about media and communication. Members detect these words and related platform names.
result.label: online/digital modifier before nouns

result.description: Fires on the word " weather" in meteorology and atmospheric-science text, usually as an object after words like "understanding", "forecast" or "predicting". Members are mostly detectors of "weather" and related words like meteor-, wind and climate.
result.label: ' weather' in meteorology text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ch' in "etching" (et-ch), and 'ot' in words like "pluripotent"/"totipotent". It is silent on 'ch' in "bench" or a bare "ching" at sentence start. Needs a specific word-piece context.
result.label: Word-piece 'ch'/'ot' in etching, -potent

result.description: Fires on the noun ' use' in the slot "[determiner/adjective] use of X", such as "innovative use of" or "The use of". It is silent on a bare sentence-initial ' use' verb, which has no preceding modifier.
result.label: noun 'use' before 'of'
'adr' in Quadratic
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'adr' in "Quadratic" (Qu|adr|atic), almost always in headings about quadratic residues or fields. It is silent on the fully spelled word "quadratic". Members mostly detect mid-word fragments.

Fires on the piece 'os' completing the word "chaos", mostly in "chaos theory" or chaos as a mathematical or physical concept. Members are mostly 'os' detectors. It is weakly active on other word-final pieces.
result.label: 'os' ending "chaos"

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after a noun naming a product, method, process or therapy (insulin for, therapies for, processes for), introducing its purpose. Silent on ' for' after adjectives like 'essential' or some other nouns.
result.label: ' for' after purpose noun

result.description: Fires on the word " Fair"/" fair", mostly capitalized, in fair trade and fair prices contexts, where the next word is likely "trade". Members are detectors of "fair" and "trade" tokens.
result.label: "Fair" in fair trade

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verb (' are', also ' been', ' being', ' have') right after a plural subject noun phrase like "Several different types" or "Many methods", near document start. Stays silent after pronouns or relative "which/they are".
result.label: Are after quantified plural subject

result.description: Fires on measurable-quantity nouns such as level, size, density, content, mostly after a property noun in technical or scientific text (particle size, moisture content level, sample size). Weak on similar nouns like states or points.
result.label: Measurable quantity nouns in technical text

result.description: Fires on the noun meaning result or consequence, mainly the "lications" piece of "implications", and also "effects", "consequences" and "importance". It usually comes before "of" or "for". It is silent on one "implications" example that follows "broad".
result.label: Implications / consequences / effects nouns
List items in abstract noun series
result.description: Fires on a list item or comma inside a series of abstract or technical nouns (e.g. "breeding, reproduction, or sampling"; "transparency, privacy"), where another list item is expected. Silent on commas outside such enumerations.

Fires on 'friend' in hyphenated compounds like "user-friendly" and "eco-friendly", and more weakly on hyphens in compounds like "decision-making". It needs the hyphenated compound-modifier slot, before a suffix like "-ly".
result.label: friend in hyphenated compounds

result.description: Fires on the noun ' shift' meaning a change or transition (e.g. "a shift towards", "the shift from"). Members detect ' shift' and related words like transition and change. It is silent when ' shift' starts a text with no preceding context.
result.label: noun 'shift' (change, transition)

result.description: Fires on " of" right after a period or named-thing noun such as "Age" (Age of Enlightenment/Discovery), weaker for "Wars of Religion" and "Wealth of Nations". It stays silent on "of" after ordinary nouns like "portion" or "end".
result.label: "of" in "Age of ..." titles

result.description: Fires mainly on " structures"/" structure" in civil-engineering contexts (safety, loads, foundations, buildings), plus a few odd word-piece peaks like " Res" and "loc". Silent on a sentence-initial " structures" lacking engineering context.
result.label: Engineering 'structures' noun

result.description: Fires on a mix of tokens: ' secondary' most often, also ' Lie' (Lie algebras/brackets), 'fol' (folding), and word pieces like 'ory'. Members detect 'primary'/'secondary' pairs, but the other peaks share no clear link.
result.label: secondary / Lie / mixed word pieces
