result.label: 'ive' in "supportive"

result.description: Fires on scattered, rare word pieces: fragments of non-Latin scripts (Arabic, Thai, byte pieces), ' Besch', ' wy', 'buf', 'overline'. Peaks are inconsistent. The members are mostly token detectors for odd fragments, so the pattern is diffuse and weak.
result.label: Rare multilingual token fragments

result.description: Fires on the verb " transformed" (passive or active, e.g. "were transformed into", "has transformed the landscape"). Members are mostly detectors of "transformed" and similar past participles like identified or created.
result.label: ' transformed' verb detector

result.description: Fires on "ver" inside "maneuver(ing)", and more weakly on "navigate" or "negotiating". These are words about steering or maneuvering through something. It stays silent on "ver" in "fever" or a bare "ver".
result.label: "ver" in maneuver(ing)
'ist' in 'trans-ist-ors'; ' arise'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ist' mainly inside 'transistors' (after 'trans'), and on ' arise' before 'from'. Weaker on other mid-word pieces after 'trans' (e.g. 'par' in transparency).
Fires on the verb "focus" and on "concent"/"rate" in "concentrate" when used as a verb meaning to direct attention, predicting "on". Weaker on other "focus on" uses.
result.label: focus / concentrate (on)

result.description: Fires on the 'ism' piece inside "seism-" words (seismic, seismograph, seismology). It stays silent on 'ism' in paleomagnetism, so it needs the "se" prefix. It weakly fires on 'war' in "dwarf".
result.label: 'ism' in seismic words

result.description: Fires on the token 'cos' as a word piece, mostly in "viscosity" and "ecosystem" (also the trig function), with a weaker hit on ' golden' in "golden standard". Members are mostly 'cos' detectors.
result.label: 'cos' word piece (viscosity, ecosystem)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' dr' when it starts a word like drilling, drill or drought, after a preceding word. It stays silent when ' dr' is the first token of the document, so it needs a preceding context token.
result.label: ' dr' word-start piece (drilling)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ess' mid-word (Hess-ian, chess, non-ess-ential, tenderness), plus other mid-word fragments like ' dict', ' perpet', ' gover'. Seems to expect a continuation like 'ential'. Mixed and weak peaks.
result.label: Mid-word 'ess' fragment

result.description: Fires on the particle ' up' (occasionally ' down') after motion or change verbs like moves, curves, bounce back, speed, scale, where it is a directional adverb. It pushes toward suffixes like 'wards'. Silent on 'calling up' (telephone sense).
result.label: directional ' up' after motion verbs

result.description: Fires on the '.,' token in the abbreviation "e.g.," (also "i.e.,") when it opens a parenthetical list of examples, such as "(e.g., notebook)". Weakly fires on "such as" and "includes both".
result.label: "e.g.," example-introducer

result.description: Fires on the piece 'acci' in "Fibonacci", inside mathematical text about Fibonacci numbers and sequences. Members detect 'acci' and preceding 'Fibon' pieces, plus math-topic context.
result.label: Fibonacci 'acci' token

result.description: Fires on ' and' (occasionally ' or') joining two plural or technical nouns, often at the end of a short noun phrase such as "actuators and". It stays silent on many other ' and' contexts, and the contrast does not show clearly what separates them.
result.label: Noun-coordinating ' and'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ography' completing the word "chromatography". Upstream members detect the chromat- prefix and analytical-chemistry context (analytes, separation). Only weak activation on other words.
result.label: 'ography' in chromatography
'zym' inside 'enzyme'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'zym' in 'enzyme' (en-zym-e) in biochemistry text. It stays silent when 'zym' starts a word, as in 'zymes' at the start of the text. A few weak firings on other pieces such as 'rom' and ' lot'.

result.label: Mid-word fragments in technical terms
result.description: Fires on word-internal pieces like 'id', 'ic', 'ell', 'c' in the middle of multi-token technical words (St-ell-ar, nucle-ic, undec-id-ability), where the word is unfinished and likely continues with a suffix.
Fires on the token ' fruit' (occasionally ' Black'), mostly when it begins a compound or modifier such as 'fruit slicer' or 'fruit pairs'. Members detect fruit, seed, and food words.
result.label: ' fruit' token detector

result.description: Fires on abstract action nouns like "realization", "recognition", "establishment" right after "the" (or "real-"), heading a following "of ..." phrase. Silent on "-ization" in words like digitization, globalization, synchronization.
result.label: Abstract noun after 'the', before 'of'

result.description: Fires on the word " problem" (also problems, and a few word pieces like cha-, thre-), mostly in educational "problem-solving" or "problem types/statement" text. Predicts continuations like "-solving". Members are mostly " problem" detectors.
result.label: ' problem' in problem-solving contexts

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in linguistics/math terms, mainly 'omorph' (allomorph, homomorphism), also 'ph' in Morph- and 'ographic' in Orthographic. It pushes toward suffixes like -ological, -ology, -etic.
result.label: morph- word pieces in technical terms

result.description: Fires on ' just' right after a copula verb (is/are/was) as an adverb, as in "is just as important". It stays silent on "not just" / "more than just".
result.label: ' just' after is/are (not "not just")

result.description: Fires on nuclear-physics vocabulary word pieces, mainly ' neut' (before -ron), ' emission', ' Rad(iation)' and ' nucle', in texts about neutrons, radiation and nuclear processes. Silent on unrelated science text.
result.label: Nuclear physics terms: neutron, emission

result.description: Fires on abstract quality nouns such as " efficiency", "-ization" (miniaturization) and "-ability" endings, mostly in engineering and technical text, often after "for", "in" or "of". Predicts word endings or following nouns.
result.label: Efficiency / -ization technical nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mod' when it begins a longer word such as modular, modulation or modulo, mid-sentence. It stays silent when ' mod' is the first token of the document. Members are mostly ' mod' token detectors.
result.label: ' mod' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word fragments that start a longer word, mainly 'ipp' (stippling, ripples) and ' puzz' (puzzle), where a suffix like -le/-les/-ling is expected next. Predicts those suffixes.
result.label: Mid-word 'ipp'/'puzz' fragments

result.description: Fires mainly on " Big" in "Big O" notation lists in computer-science asymptotic analysis text. Weak activity on a few other word-start pieces (etra, cardinal, mic). Silent in unrelated math text.
result.label: "Big" in Big O notation

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Pol' at the start of "Polymer" headings, where it is the first piece of a longer word. Weaker on other word-start pieces like ' pol' in polysemy.
result.label: ' Pol' in Polymer

result.description: Fires on the word "index" (and Index, indexing) as a noun or stem, mostly in database and technical text. Members detect index/indexes tokens plus database context such as MySQL, tree and DBMS. Predicts suffixes like -ation and -ing.
result.label: " index" word detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces that begin a longer word or name, mainly ' Mark' in Markov, 'ald' in heraldic/Heraldry, and ' Tim' or ' feed' pieces. It expects a suffix to follow (e.g. 'ov', 'ic', 'ry'), not a whole-word use.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: Mark(ov), Her-ald(ry)

result.description: Fires on the word " questions" as a noun, mostly after adjectives or verbs like "asking probing/open-ended/reflective questions". Members are mostly detectors of "questions", "ask" and "answer". The contrast text has no such word.
result.label: ' questions' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " heat" (also the "at" of "Heat"), strongest in physics contexts such as "specific heat" and "latent heat". Weaker on "heat flow" or "absorb more heat". Members are mostly heat/thermal/temperature detectors.
result.label: heat in thermodynamics terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' neut' at the start of neutron/neutrino, in physics text. Members are mostly ' neut' token detectors. It predicts continuations like 'ron' and 'rino'.
result.label: ' neut' in neutron/neutrino

result.description: Fires on the ending pieces "ations", "ibration" or "ational" when they complete the word "vibration(s)" or "vibrational" in physics or math text. It stays silent on "-ations" in other words such as examinations, deformations or foundations.
result.label: vibration word endings

result.description: Fires on the word "interaction(s)" (also "interactional", occasionally "Exchange"), mostly in academic text about human or social interactions. Members are detectors of interaction/relationship words.
result.label: interaction(s) word detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cre' at the start of a split word (creativity, creator, creep) and predicts continuations like 'ativity', 'ape', 'ative'. Members mostly detect ' cre' or similar word-start pieces like ' innov'.
result.label: ' cre' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'er' right after 'coh' (coherence, coherent), and weakly on 'cular' in 'molecular'. It stays silent on 'er' in other words like polymer or pioneer.
result.label: 'er' in 'coh-er-ence'

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'uster' in austerity, 'astic' in elastic/inelastic, 'vik' in Bolshevik, and 'ity' after auster. Needs the specific word context; members detect 'astic' and 'uster' pieces.
result.label: Word pieces in austerity/elastic/Bolshevik

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces such as 'alous' (anomalous, Anabalous), 'ic' (Gothic) and 'ific' in the middle of multi-token words. Upstream members detect word fragments like anom-, Goth-, incons-.
result.label: Word-ending suffix pieces (-alous, -ic)

result.description: Fires on morphology terms in linguistics text, mainly ' suffix', infix 'ix', 'emes', and 'letters', especially in lists like "prefixes, infixes, suffixes". Silent on general grammar text about nouns and verbs.
result.label: Morphology terms: suffix, infix, morphemes

result.description: Fires on semicolons separating items in a semicolon-delimited list or series of parallel clauses, after a list item or clause. Mostly silent on semicolons in some other contexts, such as a slash-joined planning list.
result.label: Semicolon separating list items

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' intermediate', Cyrillic pieces, and mid-word Arabic letters, plus weakly on ' other'. Predicts plural noun continuations such as alternatives, ones, options. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Mixed 'intermediate' and Arabic pieces

result.description: Fires on the piece 'vin' in the name Calvin (Calvinism, Calvin's), and occasionally 'ford'. Members are mostly 'vin' detectors plus a ' Cal' detector, so it needs the preceding Cal- piece.
result.label: 'vin' in Calvin

result.description: Fires on ' UI', ' Content'/' content' and 'X' (UX) as nouns in design/digital-media text, such as "UI Design" or "Content Management". Members detect interface, user, layout and content words.
result.label: UI / content design terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' am' at the start of chemistry terms like amines, amination, amino and ammonolysis. It is a detector of that token, with a few weak hits on '-' in 'coal-fired'.
result.label: ' am' in amine/amino words

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'us' when it completes the word "nucleus" (nucle|us), in physics and biology text. It stays silent on 'us' in the odd spelling "nuclupus", so it needs the nucle- prefix.
result.label: 'us' ending "nucleus"

result.description: Fires on a closing parenthesis (or bracket) that ends a short parenthetical, often a qualifier or variable, right before a continuing word like "and", "or", "as well as". Silent on some longer parentheticals.
result.label: Closing parenthesis after short parenthetical

result.description: Fires on ' don' (also ' do', ' didn') as the negated auxiliary in "don't"/"didn't", after a subject like "they" or "you", where n't follows. Members mostly detect the ' don' token, including the "donate" word start.
result.label: Auxiliary "don't" after subject

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ol' (and 'ult', 'et') inside compounds starting with "soci(o)-", such as sociolinguistic or socioc-ultural, predicting the next piece of the compound. Silent on 'ol' in "scholars".
result.label: Piece after "soci-" in sociolinguistic

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that begin a longer word split into pieces, mainly ' ded' (deductive), ' rel' (relatable), ' Pon' (Ponens), and ' gam' (gamut). Members are mostly detectors of these fragments.
result.label: Word-initial fragments: ded, rel, Pon

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Quant"/" quant" (Quantum, quantitative, quantized, quantifier), often at the start of a heading line. It pushes toward suffixes like "itative", "ifiable" and "ization".
result.label: Quant- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing a technical term, especially "Teleportation" in quantum/physics titles, after pieces like "Teleport". Silent on 'ation' in words like fabrication, innovation, generation.
result.label: 'ation' ending Teleportation

result.description: Fires on ' the' (also this/these/art) right after a form of "master" (mastering, masters, mastered), where the next word is a skill or subject being mastered. Silent on 'the' after other verbs. Logits favor master-like word pieces.
result.label: Determiner after "master" verb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' cop' when it begins a longer word such as copolymer, coprime or copious, i.e. a split-off prefix that continues into a technical word. Members detect ' cop' and similar prefixes (mit, sem).
result.label: ' cop' prefix in split words

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments such as ' c' (cement, cake), 'pect' in "Respect", 'ym' in "Polymer", and 'rag'. It seems to predict a word continuation. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Incomplete word fragments (c, pect, ym)

result.description: Fires on the token ' formula', mostly in math text (distance formula, midpoint formula, quadratic formula). Members are mainly detectors of 'formula' and 'equation' in earlier layers. Silent on unrelated geometry text without the word.
result.label: ' formula' token detector

result.description: Fires on plural word endings such as 'ens' in gardens and 'als' in festivals, at the end of plural nouns for places or events (gardens, festivals, venues). Weaker on other plural endings like beliefs and traditions.
result.label: Plural noun endings: gardens, festivals

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' vern' (vernacular), ' Norman', ' verm', ' Geoff' in history-of-language and medieval/Renaissance text. Members include Latin/Renaissance/medieval topic detectors and a ' vern' detector.
result.label: vern- / Norman in language history

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ros' (sometimes 'ro') inside the word "corrosion"/"corrosive", after the prefix "cor". It stays silent when 'ros' starts a word without "cor" before it.
result.label: 'ros' inside "corrosion"

result.description: Fires on the token " account" (also "accounts") in accounting, finance and "account for" uses, often before "-ing" or "-ability". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' account' token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on word-start fragments ' ec' (ecotox-, ecstatic) and ' intr' (intricate), plus some Arabic letters and punctuation. Members are mostly detectors of word-piece fragments at the start of a longer word.
result.label: ' ec' / ' intr' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the ending piece (-es, -ation, -ing) of a word in a list of morphological terms like "prefixes, suffixes, infixes" in linguistics text. Silent on 'es' in unrelated words like capes or heroes.
result.label: Affix-term plural endings in morphology

result.description: Fires on the word ' communication' (also 'Communic|ation'), in noun-modifier slots like "quantum communication" or "electronic communication". It predicts following nouns such as systems, channels, protocols and networks.
result.label: ' communication' token detector

result.description: Fires on " the" right after "laid"/"laying"/"setting" in "laid the groundwork/foundation"; weakly after verbs like "shaping" or "feeds". It predicts foundation, basis, corner. It stays silent on " the" after other verbs or prepositions.
result.label: "the" after "laid" (groundwork)

result.description: Fires on the token right after "during" (" the", a space before a year, or the "s" of a decade like 1920s), where a time period or era is expected next. It predicts period words such as periods, hours and phases.
result.label: Token after "during", before a period

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' instant', ' extra', ' simultane' that are likely followed by a suffix (instantaneous, simultaneous, extraction), pushing towards continuations like 'aneous' and 'ity'. Mostly in physics/technical text.
result.label: instant/extra/simultane word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' therm' (thermodynamic, thermometer, thermistor, thermoset) when it starts a longer word, predicting continuations like 'odynamic' or 'ometer'. Barely fires on other word-initial pieces such as ' pot' in 'potatoes'.
result.label: ' therm' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word " ideal" (rarely " perfect") in idealism, ideal gas, idealized and "the ideal X" contexts. It is a token detector, and the logits favour suffix pieces such as "ized" and "ization".
result.label: ' ideal' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " LED" (also "LED"), mainly in display-technology lists such as Quantum Dot LED, OLED, QLED. Weaker on a few word pieces like "omorphic". Members are mostly LED token detectors.
result.label: LED token in display text

result.description: Fires on 'and' or 'in' right after "flexible" or "flexibility" (e.g. "flexible and resilient", "flexibility in work hours"), predicting adaptability words like accommodate, adapt, flexible. Silent on 'in' after "collaborative".
result.label: Connector after flexible/flexibility

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' k' (a word-initial fragment or a variable), mostly where it begins a word such as ketones, kinetics or kitchens. It predicts word continuations like 'itch', 'inet' and 'urg'.
result.label: ' k' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word or piece right after "serve(s)/serving/act as / function as", where the complement noun (both, an example, emblems, mirrors, guides) begins. Peaks are scattered across tokens; the construction is what matters.
result.label: Complement after "serving as"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of longer words, especially 'ry' in Tapestry/Symmetry/embryonic, 'ag' in Backpropagation, and word-initial ' Gen' or ' Po'. Seems to mark an incomplete word piece in academic text. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word pieces like ry, ag

result.description: Fires on the piece 'il' mainly in "fossil" (also stencil, Mercantilism), and sometimes on ' chapter'. It stays silent on 'il' in "resilient". Members are mostly 'il' and ' foss' detectors.
result.label: 'il' in fossil

result.description: Fires on the token "water", often as the second piece of compounds like fresh-water, salt-water, rain-water or ground-water, and in water-related text. Members are mostly detectors of water/sea/ocean tokens.
result.label: "water" token, especially in compounds

result.description: Fires on the 'xt' piece inside "juxtaposition/juxtaposes" (and the ' ju' start), mostly in literary-technique text. Weaker activation on other word-start pieces like ' ver' in "verbs".
result.label: 'xt' in juxtapose

result.description: Fires on ' we' (occasionally ' you'/' they') when it begins a relative clause right after a noun, as in "the words we choose" or "each language we speak". It stays quiet on ' we' as a main-clause subject or after "as if".
result.label: ' we' starting a relative clause

result.description: Fires on word pieces ' conj' and 'pos' inside the grammar terms "conjunctions" and "prepositions", in English grammar-teaching text. Silent on a bare "conjunctions or" at the start of a document.
result.label: Grammar terms: conj-/prepos- pieces

result.description: Fires on the nouns " effect", " effects" and " impact" (causal influence), often in statistical or research text. It is mostly silent when "effects" starts a document with no preceding context. Logits favor " on" as the next token.
result.label: effect / impact noun

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('us' in ethnomusicological, 'ene' in Hermeneutic, ' Res' in Respect) where the word is incomplete and a suffix like 'ic', 'pect', 'an' should follow. Silent on 'us' in 'illusions'.
result.label: Mid-word piece in rare words

result.description: Fires on the word piece " caus" at the start of "causality" and "causal", mostly in philosophical or analytical text. It predicts suffixes like "ality", "ities" and "ity". Members are mostly " caus" detectors in earlier layers.
result.label: ' caus' stem before -ality/-al

result.description: Fires on the piece 'on' inside the word "spintronics" (Spintr-on-ics). It stays silent on 'on' in other words like "photon" or "phenomenon".
result.label: 'on' in spintronics

result.description: Fires on "wider", "broader" (the 'ader' piece after "bro") and "global" as scope-widening adjectives before an abstract noun (changes, social transformations, financial crisis). It needs an adjective-before-noun slot about scale or scope.
result.label: wider / broader / global scope adjectives

result.description: Fires on the piece "ote" inside words like nanotechnology, Geotechnical, Remote, biotech, and on the word " remote" (remote sensing, remote work). Silent on other nano- words such as nanophysics.
result.label: "ote" piece and " remote"

result.description: Fires on the token ' und' (and similar word-start pieces like 'und', 'cr', 'ind') when it starts a word such as undermines or undulates, and also on German 'und'. Predicts continuations like 'istance', 'es', 'istant'.
result.label: ' und' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word "energy"/"Energy", most strongly on "Energy" as a list-heading item in topic outlines (Energy Auditing, Energy Modeling), and also mid-sentence before nouns like usage, supply or conservation. Silent in other topic lists.
result.label: Energy word detector

result.description: Fires on "on" in "hands-on" and on "active"/"young" after encouraging/promote verbs, in education and pedagogy text. It predicts participation or engagement words next. It stays silent on "on" inside names like Pokémon.
result.label: Hands-on / active learning in education

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (through, their, who, grow, 's, -ates) mid-sentence in explanatory text. Logits mildly suppress pronouns like their/they/them. Peaks are inconsistent and members are diffuse, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered mid-sentence function words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Aqu"/" aqu" (aqueduct, aquifer, aquatic, Aquinas, Aquitaine), when it is a fragment that begins a longer word. It also fires weakly on similar fragments like "mar" and "Angle".
result.label: Aqu- word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' times' in any sense: multiplication ("5 times 4"), multiples ("3 times"), access/refresh times, and historical eras ("ancient times"). Members are mostly ' times' detectors plus similar words like periods and moments.
result.label: ' times' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' that' used as a demonstrative pronoun or determiner, especially in comparisons ("similar to that of", "greater than that of", "like that friend"). Silent when 'that' is a relativizer or complementizer.
result.label: Demonstrative 'that' in comparisons

result.description: Fires on the token " data" (and "Data") as a modifier or head in data-related phrases such as "data analysis", "data-driven", "big data". Members are mostly detectors of " data" itself. The contrast has no " data" token.
result.label: ' data' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 've' piece in "eigenvectors" and on related linear-algebra words like "eigenvalues", "ctors", "paces", within matrix and vector-space text. Members are mostly linear-algebra topic detectors.
result.label: eigenvector/eigenvalue linear algebra tokens

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' fra' (fractions, fraud) when it is split before its continuation, with weaker firing on other word-start pieces like ' redu', 'rop', 'ec'. It predicts a word-completing suffix.
result.label: ' fra' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece " sust" (start of sustainable/sustainability), mostly after "environmental" or "ecological". It is silent on some " sust" after verbs like "incorporating" or "promote", so context matters.
result.label: sust- after environmental/ecological

result.description: Fires on word endings like -ized/-ize/-ization when they complete "special" (specialized, specialize, specialization). It stays silent on the same suffix after other stems such as standardized or stabilized.
result.label: Suffix after "special"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ized' right after 'personal' (also individual-, special-, custom-), where the next word is a noun like experiences or recommendations. Silent on 'ized' in words like unauthorized or utilized.
result.label: personalized suffix 'ized'

result.description: Fires on ' important' as the predicate adjective after "it is" / "is" (e.g. "it is important to note"). Stays silent on superlative "most important" as a noun modifier. Weaker on vital, essential, crucial.
result.label: Predicate "is important" adjective

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "itional" completing "Propositional" (also "Biconditional", "Unconditional") in formal logic text. It fires more weakly on "itional" in other words, like "nutritional".
result.label: "itional" in Propositional/logic terms

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens mid-word such as 'liqu' in solid-liquid, 'par' in transparency/preparation/separable, and 'ced' in unprecedented. Seems to need an incomplete word start inside science/technical text.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: liqu, par, ced
'ark' piece in quark
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ark' completing "quark" (top quark, bottom quark, quarkonium) in particle physics text. Silent on general particle-physics text without it. Weakly fires on 'MR' in NMR and on 'arks'.

Fires mostly on '=' after a short variable name in equations (F=, R=, N=), and on ' Mor' starting repeated "Moral ..." list lines, plus quote-dash tokens. Mixed peaks; members are mainly '=' detectors.
result.label: Equals sign after variable; ' Mor'

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of reasoning/analysis verbs (' dedu' in deduction, ' ver' in verifying, ' analyz', ' determ') in abstract math/logic/philosophy text, mid-word before the suffix is completed.
result.label: Reasoning-word prefixes in math/logic text

result.description: Fires on a few different nouns that often start compounds or words: ' heart', ' height', ' pot' (melting pot), ' sou'. Peaks are mixed; members include height and heart token detectors. Logits are unclear.
result.label: heart/height/pot word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " patient" as a modifier in healthcare text (patient-centered, patient safety, patient data), and less on word pieces like "asure" in "treasure". Mostly a patient detector with a minor secondary token.
result.label: ' patient' in healthcare text

result.description: Fires on "ken" in "likened (to)" and on " similar" in "is similar to", plus "kin" in "akin to". It marks comparison phrases that introduce an analogy, before "to".
result.label: Analogy phrase: likened/similar/akin to

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " scal" (as in scalability, scalable, scalars), and weakly on " coast" before "-al". It predicts suffix pieces like "ability". Members detect "scal" and similar prefix pieces.
result.label: " scal" prefix of scalability

result.description: Fires on the word " failure" (also " errors", " fail") as a noun for things going wrong, in technical and general discussion. Members are detectors of failure/fail tokens across earlier layers. Silent on contrast text about quality control without that word.
result.label: failure / errors noun

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Pro" (also "pro") when it begins a longer word, such as "Probability", "Proton" or "Protocol". It is strongest at the start of a line or title. It pushes toward continuations like "port" and "finite".
result.label: Pro- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "act" when it completes "Imp|act" (as in "Environmental Impact Assessment"). It is quiet on other "act" contexts such as a different word split, and members detect "act" and "Imp" pieces.
result.label: "act" piece in "Impact"

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ence' and 'ing' in "adherence" / "adhering" (before "to standards/regulations"). It stays silent on 'ence' in other words such as "excellence". Logits favour "strict", "strictly", "standard".
result.label: adherence / adhering word ending

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cogn' (start of "cognitive/cognition") in academic text, typically after an adjective or preposition. Members are detectors of ' cogn' and related science word starts like psych, sexual, visual.
result.label: ' cogn' word-start detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments after a prefix like pre-/pred-/Hyp-, e.g. 'oth' in Hypothesis, 'erm' in predetermined, 'et'/'os'. It is silent on 'erm' in undermine, so it needs the pre-/hypo- word context.
result.label: Mid-word piece in pred-/Hyp- words

result.description: Fires on the word " concept" (also "cept" in "Conceptual") when it follows "the" as a head noun, as in "the concept of X". Silent when "concept" starts the text without a preceding "the".
result.label: "the concept of" noun

result.description: Fires on the noun after "mental" (mostly " states", also "caus" in "mental causation") in philosophy-of-mind text about mind-body relations. Silent on general consciousness text without this phrase.
result.label: "mental states" / causation noun

result.description: Fires on the word after an adverb like "primarily/largely/mainly" in descriptions of what a society or activity is based on, driven by, or governed by (" based", " driven", " by"). Silent on "based" without such a preceding adverb.
result.label: Word after "primarily/largely" (based, driven)

result.description: Fires mainly on ' Plan' as the start of "Planck" (the physicist/satellite), and on a few other pieces like ' astronom' in science text. Predicts "ck" continuation. Silent on the contrast's cosmology text without that name.
result.label: Plan- in Planck

result.description: Fires on the 'bs' piece in "Adverbs" at the start of a document or heading in grammar text about parts of speech (adverbs of time, manner, place). Members detect 'bs' and grammar terms like adverb, clause.
result.label: 'bs' in "Adverbs" heading

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' liter' (literacy), ' advoc' (advocate) and ' accum' (accumulate), where the next piece is likely a suffix such as 'acy' or 'ates'. Mostly the ' liter' stem.
result.label: liter-/advoc-/accum- word stems

result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix "ness" (especially in "wellness", also fitness, illness) and on " fish" in fisheries-type words. Members are mostly "ness" detectors. Weak firing on " describing".
result.label: "ness" suffix and " fish"
Greenhouse 'house' piece
result.description: Fires on the token 'house' when it completes "greenhouse" (as in greenhouse gas/effect), in climate text. It predicts ' gas' next. It is silent on general climate text without that word piece.
Fires on the word piece "acc" in "vaccine(s)", after the "v" piece. Members are mostly detectors of this "acc" token in vaccine contexts.
result.label: "acc" in vaccine

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cub' (start of "cubic") in crystallography lattice lists, such as "body-centered cubic" or "face-centered cubic". Members detect ' cub', 'ic', and crystal or lattice context.
result.label: ' cub' in crystal lattice types
'ction' in "auction"
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ction' when it completes "auction" (auction theory, auctioneers), and weakly on ' dedu' in "deduction". It stays silent on 'ction' in other words like "contraction" or "transactions".

Fires on the stem of verbs like "utilize" and "incorporate" (also "emphasize", "exploit") right after a relative pronoun such as "that" or "which". It is the word-start piece before the -ize or -ate ending.
result.label: util-/incorpor- verb stem after "that"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ist' in "twist" (also twisty, twisting) after 'tw', mostly in writing about plot and narrative. It is silent on 'ist' in other words, such as "undistracted".
result.label: 'ist' in "twist"

result.description: Fires on the token ' consumption' (energy, economic, goods consumption) in all its appearances. Members are mostly ' consumption'/' consume' detectors plus a few unrelated word-piece detectors. Predicts next tokens like patterns/habits.
result.label: ' consumption' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " gas" (also " Gas"), mostly in physics and chemistry or oil and gas text about gas properties and behavior. Members are mostly detectors of the same token in earlier layers.
result.label: The word "gas"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' hum' when it starts a longer word, mostly "humidity" (also humidifier, humorous). Members are detectors of ' hum' and similar word-start fragments. It predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' hum' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces like 'rium' in Equilibrium and 'ier' in Le Chatelier, in chemistry/equilibrium text. Silent on lowercase 'chatelier' in a different context. Members detect reaction, equilibrium constant and 'ier' tokens.
result.label: Equilibrium / Chatelier word endings

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ary' in pituitary, 'cient' in Ancient, 'it', 'ic', mainly in biology/science terms. Stays silent on 'ary' in evolutionary and eukaryotic. Peaks are varied word fragments.
result.label: Word fragments in pituitary, Ancient

result.description: Fires on the word piece "action" completing "Inter-action" (also "Interactions"), and more weakly on " exit" and a few other pieces. Members detect "Inter" + "active"/"action" pieces.
result.label: Inter-"action" word piece
'ic' in "biconditional" after 'b'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ic' right after a word-initial 'b' in "biconditional" (b-ic-onditional). It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as logic, intricately or mathematic.

Fires on the word " tools" (also " tool"), especially as a plural noun after phrases like "variety of", "use of", or "appropriate". Members are mostly detectors of "tools". Predicts next words like kit, box, used, employed.
result.label: Word "tools"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' p' as a standalone token, often the start of a split word like "pandering" or "pivotal", or a variable like p in pH. It stays quiet on some ' p' tokens, such as those right after a period or in "pragmatics", "paved".
result.label: Split-word ' p' token

result.description: Fires on the token ' goals' (also 'objectives' pieces) right after an adjective like clear, measurable or long-term, in management and planning text about setting objectives. Members are mostly goal/target/objective detectors.
result.label: ' goals' after modifiers in planning text

result.description: Peaks scatter across unrelated tokens (word fragments like 'ed', 'ary', ' MO', '/', 'world') mostly inside technical or academic text, mid-word or mid-compound. No coherent trigger or condition is visible; members are mixed token detectors.
result.label: Scattered mid-word fragments, unclear

result.description: Fires on the word "cost(s)" and related money-expense words (expenses, overhead) in business or accounting text about costs. It is silent on "production costs" in a regulatory list context. It pushes toward cost-related continuations.
result.label: cost / expenses noun

result.description: Fires on a comma inside a list of parallel nouns, such as fields, disciplines or elements (physics, engineering, science, art), after a list item that is followed by more items. It is silent on commas after clause adverbs or relative clauses.
result.label: Comma in noun lists

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece " indust" (before "ries"), also on other incomplete word stems like " assemb", " Supp", "ing-red". It predicts a suffix continuation. It was silent on one sentence-initial "industries".
result.label: Incomplete stem ' indust' predicting suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oph' (occasionally 'ph') in the middle of multi-piece words such as Chordophones, Membranophones, nucleophile, eosinophilic and Diophantine. Weaker on 'ph' in euphoria and dolphins.
result.label: 'oph' mid-word piece

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' F' and ' Str' (also ' ha') that start a capitalized word at the beginning of a list line or title, such as 'Dr. F' or '¶ Strategic'. Silent on full-name lists of people.
result.label: Word-initial ' F' / ' Str' fragments

result.description: Fires on music genre names (country, rock, roll, punk, grunge, soul) in lists or discussions of musical styles; predicts further genre words like punk, jazz, hip. Silent on non-music text.
result.label: Music genre names

result.description: Fires on the word piece " scatter" (as in scattering, scatterer) in physics text about Thomson, Rayleigh and Compton scattering. It predicts word-ending suffixes such as "ing" or "ical". Members are mostly detectors of " scatter".
result.label: ' scatter' word stem

result.description: Fires on the word " further", most strongly as an adverb after a passive auxiliary ("was further developed", "can be further segmented"), and also in "any further information". It predicts verbs like developed, stated, informed.
result.label: ' further' after passive auxiliary

result.description: Fires on indefinite/quantifier pronouns like "something", "nothing", "much", "little", "everything" when they act as the object or subject of a clause, e.g. "there's something". Silent on "something" after "when" or "of". Predicts "else".
result.label: Indefinite pronouns something/nothing

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Ne' when it begins "Neural" in machine-learning terms such as "Convolutional Neural Networks" or "Recurrent Neural Networks". It is weaker on "Neolithic". It stays quiet on ordinary text.
result.label: ' Ne' of Neural Networks

result.description: Fires on forms of "bring" (bringing, bring, brought, brings), and weakly on similar verbs like put or adds, where a particle such as "about", "forth" or "together" is likely to follow. Members are mostly detectors of "bring" forms.
result.label: Forms of "bring" verb

result.description: Fires on the token 'y' inside the word "recycling"/"recyclable" (rec|y|cling), predicting 'cling' next. Weak activation on a few other word-internal pieces such as 'abs' and 'embassy'.
result.label: 'y' in rec-y-cling

result.description: Fires on ' sensitive' (also ' safe') and on the piece 'mos' in "Atmospheric" at a document start. It looks like a mix of a sensitive-word detector and a word-piece case; the members mostly detect ' sensitive'.
result.label: ' sensitive' and 'mos' in Atmospheric

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Cr" in "Francis Crick" (Watson and Crick, DNA double helix), as a name-start fragment awaiting "ick". Members include Cr/cr detectors and genetics/DNA topic features.
result.label: Cr in Francis Crick

result.description: Fires on the word " excitement" (occasionally " susp" of suspense) in text about pacing and storytelling techniques that build excitement or suspense. Members mostly detect excitement/tension-type emotion words; it pushes toward verbs like "builds" and "increases".
result.label: excitement in narrative pacing text

result.description: Fires on the word " ensure", most strongly in purpose clauses like "To ensure …" at the start of a sentence. It weakly fires on other verbs after "to", such as "provide". Members detect ensure/ensures/ensuring.
result.label: " ensure" after "to"

result.description: Fires on Cyrillic word pieces (' у', 'ск', ' ар') inside garbled, scrambled pseudo-Russian text mixed into English. Members are mostly Arabic and Cyrillic fragment detectors. Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Cyrillic fragments in garbled text
'ing' in employing/deploying
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' ending gerunds like employ-ing and deploying (loy-ing), as in "employing X" or "deploying these". It stays silent on 'ing' after other stems such as partitioning, impacting, crafting.

Fires on the final piece of "symphony" and "orchestra" (sym-phony, or-chestra), often in metaphors comparing systems to an orchestra. Predicts orchestral or music continuations. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: symphony / orchestra word endings

result.description: Fires on the token "energy" in "high-energy" (particle beams, physics, conditions). Silent on "energy" in "energy-efficient", so it needs the preceding "high-" compound. Supported by energy/physics detectors upstream.
result.label: energy after "high-"

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside technical or art words, mostly 'work' after 'art' (artwork, brushwork), also 'av' in concavity and 'ating/ations' in oscillating/oscillations. Silent on 'art' alone.
result.label: 'work' in artwork; oscillat- endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'if' inside multi-piece words such as aqu-if-ers, B-if-urcation and sher-if. Silent when the word is split differently (e.g. "acre…"). Members are mostly 'if' detectors plus an ' aqu' detector.
result.label: 'if' inside words (aquifers)

result.description: Fires on the word " concurrent" as an adjective before nouns like systems, programming, or processes, mostly in computing text. Members detect related words such as parallel, concurrency, isolated and independent.
result.label: ' concurrent' in computing text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (th, ib, oth, ath, on) inside technical Greek-derived words after a "ph"/"ph-" start, like diphthong, hydrophobic, phonetics. It is silent on ordinal "th" such as 15th.
result.label: Mid-word piece in ph- technical words

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after the prefix "anti" (anti-inflammatory, anti-CTLA, anti-particles), and weakly on other split pieces of "anti". It stays silent on hyphens after other words like self-, far-, life-.
result.label: Hyphen after "anti" prefix

result.description: Fires on plural suffix pieces (-es, -ms, -ants, -ations, -iders) ending business/company nouns like franchises, firms, giants, corporations, in economic or business text. Predicts verbs like began, started, expanded.
result.label: Plural company-noun endings in business text

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " detect" when it is a stem that continues into a suffix, as in "detectors" (heat/smoke/radiation detectors). Weaker on a few word pieces like "uth" and "prec". It is silent on "detection".
result.label: " detect" stem before -ors
' ess' word-piece in essence/essay
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ess' when it begins a word like "essence" or "essay", usually after "the". Silent when ' ess' is at document start with no preceding context. Predicts continuations such as "entials" or "ence".

Fires on the noun completing an "In the fast-paced/dynamic ... world/realm/environment of" opening, right after stacked adjectives near document start. It stays quiet on "world" in other phrases, such as "the business world".
result.label: "In the dynamic world of" opener

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: 'ions' ending "fermions" (not in "invasions" or "inventions"), and ' Africa' in colonial or geographic contexts. Mixed, polysemantic target; weak activations on other tokens.
result.label: 'ions' in fermions; ' Africa'

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ir" at the start of "irony" (situational irony, verbal irony), as a split-word fragment. Members detect " ir" and similar word-start pieces like irrigation and par(adox). Weak firing on "primary".
result.label: " ir" piece in "irony"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'oid' ending scientific terms like solenoids, toroids, geoid, steroid, paraboloid. Members are mostly 'oid' detectors; weak firing on ' am' in amines and 'igen' in antigen.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in science terms

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces like 'ular', 'abol', '-ative' in biology/biochemistry words (cellular, metabolic, neurodegenerative). Silent on 'ular' in cardiovascular, so it seems to need a cell/metabolism context.
result.label: Cell/metabolism word-piece suffixes

result.description: Fires on word pieces that begin an art/culture "-ism" or "-ist" term: "ge" in zeitgeist, " Cub" in Cubism, " Symbol" in symbolism. Context is art movements and cultural analysis; upstream members are art-name and word-start detectors.
result.label: Art-movement word stems (Cub, zeitge)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ther' inside a longer word, mainly in "Panthera" and also "Ethernet". Members are detectors of 'ther' and of word-initial pieces like 'pan', 'E' and 'A-mp'.
result.label: 'ther' inside Panthera/Ethernet

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ology' (also 'ics') ending a short science-field heading, most strongly in physiology titles like "Molecular physiology." in lists of academic topics. Stays silent on 'ology' in running text or other fields like ethnomusicology and dialectology.
result.label: Science field-name suffix 'ology'/'ics'

result.description: Fires on the word " there" in many uses: existential "there is/are", "out there", "over there", "thereof". Members are mostly detectors of " there" at earlier layers. Weakly predicts words like "after".
result.label: the word " there"

result.description: Fires on "estimation" and "-ators" (estimators) in statistics text about point and interval estimation, after a word like point, interval, or unbiased. It is weaker on cost estimation and linear regression.
result.label: Statistical estimation / estimators

result.description: Fires on the token right after "audio" (encoding, Com-, Sign-, dec-, hyphen, signal), where a technical audio term is being continued. Silent on hyphens after other words such as Real- or Single-. Pushes toward video/visual/compression-type words.
result.label: Token following "audio" compound

result.description: Fires on the 'a' piece inside "Versailles" (Vers|a|illes), mainly in "Treaty of Versailles". It stays silent on 'a' in other words or as the article, and the logits favor the continuation "illes".
result.label: 'a' in Treaty of Versailles

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'omed' in "Biomedical" (mostly at document start in course/field lists) and on 'ial' suffixes in words like factorial or adverbial. It seems to detect unfinished word fragments rather than a topic.
result.label: Word fragments: 'omed' and 'ial'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'yn' inside multi-token words such as nucleos-yn-thesis, photos-yn-thesis, pol-yn-omial and Ke-yn-esian. It mostly predicts 'thesis' next.
result.label: 'yn' piece in nucleosynthesis

result.description: Fires on ' proportion' (also ' combination', ' ratio') as a noun or word start, mostly in art, design and cooking text about balance and ratios. Members are proportion detectors plus art/design topic latents.
result.label: proportion / combination ratio words

result.description: Fires on the word " means", both as a noun ("by means of", "a means of") and as a verb ("X means increased demand"). Members are mostly detectors of " means" itself. Next-token logits are unclear.
result.label: ' means' token detector

result.description: Fires on 'expand' and the 'ing' ending of expanding/broadening-type verbs (expand, expanding, broadening), especially where the verb takes an object like scope, reach or territory. Silent on 'ing' in unrelated words like mining or spurring.
result.label: expand / expanding verb forms

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ep' completing the word "creep" (material deformation under stress) in engineering text. Members are mostly 'ep' token detectors plus some mechanical-engineering context members.
result.label: 'ep' in "creep" (materials)

result.description: Fires on the word " when" introducing a subordinate clause after a main clause (e.g. "minimal storage space when compared", "professionalism when capitalizing"). Silent on "whenever". Members are mostly " when" detectors.
result.label: Subordinating " when" after clause

result.description: Fires on verbs and prepositions like "develop/developing", "towards", "improve", and "and" in policy or public-health text, where a policy-related object comes next (policy, education, strategy). Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Policy-directed verbs and 'towards'

result.description: Fires on commas inside a long list of single abstract nouns (e.g. "humility, gratitude, awareness"), mainly after the third or later item. It stays quiet on commas after longer phrases or in adjective lists.
result.label: Comma in lists of bare nouns

result.description: Fires on a capitalized word-initial fragment that begins a longer word and is split across tokens (Ama in Amadeus, Per in Perfect, Poss, Luc). It seems to predict a continuation piece such as 'art', 'ren' or 'on'. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-start fragments (Ama, Per, Poss)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' (also 'astic') inside words like acidic, elicit, elastic, in chemistry/acid-base and economics-style text. It is silent on 'ic' in other words such as phenolic or monoprotic.
result.label: 'ic' suffix in acidic/elastic words

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " mascul" (masculine/masculinity) in gender-studies style text, and weakly on " side" and a few name fragments. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: " mascul" in masculine/masculinity

result.description: Fires on the verb "lies" (also " rely") in "relies" where a subject depends on something, typically just before "on/heavily on". Weaker on similar "X on" verbs like capitalize/focuses.
result.label: "relies" before "on"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ular' completing "cardiovascular" (as in cardiovascular system). It stays silent on 'ular' in "cellular" and at the start of a document, so it needs the cardiovasc- prefix.
result.label: cardiovasc-'ular' word ending

result.description: Fires on ' before' ending a comparative "than ever before" phrase, meaning previously. Weak on other "before"/earlier-time uses. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "than ever before" – before

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'ot' and 'u' inside abstract philosophical/linguistic terms (den-ot-ation, individ-u-ation), where a suffix such as -ation is expected next. Silent on 'ot' in other words like negotiation or stereotypes.
result.label: Mid-word 'ot'/'u' in academic terms

result.description: Fires on the token " instrument" (and the piece "ast"), including as a stem in instrumental/instrumentation. Members are mostly detectors of "instrument" and similar words such as tools. Predicts suffixes like -al and -ation.
result.label: ' instrument' token detector

result.description: Fires on " art" and " music" (also "arts") in historical/Renaissance-era cultural passages, especially where "art" begins a word like "artistic" or is a modifier. It stays silent on "art" as a plain standalone noun in other phrasing.
result.label: art/music in Renaissance cultural history

result.description: Fires on the token ' ions' (plural of ion) in chemistry text about charged atoms, cations/anions and ionic bonding. Silent on nearby chemistry words like 'ionic' in the contrast. Members include ion-token detectors and chemistry context features.
result.label: chemistry 'ions' token

result.description: Fires on a comma separating items in a list of nouns (e.g. "the heart, blood vessels", "argon, carbon dioxide"), mostly in the middle of enumerations in explanatory text. Silent on commas after introductory phrases like "for example," or "to understand this,".
result.label: Comma between list items

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' prepar' and ' veget' (preparing, preparation, vegetables) in cooking text, where the next piece is likely a suffix like -ation. Silent on 'prepare food' in the contrast.
result.label: prepar-/veget- stems in cooking

result.description: Fires on the word " alongside" after a noun phrase, where a coordinate item follows (e.g. "creativity alongside academic pursuits"). It pushes toward next words like "traditional", "those", "other", "existing". Members detect "alongside"/"with"/"against" style tokens.
result.label: ' alongside' connecting parallel items

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' precip' (precipitate, precipitation, precipitated), a split-word fragment that expects a continuation like 'itate'/'itation'. Members are mostly ' precip' detectors across early layers.
result.label: ' precip' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' time' when it follows "a" and means an era or period, as in "In a time when/of...". It stays silent on "over time", "timeframes", "beyond time" and sentence-initial "time".
result.label: "a time" meaning an era

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mon' (also ' Orth') at the start of a longer word such as monastic, monk, monism or monopoly. It predicts word continuations like 'archy', 'opol' and 'odox'. It is quiet on text without such a word start.
result.label: ' mon' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' Korea', especially after 'North' or 'South' or in lists of Asian and world countries in geopolitical or historical text. Members are detectors of other country, region and Asia tokens.
result.label: ' Korea' in country lists

result.description: Fires on abstract head nouns like "form", "representation", "model", "entity" after an adjective or article (a dense representation, a whole new entity, a model to represent). Silent on "form" as a word piece (formulates) or in "language form".
result.label: Abstract head nouns: representation/model/form

result.description: Fires on the second word of finance/economics compound terms after a financial noun (wealth tax, revenue streams, asset turnover, income tax), in finance and economics text. Predicts financial continuations like income, percent, returns.
result.label: Finance compound noun after money term

result.description: Fires on a digit, mostly '1', that begins a number in a heading or section numbering (e.g. "## 1", "### 1.", "2.1") or a matrix entry at the start of a line. It stays silent on '1' inside years or larger numbers in running prose.
result.label: Leading digit in section numbering

result.description: Fires on linear-algebra nouns like " transformation", " matrix", " vector", especially right after "linear" or "orthogonal", in math text about vector spaces. Members detect transform/transformation tokens plus math-operation context.
result.label: Linear algebra transformation/matrix nouns

result.description: Fires on ordinal/onset words like " first", " early", " initial" when they come without a preceding "the" (e.g. at the start of a phrase). It stays silent on "the first ...", so it needs a particular construction slot.
result.label: first/early/initial without "the"

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after a quantity or measure noun (percentage, ratio, volume, proportion, quantity) in scientific or technical definitions. It stays silent after general nouns like property, study, law or accuracy.
result.label: ' of' after measure nouns

result.description: Fires on the word " curve" (also "curves"), mostly in calculus or math text about tangent lines, slopes and concavity. Members are mainly detectors of "curve" plus math-context features.
result.label: ' curve' in math contexts

result.description: Fires on the adverb " closely" (e.g. "closely related", "closely followed", "closely track"), weakly on other -ly adverb endings. Members detect "closely"/"close" and -ly suffixes. Logits favour participles like "tied", "linked".
result.label: Adverb "closely"

result.description: Fires on ' into' right after "insight(s)" (e.g. "valuable insights into"). It stays silent on physical-transformation "into", such as "deformed into".
result.label: ' into' after insight(s)

result.description: Fires on the word " based" when it follows a noun or verb phrase and introduces "based on" (e.g. "predict an outcome based on"). Members are mostly detectors of "based" and related "depending/depend" tokens.
result.label: " based" in "based on"

result.description: Fires on the noun completing a "social/type of X" phrase, mostly ' protection', also ' benefits', ' benefit' and ' advantage'. It follows a modifier such as social, differential or economic. Members detect protection, defense, assistance and welfare words.
result.label: protection/benefit noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on the prefix tokens ' inter' and ' non' as standalone word-start pieces, mainly ' inter' beginning "intervention" or "interference". It stays silent on ' inter' in "intertwine", "inter-personal" and "interruption". Members are mostly weak token detectors.
result.label: inter-/non- word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the word "dialogue" (mostly the 'ue' piece, also ' dialog') and nearby tokens in creative-writing text about plot, characters and readers. Silent on 'ue' outside this setting. Predicts writing-craft continuations like writer or characters.
result.label: dialogue in creative writing

result.description: Fires on the word after "replaced" (mostly " by", also " with" or the start of the replacement phrase like " more"), in replacement constructions. Silent on " by" after "driven" or "monitored".
result.label: "replaced by" agent slot

result.description: Fires on ' men' as the first piece of "menstrual" (and weakly on ' Race' in "Arms Race"), i.e. a word-initial fragment inside a longer word. Circuit is failed and diffuse, with only generic members.
result.label: ' men' in "menstrual"

result.description: Fires on 'on' (also 'into') right after nouns like perspective, insight, information, light that introduce a topic ("insights into", "perspectives on", "sheds light on"). Silent on 'on' as a physical or verbal preposition, as in "founded on" or "focuses on".
result.label: 'on/into' after insight-type nouns

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on scattered tokens (commas, 'but', 'of', 'enough', word pieces) in expository text. No dominant token or construction; members are generic token detectors. Failed circuit, evidence thin.
result.label: Scattered function-word peaks, unclear

result.description: Attention-layer target that peaks on the document-start token and also fires weakly on scattered mid-word or function tokens (' as', ' transfer', 'ing') in science text. Members are rare-token and word-piece detectors, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Document-start token, scattered pieces

result.description: Fires on "logging" (also records, logs, tools) in well logging text about oil and gas and subsurface measurement. Silent on software or audit logging and reporting contexts.
result.label: Well logging (oil and gas)

result.description: Fires on ' in' right after "lies" (also "lie", "rooted", "not only") in sentences saying where a quality or value of a topic resides ("the key lies in its ability"). Silent on ordinary locative or other uses of ' in'.
result.label: 'in' after "lies" (essence lies in)

result.description: Fires on the possessive 's right after the word piece "stein" (Einstein's), before a noun like "groundbreaking ideas". Weakly on 's after theory or Kepler. Silent on 's after Einstein in other contexts and on decade 1900's.
result.label: Possessive 's after -stein

result.description: Fires on ' to' (also 'the', word pieces) right after "contributions" in the phrase "significant contributions to". Silent on ' to' after other verbs or nouns, such as "led to" or "from X to Y". Members detect "contributions" and the following ' to'.
result.label: 'to' after "contributions"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "as important/crucial/significant as" in an equative comparison, mostly the '-ing' of a gerund (having, maintaining, avoiding) or a following noun. Silent on '-ing' in other contexts.
result.label: Gerund after "as important as"

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "early days" (also "early years"), as in "the early days of X". It stays silent on " of" after other nouns such as "repeal of", "use of" or "shades of".
result.label: "of" after "early days"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "izers" completing "fertilizers", mostly after "synthetic fert(il)" in agriculture text. Members include detectors of "izers" and farming word pieces (crops, agriculture). Weaker on "izer" and on the comma after a fertilizers list.
result.label: fertilizers suffix 'izers'

result.description: Fires on ' and' (also possessive/comma) directly after "computer vision" / "human vision", the connective following that topic phrase. Silent on ' and' after other nouns such as reconstruction or DCT.
result.label: 'and' after "computer vision"

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer target firing on varied tokens (mid-word pieces, function words, commas) in expository text, often inside a list or word being completed. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Diffuse mid-phrase expository tokens

result.description: Fires on tokens right after or inside the object slot of "achieving" (e.g. "achieving both", "achieving optimal", "achieving the"). It is silent on "both" after other words such as "of both" or "on both". Members are mostly generic word-piece and topic detectors.
result.label: Words following "achieving"

result.description: Fires on a comma following a noun phrase like "various debris" or "complex structure", where a relative or participial clause follows (", which includes", ", recycling"). Silent on some commas in similar contexts, so the condition is unclear. Weak, near-threshold circuit.
result.label: Comma after noun phrase before clause

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (word pieces, function words, punctuation) in technical or expository lists and noun phrases. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed, so no single trigger is clear.
result.label: Scattered tokens in expository text

result.description: Fires on the name "Rachel" (' Rach', 'el') and following ' Car'/' P' in the name Rachel Carson, mostly when the name appears inside running prose. It stayed silent on a "Rachel Carson" that starts a new line after a list of names.
result.label: Rachel Carson name pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' (also 'ative') when it completes the word "collaboration"/"collaborative", after the piece 'abor'. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like improvisation, innovation, dedication.
result.label: -ation in collaboration

result.description: Fires on the '9' in a 20th-century year (1957, 1961, 1960s, 1984) in space, satellite and technology-history text. It stays silent on some other years, such as 1962 and mid-1990s, so it seems to need a space or tech-history context.
result.label: '9' in 1900s year, space/tech

result.description: Weak, scattered attention-layer target peaking on varied tokens (' standards', ' both', ' and', ' for', mid-word pieces) in academic text. Silent on ' standards' after some words, but evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered academic-text tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word pieces, ')' and ' and') inside noun phrases that follow "growth of/in ...", e.g. "growth of multinational corporations", "growth of these bacteria". Silent on ')' in other contexts. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Noun phrase after "growth of"
Comma after list item in art text
result.description: Fires on commas that end a noun or phrase in running lists or clauses, mostly in essay-style text about art and culture. It stays silent on some commas after "art" itself. Members are comma detectors that push toward "including" and "which".

Fires on the space or digit tokens right after "ound" (as in "around") when a number follows, e.g. "around 6000" or "around 10,000". It stays silent on some spaces and digits in other number contexts.
result.label: Number after "ound" (around)

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer target firing on assorted function words and word pieces (for, to, and, the, learning, -ing) in academic or technical prose. Peaks are inconsistent and the same tokens are often silent, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Diffuse function-word firing in technical prose

result.description: Fires on interrogative "who" (also "what", "with", "(") used as a free-standing question word in an embedded clause, e.g. "determine who speaks", "knowing who they communicate with". It stays silent on relative "who" after a noun (those who...).
result.label: Embedded interrogative "who" clauses

result.description: Attention latent firing on the end of a list item or noun phrase, such as ' problems', ':', ';' or ' management', where a list or enumeration is being introduced or continued. Silent on 'problems' in other contexts. Evidence is weak and mixed.
result.label: List-item and enumeration boundary tokens

result.description: Fires on ' target' used as a noun modifier before a head noun (target audience, target demographics, target value). Silent when 'target' is a verb or in 'targeted' after 'and'.
result.label: ' target' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on tokens shortly after the verb "adopt/adopting" (e.g. "these", "ag", "ing", "cutting"), in the object phrase of adopting methods or practices. Silent on "these" elsewhere. Members detect "adopt" and method words.
result.label: Object slot after "adopting"

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "harmon-" words (harmony, harmonious, harmonies), mostly 'ony', 'ious', 'ies', when the stem "harm" has just been written. Silent on at least one 'ony' in "natural harmony", so it is not fully consistent.
result.label: Suffix completing "harmon-" words

result.description: Weak, mixed target firing on determiners and prepositions (' your', ' the', ' to') before a noun, plus a word-piece 'mole' in 'molecules'. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered determiners before nouns

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (' of', ',', ' purpose', 's', ' which', ' than') in abstract, technical expository text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. Logits weakly favor ' and' and ' are'. The circuit is weak and unclear.
result.label: Mixed function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on varied words (audio, cast, access, accessible, educational, tech) inside text about podcasts, online media and digital platforms. Silent on 'audio' in 'audiobook', so it seems to need the podcast/media-platform context.
result.label: Podcast and digital media words

result.description: Fires on verbs and function words (were, are, in, during, past participles) right after a plural or passive-style subject in expository history/economics text. The contrast shows it is silent on some 'were' cases, so it is inconsistent and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Verb slot after subject in expository text

result.description: Fires on ' while' (or ' whilst') as a contrastive conjunction right after a comma-ended clause, introducing a parallel contrasting clause. It is silent when 'while' follows a clause with no comma, such as 'advance plots during cliffhangers while slowing'.
result.label: Contrastive 'while' after comma

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' and', ' property', ' ground', 'ic', ' of', ' in') in abstract expository text, with no dominant token or clear condition. The circuit failed and its members are generic, with no discriminative ones.
result.label: Scattered mixed tokens, weak circuit

result.description: Fires on the token completing or following a battle name, mainly 'ne' in "Battle of the Marne", also ' of' after "Battle" and 'burg' in Gettysburg. It needs a battle or war context. Members mix 'ne' detectors with military-word detectors.
result.label: Battle names: Marne, Gettysburg, Battle of
'c' in "Advancements" at document start
result.description: Fires on the piece 'c' inside "Advancements" in a title-like opening ("Advancements in..."). Members detect 'c' in other words (Crescendo, V_c, Procurement), but the target peaks in this word.

Fires on the token right after the word "life" (hyphen in "life-saving", "'s" in "life's", or " cycle"), i.e. the continuation slot after "life". Does not fire on hyphens after other words like "self-" or "X-".
result.label: Token following "life" (life-, life's)

result.description: Fires on the word or function word right after "gaps" (e.g. " in", " between", " greater") when text is about bridging gaps, especially between cultures or in communication. It stays silent on ' in' in other contexts.
result.label: Token following "gaps" in bridging contexts

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'and', 'to', word endings, nouns) inside long expository sentences, often at a slot where a continuation of a phrase is expected. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak, with no clear shared trigger or condition.
result.label: Scattered mid-sentence tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' to', ' is', ',', ' but', ' beauty') in dense academic or technical prose. No single token or construction dominates, and the circuit failed its faithfulness checks, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Scattered function words in technical prose

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside the name of an academic field right after the opening phrase "The field of" (atmospheric, geotechnical, descriptive, bi-, combin-). It stays silent on the same pieces (e.g. ' bi') in other contexts, such as mid-sentence mentions of biology or biomedical engineering.
result.label: Field-name pieces after "The field of"

result.description: Fires on the "fs" piece completing "serfs" (ser + fs), in text about feudal social classes such as peasants and serfdom. Members detect feudal and class words and "serf" word pieces.
result.label: "fs" ending of "serfs"

result.description: Diffuse attention-layer latent peaking on mixed tokens: commas, conjunctions, ' a', and noun endings like ' nature', ' spaces', ' platforms'. No clear shared token or context; the circuit failed and the members are generic token detectors.
result.label: Diffuse mixed function-word and noun peaks

result.description: Fires on ' salt' and word pieces within passages about table or cooking salt (fine grains, granulates, evaporating seawater). Silent on 'salt' in a plain ingredient list, so it seems to need an article centred on salt itself.
result.label: Salt as article topic

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "idents" in "accidents" or "incidents", and sometimes on "accident" or a following "and", in safety and traffic engineering text. It is silent on general road-safety policy text that lacks these words.
result.label: "idents" in accidents/incidents

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe or following 's' in the possessive of a mathematician's name, such as "Green's Theorem" or "Stokes'". It is silent on apostrophes in other contexts like contractions and "Beginner's".
result.label: Possessive after Green's theorem names

result.description: Fires weakly on ' and' or commas after a technical noun in academic lists (e.g. "data organization and", "number theory,"), plus an occasional 'UI'. Contrast shows ' and' often silent in similar contexts, so the condition is unclear. Circuit failed.
result.label: Conjunctions after academic topic nouns

result.description: Fires on commas and "and" (also "use", "to") separating items in lists about lifecycle, recycling, waste and sustainability. Silent on similar commas in other list contexts; the evidence is weak and the circuit failed.
result.label: List separators in sustainability lifecycle lists

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' arrow', 'als', ' making', ' charge') with no shared meaning. Members are generic, non-specific context latents. The circuit failed faithfulness and is near threshold, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered mixed tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on word endings like "ments" in "metabolic rate adjustments" and " mod" in "metabolic modulation", in a repeated biology-adaptation list. Silent on "adjustments" in other phrasings. Evidence is weak; the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: metabolic rate adjust-ments list

result.description: Fires on tokens right after or within the phrase "in accordance with" (' the', possessive 's, 'or' in "investor's"), in business or corporate text. It stays silent after similar phrases like "in line with" or "aligned with".
result.label: "in accordance with the" slot

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (plural -es/-s endings, 'charts', 'with', 'play', 'above') in science and environment text such as oceans, lakes, radiation and navigation. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak and poorly faithful.
result.label: Scattered tokens in science text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ometry" completing "Geometry", mostly in "Algebraic Geometry" and "Differential Geometry" titles. Members detect geometry, algebra and "-ology" word pieces.
result.label: "ometry" in Geometry

result.description: Fires on the word right after "intersection" (mostly " of", also words like "considerations", "insights", "disciplines") in phrases about the intersection of fields. Silent on " of" after other nouns like "boundaries" or "structure".
result.label: "of" after intersection

result.description: Fires on ' particularly' and ' especially' (also ' specifically') when they come after a comma or clause and introduce a narrowing focus, such as "X, particularly those in...". Members detect these emphasis adverbs and related words like typically and such.
result.label: Emphasis adverb 'particularly/especially' after comma

result.description: Fires on the word after "highlight(s)" (often "the", or the noun like variety/beauty/colors) in food presentation and visual-aesthetics text. Also peaks on "ures" in some words, but stays silent on "ensures" and "gestures".
result.label: Highlighting the visual qualities of food

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' events', ' on', ' probability', 'ent') in abstract text about events, probability and philosophy. Members detect 'events'/'event' and probability words. It is silent on 'events' in some everyday-life contexts. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Events/probability in abstract text
