result.description: Fires on varied noun or word-piece tokens (modifications, data, selecting, substitution) in technical academic text, mostly biology and computing, where a modifier precedes a noun. The peaks are scattered and weakly consistent. The evidence is thin.
result.label: Scattered technical nouns in science text

result.description: Weak, scattered attention-layer latent firing on varied mid-word or noun tokens (legal, water, powder, hinder, gases) in expository text. Consistency is low and the circuit failed, so no clear shared trigger; the contrast shows ' legal' silent in some contexts.
result.label: Scattered mid-word/noun tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word endings like -ing, -ation, 's, this, them) in abstract academic-style prose. Peaks are inconsistent, and 's is silent after some nouns. Members are generic and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Scattered suffixes and function words

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (commas, "between", "towards", "and", "all", suffixes) inside abstract academic prose, where the next word continues a noun phrase. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Scattered connectives in academic prose

result.description: Fires on " Korea" (also " Korean") in Korean War text, especially after "North" or "South". Inputs are country and war-topic detectors (Germany, China, Vietnam, Cold War). Silent on a generic Cold War passage without Korea.
result.label: Korea in Korean War context

result.description: Fires on coordinators (and, or, comma, open paren, slash) joining parallel items right after a preposition, as in "within and outside", "in or at", or lists of prepositions. Silent on 'and' joining ordinary clauses or nouns.
result.label: Coordinator after preposition

result.description: Fires mostly on commas (also pronouns like "it/they" and nouns) at clause boundaries in expository text, where a new clause or list item follows. Silent on some commas in similar contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Clause-boundary commas in expository prose

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-latent firing on varied tokens inside math/LaTeX formulas (' y', ' of', '(', exponent, 'ln') and some mid-word pieces. Members are mostly math-term and word-piece detectors; the evidence is mixed and the circuit fails.
result.label: Diffuse math-formula tokens

result.description: Fires on ' the' (also 's, ' of') right after "the product of" in physics/math law statements (e.g. Snell's law: "product of the index of refraction and the sine…"). Silent on 'the' after other verbs or prepositions.
result.label: "the" after "product of"

result.description: Fires on the token right after "cornerstone of" or "fundamental element of" (e.g. ' ', ' the', ' a', word pieces), where a descriptive abstract noun phrase begins. Silent on ' ' after "the" before a decade like 195x.
result.label: Token after "cornerstone/element of"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'avel' in "w|avel|ength" (wavelength), right after the 'w'. Members are mostly detectors of this same 'avel' piece in that word. The contrast text about sound waves stays silent.
result.label: 'avel' inside wavelength

result.description: Diffuse attention-layer latent peaking on varied tokens (' that' after "techniques", ' in', ' time', word pieces) in academic prose. Members are generic token detectors; the evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Diffuse mixed-token academic prose latent

result.description: Fires on ' as' directly after a passive verb of defining, viewing or labeling (defined as, seen as, viewed as, known as, described as). Stays silent on 'such as' and on 'appear as' or 'proved as'.
result.label: ' as' after defined/viewed/seen

result.description: Attention latent firing on varied function words and word pieces (' the', ' and', ' of', ' holds', 'range', ' onto') mid-phrase in abstract expository text; no dominant token, and it stays silent on many ' the' contexts. Evidence is weak and mixed.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on tokens inside the object phrase after "providing valuable/crucial information (or data) for ...", such as the noun, a comma in a list of uses, or "management". Silent on commas in other lists.
result.label: Object of "information for" phrases

result.description: Weak, scattered circuit that peaks on varied tokens (' and', ' that', ' divine', ' rights', ' success', ' brand', ' a') in mid-sentence positions. No clear shared trigger or condition; members are mostly generic token detectors.
result.label: Scattered mid-sentence tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ics' completing "Economics" (Econom|ics), especially in academic topic or heading text. It stays quiet on 'ics' in Ethics and mechanics, and in one lowercase "economics" case.
result.label: Econom-ics word ending

result.description: Fires mostly on "ments" completing "departments" after "across/among/between various/different", in business text about collaboration and communication; silent on "ments" in "measurements". Also weakly on following commas.
result.label: "departments" after across/among

result.description: Fires on function words (of, in, and, with, or) right after the word "theory"/"theories" in academic or philosophical text about science. Stays silent on "of" after other nouns like "nature" or "importance". Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function words after "theory" in academic text

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer latent peaking on varied connective tokens (' or', ' of', ' and', commas) and word pieces mid-phrase in abstract academic text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Diffuse connectives in academic text

result.description: Fires on nouns like "resources", "capabilities", "insights" (and following commas) in business-strategy lists of competitive advantage, e.g. "achieved through unique resources, advanced capabilities". Silent on "resources" in other phrasings. Weak, near-threshold circuit.
result.label: Competitive-advantage resources/capabilities nouns

result.description: Fires on "presence" (and the following "or" in "presence or absence") after a determiner or possessive, as a noun that expects "of". Members detect presence, existence, lack and absence words.
result.label: "presence" (or absence) noun

result.description: Weak, scattered attention-layer latent peaking on varied tokens ('ing', 'ins', ' the', ' and') in several windows near the word "bestow"/"bestowing". Circuit failed faithfulness and members are generic, so the evidence is thin.
result.label: Scattered tokens near "bestow" contexts

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (govern-'ments', 'from', 'individuals', 'user', 'over') in expository passages about shared resources or consumption; no single token dominates and the circuit is diffuse and weak.
result.label: Diffuse mixed-token attention latent

result.description: Fires on the '0' digit in the year "20" + 0 (e.g. 200x, 201x) right after "the early", as in "the early 2000s". It stays silent on '0' in 1960s/1990s years or other numbers.
result.label: '0' in early-2000s year

result.description: Fires on the 'ing' piece of "reflecting", especially as a participial clause after a comma ("..., reflecting not only..."). Silent on 'ing' in other words like transitioning, demanding, impacting, occurring.
result.label: 'ing' in "reflecting"

result.description: Fires on the word or continuation right after the subject "milestone(s)" in project-planning text (ones, represents, are, include, and, -). Members include milestone-token detectors plus stage/step words. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is faithful only partly.
result.label: Tokens following "milestone" subject

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a complementizer introducing a clause after verbs of saying or showing (suggest, indicate, show, contend, posit). It stays silent on relative-clause 'that' and on 'that is'.
result.label: complementizer 'that' after reporting verbs

result.description: Fires mostly on " any" right after "with" (e.g. "with any financial strategy"), and weakly on other words after "with" such as "an", "service" or "ability". It is silent on " any" after other words like "in", "avoid" or "and".
result.label: " any" after "with"

result.description: Fires on the end of "coordinating/subordinating conjunctions" and on "connected by/linked by" in grammar text about joining clauses. It stays silent on "coordinating" in comparison or title contexts, so it seems to need a linking-clauses construction.
result.label: Clause-linking conjunction terms in grammar

result.description: Fires on " Law" in "Zeroth Law" (of Thermodynamics) and nearby thermodynamics words like "equilibrium". It stays silent on "First Law" and "Second Law" of Thermodynamics, so it seems to need the Zeroth Law context.
result.label: Zeroth Law of Thermodynamics

result.description: Fires weakly on ' language' after "for"/"that" (e.g. "for language acquisition") and on hyphens in "word-to-word". Silent on many other ' language' tokens. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' language' and hyphen, linguistics text

result.description: Fires on commas (and 'and') separating items in a list that is the object of "identify", e.g. "identify common themes, seasonality, ...". Silent on commas in similar lists not following an identify-type verb.
result.label: List commas after "identify"

result.description: Fires on function words and connectives (' and', ',', ' involves', 'ines') inside the opening sentence of an academic-style document about a field, such as spatial mapping and computer science. It stays silent on ' and' in other contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Connectives in academic field intros

result.description: Fires on varied connector tokens (and, commas, with, that, like) and word pieces in technical or expository lists about industry, engineering and science. It stays silent on 'and' in environmental lists. The circuit failed and is diffuse.
result.label: Connectors in technical expository lists

result.description: Fires on the word(s) right after "fundamental to" / "essential to" / "key to" (e.g. "the", "a", "investigation", "design"), within sentences saying a concept is fundamental to something. Silent on "the" after other phrases like "akin to" or "linked to".
result.label: Object after "fundamental to"

result.description: Fires on connectors (' and', '-', ',', ' or') joining the first item of a pair or list, such as 'Curie-Weiss' or 'tariff and non-tariff'. Members detect tariffs/trade terms and ' and' after a noun. Fires weakly and inconsistently; contrast shows ' and' often silent.
result.label: Connector after tariff/trade term

result.description: Fires on ' how' as a complement clause introducer after verbs like demonstrate, explore, examine, elucidate ("this section explores how..."). Silent on ' how' in other positions, such as sentence-initial or clause-final.
result.label: ' how' after explore/demonstrate verbs

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'to', 'from', nouns like 'goals', 'application') mid-sentence in technical or academic expository text. It is silent on many commas. Members are mostly generic token detectors, so the pattern is diffuse and weak.
result.label: Diffuse mid-phrase tokens in technical text

result.description: Weak, mixed attention latent firing on varied tokens (commas, 'by', 'into', word-ending pieces) at clause or phrase boundaries in expository prose. It stays silent on commas in some business-text contexts. Evidence is thin; the circuit failed.
result.label: Mixed clause-boundary tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' in', digits, ' growth', ' programs', hyphens) inside academic or technical expository text about history, development and theory. No dominant token or clear condition. Members are mostly generic token detectors.
result.label: Scattered tokens in academic expository text

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (possessive 's, 'the', word pieces) right after verbs like highlight/underscore/emphasize, i.e. inside the object phrase. Silent on 's in other contexts such as contractions. Weak, mixed circuit.
result.label: Object of highlight/underscore verbs

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after "laid/laying the groundwork/foundation" or "setting the stage", where the next words describe future developments. It stays silent on ' for' after other nouns like "avenues" or "principles".
result.label: 'for' after laying the groundwork

result.description: Fires on words like "thesis", "statement" and "evidence" in writing-advice text about essay or paragraph structure (thesis statement, supporting evidence, topic sentence). It stays quiet on "statement" in other uses.
result.label: Essay structure terms: thesis, evidence

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word endings (' for', ' to', ',', 'ies', 'ces') after abstract academic noun phrases. Peaks are mixed and the target is silent on many ' for' cases, so no clear pattern emerges. The circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse academic-text function words

result.description: Fires on varied nouns and function words (' system', ' events', ' are', ' and') in abstract science or economics prose, often after a subject noun phrase. Silent on ' system' used as a modifier in computing text. Evidence is mixed and the logits are unclear.
result.label: Scattered subject nouns in abstract prose

result.description: Fires in the Rachel Carson / "Silent Spring" context, mainly on the opening quote after "Rachel Carson's" and on "son" in Carson. It stays quiet on quotes before other titles, so it is tied to that specific name and book.
result.label: Rachel Carson's Silent Spring

result.description: Fires on words right after "can better" (e.g. "better understand", "better manage their", "better predict environmental"), in the verb or its object, in expository text about people or science. Silent on "understand" without "better".
result.label: Words following "can better"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (-ing suffix, 'the', 'its', ';', 'back', 'to') inside lists or phrases in abstract professional or technical expository text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weak; members are mostly word-piece detectors.
result.label: Scattered tokens in technical lists

result.description: Fires on the 'ation' suffix at the end of "recombination" in genetics text, where earlier pieces 'recom'/'bin' and genetic context are present. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words such as mutation or speciation.
result.label: 'ation' in recombination

result.description: Fires on the "ms" piece completing "fir|ms" (firms) in economics text about markets and competition. It stays silent when "ms" starts a sentence or follows a period, with no "fir" before it.
result.label: "ms" ending "firms"

result.description: Fires on commas (and 'and'/'or') separating items in a list of parallel abstract nouns, e.g. "economic prosperity, political dissent, environmental factors". Silent on commas that end a clause or introduce a "which" clause.
result.label: Comma in lists of abstract factors

result.description: Weak, mixed attention-layer target peaking mostly on 'tons' in "protons" (also commas, 'ized', ' output'). It stays silent on 'protons' in one similar contrast text. Members are generic token detectors; the circuit failed to reproduce it.
result.label: Protons 'tons' piece, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the space, period or bold marker right before or after a number in a numbered list (e.g. "9." or "¶ 10."), where a new item begins. It stays quiet on some similar list-number spaces, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Numbered list item boundary

result.description: Fires on tokens right after "consist(ing) of", "made up of", "comprises" (a, one, either, several, or word pieces of the composition noun), where a list of constituents is about to follow. Silent on "a" after "serves as" or "is".
result.label: Composition "consisting of" constituents slot

result.description: Fires on ' this', sentence-ending periods, quotes and ' while' at clause or sentence boundaries, often where a new sentence starts after a period (e.g. "service. this time"). Evidence is weak and mixed; members are generic word-piece detectors.
result.label: Sentence-boundary ' this' and connectives

result.description: Fires on the object noun (or word after it) following "keeping" in "keeping X intact/constant", e.g. "keeping the country's core values". Silent on "values" after "upholding" or in brand-value text. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Object noun after "keeping"

result.description: Weak, mixed target firing on varied tokens, often a modifier or noun in a technical noun phrase (agents, performance, pipeline, impact) or a word piece mid-word. Peaks are inconsistent; the circuit is a poor fit.
result.label: Scattered technical noun-phrase tokens

result.description: Fires on " analysis" right after "sentiment" (sentiment analysis), and weakly on related NLP/analytics terms. It stays silent on "analysis" after other words like data, market, predictive or audience composition.
result.label: "analysis" in "sentiment analysis"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens inside lists of abstract nouns or topics (e.g. "simplicity", "and", "as", commas) in essay-like prose. It marks list positions where another noun or concept follows. Evidence is thin and mixed; the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: List items in abstract-noun lists

result.description: Fires weakly on varied tokens, often word-ending pieces or noun heads such as 's' in decades, ' statement', 'or' in semiconductor, and subscripts. The circuit is diffuse with no discriminative members, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Diffuse mixed word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on tokens inside the list or noun phrase after "is especially true for ..." (e.g. "verbal", "poems", "scenarios", "technologies", list commas). It marks the scope of an emphasized category. The contrast shows commas in ordinary lists staying silent.
result.label: Scope noun phrase after "especially true for"

result.description: Attention-based target firing on scattered tokens (' and', ' name', ' names', ' is', word endings) in text about grammar, names and language. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness, so the trigger is not clear.
result.label: Scattered tokens in grammar/names text

result.description: Attention-layer target firing on scattered function words (' by', ' to', ' and', ' of') and occasional content words in expository text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is a weak, diffuse set of generic token-level members, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Diffuse function-word attention latent

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Pan' at the start of a word, mainly the beginning of Panthera/Panther (also Pan-Slavism, Pan–African), before the rest of the word is completed. Members detect Pan/pan pieces and Felidae context.
result.label: ' Pan' word-start piece (Panthera)

result.description: Fires on function words (' a', ' was', ' the', ' particularly') right after a sentence-opening "It was" near the start of a document, in descriptive or historical prose. Silent on ' a' after "was" mid-sentence, with other subjects.
result.label: Early "It was a" function words

result.description: Fires on tokens right after the word "function" in mathematical text (function's, function behave/to/at), in calculus discussions of functions and differentiability. Silent on apostrophes after other nouns.
result.label: Token after "function" in calculus

result.description: Fires on the word right after the noun phrase "there are many challenges" (mostly " to", also "that", "with", "continue"), at the start of a document. Silent on " to" in other uses, such as "lead to" or "resistance to".
result.label: Word after "many challenges"

result.description: Fires on the token ' inform' (inform, informs, informative, informal) as a word start. Members are mostly detectors of ' inform' at earlier layers. Silent on the similar word 'information'.
result.label: ' inform' token detector

result.description: Fires on tokens inside VPN/network-security text: pieces of "VPN" (V, PN) and nearby words like secure, online, remote that precede or describe VPN use. Silent on plain 's' suffixes elsewhere. Circuit is mixed and weak.
result.label: VPN and secure-network context

result.description: Fires on ' anger' when it is the first item right after "emotions like" in a list. It stays silent when ' anger' comes later in a list, after "or", "and" or commas. Members are mostly generic and weak, and the circuit failed.
result.label: ' anger' directly after "emotions like"

result.description: Weak, mixed layer-5 attention latent peaking on scattered tokens (a space before numbers, ' customer', ' or', hyphen, closing paren) in technical text. No consistent token or context; members are generic low-specificity token detectors.
result.label: Scattered tokens, unclear (failed circuit)

result.description: Diffuse attention-layer latent peaking on mixed tokens (' and', ' of', ',', ' rise') in economics and science expository text. Peaks are inconsistent, members are generic, and the circuit failed, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Diffuse function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on the 'co' piece in "roller|co|aster" (and nearby pieces after "roll"), i.e. the middle of the word "rollercoaster". Silent on 'co' in other words like "eco-friendly" or "recovers". Circuit members include roll- detectors.
result.label: 'co' inside rollercoaster

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention latent firing on varied tokens in list-like or coordinated academic text: commas, 'and', 'or', and word-piece fragments inside list items. It is silent on commas that follow a clause. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: List-item continuation tokens in academic text

result.description: Fires on varied words (basic, autom-, future, areas, tasks) in robotics/technology-history text describing early or foundational developments. It is silent on 'basic' in other computing contexts. The evidence is mixed and the circuit fit was poor.
result.label: Robotics history foundational/basic words

result.description: Fires on punctuation or words (comma, "sources", "into", "(") right after "renewable energy sources" in sustainability and energy-strategy text. Silent on commas in other energy or technology contexts. Members detect "renewable", "sources", solar/wind power and recycling.
result.label: After renewable energy sources phrase

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in lists or technical noun phrases: slashes in codes, word pieces, ' units', ' gas', or an opening parenthesis. It seems to predict a continuation noun like 'investigation'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Mixed list and technical-term tokens

result.description: Fires on a noun ending a technical compound noun phrase (e.g. "frequency reuse", "design methods", "body composition"), and on the following ' (' or ' and'. Silent on ' (' after some nouns. Evidence is weak and mixed.
result.label: Compound technical noun phrase endings

result.description: Fires on the word right after "The maintenance of" at the start of a document (e.g. 's, -ural, faithful, gen-), the slot where the object of "maintenance of" begins. It stays silent on "of the" in mid-text contexts.
result.label: Word after "The maintenance of"

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in lists and mid-phrase positions (' that', ',', word pieces like 'ance', ' to') in abstract policy, economics and business prose. The peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse, so the target is unclear.
result.label: Diffuse mixed tokens in expository lists

result.description: Fires on ' almost', most strongly in "an almost [adjective/noun]" phrases (an almost endless array, an almost surgical precision). Members are mostly detectors of ' almost' and similar degree adverbs like essentially, truly.
result.label: ' almost' after 'an'

result.description: Fires mainly on " though" in "even though" (concessive clause openers), with members detecting although/despite/while/even-if. Silent on "as though". Minor peaks on unrelated tokens like " Marshall" and " time".
result.label: "even though" concessive connective

result.description: Fires on the token "over"/"Over" when it is a prefix at the start of a compound word (overfitting, overlay, overlap, overview, overclocking), predicting a word continuation. Silent in "overfatigue" in the contrast.
result.label: "over" as word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on ' up' right after speed/speeding/speeds (speed up a process). Stays silent on ' up' in other phrasal verbs like 'open up' or 'showing up'. Members detect ' up' plus speed-related words.
result.label: 'speed up' particle

result.description: Fires on ' you', ' readers' or ' us' as the object right after 'take/takes/taken' (e.g. "takes you on a journey"). It stays silent on 'you' in other slots, such as subject 'you're' or after 'help'.
result.label: Object pronoun after 'takes'

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'roc' (atrocities), 'Param' (non-parametric), ' Lap' and 'of' in hyphenated "Out-of-", with no shared meaning. Peaks are scattered word fragments; the evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered mid-word fragments (roc, Param)

result.description: Fires on ' is' after a gerund-like subject noun phrase such as "understanding these differences is", where a predicate like "crucial/essential" follows. Silent on ' is' after simple subjects like "It" or "the goal".
result.label: ' is' after plural abstract subject

result.description: Fires on the piece 'etic' completing the word "synthetic" (synth|etic). It stays silent on 'etic' in "genetic" and "th|etic", so it needs the preceding "synth" piece.
result.label: 'etic' in "synthetic"

result.description: Fires on the token ' norm' (as in "social norms", "cultural norms") when it follows a modifier like social, cultural or gender. It was silent on "these norms", so it seems to need a preceding modifier noun.
result.label: ' norm' after social/cultural modifier

result.description: Fires on the ' (' that opens an enumerated item number like "(1)" or "(2)", after a colon or semicolon in a list of points. It stays silent on ' (' that opens an explanatory aside such as "(such as ...)".
result.label: Open paren of numbered list item

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in technical or academic lists and noun phrases (commas in lists, 'ten' in molten, 'ver' in cantilever). Peaks are mixed and silent on many commas. Logits hint at research/scientific words. Evidence is weak.
result.label: Mixed technical list tokens

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of multi-token technical or academic words (lip-, Fin-, Cir-, endocr-), mostly in list-like or scientific text, where the word is still incomplete. Mixed evidence; weak circuit.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments in technical terms

result.description: Fires on the plural nouns " measurements" or " observations" when they follow a qualifying modifier such as satellite, geodetic, in-situ or angular, in scientific or geodesy text. It is silent when the word starts the text.
result.label: measurements/observations after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expl' (start of explore/exploration/explorers), strongest after "space" in "space exploration". Silent when ' expl' begins a sentence or follows no preceding noun, as in "exploring these norm…".
result.label: ' expl' piece mid-phrase

result.description: Fires on the word piece " insert" when it is the start of "insertion(s)", mostly in data-structure text (trees, search, insertion and deletion). Predicts suffixes like "ion". Members are detectors of insert/Insertion.
result.label: "insert" stem before -ion

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lications" in "implications" (after "imp"), including capitalized forms. Members detect "lications" and related words like "consequences" and "effects". Weaker on "health implications".
result.label: "lications" in "implications"

result.description: Fires on "understanding" (also "understand", "explaining") right after "for", "to" or "by" in academic or scientific text. It predicts a following "how" or "why" clause. It stays quiet when "understanding" follows an adjective such as "comprehensive".
result.label: understanding after 'for/to' in science

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ital' in 'orbital' (Orb|ital), mostly in physics or astronomy text on orbital mechanics and elements. Weakly fires on 'ital' in other words like capitalist.
result.label: 'ital' in orbital

result.description: Fires on " of" in the phrase "part of" (especially "As part of" at the start of a text). It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "core", "world", "use" or "thoughts".
result.label: "of" in "part of"

result.description: Fires on the token ' revolution' (also 'Revolution') in all contexts, such as "Agricultural Revolution" or "revolutionized", and predicts suffixes like -ize/-ary. Silent on synonyms like 'innovation'.
result.label: ' revolution' token detector

result.description: Fires on the beginning-of-document token at the very start of a text. It is silent on the same token when it appears mid-text after a preceding passage. Members are mostly diffuse, unrelated token detectors.
result.label: Document-start token

result.description: Fires on the word "address" (Address, addresses, address-ing), often in IP/network contexts, and also on the hyphen in "trade-" (trade-offs, trade-related). Weakly on "street" and "function" as a first word of a compound. Mixed triggers.
result.label: address word and trade- hyphen

result.description: Fires on " get" and on degree adverbs like " entirely"/" completely", mostly after a negation or auxiliary ("not entirely", "don't get"). Members detect get-forms, entirely, and partly/-ly adverbs.
result.label: get / entirely after negation

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' descri' (start of "descriptions") in writing-craft text, after adjectives like "physical", "rich" or "brief". It is weak on other split-word starts such as ' spec'. It predicts continuation pieces like "ptions".
result.label: ' descri' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on incomplete word pieces that precede a suffix: ' chem' (before -istry), 'chn' (in Geotechnical), and 'ad' in 'Leadership'. Each is a mid-word fragment expecting a completion.

Fires on the word " sample" (also "Sample") used as a modifier before a noun, as in "sample loading", "sample mean", "sample preparation". It is found in analytical chemistry and statistics text. Weak side activation on "ci" in "glaciers".
result.label: ' sample' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the verb "indicate" (indicates/indicating) when a sign, gesture, or value is said to signal a meaning. Weaker on similar verbs like suggest and imply. Members detect indicate, suggest, show and represent.
result.label: verb "indicate" signaling meaning
'amin' word piece (Lamin-ar, Vitamin)
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'amin' inside words like "Laminar" (and Vitamin), a mid-word fragment where the word continues. Mostly specific to this piece; weak activation elsewhere on other word-start fragments.
Fires on the word piece "rim" in "discrimination" (a split-word fragment, mostly in economics and social text), predicting a continuation like "ination". Also fires weakly on 'rim' in "shrimp".
result.label: "rim" in discrimination
' mot' as start of motif/motet
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mot' when it begins a word like motif or motète, in music and art contexts. It is silent when 'mot' starts the text, as in the document-initial 'motets'. It pushes toward 'if' and 'ifs' next.

Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words that are split into pieces, mainly ' Est' (Estate, Estimation), ' manip' (manipulation), and ' saf'. It predicts a suffix continuation such as 'rage' or 'ates'. Members are mostly detectors of other word-start pieces.
result.label: Word-start fragment before suffix (Est, manip)

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces, mostly 'age' in 'signage' (also 'wage', 'phage') and 'tons' in 'protons', after a word-start fragment. Silent when 'age' starts the text. Members detect 'sign-' stems and 'age' pieces.
result.label: '-age' suffix after word stem

result.description: Fires on the digit '4' as a standalone section number right after a document-start markdown heading ("### 4."). Silent on '4' inside longer numbers like years or two-digit numbers such as 14.
result.label: Section number 4 at heading start

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " anticip" (anticipation/anticipatory), and weakly on other mid-word pieces like "ize" in prioritize and "ities". Seems to need the piece inside a longer word being built, with the next token likely a suffix.
result.label: anticip- word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the 'ing' suffix of "laying" (as in "laying the groundwork/foundation"). It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs such as altering, mastering or modeling. Members detect lay/laid.
result.label: 'ing' in "laying" (groundwork)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lingu" (and "ingu" after "L" or "ethnol") at the start of linguist/linguistics/linguistic, predicting suffixes like -istic/-istics. Silent on some occurrences after words like "computational" or "cognitive", where the preceding context differs.
result.label: lingu- piece of linguistics

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings such as 'eters' in "kilometers" (before a parenthetical conversion) and on 'x' inside words like dioxide or in function notation u(x). Appears tied to unit and measurement words and chemical-word pieces.
result.label: Unit 'eters' and 'x' word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'yg' inside words like hygiene and polygon (and occasionally 'est' in pedestrian). Members are mostly 'yg' token detectors. Silent on hygiene-related text lacking the 'yg' piece.
result.label: 'yg' piece in hygiene/polygon

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' hier' (hieroglyphs, hierarchy) and sometimes ' semi' (semiotics), a word piece that is continued by a following suffix. Members are detectors of hier-, mon-, mult-, travers- and similar prefixes.
result.label: hier- / semi- word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly function words or mid-phrase positions (' an', ',', 'iti', ' respond') where a noun or object is expected next. Peaks are inconsistent, and the circuit is diffuse with no clear shared meaning.
result.label: Diffuse mid-phrase function-word positions
' matter' as physical substance
result.description: Fires on the token ' matter' when it means physical substance in physics text (properties of matter, dark matter, light interacting with matter). Silent on other uses such as the verb or 'subject matter'. Members are mostly ' matter' token detectors.
Fires mid-word on the 'a' in "Versailles" (and similar mid-word pieces), and on the hyphen in "Event-driven". Seems to mark an unfinished word or compound where a specific continuation follows.
result.label: Mid-word 'a' in Versailles
Word-start fragments in long words
result.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into several tokens, such as Rel(ationship), Govern(ance), Inst(rumental), Str-ateg-ic, voc(abulary). It mostly appears in title-like or technical text and expects the rest of the word to follow.

Fires on ' which' used as a relative pronoun directly after a bare noun (no comma), as in "Leadership which controls...", predicting a verb. It is weaker after a comma and silent in some comma-preceded cases.
result.label: Relative 'which' after bare noun

result.description: Fires on the 's' of contracted "it's" / "there's" (is-contraction) at the start of a clause, often before "not" or "a". Stays silent on possessive 's (land's, people's) and plural s.
result.label: 's contraction of "is" (it's/there's)

result.description: Fires on the adjective " historical" (also "historic", occasionally "past") when it modifies a following noun like data, analysis, trends or practices. It stays quiet in some contexts, such as "limited historical documentation", where the word follows an evidence-scarcity phrase.
result.label: adjective "historical" before noun

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments in linguistics/classification terms (typ-ologies, Ind-o, proto-, logographic, descri-), where a longer word is being built. Silent on 'o' in unrelated words like espresso or eloquent.
result.label: Linguistic/typology word fragments

result.description: Fires on the verbs "provides/offers/provide/offer" when an inanimate or abstract subject (a section, a method, a concept) is about to supply something like insight, an introduction or information. It is silent when the verb appears at the very start of a text with no subject.
result.label: provides/offers after abstract subject

result.description: Fires on the word "energy"/"Energy", most strongly after "dark" in cosmology/physics text. Silent on "energy" in "mass and energy". Members detect energy, dark matter and physics terms.
result.label: Energy after "dark" (physics)

result.description: Fires on ' of' after nouns of durability or condition such as longevity, integrity, lifespan, performance, reliability, where an object or system follows. Silent on ' of' after selection, combination, use or signs.
result.label: ' of' after longevity/integrity nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lex' inside "reflexive" (ref|lex|ive), mostly in grammar text about reflexive pronouns. Silent when 'lex' starts the text without the 'ref' prefix.
result.label: 'lex' in "reflexive"

result.description: Fires on the verb "send" and especially "sending" (also "sender" pieces) in text about communication and transmitting messages or alerts. Weak firing on "neurons". Members are detectors of send/message/transmit words.
result.label: "send/sending" in communication text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' rev' when it begins a word like revitalization, revival or revive, predicting the continuation (ital/ival). Silent when ' rev' is the very first token of the document.
result.label: ' rev' start of revival/revitalize

result.description: Fires mainly on " settled" in "transition from nomadic hunter-gatherers to settled agriculture", in prehistory/early-civilization text. Silent on "groups settled into", the verb use. Members detect primitive/ancient-civilization words.
result.label: "to settled" in nomadic-to-agrarian transitions

result.description: Fires on the article ' a'/' an' right after a verb like "saw", "experienced", "witnessed", "characterized by", "resulted in", where a noun for a change or period is expected. Silent after commas, prepositions like "within", or "As a result".
result.label: Article 'a' after experienced/witnessed verbs

result.description: Fires on visual-art technique terms like "shadow", "shading", "value" (tonal) in painting/drawing text about light, depth and texture. Silent on generic creative-arts prose without such technique words.
result.label: Art technique: shadow, shading, value

result.description: Fires on the articles ' a' / ' an' after a verb like offering, form, maintain, represent, provide or play, in abstract academic prose, where a noun such as "form", "level" or "role" is expected. Silent on 'a' after "known as" or "by".
result.label: Article 'a/an' after abstract verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece "rib" at the start of a longer word (ribosome, ribonucleic, Attributable), and weakly on " speak". Members detect rib/chrom and molecular-biology word pieces.
result.label: "rib" word-piece (ribosome, attributable)

result.description: Fires on the word " current" used as an adjective before a noun (current assets, current affairs, current situation), also weakly on "latest". Predicts nouns like affairs or district. Silent on text without that word.
result.label: adjective "current" before noun

result.description: Fires on ' time' (and 'spacetime', ' space') when it is the physical dimension in relativity/physics text, e.g. "space and time coordinates", "time dilation". Silent on idiomatic "over time" or a sentence-initial "time".
result.label: Physics 'time' in relativity

result.description: Fires on " in" after a negated or absent-from phrase like "not found in", "not visible in", "not reflected in", where it introduces the place or context where something is missing. Silent on other uses of " in".
result.label: " in" after "not found/reflected"

result.description: Fires on the token ' stack', mostly in computing text (stack pointer, stack overflow, stack allocation, stack data structures). It stays silent on the non-computing sense, a cluttered pile of items. Members detect ' stack' and related memory/thread terms.
result.label: ' stack' in computing contexts

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " chem" (or " Chem") that begins chemistry, chemical or chemometrics, and predicts a continuation such as "istry". Members detect "chem" and similar science word starts. It is silent on one "chem" at the start of a document.
result.label: chem- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start fragments, mostly ' lear' (as in learner), also 'elf' in welfare and ' pa', where the next piece completes the word. Logits favor word-continuation pieces like 'pt', 'ide', 'iver'.
result.label: Mid-word fragment ' lear' (learner)

result.description: Fires on the token " heap" in computer-science text about heap data structures (binary heap, heapify, heap sort, priority queues). Members are heap detectors plus data-structure context such as array, tree and priority queue.
result.label: ' heap' in data structures

result.description: Fires on the middle piece 'or' (also 'it', 'u') inside a split-up word such as euph-or-ic, serendip-it-ous or rhet-or-ic, where the word is still unfinished. It stays quiet on 'or' in other words like absorbed or sonorities.
result.label: Mid-word 'or' in euphoric/rhetoric

result.description: Fires on the token " standard"/" Standard" (also "standards"), mainly in statistics terms like "standard deviation" or "standard error" and before "-ization". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: "standard" word detector

result.description: Fires on the word ' in' when it follows a noun, name or phrase and begins a locative or topical prepositional phrase (e.g. "Sartre in Germany", "anyone in"). It stays silent on 'in' inside verb phrases such as "tune in", "steeped in" and "results in".
result.label: ' in' after noun, as preposition

result.description: Fires on " in" right after an adjective (simple, unique, microscopic, fundamental) where "in" introduces a respect, as in "simple in form" or "microscopic in nature". It stays silent on locative or other uses of "in".
result.label: "in" after adjective, specifying respect

result.description: Fires mostly on " little" after an article or determiner (a little, that little, own little), and also on " behind" and word pieces like "ro" in "nitrogen". Members detect quantity words like little, much, less, no, some.
result.label: Quantifier 'little' and 'behind'

result.description: Fires on participle or conjunction words that precede an "as"-type complement, mainly "viewed" (as), also "presented", "served", "though/if" after "as". Mixed, weak consistency; members mostly detect "viewed/identified" past participles.
result.label: Viewed/identified "as" framing

result.description: Fires on a bare space token before a number (e.g. after a paragraph break or comma) and on apostrophes before "s/t/re". Silent on spaces after markdown headings. Mixed evidence; circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Space before digits, apostrophe contractions

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' dep' (and ' Cart'/' cart') when it begins a verb like "depict" in cartography/map text, e.g. "to dep|ict". It stays silent on "depiction" after "accurate". Members detect dep/cart/fr pieces predicting "ict".
result.label: "dep" before "-ict" in map text

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' more', ' thread', word fragments like 'l', 'Ind', 'ited') mid-phrase where a continuation or word completion is expected. Peak tokens are inconsistent and the circuit fails faithfulness, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered mid-phrase tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' man' when it starts "manager(s)" (e.g. "project man|agers"), and weakly on a few other word-start pieces like 'pt' in "Adaptability". Silent on ' man' before "aging".
result.label: ' man' as start of "managers"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' spe' at the start of a word, mostly in "speciation" (also "speeds"), where it predicts a continuation like "ci". Members are mostly ' spe' token detectors.
result.label: ' spe' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word " storage" itself, in food handling and data/computing contexts alike, usually as a noun modifier before words like conditions, techniques or systems. Members are mostly storage/memory token detectors.
result.label: ' storage' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'igen' inside longer words such as Eigenvalues, indigenous, epigenetic, antigenic and terrigenous. It is silent when 'igen' starts the text with no preceding piece, so it needs a preceding word piece.
result.label: 'igen' word piece
'ade' piece in "inadequate"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ade' in split words, most strongly in "inadequate" (in|ade|quate). Members are 'ade' detectors that push toward "qua". It is silent on unrelated text.
Fires on the word piece 'ump' in words like pumping, pump, pumpkin and trumpet, typically right after 'p' or 'tr'. It weakly fires on 'iv' in 'captivating'. Members are 'ump' detectors.
result.label: 'ump' word piece (pump, trumpet)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' trans' when it begins a longer word such as transitions, transcends, transcription or transpose. It stays silent on 'transparency' at the start of a document. Logits favour continuations like 'c' and 'itions'.
result.label: ' trans' prefix mid-text

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ell' when it is the second token of "Stellar" (St+ell+ar), especially at the start of a document or heading. It is silent when 'ell' appears as a bare "ellar" without the "St" before it.
result.label: 'ell' in "Stellar"

result.description: Fires on the comma after an adjective or noun that begins a list of parallel abstract items (social, economic, technological). It stays quiet on commas after a single noun or clause boundary, not in a list.
result.label: Comma in adjective/noun lists

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens like 'ada' (Dada, adaptation) and 'trans' in 'neurotransmitter', plus occasionally ' the'. Members detect 'ada' and other mid-word pieces. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: 'ada' and 'trans' word fragments

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that are incomplete and need a continuation, mainly ' dialog' (before 'ue') and ' Aust' (before 'ronesian'/'ralia'-like pieces). It predicts suffix pieces, not whole words.
result.label: Dialog / Aust word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the pronoun ' you' (rarely ' we') directly after the conditional 'if'. It stays silent on 'you' after 'when', 'how', 'that' or at sentence start.
result.label: ' you' right after 'if'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ins' in "insights", right after "provide/provides/providing (new/valuable)". Members are mostly ' ins' detectors (insurance, inscribed too), and the target is silent on other uses.
result.label: ' ins' in "provide insights"

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' secre' (as in "secrets"), mid-word before its continuation, with a minor peak on 'ational' in "rotational". Members are detectors of incomplete word-start pieces like ' san', ' seg', ' prepar'.
result.label: ' secre' word-fragment detector

result.description: Fires on ' limited' (also 'restricted', 'confined') right after a negation, as in "is not limited to", where a "not limited to..." construction is expected. Weaker for "but not limited to" and "mostly restricted to".
result.label: "not limited to" negated limitation

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe (straight or curly) in contractions after a pronoun or auxiliary, like it’s, they'll, don’t, before an s/ll/t suffix. Silent on quote-marks and possessives or a leading apostrophe.
result.label: Contraction apostrophe (it’s, don’t)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'oga' completing the word "Yoga", mostly in texts about Hindu philosophy and the paths of yoga (Jnana, Karma, Bhakti). Members detect 'oga' and related Sanskrit/religious word pieces.
result.label: 'oga' in Yoga

result.description: Fires on ' the' and ' of' right after a "by"/"at" time-phrase such as "by the early…", "by the end of", "at the same time". It stays silent on ' the' in other prepositional or verb contexts.
result.label: 'the/of' in "by the end of" phrases

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'scop' in micro-/macro-/mesoscopic and microscope words, where the next piece is typically 'ic' or 'es'. Weakly fires on 'ical'/'ics' in optics words.
result.label: 'scop' piece in microscopic/microscope

result.description: Fires on the word " equivalent" in the construction "the [field-adjective] equivalent of X" (e.g. "the rotational equivalent of force"). It fires weakly on " similar" in comparison phrases. Members detect equivalent/similar/equal words.
result.label: " equivalent" in analogy phrases
Sentence-initial concessive "While"
result.description: Fires on concessive connectives like " While" or " Although" that begin a sentence, right after a period or at document start. Weaker on "Even though" and "Despite". Silent on mid-sentence temporal "while".

Fires on the word piece ' ret' at the start of a word, most often in "retail/retailers" (online retail) and also "retention" or "retina". Members are mostly ' ret' token detectors. The word continuation is not predicted.
result.label: ' ret' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on subject pronouns ' they' or ' it' that start a subordinate clause after a conjunction like "that", "because", or "as", where a verb comes next. It stays silent after "how" in some contexts.
result.label: Clause-initial 'they'/'it' after conjunction

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' hyper' when it begins a word like hyperbole or hyperbolic, mostly in literary or rhetorical text. Upstream members are mainly ' hyper' token detectors plus other word-start piece detectors.
result.label: ' hyper' prefix (hyperbole)

result.description: Fires on the word " space" (and "spaces") as a mathematical noun, such as topological space, vector space or null space. It stays quiet on the non-mathematical "space between points".
result.label: Mathematical 'space' token

result.description: Fires on the token 'a' when it is a word-internal or isolated letter piece, such as in qu-a-estiones, Darya, salsa, auct-a, or a math variable, not on the ordinary article. Often predicts word continuations.
result.label: Word-internal or symbolic 'a' piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ism" ending philosophy-style isms in list-like headings (Physicalism, Subjectivism, Dualism). It stays quiet on "Symbolism" in literary or art contexts.
result.label: -ism suffix in philosophy terms

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' bos' in "boson" (W/Z/Higgs bosons) in particle physics text, and more weakly on 'an' in "Financial". It is a mid-word piece that expects a completing suffix.
result.label: ' bos' piece of boson

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside technical words, mainly 'amp' in "damping", 'och' in "mitochondrial", and ' trib' in "tribology". Members are detectors of these specific pieces. Weak, mixed elsewhere.
result.label: Technical word fragments: damp, mitoch, trib

result.description: Fires on the word " due" when it introduces a cause, as in "largely due to" or "mostly due", often after a hedging adverb or a noun. Members are mostly " due" detectors, plus "owing"/"related" and " to"-predicting features.
result.label: causal "due" (due to)

result.description: Fires on compass direction words, mainly ' south' and ' north', especially within lists of cardinal directions (north, northeast, east, southeast, south...) or magnetic pole discussion. Members detect direction tokens.
result.label: Compass direction words in lists
Mid-word fragments in long words
result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of rare multi-piece words, such as 'ar' in camaraderie, 'bi' in symbiotic and 'e' in coevolution. It stays silent on 'bi' when the word starts the text or follows 'non-'.

Fires on ' on' right after "depends"/"depending" (also "depend upon"), where a factor or condition is about to be named. Silent on 'on' after other words like "relies", "dependence", "savings", "impact".
result.label: 'on' after depend/depending

result.description: Fires mostly on commas inside lists of items (e.g. "architecture, engineering," or "can, could, may, might,"), where another list item follows. It is silent on commas that start a clause, such as ", which" or ", while".
result.label: Comma within item lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments that start or continue a longer word, mainly "illing" in "drilling" and " abs" before "orb/urd", plus pieces like "h" in Aryabhata. Mixed fragments; the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Word-fragment: drilling, abs-, Aryabhata

result.description: Fires on the word piece "iene" completing "hygiene" (after "yg"/"hyg"). Weak activation on other cleanliness word endings like "cleaning" and "sanitation". Members are detectors of "iene" and similar word-final pieces.
result.label: "iene" in hygiene

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' en' when it begins a longer word, most strongly in 'enzyme', and more weakly in 'enhanced' or 'endemic'. It is silent on ' en' in 'encompassed'.
result.label: ' en' start of enzyme

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments mid-word, mainly 'ain' in "porcelain" and 'person' in "interpersonal", where a suffix like -al follows. Silent on 'personal' as a whole word.
result.label: Mid-word 'ain'/'person' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " Food" (also " food") when it starts a heading or topic line in a list of course or topic titles like "Food and Identity". Weakly fires on a few unrelated word pieces.
result.label: Food in topic headings

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'ord' inside "primordial" (also "Chord", "Ford", "chordate"), with weaker firing on ' of' and 'ained'. Members are mostly 'ord' detectors in early layers.
result.label: 'ord' in primordial

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments mid-word, mainly ' Scient' in "Scientific Revolution" and 'l' inside split words (bott-l-enecks, over-l-ays), where the word is incomplete. Silent on 'l' in other words. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, Scient(ific) and l

result.description: Fires on the token " radical", mainly in chemistry text about free radicals and radical polymerization. Members are mostly detectors of " radical" itself. Weak activation on words like "joint" and "avant".
result.label: ' radical' in chemistry text

result.description: Fires on the final piece of certain multi-token terms, such as "to" in "Pareto", " inheritance" after biological or genetic words, and "IC" in "BIC". It is silent on "to" inside names like Ptolemy and McClintock.
result.label: Word-final pieces: Pareto, inheritance, BIC

result.description: Fires on the verb "refer"/"refers" when a term or concept is being defined, as in "X refers to…". Members detect refer-like words and pieces (refers, correspond, pertain) and definitional context.
result.label: "refers to" in definitions

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside attentiveness/awareness adjectives and similar words (vig-il-ant, non-ver-bal, cogniz-ant, una-ware), but stays silent on 'ful' in words like meaningful, respectful, thoughtful. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of vigilant/verbal/cognizant

result.description: Fires on the word " tool" (also " tools", occasionally "software" or "instrument") when it is used as a noun after an adjective like "essential", "powerful" or "perfect", describing something as a useful tool. Members include tool and -kit detectors.
result.label: "tool" as a noun

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in passages about industrialization, mechanization and technological revolution (e.g. 'mechan', 'revolutionized', 'techniques', possessive apostrophes). Silent on 'ization' in urbanization/globalization/quantization contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Industrial revolution/mechanization transformation words
"ions" in "emotions"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ions" when it completes the word "emotions" (emot|ions). It stays silent on "ions" in other words such as "discussions". Members detect the emot- stem and related emotion words.

Fires on mid-name word pieces (' Gar', ' God', 'cia', ' Dr') inside lists of person names, one per line, e.g. "Dr. Garcia". Peaks are scattered and weak, so the pattern is mixed. Silent on lists of famous full names.
result.label: Name pieces in Dr. name lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' strateg' (start of strategy/strategies/strategic) when it follows a preceding noun or verb mid-sentence, e.g. "content strateg", "apply strateg". Silent at document start and in some "strategic" phrases after an adjective or preposition.
result.label: ' strateg' word piece after noun/verb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ch' in "crochet" and on 'R' in the acronym "HR"/"HRM", i.e. mid-word pieces of a longer term. It stays silent on 'ch' in "tech" or "changing".
result.label: 'ch' in crochet, 'R' in HR

result.description: Fires on the token " grid" when it follows a modifier or determiner inside a phrase (such grid, appropriate grid, smart grid). It stays silent when " grid" starts the text. Occasional weak hits on "s" in "let's".
result.label: " grid" mid-phrase

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'igen' inside a word, mainly in "indigenous" (also antigen, Eigenvalues). It stays silent when 'igen' starts a fresh word after a period, with no preceding word piece.
result.label: 'igen' piece in indigenous
' Per' before 'fect' in headings
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Per' when it starts "Perfect", especially in grammar-tense headings like "Past Perfect" or "Future Perfect". It also fires on ' Per' in "Perfect Information". It is silent when the word is not split into Per-fect.

result.label: 'iar' in chiaroscuro words
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iar' in 'ch-iar-' words (chiaro, chiaroscuro, chiarocoral). Members are detectors of 'iar' and other mid-word pieces after 'ch'. It is silent on other art-history text that lacks this piece.

Fires on the word piece "part" (or "Part") when it begins a longer word such as particle, partial or particular, as in "Wave-part|icle" or "# Part|ial". Predicts continuations like "icle", "icular" and "icip".
result.label: "part" as start of particle/partial

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces 'ural' and 'arian' completing "agricultural"/"agrarian" (also vegetarian-type endings), mostly in discussions of agrarian societies and the shift from hunter-gatherer to settled farming.
result.label: agricultural/agrarian suffix piece

result.description: Fires on degree adverbs like " greatly" and " significantly" right after a modal such as "can" or after a verb or "that", before verbs like enhance, improve or reduce. Weakly fires on " necess" in "necessitating".
result.label: Degree adverbs before change verbs

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'cub' in cubic, 'ist', 'ap', 'ical', 'ic', 'trib', where a word is unfinished and likely to continue with a suffix. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low; the circuit is weak and mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragment pieces (ist, ap, ical)

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: ' <' starting HTML-like tags after a document start, ' contributions', ' information', and mid-word pieces like 'tra', 'ity', 'isse'. No single token or context dominates; the circuit looks diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: Diffuse mixed tokens, ' <' and word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' up' in the phrasal verb "open up" (opens/opened/opening up), right before an object like "new opportunities" or "doors". It stays silent when 'up' is a word piece, as in "shape upcoming".
result.label: 'up' in "open up" opportunities

result.description: Fires mainly on ' compress' (as in compressive/compressible) in engineering and materials text, with weaker firing on word pieces like 'or', 'ator', 'ents' in technical words. Members detect compress-, load, material and structural terms.
result.label: compress- in engineering text

result.description: Fires on the token ' cook' in cooking text, especially as a noun-like piece in "home cooks" or "pressure cookers". It stays silent on many other ' cook' tokens, e.g. "cooked" and "cooking" after a colon or adjective. The exact condition is unclear.
result.label: ' cook' in cooking-related text

result.description: Fires mainly on " thermal" as a modifier before a noun (thermal balance, solutions, systems), with a few other peaks (" F", "mic"). Silent when "thermal" starts a text or sits in a list of properties. Members are thermal/heat detectors.
result.label: ' thermal' before noun

result.description: Fires on word pieces mid-word, mostly ' gover' (before -ning/-ns) and 'ener' in 'greener'/'regeneration'. Weak partial-word pieces like 'stroke' and 'consum' also fire; peaks are scattered and the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: gover- / -ener word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mechan' (mechanics/mechanistic/mechanisms) when it directly follows "the" (e.g. "the mechanics of"). It stays silent after adjectives or nouns such as "mutational", "classical", "management".
result.label: ' mechan' right after "the"

result.description: Fires on " not" right after a modal or copula verb (may/might/is/are not), especially "may not be". Silent when "not" starts a clause or follows a comma or "but". Members are "not" detectors that push towards "necessarily/only/just".
result.label: "not" after modal or auxiliary verb

result.description: Fires on " it" right after the causal conjunction "as" (", as it can/is/requires..."), introducing a reason clause. Stays silent on " it" after commas, semicolons, or other words.
result.label: " it" after causal "as"

result.description: Fires on the verb "know" and its forms (know, knows, knowing, knew) when a subject knows something, as in "every baker knows". Predicts adverbs like "exactly". Members detect know/understand tokens.
result.label: Verb "know" forms

result.description: Fires on the token ' Greek' (adjective/language) in text about ancient Greek culture, language, art and mathematics. Weaker on related words like Greece, Italian, Latin. Members are mostly Greek and ancient-civilization detectors.
result.label: ' Greek' in classical culture text

result.description: Fires on digit tokens ('1', '3', '8') inside multi-digit numbers, such as dollar amounts or long digit strings. Silent on a '1' used as a list heading number or in a fraction. Members are diffuse and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Digits inside multi-digit numbers

result.description: Fires on the token ' found' (as verb "found in/themselves" and as the start of "foundations"), usually right after a plural noun subject. Members are mostly detectors of ' found'.
result.label: ' found' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'icious' in "delicious", mostly in food and cooking text. Members detect related adjective suffix pieces (icate, ious, ful) and food or taste words. Also weakly on 'bland' and 'meticulous'.
result.label: 'icious' in delicious

result.description: Fires on the word " industrial" (also "industry", " commercial", and "amin" in vitamin), mostly in science or materials text like "in industrial and manufacturing applications". Members are mostly detectors of industrial/Industrial pieces.
result.label: ' industrial' word detector

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: ' +' between algebraic terms (ax + ay +), ' back' (flashback, back in history), and 'ome' in 'biomechanics'. Mixed word pieces with no shared meaning; the circuit is weak and fragmented.
result.label: Mixed: ' +', ' back', 'ome'

result.description: Fires on the word " effect" (or "Effect"), including as a word stem in "effectiveness" and in physics names like Faraday effect. It predicts continuations such as "iveness". It is quiet on text that lacks the word.
result.label: ' effect' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'ins' piece of "origins" (orig|ins), mostly in "the origins of X" phrasing. Members detect 'ins' and related tokens such as roots. The contrast is silent on text without the word.
result.label: 'ins' in "origins"
' worked' after plural subject
result.description: Fires on the past-tense verb ' worked' right after a plural or group subject (colleagues, women, men, families), as in "worked hard" or "worked towards". It is weak on similar verbs like lived. Members detect work/working forms.
Fires mostly on the word piece "ci" inside multi-piece words such as reprodu-ci-bility, de-ci-bel, spe-ci-atory, with a few other mid-word pieces (ate, air, beg). Members are mostly "ci" detectors.
result.label: 'ci' piece in reproducibility

result.description: Fires on the "ening" piece of "Listening" (and ' listening') in headings and text about active or attentive listening skills. Members are detectors of listen/ening tokens plus eye-contact and communication context.
result.label: "Listening" word ending (ening)

result.description: Fires on the 'ate'/'ates' piece completing "Plate" (tectonic plate, Plate-au) in geology text. It stays silent on 'ate' in other words like "migrate" or "disproportionate". Members detect plate/tectonic context and "pl-" prefixes.
result.label: 'ate' in tectonic Plate

result.description: Fires on the word " independent" (or "Independent"), mostly in grammar (independent/dependent clauses) and statistics (independent variable/events). Members detect "independent" and related contrast words like dependent, random, open.
result.label: ' independent' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece "or" when it sits inside a longer word, most strongly in "cal|or|ic" and "cal|or|imetry". It stays quiet on standalone "or" as a conjunction, and on the odd spelling "ca|or|imetric".
result.label: "or" inside calorimetry words

result.description: Fires on the word " view" after an adjective (impartial, objective, all-encompassing, alternative), as in "an objective view(point)". It stays silent when " view" follows words like "different", "various" or "between" before "points".
result.label: ' view' after singular adjective

result.description: Fires on the word " confidence", mostly in statistical "confidence interval" text but also in the general sense of trust or self-assurance. Members detect confidence, trust and credibility tokens.
result.label: ' confidence' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece (-ence, -ency, -ion, -es) completing "coherence"/"cohesion"/"coherency" words, especially after "coher". Silent on -ence in other words like interdependence, correspondence, ambivalence.
result.label: coherence/cohesion word ending

result.description: Fires on the word " imperial" as a stem, mostly in essays about imperialism, colonialism and militarism, where a suffix like -ism or -ity is likely next. Members detect related stems such as colon-, royal, territorial and -ism.
result.label: ' imperial' before -ism suffix

result.description: Fires on ' readers' as the object of a verb like "allows", "encourages", "challenges", "invites" (followed by "to ..."). It stays quiet on ' readers' after "so", "help" or "keep". Members detect reader/viewer/audience-type nouns.
result.label: ' readers' as verb object

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract or scientific head noun (types, fabric, dynamics, shape) in intellectual, science-flavored prose, where a noun phrase like 'these' or 'our' follows. Silent on other ' of' uses, such as 'core of' and 'periods of'.
result.label: ' of' after abstract science nouns

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ical" completing the word "ecological" (after "ecolog"). It stays silent on "ical" in words like "political" and "philosophical". Predicts continuations like "footprint" and "niche".
result.label: "ical" in "ecological"

result.description: Fires on " studies" (also "Studies", "study", "research") when it follows a field or topic name, as in "communication studies". It stays quiet on bare "studies" with no preceding field word.
result.label: "studies" after a field name

result.description: Fires on the word " military" when used as a modifier before a noun like strength, might, dominance or campaigns, mostly in historical or empire text. It is silent when " military" starts a document, with no preceding context.
result.label: " military" as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on ' they' as the subject starting a new independent clause after a dash, semicolon or period, predicting a verb next. It stays quiet when 'they' follows 'that' or a noun in an embedded clause.
result.label: Clause-initial 'they' before verb

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' repet' (repetition, repetitive) and occasionally on 'f' in 'leftover'. It is driven by members detecting the same piece and other incomplete word starts (pun, perm, phr, Cla).
result.label: ' repet' word-start piece
Word fragments in cookware/grill words
result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces such as 'ill' in grill, 'ain' in porcelain, 'sk' in skillet, and on ' periodic'. Mostly cooking and cookware word fragments, with a weak, mixed pattern.

Fires on the word " authentication" (also "Authentication"), mostly in computer security text such as multi-factor or password-based authentication. Members are authentication/encryption detectors. The contrast text about key cards and PINs stays silent, where the word itself is absent.
result.label: authentication token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " arrang" (start of "arrangements") before the suffix "-ements". Weaker on "adv-anc-" in "advancements". Predicts the "ements" continuation.
result.label: ' arrang' before -ements

result.description: Fires on the word piece "certain" when it follows the prefix "Un" (as in "Uncertainty Principle"), mainly in headings. It stays silent on lowercase "uncertainty principle" in running text. Members detect "certain" and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: "certain" in "Uncertainty" word piece

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "pos" inside "Prepositions" in grammar headings at document start. It also fires weakly on scattered pieces such as Russian "от", " на", and Arabic or Japanese fragments. Evidence is mixed, with a consistency of 36%.
result.label: "pos" in "prepositions" headings

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after 'field' (also 'realm', 'area', 'world') when introducing an academic discipline or domain, e.g. "the field of phonetics". Silent on ' of' after other nouns like analysis, study, types, complexity.
result.label: 'of' after field/realm of study

result.description: Fires on " note"/" notes" (occasionally " score") in musical contexts, such as hitting the right note or notes a performer sings. Members include note-token detectors plus music and instrument topic latents.
result.label: Musical 'note(s)' token

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' (also 'ics') in "eth-ical"/"Ethics" in ethics discussions such as privacy and consent. It stays silent on 'ical' in ecological, geopolitical and biomedical.
result.label: ethical suffix 'ical' after eth-

result.description: Fires on the word piece " germ" (germ theory, germinate, germplasm), often as the start of a longer word. Members detect " germ" and other word-start fragments such as dig-, init-, sem-, cert-.
result.label: " germ" word piece

result.description: Fires on " policy" right after "fiscal" (also "Monetarism" 'ar' piece) in economics text. It stays silent on " policy" after other words like "currency" or "macroeconomic". The fiscal-policy context seems to be what it needs.
result.label: Fiscal policy token in economics

result.description: Fires on the word " within" used as a preposition after a noun or verb phrase (e.g. "molecules within cells", "sequence within it"). Many members are detectors of " within" itself. The contrast text has no "within" at all.
result.label: Preposition " within" detector

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (commas in lists of places, 'most' in 'mostly', '-ans' endings, 'approximately') mid-sentence in expository text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse; logits mildly favour adjective-like continuations such as economic, urban, advanced.
result.label: Diffuse mixed function-token latent

result.description: Fires on the space token that comes right after "late" (e.g. "the late" before a year like 1980s or 18th century). It stays silent on the same space after "the" alone, so it needs "late" or "mid" before it.
result.label: Space after "late" before year

result.description: Fires on the adverbs "just", "simply", "merely" right after "rather than" (also weakly after "not" or "beyond"), where they introduce a contrasted alternative, usually before "being". Silent on "not just" in several contexts.
result.label: just/simply/merely after "rather than"

result.description: Fires on " such" introducing examples ("such as") right after a comma following a noun phrase. Silent when " such" follows a noun directly without a comma or is used as a determiner ("such matrices").
result.label: "such" of ", such as" examples

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'ser' inside "assert(s/ing)" (mid-word, before a suffix), and sometimes on LaTeX ' \\' spacing. It stays silent on 'ser' in "Husserl", so it needs the "as-ser" word context.
result.label: 'ser' in "assert" word piece

result.description: Fires on the token " Fourier", mostly in math and signal-processing text such as "Fourier analysis" or "Fourier transforms". Members detect Fourier and related names (Taylor, Laplace, Joseph) and series/transform words. Weakly fires on "excell" in "excellence".
result.label: Fourier token detector

result.description: Fires on ' as' used as a standalone preposition/conjunction or in a comparison after a noun or adjective ("Truth as actionable", "beneficial as they"). Silent on "such as" and "serves as".
result.label: ' as' outside 'such as'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' influen' (before "cing") in participial clauses like ", influencing ...". Weaker on "en-han-cing". Members detect similar verb stems (facil, consequ, contrib, experien) that precede a "-cing/-uting" ending.
result.label: ' influen' stem before -cing

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ris" (start of "risks") after a risk-type modifier such as legal, operational, financial or regulatory. It is quieter in the contrast, where "organizing risks" has no modifier before it.
result.label: " ris" in "risks" after modifier

result.description: Fires on the word "network(s)/Network" in any case or number, across topics such as semantic, Bayesian, neural, computer and social networks. Members are detectors of this token in its various forms.
result.label: network(s) token detector

result.description: Fires on ' nature' meaning the natural world, as a subject or topic in lists (e.g. "subjects like nature, animals"). It stays silent on ' nature' meaning "character/quality", as in "transient nature of" or "complex nature".
result.label: ' nature' as the natural world

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ag' inside longer words, especially Pyth-ag-orean/Pythagoras and -pelagic. Weaker hits on other mid-word pieces such as ' Canada', ' Comput', ' Hor' and ' tar'.
result.label: 'ag' piece in Pythagoras

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'avel' in "wavelength(s)", after the 'w' piece. Weak activation on a few other split-word fragments like 'ug' and 'pt'. Members are mostly 'avel' detectors.
result.label: 'avel' in wavelength

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' l' when it begins a word, most strongly in 'lens'/'lenses' (also lymph, lumber) in optics-style text. Upstream members are mostly ' l' detectors.
result.label: ' l' starting 'lens' words

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' surve' (start of survey/surveying/surveillance), e.g. after "geodetic", "seismic", "syndromic". Members detect ' surve' and similar word-initial fragments that need a continuation piece.
result.label: ' surve' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ab' inside 'vocabulary' (also syllabaries, diabetes), where 'voc' precedes it. Members detect 'ab' and preceding pieces like 'voc' and 'syll'.
result.label: 'ab' in vocabulary

result.description: Fires on quality nouns like accuracy, reliability, consistency, precision when they are the object right after "ensure" (or "ensuring"). It stays quiet on the same words after "of", "between" or "as well as".
result.label: Quality noun after "ensure"

result.description: Fires on the ordinal suffix 'th' after a century number (18th, 19th, 9th), mostly in historical century ranges, and is silent on year numbers like 1840s. Members are mostly detectors of 'th' pieces.
result.label: Ordinal 'th' in century numbers

result.description: Fires mainly on ' expert' as a word start (expert systems, expertise), after "of" or "encapsulating". Weaker on other word-start pieces like 'est', 'innov'. Silent when "expert" begins a text as a plain adjective.
result.label: ' expert' in expertise/expert systems

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' capac' (start of capacitor/capacitance/capacity), mostly in electronics text after words like "electrolytic" or "double-layer". Members detect capac/cap/compact/avail/abil-type prefixes of -ity words.
result.label: ' capac' word-start piece

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'ening' piece of 'Listening' in heading lists of listening types (Selective Listening, Appreciative Listening), and weakly on ' listening'. Silent when 'ening' is in other words like 'strengthening'.
