result.label: 'ening' in Listening headings

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (work, of, their, -ence, cultural) in passages about art, creativity and culture, often mid-phrase before a noun. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak and diffuse, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered tokens in arts/culture prose

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of abstract nouns (e.g. "objectives, guide…", "planning, design, installation"), where more list items follow. Silent on commas before "but" or a new clause.
result.label: Comma inside abstract-noun lists
pioneer word-piece 'ione' after sentence start
result.description: Fires on the 'pione'/'ione' pieces of "pioneer/pioneering" when the word begins a sentence or clause in text about innovation and development. It stays silent on 'ione' at the very start of a document. It predicts the 'er/ering' continuation.

result.label: ' mod' stem before -ulation/-ular
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mod' when it begins a longer word such as modulation, modular, modality or modifier. Members are mostly ' mod' detectors. It is weakly active on 'manip' in manipulating, and silent on the whole word 'manipulate'.

Fires on the word piece ' elect' when it begins a word like electrical, electromagnetic or electrode, in physics and engineering text after a preceding word. It is silent when ' elect' starts the text with nothing before it.
result.label: ' elect' start of electro- words

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-phrase tokens in abstract academic prose (' methods', ' established', ' to', '-', ' while'), with no single token dominating. Silent on ' methods' in some contexts, but the evidence doesn't show what separates them.
result.label: Scattered academic-prose tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the token piece "inos" completing "neutrinos" (e.g., "tau neutr|inos"). Members detect "inos"/"ino"/"neut" pieces, including "lum|inos|ity", plus physics context. Weak firing elsewhere in math text.
result.label: "inos" in neutrinos

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer words, most often 'ent' in "relentless" and "relates", where more word pieces follow. It stays silent on 'ent' in "inherent", where the word is complete. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Mid-word piece, as in rel-ent-less

result.description: Fires on words naming a historical or geological time span, especially the 'ch' of 'epoch', and also ' era', ' period', ' time', in passages about eras and epochs. Silent on general history text without such nouns.
result.label: Epoch/era/period time-span nouns
Word-initial fragments: W, subs, Orth
result.description: Fires on the start of a multi-piece word where a continuation is expected, mainly ' W' (Wave, Woolf, WWI), ' subs' (subsidies) and ' Orth' (Orthographic), and sometimes ' to' after "continues". Silent on ordinary text.

Fires mainly on " classical" (as in classical antiquity, mechanics, music), and also on "communic" in "telecommunications" and " possess" in "possessive". Mostly a token-specific detector for "classical", with a few other unrelated pieces.
result.label: "classical" token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb " maintain" (including maintains/maintaining), mostly in technical text where a structure, operation or property keeps something intact, e.g. linear transformations maintain structure or a tree maintains balance. Members are mostly maintain/keep/retain detectors.
result.label: ' maintain' verb detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'pler' ending the name Kepler, after 'Ke'. It stays silent when 'pler' appears at the start of a text without the preceding 'Ke'.
result.label: 'pler' in Kepler

result.description: Fires on the word piece "etic" completing "Geodetic" (Geod|etic) in geodesy headings and glossary text. Members detect "etic" and "Geod" pieces plus survey and latitude context.
result.label: "etic" in Geodetic

result.description: Fires on the token ' fluid' (also 'uid' in Fluid), mostly as a modifier before nouns like dynamics, behavior or mechanics. Predicts continuations like conservation, dynamics, principles. Silent on nearby text that lacks the word.
result.label: ' fluid' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' subst' (start of "substance/substances"), mostly after adjectives like toxic, hazardous, dangerous. Members are mostly ' subst' detectors from earlier layers. Weakly also on ' abund' in "abundances".
result.label: ' subst' token (substance)

result.description: Fires on the article ' a' / ' an' after a copula or "also" (e.g. "is also a", "akin to a"), where a descriptive noun phrase is about to start. It is silent on ' an' after other words such as "even an" or "offer an".
result.label: Article 'a/an' after "is also"

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "work(s)" in the sense of creative works ("works of art", "work of others"). It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "form", "story", "boundaries" or "nature".
result.label: " of" after "work(s)"

result.description: Fires mostly on the mid-word piece 'lin' in "streamlining" and similar word fragments (recalibrate, Health, magazines), in business-style text. Seems to mark an unfinished word expecting a suffix like 'ing'. Peaks are mixed.
result.label: Mid-word 'lin' in streamlining

result.description: Fires on commas (and 'and'/'or') separating items in a list of examples, such as techniques, elements or disciplines after 'such as' or 'including', mostly in art-related text. Silent on commas that end clauses or follow introductory phrases.
result.label: Commas in example lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cul' when it begins "culinary", mostly after "the/in the realm of" in phrases like "culinary arts/industry". Silent when "culinary" starts the text or follows other words like "epic" or "is".
result.label: ' cul' of "culinary" after "the"

result.description: Fires on the word "circle"/"circles" (and the piece "cles" in "Circles") in geometry text. Members are mostly detectors of circle tokens and related geometry words like radius and sides.
result.label: circle / circles token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lications" completing "implications", mostly in "have profound/significant implications for" in scientific text. Weakly fires on "consequences" or "impacts" in similar phrases.
result.label: "implications" word piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' psych' at the start of psychology/psychological/psychologist, most strongly after 'cognitive'. Members are mostly detectors of ' psych' in earlier layers.
result.label: ' psych' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'pend' in "perpendicular" (also ' dens' in "denser/density"), in technical math/science text. Members detect word-start fragments of technical terms (precip, cart, dist, per-me).
result.label: 'pend' in perpendicular

result.description: Fires on the token " processes" (also "process" and similar plurals), strongest after modifiers like "industrial" or "chemical" in science text. It is silent on some uses, such as after "these" or "two", or in some mid-sentence spots.
result.label: ' processes' after industrial/chemical

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' evol' (start of evolve/evolved/evolving), mostly after a plural or abstract subject like language, societies, businesses. Members are mostly ' evol' detectors. Silent once in "with evolving social complexity".
result.label: ' evol' stem of evolve

result.description: Fires on ' such' when it begins the "such as" exemplifying phrase after a comma or noun, introducing examples. It stays silent when 'such' is a determiner before a noun ("such quests", "such a tradition").
result.label: "such" in "such as" examples

result.description: Fires on ' property' (as in property rights, intellectual property) and on 'hold' in stakeholders/shareholders, with weaker hits on other word pieces like 'inter' and 'ance'. Members mostly detect 'property' tokens.
result.label: property / stakeholder 'hold' token

result.description: Fires mostly on " Symbol" in title-like headings of the form "X as Symbolism" (after "as"), with weaker firing on pieces like "person" and "against". The evidence is thin and mixed beyond the " Symbol" cases.
result.label: "as Symbol(ism)" heading

result.description: Fires on ' rates' after an economic modifier such as interest, exchange, or floating, in monetary and economic text. Weakly on ' rate' or ' prices' in finance contexts. Members detect rate/rates and related finance words.
result.label: ' rates' in economics (interest rates)

result.description: Fires on ' the' (sometimes ';') beginning a new item in a parallel list or series of comparable noun phrases, e.g. "be it the roughness of X, the softness of Y, or the crispness". Silent on ' the' in ordinary non-list positions.
result.label: ' the' opening parallel list item

result.description: Fires on the word-final piece 'ose' in sugar names such as glucose, fructose and galactose, in biochemistry text. Weak activation on unrelated word pieces like 'ust' and 'ail'.
result.label: 'ose' ending of sugar names

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ote' when it is the middle of "geotechnical", "geotechnology" or "geotextiles" (after "ge"), and weakly in "biotechnology". It stays silent on 'ote' at the start of a word or in odd capitalization.
result.label: 'ote' in geotechnical words

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (composition, horizon, object, Religion, Electron, predator) that are the head noun or word right after a science-topic context word like soil, in, or and. It is inconsistent, and it stays silent on some 'composition' contexts.
result.label: Noun after science modifier (soil composition)
Word-start piece 'neg' (negation)
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' neg' / 'neg' / ' Neg' when it begins a word like negation, negating or negator, often in logic text. Members are mostly detectors of this same token.

Fires on the piece 'm' (also 'yst', 'g', 'en') in the middle of a longer word, especially after a prefix like 'dis' (dis-m-antle) or in catal-yst. It stays silent on 'm' in words like pragmatic, nightmare, enigmatic, realm.
result.label: Mid-word 'm' after prefix

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'lier' in the word "supplier" (supp|lier), in supply-chain and procurement text. Silent on the full word "suppliers" in a culinary context. Members are detectors of 'lier'/'liers' and 'supp'.
result.label: 'lier' in supplier
Beauty/joy abstract nouns after "the"
result.description: Fires on abstract positive-quality nouns such as " beauty" and " joy" (also "ness", " charm", "wonders") when they are the head of an "the/of X" phrase. Members are mostly detectors of "beauty" and similar words.

Fires on varied tokens in title-like headings of geography/geodesy topics, e.g. the word after "Geomorphic" or "Geodetic" in a multiword technical term (Mapping, Positioning). Weaker on function words like "is". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Geo-technical heading term continuation

result.description: Fires on the token ' ocean' in marine and earth-science text (oceanic currents, chemistry, temperatures). Members detect ocean, marine and sea tokens. It stayed silent on one 'open ocean' case, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' ocean' in marine science text

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces like 'ck'/'cks' (as in "wire rack"), 'ards' (boards), and 'old', completing a noun after a split word. Strongest on "rack" in cooling/wire rack text; other peaks are weak and mixed.
result.label: Word-ending pieces 'ck', 'ards' (rack)

result.description: Fires on the 'ishing' piece in "distinguishing", mostly before "between"; weaker on "differentiate". Members detect distinguish/differentiate word pieces and "between", and the output pushes toward ' between'.
result.label: distinguishing (ishing) before between
"person" in "third-person" narration
result.description: Fires on "person" in "third-person" (narrative viewpoint), especially in lists like omniscient or limited third-person. It stays silent on "first-person" and "second-person", so it needs "third" before it. Members detect "third", the hyphen, and "person".

result.label: conver- before -ge (converge)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' conver' (also ' diver') when it begins "converge/diverge", as in plates or rays converging. It predicts a following 'g' piece (-ging, -gent). Members are detectors of conver/diver/emer-like stems.

Fires on the later word of machine-learning model names like "Recurrent Neural Network", "Long Short-Term Memory" and "Support Vector Machines". It needs an ML-terminology context, and members track neural/NN/training words.
result.label: ML model-name words (Network, Term)

result.description: Fires on the word " entire" (occasionally "whole", "complete", "full") as a determiner after "an", "the" or "their", before a noun. Members are detectors of whole/entire/full words.
result.label: "entire" / "whole" determiner
' coh' word-start fragment
result.description: Fires on the word-initial fragment ' coh' (coherent, cohesive, cohomology), and sometimes ' hip' or other word starts, where the rest of the word must follow. It was silent on one 'social coh' (cohesion) example.

result.label: "out" as prefix of compound words
result.description: Fires on the token " out" / " Out" when it is a word-initial piece of a longer word (outcomes, outbreak, outflow, outreach), predicting a continuation like "comes" or "break". Stays silent on at least one "measurable outcomes" case.

Fires on varied tokens in academic text, mostly mid-word pieces (neuroplastic, biocompat, stylistic) and list separators like commas or 'and' within a series of items. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Mid-word pieces and list separators

result.description: Fires on commas and 'and'/'or' inside lists of concrete resources or materials (oil, gas, coal, water, minerals), after a list item. Silent on commas in abstract clause-level prose. Oil/gas members support it.
result.label: List separators in resource/material lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'c' in the middle of a word, mostly 'inter|c|ultural' (also 'cres|c|endo', 'Pro|c|urement'). Silent on 'c' after a hyphen ('-c') or in 'trans|c|end'. Members are detectors of 'c' after a prefix.
result.label: 'c' inside intercultural

result.description: Fires on the middle word piece 'isen' in "Heisenberg" (mostly), after "He". Silent when 'isen' starts the text without "He" before it. Weak firing on other mid-word pieces, such as 'oph' in "sophisticated". It predicts a continuation like 'berg'.
result.label: 'isen' inside Heisenberg

result.description: Fires on 'current' (esp. sentence-initial "Currently," after a period) and on ' also' after a subject/period noun, both sentence-adverb-like positions. Silent on 'current' at document start.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'current(ly)' and 'also'

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' e' as a word-initial fragment or symbol (e.g., "e.g.", the number e, e^x, "eyebrows", "eco-"). It stays silent on ' e' in "ecosystem" after "the/natural", though the cause is unclear.
result.label: Standalone ' e' token

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces and function words (' resp', ' and', ' M', 'ou', 'ppings') where a word is incomplete or a multi-token word or phrase continues. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Diffuse mid-word fragment feature

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' p' right after "plays a" / "a" (as in "plays a pivotal role"), and weaker on 'al' in "convolutional" and 'layer'. Silent on ' p' in other contexts, such as "have been pivotal" or "private payer".
result.label: ' p' of "a pivotal" role

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'al' in "focal" (also 'ruct' in "non-destructive"), where the word continues or is completed. Silent on 'al' in "reveal" or "visceral". Mostly a "focal" detector with scattered other word pieces.
result.label: 'al' in "focal" word piece

result.description: Fires on finite verbs like "determine(s)", "dictate", "affect" after a subject noun (e.g. "bonds determines the polarity"), mostly in science text. Silent on "difficult to determine", where it is an infinitive with no subject.
result.label: Subject-governing verb: determines/dictates

result.description: Fires on ' much' in the comparative "as much (a/about/an) X" construction. It stays silent on ' much' in ", much like" and sentence-initial "much".
result.label: "as much" comparative construction

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' br' when it begins a word, mostly 'brush' (brushstroke, brush control) in art-materials text. It stays silent on ' br' at the very start of a document or after 'poignant'.
result.label: ' br' piece in brush text

result.description: Fires on the token " identity", most strongly in "the identity matrix" in linear algebra text. It is silent when " identity" begins the document with no preceding context. Members are mostly detectors of " identity" and similar words.
result.label: ' identity' token (identity matrix)

result.description: Fires on the word " two", most strongly in "X and Y are two distinct ..." where it introduces a pair of categories. Members are mostly detectors of "two" and other small number words such as three and six.
result.label: " two" in "are two distinct"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' incred' (incredible/incredibly), mainly after "are/is/an", where a suffix like "ibly" comes next. It also fires weakly on other incomplete word fragments such as 'r' in neutrinos.
result.label: ' incred' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' background' (also 'Background', 'backgrounds'), mostly in the sense of a person's or cultural background, and also in cosmic microwave background. Members are mostly detectors of this same token.
result.label: ' background' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "speak" (speak, speaks, speaking) as a verb or gerund, e.g. "when someone speaks of" or "know when to speak up". Members detect speak/speech/speakers tokens. It stays silent when the word is split into pieces like "aking".
result.label: "speak" / "speaking" word detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' alleg' (start of allegory, allegiance, allegorical), a split-word prefix token. Members are mostly detectors of ' alleg' and other word-initial fragments like Id, Log, histor, sequ.
result.label: ' alleg' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires mainly on ' IP' (Internet Protocol) in networking text, such as "private IP addresses" or "IPv4". It also fires on word-start pieces like 'il' in "Soil". It is silent on "TCP/IP", so it needs IP as a standalone word.
result.label: IP (Internet Protocol) token

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in academic/expository prose (' focused', ' later', ' significant', ' important', 'ates', ' difficulty'), often mid-phrase where a noun or continuation is expected. Peaks are inconsistent and members are generic; the evidence is weak.
result.label: Scattered academic-prose tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after the verb "shape" (also weakly after verbs like establish or impact on), where an abstract noun such as "trajectory" or "future" comes next. It stays silent on ' the' after other verbs, such as "witnessed the".
result.label: ' the' after verb "shape"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'itative' in "quant|itative" (quantitative), usually in method contexts alongside "qualitative". It stays silent on 'itative' after "qual" or at the start of a document, so it needs the "quant" prefix.
result.label: 'itative' in quantitative

result.description: Fires on a hyphen inside a multi-part hyphenated compound, especially after "of" or a short element, as in "out-of-order", "state-of-the-art", "out-of-pocket", "can-see-everything". It stays silent on hyphens in simple compounds like "high-performance" or "data-driven".
result.label: Hyphen in multi-part compounds

result.description: Fires on the hyphen in "laissez-faire", after "laissez" (also "shall" in "shallow"). Silent on hyphens in other compounds like "supply-side", "19th-century" or "far-reaching". Members are mostly generic hyphen detectors plus "laissez" pieces.
result.label: hyphen in laissez-faire

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' l', ' your', ' method', ' imm', 'for') in cooking/dough text, especially mid-word pieces like dough-"l"-amination. Silent on ' l' in other food contexts such as lamb. Members are mostly cooking and food detectors.
result.label: Dough and cooking-technique tokens
"or" ending "conductor"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "or" when it completes the word "conductor" (conduct + or), including the possessive "conductor's". It stays silent on "or" in other words like "rotor", "flavor", "sculptor" and "and/or".

Fires on the word " jazz" when it follows a modifier or preposition in music-genre discussion (e.g. "Latin jazz", "in jazz harmony"). It is silent when " jazz" starts the text. Members detect jazz and other music genres.
result.label: ' jazz' after a word

result.description: Fires on ' impact' (also ' influence', ' effect') as a head noun right after "the", about to take "of ...". It stays silent on "impact" after adjectives like "lasting" or used as a verb ("impacts").
result.label: "the impact" before "of"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'state' mostly in "solid-state" (physics/electronics), and also on 'cial' in "facial". Members are detectors of 'state' and 'cial' tokens.
result.label: solid-state 'state' / facial 'cial'
' in' after a noun phrase
result.description: Fires on ' in' attached right after a noun (a topic, person, or process) and introducing a field, place, or domain, as in "task scheduling in operating systems". It stays quiet on some other ' in' uses, such as "applications in computer science" and title-initial "Role of Water Bodies in".

Fires on the word " inverse", mostly in matrix/linear-algebra text (inverse matrix, inverse square matrix). It is silent on related math text that doesn't contain the word, such as determinants and invertibility. Members detect inverse and nearby math words.
result.label: ' inverse' in matrix text
Mid-word pieces: -centric, kinetics, 'more and'
result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ric' in user-centric, 'inet' in kinetics, and 'ed' in user-centered, plus ' and' in 'more and more'. Members mostly detect 'ric' word pieces. Mixed evidence, with no single token dominant.
Fires on the word piece ' forec' (start of forecast/forecasting), strongest after 'market' and mid-sentence. Weaker on 'to forecast'. Silent when ' forec' starts the text with no preceding context.
result.label: ' forec' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on adjectives of silence (' silent', ' quiet', ' still') placed before a noun or abstract noun, e.g. "the quiet", "silent hero". Weakly on other adjectives like heavy or slow. Predicts word continuations such as -ness.
result.label: silent / quiet / still adjectives

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments early in a longer word, mainly 'ac' (inaccurate, polysaccharides), ' vel' (velvet), 'roid', ' Mediter'. It needs the piece to be inside a multi-token word that the next piece completes.
result.label: Word-initial fragments: ac, vel, Mediter

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after a nominalized head noun in a title or heading (e.g. "The Basics of", "The Role of", "The Evolution of"). It stays silent on ' of' in ordinary running prose, such as "a Glass of Water" or "understanding of the".
result.label: ' of' in title-style headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'et' in "gen-et-ics" (also phon-et-ics, param-et-ric), where it predicts the suffix 'ics'. It stays silent on 'et' in other words like multifac-et-ed and imp-et-us.
result.label: 'et' inside genetics

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in art/craft vocabulary, mainly 'roid' in embroidery, plus 'ouve' in Art Nouveau and ' Trad' in Traditional. Weakly on 'ourd' in other words. Mostly a word-piece detector in art-themed text.
result.label: 'roid' in embroidery, art word pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of proper names and art-movement terms split into subword tokens, mainly 'de' in avant-garde and 'bs'/'b' in Gibbs/Gibbons. Weaker on other split words like tragedies.
result.label: Split-word pieces: avant-garde, Gibbs

result.description: Fires on " power" (occasionally " energy") as a noun in energy-source compounds like "solar power" or "wind power", especially in renewable-energy lists. It stays quiet on "power needs" or "source of power" without a preceding energy-type modifier.
result.label: power after solar/wind energy type

result.description: Fires on ' such' right after a plural noun that introduces examples ("various factors such as", "fields such as"). It stays silent when 'such' is a determiner ("such techniques", "against such boundaries").
result.label: ' such' introducing examples

result.description: Fires on the word " computational" (also "ational" in "Computational"), typically as a modifier before nouns like methods, models, power or complexity. Members are mostly detectors of this same token.
result.label: ' computational' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ations' in "devi-ations" (deviations from a norm/baseline). It stays silent on 'ations' in other words like vibrations, expectations, evaluations. Members detect deviate/deviation/standard deviation/outlier contexts.
result.label: 'ations' completing "deviations"

result.description: Fires on " properties" (also " characteristics") after a modifier like physical, mechanical or electronic, mostly in materials and polymer science text. It is silent in some chemical-properties contexts and when "properties" starts the text.
result.label: "properties" after material-type adjective

result.description: Fires on word endings of attribution/notability words, mainly "cred-ited", also "noteworth-y" and "not-ably". Appears in phrases like "credited with/to" and "noteworthy for". Members detect passive participles such as referred, identified, viewed.
result.label: Credited / noteworthy word endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ides" after "w", mainly in "widespread" (also "odes"). Members detect "w" plus a following word piece such as elf, ages or ard. Weak on other w- words like "wake".
result.label: "ides" in "widespread"

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer technical word, mostly ' assist' (assistive, assistants), plus 'ics' in kinetics, 'ar' in radar, and 'ing'. It seems to predict a suffix completing the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragment: assist-, kinet-ics

result.description: Fires on the piece 'zy' ending the word "fuzzy", as in "fuzzy logic", "fuzzy systems", "fuzzy membership". It depends on the preceding 'fuz' piece. Upstream members mostly detect 'zy' after 'fuz'.
result.label: 'zy' in "fuzzy"

result.description: Fires on ' we' (rarely ' you') when it directly follows a noun as the subject of a reduced relative clause, e.g. "the accents we carry", "the palette we choose". It stays silent on ' we' as a main-clause subject after a comma.
result.label: ' we' in relative clause after noun
' persu' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' persu' at the start of persuade/persuasive/persuasion, mostly in writing about communication and rhetoric. It stays silent when ' persu' begins the document, where there is no preceding context.
Fires on the underscore in LaTeX/math-style subscripts after a variable letter (C_1, x_1, k_2, B_n), where an index follows. Silent on underscores in code-like or garbled strings.
result.label: Underscore subscript in math notation

result.description: Fires on the piece "al" completing the word "Modal" (as in modal logic), and more weakly on " modal". Silent on "al" in other words like "reveal" or "formal". Members detect "Mod" prefixes and modal/modulation pieces.
result.label: "al" completing "Modal"

result.description: Fires on ' last' as a verb stem in "which lasted" (a period or era that lasted from...), and weakly on "but rather". Silent on "the last several" (adjective use).
result.label: "which lasted" verb 'last'

result.description: Fires on the token " terms" (also " term") when it means the items of a mathematical sum, sequence or polynomial, e.g. "sum of terms", "like terms", "preceding terms". Weakly fires on "terms" meaning words.
result.label: "terms" in math sequences

result.description: Fires on the token ' convey' (including as a stem in 'conveyed', 'conveyor', 'conveyance', and as a verb). Members are detectors of convey/communicate/express/deliver-type words. Weaker on the plain verb, stronger in word-stem uses.
result.label: ' convey' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " Pl" in capitalised title or heading text, such as "Media Pl(anning)" or "Belt Pl(ate)". It also fires weakly on "UI" and "tz". Upstream members detect " Pl" and " pl" pieces.
result.label: " Pl" piece in headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' brid' (start of bridge/bridging/bridges), mostly in network or engineering text. Members detect ' brid', 'bridge' and similar split-word stems like ' mer' (merging) that are followed by 'ge/ging'.
result.label: ' brid' word-piece (bridging)

result.description: Fires on the 'tz' piece in "Boltzmann", in statistical mechanics text, after "Bol". Members are mostly 'tz' detectors plus ensemble/statistical-mechanics context. Weak activations on other pieces are scattered.
result.label: Boltzmann 'tz' token

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'vol' in 'evolving' (also 'nov' in 'Innovation' and 'Conf'), a mid-word fragment where the word is still being spelled out. Members are mostly 'vol'/'ol' piece detectors.
result.label: 'vol' fragment in evolving
Biochemistry word endings: enzyme, receptor
result.description: Fires on the final piece of molecular-biology words, mainly the 'e' completing "enzyme" and "ceptor" in "receptor". It is quiet on 'e' in other words such as "gluconeogenesis".

Fires on the word-start piece ' medi' (mediator, mediate, mediating) in scientific text, as the first fragment of a longer word. Members detect similar fragments such as initi-, orch-, acceler-, regul-.
result.label: ' medi' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ize' in "maximize" (also minimize), mostly in economics/game-theory text about agents maximizing outcomes. It stays silent on 'ize' in other verbs like prioritize or emphasize.
result.label: 'ize' in maximize
bustling / hustle word ending
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ling' (also 'le') completing 'bustling' or 'hustle' in lively city descriptions. It is silent on 'ling' in other words such as 'baffling'.

result.label: Suffix -ification after 'strat' (stratification)
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ification' (also 'ation') completing words like stratification, segregation, quantification, in social or scientific text about layering, division or separation. Members detect 'strat' word starts and hierarchy/stratigraphy pieces.

Fires on the noun ' computation' (also 'computational', 'comput-' pieces) in technical text about theory, quantum or mathematical computation. Silent on 'computing' in 'Quantum computing'. Members are detectors of computation/calculation-related tokens.
result.label: ' computation' word detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ate'/'ating' completing the word "anticipate" (anticipating, anticipates), in business/forecasting text. It stays silent on 'ate' in other verbs such as evaluate, cultivate, incorporate. Members detect anticipate/predict/forecast-type words.
result.label: -ate ending of "anticipate"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ced' in "unprecedented" (also in words like "Procedures"), where it completes a split word. It needs the preceding piece, such as "unpre". It is silent on other text.
result.label: 'ced' in unprecedented

result.description: Fires on mixed mid-word or word-joining pieces: hyphens after a first word (life-, state-), the end of "Clause", digits inside date or fraction strings, and fragments like "Roc". No single token dominates, and the logit effects are weak.
result.label: Hyphens and word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on ' theory' (also mathematics, geometry, -ology endings) when it completes an academic field name in math/science text, strongest in "number theory". Silent on "theory" in other uses such as "systems theory", "between theory and application".
result.label: Math field name ending: number theory

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " mis" as a prefix (misinformation, misuse, misconceptions, miscommunication), typically after "prevent", "result in" or "lead to". It predicts a continuing word stem such as inter-, con-, or app-.
result.label: mis- prefix token

result.description: Fires on ' world' (occasionally ' landscape') when it follows a domain adjective or noun, as in "the culinary world" or "the business world", meaning a sphere or field. It stays silent on "around the world" or "In a world where".
result.label: Domain "world" as sphere/field

result.description: Fires on short tokens such as '3', '0', 'FF', 'W' and 'P' that act as subscripts, variable names or acronym pieces (P_0, MP3, WAV-like formats). Members come from audio, compression and music topics. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Short symbol/format-code tokens (P_0, MP3)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' gravit' (start of "gravitational") in physics text, when it follows a preceding word. It is silent when ' gravit' starts the text as the first token.
result.label: ' gravit' word-piece mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on the word-piece endings of "diagnosis" and "diagnostics" (diagn-osis, di-agnostics), mostly in medical or nuclear-medicine text. Members detect diagn- pieces and related medical words like symptoms and therapy.
result.label: diagnosis / diagnostics word endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece "aking" after "b" in "baking" (also "bakers", "baker"), mostly in baking/cooking text such as "baking soda" and "baking sheet". Members detect the "aking" token and pastry or dough context.
result.label: "aking" in baking

result.description: Fires mainly on ' closely' after a form of "is/are" in "closely linked/related/tied" phrasing, with a few stray peaks on 'G' in JPEG/MPEG. Members detect 'closely'/'close' and similar adverbs.
result.label: ' closely' before linked/tied

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "intersection" (also "convergence", "fusion"), where two or more fields or concepts are about to be joined. Silent on " of" after other nouns like "rise", "state", "challenge".
result.label: "of" after intersection/convergence

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' form' when it follows a preceding word, especially as the start of "formations" after geological or coastal terms. It predicts 'ations' or similar continuations. It stays silent when ' form' starts the text.
result.label: ' form' piece before -ations

result.description: Fires on the word " distributed" (and "ributed" in "Distributed"), mostly in computing contexts such as distributed systems, file systems and hash tables. Members detect distributed, distribution, cloud and thread tokens.
result.label: "distributed" in computing text

result.description: Fires on the 'es' piece completing the plural "themes" (them+es), mostly in literary or creative-writing discussion. It stays silent on 'es' in other words like challenges, encourages or verses.
result.label: 'es' ending of "themes"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dual' in philosophy text about dualism/dualist views (mind-body dualism, substance dualism). Silent on ' dual' in 'dual approach', so it seems to need the dualism/dualist word rather than generic 'dual'.
result.label: ' dual' in dualism

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' typ' in typography/typological and on 'ard' in haz-ard(ous), mid-word pieces that continue a longer word. Weakly on a few other word fragments.
result.label: typ- and haz-ard word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token " mass" (also " Mass"), most strongly in "mass production/media/marketing" before a noun. It fires more weakly for physics "mass" (spectrometry, atomic mass). Members are mostly "mass" token detectors.
result.label: ' mass' token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'is' completing a technical noun ending in -lysis/-sis, such as electrolysis or electrophoresis, in science text. Silent on ordinary words.
result.label: 'is' ending scientific -lysis terms

result.description: Fires on varied word-ending or closing pieces: the LaTeX closer ' \)' after a variable, suffixes like 'ous', 'dimensional', 'DP', 'oth', 'ary'. Mostly math/science text, where it marks a word or symbol that is just completed. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Math/science word-ending and \) closers

result.description: Fires on the 'it' piece inside 'epitomize/epitomizes' after the 'ep' piece. It stays silent on 'it' in other words such as 'exhibit' or 'serendipitous'. Members detect 'it' and 'ep' word pieces in split words.
result.label: 'it' in epitomize

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' glo' in "across the globe" and on 'on' in "Microcanonical"; weaker on mid-word pieces like 'fa' (fauna) and 'minor'. Mostly an incomplete-word piece predicting a continuation like "be".
result.label: Word-start piece 'glo' (globe)

result.description: Fires mainly on the ' PO' piece at the start of an acronym like "POV" (point of view) in writing/narrative text, where the next piece completes the acronym. It also fires weakly on other word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' PO' start of POV
Plural 'es' of disputes
result.description: Fires on the plural ending 'es' in "disputes" (also weakly on conflicts, tensions, wars), in text about territorial or international disputes. It stays silent on 'es' in "challenges" or "businesses".

Fires on the word " evidence" (and occasionally " clear" or "indication") where a claim is about to be supported, as in "there is evidence of" or "evidence suggesting". Members are mostly detectors of "evidence".
result.label: evidence token detector

result.description: Fires on capitalized name-start word pieces such as ' Gree' (Greeks), ' Rom' (Romantic), and ' Stuart' (Hall), mostly in academic text. These are fragments that precede a completing suffix, and the peaks are mixed. The evidence is thin.
result.label: Name/word-start fragments Gree, Rom, Stuart

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Dist" (as in Distributed, Distance), a prefix token that needs a continuation. Members detect similar word-start fragments (dist, Inst, Met, coh). Predicts continuations like "ributed" and "ance".
result.label: Word-initial " Dist" fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' conclus' (conclusions, conclusive) mid-word, and also on 'rane' in 'membrane'. Mostly academic or logic and argument text, with members detecting 'conclus' and similar word pieces.
result.label: ' conclus' and 'rane' word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' at' right after "aimed"/"aim"/"aiming" (and similar goal words), where it introduces the purpose or goal. It stays silent on other uses of ' at', such as location or "comes at".
result.label: "aimed at" purpose preposition

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' enh' (start of enhance/enhancement/enhances), across cooking, imaging and science text. Upstream members are mostly ' enh' detectors plus similar verbs like improve.
result.label: ' enh' token (enhance)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compreh' at the start of "comprehensive", "comprehension" or "comprehending", where the next piece must complete the word. Members mostly detect ' compreh' itself, plus similar word-start pieces like ' int' and ' aw'.
result.label: ' compreh' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like -ention, -ake, -ption completing uptake/retention/absorption nouns, mostly in soil, plant or biology text about water and nutrients. Silent on general plant-life text without such a noun ending.
result.label: Uptake/retention/absorption noun endings
"ival" in "survival"
result.description: Fires on the word piece "ival" completing "survival" (also "survivalist"), after the "surv" piece. Members are detectors of "surv"+"ival" and related word endings like resilience. Silent on other text.

Fires mainly on " figure" as a noun, especially "a towering/seminal/eminent figure" describing an important person, with weaker firing on a few other tokens like "ely". Members are mostly detectors of figure/figures in earlier layers.
result.label: ' figure' after adjective, notable person

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' nerv' in "nervous system" (central, autonomic, peripheral nervous system), before "ous". Members are mostly detectors of ' nerv' itself.
result.label: ' nerv' in nervous system

result.description: Fires on the last piece of a multi-token math term or heading (Num|bers, Enumer|ation, 'angle' in words like triangle) in mathematical title lists, especially combinatorics. Members are math-term detectors. Mixed token peaks.
result.label: Math term word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces (-able in "accountable", -ity, -back, -izing, -uring) and "possible" completing a word or phrase. Silent on "able" in indispensable and unsolvable. Evidence is mixed and the members are diffuse.
result.label: Word-ending suffix pieces (accountable)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'avel' in "wavelength(s)" after the 'w' token, where it predicts 'ength'. It stays silent when 'avel' starts the word without a preceding 'w', or follows 'sub-w'.
result.label: 'avel' in w-avel-ength

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' where', 'liance', '&', ' dis', ' to') in business/management-style text, especially 'areas where' and 'barriers to'. It stays silent on other uses of ' where'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Business text 'areas where' mixed

result.description: Fires on the separator symbols ' /' and ' &' (also '/' and ' AND') joining items in lists, phonemic slashes or matrix entries. Silent on a slash without the preceding space in running prose, as in 'statements/efficient'.
result.label: Slash and ampersand separators

result.description: Fires on ' world' (also worlds) in fiction and worldbuilding text, as in "building a world", "worldview", "worldbuilders". It is weaker for generic "the world". It predicts compounds like "-wide" and "view".
result.label: ' world' in worldbuilding contexts

result.description: Fires on the final 's' of "Bretton Woods" (the conference/system), after "Bretton Wood". Silent on other 's' tokens such as possessive 's or decade 's. Members detect Bretton/Wood pieces plus economics context.
result.label: 's' in Bretton Woods
'icate' in 'delicate'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'icate' when it completes "delicate" (del|icate), strongest before foods like pastries. It stays silent on 'icate' in "intricate". Members mostly detect 'icate' itself.

Fires on ' for' right after "allow(s)/allowed" (also "enable", "facilitates") when a verb says something makes an action possible, as in "allows for the analysis". Silent on ' for' after nouns such as "foundation for".
result.label: allow/enable 'for' after enabling verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece "book"/"books", mostly at the end of "textbook(s)" (e.g. physics textbooks), and also on "ail" in "retailers". Members are book-piece detectors.
result.label: textbook / books word-piece

result.description: Fires on words meaning blending or combining things (blending via 'ending', ' combining', ' mixing'), especially after "involve", "principles of" or "by", where the next words name what is combined. Silent on 'ending' as in "transcending" or a plain ending.
result.label: Combining/blending gerund
"contact" after language (language contact)
result.description: Fires on the token ' contact' when it follows a modifier such as "language" or "eye", as in "language contact" in sociolinguistics text. It stays silent on ' contact' at the very start of a text, with no preceding word.
Fires on the word piece 'oid' in technical words like geoid and ellipsoid (geodesy/math context). Members are mostly 'oid' detectors from earlier layers; it stays silent on other tokens.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in geoid/ellipsoid

result.description: Fires weakly on varied tokens, mostly mid-word pieces or function words (' suffering', ' myster', 'ia', digit '5', ' of', ' set'), with no clear shared context. Logits favor word-continuation pieces. Circuit is diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: Diffuse mixed mid-word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on ' force' ending physics noun phrases like "drag force" or "resistance force" in fluid-dynamics text, with weaker hits on ' conditions', ' motion', ' profile' and "on" in "phenomenon". Silent on 'force' in other senses.
result.label: Physics 'force' after drag/resistance

result.description: Fires mostly on ' bow' (as in bowl/bowling/bow style) and scattered other tokens like ' hair', 's', ' become', ' and'. Members detect word-start fragments (bow, viol, bu, Rot). Mixed and weakly faithful, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: ' bow' word-piece detector, mixed

result.description: Fires on the word piece completing "empath-" words (empathetic, empathic, empathy) and on the communication-related word after "empathetic" (e.g. "listening", "hearing"). Silent on "etic" in "aesthetic", so it needs the empathy context.
result.label: Empathetic/empathic suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on ' common' (also 'preval-ent', 'dominant', 'popular') as a predicate after "became/was/are", where "-place" is expected (commonplace). Silent on attributive 'common' before a noun like "common speech".
result.label: predicate 'common' before -place
'yn' in photosynthesis
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'yn' in split words like photos-yn-thesis and nucleos-yn-thesis, where it predicts 'thesis' or 'thetic'. It is silent on other words such as 'photogenesis'.
Fires on ' as' (occasionally ' like') in the "such as" exemplifying construction, right before an example list after a general noun. Silent on other uses of ' as' such as comparisons or conjunctions.
result.label: "such as" introducing examples

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " fe" (or " Fe") when it begins a longer word such as feast, feather, feudal, fees, feed. It predicts word continuations like "ared" or "ouse". It is silent on other text.
result.label: ' fe' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period, often at a sentence or heading boundary with the next text running on without a space. It stays silent on some periods, mostly where a fragment or comma follows. Members are mostly period detectors that predict sentence starters like This/The/It.
result.label: Sentence-final period before new sentence

result.description: Fires on " with" after a noun that is being balanced, replaced, substituted or reconciled against something ("balance considerations with", "replace X with"). Silent on "with" after "linked", "grapple", "responding", or "inherent".
result.label: "with" in balance/replace constructions

result.description: Fires mainly on 'el' completing "Diesel" (Diesel engine/cycle/fuel) in technical text, but not on 'el' in fusel-age, propel or biodiesel. Occasionally on other tokens like ' Foreign' or 'uth'.
result.label: 'el' in "Diesel"

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after "serves/acts/serving" meaning "functions as" (serves as a catalyst). Silent on other ' as' uses like "seen as", "such as", or a clause-initial "as".
result.label: 'as' after serves/acts (role)

result.description: Fires on the ending of "carbon footprint(s)" (mostly 's' or 'print' after "foot") and on "emissions" in environmental text. Silent on other 's' tokens such as "impacts" or "it's".
result.label: carbon footprint / emissions ending

result.description: Fires on the word-initial prefix " auto" (or " Auto"), as in autoimmune or auto-scaling, where it begins a longer word. Members detect similar word-start prefixes like bio, neur, self, and anom.
result.label: ' auto' prefix token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "iction" completing "fr-iction" (friction), mostly in physics and engineering text about drag and force. Members detect the same piece in earlier layers.
result.label: "iction" piece in friction

result.description: Fires on the word piece "iffer" in "Differential" (as in "Differential Equations"), when it follows a capital "D" inside that word. It stays silent when the word starts with "iffer" at the beginning of the text.
result.label: iffer in "Differential"
Disruption 'ruption' after dis-
result.description: Fires on 'ruption' (occasionally 'ptions') completing the word "disruption", as in supply-chain or business disruption. Members detect the dis- + rupt word pieces. Silent on text without that word.

Fires on the word " energy" as a noun completing a compound term in chemistry text, such as activation energy, free energy or formation energy. It stays quiet on "kinetic energy" in some contexts and on "energy" as a plain noun after "the" or a verb.
result.label: Energy in chemistry compound terms

result.description: Fires on the modal verb " can" right after an inanimate or abstract noun subject (events, requirements, variables, points), in technical or analytic text. It is quieter after "one" or people subjects like "authors" or "writers".
result.label: ' can' after abstract noun subject

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-start fragment " Eu" (as in Euclid) in math text, plus a few other incomplete word pieces and garbled bytes. Members detect other word-initial fragments like Eu, entrepr, andro, val.
result.label: Eu- word-start fragment (Euclid)

result.description: Fires on "logic" (and the "ic" in "Logic") when it ends a named type of logic such as second-order, propositional, fuzzy or modal logic, in formal logic or math/CS text. Silent on "standard logic" in a symbols sentence.
result.label: Logic in named logic systems

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "omega" (omega-3, omega-6) in nutrition text. It stays silent on hyphens in other compounds like fiber-rich, plant-based and non-starchy. Members include detectors of the "ega" piece.
result.label: Hyphen after omega

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 'es' completing "business|es", especially as the noun after "for/help business" (e.g. "for businesses to..."). It stays silent on 'es' in other words like challenges, weaknesses, establishes.
result.label: 'es' in "businesses"

result.description: Fires on the word " drug" as a modifier noun in scientific or technical text (drug design, drug development, drug efficacy). Members are mostly detectors of " drug" and related biomedical nouns like gene, disease and tissue.
result.label: ' drug' in biomedical compounds

result.description: Fires on the "edy" piece in "Greedy" (greedy algorithms/methods), in computer-science or optimization text. Weak activation on a few other word pieces like "Fram-ing" and "chaos theory".
result.label: "edy" in Greedy

result.description: Apostrophe in a contraction after a pronoun subject (they're, they'll, you'll, it's), especially in rhetorical "X; they're Y" clauses. Silent on apostrophes in n't, let's, or sentence-initial 's.
result.label: Apostrophe after pronoun (they're)

result.description: Fires on relation nouns like "relationship", "connection", "interdependence" that are expected to be followed by "between", especially right after "The" at the start of a document. Silent on "the relationship" mid-sentence in the contrast example.
result.label: Relationship/connection noun before "between"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'u' in the middle of split words, mainly in physics terms like gl-u-on, vac-u-um and fluct-u-ations. It needs the preceding word fragment, as the piece comes after a partial word.
result.label: Mid-word 'u' in physics terms

result.description: Fires on ' creation' (also conception, formation) when it names a stage in a lifecycle or process, as in 'from conception to creation' or 'design creation, deposition'. Silent on other process words in the contrast.
result.label: creation as process stage

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' re' starting a word (receptors, reef, reworking) after a preceding modifier, in science text. It stays silent on 'chemical re|actions', so it needs a particular preceding word or word context.
result.label: ' re' word-start piece after modifier
' contradict' word-stem detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' contradict' (contradictory, contradictions, contradicts), mostly in abstract or philosophical prose. A member from layer 4 that fires on the same token drives it, along with related words such as conflic-, oppos-, and question.

Fires on the 'ous' ending of 'meticulous' (also weakly on 'methodical'), when it modifies a following noun such as care, observation or analysis. It stays silent on 'ous' in other words like 'nebulous' and 'arousing'.
result.label: 'meticulous' word ending

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' in "compet-ing" (competing demands/interests), and weakly on related pieces like oppos-ing or intersect-ing. It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs such as challenging, analyzing, licensing.
result.label: 'ing' in "competing"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ch' in "mer|chandise" (also 'rec' in "recycling"), a mid-word fragment where the word continues. Silent on 'ch' in "tech", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: 'ch' in merchandise

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cru' (start of "crucial"), mostly right after "is" or "are" in a sentence saying something is crucial. Also seen in "crude" and "cruising". Silent when "essential" is used instead.
result.label: ' cru' in "crucial"

result.description: Fires on ' is' when it begins a sentence with no subject, as if the subject was dropped (e.g. ". is crucial to..."). It stays silent on ' is' after a normal subject such as "it" or "this".
result.label: Subjectless sentence-initial ' is'

result.description: Fires on the word "stage" (theatre stage, stage presence, or a process stage), especially when it is the second or repeated "stage" in a compound like "stage fear" or "stage design". Silent in "center stage" here.
result.label: ' stage' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " fluid" (occasionally " liquid" or "-cos/-ous" pieces), mostly as a physics or mechanics noun, as in "fluid dynamics" or "understanding fluid". Members are mainly fluid and solid token detectors.
result.label: fluid (physics noun) token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Ram' at the start of "Raman" (spectroscopy, scattering), a split-word first piece, predicting the continuation "an". Members are mostly ' Ram' detectors plus other word-start piece detectors.
result.label: Ram- piece of "Raman"

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece " bio" / " Bio" that begins compounds like biofuel, bioinformatics, bioenergy, biochemical. It mainly predicts continuation pieces of such words.
result.label: bio- prefix piece

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments right after "ch" (ch-ess, ch-ances, ch-ick, ch-ord) and a few other mid-word pieces like "ASSE-SS". It stays silent on the suffix "ess" in "shallowness", so it needs the "ch" onset.
result.label: "ch" + word-piece continuation (chess, chances)

result.description: Fires on ' reached' when it is a verb with an abstract subject attaining a level or state (e.g. "architecture reached its peak"). Silent on "reached for it", where it means stretching a hand out. Members detect reach/reaching forms.
result.label: ' reached' as attaining a level

result.description: Fires on the word "high" (also High/high-) as a modifier, often opening a compound like high-stakes, high-pressure or high-temperature. Weaker on "low" and "upper". Members are mostly detectors of "high"/"low" tokens. It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "high" word detector

result.description: Fires on the word " formal" as a modifier before a noun, often in history or math text (the formal formulation, formal proof), and pushes toward suffixes like -ization, -ism and -ized. It is silent when "formal" starts the document.
result.label: ' formal' predicting -ization/-ism

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Sem" (Semantic, semiconductor), mostly as the first token of a document or heading. It is a token detector, with weak activation on other word-initial pieces. The logits favor continuations of the word.
result.label: ' Sem' word-start token

result.description: Fires on ' to' introducing a purpose infinitive ("in order to") right after a noun phrase (e.g. "strict measures to minimize"). Silent on prepositional 'to' (adhering to, exposes to) and on 'to' after a verb.
result.label: purpose-infinitive 'to' after noun

result.description: Fires on mixed word pieces and words in academic or technical text (' normal', 'ertain', 'ict', ' broad', ' relative'), often mid-word or at the start of a longer word. Peaks are scattered, and the logits and members show no clear pattern.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments in technical text

result.description: Fires on the token '1' at the start of a number in list or reference numbering (e.g. "11. Chang.¶ 12."), near document start. Silent when '1' begins a year such as 1100 or 1750 in a date range.
result.label: '1' in numbered list items

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece of "beneficial" ('icial') and "advantageous" ('ous'), the final piece of an adjective meaning helpful or favorable, often in biology or adaptation text. Weakly on similar adjective endings.
result.label: beneficial/advantageous adjective suffix

result.description: Fires on the start of a word piece (often ' bo' in boiling, ' ge', ' h') or a participle after "instead of", "not", or "typically/traditionally". It predicts a word continuation piece.
result.label: Word-start pieces after negation/instead of

result.description: Fires on the token ' capacity' (residual capacity, heat capacity, capacity planning/metrics, oxidative capacity). Members are mostly detectors of ' capacity' and close words like ability. The contrast text has no such token.
result.label: ' capacity' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' linear' in linear-algebra text, and also on matrix whitespace and subscript underscores (B_n, C_1) in math. The contrast shows it silent on some ' linear' tokens, so it needs a particular context; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Linear in math contexts, matrix spaces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ivid' in "vivid", mostly in writing and imagery contexts (vivid imagery, vivid detail, vivid color). Members detect 'ivid' and related descriptive adjectives such as vibrant, rich and bright.
result.label: 'ivid' in "vivid"
' how' as embedded clause opener
result.description: Fires on ' how' introducing an embedded clause after a verb or preposition (knowing how, determines how, on how, counting how). It stays silent on ' how' beginning a direct question at document start.
Fires on the word "question"/"questions" (also "questioning") in text about asking questions and communication. Members detect question, ask, answer and objection words.
result.label: question / questions token
Word-start pieces before a suffix
result.description: Fires on incomplete word pieces such as ' dru' (before "gs") and 'power' in "AI-powered", where the word continues with a suffix. Peaks are mixed (dru, power, real, side), so the common thread is a mid-word fragment.

Fires on the word " reform" (and weakly on "re-forms"), mostly as a noun after a modifier like "further", "education" or "orthographic". Members include reform detectors plus related change words such as transform, improvement and change.
result.label: ' reform' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'in' piece at the end of "grain" (gra|in), when the word is split into pieces. It stays silent on 'in' inside other split words like "strain" and "fascinating". Weaker on similar word-internal pieces such as 'ant' in "elephant".
result.label: 'in' inside split word "grain"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ad"/" Ad" at the start of "adjectives" or "adverbs", mostly in grammar lists and headings, where it predicts the continuation "-jective" or "-verb".
result.label: "ad" start of adjective/adverb

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ibr' inside 'calibrate/calibrating' (mid-word fragment), with a few weaker hits on other mid-word fragments like 'erm' in 'undermines'. Silent on 'ibr' in 'vibrations'.
result.label: 'ibr' in calibrate

result.description: Fires mostly on ' composition' and on word pieces like -ization/-ation (e.g. polarization), in science/chemistry text. Peaks are mixed, and it weakly pushes suffix-like continuations. The circuit is low-faithfulness and diffuse.
result.label: composition and -ization suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on a mix of word-ending or word-start tokens, mainly ' turn' (as in turnover), ' view' in "point of view", and ' close'. Peaks are scattered, so the pattern is mixed and low-consistency. The logits show no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: Mixed: turn(over), point of view

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' exc' when it begins a word, most strongly in physics text before "itons" (excitons). It stays silent on "exc" at the start of a document, as in "exciting".
result.label: ' exc' piece in exciton

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ization" when it completes "quant-" (quantization), in physics text. It stays silent on "ization" in "realization" and "magnetization".
result.label: quant|ization suffix

result.description: Fires on the adjective " easy" (rarely " easier") used as a predicate or modifier, as in "easy to locate", "easy-to-", "quick and easy". Upstream members detect easy/quick/simple and the hyphen in "easy-to-".
result.label: ' easy' adjective detector
' under' in "have undergone"
result.description: Fires on the token ' under' when it is the start of "undergone" after "has/have" (a subject that has undergone change). Weaker on other uses of ' under'. Silent on "underwent" after a noun subject.

Fires on the noun " journey" (occasionally " voyage"), mostly in figurative or abstract uses such as a personal, customer or organizational journey. Members are journey/voyage/path/trajectory detectors.
result.label: journey / voyage noun

result.description: Fires on mid-word or compound pieces such as hyphens in 'step-by-', 'sh' in 'handshake', 'que' in 'torque', and symbols like τ, μ or the 2 in CO2. It seems to expect a word continuation. Mixed evidence; hyphens are only partly specific.
result.label: Hyphen and mid-word continuation pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " all" as a quantifier, such as "for all", "that all" or "all angles". It appears mostly in abstract or foundational statements and also in word-start pieces like "all-" in "allergies". The circuit is mostly " all" detectors.
result.label: Token ' all' quantifier

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " poly" (also "Bi-ote", "Music", "sym") when it begins a technical term in materials or chemistry text, e.g. "polyethylene and [poly]propylene". Silent on plain chemistry headings.
result.label: poly- prefix in materials terms

result.description: Fires on the token ' convergence', mostly in mathematical contexts such as series and theorems. It fires more weakly in linguistic or economic uses. Upstream members detect convergence, 'gence' and related words like fusion and intersection.
result.label: ' convergence' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' rem' (occasionally ' alleg') when it begins a longer word such as reminder, remediation or remnants. Members are detectors of ' rem' and similar word-start fragments.
result.label: ' rem' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on short Cyrillic syllable fragments (ку, ско, де, на) inside garbled, nonsensical pseudo-Russian text. Members mostly detect Arabic/Cyrillic/Japanese word pieces. Weak and inconsistent; faithfulness is poor.
result.label: Cyrillic syllable pieces in garbled text

result.description: Fires mainly on " process" (also "clause", "ule") as a head noun after a scientific or technical modifier, e.g. "conversion process", "glycolytic process". Silent on "process" in generic contexts like "preparation process". Members are biology/science-flavored.
result.label: Process noun after scientific modifier

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings mid-word, mainly 'ness' in "har-ness-ing", also 'ing' in "light-ing" and 'cent'. Silent on 'ness' as a noun suffix (consciousness, alertness, boldness). Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: harness-ing / lighting word pieces

result.description: Fires on the past participle " described" after "has been", "as" or a noun, as in "described by" or "described as". Members detect similar passive participles (seen, identified, compiled, mentioned) and describe-forms.
result.label: passive "described" participle

result.description: Fires on the word ' not' (negation after auxiliaries or 'be', also 'not only'), mostly in technical or logical text. Boosts next-token words like 'just', 'only', 'necessarily'. The contrast example lacks the token 'not' altogether.
result.label: Negation ' not' token

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' batt' (as in "battles") and ' brut' (as in "brutal"), mostly in war and fighting contexts. It fires on the unfinished word piece, before the word is completed.
result.label: ' batt' / ' brut' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on ' one' as a predicate pronoun right after a copula ("is one of", "was one of"), introducing a "one of many/several" construction. Silent on ' one' as a modifier or substitute noun elsewhere.
result.label: "is/was one (of)" after copula

result.description: Fires on the word "Virtual"/"virtual" (e.g. Virtual Memory, Virtual Reality, virtual network), especially as a capitalized title word. Its members are mostly detectors of this same token. It nudges the next token towards things like environments, settings and locations.
result.label: Virtual token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'il' inside scientific terms (nucleophilic, electrophil-, fertilization), plus 'ity' and separators like '-' or '/' in number strings. Mixed and weakly consistent; the circuit is a poor fit.
result.label: 'il' word piece in science terms

result.description: Fires on ' and' (sometimes ' or') joining two abstract nouns or noun phrases in academic-style text, e.g. "cultural identity and displacement". Quiet on ' and' after commas or joining clauses.
result.label: ' and' joining abstract noun phrases

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' psych' (as in psychology, psychological, psychologist), mainly when it follows other academic or field words, and predicts the continuation "-ology/-ological". Silent on unrelated linguistics text.
result.label: ' psych' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' in', possessive 's, ' the', word pieces) right after a subject noun in academic or technical text, where a verb or predicate is expected next. It is silent on ' in' after 'results in' or 'increase in'.
result.label: Subject noun before predicate, academic text

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' pers' (as in perspectives, persistence, persuasion), when it begins a longer word split into pieces. Predicts word continuations like 'istence', 'pect', 'ding'. Silent on ordinary text without this fragment.
result.label: ' pers' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' O' (also ' star'/' Star'), mostly the O of Big-O notation in algorithm complexity text, and also on O as a standalone letter in lists. Members are mostly ' O' token detectors.
result.label: Letter ' O' (Big-O notation)

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: surnames in lists of "Dr./Professor Name" lines (Davis, Jenkins, Williams), plus word-piece 'im' inside words, and occasional ' to'. Mixed peaks with low consistency; no single clear condition.
result.label: Surnames in title lists, 'im' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'estr' inside "orchestration/orchestrate", and weakly on ' Complex' (e.g. Histocompatibility Complex). Members mostly detect 'estr' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'estr' in orchestration

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' R' when it starts a capitalized name or term (Rousseau, Risk, RNA), with weaker firing on pieces like 'gar' in avant-garde. Predicts continuation pieces of the word, not a full word.
result.label: Initial ' R' word-piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Ne' when it begins a word like Neural, Neumann or Neuronal, mostly inside title-like text. It is silent on ' Ne' in 'Neutron'. Also fires weakly on 'elling'.
result.label: ' Ne' piece before 'ural/umann'

result.description: Fires on the noun ' culture' (society's customs), often after a modifier like foreign, popular, Irish or one. Silent on the adjective 'cultural'. Members detect culture/cult/cultural word pieces.
result.label: ' culture' noun token

result.description: Fires on a colon that follows a short title, heading, label or list item (e.g. "The Silk Road:", "Wake up:", "Russian:"), where a description or value comes next. Silent on plain name lists ending in periods.
result.label: Colon after heading or label

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' las' (as in laser/lasers), and weakly on 'photo', 'nan', 'hist' fragments, in physics and optics technical text. It pushes toward completions like 'er', 'ers', 'onic'.
result.label: 'las' of laser word-start

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'end' in comm-end-ation, 'im' in Ferr-im-agnetism, and 'od' or 'ens' in similar split words. It needs a longer word that is still being spelled out. It is silent on 'end' in the name Brendon.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in long words

result.description: Fires on the word " contrast" (also "contrasting", "comparison"), mostly in art, design and media discussions of contrasting elements. Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of the same token, plus juxtaposition/opposites pieces.
result.label: ' contrast' word detector

result.description: Fires on ' systems', ' dynamics', 'phenomena' or ' forces' when they end a physics or dynamical-systems phrase, such as "dynamic systems" in differential-equations text. It stays silent on 'systems' after other modifiers (vector, microfluidic, complex).
result.label: dynamic systems / dynamics in physics

result.description: Fires mostly on " along" after a noun in technical or scientific text (e.g. "quantity along the curve", "sediment along the coast"). It also fires weakly on scattered other tokens. Logits are mixed and unclear.
result.label: ' along' in technical text

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' app' when it starts a longer word (appliances, approximations, apples, apposition). It is silent on 'app' in 'appetizers', so it needs a particular continuation.
result.label: ' app' word-initial fragment

result.description: Fires on verbs of sending or transmitting (send, transmit, transmitting, carry) in explanations of signals, neurons and communication systems, where the next word is likely a signal, message or wave.
result.label: send/transmit verbs for signals

result.description: Fires on mid-word or ending pieces of zoological/biological terms (dinosa-urs, mamm-als, verte-br-ates, reproduct-ive) in biology text, predicting further taxonomic or reproduction-related word pieces.
result.label: Biology animal-term word pieces

result.description: Fires on an incomplete word-stem piece (' confront', 'ile' in dilemmas, ' discuss', ' compreh') in abstract academic text, where the next token is a suffix like -ation or -ions that finishes the word.
result.label: Word stem awaiting suffix (confront-ation)

result.description: Fires on the piece 'r' inside a split word, mainly "neut-r-ino(s)" and "aber-r-ation", where the next piece is a suffix like 'ino' or 'ation'. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'r' in neutrino / aberration

result.description: Fires on tokens inside the noun phrase right after "through" or "via" (e.g. mechan-isms, advoc-acy, the arts), where a means or channel noun is expected next. Logits favor 'channels', 'means' and 'methods'.
result.label: Noun phrase after "through" (means)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "omorphic" completing "Geomorphic" (e.g. "Geomorphic Mapping", "Geomorphic cycles"). Members detect "omorph" pieces and earth-science word fragments.
result.label: Geomorphic 'omorphic' word piece

result.description: Fires on ' rules' (and following ' of'/' and') when discussing rules, norms, or conventions governing language or systems; predicts governing words like rules, codes, conventions. Members are rule/legislation/linguistic detectors.
result.label: Rules governing language/systems

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'y' (also 'bb', 'os', 'b') inside a word split into pieces, like rec-y-cling, lob-b-ying, lo-y-alties. It stays silent on word-final 'y' as an adjective suffix (dusty, rosy).
result.label: Mid-word 'y' piece (recycling, lobbying)

result.description: Fires on 'lies' in 're|lies' ("relies on"), after a subject like a field or discipline at the start of a document. Members detect rely/relied/relies forms, so it predicts "on".
result.label: "relies" verb piece 'lies'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ic" completing "strateg|ic" (Strategic) in business or management text. It predicts planning-type next words such as "planning" and "decision".
result.label: "ic" in "strategic"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' aw' when it starts "awareness" (after words like heightened, increasing, global, phonological). It pushes the next token towards 'aren'. Weakly fires on 'aw' in "awakening".
result.label: ' aw' start of awareness

result.description: Fires on adjectives or adjective endings (conducive, specific, appropriate, -able, rich, needed) where a complement or "enough/than/-ness" could follow. Silent on 've' in other words (conveying, they've), so it depends on the adjective role.
result.label: Adjective ending awaiting complement

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' cru' (before "cial") and ' fa' (before "cial"/"una"), where the next piece is a specific completion. It predicts suffixes like 'cial', 'unal', and 'ness'.
result.label: cru-/fa- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires mostly on " inclusion" (and sometimes " efforts"), especially in "diversity and inclusion" in business/organizational text. Stays silent on unrelated contexts. Logits weakly favor organization/commitment-type continuations.
result.label: Diversity and inclusion (efforts)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' und' at the start of a longer word, such as undermine, undeniable, undo and undue. The prediction pushes towards continuations like 'erm', 'uly' and 'ul'. It stays silent on the contrast text.
result.label: ' und' prefix in undermine/undeniable

result.description: Fires on the word "green" (greenhouse, green technology, green principles, blue-green), strongest in "greenhouse" contexts and weaker for the eco-friendly sense. Predicts continuations like "house" and "thumb".
result.label: green token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " land" (also "Land" and "landscape") in academic text about land use, terrain and landscapes. It is silent on unrelated geoscience text. Members are mostly land detectors.
result.label: " land" token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' clause' in grammar text, especially after 'independent', 'dependent' or 'relative'. Members detect 'clause', 'sentence' and 'verb' tokens and grammar-topic context. Silent on the contrast passage about punctuation.
result.label: ' clause' in grammar text

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ot' (also 'ry', 'bra') inside longer words, especially "den|ot|ation" and similar multi-piece words. Members detect 'ot'/'ou'/'os' fragments in the middle of split words.
result.label: Mid-word 'ot' fragment in denotation

result.description: Fires on ' to' right after "correspond(s)/corresponding" (also weakly after words like opposite, due, response), where 'to' is a preposition linking to an object. It stays silent on infinitive 'to' (necessary to, used to).
result.label: 'to' after correspond

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ac' (also ' Ac') when it begins a longer word such as "acids", "acquisition" or "acoustic". Its members are mostly ' ac' detectors, and the logits point to continuations like "quisition".
result.label: ' ac' word-start piece

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'medi' in "X-mediated" (cell-mediated, gravity-mediated), with weaker hits on other tokens like ' particular', 'ced', ' rates'. Silent on 'medi' in "intermediates".
result.label: 'medi' in -mediated compounds

result.description: Fires on the token " Luther", mostly in "Martin Luther" (Reformation context, also Luther King). Members include many Luther detectors plus Reformation, Church and Germany context features.
result.label: Luther in Martin Luther

result.description: Fires on ' the' (occasionally ' these', ' this') when it appears in an unusual slot with no normal preposition or verb governing it, such as right after a noun or verb ("verbs the dynamic", "something the user knows"). It stays quiet on ordinary ' the' after a preposition or verb.
result.label: Out-of-place 'the' after noun/verb

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "process" (also weakly "art of"), where a gerund or action noun follows, like "process of decomposing". Silent on other "of" uses such as "inclusion of" or "layers of".
result.label: "of" after "process"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' inher' (inherent/inherently), which is the start of a longer word, and occasionally on similar prefixes like ' rel' or ' inn'. It predicts suffixes such as 'ent' and 'ently'.
result.label: inher- word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on 'ological' in 'technological' and on ' industrial', in contexts about industrialization or technological progress and advancement. It predicts words like 'advancements', 'transformation' and 'progress'. It is silent on a bare 'ological' with no 'techn' before it.
result.label: technological / industrial progress words
' per' in science/perception text
