result.description: Fires on the token ' per', both as the word-start piece in perpendicular, permeability and perception, and as "per" in unit phrases like "weber per square meter". It is silent on "perspectives" in the contrast.

Fires on " of" right after a quantity noun like "amount(s)", "quantities", "levels", "a lot", where a mass or substance noun comes next. It stays quiet after "impact", "example", "combination" and "application".
result.label: "of" after amount/quantity nouns

result.description: Fires on the pronoun ' It' when it starts a sentence, especially at the start of a document or after a full stop. It weakly fires on sentence-initial 'They'. The next-token logits are weak.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'It'

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' Ph' / ' ph' (also 'Ph') when it starts a longer word such as phases, phonetics, phonological or pharmaceutical. It predicts continuations like 'arma', 'on' and 'oto'.
result.label: Word-initial 'Ph' piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' narr' (start of narrative, narrator, narration), mostly in literary-technique lists. The members are mostly their own ' narr' detectors, and the target predicts suffixes like 'ative'.
result.label: ' narr' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the hyphen in "easy-to-…" compounds (easy-to-understand, easy-to-access, easy-to-read). Stays silent on hyphens in other compounds like subject-verb, well-constructed, real-time.
result.label: Hyphen in easy-to- compounds

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after the prefix "eco" / "Eco" (eco-friendly, eco-conscious), and weakly on "e-". It stays silent on hyphens after other words like single-, well-, market-, vegetable-.
result.label: Hyphen after eco- prefix

result.description: Fires on plural nouns like norms, conventions, boundaries, ending a phrase after "challenge/break away from conventional/traditional". Silent on "norms" in neutral sociological contexts, so it needs the challenging or defying-convention construction in arts and literature.
result.label: Challenged conventions/norms/boundaries plural noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'wise' (pointwise, pairwise) and on ' hand' in 'on the other hand', plus weaker on adverb/suffix pieces like -worth, -eless. Seems to mark word-ending or discourse-adverb pieces that precede a modifier or contrast.
result.label: '-wise' suffix and 'other hand'

result.description: Fires on the plural ending of "strategies" and "interventions" (also "measures", "plans") in public-health and program-planning text about developing or applying approaches. Silent on "strategies" in business pricing text and on "economies".
result.label: Strategies/interventions plural ending, health planning

result.description: Fires on the 'st' piece inside "cry-st-allization" (and variants like crystallation, crystalline), and sometimes 'ieval' in "retrieval"-like words. Needs the word-piece after "cry"; silent on the word's other pieces.
result.label: 'st' in crystallization

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' completing "electromagnetic" (occasionally 'ien' in "Experiencing" nearby). Silent on 'ic' in other words like isentropic, atmospheric, proficiency. Members detect 'electromagnet' and related physics context.
result.label: 'ic' ending of electromagnetic

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lig' in "negligence"/"negligent" (legal tort text). It stays silent on 'lig' in "ligopolitic". Members are detectors of word-start pieces in multi-token words, including 'lig' in oligopoly.
result.label: 'lig' in negligence

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'old' in "uphold(ing)" and 'cis' in "exercises", where the word is unfinished and a suffix like -ing or -es follows. Weaker on pieces like 'cept' and 'ens'.
result.label: Word-piece 'old' in uphold, 'cis'
' caps' token detector
result.description: Fires on the token ' caps' in ice caps, small caps and similar phrases. Members are mostly detectors of preceding word pieces and ' caps' itself. The contrast has no ' caps' token.

Fires on the first piece of a field or discipline name right after "in the field/realm/world of" (bi-, chem-, psych-, ac-, tissue, programming). It predicts academic field words like sciences, engineering, medicine.
result.label: Field name after "realm of"

result.description: Fires on ' ensure' and similar verbs of providing or securing (' provides', ' enable', ' stabil-'), mostly when the verb follows a normal subject or purpose phrase. It stays silent on some ' ensure' tokens that follow a word run together with no space, as in "vergence ensure".
result.label: ensure / provide verbs

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments such as " termin" (terminology, terminates), and on "based" after "cloud-", plus a few other word pieces. These are pieces that need a suffix such as "-ology" to complete the word. Mixed evidence; peaks are inconsistent.
result.label: ' termin' and 'cloud-based' word pieces

result.description: Fires on the verb ending 's' of "highlights" (also ' highlight', 'delves') when a document section or case is the subject, e.g. "section highlights the importance of". Silent on other plural or verb 's'.
result.label: Section "highlights" verb ending

result.description: Fires on verbs of hindering or restricting (h-inder, limit, damp-en, hamp-er, inhibit, under-pin) when the word is a verb that will take an object, often after "can/may". It predicts word-ending pieces.
result.label: Hinder/limit verb pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' br' when it begins "brush/brushes" in art-tool text, predicting 'ush'. Silent on other art text without this piece; weak on 'br' in 'brands' and 'car' in 'carving'.
result.label: ' br' starting 'brush' in art text

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a food word split into pieces, mostly ' sau' (before "ce"), also ' corn' and ' ol' (olives), in cooking and ingredient text. Members are food and cooking detectors plus ' sau' detectors.
result.label: Split food word start: sau(ce)

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'icians' at the end of "mathematicians", the plural-person ending after "mathemat". Members detect 'icians' and related person-plural endings, plus math-topic context.
result.label: 'icians' in mathematicians

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "in" as the ending of a biochemical/protein name (tropomyosin, myosin, actin, serotonin), in muscle and biology text. It stays silent on the standalone preposition "in".
result.label: -in suffix in protein names

result.description: Fires on the token ' X' (also ' x') when it is used as a variable name, mostly in math or statistics text such as "random variable X" or "topological space X". It also fires on X in names like X-ray or XRF.
result.label: Variable X token

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in contractions after a pronoun subject like you're, we're, they're. It stays silent on possessive apostrophes and on n't contractions such as isn't.
result.label: Apostrophe in pronoun 're contractions

result.description: Fires on the word " fit" (also "fits", "beat", "match") across senses, such as mechanical fit, fitness function, and matching or aligning. Members are mostly " fit" token detectors in early layers.
result.label: ' fit' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('en', 'end', 'if', 'ron') right after the prefix "ser" in words like serendipitous, serenity, serenading, serif, serrations. Members detect these fragments after "ser".
result.label: Word pieces after "ser-" prefix

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (or 'cing') at the end of verbs meaning affect/impact/influence, such as "impacting" or "influencing". It stays quiet on 'ing' after other verbs like aligning or conducting.
result.label: -ing of affect/impact/influence verbs

result.description: Fires on uppercase acronym pieces like ET, AC, AN inside early computing names such as ARPANET and ENIAC, in computing-history text. Weaker on other name fragments like cithara and Giotto.
result.label: Acronym pieces in ARPANET/ENIAC

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ip' inside words like Equipment, viviparous and Hip-hop. It also fires more weakly on ' Card', ' Set' and ' card' at the start of a term. Predicts word-continuation pieces.
result.label: 'ip' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (vie-wer, pla-cement, c-ues, g-ears) after "visual", design or color words. It pushes toward visual/viewer/layout words. Design and cooking-presentation context is needed.
result.label: Word start in visual design text

result.description: Fires on the 'e' in the abbreviation "i.e." (and similar "e.g." pieces) when it opens a parenthetical clarification. Silent on 'e' inside ordinary words such as "sleeves".
result.label: 'e' in "i.e." abbreviation

result.description: Fires on the word piece " mus" when it begins "muscle(s)", mostly in anatomy text about muscle types, and predicts "cle/cles". Weaker on "in" in "confinement" and a few other word starts.
result.label: ' mus' start of muscle

result.description: Fires on plural count nouns naming technical items or categories (branches, processes, classes, groups, records, frames), mostly in computing text, when used as the subject or object of a clause. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Plural technical collection nouns

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (zy, inet, ichi, emat) inside technical science terms like kinetics, kinematics, stoichiometric, mostly in chemistry/physics text. Weaker on Arrhenius and gluten. Silent on the whole word 'mechanics'.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of chemistry/physics terms

result.description: Fires mainly on dash tokens (' --', em dash) used as parenthetical or appositive breaks in running prose, and secondarily on ' organization'. Dash members dominate the circuit; it is silent on text without such dashes.
result.label: Dash punctuation (' --') and 'organization'

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of proper names and rare or foreign words (' York', 'Moh-awk', 'Mon-tero', 'Mag-gio', Cyrillic 'ности'), mostly where a name or word is incomplete. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Mid-word name fragments

result.description: Fires on the 'on' piece (sometimes 'phon') right after 'ph' in words like phonemic, phonology, phonon, predicting continuations such as 'eme' or 'ological'. Silent on 'on' in other words like jargon or phenomenon.
result.label: 'on' in ph-on words

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization'/'ize'/'izing' right after "visual" (visualization, visualize). It stays silent on the same suffix in other words like personalization and optimization.
result.label: visual + -ization suffix

result.description: Fires on a comma that follows a sentence-ending period, so the comma starts a new sentence, often lowercase. It stays quiet on ordinary mid-sentence commas, such as list commas or commas after clause openers.
result.label: Comma right after a period

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mark' when it begins "markets" (e.g. "financial mark|ets", "money mark|ets"), mostly in finance text. It predicts the continuation 'ets'. Weaker on general "markets" contexts.
result.label: ' mark' in "markets" (finance)

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' imag' (as in imagery) and ' stim' (stimuli) after sensory words like "visual" or "vivid", predicting the suffix (ery, uli, ulus). Mostly in writing and sensory-perception discussions.
result.label: imag/stim word-start before suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ul" inside multi-piece words such as pend-ul-um, vocab-ul-ary, post-ul-ates, cell-ul-ose and hydra-ul-ic. It is weaker on similar pieces like "ati" or "mon".
result.label: "ul" piece inside longer words

result.description: Fires on plural category nouns like systems, platforms, models, tools that end a noun phrase inside a list of technical examples (e.g. "X, Y systems or Z"). Silent on some 'systems' outside such enumerations.
result.label: Technical noun in example lists

result.description: Fires on abstract drive/motivation nouns, mainly " passion", the "ition" piece of "ambition", and " vision" (also desire, belief). Often follows "driven by" or "embodiment of", and the logits point to suffix-like continuations.
result.label: Passion / ambition / vision nouns

result.description: Fires on ' toler' (tolerance) and the 'ance' ending of words like reliance, in business/technical prose. Mostly the word-start piece ' toler' that precedes 'ance'; the members detect ' toler' and '-ance' pieces.
result.label: toler- / -ance word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word right after a form of "draw" (draws the viewer, draws attention, draw on), mostly ' the'. It stays silent on ' the' after other verbs or prepositions. Predicts attention/conclusion-like objects.
result.label: Word after "draw(s)" (draws the viewer)

result.description: Fires on word endings like "iency"/"ency" (proficiency, fluency, competency) and sometimes "skill", in text about language ability or skills. Predicts "in" or skill-related continuations.
result.label: Proficiency/fluency word endings
Differential Equations title 'iffer'
result.description: Fires on the 'iffer' piece in capitalized "Differential Equations" titles or headings, especially at document start. It stays silent on lowercase "differential equations" in running prose.

Fires on the suffix 'iveness' (also 'ive') at the end of "cost-effect|iveness", especially in cost-effectiveness in health policy. It stays quiet on 'iveness' in plain "effectiveness" or "competitiveness" lists.
result.label: cost-effectiveness suffix 'iveness'

result.description: Fires on the noun " identification", mostly right after "the" as the head of a nominal phrase (e.g. "the identification of risks"). Silent on the verb form "identifying". Members are mostly identification/detection/recognition detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: noun "identification" after "the"

result.description: Fires on " often" (also "sometimes", "utter") as a frequency adverb right after a subject noun phrase, before the main verb (e.g. "design often includes"). Silent when "often" follows "were/is" or "Though".
result.label: Frequency adverb "often" after subject

result.description: Fires on ' to' (occasionally ' for') right after "in order", the purpose-clause opener, especially at the start of a document. Silent on other infinitive ' to' after nouns or verbs. Predicts adverbs like "effectively" or "properly".
result.label: "to" after "in order"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' divers' and ' coh' (also ' rev') that begin a longer word like diversity, cohesion, revitalization, in cultural/linguistic/social-policy text. It is silent on some ' divers' tokens in other phrasing contexts.
result.label: divers-/coh- fragments in cultural text

result.description: Fires on the plural nouns ' computers' and ' machines' (also 'factories'), mostly as the head noun after a modifier like personal, quantum, classical, or traditional. Silent on 'computer science'.
result.label: computers / machines plural noun

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-start piece ' del' (as in "delicate"), and also on ' incomplete', 'complete' and ' Deep'. Members are mostly ' del' token detectors from earlier layers. Weaker on "delicacies" and "Delphi".
result.label: ' del' piece of "delicate"

result.description: Fires on ' also' used as an additive adverb after a subject noun, clause boundary or comma (e.g. "period also", "; also", ", also known as"). Silent on ' also' after an auxiliary verb ("had also been") or at text start.
result.label: Additive ' also' after subject/clause

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'enn' in Penn/Venn, 'or' in absorbing/absorption, and 'up' in follow-up, where a word is still unfinished. It stays silent on 'or' in 'tailor'. Evidence is mixed, with a low consistency of 38%.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: enn, or, up

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ess' inside split words, most strongly in "Montessori" (also chess, Politeness). Mainly a detector of the 'ess' fragment mid-word; weak activity on other fragments.
result.label: 'ess' piece in Montessori

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " ret" when it begins a longer word, most strongly in "online retailers/retailing/retail". Members are mostly " ret" detectors (retention, retina), and the target predicts continuations like "ail".
result.label: " ret" word-start fragment (retail)

result.description: Fires on the token ' land' (ground, territory), including as the start of compounds like landowner, landfill, landscape. Members are mostly ' land' detectors across earlier layers. Predicts continuations like 'sc', 'sl', 'marks'.
result.label: ' land' token detector

result.description: Fires on the letter token 'Q' (or ' Q') used as a symbol, such as an orthogonal matrix Q or the Q in QED. It predicts that more capital letters follow. Members are mostly Q-token detectors.
result.label: Letter Q symbol/acronym token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expl' when it begins a word like exploration, explores or explorers, and predicts the continuation (oration, ores, oring). Silent when ' expl' starts the text or appears as a sentence-initial ' exploring'.
result.label: ' expl' word-start (explore/exploration)

result.description: Fires on the prefix token " inter" (or " Inter") as a word-start piece, e.g. in interference, interstellar, intertwined, interrelated. It predicts continuations like connected, ference, play, tw.
result.label: ' inter' prefix token

result.description: Fires on word pieces in title or heading-like text at the start of a document, mainly 'chni' in "Techniques" and ' Background', plus a few other mid-word pieces. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Heading word pieces: Techniques, Background

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like " Lip"/" lip" (lipase), " equilib", " sol" in science/chemistry/biochemistry text, usually mid-word where the next piece completes a technical term. Members are mostly word-piece and chemistry detectors.
result.label: Technical word-start fragments (Lip, equilib, sol)

result.description: Fires on the word "electron" (and "electrons", "Electron") in physics and chemistry text about atomic structure, such as configurations, shells and transfer. Members are mostly electron-token detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: electron token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Ar" (Arbitrage, Arithmetic, Arcade, Arcia) when it begins a longer word that continues in the next token. Members detect similar word-initial pieces like Tre, Tri, At, Alg.
result.label: Word-initial ' Ar' fragment

result.description: Fires on the 's' (or 'S') that ends a decade plural like 1970s, 80s or 90's, usually after a year number. It stays silent on possessive 's after names and nouns.
result.label: Decade suffix 's' (1970s)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' acc' (start of "accent") in linguistics text, and weakly on ' subject' and ' object'. Members are detectors of acc/inc/sc word-beginnings plus grammar and language vocabulary.
result.label: ' acc' in accent (linguistics)

result.description: Fires on the token ' home' (also in word starts like home-omorphic, homeostasis, homeopathy), in phrases such as "at home" and "from home". Members are mostly ' home' detectors across layers.
result.label: ' home' token detector

result.description: Fires on abstract head nouns (terms, case, context, level, form, domain, course) right after "in/at the" and before "of", as in "in terms of" or "in the context of". Silent in plain descriptive text.
result.label: Abstract noun before "of" (in terms of)

result.description: Fires on the adjective ' unique' (also 'uniqu-' and ' distinct') when it modifies a following noun such as identities, patterns or characteristics, mostly in cultural or linguistic text. It is silent on some 'the unique' contexts.
result.label: unique / distinct adjective before noun

result.description: Fires on ' it' right after the conjunction "when" (also weakly after "as"), especially in "when it comes to". Silent on ' it' at clause starts after a comma, colon or semicolon.
result.label: ' it' after "when"

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract action or process noun (distribution of, arrangement of, application of, study of), predicting a following object noun like data or communication. Silent on some ' of' after similar nouns, so the cause is unclear.
result.label: ' of' after process nouns

result.description: Fires on the possessive " our" when it follows a verb or preposition and comes before a noun, as in "shape our bodies" or "guide our decisions". It is silent in the contrast text, which has no " our".
result.label: possessive "our" before noun

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' fol' (mostly before "ding", as in folding dough or protein folding), occasionally ' fla' in "flaky". Silent when ' fol' starts the document, so it needs preceding context.
result.label: ' fol' piece before -ding

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'hip' completing words like craftsmanship, sportsmanship, artisanship. It depends on the preceding word stem (craftsmans-), and it is weakly active on 'asure' in treasure.
result.label: 'hip' suffix in craftsmanship

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ert' inside words like exert/exerted/inertial, and on ' of' after 'pair' (also group/set of). Silent on 'ert' in 'fingertips'. Mostly science-style text.
result.label: 'ert' in exert; 'pair of'

result.description: Fires on " called" (and sometimes " as" after known/referred/labeled) when introducing a name or label for something, just before a quoted or named term. Members detect called/known/referred/as naming words.
result.label: naming verb "called" before a label

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ibration' completing "calibration" (after "cal"), and weakly on similar suffixes like 'ization' in "synchronization". Silent when 'ibration' starts the text without "cal" before it.
result.label: calibration suffix 'ibration'

result.description: Fires on " providing" (also " provided") as a participial clause after a comma or conjunction, e.g. ", providing opportunities for". Members detect provide/provides/providing forms and predict object nouns like insight.
result.label: participial "providing" clause

result.description: Fires on 'lock' in the name "Sherlock" (before Holmes), typically in analogies like "akin to Sherlock Holmes". It stays silent on 'lock' in unlock or flock.
result.label: Sherlock 'lock' token

result.description: Fires on the word " above" in its spatial or positional sense (high above, lies above, bounded above, orbiting above). Members include detectors of above/below/beyond and related position words. Silent on text without the word.
result.label: ' above' token detector

result.description: Fires inside "ratio of the ..." / "degree or duration of ..." phrases in science text, peaking on word pieces like "incidence", "sound", "the" after "ratio of". Predicts quantity-like continuations (required, total, quantity).
result.label: Quantity/ratio "of" phrases in science

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' direct', ' a', ' them', ' an') right after verbs like "view/treat" in "some cultures viewing direct criticism as...", where an adjective/noun object is expected. Weak, mixed evidence; logits are not coherent.
result.label: Object slot after view/treat verbs

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ment' in fer-ment-ation and 'ers' in imm-ers-ive, where the word continues with a suffix (-ation, -ive, -ally). Silent on 'ment' ending complete words like entertainment.
result.label: Mid-word piece before suffix (ferment, immers)

result.description: Fires on the word "algorithm" and its case and plural variants (Algorithm, algorithms), including when it is the stem of "algorithmic". Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token or its pieces. It stays silent on other words like "algebra".
result.label: Algorithm word detector

result.description: Fires on the word " domestic" (as in domestic industry, production, currency), mostly in economics and trade text after a verb like protect or boost. Members detect domestic/local/national-type adjectives.
result.label: ' domestic' in trade economics

result.description: Fires on ' DNA' (also 'le' in "nucleic" and ' gene') in molecular biology text, such as DNA replication, templates, and nucleic acids. It is quiet on cDNA in an unrelated cloning context.
result.label: DNA in molecular biology

result.description: Fires on word pieces that mark a part of a period or an ordering, mainly ' latter' (the latter half) and 'colon'/'ital' inside post-colonial or revitalization. It also fires weakly on 'Early'. Mixed tokens, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: 'latter' and period-part word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Conf" (capitalized), mostly in heading-like text such as "Conflict Development" or "External Conflict", where it is the first piece of "Conflict". It predicts continuations like "lict".
result.label: " Conf" start of Conflict

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of folklore/legend words ('ore' in folklore, 'ends' in legends, ' tales'), in text about myths, folk traditions and stories. Predicts next tokens like trad(itions), tales, stories, songs.
result.label: Folklore and legends word endings

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns like "environment", "atmosphere", "culture" (also "ambiance") right after "create/foster a/an", as in "create an environment of trust/conducive to". Predicts continuations like "conducive" or "of trust".
result.label: Created environment/atmosphere/culture noun

result.description: Fires on the adverb " highly" (rarely " extremely") when it sits before an adjective in technical or descriptive text, predicting adjectives like complex, efficient, stable. Members are detectors of "highly" and similar degree adverbs.
result.label: Degree adverb "highly" before adjective

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " fu" in "fossil fuels", where the next piece is expected to be "els". It also fires more weakly on " coal" and " fuel". Members detect fossil, fuel, coal and oil/gas tokens.
result.label: "fu" of fossil fuels

result.description: Fires on abstract part-noun heads like "aspect", "component", "part", "step" right after an importance modifier such as "fundamental", "core", "central" or "key", as in "the fundamental aspect of...". It stays silent when the noun is not in that slot.
result.label: aspect/component noun after 'fundamental'

result.description: Fires on the token " he" (also "he", " she"), both as the pronoun and as the start of a word like "heating", "heal", "pantheon". It is a token-level detector, and the logits favor continuations like "avy", "fty" and "aval".
result.label: Token " he" detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ot' inside "denotation/denotative" (after "den"), in semantics discussions. Stays silent on 'ot' in "negotiation". Members detect 'ot'/'ou' pieces mid-word.
result.label: 'ot' in denotation
' black' token detector
result.description: Fires on the word ' black', mostly in physics text before 'hole' (black holes), and also in red-black tree node text. Members are mostly ' black' detectors plus 'hole' and 'dark' related latents. Predicts ' hole'.

result.label: ' pers' start of 'perspectives'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pers' when it begins the split word "perspectives", usually after adjectives like "different", "multiple" or "cross-cultural". It predicts the continuation 'pect'.

result.label: Word-initial ' t' before continuation
result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' t' (or ' T') when it begins a longer word split into pieces, such as t-test, tense, tau, tonal, tapestry. It is silent on a sentence-initial 'tension'. Members are ' t' detectors that predict continuations like -endency and -ense.

Fires on the verb ending 'als' in 'reveals' (also 'poses' in 'exposes') when an abstract subject, such as a study or analysis, is said to reveal or expose something. Silent on 'als' in nouns like 'universals' or in 'falsifiability'.
result.label: reveals/exposes verb ending

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' trig' (trigonometry, trigonometric, trigonal), a fragment that precedes a completing suffix like 'onometry'. Members are mostly detectors of ' trig' and of other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' trig' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' Indones', ' por', 'pers', ' Por' that need a continuation (Indonesia, pores, superset). Predicts word-completing suffixes such as 'ence', 'ouse', 'ridge'.
result.label: Word-start fragments awaiting completion

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Reg' (also ' reg') when it begins a longer word split into pieces, such as Regression or Reggae/Reggaeton. Members are detectors of Reg/reg and similar word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' Reg' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on abstract extent nouns like " scope", " course" (as in "over the course of") and " depth", usually after "the" and before "of". Contrast silent on unrelated text. Members are mostly detectors of these tokens.
result.label: scope/course/depth noun before "of"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ru' in the middle of words like Instruments, Interruptions, Congruence (and ' cru' in crucial), predicting a continuation such as 'cial' or 'ptions'. Silent on 'ru' in 'disruptions'.
result.label: 'ru' word-piece in Inst-ru-ments, Inter-ru-ptions

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' caus' at the start of words like causality and causal, where a suffix (-ality, -al) is expected next. Members are mostly ' caus' detectors across layers.
result.label: ' caus' word-piece (causality/causal)

result.description: Fires mainly on " Carlo" in "Monte Carlo" (methods, simulation, algorithms), with weaker firing on " computational" in numerical/simulation text. Members detect Carlo and simulation/numerical-methods words.
result.label: Monte Carlo (Carlo token)

result.description: Fires on sequence/outcome adverbs, mainly " finally" and " ultimately" (also "eventually"), often after a comma, semicolon or "and" before a verb. Many members detect "finally" itself, including repeated ones.
result.label: finally / ultimately adverbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece " rep" when it begins "replication", mostly in DNA replication and biology or science text. It stays silent on unrelated text. Weak activation appears on " sy" in "syllables".
result.label: " rep" in "replication"

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ing" completing "wield" (wielding), and weakly on similar pieces like "unyielding". It predicts objects of wielding such as influence, tools, weights. It stays silent on "ing" in other verbs.
result.label: -ing suffix of "wielding"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' eng' when it starts "engage/engaging/engagement", mostly right after "and" or a verb. Predicts continuations like "agement" and "aging". Mostly silent after "for" in one contrast example.
result.label: ' eng' start of engage-words

result.description: Fires on the document-start/boundary token (shown as ¶) when it follows a short list-like line of topic headings (e.g. "Volcanoes. Earthquakes."), at the start of the next heading. Silent on the start token in some other contexts, such as prose openings.
result.label: Boundary token after topic-list headings

result.description: Fires on frequency adverbs ' typically' and ' usually' after a plural or generic subject in explanatory statements (e.g. "phrases usually begin with"), where a general rule or pattern is being described. Weakly on ' primarily'.
result.label: typically/usually generic-statement adverbs

result.description: Fires on "particles" and related words (interaction, interact) in quantum entanglement text, about entangled particles and non-local interactions. It stays silent on "particles" in other physics contexts, such as subatomic or charged particles.
result.label: Entangled particles/interactions in quantum text

result.description: Fires on a hyphen or en dash inside a multi-part hyphenated compound, such as infrastructure-as-a-service, what's-in-it, or Side-Side-Side, where the dash is the second or later link. Silent on simple prefix hyphens like tree-, ever-, one-, after-.
result.label: Hyphen within multi-part compounds

result.description: Fires on ' cross' (and sometimes ' run') as a word-initial prefix piece before a hyphen or continuation, as in cross-border, cross-cultural, cross-validation, surface run|off. Predicts compound continuations.
result.label: cross-/run- compound prefix

result.description: Fires on the word "emphasis" (its final piece "is") and on "focus", where the next word is likely "on" or "attention". It appears mostly in art and design composition text. It stays silent on "is" in unrelated words.
result.label: emphasis/focus, predicts "on"

result.description: Fires on the middle word piece 'or' or 'hor' inside "rhetoric/rhetorical" and "metaphor/metaphoric", where a suffix like -ic or -ical is expected next. Weaker on similar mid-word pieces such as "stylistic".
result.label: Mid-word 'or' in rhetoric/metaphor

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' spac' when it begins "spacetime" (e.g. flat spacetime, curvature of spacetime), predicting the continuation "etime". Members are mostly detectors of ' spac' and of other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' spac' in spacetime

result.description: Fires on the word-initial token ' A' / ' An' (e.g. 'An' of 'Ancient', matrix 'A', 'A' in AI), where the next piece continues a word or name. Silent on 'A' inside 'AAS' after 'within'. Logits are mixed.
result.label: Capital A / An token

result.description: Fires on 'ate' completing the word "innate" (inn|ate), in discussions of innate abilities, immunity or structures. Predicts nouns like effects, dependency, relations. Members detect 'ate' and related pieces like intrinsic.
result.label: 'ate' in "innate"

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens in the middle of a technical word, mainly 'red' in Infrared and ' v' in "vibrations", in spectroscopy and chemistry text. It is silent on 'red' in "ingredient".
result.label: Word pieces in spectroscopy terms

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' orbit', ' reg' (regul-) and 'g' in 'congestion', mostly in repeated or scientific text. Members detect orbit, regul and con-fragments; the target seems to predict word continuations like -ulation, -olds.
result.label: orbit / reg / con-g word fragments

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' strateg' (before "ies") and ' phys' (before "iology"), mostly after a modifier noun such as "pricing" or "Endocrine". It predicts the suffix continuation; it is silent on some ' strateg' contexts.
result.label: strateg-/phys- word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after "one" in the "one of the most/key..." construction (also "One of" at sentence start). Silent on ' of' after other nouns like "aspect of" or "part of".
result.label: ' of' after "one"

result.description: Fires on the capital letter "B" as a standalone symbol or abbreviation start, such as "Role-Based", the event B in P(A|B), or B-tree. It predicts uppercase continuations.
result.label: Capital B as symbol/abbreviation

result.description: Fires on the capital letter "N" (mostly inside acronyms like miRNAs, NMR, NLP) where it begins or sits inside an all-caps abbreviation. It is strongest in RNA-type words and in "NMR".
result.label: Capital N in acronyms

result.description: Fires on a plural category noun (factors, aspects, areas, fields, methods, species) right after "other" in phrases like "among other factors" or "or other methods". It stays silent after "these" or "external".
result.label: Noun after "other" in lists

result.description: Fires on ' like' right after a perception or linking verb (seem, sound, feel, look) where it introduces an impression or comparison ("may sound like an overkill"). Silent on ' like' as a preposition after a noun, colon, or "much like".
result.label: 'like' after seem/sound/feel/look

result.description: Fires on verbs or copulas (have, are, may, lead) and words like non/absent in statistics or technical prose, where a negative or deficient predicate (non-uniform, absent, errors) is expected next. Silent on neutral 'have been made'.
result.label: Verbs before negative or deficient predicate

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' c' (lowercase, with space) as a fragment starting a longer word like "cement", "cash", "cues", or as a coefficient variable c1 in math. Predicts word continuations such as 'ater', 'oded', 'ues'.
result.label: Standalone ' c' fragment token

result.description: Fires on the minimizing adverb ' merely' (also ' essentially'), especially in "is essentially merely" or "as merely" phrasing that reduces something to a simple role. Members detect merely/just/simply/essentially.
result.label: merely / essentially minimizer adverb

result.description: Fires on the adjective " simple" (occasionally "straightforward" or "rud-"), mostly describing basic or early versions of technology, tools or systems. Members detect simple/basic/primitive words. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Adjective "simple" (basic/primitive)

result.description: Fires on function words and modifiers (' the', ' a', ' our', '-', ' as') in astronomy/stars text, especially before a noun describing a stellar or physical object. Silent on ' the' in physics/chemistry phrases like "in the context of". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Determiners in astronomy text

result.description: Fires on "communication" (or the "ation" ending of "Communic-ation") especially after a modifier like "digital" or "virtual", as in headings or technology topics. It is silent on some "communication" tokens where no such modifier precedes it.
result.label: Digital communication word

result.description: Fires on the words "Material"/"material" and on "liquid"/"fluid", mostly in science and engineering text (materials science, physical states). Members are mainly detectors of the token "material(s)", with a few for "fluid" and "liquid". Logits are not clear.
result.label: material / liquid / fluid words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sed' that begins "sediment(s)/sedimentology" in earth-science text, predicting 'iments'/'iment'. Weakly fires on 'oph' in "sophisticated". Members are detectors of ' sed', ' foss' and geology-related pieces.
result.label: ' sed' start of sediment

result.description: Fires on record-keeping and preservation words (document, documentation, archive, museum) in text about preserving languages or cultural heritage. It predicts preservation-related nouns such as "preserved", "repositories" and "collections".
result.label: Documentation/archive/museum preservation words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ough' completing "Dough", mainly in baking or dough-preparation text where "D" opens a heading or sentence. Weak on 'ough' in "tough" and on other word pieces.
result.label: 'ough' in "Dough"

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after a comma that opens a causal clause ("..., as it will allow"), meaning "because". It stays quiet on ' as' in other uses, such as "as well as", "serve as", or comparisons.
result.label: clause-initial causal 'as' after comma

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Cal" at the start of a name, mostly in "John Calvin" (also Calvinist), where the next piece is expected to complete the name. Weakly fires on other split name or word beginnings.
result.label: Cal- in Calvin

result.description: Fires on nouns like "methods", "method", "techniques", "forms" right after "traditional" (or similar words like conventional or ancient). It is silent on "methods" that lack that preceding "traditional" cue.
result.label: methods/techniques after "traditional"

result.description: Fires on the token ' chain' (and pieces like 'ains', 'ain'), mostly in 'supply chain', also 'chain reaction' and 'Markov chain'. Silent on unrelated text such as hash-map collisions. Promotes next tokens like reaction, networks, nodes.
result.label: ' chain' token, supply chain

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment (mostly 'cer', also 'h', 'l', 'bon') inside a longer split-up word such as sincerity, ulcer, carbohydrates, coulometry. It needs the word to be spelled in pieces and predicts a continuation fragment.
result.label: Mid-word fragment 'cer' in split words

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "system(s)" (e.g. "system A", "systems of", "systems that"), where the next word is likely about the system's behavior or monitoring. Quiet on "behavior" without a preceding "system".
result.label: Token following word "system(s)"

result.description: Fires on the word " diagonal", mostly in linear algebra text about diagonal matrices. Members include math and matrix context detectors (linear, eigenvectors, multiplication) and a diagonal token detector. Silent on other matrix text like "inverse matrix".
result.label: " diagonal" in matrix text

result.description: Fires on the 'vity' piece completing "longevity", mostly in talk of extending shelf life or product durability. Also weakly on "lifespan" (pan) and "durability". Members detect lifespan/life/durability word pieces.
result.label: longevity 'vity' suffix

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start or continue compounds: 'ogether' (sentence-initial "Together,"), hyphen after "sea", and ' rece' in "receivers". Mixed pieces; members detect 'together', hyphens, and sea-related pieces.
result.label: Compound pieces: ogether, sea-, rece

result.description: Fires on ' early' used as an adjective meaning 'earliest/ancient' before a plural noun (early predecessors, early cave paintings). It stays silent on ' early' in date phrases like 'early 19th' or 'the early part of'.
result.label: ' early' as 'ancient/primitive' adjective

result.description: Fires on 'optimization' and the -izing/-ising/-ization endings of 'optimize' (optim|izing), i.e. the word optimize and its forms. It stays silent on -izing in other words like minimizing or emphasizing, so it needs the optim- stem.
result.label: optimize / optimization word forms
Mid-word fragments 'unct' in conjunctive
result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces such as 'unct' in "conjunctive"/"disjunctive", also 'os' in "presuppositions" and 'look' in "overlooked". It fires on an incomplete word that is continuing, in grammar and logic text.

Fires on the word-start piece " Id"/" id" that begins "idiom(s)" or "idiomatic", as in "Idioms in Business" headings and "linguistic idioms". Members are detectors of this piece, and it predicts continuations like "ios"/"iom".
result.label: ' Id' piece starting 'idiom'

result.description: Fires on the word piece " lever" (also "voy", "man", "aver") where a suffix like "-age/-aging/-agers" is likely to follow. Members detect stems such as man, eng, rein, contract, and push toward "aging/ages/aged".
result.label: ' lever' stem before -age suffix

result.description: Fires on the document-start token (<s>) when it appears right after a sentence-ending period in concatenated text, i.e. a new document or list item beginning after a short title-like sentence. It is silent on some other start tokens.
result.label: Document-start token after period

result.description: Fires on " be" / " being" as a passive or copular auxiliary after modals or "to" (must be, to be, R being), predicting an adjective or participle like considered, viewed, valid. Quiet on some "can be" / "would be" cases.
result.label: be/being before participle or adjective

result.description: Fires on the token ' sum' (and pieces like 'sum' in summing, Gauss sum), mostly in math text such as "a sum of", "direct sum". Weakly fires on other 'sum'/'mar' word pieces like summers. Members are mostly ' sum' detectors.
result.label: ' sum' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' impress' in "impressive", the stem before the suffix. It predicts continuations like "ive" and related achievement words. Members detect similar stems (impress, achiev, compet, persu, delight).
result.label: ' impress' stem of impressive

result.description: Fires on the token " dialect" (including before suffixes like -s or -al) in linguistics text about language variation and dialect continua. Members are mostly detectors of "dialect" and related pieces. It is silent on general communication text.
result.label: ' dialect' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word right after a conversion verb (translate, convert, transform), typically the object noun such as "mechanical", "source", "high", where "into" is expected next. Silent after other verbs.
result.label: Object after convert/translate verb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' int' when it begins a longer word (intimacy, intimate, intentionally) after a preceding word, where more letters must follow. Silent when ' int' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' int' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces: " aqu" (start of aquifer/aquatic), " efforts"/" attempts", and " members"/" memb". Mostly token-specific detectors feed it; no shared context is evident.
result.label: efforts / aqu- / members tokens

result.description: Fires on the token ' revolution' in every sense: solids of revolution, political, scientific, agricultural and digital revolutions, and the start of 'revolutionized'. Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token. Logits favor suffixes like -ized and -ary.
result.label: ' revolution' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ang' inside "entangled/entanglement" after "ent", predicting "lement". It stays silent when 'ang' starts the word without the "ent" prefix. Weakly fires on 'rop'/'hal' after "ent".
result.label: 'ang' in entanglement

result.description: Fires on the token " computing" (also "computation"), strongest after a modifier like "quantum", "mobile" or "distributed". It stays silent when " computing" starts the text with no preceding modifier.
result.label: ' computing' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ens' when it ends a plural noun such as "kitchens" or "gardens". It stays silent when 'ens' is inside other words such as "utensils" or "indispensable".
result.label: 'ens' ending plural nouns (kitchens)

result.description: Fires on the middle piece 'oz' or 'o' inside geological era names such as Mesozoic, Paleozoic and Cenozoic, in the middle of the word. It is silent on other text.
result.label: Mid-word 'oz' in geological eras

result.description: Fires on the word " culture", mostly in organizational or leadership text ("organization's culture", "company culture"). Members detect culture and related leadership, organization and vision words.
result.label: Organizational "culture" token

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' narr' (narrative) and ' po'/' Po' (poetic, poetry) in literary text, where the word is incomplete and likely continues with 'ative' or 'etry'. Silent on ' narr' in 'narrators' at text start.
result.label: Incomplete narr-/po- word starts

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' pr' when it is split off at the start of a word, mostly in 'pricing' (e.g. "penetration pr|icing"), and predicts 'icing' as the continuation. Also fires weakly on other split prefixes such as 'pr' in 'Pronoun'.
result.label: ' pr' prefix before 'icing'

result.description: Fires on the 'berg' piece in the name Gutenberg (printing press inventor), with weak firing on ' press' in printing-related text. Members include printing-topic detectors and other 'berg' name detectors.
result.label: Gutenberg 'berg' token

result.description: Fires on the word " quantum" (and the start of "Quantum") across physics and computing text. Members are mostly detectors of "quantum" or "Quant|um". It predicts continuations like computing, bits, gate and advantage.
result.label: quantum token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'et' inside the word "diet" and its derivatives (dietary), after the 'di' piece. It stays silent on 'et' in other words like "appetizer".
result.label: 'et' in "diet"

result.description: Fires on words like "accessible", "available", "share" in text about digital media distribution (music, streaming, online content), where the next word is likely online/broadcast/files. Needs the digital-access topic.
result.label: Digital content accessibility words

result.description: Fires on the word " research" (occasionally " study") as a noun in scientific or methodology text, such as "biological research" or "research findings". Next-token logits favour words like "integrity" and "Valid". Members are mostly detectors of "research" and related science words.
result.label: " research" in scientific methodology text

result.description: Fires on the word " overall" used as an adjective before a quality noun (overall quality, performance, health). It predicts nouns like picture, quality, health, satisfaction. Members are mostly " overall" detectors.
result.label: adjective "overall" before quality noun

result.description: Fires on the word ' hard' (as in hardness, hard faced, as hard as), mostly when it begins a compound or derived word. Next-token logits favor word continuations like core, ships, working.
result.label: ' hard' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on noun-forming suffixes 'ance'/'ence'/'ness' completing words like "elegance" or "essence", mostly in abstract, mathematical-beauty prose. Silent on 'ance' in verbs like "enhance". Members detect elegance/beauty/symmetry words.
result.label: elegance/essence noun suffix

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ize/izes/izing" in "emphasize", after the "emphas" stem, where an abstract subject (theory, approach, perspective) is followed by an object like "the importance of". It stays silent on "ize" in "symbolize" and "prioritize".
result.label: emphas-ize suffix

result.description: Fires on ' As' (occasionally ' With') as the first word of a new document or paragraph right after a document-start break. It is often the start of a word like Asset or Aspect, or a sentence opener like "As the...".
result.label: Sentence-initial ' As' at document start

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'en' (also 'or', 'og') right after 'Y' in "Yenisei/Yeniseian". It stays silent on 'en' in other words like Quenya or showcasen.
result.label: 'en' inside Yenisei word

result.description: Fires on the token " art" / " Art" (also the start of "Artistic"), most strongly in "culinary art" and in art-topic headings. It stays quiet on some uses, such as "mixed media art" and a bare "art of plating".
result.label: Word "art" / "Art"

result.description: Fires on the plural nouns "concerns" and "questions" (occasionally "issues") as the object of "raises" or after an adjective like "ethical" or "privacy". It predicts "about" or "regarding" next.
result.label: concerns/questions raised about

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' inclus' (start of "inclusive/inclusiveness"), occasionally on ' invent' in "inventory". It is predicting a word-continuation suffix. Members are mostly detectors of ' inclus' and ' divers'.
result.label: ' inclus' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the distributive determiners " every" and " each", mostly right after a preposition or conjunction ("with every plate", "where each instrument", "in each") in descriptive prose. It predicts a singular noun next.
result.label: Distributive every / each

result.description: Fires on the token ' just' when it is the start of a word like justification, justifiable or the adjective "just" (fair). It pushes the next token toward suffixes such as -ification, -ifiable, -ness. Weaker on the adverb "Just like".
result.label: ' just' as justice/justification stem

result.description: Fires on ' two' (also ' composite') in technical or academic text, often before a noun or hyphenated term like "two-dimensional", "two points", "two or more". Members are mostly detectors of 'two', 'three' and 'four'.
result.label: 'two' / 'composite' in technical text

result.description: Fires on the 'ant' piece completing "vibrant", especially in "a vibrant and dynamic" praise of arts or culture. It weakly fires on ' dynamic' and similar lively adjectives, and it pushes towards nouns like landscape, scene and spirit.
result.label: 'ant' in "vibrant"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in the middle of long, rare words (Log-arith-mic, Babyl-oni-ans, Pyth-agoras, rhyth-ms, org-anoid), where the word is still unfinished and a suffix piece like 'mic' or 'ans' is expected next.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of rare words

result.description: Fires on ' So' at the start of a repeated "Soil ..." heading in a list of topic headings, and on 'il' in words like fossil or fertilization. It seems to predict the "il" continuation of "Soil".
result.label: 'So' of Soil headings, 'il' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' aud' (start of audit/auditor/auditory) mid-sentence, especially after "internal" or "external", predicting continuations like 'it', 'itory', 'itor'. Silent when ' aud' begins the text.
result.label: ' aud' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ological', 'tery', 'ING', 'en' and 'on' inside longer or split words. It is silent on 'ological' after 'bi'. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Mid-word suffix fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' character' (also 'character-' pieces) used as a modifier noun, as in "character development" or "character traits". It predicts continuations like ' development' and '-ize' suffixes. It is quiet on the contrast text.
result.label: ' character' as modifier noun

result.description: Fires on verbs meaning "make better" (enh-ance, improve, cultivate, facilitate) right after "can/to", predicting an object like skills or abilities. Silent on noun "governance".
result.label: Improve/enhance verb before object

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'bo' (carbohydrate, bamboo) and 'in' (violin), where the word is unfinished and a continuation is expected. Mostly these specific word pieces in particular words.
result.label: Mid-word 'bo' / 'in' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' fi' (before 'ber', as in fiber/fibreglass) and on ' arms' (as in arms race), i.e. tokens that begin a known word or compound. Members detect ' fi', ' fib', ' arms' and similar word starts.
result.label: ' fi' (fiber) and ' arms' (arms race)

result.description: Fires on the end of "virtual/augmented reality" (the "ality" piece, " reality") and the closing parenthesis of the abbreviation "(AR)" / "(VR)", in technology text about immersive media.
result.label: Virtual/augmented reality terms

result.description: Fires on the prefix " micro" / " Micro" / " macro" (as in microstate, microscopic, microblogging), where a word continuation like -scope, -state or -phone is expected. Members are mostly detectors of this prefix.
result.label: micro/macro prefix token
'b' in 'turbines'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'b' inside split words, mainly 'tur|b|ines' in energy and power-generation text. Also seen in 'micro|b|acterium' and 'he|b|domar'. Members are 'b' detectors.
Fires on " memory"/" Memory" right after "virtual"/"Virtual" (virtual memory). It stays silent on "memory" as a modifier in other computing phrases, such as "memory latency" or "memory footprint".
result.label: "memory" in "virtual memory"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ge' that begins geography/geographic/geo- words (geopolitics, geology), and predicts 'ography', 'ographical' or 'opol' next. Weaker on 'geological'. Members are mostly ' ge' detectors.
result.label: ' ge' start of geography words

result.description: Fires on ' this' (occasionally ' her') right after a preposition or phrase like "central to", "in", "for", before a noun. It is silent on sentence-initial or clause-initial ' this'.
result.label: ' this' after preposition

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'eth' in the middle of words starting with "m" like methane, methyl, methylation, and also in bioethics. Needs 'eth' inside a word after a preceding piece. Weak on similar mid-word pieces such as 'am' and 'ys'.
result.label: 'eth' piece inside methyl-words

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens that precede a suffix-like continuation: ' container' before "ization", 'e' in "in-e-fficiency", ' ###' heading at document start, ' Princi'. Logits favor word-piece continuations such as 'ffic'. Mixed evidence.
result.label: Mixed tokens predicting word-piece continuations

result.description: Fires on the "iation" piece in "negot|iation" (negotiation), predicting words like tactics, skills, power. It stays silent on "iation" in "remediation", so it needs the negotiation word.
result.label: negot-iation word piece

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "existence" (also "presence"), in abstract math/logic/philosophy text. It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "nature", "validity" or "combination". Predicts a following noun phrase such as "additional", "novel" or "new".
result.label: " of" after "existence/presence"

result.description: Fires on the verbs "begin/begins/start/starts" (and "began", "Begin-ning") when they introduce the onset of a process or action, typically followed by "with" or "to". Members are detectors of begin/start forms.
result.label: begin/start verbs

result.description: Fires on ' by' introducing the agent after a passive past participle (created by, formed by, laid by, provided by). Silent on ' by' after other verbs/nouns or in non-agent uses (plagued by, abide by, reducing X by).
result.label: Passive agent ' by'

result.description: Fires on the underscore of a LaTeX/math subscript right after a variable (k_1, x_1, r_1, m_1), where an index like 1 or 2 comes next. Silent on a differently formatted polynomial example.
result.label: Subscript underscore after math variable

result.description: Fires on the word piece " dual" (dualism, dualistic), mostly as the start of a longer word, and weakly on other word-start pieces like " coord" and " mechan". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: " dual" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on abstract action nouns and word pieces such as " use", " assigning", " allocation", " creation", " application" and "unct" (in punctuation). Silent on " use" when it follows an adjective or modifier, as in "correct use" or "advanced use". The members are mostly generic, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Action nouns like use, allocation

result.description: Fires on the word " flow", most strongly in "the flow" of a narrative or text (disrupting/maintaining the flow), and also in technical flow contexts. Weakly on "cos" in cosmic/cosmos.
result.label: ' flow' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " algorithm" (also "Algorithm"), mostly as a singular noun or stem before "-ic" as in "algorithmic". Its logits push towards suffixes like "ic" and "ically". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' algorithm' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "market" (and "markets", "mark|ets") in business and marketing text, such as market entry, market research, marketplace. Members are mostly detectors of market/mark/ets tokens.
result.label: Market word in business contexts

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer word, mainly 'oph' in "Diophantine" and ' Des' in "Descartes". It needs the preceding piece (Di, René) and predicts the word's continuation. It is silent on the complete word "Cogito".
result.label: Mid-word fragments: Di-oph, Des-cartes

result.description: Fires on the final piece of biochemical compound names in metabolism text (oxaloacet-ATE, acetyl-Co-A, -ine), not on 'ate' as a verb ending like initiate or accelerate. Needs a biochemistry context.
result.label: Metabolite name endings (-ate, CoA)

result.description: Fires on the word " relative" (relative pronouns/clauses, relative motion or velocity), and occasionally on " dist" in words like distortion. Silent on "possessives" text without the token. Many members are " relative" token detectors.
result.label: ' relative' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " internal" (also weakly on similar words like "inner" or "immediate") as a modifier before a noun, mostly in physics and thermodynamics text such as "internal energy". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' internal' modifier token

result.description: Fires on the last word of a subject noun phrase inside semicolon-separated lists of abstract process or topic items (e.g. "teaching methods", "pricing", "sentences"), at the point where a verb like "should" or "is" comes next. Silent on "should" itself.
result.label: Subject noun before verb in lists

result.description: Fires on the pronoun " it" (also "they") as the subject of a clause, strongest after comparative "as" ("as challenging as it sounds") or a conjunction. It is quiet when "it" is an object, as in "make it seem" or "spot it".
result.label: Subject 'it' after 'as'/conjunction

result.description: Fires on " system"/" systems" right after "closed" (or similar physics/thermodynamics qualifiers), as in "closed system" in energy conservation text. Silent on "system" in other positions, e.g. after "with" or "the".
result.label: "system" after "closed"

result.description: Fires on the token ' approach' (method or strategy sense), usually after an adjective or modifier such as "systematic approach" or "waterfall approach". Members are mostly detectors of ' approach' itself.
result.label: ' approach' token detector

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' p' (the letter or a word-initial fragment like p-norm, prime p, pH, p-ausing), predicting continuations such as 'rag', 'unch', 'iv'. It stays silent when ' p' starts a word like 'pragmatist' at document start.
result.label: Lowercase ' p' token fragment

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns ending a noun phrase in linguistics or communication text (text, language, discourse, information, representation), where a comma or "and" often follows. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Language/communication noun heads

result.description: Fires on " has"/" have" as the auxiliary right after a singular or plural abstract subject, like a technology or social trend (internet, social media platforms), before a verb like "altered" or "allowed". Silent on a bare " has" with no such subject.
result.label: has/have after technology-trend subject

result.description: Fires on the token ' Fourier' when it follows "of" in a phrase like "Background of Fourier Analysis" or "Concept of Fourier Transforms". It stays silent when 'Fourier' opens a document, so it needs preceding context.
result.label: ' Fourier' after 'of' mid-text

result.description: Fires on the topic word (Market, Transport, Communic, Trade, Health) right after "Global"/"International" in title-like headings of topic lists, expecting a noun-compound continuation. Silent on "Market" in a heading without global/international before it.
result.label: Topic word after "Global" heading

result.description: Fires on the word-piece right after an initial "t" token when a word is split (t|ides, t|ire, t|et|ragonal, t|ipping, t|une, t|ours). It needs the word to be split with a bare "t" start.
result.label: Continuation piece after split "t"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " bi" (biased, biological, biomedical), a fragment that is continued by a suffix. Silent in one sentence-initial "In bi-" example, so the condition is unclear. Predicts continuations like ased, ological, omet.
result.label: ' bi' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after an abstract quality noun, often the last item in a list like "efficiency of" or "durability of". It stays quiet after nouns like behavior, force, conduct or grammar.
result.label: ' of' after abstract quality nouns

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' dem' that begins words like demographic, democracy, democratic. Silent on a sentence-initial ' dem' in "demands". Many members detect ' dem' itself.
result.label: ' dem' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' synth' (synthesis, synthetic, synthesizer) across chemistry, biology and music text. It predicts continuations like 'esis' and 'etic'. Upstream members are mostly ' synth' detectors.
result.label: ' synth' word-start piece

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix piece "ories" completing "memories" (after "mem"), with weaker firing on related memory/recall words. Members detect "memory", "recall" and "ories" tokens.
result.label: "ories" in "memories"

result.description: Fires on determiners (' a', ' an', ' their', 'ader' in broader) right after the verb "reach"/"reaching" (or "approach"), predicting goal-like nouns such as threshold, peak, destination, equilibrium. Silent on the same determiners after other verbs.
result.label: Determiner after "reach/reaching"
'ob' piece in aerobic/anaerobic
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ob' inside "aerobic" and "anaerobes/anaerobic", mostly in biology or metabolism text. Weaker firing occurs on other mid-word pieces such as 'roph' and 'ol'.

Peaks are scattered across unrelated tokens (' ten', ' own', '/', ' pairs', name fragments), often in grammar or possession text. No dominant token or clear condition. The circuit failed faithfulness, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and possession tokens

result.description: Fires on the word " audience" (the listeners of a speaker or writer), mostly after "the", "your" or "intended" in text about communication and presentations. Upstream members are audience/reader/viewer detectors.
result.label: ' audience' in communication text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "att" inside "lattices" (crystal/Bravais lattices), and weakly on similar mid-word pieces. Members are detectors of "att" and other word fragments like "ym" in "lymphatic".
result.label: "att" in "lattices"

result.description: Fires on the word "balance" (also "Bal|ance", "balancing", and weakly "equilibrium") as a noun, e.g. balance of trade, balance and symmetry. Logits favor "sheet". Members are mostly detectors of balance/equilibrium tokens.
result.label: balance / equilibrium noun

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'iene' completing the word "hygiene" (after "hyg"). Predicts next words like standards, practices, training. Members detect 'iene' and related word pieces in sanitation and food-safety text.
result.label: 'iene' in hygiene

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " adv" (of advances/advancements) when it begins a sentence or clause after a full stop or comma in technical text. It stays silent when " adv" follows an adjective like "significant" or "technological".
result.label: Sentence-initial " adv" (advancements)

result.description: Fires on the word " analysis" (or "Analysis") as the head noun after a modifier such as Fourier, harmonic, functional or image, mostly in mathematical text. Weaker on general uses such as "better analysis". Its logits favour ' processing' and ' algorithms'.
result.label: ' analysis' after field modifier

result.description: Fires on " type"/" types" in programming text about type systems (static/dynamic/explicit/implicit type declarations, conversions). Weak in non-programming uses. Members include type/typing detectors and programming-language context.
result.label: "type" in programming type systems

result.description: Fires on the word "Interface"/"interface", mostly in "User Interface" within UI/UX design text. Members detect interface, user experience and related design words before it.
result.label: "Interface" in user interface

result.description: Fires on the ending piece "ics" (or "ytics") in "analytics", especially in data/business analytics contexts. It stays silent on "ics" in other words such as economics, robotics or photonics.
result.label: "ics" ending of "analytics"

result.description: Fires on the "ense"/"enses" piece completing the word "tense(s)" in grammar contexts (verb tense, past tense). It stays silent on "ense" in "suspense", so it needs the tense word.
result.label: "tense" grammar word ending

result.description: Fires on a mid-word piece (e.g. 'on', 'ens', 'ol') inside a longer word being spelled out or repeated, such as Decol-on-ization or Ath-ens. Often predicts a continuation suffix. Silent on 'on' in Pantheon or Organon.
result.label: Mid-word piece in multi-token words

result.description: Fires on the token "free" (including " free" and "Free"), as in "lock-free", "wait-free", and the "free" in "freezing". Upstream members are mostly detectors of "free" itself. Weaker activity appears on "secure".
result.label: "free" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " Marine" (rarely " marine"), mostly as a list-item heading of a science field at the start of a document, e.g. "Marine Biology", "Marine Ecology", "Marine Geophysics". Silent on other subject lists.
result.label: " Marine" in field-of-study headings

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "istic" completing the word "heuristic" (Heur-istic), mostly before "algorithms". It stays silent on "istic" in words like "probabilistic" and "sophisticated".
result.label: "istic" in "heuristic"

result.description: Fires on the word " Earth" (the planet), mostly in earth-science text after "of", "on", "in" or "the", often just before "'s". Members are mostly Earth-token detectors.
result.label: Earth token (planet)

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes inside longer words, mostly 'ic' in "stylistic", also 'me' in "permeated" and 'ge'. It stays quiet on 'ic' in words like Neoclassicism or mosaic, so it needs the specific host word.
result.label: Suffix piece 'ic' in stylistic

result.description: Fires on the word ' specific' (occasionally ' certain' or ' particular') when it follows a verb or preposition like target, meet, identify or focus on, introducing a narrowed-down object. Predicts nouns like needs, goals and requirements.
result.label: ' specific' after targeting verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' lingu' (also 'ingu') when it begins "linguistic(s)" or similar words, typically after a modifier like cognitive or computational. It predicts continuations like 'istic'/'istics'. Silent on one "compares lingu-istic" example.
result.label: lingu- word piece (linguistics)

result.description: Fires on nouns naming a measurable physical property (color, weight, mass, size) in lists of material or chemical properties, especially after "molecular" or in property enumerations. Silent on generic technical prose.
result.label: Material property nouns (color, weight)

result.description: Fires on function words (the, of, like, and) inside lists of educational or historical institutions and developments, such as "institutions like the", "the rise of". Predicts academic nouns next. Silent on "the" in other contexts.
result.label: Function words before academic/institution nouns

result.description: Fires on a standalone space token that precedes a year number's digits, especially after "from around", "from about", "between" in date-range phrases for historical periods. Silent on spaces after "the" or "late" before century or decade numbers.
result.label: Space before year in date range

result.description: Fires on the final token of a group or people noun (people, tribes, settlers, -ers, -ants) right after an ethnic or indigenous word, in history and culture text. It seems to predict what comes next for that group.
result.label: Group noun after indigenous/ethnic term

result.description: Fires on abstract structure nouns "complexity" and "hierarchy", and the suffix "able" in "manageable", typically after "the" or a modifier; members are detectors of these words.
result.label: complexity / hierarchy / manageable

result.description: Fires on the token ' acid' in chemistry text (acid-base, acidic strength, hydrochloric/citric acid). Predicts suffix continuations like 'ity', 'ic', '-'. Silent on cooking text about seasoning. Members are mostly acid-token detectors.
result.label: ' acid' token in chemistry

result.description: Fires on the 's' in decade plurals written with an apostrophe (1940's, late 1970'S) and on ' either' after a modal like "can either". It stays silent on possessive 's' and on decades without an apostrophe. The two triggers look unrelated.
result.label: Apostrophe decade 's and 'either'
'ged' inside 'tragedy'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ged' in 'tra-ged-y' (tragedy/tragedies). It stays silent on 'ged' in other words such as 'judged' or 'emerged'. It fires weakly on 'iv' in 'pivotal'.

Fires on the word ' product', mostly in mathematical uses (product rule, dot/inner/Cartesian product, product of functions). It is weaker in 'productivity' and commercial uses. Upstream members are mostly ' product' token detectors, with some math-topic members.
result.label: ' product' token, math sense

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' V' (VR, VPN, VLAN, Vision) and on 'oe' inside onomatopoeia or thermoelectric, where the token is an early fragment of a longer word or acronym. Weak on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: ' V' and 'oe' word fragments

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mainly 'chni' in "Techniques" and 'ide' in "epidemics", also 'cont' in "subcontinent". Fragment is only active inside those particular words, in the middle of a split word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: Techniques, epidemics

result.description: Fires on punctuation or connecting tokens (comma, parenthesis, "of", "out") right after "first", "first-generation", "First-In, First-Out" and similar ordinal/initial-stage wording. Members detect "first-" hyphens and stage/step words. Silent on ordinary list commas.
result.label: Token after "first"/initial-stage phrase

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces at the start of a longer word or number, mainly ' retro' (retrofit), ' pover' and the '2' in "Early 20th century". It seems to predict a word or number continuation. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-start fragments: retro, pover, 2(0th)

result.description: Fires on "implementing"/"implement"/"applying" and on "of" right after "implementation"/"application" (implementation of X). Silent on "of" after other nouns like development or optimization. Predicts an object like policies or strategies.
result.label: implement/apply verbs and "implementation of"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' fa' when it begins a longer word, mostly "facial" (also "fauna"), and predicts the continuation 'cial'. Weak on similar split starts like ' eigen' and ' ps'.
result.label: ' fa' piece before 'cial'

result.description: Fires on the 'ive' suffix completing "intuitive", in UI/design text where interfaces or navigation come next. Stays silent on 'ive' in collective, immersive, reflective and adaptive.
result.label: 'ive' in "intuitive"

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces (-its, -ctions, -els, -itors) completing audit/inspection-related plural or agent nouns in compliance, safety, and oversight text. Members detect audit, inspect, insurance, and scrutiny word pieces.
result.label: Audit/inspection word endings

result.description: Fires on the token ' World' (World War, World of, World Cup, WorldView), mostly as the capitalized first word of a proper name or phrase. Members are mostly ' World' detectors.
result.label: Capitalized ' World' token

result.description: Fires on the piece 'isk' in "Risk" when it starts a document or heading, as in "Risk Assessment" or "Risk Mitigation". It stays silent on a bare 'isk' without the "R" before it.
result.label: 'isk' in heading "Risk"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, such as ' bro' (broiler), ' tem' (temples), ' fert' (fertility), ' quart' and ' scalar'. It seems to anticipate a suffix continuation, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (bro, tem, fert)

result.description: Fires on the word " integrated" (as in "integrated circuit" or "integrated with"), in both adjective and participle uses. It pushes toward "circ", "circuit" as the next token. Members detect integrated, integration and embedded.
result.label: ' integrated' token detector

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "higher"/"high" (higher-order, high-energy) in technical or math text, plus a few word pieces like "ree" in degree and "ie" in Curie. Silent on hyphens after words like real, grid, term, complex.
result.label: Hyphen after "higher" compounds

result.description: Fires on the copula " is" right after a abstract subject noun phrase like "The key to X" or "The core of X", where a complement or definition follows. Silent on " is" after pronouns, relative "that/which", or casual subjects.
result.label: "is" after "The key to X"

result.description: Fires on "from" (or "From") that starts a range or enumeration, as in "from X to Y". It usually comes after a colon, a sentence break or a list-introducing clause. It stays silent on "from" meaning origin or source inside a clause.
result.label: range-opening "from" (from X to Y)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece "Equ"/"equ" (Equilibrium, Equival-, equity, equipped), mostly at the start of a document or heading. It predicts continuations like "ips", "ilib", "ity". Members are detectors of the same piece.
result.label: Equ- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on verbs of making, mainly ' create', ' creating', ' produce', after "to" or a comma, in artistic or design descriptions. Predicts an adjective or noun describing the result (memorable, striking, visual).
result.label: create/produce verbs in art text

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "cers" completing "producers" (produ|cers). Members are mostly detectors of "cers" after "produ" and of the producer/produce meaning. Rare weak firing on other tokens.
result.label: "cers" in "producers"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ins' when it follows a preceding word like health, auto, or private and begins 'insurance' (or 'insights'). It stays silent when ' ins' starts a document or has no preceding word.
result.label: ' ins' mid-word after prefix word

result.description: Fires on the ordinal suffix 'th' after a century number like 20 or 19, strongest in "mid-20th century" and "second half of the 20th century". Members are mostly 'th' and digit detectors.
result.label: Century ordinal 'th' suffix
