result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "number" (as in "the number of objects/outcomes"), mostly in math and combinatorics text. It stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like occurrence, probability, methods or core.
result.label: "number of" – of after number

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' comp' when it begins a longer word, mostly "compound(s)" after a preceding modifier (sulfur, polar, ternary). It stays silent on ' comp' after "evaluate", so it needs a chemistry or linguistics compound context.
result.label: ' comp' piece in compound(s)

result.description: Fires on the piece "aging" when it completes the word "packaging" (pack|aging). It stays silent on "aging" in "managing" or at the start of a sentence. Members detect "aging" and packaging or container context.
result.label: "aging" in packaging

result.description: Fires on the word piece "atial" completing "geospatial" (also weakly "icult"). Members detect geo-/spatial word fragments such as "oge", "od", "spatial", "territorial" and "ometric", which together build up the word.
result.label: "atial" in geospatial

result.description: Fires on " studies" (also " study") mainly in "case studies" and similar compounds like "observational studies", in academic or report-style text. Silent on "performance studies" as a field name. Weak extras on "or" in "rhetoric".
result.label: case studies
Verb-start piece after 'approach'
result.description: Fires on the beginning piece of a transitive verb (en-compasses, prior-itizes, prom-otes, align-s) right after the noun 'approach' or 'method', as the subject's verb. It stays silent on 'en' in other slots, such as after 'and'.

Fires on the word-piece ' ch' (or ' Ch') when it begins a longer word such as cholesterol, chloride, chains or chromosome, mostly in science text. It predicts continuations like 'lor', 'ains' and 'oval'. It stays silent on 'chord' in geometry text.
result.label: ' ch' word-start piece (chain, chloride)

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of a word meaning revival or renewal ("rev|ival", "rediscover|y", "renew|al") in text about the Renaissance and cultural rebirth. It stays silent on the verb "revived" in a similar context.
result.label: Revival word endings in Renaissance text

result.description: Fires on verbs like "into" (delves into), "explore", "examine" when a section/chapter/article announces what it will cover ("this section delves into", "we explore"). Silent on "insight into" and other non-announcing uses of "into".
result.label: Section-topic announcing verbs (delves into, explore)
'ros' piece in neuroscience
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ros' mainly in 'neuroscience' (neu|ros|cience). The contrast text with 'neurophysiology' is silent. Members include 'ros' detectors from corrosion and microscope, so it is a token-level piece detector.
Fires on the plural word " humans", mostly as the object or subject noun after prepositions or comparisons like "like", "by", "between". Stays silent on the singular "human" in "human innovation".
result.label: Plural noun ' humans'

result.description: Fires on the word ' budget' (also in budgeting) in texts about budget types and methods, such as traditional, zero-based or performance budgets. Members are mostly budget-token detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: ' budget' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ending "ous" in "autonomous" (also "gent", "line", "ized"), predicting nouns like operations, decision, navigation. Mostly in autonomous-systems and robotics text.
result.label: autonom-ous word-piece before system nouns

result.description: Fires on the plural noun " images" (mostly in image processing / computer vision text), with members detecting image/images/pictures tokens. Silent on the hyphenated "image-container" in the contrast.
result.label: ' images' token in imaging text
Sentence-ending period
result.description: Fires on a full stop that ends a sentence, heading or short title line (e.g. "Education and society."), where a new sentence or line comes next. Silent on periods in abbreviations like "B.C." and "i.e." or after list numbers.

Fires on the piece 'loy' inside "alloy" (alloying, alloyed), mostly in metallurgy and materials text. It fires weakly on ' adv' in "advances/advancements". Members are mostly 'loy' and 'ys' piece detectors.
result.label: 'loy' in alloy

result.description: Fires on the letter "P" used as a propositional or probability variable (P implies Q, if P, P(A|B)). Weakly fires on P- word starts like Pythagoras. Supported by logic and statement members.
result.label: P as logic variable

result.description: Fires on the token " volume" (the quantity/measure, e.g. "volume of water", "volume, surface area"), mostly in math and science text. Weakly also on " closure". Members are mainly volume-token detectors.
result.label: " volume" token detector

result.description: Fires on ' in' right after a noun phrase, where it introduces a domain, place or group ("neuroplasticity in developing...", "dynamics in society"). Silent on sentence-initial ' in' and on verb-bound uses like "resulting in" or "involved in".
result.label: ' in' after noun, introducing domain

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' completing the word "scent" (after "sc"). It stays silent on 'ent' in other words such as "latent" or "authentically". Members detect 'sc' plus 'ent'/'ann' pieces and smell/taste context.
result.label: 'ent' in "scent"

result.description: Fires on the verb "help" and its forms (helping, helped, helps), mostly "helping" after "while also" or "by", in explanatory text. It predicts a following verb like understand, define or clarify. Members are detectors of help and assist.
result.label: help/helping verb before a verb

result.description: Fires on nouns naming a category of art or historical time, mainly " genre" and " Age" (Digital Age, Stone Age), also " era" and " landscape". Seems to be a modifier-plus-noun slot, used in art and history writing.
result.label: genre / Age / era category nouns

result.description: Fires on the token ' text' (also ' Text', 'text'), strongest when it is a standalone noun like "The text is". It weakens in compounds such as "predictive text" or "textbook". Members are mostly ' text'/' Text' detectors. Logits favor continuations like 'book', 'ual', 'ile'.
result.label: ' text' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " such" used as a determiner right after a verb or preposition, as in "govern such", "predict such", "in such", before a noun. Weak or silent when " such" follows a comma and leads into "such as".
result.label: " such" as determiner after verb/preposition

result.description: Fires on the token " charged", mostly in physics and chemistry text about electrically charged particles (e.g. "negatively charged", "between charged particles"). It predicts particle-related next words. Members detect charge, ion and subatomic words.
result.label: ' charged' in particle physics

result.description: Fires on the 'at' piece inside "chromatography" / "chromatographic" (chrom|at|ography). It stays silent on 'at' in other words such as "versatility", and the members detect 'at' after 'chrom' plus analytical-chemistry context.
result.label: 'at' in chromatography

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Be' (Beethoven, Behavior, Beam) where a word continues, predicting a suffix like 'havior'. Also fires on long dash-line separators and a few pieces like 'itz'.
result.label: ' Be' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ce' completing the word "sauce" (split as sau+ce), mostly in cooking text. Silent on 'ce' in "masterpiece". Weakly fires on 'itch' in "kitchens".
result.label: "ce" ending of "sauce"
'ap' piece after S (Sapir)
result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ap' right after an initial 'S', mainly in "Sapir" (Sapir-Whorf). It fires more weakly on similar mid-word pieces such as 'oph' in "sophisticated" and 'yl' in "syllogisms".

Fires on the word piece 'ific' (also 'istic') in the middle of a word, mainly in "Artificial" at the start of "Artificial Intelligence", also in Scientific and Significance. It is silent when 'ific' appears alone at the start of the text, with no word-start piece before it.
result.label: 'ific' piece inside Artificial
' dow' in downtime
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dow' that begins "downtime" (also "downturn"), mostly in IT or operations text. It is weakly active on ' portion' in "portion control". Members are mostly detectors of ' dow' and other word-start pieces.

Fires on the token " development" (also " Development") across contexts like biological, software, and human capital development. It mildly predicts the suffix "al" next. Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' development' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece "care" completing the word "healthcare" (after "Health"/"health"), especially in policy-style headings like "Healthcare Access." It stays quiet on other policy headings that lack this word.
result.label: "care" in "healthcare"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compreh' (start of comprehension, comprehensive, comprehending) and predicts continuations like 'ensive' and 'ension'. Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of the same piece.
result.label: ' compreh' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the "ils" piece in split-up "soils" (so|ils), and more weakly on " soil", in soil science text about texture, porosity and engineering. Members detect "il" after "So" and soil-related words.
result.label: "ils" in "soils"

result.description: Fires on the ' re' piece that begins "reactions" right after a chemistry word like "redox", "chemical" or "electrolysis". It stays silent when ' re' starts a sentence or begins other words like "reagents".
result.label: ' re' of redox reactions

result.description: Fires on the end of words naming inner conflict or hardship (turmoil, struggles, dilemmas, conflict) in writing about story characters and narrative craft. Members are mostly fiction/character-topic detectors.
result.label: Internal struggle words in fiction

result.description: Fires on determiners (' the', ' an', ' a', ' this') right after the verb "follow/following" (follows the, following an). Predicts nouns like rules, path, pattern. Silent on 'the' in other contexts.
result.label: Determiner after "follow"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the word "delivering" (also on ' deliver' itself). Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like responding or staying. Pushes toward delivery-related words such as delivered, delivery, services.
result.label: 'ing' in "delivering"

result.description: Fires on the token 'th' in many settings: ordinal suffixes after digits or letters (4th, 19th, i-th), and word-internal 'th' (these/those, Carthage, growth). Predicts continuations like ' century', 'ought', 'ink'.
result.label: 'th' token, ordinals and word pieces

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' voc' (vocabulary), ' constitu' (constituent) and ' acc' in linguistics-flavoured text, where the next piece completes the word. Supported by language and lexicon members.
result.label: Word-start fragments in linguistics text

result.description: Fires on ' and' (sometimes ' or') joining two nouns or verbs in a paired phrase, like "wear and tear", "tender and flavorful", "Food and Religion". Silent on ' and' after a comma that joins clauses.
result.label: ' and' joining paired words

result.description: Fires on the verb " are" (and "aren" in "aren't"), most strongly after plural subjects like "areas", in descriptive or definitional statements. It stays silent on some "are" tokens, for example in relative clauses or after certain subjects, and the evidence doesn't say why.
result.label: Plural-subject verb " are"

result.description: Fires on the token " method" (also "methods"/"Method"), especially where it could continue into "methodology/methodological". Logits boost "ologies", "ological", "ology". Upstream members are mostly " method" detectors.
result.label: ' method' predicting -ologies

result.description: Fires on word pieces in discussions of Hindu/Buddhist spiritual liberation (moksha, Samsara, Jnana, 'ultimate', 'liberation'). Silent on 'imate' in unrelated words like 'intimate' or 'underestimate'. Pushes toward Buddhist/spiritual terms such as Bud, Kar, Mah.
result.label: Spiritual liberation in Eastern religion

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ute" when it ends a word after a prefix, mainly "ac|ute" (acute angle) and "fl|ute". It stays silent when "ute" starts a text or stands alone.
result.label: 'ute' suffix piece (acute, flute)

result.description: Fires on the token " development" (also "Development"), most strongly as a noun after modifiers like "economic" or "sustainable" in academic or policy text. It predicts suffixes such as "al" and nouns like "plans" or "policy".
result.label: " development" token

result.description: Fires on the final piece "us" completing the word "nucleus" (atomic nucleus, in physics text). It stays silent on "us" in other words, such as "usually".
result.label: "us" ending "nucleus"

result.description: Fires on the word " government" (mostly as a modifier before nouns like policy, action, spending, intervention) in economics and policy text. Members detect government, state, govern and polic- tokens. It is silent on a sentence-initial "government'll".
result.label: ' government' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on growth/development/expansion nouns, mostly right after "urban" (or economic, rural, sustainable), in urban planning and economics text. Silent on unrelated text like geometry. Members detect urban/city and development words.
result.label: Urban growth/development noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'era' inside "therapeutic" (th|era|peutic), predicting the following 'pe'. Members are detectors of 'era' and similar mid-word pieces after 'th'. Only weakly fires on 'era' in "ephemera".
result.label: 'era' in "therapeutic"

result.description: Fires on the digit '5' as the third digit of a number starting with "1" (e.g. 15xx years, 150). Silent on '5' in other positions, such as after 9 or 17, or at the start of a number.
result.label: Digit 5 after leading 1

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' travers' (as in tree traversal: in-order, pre-order traversals), where a suffix like -al/-als is expected next. Weakly fires on ' eigen' before value/vector.
result.label: ' travers' (traversal) word piece

result.description: Fires on varied nouns ending a noun phrase in tech/AI and human-interaction text, most often ' vision' in "computer vision", also interaction, temperature, soundscapes. Weak, mixed evidence; the contrast is unrelated training text.
result.label: Computer vision and tech nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mult' (start of multi-), strongest after "a/are" in phrases like "a multidimensional/multifaceted". Silent on 'multicultural' in the contrast, so it seems to need the multidimensional/multifaceted-type continuation context. Predicts 'if', 'itude', 'ities'.
result.label: ' mult' prefix before multifaceted
Capital R starting 'Risk' word
result.description: Fires on the token ' R' (word-initial capital R piece), mostly at the start of a line or document where "Risk ..." headings begin. Also weakly on R in RNA. Silent on other list items like Recovery.
Fires on the word piece " cre" at the start of a word such as creep or creative/creativity, mostly in materials-science "creep" passages. It predicts continuations like "ep", "ative" and "ativity".
result.label: ' cre' word-start piece (creep/creative)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' res' at the start of a longer word (reservoir, resin, resilient, reserves), where the next piece completes the word. Members are mostly ' res' detectors.
result.label: ' res' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word "resource"/"resources" (singular and plural) in allocation, management and utilization contexts. Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of the same token. It predicts allocation-related continuations.
result.label: resource(s) in allocation contexts

result.description: Fires on the ending piece 'inos'/'ino' in "neutrinos" (after 'Neutr'), and occasionally on 'erm' in "Thermodynamics". It is a word-completion piece in physics terms.
result.label: neutrino word-ending piece
Word-start fragments: kn-ot, cont-, fac-
result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces that begin longer words, mainly 'ot' in "knot" (math/topology), plus ' cont' (controlling, contour) and ' fac' (faculty). Silent on 'ot' in "jotting", so it depends on the specific word.

Fires on the final 'S' of security acronyms such as IDS, HIDS and NIDS (Intrusion Detection Systems), in cybersecurity text. It stays silent on 'S' at the start of a word or in other acronyms like COTS.
result.label: Final S of IDS acronyms

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens (' perm' in permits, ' Tra' in Traffic, ' Fant', ' di' in dietary), where the next piece completes the word. Members detect these word-initial fragments.
result.label: Word-initial fragment before continuation

result.description: Fires on the last word of a title-case topic heading in a list of course or subject headings (e.g. "Traffic Control Systems", "Group Communication Technology", "Economics Methods"). It is quiet on "Systems" in a physics heading.
result.label: Heading-final noun in topic lists

result.description: Fires on word pieces (e.g. -ential, -ization, -ing) completing multi-word entries in line-separated lists of academic subjects or course topics. It stays silent on the same piece in running prose or equation text.
result.label: Word endings in academic topic lists

result.description: Fires on 'of' inside hyphenated compounds such as out-of-order, state-of-the-art, and -of-Flight. The contrast suggests it needs the hyphen-joined slot rather than a plain prepositional 'of'. It pushes towards a following hyphen or word piece.
result.label: 'of' in hyphenated compounds

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " magic" (also " love" as an abstract concept noun, e.g. "concepts like love"), often as a noun after a determiner or preposition. Members detect magic/magical/trick tokens. Logits favor magic-related continuations like proof, wand.
result.label: magic (and abstract love) noun

result.description: Fires on a third-person present-tense verb (defines, signifies, specifies, reflects, indicates) that follows a technical subject in science or math explanations, just before the clause saying what the subject means or represents.
result.label: Explanatory verbs: defines, signifies, reflects

result.description: Fires on the 't' (or 'T') of the contraction "don't" / "doesn't" after the apostrophe, in present-tense negation. It stays silent on "won't" and "weren't" and on 't' inside words like storytelling. Predicts words like "just", "necessarily", "bother".
result.label: 't' in don't / doesn't

result.description: Fires on the word " topological" (and "ological" in "Topological") in math and physics text, such as topological insulators, states, invariants and maps. Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: topological word detector

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a relative pronoun right after a plural or abstract noun (e.g. "lessons that", "themes that"), introducing a clause that modifies the noun. Silent on complementizer 'that' after ensures, note, or such.
result.label: Relative 'that' after noun

result.description: Fires on the word "string"/"String"/"strings", especially in string theory and string instruments. It is silent on computing text about trees and nodes, so the physics and music senses seem to matter.
result.label: string (theory / instruments)

result.description: Fires on the token 'i' when it ends a word piece in a technical term, most strongly in "Pauli" (Pauli gates, Pauli Exclusion Principle), and sometimes in math indices or "physiology". Members are mostly 'i' detectors.
result.label: Word-final 'i' in Pauli

result.description: Fires on ' analyt' (analytical/analytics) and on the 'or' in 'Kolmogorov', with weaker hits on ' widely'. It looks like a word-start piece predicting a suffix such as 'ical'. Evidence is mixed across these tokens.
result.label: analyt- and Kolmogorov 'or'

result.description: Fires on " cannot", mostly after a subject like "that", "externalities" or "energy" in expository economics or science text, where "be" often follows. Members are mostly detectors of "cannot" and negation words.
result.label: ' cannot' modal negation

result.description: Fires on the token ' selection' (natural, sexual, index, selection process) across evolution, algorithms and databases. Predicts next words like criteria, process, bias. Members are mostly selection/select/choice detectors.
result.label: ' selection' noun token

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ate' completing "adequate" / "inadequate", before a noun such as funding or capacity. Silent on 'ate' in verbs like "accommodate" or "disincentivate".
result.label: "ate" in adequate/inadequate

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a surname (E in Euler, Sim in Simon/Siméon, Bern, F) after a first name in lists of mathematicians. It predicts the continuation of a famous mathematician's name, such as ö or Lap. It stays silent on non-mathematician names.
result.label: Mathematician surname first piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'tere' when it follows "s" to form "stereo-" words (stereo images, stereochemistry, stereomers). It is silent when 'tere' begins a word without the preceding "s", as in "tereoisomost". It predicts suffix pieces like 'ois' and 'opsis'.
result.label: 'tere' in 'stereo-' words

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' fal' (as in fallibilism/fallibility) and ' susp' (suspensions), where the word is split into pieces and continues in the next token. Weakly on other split word starts like 'ade', 'unf'.
result.label: Word-start pieces 'fal' and 'susp'

result.description: Fires on " and" directly after the word "time" (e.g. "time and space", "time and effort"), joining it to a second noun. Weaker on "and" after other nouns like temperature. Silent on "and" after commas or other words.
result.label: "and" after "time"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'clusion' completing "Inclusion-Exclusion" (also "inclusion and exclusion"). Members are mostly 'clusion' and ' inclusion' detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: 'clusion' in Inclusion-Exclusion

result.description: Fires on the ' A' of "Middle Ages" (Early/High/Late Middle A-), where the word is split and 'ges' must follow. Silent on sentence-initial ' A' and other uses of ' A'. Predicts 'ges'.
result.label: ' A' in "Middle Ages"

result.description: Fires on the token ' defined', most strongly in "is/are defined as" definitional phrasing. Weaker in "richly defined" or "defined success as". Predicts 'as' or 'differently' next. Members are mostly detectors of defined/described/characterized.
result.label: ' defined' in "is defined as"

result.description: Fires on the word " sample" used as a noun modifier or head in lab and statistics text (sample loading, sample preparation, sample mean). It weakly also fires on "omorphic" and similar word pieces.
result.label: ' sample' in lab/statistics text

result.description: Fires on the piece 'er' in the middle of a longer word (ana-er-obic, res-er-voir, Polym-er, Pe-er, coh-er-ence), when the word is not yet complete. It is silent on comparative 'er' (tougher). Occasionally fires on 'friend' in Eco-friendly.
result.label: 'er' inside split words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "antic" in "Rom-antic" (Romanticism, Romantic), the movement or era. It stays silent when "antic" appears alone at the start of a text, so it needs the preceding "Rom" piece.
result.label: "antic" in Romantic/Romanticism

result.description: Fires on ' also' right after a subject pronoun like "it" (often after "but" or a semicolon), where a verb such as fosters, presents or serves follows. It is quieter after modals, "and" or at the start of a sentence.
result.label: ' also' after subject 'it'

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (eless, iring, " of", heart, "ground") in essay-style text about literature, nature and creativity, often in phrases like "source of", "inspiring", "fertile ground". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: Inspiration/source phrases in creative essays

result.description: Fires on the split token ' n' in the word "nouns" after a noun-type word (Common, Proper, Abstract, Concrete) in grammar headings. It stays silent when ' n' starts the text with no preceding modifier.
result.label: ' n' of "Common nouns" headings

result.description: Fires on the word " bounded" (as in boundedness, bounded operator, bounded growth), mostly in math or technical text. Weak activation on a few other word pieces such as "rained" and "ishing".
result.label: ' bounded' in math text

result.description: Fires mainly on " otherwise" in "an otherwise [adjective]" (also " overall", " else", and word-piece 'o'/'ic'), where an adverb modifies a following adjective. Mixed secondary peaks on word fragments.
result.label: "an otherwise" + adjective adverb

result.description: Fires on the word piece completing a social-structure term right after "social" or in hierarchy words (social strat-ification, hierarch-ies, social class, hierarchy). Predicts continuations like "strat", "arch", "class".
result.label: Social hierarchy/stratification terms

result.description: Fires on mixed word pieces and tokens, mainly ' significant', 'arr' (in Narrative), and 'ider' (in Collider), plus a few others. Peaks look unrelated, with low consistency, so there is no clear shared meaning.
result.label: Mixed tokens: significant, arr, ider

result.description: Fires on an apostrophe (straight, curly or prime) right after a decade year like 1950 or 1960, before "s". Silent on apostrophes in possessives or contractions, so it needs the year-decade slot.
result.label: Apostrophe after decade year

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " las" (and " Las") in "laser"/"lasers", predicting a suffix like "er" next. Members are mostly " las" detectors plus other word-fragment detectors (polym-, Bo-, ul-).
result.label: " las" piece of "laser"

result.description: Fires on mechanical/engineering modifier nouns like " driver", " motor", " gauge" when they come right after a modifier or word and precede another noun (driver control, motor vehicles, motor neurons). Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: driver/motor/gauge noun modifiers

result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'iller', 'illing' and 'ill' after 'thr' in "thriller/thrilling/thrillers", in writing and genre text. Weak activation on similar pieces like 'exc-iting'.
result.label: thr-iller / thr-illing word piece

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' int' when it begins a longer word, mostly "intimacy/intimate" and also "intake". It predicts continuations like 'imate' and 'ently'. It stays silent when ' int' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' int' word-start piece (intimacy)

result.description: Fires on function words (' of', ' in', ' is', ' and') right after the word "diversity" or "diversification", where the next word is likely a category like species, inclusion or populations. Silent on ' of' after other nouns such as levels or impact.
result.label: Function word after "diversity"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments 'Mon'/'mon' (also 'electro', 'dr') at the start of a longer word being spelled out, like Monetarism, Monitoring, Monopoly. Predicts continuations such as 'et', 'opol', 'itor'.
result.label: Mon- word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece "strateg" (and "ateg" in "Strateg-") as the stem of strategy, strategies, strategic or strategizing, typically after a modifying word. Members are mostly detectors of this same stem.
result.label: strateg word stem

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a language or language-family name (Finn-, Mand-, Mal-, Sah-, Kho-, Russ-) inside linguistics text about language families, where the name continues in the next token.
result.label: Language name first fragment

result.description: Fires on the word ' approach' (verb or noun, also 'approaches'), especially when it is a repeated mention of a previously named method or a verb about nearing a value. Silent at the very start of a document.
result.label: ' approach' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Gal' (occasionally ' Far') at the start of a name like Galileo, Galois or Galvani. It predicts name continuations such as -ile, -ois and -van.
result.label: ' Gal' name-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' narr' (start of narrator, narrative, narration), mostly when it follows a modifier such as Unreliable, Multiple, or Non-linear. Silent when it opens a text with no preceding context.
result.label: ' narr' word-start piece
' ret' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' ret' (retention, retail, retina) when it is split from the rest of the word, predicting a continuation like 'ention'. Weakly also on similar fragments such as ' sust'.

Fires on the word-start piece ' le' (also ' dem', ' res', ' str') when a continuation like "leap" or "leverage" is expected, often after "significant/transformative" in change-themed text. Predicts 'ap', 'verage'.
result.label: ' le' piece before leap/leverage

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining two coordinated place or country names, especially "the United States and" (also "Montana and"). It stays quiet on ' and' joining clauses or items in a list after a comma.
result.label: 'and' between country names

result.description: Fires on the markdown heading marker ' ##' at the start of a new section right after a paragraph break, and on the '.' after a section number in numbered headings (e.g. '## 6.'). It anticipates the heading title.
result.label: Markdown heading marker ' ##'

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' mic' and ' tele' (microscope, microwave, telephony, telepresence) before the word is completed, predicting continuations like 'ro', 'ele', 'communic'. Weakly on similar prefixes such as quant- and meas-.
result.label: mic-/tele- word-start prefixes

result.description: Fires on the noun ' position' (and sometimes state, identity, status) as a head noun after "the/initial/relative", typically in science or math text about location of something, often followed by "of". Members detect position/location words.
result.label: ' position' as head noun

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, most often 'll' inside 'syllables' (not the contraction 'll), plus ' pair', 'a', '/'. Members are linguistic and phonetic terms (consonants, sounds, linguistic). Evidence is mixed; the peaks look like mid-word fragments.
result.label: 'll' in syllable-type words, mixed

result.description: Fires on the word "unit"/"units" (and Unit) as a noun, such as processing units, units of measurement, unit cell or unit tests. Members are mostly detectors of unit/units tokens.
result.label: unit / units token detector

result.description: Fires on contraction suffixes 've' and 're' right after "you'" (e.g. "you've ever", "next time you're"), predicting a following verb. Members detect 've' tokens and apostrophes.
result.label: you've / you're contraction suffix

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'eman' piece in "Kahneman" (Daniel Kahneman, prospect theory) and on ' tempor' in "temporality". Weaker on a few other mid-word pieces. Members detect 'eman' and 'Kahn' pieces.
result.label: Kahneman 'eman' word piece

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment in the middle of a longer technical word, mostly 'bi' in symbiotic/unbiased, also 'tr' in synchrotron. It needs the piece to be inside such a word, where the next piece completes it.
result.label: Mid-word 'bi'/'tr' fragments

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like " contra", " abstra", " au", " extra" that are followed by a "-ction"/"-ctions" style completion (contrapositive, abstraction, auctions). It predicts 'ction' endings.
result.label: Word-start pieces before -ction

result.description: Fires on the word ' discrete' (and pieces like 'crete'), mostly in math and probability text such as "discrete random variables" or "discrete probability". Members are mainly detectors of 'discrete' and related probability/math words.
result.label: discrete (math/probability)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'uct' inside words like Inductive and Deductive (also weakly in fluctuations), where it is followed by a suffix such as -ive. Members are mostly 'uct' detectors.
result.label: 'uct' in Inductive/Deductive

result.description: Fires on the word " observations" (also "observation", "experimental") in scientific or empirical-research text, often after a modifier like "satellite", "empirical" or "field". Upstream members detect observation, experiment and measurement words.
result.label: Scientific 'observations' token

result.description: Fires on the word " role" (and weakly "roles"/"significance") as a noun, usually after "its", "their", "the" or "significant", in academic text. Predicts " in", " for" or " as" next. Members are mostly role/roles detectors.
result.label: ' role' noun token

result.description: Fires on ' experience' as the object of "enhance/enrich the experience", where "of" comes next. It is silent in compounds like "culinary experience" or "dining experience" that end a clause.
result.label: "the experience" after enhance verbs

result.description: Fires on the first piece of an uppercase acronym being spelled out, mainly ' ER' (ERP) and ' SD' (SDN), where more letters follow. Members detect acronym fragments such as SD, CD, UI and ER.
result.label: Acronym-initial letters (ER/SD)

result.description: Fires on resource-type nouns (resources, supply, supplies) right after "water" in water-management or hydrology text. It stays silent on "resources" after generic words like "limited" or "shared". Predicts "management" or "engineering" next.
result.label: water resources/supplies noun

result.description: Fires on mixed connector or boundary tokens such as " or", " (", "/", "0" and " and", often after a list item or number. It stays quiet on " or" between some noun pairs. The evidence is mixed and the members are mostly generic.
result.label: Mixed connectors: or, parenthesis, slash

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'os' inside "chromosome(s)" / "chromosomal", after "chrom". Weaker activity appears in similar pieces like 'ribosomes' and 'explosive'.
result.label: 'os' in chromosome

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "itory" in "auditory" (also " wet", " bitter", " wheel" at lower counts). Members are mainly "itory"/auditory detectors. Stays silent in a nearby passage about motor skills that lacks the word.
result.label: "itory" in auditory

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ine' completing the word "vaccine" (after "vacc"). It stays silent on 'ine' in other words like biomedicine, pristine, quinine.
result.label: 'ine' in "vaccine"

result.description: Fires on scope adjectives "international" and "global" (also "regional") used as modifiers before a noun like competition, relations, standards, trade. Predicts such nouns next. Members are detectors of international/global/local/national tokens.
result.label: International/global scope adjective

result.description: Fires on " eventually" after a relative "that (would)" clause describing earlier ideas or developments that later led to an outcome. Members detect time-sequence adverbs like later, finally, ultimately, gradually. Predicts verbs like lead.
result.label: "eventually" after "that would"

result.description: Fires on connectives (' and', ' for', ' of') right after the word "standards" (e.g. "standards and certifications", "standards for quality"), where a quality or certification term comes next. Silent on 'and' after other nouns like food or accuracy.
result.label: Connective after "standards"
