result.description: Fires on mid-word or word-ending pieces (counter-part, semiconduct-or, p-type, microb-ial, ' pro') in science text, where the word may continue or complete. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak; silent on ' pro' in proton words.
result.label: Word-piece fragments in technical text

result.description: Fires on the token ' norm' (as in "societal norms", "cultural norms", also "normative", "Euclidean norm"), peaking in social-convention contexts. Members are mostly detectors of ' norm' itself, with some "challenge traditional structures" context.
result.label: ' norm' token detector

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe in possessive 's after a noun (e.g. "biology's", "Theme's") at the start of abstract academic-style text, and on the "estr" piece of "orchestrates/orchestration". Silent on apostrophes after pronouns or in quotes.
result.label: Possessive apostrophe and orchestr- piece

result.description: Fires on a period ending a short topic heading or list item (e.g. "Continuous functions.", "Closed sets.") in a line-separated list of headings, especially academic topics. Stays silent after personal or organization names in name lists.
result.label: Period after topic heading

result.description: Fires mainly on 'ent' in "underwent" and 'one' in "undergone", the "undergo" forms, plus scattered tokens like " finished" and " many". Silent on 'ent' in unrelated words such as turbulent or nutrient.
result.label: undergo forms (underwent/undergone)

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "context" (in the context of), framing a topic or domain. It stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like "understanding of", "importance of" or "complexity of".
result.label: ' of' in "the context of"

result.description: Fires on the word " without" when it follows a verb phrase or clause and introduces a manner or exclusion ("transfer X without losing..."). It stays quiet after "even" at the start of a phrase. Members are mostly " without" detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: " without" after a clause

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ste' when it begins a longer word, mostly "stewardship" after "environmental" and also "steering". Predicts continuations like 'ward'. Silent where no such word is being started.
result.label: ' ste' word-start (stewardship/steering)

result.description: Fires on intensifying adjectives like "significant" or "substantial" right after "saw"/"have seen" (an era or decade seeing significant progress), before a noun like progress, investment or research. Silent on predicative or "A significant milestone" uses.
result.label: significant/substantial after "saw"

result.description: Fires mainly on " close" as an adjective after "paying/pay" or a determiner, as in "paying close attention" or "close relationships". Members detect close/closer/closed. Weaker on a few word pieces like "ance".
result.label: "close" in "paying close attention"

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' eth' (before "ics", as in medical eth-ics, virtue eth-ics) and ' sc' (sc-anners, sc-affold) that begin a split word. It is silent on ' eth' before "ical" in other contexts, so it depends on the word being completed.
result.label: ' eth' / ' sc' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the standalone token 'n', mostly as a math variable (n+1, n!, a_n, choosing n items), and also inside words like supernova. Weaker on ' group' and 'N'. Silent on 'n' as a subscript in C_n(X).
result.label: Letter 'n' as math variable

result.description: Fires on "ged" in "emerged" (occasionally "originated", "arose", "occurred") after a relative clause like "which/that emerged" about a movement or idea, before a time phrase like "in the...". Silent when "emerged as/from".
result.label: "emerged" in relative clauses

result.description: Fires on the final digit, mostly '2', of a four-digit year (e.g. 1972, 2012, 1992) after a decade prefix. It stays silent on '2' at the start of a number like 2000 or 20th century.
result.label: Last digit of a year

result.description: Fires on "when" (or "When") introducing a subordinate clause, often after a semicolon, colon, "that", or at sentence start. It stays quiet when "when" follows a noun, as in "moments when" or "pleasure when".
result.label: Clause-introducing "when"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' combin' (start of "combinatorial/combinatorics") mid-sentence in mathematical text, before the suffix. Silent when it begins the document. Logits are unclear.
result.label: ' combin' in combinatorial

result.description: Fires on ' probability' (and the 'ability' piece of "Probability") in statistics/math text about probability distributions and random variables. Weaker in other math-like uses such as "probability theory".
result.label: probability in statistics text

result.description: Fires on the modal verb " may" (also " might") right after a noun-phrase subject, as in "one culture may indicate" or "aging populations may". It stays silent when "may" starts a text with no subject before it.
result.label: Modal 'may' after a subject noun

result.description: Fires on varied tokens, mostly the first word piece of a new list item or heading line (' Pr' in "Pronoun", ' Ad' in "Adverbs") and occasionally mid-sentence words like 'environmental' or 'un'. Evidence is mixed; the logits show no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: List-item initial word pieces (Pr, Ad)

result.description: Fires on ' more' used as an adverb right after a verb plus its object noun (e.g. "analyze patterns more efficiently"). It stays silent when ' more' comes before an adjective or noun, as in "faster and more efficient".
result.label: Adverbial ' more' after verb object

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' of', ' to', ' an', ' its', 'ous') in abstract, philosophical or academic explanatory prose. It is silent on many ' of' tokens after abstract nouns, so the evidence is mixed and the trigger is not clear.
result.label: Scattered function words in abstract prose

result.description: Fires on auxiliary "have/had/has" (and would/will have) in discussion of perfect tenses and verb conjugation, where a participle like "been" is expected next. Silent on "have" in relative clauses ("which have", "that have").
result.label: Perfect-tense auxiliary have/had

result.description: Fires on the word "festival"/"Festival" (and variants) in text about events, such as "Music Festival" headings or "festival attendance". Members are mostly festival and event-word detectors. It stays silent on one quoted instance, but the evidence for why is thin.
result.label: festival token detector

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'st' piece in "overstated"/"overstating" (after "over"), i.e. a mid-word fragment awaiting a suffix. Silent on ordinal "21st". Weak firing on other word-start fragments and odd tokens.
result.label: 'st' inside "over-stated"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in phrases about what was not possible or not done before ("previously unimagined", "never before seen", "words alone could not", "can compete"), where a modal or adverb precedes a verb. Mixed, low consistency.
result.label: Previously/could capability phrasing

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly ' they', ' closer', ' will' and word pieces, in explanatory academic/economic prose where a subject is about to take a verb or comparison. Silent on many ' they' in other clauses. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Scattered ' they' in explanatory prose

result.description: Fires on the -ability/-ility/-iveness suffix completing quality nouns (adaptability, agility, flexibility) in lists of desirable organizational traits. Silent on 'profitability' and 'availability', which are business or metric terms.
result.label: -ability suffix in trait nouns

result.description: Fires on the token "term" in the compound "long-term" (also "short-term"), where it follows a hyphen and "long". Members are mostly detectors of "term" itself, with "level" as a weaker neighbor.
result.label: "term" in long-term
search / searching word detector
result.description: Fires on the words "search" and "searching" (also "retrieve"), mostly in computing and information-retrieval text about search algorithms or indexing. It stays silent on "search" in compound names like "grid search" and "binary search trees".

Fires on "ender" in "Gender" and on " gender", strongest in repeated "Gender and X" headings at document start. Silent on "ender" in mid-sentence "Gender stereotypes" and in a fragmentary "ender roles" context.
result.label: Gender token in headings

result.description: Fires on " is" right after a short abstract noun-phrase subject that opens a general statement, especially business/management concepts at sentence start ("Succession planning is…"). Silent on "is" after pronouns, or after longer subjects mid-sentence.
result.label: " is" after abstract concept subject

result.description: Fires on the piece "icate" completing the word "delicate" (del|icate), especially before "balance". It stays silent on "icate" in "intricate", so it needs the "del" prefix.
result.label: "icate" in "delicate"

result.description: Fires on ordinal/onset adjectives like "initial", "first", "earliest", "early" after a determiner or possessive (the, its, their), introducing the earliest stage or instance of something. Weak on "early" in dates.
result.label: Initial/first/earliest adjectives
'odes' in geodesy
result.description: Fires on the piece 'odes' inside "geodesy"/"geodesic" (Ge|odes|y). It is silent when 'odes' starts a text without the "Ge" before it. Supported by members detecting 'odes', 'od' and 'etic' in geodesy-related words.

Fires on ' for' right after a subject noun and comma, opening an illustrative aside ("X, for example/instance"). It stays silent on ' for' as an ordinary preposition (formula for, crucial for). It predicts ' example'/' instance'.
result.label: ", for example" aside opener

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces like 'um' (curriculum, Librorum) and 'al' (Environmental) that complete a multi-piece word, often in headings or title-like phrases. Members detect 'um', 'curr', 'ula' and education or teaching words.
result.label: Word-ending 'um'/'al' in curriculum-type words

result.description: Fires on ' From' when it opens a sentence or document, right after a full stop (e.g. "From the earliest stages…"). Members detect 'from'/'From' tokens. Silent in mid-sentence contrast text.
result.label: Sentence-initial "From"

result.description: Fires weakly on scattered function words and word pieces (' in', ' or', ' and', ' within', ' spin') inside abstract science or social-science expository text, often mid-phrase. No clear single trigger; the circuit failed and members are diffuse.
result.label: Scattered connectives in abstract expository text

result.description: Fires on a mid-word piece, mostly 'ation' in "Penetration" (also 'and' in "merchandise"), when it completes a specific word after a split-word prefix. Silent on 'ation' in revelation, experimentation, innovation.
result.label: Penetration 'ation' word-piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'mat' inside "grammatical" (also "pragmatics"), where the next piece is likely 'ical'. Members are mostly 'mat' detectors plus other mid-word fragment detectors.
result.label: 'mat' in gram-mat-ical

result.description: Fires on the piece 'int' inside the word "quint-" (quintessence, quintessential, quintet, quintest). Other 'int' uses, such as the integral sign or "unintended", don't drive it in the windows shown.
result.label: 'int' in "quint-" words

result.description: Fires on abstract process/project nouns in professional or engineering lists (development, design, campaign, construct, activity), often within lists of tasks. Silent on one 'development' example. Members are mostly generic word-piece detectors, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Project/process nouns in lists

result.description: Fires on "royal" and the "ty" in "royalty" (payments for use of music or IP, and also royal/noble contexts). Members detect " royal", "noble" and "ty" tokens. Silent on nearby text about music earnings without the word.
result.label: royal / royalty token

result.description: Fires on 'and', 'or' or a comma right after an adjective like "subtle", "nuanced" or "intricate", where another adjective is expected next. It stays silent on 'and' after nouns or other adjectives. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Conjunction after 'subtle' adjective

result.description: Fires on the token " air" (also " Air"), including as the first piece of compounds like airport, airspace, airways, and in phrases like air quality. Upstream members are mostly detectors of " air" itself.
result.label: Token " air"

result.description: Fires on ' between' after nouns like "line(s)", "boundaries", "gap", "bridge" (blurring or bridging a divide). It stays quiet after "connection", "communication" or "interaction".
result.label: ' between' after blur/line/gap nouns

result.description: Fires on the verb " contribute" (also "contributes") right after a plural or abstract subject, often after "that", where "to" or "significantly" is expected next. Members detect contribute/contrib word forms.
result.label: verb "contribute" after subject

result.description: Fires on " transformations" (also " transformation", "maps", "mappings") mainly in linear algebra or math text, such as "linear transformations". It is silent on other math text that lacks the word, like vector spaces and dimension.
result.label: "transformations" in math text

result.description: Fires on the 'LC' of the acronym SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) when it is introduced in parentheses, and on 'Cy' in 'Life Cycle'. Also weakly on mid-word fragments. Silent on later 'SDLC' uses in running text.
result.label: SDLC acronym 'LC' piece

result.description: Fires on incomplete first word-pieces in the middle of a multi-token word, such as ' er' (erosion), ' pros' (prosody), and 'ain' (Remainder). It expects a continuation piece to complete the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragment awaiting completion

result.description: Fires on pieces of "sophisticated"-like words (s, istic, ated) or a preceding adverb, when the text describes a shift from simple or rudimentary systems to something more advanced. Silent on "more sophisticated" without that contrast.
result.label: Simple-to-sophisticated shift, word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' moment' (singular, also plural variants) across senses, such as "moment of inertia", statistical moments, and "the right moment". Members are mostly detectors of ' moment'/' moments'. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' moment' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' data' (also datasets, information) as the noun ending a phrase like "large amounts of data" or "vast datasets", in big-data/analytics text. Silent when data begins a phrase or is a subject, e.g. "data analytics", "As data expands".
result.label: data after quantity/modifier phrase

result.description: Fires on ' it' right after "what" (as in "what it means to exist"), the subject slot of an embedded what-clause. It stays silent on ' it' in other positions, such as after "as" or a comma.
result.label: ' it' after 'what' in clauses

result.description: Fires on the adverb ' particularly' (sometimes ' especially') right after a copula or modal like "is/are/can be", before an adjective such as useful or important. Silent when it follows a comma introducing a prepositional phrase.
result.label: Intensifier 'particularly' after copula

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' mus' (as in muscle, muscular, musician), mostly in anatomy text about muscle types. Members are mostly ' mus' token detectors; the logits favour continuations like 'cle', 'cles' and 'icians'.
result.label: ' mus' word-start piece (muscle)

result.description: Fires on the word " individual" (also "personal"/"Personal") used as an adjective or prefix, especially before "-ized", "-ism" or an abstract noun like freedom or choice. Silent when "individual" is a noun-like head, as in "the individual artist".
result.label: adjectival "individual" / "personal"

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (commas, 'of', 'technique', word-piece endings, 'ly') in expository lists and technical prose. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; it stays silent on many commas in similar lists, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Scattered tokens in expository lists

result.description: Fires on the document-boundary token (shown as ¶) that comes right after a short list item or heading line, where a new item or title is about to start. It stays silent on some other boundary tokens, such as at the very start of a document.
result.label: Boundary token after list/heading line

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' math' (as in mathematician, math lovers, math students), often a word-start piece expecting a continuation like 'ematician'. Members are mostly detectors of ' math' and ' Mathemat'.
result.label: ' math' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mainly 'lic' in implicature/replicating, also ' redund' (redundancy), 'ate' in adequate, and 'ive'. It predicts a suffix-like continuation of the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: lic, redund, adequ-ate

result.description: Fires on a mix of tokens: ' entropy', ' N' at the start of a heading line (Nouns, Nuclear), ' only', and ' or'. The peaks share no single meaning and the circuit is diffuse, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Entropy, heading-initial N, only

result.description: Fires on "environmental" and related word pieces (ecolog-ical, environment-al, carbon) in sustainability and eco-responsibility text, usually just before nouns like sustainability, consciousness or conservation. Members detect eco, recycling and green vocabulary.
result.label: Environmental / ecological adjective

result.description: Fires on ' technique' when it follows an introducing phrase or adjective, such as "a cornerstone technique" or "a subtle yet effective technique", as the head noun of a definitional sentence. It stays silent when the word starts a sentence or document.
result.label: ' technique' after descriptive modifier
Document-start token after a title line
result.description: Fires on the document-start token (shown as ¶) when it comes right after a short title or heading-like sentence, as in lists of topic headings such as "Byzantine Art." It stays silent when the start token opens the text with no preceding title.
Fires on ' yet' used as a contrastive conjunction between two adjectives, especially after "subtle" (subtle yet powerful). Silent on temporal "yet" ("have yet to be resolved").
result.label: Adjective-linking 'yet' (subtle yet)

result.description: Fires on ' as' directly after a form of "serve" (served/serves/serving as), meaning "functioning as". It stays silent on ' as' in "as well as", "such as", or "labeled X as".
result.label: "as" after "served/serves"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' staff', ' and', ' come', commas) in abstract expository text about people, groups, cultures and organizations, often right after a coordinated list. Peaks are inconsistent and ' staff' stays silent in some contexts; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered tokens in list-like organizational prose

result.description: Fires on the word pieces ' hash' (hash function/table/map) and ' emphas' (emphasis/emphasize), mostly when they start a word after a determiner or adjective. Silent on 'an emphasis on'. Members are mainly ' hash' detectors.
result.label: ' hash' and ' emphas' word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' this' when it begins a new clause after a semicolon or sentence break, as a subject-position demonstrative (“; this involves…”). It stays silent on ' this' after a verb or preposition, as in “drawn to this style”.
result.label: clause-initial 'this' after semicolon

result.description: Fires on the document-boundary token (shown as ¶) that follows a finished sentence or list item, where a new line or item begins. Silent at the very start of a document. Members are all detectors of this same token.
result.label: Boundary token after sentence end

result.description: Fires on a scattering of tokens: digits inside numbers (e.g. '9' in 299.79, 1899), plus function words like ' the', ' in', ' above', ' for'. Logits favor plural abstract nouns (areas, changes, data). No clear single trigger; the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse digits and function words

result.description: Fires on incomplete word pieces in the middle of a multi-token word or name (Mic-row-wave, Mac-intosh, Carl, Fact-ors), where the next piece completes the word. Silent on 'row' in an unrelated name (Drowne).
result.label: Mid-word piece before completion

result.description: Fires on the ' clusion' piece in "Inclusion-Exclusion" (Principle), the second half of "Exclusion". Members detect 'clusion' and inclusion/exclusion context. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: Exclusion in Inclusion-Exclusion

result.description: Fires on the period after a number at the start of a line in a numbered list or heading (e.g. "4.", "5.", "2.1."), and weakly after decimal digits. Silent on sentence-ending periods.
result.label: Period after list number

result.description: Fires on the word " latter", most strongly in "the latter half/part of" (late period of a span), and more weakly when "latter" refers back to the second of two items. Members detect latter, former, late, and ordinal words.
result.label: " latter" after "the"

result.description: Fires on the final suffix piece of geological/historical era names (Cretace-ous, Proterozo-ic, Eoc-ene, Neolith-ic, Babyl-onian), completing the period name. Silent on numeric period descriptions.
result.label: Era-name word endings

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments or single characters (e.g. 'm' in "Pragmatic", digits in fractions, 'f' in a series formula). Peaks are scattered and the members are generic; there is no clear shared meaning.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, scattered

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' warm' or ' clean' before 'water' in washing/cleaning instructions, 'iring' in 'acquiring', and long runs of dashes. Peaks are scattered and inconsistent, so the circuit looks polysemantic.
result.label: Warm/clean water, acquiring, dashes

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Princi' when it follows a named concept (Safety, Pigeonhole, Pauli Exclusion, Uncertainty), where the next token is 'ple'. Weaker on the name Princip.
result.label: ' Princi' before 'ple'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Ma' (occasionally ' ma') that is a fragment of a longer word or name, like Maillard, Maurya, Maori or maze. Predicts continuations such as 'ill', 'arten'.
result.label: ' Ma' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word " until" as a conjunction after a verb phrase, such as repeat steps or wait "until" some condition. Members are mostly detectors of " until", " till" and " before". Silent on the contrast text, which has no "until".
result.label: ' until' conjunction detector

result.description: Fires on predicate adjectives/participles like available, allowed, required, needed after "is/are/than" (e.g. "as they are needed", "not allowed", "more than required"). Silent on attributive "the available options".
result.label: Predicate 'required/allowed/available' adjectives

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' exc' at the start of a split word, mainly in 'exciton' in physics text. Members are mostly ' exc' detectors from earlier layers, and the target predicts continuations like 'itation'.
result.label: ' exc' piece, as in exciton

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'ter', 'circul', 'cul' inside anatomical/circulatory words like arteries, circulatory, microcirculatory, and weakly in muscul-, orchestral. Needs the mid-word piece in a biological vessel context.
result.label: ter/circul pieces in arteries, circulatory

result.description: Fires on a hyphen after "over" (over-simplistic, over-fermentation) and on the "im" piece inside words like multidimensionality and neuroimaging. It marks a word-internal split where the word continues. Silent on hyphens after non, cross and human.
result.label: Hyphen after "over" / "im" mid-word

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ask' inside the word "multitasking" (Multit|ask|ing), the word-piece before the suffix. Barely fires on other tokens like ' bread' or 'io' in "grandiose".
result.label: 'ask' in multitasking

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'crete' in "discrete", 'id' in "humidity"/"Dravidian", 'ous' in "continuous", and 'ary'. Peaks are scattered word pieces, and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: discrete, humid, continuous

result.description: Fires on a full stop ending a sentence, often with the next sentence starting immediately, with no space or after a heading. It stays quiet on periods after abbreviations ("etc.") and on periods inside quotes or broken text.
result.label: Sentence-final period

result.description: Fires on ' for' introducing a purpose or beneficiary phrase right after a noun or verb object (e.g. "alloys for aerospace", "preserve them for future generations"). Quiet on ' for' after "solutions", "allows" or "techniques".
result.label: purpose 'for' after object

result.description: Fires on analysis-type verbs (analyze, interpret, understand, process, -ing forms) in coordinated lists of verbs, right before an expected object like "data". Silent on 'ing' in other settings.
result.label: Verbs in lists before data object

result.description: Fires on the verb ' served' (also ' serve') mostly in the "served as" sense of fulfilling a role or function, e.g. "which served as a hub". Members are detectors of serve/act/serving forms.
result.label: "served as" role verb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' las'/' Las' when it begins "laser(s)" and the next piece is expected to be "er". Also weakly on similar split-word pieces like "hyp" and "Dür". Silent on one isolated "las" in "laser probe".
result.label: "las" start of "laser"

result.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment such as 'cons' in "reconsider" (also ' abbre' in "abbreviations") in the middle of a word, where the next piece completes the word. Members detect prefix pieces like re-, mis-, ver-, pract-.
result.label: Mid-word 'cons' / 'abbre' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' augment' (mostly in "augmented reality", also "data augmentation"). Members detect Aug/augment/ment pieces and similar word-stem tokens such as complement and renew.
result.label: ' augment' token in augmented reality

result.description: Fires on ' over' right after "control" (also power/authority), as in "control over X". Stays silent on ' over' meaning "better than", in "overload/overlook", or "from over generations".
result.label: ' over' after control/power

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ized" in "characterized" (as in "characterized by ..."). It stays silent on "ized" in other words like "symbolized" or "organized", so it needs the "character-" stem.
result.label: "characterized" suffix -ized

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments after "sw" (swirling, swimmers, swapped) and on country names in comma lists (Indonesia, Korea). Mixed and low-consistency; mostly word-piece detection with a weak list-of-countries side.
result.label: sw- word fragments, country lists

result.description: Fires on 'water' as the second piece of a compound, especially 'groundwater' (ground|water), also underwater, freshwater, meltwater. Silent on 'water' in 'water cycle'. Members are water/ground detectors.
result.label: 'water' in compound words (groundwater)
"utter" piece in "shutter"
result.description: Fires on the word piece "utter" after "sh" in "shutter", mostly in photography and shutter-speed text. Members are detectors of "utter" and of mid-word fragments in photography and technical words.
Fires on the word piece "eu" inside "maneuver(s)/maneuvering", predicting the continuation "vers". Members detect "eu" and other mid-word fragments (tw, cal, orn, manip-ul).
result.label: "eu" in maneuvers

result.description: Fires on the word piece " loyal" (as in loyalty or loyal customers), mostly in business and customer-relationship text. It predicts a following "ty" completion. Members are mainly detectors of " loyal" and related word pieces.
result.label: ' loyal' token (loyalty)

result.description: Fires on the token ' SW' when it begins the acronym SWOT/SWAT (SWOT Analysis). Members detect acronym-like capital-letter fragments (AT, OT, SV, CS, FM) in the previous layers.
result.label: ' SW' starting SWOT acronym

result.description: Fires on the verb or adverb slot right after "what (would/is/will) ..." in the phrase "what is now known as / what would become known as / what is considered", predicting "known". It needs the "what" relative-clause construction.
result.label: "what is now/become [known as]" slot

result.description: Fires on the word " consumer" when it comes mid-sentence as a modifier in economics text (consumer expenditure, loans, trust, choice). It stays silent when the word is the first token of the text.
result.label: ' consumer' mid-sentence modifier
' organ' as start of organic/organism
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' organ' when it begins a longer word such as organic, organism or organizational. It stays silent in one case where 'organ' precedes 'ismal'. Members are mostly detectors of the ' organ' token.

Fires on the word " tree" (also " named") in computer-science text about data structures like AVL, binary search and decision trees. It was silent on one possessive " tree's" example, but the contrast is thin.
result.label: ' tree' in data-structure text

result.description: Fires on " can" right after a subject noun in a "how X can ..." embedded clause (e.g. "how music can help"). It stays silent on " can" in ordinary main clauses without "how".
result.label: " can" after "how + subject"

result.description: Fires on the plural noun (effects, impacts, implications, applications) after an adjective like "direct", "cascading" or "broad" in a "have X effects/impacts on" phrase. It stays silent on the same tokens in other constructions, such as "Evaluating the impacts of".
result.label: Plural effects/impacts after adjective

result.description: Fires on ' about' (also ' regarding') right after a noun like "concerns" or "questions" that introduces the topic of worry, as in "concerns about user privacy". Silent on "bring about" and "discussion about".
result.label: 'about' after concerns/issues

result.description: Fires on 'and' / 'as' (in 'as well as') linking two paired academic or domain adjectives/nouns (academic and practical, theoretical and practical), after the first element of a "both X and Y" style pairing. Predicts a contrasting word like 'practical'.
result.label: Coordinator between paired academic terms

result.description: Fires on ' Since' as the first word at the start of a document or passage, opening a temporal clause like "Since the inception/early...". Members include 'since'/'until'/'after' detectors. Silent mid-text.
result.label: Sentence-initial "Since" (temporal)

result.description: Fires on the last token of a topic-noun title phrase, such as "therapy" in "music therapy" or "reality" in "virtual reality". These are often headings where a subject term is complete and a verb like "is" or "has" could come next. Mixed evidence.
result.label: End of compound topic term

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "real" in "real-time" (also real-life, real-world), predicting a compound continuation. It stays quiet on hyphens after other words like vector-, pop-, context-, e-.
result.label: Hyphen after "real"

result.description: Fires on ' it' (occasionally ' them') when it is the object of a verb or preposition (e.g. "of it", "preparing it", "breaking them"). It stays silent on ' it' as a sentence subject, especially before contractions like "it's" or "it'll".
result.label: Object pronoun ' it'/' them'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' f' mainly after "nuclear" (Nuclear f|ission/fusion), also on math-style f(x). It predicts continuations like "ission", "uzz", "uz". Silent on ' f' in "fuzzing" after a comma.
result.label: ' f' fragment after nuclear

result.description: Fires on ' go' in the compound "go-to" (as in "your go-to tool/resource"), predicting an adjective-like continuation. Stays silent on 'go' in "letting go".
result.label: "go" in "go-to"

result.description: Fires on " variety" (rarely " range") in the quantity-noun phrase "a variety of", especially at the start of a document or sentence. Members detect variety, range, array and multitude words.
result.label: "a variety of" quantity noun

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in technical or enumerating text (units like Hz, "degrees", "angles", "condition", a letter in a class list). No single token or context dominates, and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Scattered technical-term tokens, diffuse

result.description: Fires on " character" (fiction-character sense) in lists of story elements, especially after "plot and" before "development/growth/building". Silent on some other uses, e.g. "each character" or "character profiles"; the contrast isn't clear-cut.
result.label: character in plot-and-character lists

result.description: Fires on " becomes" (also " become") right after an abstract noun subject, like "dialogue becomes" or "the economy becomes", where a predicate adjective or noun such as "apparent", "essential" or "more complex" is expected next. Members are mostly detectors of become-forms.
result.label: "becomes" after abstract subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' neut' (start of neutron, neutrino, neutrophile) in physics text, when it follows a preceding word. It stays silent when ' neut' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' neut' word-piece (neutron/neutrino)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' ident' / ' Ident' (before -ities, -ifying, -ification), also weakly on similar prefix fragments like 'origin', 'A'. Predicts suffix continuations such as 'ifying' or 'ities'.
result.label: ' ident' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on scattered separators and function words (commas, semicolons, 'and', 'the') inside lists of abstract nouns like "entities, attributes, and relationships". Predicts abstract noun suffixes (-ity, -ation). Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: List separators before abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' innov' (start of innovation/innovative) after a preposition or verb such as "of", "towards", "drives". It was silent on one "As a result, innovative" example, where it comes at the start of a sentence.
result.label: ' innov' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'w' in "inter-w-oven" (also Fire-w-alls, P-w-aves), mid-word after a prefix like inter-. It predicts the word continuing, e.g. "oven". Weaker on other inter- pieces like dis, le.
result.label: 'w' in interwoven word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces " fi" and " fib" of "fiber/fibre" (also fibers, fiberglass), mostly in textile or optical-fiber text. Weaker firing on sentence-initial "While"/"Although".
result.label: fi/fib start of "fiber"

result.description: Fires on a comma ending a clause that closes with "this trend/shift/regard/aspect" or a similar abstract noun, where a relative or participial clause ("which...", "resulting in...") follows. Silent on many other commas after clauses.
result.label: Comma after "this trend" clauses

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Pol' when it begins "Polymer/Polymerization" in polymer-science headings or lists. It stays silent on 'Pol' in "Policies" (Taxation Policies), so it needs the polymer word.
result.label: ' Pol' starting Polymer words

result.description: Fires on the 'ic' piece completing "Econom|ic" (and weakly on ' economic') in repeated title-like headings such as "Economic Growth" or "Economic Inequality". Stays silent on 'ic' in other words or in some mid-sentence economic contexts.
result.label: Econom-ic heading completion

result.description: Fires on the 'ur' piece inside "entrepreneurship/entrepreneurial", after 'entrepreneur' is split into pieces. It stays silent on 'ur' in other words such as "heuristics".
result.label: 'ur' in entrepreneurship
'ence' completing 'essence'
result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ence' when it completes the word "essence", especially in the phrase "in essence". It stays silent on 'ence' in other words such as resilience, ambivalence or adherence.

Fires on the word piece ' qu' (occasionally ' cent') when it is the start of a longer word, mainly in "status quo". It stays silent on ' qu' in "quirks". Members are detectors of qu- pieces in quark, quake, quilt.
result.label: ' qu' in "status quo"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'e' when it is a word-internal fragment after a prefix like macro-, micro- or socio-, where 'conomic' comes next. It stays silent on 'e' at the start of a word or document.
result.label: 'e' inside macro/socio-economic

result.description: Fires on the word piece "bul" in "turbulent" / "turbulence" (fluid dynamics). It is silent on other flow text that lacks this piece. It predicts suffix continuations such as "ent".
result.label: "bul" in turbulent/turbulence

result.description: Fires on the token " discuss" (discusses, discussing, discussions), especially when a section or part of a text describes what it covers. Members are mostly detectors of "discuss" and similar word stems like teach, convers and contract.
result.label: ' discuss' word stem detector

result.description: Fires mostly on " paragraph" in references like "paragraph 1" and on " Pe"/" pe" word pieces, with weaker hits on "and" or "0" in lists. Peaks are mixed, and the contrast gives no clear condition.
result.label: ' paragraph' and ' Pe' pieces

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ate' in "corporate" (weakly 'ational' in "organizational"), mostly before words like governance, accountability or social responsibility. Silent on 'ate' in other words such as Directorate, cultivate, anticipate, participate.
result.label: 'ate' ending of "corporate"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' catal' (start of catalyst/catalysis/catalyzing), and weakly on 're' in "disagreements" and similar mid-word pieces. Members are mostly ' catal' detectors from layers 3-5.
result.label: ' catal' word piece (catalyst)

result.description: Fires on " era" (occasionally " age" or epoch pieces) when it completes the phrase "a new era" heralding a transition, typically before "of". It stays silent on "this era" or "digital era" used as a period reference.
result.label: "a new era" announcing phrase

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ur' in "impurities" and "heuristic", plus ' clear', ' transparent' and 'ark' in "quark". Silent on 'ur' in "culturally". Mixed word pieces with weak consistency.
result.label: 'ur' in impurities/heuristic, clear

result.description: Fires on a hyphen right after "music" when starting a compound modifier (music-making, music-related, music-themed). Stays silent on hyphens after other words like cross-, self-, mindfulness-, limited-.
result.label: Hyphen after "music"

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "large" (also "small", "wide", "infinite") in compounds like large-scale or large-sized, predicting "scale"-type continuations. Stays silent on hyphens after other words such as high, real, edge.
result.label: Hyphen after "large" (large-scale)

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'as' in "Plasmonics/plasmon" (also 'ast', 'ur' in plastics, plurality). It acts as a word-piece inside "pl-" words, and is silent on 'as' in other words like "speakeasies".
result.label: 'as' inside Plasmon words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "lic" inside "carboxylic" (carboxylic acids), in chemistry text. Members detect "lic" in other words too (slicing, replicating), so the target seems to need the carboxy- prefix.
result.label: "lic" in carboxylic

result.description: Fires on the piece "let" inside the word "subtleties" (subt|let|ies), and weakly on "let" in words like wavelet or "avelet". Members detect "let" and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: "let" in "subtleties"

result.description: Fires on the word "labor"/"labour" as an economic noun (labor costs, labor market, manual labor, labor force). It is silent on some uses, such as "workers in labor" and "examining labor supply". Members mostly detect "labor" tokens.
result.label: labor / labour economic noun

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: the Greek letter λ in math (eigenvalue, rate parameter), suffix pieces like 'ive' and 'zes', and ' roof'. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, so no single trigger is clear.
result.label: Mixed tokens, math λ and suffixes

result.description: Fires on ' framework' (also ' approach', ' method', '-ology') when it begins a sentence as the subject, right after a period, referring back to a previously mentioned system. It stays silent on 'a framework for' mid-sentence.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'framework' as subject

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a rare word split into several tokens, especially 'est' in "Aesthetic" at the start of a title or heading, also 'f', 'olate', 'ph'. Silent on 'est' in "orchestral".
result.label: Mid-word fragments in split rare words

result.description: Fires mostly on ' early' (e.g. "late 1950s and early", repeated "early") and on scattered mid-word or adjective pieces in science text (continental, oceanic, floor). Silent on "the early 20…" century contexts. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: ' early' in non-century contexts
'im' piece inside multidimensional-type words
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'im' in the middle of longer words, most strongly in "multidimensional" and similar words such as calorimeters, intimacy and pessimistic. It predicts continuations like 'ensional'. It stays silent on 'im' in "spacetim".

Fires on mid-word pieces like 'text' (in subtext, \text{ in LaTeX, ciphertext) and 'iz' in Al-Khwarizmi, where a word continues with a suffix. Peaks are a mix of unrelated word fragments; the evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'text' and 'iz'

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: 'x' inside derivative notation f'(x), mid-word pieces (Col-in, semi-ann-ual), commas and some function words. No single token or context dominates; the evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and 'x' pieces

result.description: Fires on method-like nouns (' method', ' approach', ' framework') right after an evaluative adjective such as "systematic", "methodical", "efficient" or "traditional", when the text describes something offering a way of doing a task. Silent on bare or "this method" uses.
result.label: method/approach noun after adjective

result.description: Fires on ' blocks' in the metaphor "building blocks" (fundamental building blocks of X). Weaker on 'block' or 'cornerstones'. Silent on "foundation" without "building" before it.
result.label: "building blocks" metaphor

result.description: Fires on "ent" in "inherent" (also "afforded", "required", "placed") when it follows an abstract noun phrase and precedes "in"/"by", as in "fairness inherent in" or "precision afforded by". It stays silent on "inherent" followed directly by a noun.
result.label: inherent/afforded before in/by

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ical" completing "clin-ical", as in clinical trials, practice or monitoring. It stays quiet on "ical" in biomedical, biomechanical and statistical. Its logits favour words like trial and behavior.
result.label: "ical" in "clinical"

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of parallel items (e.g. "architecture, engineering, technology" or "x₁, x₂"), where more items are expected. It stays silent on commas that end a clause.
result.label: Comma inside list of items

result.description: Fires on ' Amazon' (company or region) and on 'ynam' in 'Thermodynamics'. Members are detectors of proper names (Amazon, Google, countries, Paris), so it looks like a proper-name/entity-word feature with a couple of unrelated peaks.
result.label: Amazon and Thermodynamics token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ade' in "inadequate", where the model is mid-word and expects "quate" next. Weak activation on other mid-word fragments like 'arma' in pharmaceutical.
result.label: 'ade' in "inadequate"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ony' (and sometimes 'y') in the middle or end of a split-up word, mostly in carb|ony|l, also harm|ony and ir|ony. It depends on the preceding word fragment.
result.label: 'ony' suffix piece, as in carbonyl

result.description: Fires on ' high' as a quantity adjective before a noun like level, cost, or density (e.g. "a high level of", "its high cost"). It stays silent when 'high' is followed by a hyphen in compounds such as "high-energy" or "high-throughput".
result.label: ' high' as quantity adjective

result.description: Fires on ' to' (sometimes ' in') right after causal verbs like "led", "leading", "resulted", where it introduces a consequence. It stays silent on ' to' in ranges, infinitives or "approaches to".
result.label: Consequence 'to/in' after led/resulted

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' priv' when it is the start of "privacy" split into pieces, predicting the continuation 'acy'. Weaker on ' effic' before 'acy'. Silent when the word starts with 'acy' alone.
result.label: ' priv' piece before -acy

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly ' pair' and the verb ' is' (also "There's", ' and'), where a verb or noun phrase continues. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. The logits are not clear.
result.label: Mixed ' pair' and ' is' tokens

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in longer words, mostly 'iz' (Organizational, wizards, Citizenship) and 'c' in 'transcends'. It also fires weakly on a few prefix pieces such as ' compreh' and ' ab'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'iz', 'trans-c'

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of technical or science words that are split into pieces, mainly ' cou' (coulometry, coulomb, coupling), also ' Vol' (Volta), ' Circ', ' Tele'. It fires mid-word, expecting a continuation piece.
result.label: Split-word fragment 'cou' in science terms

result.description: Fires on the piece 'igen' in "epigenetics"/"epigenetic" (also in "Eigenvalues"), after a word-start fragment like "ep". Silent on 'igen' in "antigen".
result.label: 'igen' in epigenetics

result.description: Fires on " each" (occasionally " every") when it begins a noun phrase as a determiner, typically right after a verb or preposition (ensure each, shape each, for each, with each). Members are mostly detectors of each/every.
result.label: Determiner 'each' / 'every'

result.description: Fires on unit-of-measure nouns right after a number, mostly ' miles' (often in parentheses after a kilometer figure), also years, meters, seconds. Members detect distance and time units and quantity words.
result.label: Units after numbers (miles, years)

result.description: Fires on ' health'/' Health' as the start of a healthcare topic or heading (Healthcare economics, Health Insurance), especially at document or heading starts. Silent on 'health' after modifiers like 'public' or 'systemic'. Predicts 'care'.
result.label: health at healthcare topic start

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'geon' in "burgeoning" (bur|geon|ing). It stays silent on 'bourgeoisie', so it needs the piece inside "burgeon". Upstream members are mostly 'geon' detectors.
result.label: 'geon' in burgeoning

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces and word endings (yt, rop, ation, building, access) in technical or scientific text, often where a word may continue or a suffix completes it. Peaks are scattered and the evidence is weak.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments in technical text

result.description: Fires on a comma (occasionally ' and') right after "evolve"/"evolving"-type verbs of change, where a list of further change verbs follows (evolve, adapt, ...). Silent on commas in other clauses.
result.label: Comma after evolve-type verb

result.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into several tokens (Mil|ky, s|tere|otype, J|PE|G, hero|ism), where a suffix is expected next. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: Incomplete word fragment mid-word

result.description: Fires on the "end" piece in "exp-end-iture" (expenditure, in public finance text), predicting the continuation "iture". Weak activity on a few other odd tokens.
result.label: "end" inside expenditure

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, often science nouns or word pieces (ants, wine, fung, products, '-' in predator-prey, digit '1'), mostly in science text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse. Logits favor adjectives like specific, exclusive, unique.
result.label: Diffuse science-noun mix

result.description: Fires on connectors (' from', ',', ' with', ' of') right after a process noun like testing, feedback, or collaboration in iterative-cycle or process-description text. It stays silent on 'from' in other uses, such as 'range from' or 'different from'.
result.label: Connector after process noun

result.description: Fires on "uring" in "enduring" (as in "create enduring long-term..."), the adjective meaning lasting. It stays silent on "uring" in other words such as manufacturing, measuring and ensuring. Members detect lasting/endure word pieces.
result.label: "enduring" word piece 'uring'

result.description: Fires on the token " dynamics", strongest in "the dynamics of ..." as a standalone head noun. It stays quiet when "dynamics" follows a modifying noun like "population" or "rhizosphere", or starts the text.
result.label: "the dynamics of" head noun

result.description: Fires mostly on ' and' in coordinated lists of nouns or adjectives, plus word pieces like ' rec', 'ive', ' aud' that begin or continue an expected next item. It stays silent on many other ' and' cases, and the condition is unclear.
result.label: Coordinating 'and' in lists

result.description: Fires on ' setting' used as a verb (gerund), as in "by setting goals" or "like setting the tempo". Stays silent when 'setting' is a noun meaning a story's location or scene.
result.label: verb 'setting' (not noun)

result.description: Fires on the token " professional" (and "Professional"), mostly in workplace communication and etiquette text such as "professional settings" or "professional relationships". Members are mostly detectors of the same token plus related words like profession and career.
result.label: ' professional' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' abstract' (adjective, noun or verb) in text about abstract concepts, nouns and thought. Members are mostly detectors of ' abstract' and related pieces such as 'abstraction'. The contrast has no ' abstract' token.
result.label: ' abstract' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' including' (also 'such as', 'like') right after a phrase like "in various fields/sectors", where a list of example domains or industries is about to start. Silent when 'including' follows a non-domain list.
result.label: Examples list after "various fields"

result.description: Fires mainly on 'omed' in a repeated "Biomedical" course-list heading (second occurrence, "Bi-omed-ical"), and on ' designed' in "designed to". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: 'omed' in Biomedical, ' designed'

result.description: Fires on the token ' strength' (and the stem in 'strengths', 'strengthen'), in business SWOT contexts and materials-science contexts alike. Predicts suffixes like 's', 'ened', 'ening'. Upstream members are mostly ' strength' detectors.
result.label: ' strength' token detector

result.description: Fires on the noun naming a group of people (designers, educators, teams, developers) right after "help(s)", as the object of the verb. It predicts a following verb like understand, improve or gauge.
result.label: Object of "help": people-group noun
inter- prefix mid-sentence
result.description: Fires on the word piece " inter" used as a prefix starting a word (interwoven, interdisciplinary, intertextuality, interfere) in academic prose. It is silent when the piece is at the very start of the document, and the next piece completes the word.

Fires on the final piece of "uncover" / "reveal" (uncover-ed, un-cover-ing, reve-al), where the next word is likely an object like "insights" or "hidden patterns". Silent on other "-ed" endings such as "authored" or "targeted".
result.label: Uncover/reveal verb ending

result.description: Fires on word endings or nouns in descriptions of a culture's or era's art and creative expression (art-istic, art-istry, creative expressions, flavors, spirit). It stays silent on some 'artistic expression' cases and on 'linguistic', so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Cultural artistic expression word endings

result.description: Fires on ' specific' (also ' particular', ' certain') used as a determiner after a verb or preposition, introducing a selected kind of noun ("focus on specific aspects", "meet specific needs"). Silent after demonstratives or possessives like "their specific forms".
result.label: specific/particular as object determiner

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dead' when it begins a longer word, mainly 'deadlock' (also 'deadline'), in computing/process-management text. It is silent on other uses in the contrast. Members are mostly ' dead' detectors.
result.label: ' dead' in deadlock

result.description: Fires on forms of "advance" (adv-ances, advanced, advance) as a verb of progress, e.g. "as data analytics advances and AI…", in tech/science text. It stays silent when "advances" is a noun after "progressive" or "future".
result.label: Verb "advance" progress in tech

result.description: Fires on ' often' (also ' sometimes') when it opens a trailing participial or appositive phrase after a comma, e.g. ", often leading to...". It stays silent when 'often' follows a verb or auxiliary ('are often assumed', 'but often find').
result.label: ', often' after comma clause

result.description: Fires on commas, "and", and verbs like imbue/convey/impart in lists or phrases about how art, design or writing creates depth, feeling or effect, where a noun like "depth", "vitality" or "detail" comes next. Silent on commas in grammar or linguistics lists.
result.label: Artistic effect lists: depth, imbue, convey

result.description: Fires on the token " power" in any sense: political or authority power (monarchical, imperial), and also energy/electrical power (hydraulic, steam). Also fires weakly on "power" inside words like "powerfully". Output boosts suffixes like "house" and "fully".
result.label: ' power' word detector
' trad' in tradition/trader words
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' trad' at the start of words like traditions, traders and trading, often after culinary, cultural or regional words. It stays silent on ' trad' in 'traded' and 'trading posts' in trade-history contexts.
Fires on the piece 'ci' inside the word "speciation" and its variants (speciatory, speciogenetic) in evolutionary biology text. It is silent when 'ci' starts a fresh word after a period.
result.label: 'ci' inside "speciation"

result.description: Fires on the relative pronoun ' who' right after a plural person noun (leaders, individuals, people, customers), starting a relative clause. Weaker after a named person or after 'artists'. Members are mostly ' who' and ' that' detectors.
result.label: relative pronoun 'who' after people nouns

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' g' / ' G' (case variants) when it starts a new word after a preceding word, e.g. "Greenhouse gases", "Economic Growth", "endocrine gland", "income gaps". Predicts continuations like 'ases', 'aps', 'rowth'-type endings.
result.label: Word-initial ' g' / ' G' token

result.description: Fires on the token ' aspect', most strongly in "a fundamental/significant/vital aspect of X". It is silent on "non-intuitive aspect", so it seems to need the noun used after an evaluative adjective and before "of".
result.label: ' aspect' after fundamental adjective

result.description: Fires on ' can' as a modal verb right after an agent subject (we, one, you, students, artists, researchers), where an active verb is expected next. It stays silent after relative 'that' or in passive-style 'can be' contexts.
result.label: ' can' after agent subject

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expl' when it starts a word like exploration, explore or exploratory, and pushes toward completions such as 'oration' and 'oring'. It stays silent when ' expl' begins a document.
result.label: ' expl' word-start (exploration)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that are the start of a longer word split into pieces, mainly ' ton' (before -ality), ' Fund' (amental), ' fil', ' Est'. Often in music or abstract academic text. Predicts a word continuation.
result.label: Word-start fragments like ton-/Fund-

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ipp' inside "stippling" (also in "ripples"), where a suffix continuation is expected. Weak, scattered activity on ' definition' and a few other words. Members are mostly 'ipp' piece detectors.
result.label: 'ipp' in stippling

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of an academic field name, mostly 'ology' (biology, geomorphology), also 'ics', 'istry', 'science'. Silent on 'ology' in 'methodology', so it needs the word to be a discipline name.
result.label: Academic field name suffix

result.description: Fires on an em dash (or ' --') that follows a noun or list item in technical or expository text, often starting an appositive, elaboration or list continuation. Silent on some dashes in other contexts.
result.label: Em dash after noun phrase

result.description: Fires on the word "balance" (and the piece "ance" in "Balance"), mostly as a noun in lists of design principles or "balance between". It is silent on at least one sentence-initial " balance" example.
result.label: balance word detector

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens (' only', ' Rich', ' section', ' theory', ' also'), mostly ' only' in non-"not only" use. Silent on ' only' after "not" or "can". Members are mostly junk-token detectors, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Mixed ' only' / ' Rich' tokens

result.description: Fires on sentence-ending question marks (occasionally '!' or a few word pieces), ending a sentence or clause. Weaker on periods. Members are punctuation detectors for '.', '...', '!!' and '?'.
result.label: Question mark sentence end
Diffuse mid-word and ' between' firing
result.description: Fires weakly on scattered tokens: ' between', word pieces (avel, itive, T in won't), 's in let's. No dominant token or clear context; members are diffuse with low specificity. Predicts verb-like next tokens weakly. Low faithfulness.

Fires on the token " art" when it follows "into" or "an" in a transformation phrase ("turn X into art", "an art form"), where it is often the start of "artistic". It stays silent after "the", "this" or "of".
result.label: ' art' after "into"/"an"

result.description: Fires on 'ending' as the suffix of 'spending' (especially government spending in economics text). Silent on 'ending' in other words like 'comprehending'. Weakly fires on 'expenditures'.
result.label: 'ending' in 'spending'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' rever' (as in reverberation, reverb) when the word is split into pieces. Members are detectors of other incomplete word-start fragments (renew, rot, conj, alleg) and ' rever' itself.
result.label: ' rever' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the adjective " local" (also " Local", " regional") right before a noun such as producers, ingredients, communities or businesses. Members mostly detect local, locally, regional, rural and national.
result.label: adjective "local" before a noun

result.description: Fires on the token "an" when it appears as a word-start fragment right after a sentence-ending period, with no space, as in ".an" followed by "cial" or "ies". It looks like a broken "Financial" or "Companies" after a sentence break.
result.label: "an" fragment after period

result.description: Fires on " on" right after "relies (heavily)" or "dependent/reliant", the preposition marking what something depends on. Silent on " on" after "based", "concentrate", "contingent", or "impact".
result.label: " on" after relies/dependent

result.description: Fires on ' was' (rarely ' were') when it is a fragment of a word like "wastes" or "washing" (plastic|was|tes, contour|was|hing). Predicts word-completing pieces such as 'tes' and 'hing'. Silent when ' was' starts the text.
result.label: ' was' as start of waste/wash

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, such as ' pl' (planners, plastic), 'current' (currently, concurrent) and '-' in Sturm-Liouville, where the next piece must complete the word. Silent on ' pl' after 'provides'. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (pl, current)

result.description: Fires on the word " until" (63 of 64 peaks), as a conjunction or preposition after a clause, as in "waiting until" or "not until". Members are mostly until/till detectors. The contrast gives no clear extra condition.
result.label: ' until' token detector

result.description: Fires on the end of positive quality adjectives in lists of system or material traits, such as resil-ient, reliable, secure, sturdy and dependable. It stays silent on 'ient' in 'proficient', so it needs this descriptive-adjective sense.
result.label: Resilient/reliable/secure quality adjectives

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece "rent" inside "apprentice/apprenticeship", and also on " patron" and "emph" (emphasis). These are mid-word pieces where the word is not yet complete; the logits suggest no clear next token.
result.label: "rent" in apprentice; patron, emph

result.description: Fires on the word piece " extra" when it begins "extraction", especially after "resource". It is silent when " extra" is followed by other endings, as in "made extraction". Members detect the extra-/abstra-/explo- prefix that precedes "-ction".
result.label: "extra" in "extraction"

result.description: Fires on plural category nouns (projects, aspects, areas, matters, issues, fields) right after a quantifier like "various" or "range of", where a list of types follows. Silent on "their projects" with a possessive.
result.label: Plural noun after "various"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ized' right after "personal" (personalized medicine, experiences, healthcare). Silent on 'ized' in other words like decentralized or revolutionized, so it needs the "personal" stem.
result.label: 'ized' in "personalized"

result.description: Fires on the token ' mean' when it is the noun stem of "meanings" (a split word, e.g. "different mean|ings") or the statistical mean, and predicts the suffix 'ings'. It is silent on the verb "mean" ("actually mean the same").
result.label: ' mean' as noun stem (meanings)

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece 'rec' at the start of a longer word like "precision" or "recognition", where a suffix such as -ision comes next. Weaker, scattered hits on other word fragments and on '1' in digit strings.
result.label: 'rec' word-start fragment (precision)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' organ' as the start of a longer word, mostly 'organ|ism' after 'living', also organic or organizational. Members are detectors of ' organ' and its continuations.
result.label: ' organ' word-start piece (organism)

result.description: Fires on the word-start token ' abandon' (mostly before '-ment') and on ' confront' (before '-ation'), with a few other word pieces like 'rac' in 'embraced'. It marks an incomplete word stem awaiting a suffix.
result.label: abandon-/confront- word stems

result.description: Fires on the modal ' must' after a noun subject (e.g. "ideas must be developed"), and more weakly on obligation 'to' ("required to", "forced to"). Members are mostly ' must' detectors in formal, expository text.
result.label: Obligation modal ' must'

result.description: Fires on the word " context" when it follows "on", "to", or "depending on (the)" as the thing meaning depends on, e.g. "dependent on context". Quieter in "in the context of" or after adjectives like "historical context".
result.label: ' context' as dependence object

result.description: Fires on forms of "become" (becomes, became, become, becoming) right after an abstract subject noun, predicting a state complement like "apparent", "evident", "clear" or "increasingly". Members are mostly detectors of become-forms.
result.label: "become" verb forms after subject

result.description: Fires on the quantifier ' some' (also 'Some') introducing a noun phrase, e.g. "there may be some", "examine some of". Members are mostly ' some' detectors; no clear extra condition from the contrast.
result.label: ' some' quantifier detector

result.description: Fires on the token " known" (e.g. "of known heat capacity", "known as", "well-known"), mostly in scientific or measurement text. Members are mainly detectors of " known" across earlier layers.
result.label: ' known' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " particles" (plural) in physics text about subatomic or charged particles. Upstream members detect particle/particles and related physics terms like Higgs, quantum and forces. Silent in a general QFT passage without the token.
result.label: ' particles' in physics text

result.description: Fires on the piece 'worth' inside 'trustworthy' / 'trustworthiness', after 'trust'. It predicts suffixes such as 'iness' and 'y'. Weakly fires on 'alla' in 'parallax'.
result.label: 'worth' in trustworthy
'u' inside "fluctuations"
result.description: Fires mainly on the 'u' piece in "fluct-u-ations/fluctuating", where a word-piece detector cluster predicts the continuation. It also fires weakly on ' to' after "turning/turned".

Fires on the word ' sensor' (and the 'ensor' piece of 'Sensor') when it is followed by a noun like technology, design or integration, mostly in robotics or engineering text. It stays silent when 'sensor' opens the text, with nothing before it.
result.label: ' sensor' token in technical text
'oph' in "homophone" word pieces
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'oph' inside "hom-oph-one(s)" and similar technical words (geophysics, esophagus, Diophantine). Stays silent on 'oph' in "sophisticated". Weaker on 'oul' in Bernoulli.

Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ote' in Geotechnical/geo- words, and ' Cons' in 'Sequential Consistency', where a word is being built and 'chn'/'istency' continuations are expected. Silent on 'ote' in 'otechnology' without a geo/nano prefix.
result.label: Mid-word 'ote' after geo-/nano-
Similarity words before "to"
result.description: Fires on ' similar' and related comparison words (liken-ed, comparable, related, due) where a "to" complement is expected, e.g. "similar to the influence…". Quiet on "is similar" at the end of a clause in technical text.

Fires on incomplete word-start fragments (' uniqu', ' vari', ' oblig', ' manif', ' li') in abstract academic text, where the next piece is a suffix completing the word (-ely, -ability, -ation). Predicts suffix continuation.
result.label: Word-start fragments awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on variation/specifier adjectives like "different", "varying", "various", "certain", "distinct", "specific" placed before a plural noun. Predicts nouns like kinds, amounts, types. Silent on the contrast text, which lacks such a word.
result.label: Variety adjectives before plural nouns

result.description: Fires on auxiliary "has/had/have" right after "what" (or a relative subject) in a free relative clause, like "what has been agreed", where a past participle such as "been" is expected next. Silent on "has" after a quoted word as main verb.
result.label: has/had after 'what' relative clause

result.description: Fires on plural abstract nouns (methods, forms, applications, capabilities, explanations) after a comparative "more/wider/higher + adjective" phrase, where "than" is likely next. Silent on "methods" after technical field words like computational or statistical.
result.label: Noun after comparative modifier, expecting 'than'

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: quantity nouns like " number", " amount", " extent" before "of" (e.g. "the number of"), plus "it" inside words like "epitaxial" or "parasitic". Silent on "A significant number of". Mixed, weak evidence.
result.label: Quantity nouns 'the number of' and 'it' pieces

result.description: Fires on " the" right after verbs like laid, set, provided, paved, in idioms such as "laid the groundwork", "set the stage/standard". Predicts foundation-like nouns. Silent on " the" after prepositions or other verbs.
result.label: "the" after laid/set/provided (groundwork)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer, multi-piece words (Ger-b-ner, Liter-ary, cru-cial, et-iquette), where the word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. Peaks are varied; the evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of split words

result.description: Fires mostly on " font"/" Font" (also " type", " ser" of serif) in typography text, especially after style words like serif or classic. Silent in one font example. Predicts word-continuation suffixes like "-", "ive", "ion". Circuit is diffuse and weak.
result.label: font word in typography text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' del' when it starts "delicate" (also weakly "delve"). It stays silent on some "delicate" cases, such as at the very start of a text or after certain words, so the context matters. Members are ' del' detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: ' del' in "delicate"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mainly 'elect' in piezoelectric, ' comple' (complements), 'over', and the ' <' of HTML tags. Peaks are mixed, and the logits show no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: Word-start fragments: elect, comple, over

result.description: Fires on the verb-ending piece of "foster" and similar promotion verbs (fost-er, encourag-es, promotes, cultivating) in lists of positive outcomes. Silent on "er" inside unrelated words like "synergy". Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Foster/promote verb endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' insp' at the start of inspire/inspiring/inspiration, before the rest of the word is seen. It predicts the suffixes 'ire', 'iration' and 'iring'. Members are mostly ' insp' detectors plus similar pieces like stim-, motiv-, inqu-.
result.label: ' insp' word-piece (inspire)

result.description: Fires on the possessive ' their' (also his, its, 's) right after a clause opener like "how", "where", "the way", "that", when a possessed noun with its own possessive follows. Silent after "as", "within", "discuss".
result.label: Possessive 'their' after clause openers

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' gre' (greener, grease, greedy), a fragment that needs a continuation like -edy, -ener or -ase. Members are detectors of ' gre' and similar incomplete word starts.
result.label: ' gre' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the verb "introduce" and its pieces (introdu-cing/ces) when a cause brings in something new, such as latency, carriers or details. Silent on "introduce" in the sense of presenting a topic, as in "introduce relative clause".
result.label: introduce as bringing in new effects
Verb 'form' as constitute
result.description: Fires on ' form'/' forms' used as a verb meaning "constitute", typically after a plural subject, as in "these principles form the basis of". It stays silent on the noun 'form' (a kind of, or form of argumentation) and on 'form' as a prefix in words like formative.

Fires on word-initial fragments ' ob' (objection, oboe, obedience) and ' pun' (punctuation, puns), weaker on ' dep' (depicting), where the word continues in the next token. Members are mostly ' ob'/' pun' token detectors.
result.label: Word-start fragments ob / pun

result.description: Fires on the 'st' token in "Amidst" at the start of a document (e.g. "Amidst a global..."). Silent on 'st' in ordinal "21st". Weak on a few other word-piece splits.
result.label: "st" in "Amidst"
' cop' as word-start fragment
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cop' when it begins a longer, split-up word such as copolymer or copiousness. It is silent on whole words. It predicts continuation pieces like 'r', 'oli' and ' Sc'.

Fires on ' requires' (also ' involves') right after an abstract noun subject, like "effective communication requires", where a demand or needed action comes next. Silent when it starts the text with no subject before it.
result.label: requires/involves after abstract subject

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' atmos' (before -pheric) and ' determin' (before -ant/-ism), where the token is an incomplete prefix of a longer word. Members are detectors of these pieces and 'air'/'mos'.
result.label: atmos- and determin- word prefixes

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'arg' inside "bargain" words (bargain, bargained, bargaining, bargainer), mostly after "b". It stays silent when 'arg' starts the text without a preceding "b".
result.label: 'arg' in bargain

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' clin' (clinical, clinician), mostly in medical or research text. It predicts the continuation 'ical'. Members detect word pieces that begin medical or scientific words.
result.label: ' clin' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the adjective " main" (occasionally " primary") after "the" or similar determiners, before a head noun like idea, message, verb or point. Members are mostly detectors of main/primary/central.
result.label: "main" as modifier adjective

result.description: Fires on the word piece " hum"/" Hum" at the start of words like humour, humorous, humidity, humid. Members are mostly detectors of the " hum" token. Weak firing on similar pieces such as "pam" and "hum" in humpbacks.
result.label: "hum" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a verb or preposition (affect, regardless of, independently of, state of) in quantum-physics text about particle states, predicting "state"/"states" next. Silent on ' the' in other constructions, like after "contravening" or "comprised of".
result.label: ' the' before "state" in quantum text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "it" inside multi-piece words, such as aud-it, expend-it-ures and exc-it-onic. It stays quiet on "it" in other words like legitimate, prioritizing, deficit and facilitates.
result.label: "it" piece in aud-it, expend-it-ures

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period in text that compares two related topics or approaches, where the next sentence likely begins with a reference like "The former/latter" or "These". It is silent on many periods in similar text, and the cause isn't clear.
result.label: Period in two-topic comparison text

result.description: Fires on the token ' T' in immune-biology text, mainly in "T cells" or "helper T" before "cell" or "lymphocyte". Weak activation on other T/t word starts. Silent on immune text that lacks the T token.
result.label: T in T cells

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " therm" (thermometer, thermocouple, thermodynamics), a prefix that continues into a longer word. Members are mostly detectors of " therm" and related thermo/physics pieces.
result.label: ' therm' word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after the word "real" (real-time, real-world, real-life), predicting "time" or "world" next. It stays silent on hyphens after other words like problem-, high-, hands-, AI-.
result.label: Hyphen after "real"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of long multi-piece words, mainly 'dep' in interdependence, 'av' in concavity, also ' contrib' and 'defin' in indefinite. Fires on the word piece before the rest of the word completes.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: dep, av, contrib

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' the' after verbs like convey/communicate, the 'urt' piece in nurture/kurtosis, and word-initial 'd'. The mix is inconsistent, and ' the' is often silent elsewhere, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed: 'the', 'urt', 'd' pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' completing "metallic" (also in organometallic, metallurgical-type words), in materials-science text. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as "ionic" or "polymeric".
result.label: 'ic' ending of "metallic"

result.description: Fires on the end of a word or compound after a specific prefix: ' programming' after "dynamic", 'here' in "adhere", 'ning' in "spinning". Mixed word-final pieces; the tokens share no meaning, and the next token is often a continuation like "to" or "strictly".
result.label: Word-final pieces: programming, adhere, spinning

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ien' inside 'audiences' (aud-ien-ces). Members mostly detect 'ien' and similar mid-word pieces in split words. Weak activations on other mid-word fragments.
result.label: 'ien' in 'audiences'

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ete' in "Intrusion Detection" (a misspelled/split "Dete-ction"), and weakly on other mid-word pieces like 'ks' in "seeks". Members are detectors of 'ete' pieces.
result.label: 'ete' piece in Detection

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' emot' (start of emotion/emotional) when it follows an adjective like subtle, intricate, unstated, layered, conveying. It stays quiet after 'an', 'as', 'to', or a possessive. Members are mostly ' emot' detectors.
result.label: ' emot' after descriptive adjective

result.description: Fires on the word piece " intellect" (as in intellect, intellectuals, intellectually), often before a suffix. It is silent on the full word "intellectual". Upstream members detect related mind and virtue words such as rational, vision and virt.
result.label: ' intellect' word stem
"itch" in "kitchens"
result.description: Fires on the piece "itch" when it follows "k" in "kitchens" (plural kitchen contexts). Members detect "itch" and word-initial k-fragments. It stays quiet on other words such as knife text.
Fires on the piece 'ex' right after a negating prefix 'non-' (e.g. non-excludable, non-exclusive), where it begins a word like 'excludable'. It stays quiet on 'ex' after a bare hyphen without 'non'.
result.label: 'ex' after 'non-' prefix
