Fires on the word " revolution" after a modifier such as industrial, scientific, agricultural or digital, as in "the industrial revolution". It stays silent when "revolution" starts the text with no preceding modifier.
result.label: "revolution" after modifier (industrial)

result.description: Fires on the suffix completing "anatom" (-ical, -y) in anatomy text. It stays silent on 'ical' in other words like Classical, Alchemical, empirical. Members mostly detect anatomy-style word pieces.
result.label: Anatom-ical / anatom-y suffix

result.description: Fires on the word " step" (also "mil-est-ones", " spe") as a progress/advance noun, often before "forward", "towards" or "-wise". Members are mostly detectors of " step" itself.
result.label: "step" as progress noun

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ov' (Markov, Chekhov-type surnames, photovoltaic, cardiovascular), 'ac' in vernacular, and 'roph'. Members are mostly 'ov' detectors. Predicts word continuations like -sky, -irus, -itis, -ial.
result.label: Mid-word 'ov' / 'ac' fragments

result.description: Fires on function words (the, and, of, a) and some nouns mid-phrase, especially after "and" in a definition or pair of terms (signifier/signified), where a noun or quoted term comes next. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function word before defined term

result.description: Fires on ' capital' (economic capital, before -ism/-ization/accumulation) and on ' talent' as a managed resource, in economics and HR text. Weaker on related words like candidates. Predicts allocation/flows-type continuations.
result.label: capital / talent as economic resource

result.description: Fires on the piece "ur" inside "heuristic(s)" (he-ur-istics), predicting the "istics" continuation. Silent on "ur" in other words such as "urists".
result.label: "ur" in "heuristics"

result.description: Fires on varied words (e.g. "for", "diverse", "music") in text about materials' diverse characteristics and applications, such as "crucial for their various applications". It stays quiet on "crucial for" in computing/optimization text.
result.label: Diverse properties and applications phrasing

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "times" (also "time", "face") in phrases like "in times of crisis/low demand". Stays silent on ' of' after other nouns such as types, part, one, outcomes. Predicts state words like limited, scarce, high.
result.label: "times of" (hardship) ' of'

result.description: Fires on ' new' used as an adjective after a verb or article, before a noun like ways, life, form or perspectives. It is silent when ' new' starts the text or follows 'this'. Logits are mixed.
result.label: Adjective ' new' mid-phrase

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iv' inside split words like construct-iv-ism, object-iv-ism, posit-iv-ism, carn-iv-ores, and weakly on 'char' in polysaccharides. Silent on 'iv' in 'pivotal'. Predicts suffixes like -ism, -ist, -ities.
result.label: 'iv' piece before -ism/-ist suffix

result.description: Fires on the token " access" (also " Access") in many contexts, such as access control, unauthorized access, access to, and accessibility or accessories. It pushes next-token predictions towards suffixes like "ibility" and "ories".
result.label: ' access' token detector

result.description: Fires on function words (by, to, because, the, several) right after a cause/obstacle phrase such as "hampered by", "due to", "challenges ... because", where a cause or list of causes comes next. Silent on agentive "by" in other uses.
result.label: Cause/obstacle connector before explanation

result.description: Fires on the end of "emotions" (the "ions" piece after "emot") and on "feelings" when the text is about emotions; silent on "ions" in other words like progressions or conventions. Predicts words like "associated" or "related".
result.label: emotions / feelings noun end

result.description: Fires on the word " digital" (also "Digital") as a modifier mid-sentence before a noun like media, platforms, or audio. It stays silent when " digital" opens the text, as in "digital era".
result.label: ' digital' as a noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the verb "helped" (also help/helps/helping), mostly after an abstract or inanimate subject, in the pattern "X helped (to) verb". Members are mostly detectors of help/helping/assist variants.
result.label: "helped" after a subject noun

result.description: Fires on a middle word piece (e.g. 'ard', 'us', 'sky') inside a multi-token surname of a famous scientist or thinker, such as Willard, Clausius, Podolsky. It stays silent when the piece starts the text or sits in Kierkegaard.
result.label: Mid-surname piece of scientist names

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ues' completing "clues" (cl|ues), often where clues are given about something. It stays silent on 'ues' in "tongues", so it needs the cl- prefix.
result.label: 'ues' in "clues"

result.description: Fires on plural person-role nouns (participants, citizens, individuals, -ers/-als) after an adjective in civic or educational text about people becoming active or responsible. Silent on verb-ending 'ers' like fosters or empowers. Predicts -hip/-ships or "who".
result.label: Plural person nouns (citizens, participants)

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'em' in "epistemic/epistemology" (also "phonemic") and on 'ations' in "installations". Silent on 'em' in "ephemeral", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: epist-em-ic and install-ations pieces

result.description: Fires on the token right after "as" (often a word fragment such as "lessly" in "as seamlessly as", " emb", " cons", " coh"), where a word continues after "as". Contrast text lacks this "as" slot.
result.label: Token following "as" (word pieces)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mostly ' conver' (convergent), also ' ach' (achieving), ' prof' (proficiency/profound). It predicts the continuation of the word (-gent, -ieving, -ound).
result.label: Word-start fragments: conver, ach, prof

result.description: Fires on quantifier words like "various", "many", "numerous", "several" after a preposition (e.g. "in various fields", "in many applications"), especially in expository text. It predicts a plural noun for fields or applications.
result.label: Quantifier 'various/many' after preposition

result.description: Fires on the plural noun " colors"/" colours", most strongly in art and color-theory text (e.g. "primary colors", "secondary colors"). Weaker in other contexts such as produce or light dispersion.
result.label: Plural "colors" in color theory

result.description: Fires on " particular" in the phrase "in particular", usually at the start of a sentence or as a parenthetical after "in". Members detect "particular", "in contrast", "specifically" and "especially".
result.label: "in particular" phrase

result.description: Fires on the plural biochemical suffix pieces 'ides'/'ids' ending a chemical class noun (lipids, triglycerides, polysaccharides, nucleosides). Silent on 'ides' inside other words like 'molecides' or 'widespread'.
result.label: Biochemical class suffix -ides/-ids

result.description: Fires on ' character' when it is the start of the verb "characterized" (after a comma or "is/was/often", before "-ized by"). Silent when 'character' is a noun about fictional characters or traits. Logits favor suffix-like continuations.
result.label: 'character' in "characterized by"

result.description: Fires mainly on " religion"/" Religion", with weaker, odd peaks on "ull" in "Hull" and "cies" in "intricacies". Members are mostly detectors of religion words (religious, faith, Relig). The target's peak set is mixed.
result.label: religion word, plus stray 'ull'

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces ' kin' (kinematics, kinetic), ' coh' (coherence, cohomology) and ' synth' (synthesis, synthesizers), where the word continues in the next token. Mostly technical text.
result.label: Word-start pieces kin-, coh-, synth-

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vent' inside "unconventional" (also "conventional"), predicting a suffix like 'ional'. Weakly fires on similar mid-word pieces such as 'att' and 'get'.
result.label: 'vent' in unconventional

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " reconst" (also "const", "itation") in the middle of a word like "reconstruction", predicting the continuation "ruction". It appears mostly in academic text on linguistics and reconstruction methods.
result.label: reconst- word-piece before -ruction
Food preservation/cooking suffix (freezing, refrigeration)
result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces 'zing', 'ation', 'ing' completing food-processing terms like freezing and refrigeration, in lists of food preservation or cooking methods. Silent on general cooking text without such a suffix.

Fires on the second element or end of a word inside a "merge/combine/blend X and Y" construction (e.g. "merges culinary arts", "combine expertise and resources"). It predicts a combining continuation like "with", "into" or "elements". It stays silent on the same word pieces, such as "ology", in ordinary text.
result.label: Merging/combining two domains construction

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' enthus' (before iasm/iast), and less on ' fun' and ' passion', where a longer word is likely to continue. Often follows "and" or a verb in lists of positive traits.
result.label: enthus- word start piece
' phys' in "…physiology" after field word
result.description: Fires on the piece ' phys' (or 'phys') that starts "physiology" in headings like "Renal physiology", after a field-modifier word. It also weakly fires on name fragments like Clausius and Plateau.

Fires on varied word pieces, often participle or suffix endings (' trained', 'iled', 'atile', 'es', ' typing') in the middle of a phrase. Peaks are scattered and weakly consistent; the next-token logits are weak and mixed.
result.label: Scattered participle and suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on ' of' or ' to' right after "consideration" or "attention" (e.g. "careful consideration of", "attention to detail"), in requirement-style technical text. It predicts "detail", "factors", "accuracy". Silent on other 'of' uses like "levels of" or "example of".
result.label: of/to after consideration/attention
Software at start of heading
result.description: Fires on the word "Software" (mostly capitalized), especially as the first token of a document or heading line such as "Software Configuration Management" or "Software Quality Assurance". Weaker firing on "###" headings. Predicts engineering or development-type continuations.

Fires on the article ' a' (rarely ' an') right after "towards", "encouraging", "inspire a shift towards" in uplifting sustainability prose, where an adjective like "more", "collective" or "greener" follows. Silent on ' a' after copulas or verbs such as "represents" or "is".
result.label: ' a' after "towards"/encouraging

result.description: Fires on the word " introduction" in "the introduction of X" (new technology or change arriving), after "the". Members are introduction detectors plus similar nouns like creation, advent, development, establishment.
result.label: "the introduction of" noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Riemann' (as in Riemann Hypothesis) and on ' bott' at the start of 'bottlenecks'. Two distinct tokens share the latent; it is mostly a Riemann detector, supported by members for math-name pieces.
result.label: Riemann and bott(lenecks) token

result.description: Fires on the verb " serves" (also " serve") when a subject is followed by the "serves as / serves to" role construction. Members detect serve/act/function verbs in the same slot.
result.label: verb "serves" (serves as)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ib' mainly inside 'antibody/antibodies', also in Caribbean and Fibonacci. Members are mostly 'ib' detectors. Weak firing on 'ional' in some words.
result.label: 'ib' piece in antibody

result.description: Fires on the token " thrust" (including inside "ion thrusters") in propulsion and aerospace text, such as generating thrust or lift, drag and thrust. Supported by members for propulsion, aircraft, engines and thrust.
result.label: " thrust" in propulsion text

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' marg' (as in "marginal" utility/cost/analysis), predicting the continuation "inal". Members are detectors of ' marg' and similar word-start fragments. Silent in generic economics text lacking the piece.
result.label: ' marg' word-start piece (marginal)

result.description: Fires on the token " meaning" (noun) in texts about language, semantics and philosophy, e.g. "creating meaning", "understanding meaning". It predicts suffixes like "ful" and "less". Members are mostly detectors of "meaning"/"mean".
result.label: ' meaning' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "backup" (and "backups", "ups") in data-backup text, such as types of backup like full, incremental or differential. Members are mostly "backup" token detectors. Weak firing on a few unrelated word pieces.
result.label: backup token in data backup text

result.description: Fires on the verb "save"/"saving" in the sense of conserving or rescuing (money, energy, the planet), mostly as a verb after "can", "to" or "while". Predicts objects like money, lives, dollars.
result.label: save / saving verb

result.description: Fires on the word "independent"/"Independent" (and the start of "adaptive" as " adapt"), mostly when it is a modifier in technical or grammatical text, such as independent events, variables or clauses. Members are mostly "independent" detectors.
result.label: independent / adapt word detector

result.description: Fires on commas (also 'and') after an item in a list of fields, sectors or industries (healthcare, finance, ...), expecting another domain next. Silent on commas before relative clauses like 'which'.
result.label: Comma in lists of fields/sectors

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " tour" (before -ism/-ist) in text about tourism, geography and sustainability. It also fires on " coordinate" in a few cases. Predicts the word's continuation as a noun such as stations or routes.
result.label: ' tour' as start of tourism

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' th' when it begins a split word, mainly "th" before "erapeut-" (therapeutic), after words like create, personalized or novel. Predicts continuations like 'era'. Members are word-start piece detectors.
result.label: ' th' starting 'therapeutic'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' card' when it is the start of a longer word, mostly 'cardio-'/'cardiac' in medical text, and expects a continuation piece next. Members detect ' card' and similar word-start fragments.
result.label: ' card' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ian' ending doctrine or school-of-thought adjectives such as egalitarian, utilitarian, Lagrangian, Bayesian, and predicts 'ism' next. Weakly fires on 'relativ' in moral relativism.
result.label: -ian suffix in -ism doctrine words
' aw' before 'areness'
result.description: Fires on the split word piece ' aw' when it begins "awareness", after words like public, consumer, global, environmental or raise. It predicts the continuation 'aren'. It stays silent when ' aw' starts the document with no preceding word.

Fires on verbs meaning "includes/encompasses/involves" (including the 'es' of encompasses), especially as a sentence-initial or subject-following verb introducing a list or set of components. Predicts a gerund or component noun next.
result.label: includes / encompasses / involves verbs

result.description: Fires on "ized" after "standard" (standardized) and on "of" in "unit of" (measurement), in measurement and standards contexts. It predicts "measurement" or "tests". It is silent on "ized" in "characterized".
result.label: standardized / unit of measurement

result.description: Fires on the token " artist" (singular, often before 's or as "the artist"), in text about art and creators. Members detect " artist" and similar role nouns (composer, writer, teacher, director). Silent on general "art" text lacking the word.
result.label: ' artist' token detector

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' sm', ' bul', ' pan', ' rep' that are followed by a suffix continuing the word (smiling, bulbs, panels, replication). Predicts word-continuation fragments such as 'elling', 'gs'.
result.label: Word-start fragments sm/bul/pan/rep

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ut' in the middle of longer words (pharmaceutical, pollutant, nutrient, hermeneutic, absolutism, scrutiny). It predicts continuations like 'ic', 'iny', 'ical', 'ri'.
result.label: 'ut' mid-word piece

result.description: Fires on the word " satisfaction", mostly in business or workplace text about customer or employee satisfaction, loyalty and engagement. It predicts follow-ons like ratings, scores and levels. It is weakly active on related outcome nouns such as morale and trust.
result.label: satisfaction (customer/employee)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'od' completing "lifeblood", as in "X is the lifeblood of Y". Members detect 'od'/'id'/'on' word pieces inside longer words, but the target is specific to this word.
result.label: 'od' in "lifeblood"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ative'/'ive' in adjectives like indicative, reflective, symptomatic, where the word is followed by "of". It stays silent on noun or other uses such as narrative, provocative, transformative.
result.label: indicative/reflective adjective suffix before "of"

result.description: Fires on "by" as the second piece of "whereby", where the word is split into "where" + "by". It predicts a following subject pronoun such as "they", "there" or "we".
result.label: "by" in "whereby"

result.description: Fires on " learning" in "machine learning" (and similar ML terms like reinforcement learning), predicting ML nouns like models, applications, tasks. Stays silent in some other uses, e.g. "transfer learning", "adaptive learning", or sentence-initial " learning".
result.label: learning in machine learning

result.description: Fires on ' that' (occasionally ' which') used as a relative pronoun right after a plural or object noun (e.g. "structures that", "designs that"), introducing a clause describing that noun. Silent on complementizer or demonstrative uses like "concept that span refers".
result.label: Relative 'that' after noun

result.description: Fires on ' complex' (also 'Complex', 'intricate') as an adjective in phrases like "complex analysis" or "complex network/system", after "in/the". Quieter on "complex ideas/sentences/arguments" in language-writing contexts.
result.label: Adjective 'complex' in technical contexts
Word-start ' hon' (honesty, honing)
result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' hon' that begins a longer word such as honesty or honing, and pushes towards continuations like 'esty' and 'ing'. Members are mostly other word-start fragment detectors.

Fires on the token " Berlin", mostly in "the Berlin Wall" or Berlin Blockade in Cold War and German history text. It pushes towards names like Franz and Wall-related continuations. Members are Berlin detectors plus German and Cold War context.
result.label: Berlin in Cold War history

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "immerse/immersive/immersion/immersing" (ive, ersion, se, ing) after the "imm"/"immers" start. It stays silent on -ive in other words like inventive, perceive, expressive.
result.label: immers- word completion

result.description: Fires on the word piece "cel" inside "porcelain", mid-word before "ain". Weak activation on other mid-word fragments like " supre" (supremacy) and " commun" (communism).
result.label: "cel" in porcelain

result.description: Fires on the ' polym' piece in "DNA polymerase" / "RNA polymerase" (molecular biology). It stays silent on ' polym' in materials-science "polymers", so it needs the nucleic-acid context before it.
result.label: polym in DNA/RNA polymerase

result.description: Fires on the word "conditional" (and its pieces like Cond-itional), as in conditional sentences, conditional probability or conditional independence. Members detect "conditional", "Cond" and "itional" tokens plus nearby grammar/statistics terms.
result.label: word "conditional"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mil' when it begins "milestone" after a preceding word (e.g. "significant mil", "other mil"). It also weakly fires on "through" in "breakthrough". It stays silent when "milestones" starts the text.
result.label: "mil" in milestone

result.description: Fires on prepositions (mostly ' with', also across/over/in) right after a verb like increases, decreases or diminishes, marking what a quantity varies with (altitude, time, distance). Silent on other uses of 'with', such as accompaniment.
result.label: Quantity varies 'with' preposition

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces (day, athlet-ic, omed, diverse, big) in materials/industry-product phrases like "from everyday items to...", "a diverse range of products". Predicts product/household-type nouns. Evidence is mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Everyday-products phrase word pieces

result.description: Fires on the '%' sign after a number and on the word piece 'ty' (as in "certainty", "strongly-typed"). Two unrelated tokens share the peak; the circuit has separate detectors for each.
result.label: '%' after numbers and 'ty' piece

result.description: Fires on suffix or continuation tokens (-ness, -ization, -ized, " number") right after the word "random" in statistics and sampling text. It stays silent on "robust-ness" and other -ness words.
result.label: Suffix after "random"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'och' inside "mitochondria/mitochondrial". It stays silent on 'och' in other words such as cryptochrome and stereochemistry, so it needs the mit- prefix.
result.label: 'och' in mitochondrial

result.description: Fires on word pieces in thermodynamics-related words, mainly 'iger' in refrigerator/refrigeration, also 'not' in Carnot and weaker on therm-/co-oper-. Appears to need being inside these specific words in a thermal/Carnot cycle context.
result.label: refrigerator 'iger' / Carnot piece

result.description: Fires on the token " play" (also "plays"), mostly as the stem of words like playful, playground, playlist, and in "play a role". Predicts compound-forming suffixes such as "lists", "ful" and "ground". Members are detectors of play/playing/plays.
result.label: " play" word stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' conver' (start of convergent/converge/converging), mostly in math text about series and sequences. It predicts continuations like 'gent' or 'ge'. Silent on the full word 'convergence'.
result.label: ' conver' word-piece in convergence

result.description: Fires on the capitalized piece 'AN' inside an uppercase acronym or name, mainly ARPANET and PAN, where it follows other letters. It stays silent when 'AN' starts the text.
result.label: AN inside acronyms (ARPANET)

result.description: Fires on quality adjectives like "robust", "reliable", "accurate" after verbs like ensure, produce, develop, in technical or statistical/logic writing. It predicts continuations like "ness", "inference", "conclusions". Silent when "robust" starts the text.
result.label: robust/reliable/accurate quality adjectives

result.description: Fires on a word-start fragment (mostly ' emb', also ' el', ' met', ' un') right after "By" at the very start of a document, as in "By embracing". It is silent on ' emb' in mid-sentence contexts. Logits favour suffix pieces like 'ester', 'iled'.
result.label: Document-initial "By" + word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on " both"/" Both" as a determiner opening a pair of items, especially at clause start before two coordinated nouns (e.g. "both music and literature"). Quiet after the preposition "for" in one contrast example.
result.label: "both" introducing a pair

result.description: Fires on the token ' accuracy' (as a noun, often listed with precision, in measurement or evaluation contexts). Upstream members are mostly ' accuracy'/' precision' detectors from earlier layers. The one contrast example is silent because it lacks the word.
result.label: ' accuracy' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " population" in ecology, statistics and demography text (population variance, dynamics, growth, sample representativeness). Predicts continuations like growth, density, variance. Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' population' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb suffix pieces -ified/-ifies/-ifying/-ify/-ification, mostly in "intensify" and "amplify" (increase-type verbs), e.g. "intensified by climate change". Weakly on "intensity of". Predicts words like severe or conflicts.
result.label: -ify suffix in intensify/amplify

result.description: Fires on the noun "objective" (also "object" in "objectives", and "goal"/"aim") meaning a purpose, typically after modifiers like "primary", "main" or "ultimate" at the start of a statement of purpose.
result.label: Objective/goal noun meaning purpose

result.description: Fires on the word " necessity", mostly in abstract or philosophical text such as modal logic and metaphysical necessity. It fires more weakly on " need". Members mainly detect " necessity" and " need".
result.label: ' necessity' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'uck' (as in plucking, Puck) and 'o' in Paleozoic/Mesozoic. Both are mid-word pieces of longer technical words, often in geology or science text.
result.label: Mid-word 'uck' and 'o' pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'als' at the end of "universals" (e.g. "lexical universals", "Phonological Universals"). It is much weaker on other words ending in 'als', such as "numerals", and silent on "Festivals" and "reveals".
result.label: 'als' in "universals"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rom' in "aroma" and "aromatics" (a + rom). Members are mostly 'rom' detectors from earlier layers, plus some token-piece members for the preceding 'a'.
result.label: 'rom' in aroma/aromatics

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of the second item after "X and" in short title-like lists (e.g. "Circles and[ tang]ents", "Art and[ A]esthetics"). It peaks on varied word starts, such as Anth-, tang-, ar-, A-. It is quiet in plain lists of subject names.
result.label: Word start after "X and" in titles

result.description: Fires on the word " private" in mid-text, including before word pieces like "-eer" (privateer) and in "public-private". It is silent when " private" opens the text. Members are mostly private/personal/sector detectors.
result.label: ' private' token detector

result.description: Fires on words meaning selection or choosing (' selection', ' choice', ' chosen', ' suitable'), typically as a noun of a process, and pushes towards 'for', 'criteria', 'method', 'procedure'. Members are detectors of select/choose word forms.
result.label: Selection / choice words

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Un" at the start of a longer word, especially "Uncertainty" after "Heisenberg". Members detect "Un"/"un" prefixes. Weak activation on " A" in "AI". Predicts word continuations.
result.label: Un- prefix in Heisenberg Uncertainty

result.description: Fires on adjective-forming suffix pieces (-ical, -ographic, -istic) and "Cultural" when they sit in a repeated title-style heading in a list of academic topic headings (e.g. "Orthographic Variation."). Quiet on "ical" in other words like "Radical" or "Classical".
result.label: Adjective suffixes in topic headings

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Ge' / ' ge' that begins geo- words (geodetic, geoid, geomorphic, geography), especially at the start of a line in geodesy or geoscience text. It predicts geo-word continuations such as 'ographical' and 'od'.
result.label: Geo- word-start piece ' Ge'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' innov' (start of innovative/innovation), mostly after a determiner or possessive like "an" or "their", and predicts the suffix 'ative' or 'ation'. It is quieter after verbs or commas.
result.label: ' innov' word-start before suffix

result.description: Fires on verbs meaning "come about" (arise, occur, manifest), mostly after modals like "can/may" or "that", where a problem, error or condition is said to appear. Predicts the next word as a cause or circumstance (from, during, when).
result.label: Arise/occur verbs for problems appearing

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' diss' (dissipation, dissent, dissatisfaction) and sometimes other mid-word pieces like 'ic' in genomic. Needs an incomplete word whose continuation is a multi-piece word. Upstream members are fragment detectors (rev, disp, inher, Hyp, ha).
result.label: ' diss' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece (-ing, -es, -ed) completing the verb "enrich", e.g. "enrich[ing] the reader". It stays silent on -ing after other verbs like unlocking or encouraging. Predicts objects such as lives, experiences, our.
result.label: suffix after "enrich"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "mer", mostly in "simmer", "simmering" and "simmered" in cooking text. It also fires weakly in "warmer" and "Merger". Next-token logits favor continuations like "ged" and "gar".
result.label: "mer" piece in simmer

result.description: Fires on the token " script", most strongly when it names a writing system (Cyrillic script, Sanskrit script). It is silent on a bare sentence-initial " script" with no writing-system context. Upstream members are mostly " script" detectors plus writing-system context.
result.label: ' script' as writing system

result.description: Fires on the word piece " narr" (start of narrative/narrator/narrating), mostly in lists of narrative types like "Third-person limited narrative". It predicts completions such as "ative", "atives" and "atori".
result.label: ' narr' word-start before -ative

result.description: Fires on the third digit of a four-digit year right after "19" (e.g. 19[7]0s, 19[3]0s), at the decade digit. Silent on similar digits in "early 19 7 0s", apostrophe decades, or "17th century".
result.label: Decade digit in 19xx years

result.description: Fires on " necessary" as a modifier after "the" following "provide(s)" (e.g. "provides the necessary infrastructure"). Stays silent on predicative "may not be necessary". Members detect necessary/needed/required/correct.
result.label: "the necessary" after provide

result.description: Fires on the piece 'avel' inside "wavelength(s)", after the 'w' piece, and predicts 'ength' next. It is silent when 'avel' starts a document with no preceding 'w'.
result.label: 'avel' in wavelength

result.description: Fires on the article ' a'/' an' right after a copula ("is a", "was an", "becomes a") introducing a predicate noun that characterizes the subject. It stays silent on 'a' after prepositions, "not", or verbs like "plays a".
result.label: Article 'a' after copula "is/was"

result.description: Fires on a period ending a sentence, especially in advice or instructional prose about writing or safety. It stays quiet on periods inside URLs or abbreviations like "e.g." and on some other sentence ends.
result.label: Sentence-final period in expository text

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and nouns (' nor', ' and', '/', ' of', ' across', ' economy') in technical or grammatical/logical explanatory text, often in coordinated lists or conjunction discussions. Peaks are mixed; evidence is weak and the circuit failed.
result.label: Conjunctions in grammar/logic lists

result.description: Fires on ' nature' in "the nature of X" in philosophical or academic discussion (ontology, reality, knowledge), predicting " of". Silent on "human nature".
result.label: "the nature of" in philosophical discussion

result.description: Fires on ' to' or ' by' that complete causal-attribution phrases like "thanks to", "due to", "owing to", "fueled by", "spurred by", introducing a cause. Stays silent on "led to", "designed to", and infinitive 'to'.
result.label: Causal 'thanks to' / 'fueled by'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cl' in the middle of a word split into tokens (nomen-cl-ature, nu-cl-ides, super-cl-usters, recy-cl-ables). It predicts continuations like 'uster', 'imate' and 'ature'. It stays silent on a standalone word-initial 'cl' such as 'clones'.
result.label: 'cl' piece inside split words
' Bra' word-start piece
result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' Bra' at the start of a longer word, mostly Brahmagupta, Brahman and Brahmi-type names, where the rest of the word follows. Weakly fires on similar word-start pieces such as ' bra' in brainstorming.

Fires on the last piece of a plural noun (landscapes, societies, paradigms, shifts, changes) that ends a phrase about shifting societal or cultural change, as in "reflecting changing cultural landscapes". Silent in a looser, non-descriptive context.
result.label: Societal/cultural change plural nouns

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "long" (or short) in "long-term" style compounds, predicting "term"/"run". It stays silent on hyphens in other compounds such as cost-effectiveness, decision-making, fast-changing.
result.label: Hyphen in long-term compounds

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' stra' (strain) and ' fla' (flaws), mostly in technical text, where the next piece completes the word. Members are detectors of these word-start fragments.
result.label: Word-start fragments stra-/fla-

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: mid-word pieces in "hemicellulose", and ' of'/' to' after nouns like "cost of", in science and business text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. The circuit failed and the evidence is thin.
result.label: Mixed scattered tokens, hemicellulose pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ph' when it begins a word like phonotactics, phonetic or phonological, mostly in linguistics text about phonology. It stays quiet on ' ph' after "and" or at document start, and fires more weakly on pharmaceutical contexts.
result.label: ' ph' piece in phonology words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'oid' inside words like Solenoid, Toroid, steroid, ellipsoid, geoid. It is a word-final suffix token that follows a stem piece, and members mostly detect 'oid' itself.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in -oid words

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces in language/linguistics text, mainly ' ling' (as in lingua franca), also ' phr' (phrases), ' ev', ' ha'. Predicts a word continuation fragment such as 'ua' or 'ases'.
result.label: Linguistics word-start fragments (ling, phr)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'itt' in the middle of a word (w-itt-y, n-itt-y, H-itt-ite, W-itt-genstein, rem-itt-ances), where a suffix is expected next. Silent when 'itt' starts the text.
result.label: 'itt' inside split words

result.description: Fires on 'light' (and pieces like 's', ' and', ' radiation') right after 'sun'/'solar' in sunlight-related text; predicts sun/moon-related next words. Silent in other renewable-energy text without the sun prefix.
result.label: Sun+light compound completion

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' h' (a space-prefixed 'h' that starts a word split into pieces), mostly before 'ormone', 'ug', 'iring' or 'ygiene'. It predicts continuations like 'yg', 'orm', 'ind'. It was silent on one 'hormone' context.
result.label: Word-initial ' h' fragment

result.description: Fires on the final suffix piece of biology process nouns, mostly "resp-iration" and "photosyn-thesis", also "-ction", "-acy", "-ility" in life-science text. It completes a word naming a biological process.
result.label: Biological process word endings (respiration)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'com' (also ' Com') when it begins a longer word split into pieces, such as com-plement, com-pressible, dis-com-fort, De-com-position. It predicts continuations like 'pre', 'bin', 'fort', 'position'.
result.label: 'com' prefix word-piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al' completing "behavior" into "behavioral" (as in behavioral economics or interventions). It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as instrumentalism, reversal or organismal.
result.label: 'al' in "behavioral"

result.description: Fires on food and culinary words (' Food', ' Menu', 'inary', dish pieces), especially as a title or heading word at document start, with cooking and restaurant members supporting it. Silent on other list-style topic headings.
result.label: Food/menu culinary heading words

result.description: Fires on the token ' century' after an ordinal like "20th" or "1st" (e.g. "late 20th century"). Members detect century/Century and ordinal-period tokens. Logits favor continuations like ' years', ' saw'.
result.label: ' century' after ordinal

result.description: Fires on emphasis adverbs like " particularly", " especially", and sometimes " dominant" or "-ably", mostly after a comma or "is" in academic text, where a focusing qualifier introduces a specific subset. Silent on attributive "a particularly fruitful".
result.label: Focusing adverb 'particularly/especially'

result.description: Fires on the backslash that starts a LaTeX command inside math (e.g. \sin\alpha, \( \frac), mostly ' \' and '\'. Weaker, scattered firing on pieces of Cyrillic words and word fragments. Silent on plain-text logic notation.
result.label: LaTeX backslash in math

result.description: Fires on ' the' or ' these' right after a sentence-initial fragment "standing" (as in "understanding the/these ..."), predicting an abstract object noun like interactions or laws. Silent on ' the' in other positions.
result.label: determiner after "standing" fragment

result.description: Fires on the piece 'öd' inside the name Schrödinger (after "Schr"), as in Schrödinger equation. It predicts the continuation "inger". Weak activation on a few other word fragments.
result.label: 'öd' in Schrödinger

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: digits inside slash- or digit-separated number strings (e.g. '1' in 3/4/4/1), plus odd word pieces like 'ware', 'swift', 'my'. Peaks are inconsistent; the numeric-string case is the clearest. Silent on a '1' in a numbered heading.
result.label: Digits in number strings, mixed

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ate/ates/ated' completing "resonate", and on " deeply" right after "resonate", where a "with" phrase is expected. It stays silent on other -ate endings like "elevate" and "salivate".
result.label: resonate suffix and following 'deeply'

result.description: Fires on plural noun endings (-s, -es, ' Systems', ' devices') that end a technical topic phrase, typically a title-like "X in [Domain Plural]" (e.g. "in Wide Area Networks", "in Stellar Atmospheres"). Silent on verb -s, possessive 's, and other non-plural 's'.
result.label: Plural noun ending of technical phrase

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ations' completing "fluctuations" (quantum or primordial fluctuations, physics/cosmology text). Silent on 'ations' in other words like investigations, explanations, foundations.
result.label: 'ations' ending 'fluctuations'

result.description: Fires mostly on " popular" (becoming popular, popularity), and also on " ordinary" and occasionally other tokens like "SQL" or commas. Members are mostly detectors of "popular" and "ordinary".
result.label: "popular" / "ordinary" adjective detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Fin" (as in Financial, Finance, FinTech) at the start of a heading or title, where a continuation like "-ancial" is expected. Weaker on other incomplete word-initial pieces (Bi-oge, D-iffer, Cir).
result.label: Fin- word-start piece (Financial)

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after "serve(s)/act(s)" (e.g. "which serves as a backbone"), meaning "functions as". Stays silent on ' as' as a conjunction ("as they", "as necessary") or in "such as".
result.label: 'as' after serves/acts (role)

result.description: Fires on the word " printing" in historical or technical text about the printing press and industry (e.g. "the printing press", "printing industry"). It is silent in the one contrast example, where " printing" starts the text.
result.label: ' printing' in press/industry context

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Der' when it begins a longer word, mainly "Derivative(s)". It predicts continuation pieces like 'iv', 'ant', 'eg', 'ived'. It weakly fires on other word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' Der' word-start fragment (Derivatives)

result.description: Fires on the word " social" (also Social) as a modifier before a noun like stratification, order, context or networks, mostly in linguistics and sociolinguistics text. Members are mostly detectors of "social" and related words such as "political" and "societal".
result.label: ' social' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' adv' when it begins "advancement(s)/advances", predicting the continuation "ancement/anc". Members are mostly ' adv' and ' enh' detectors. It is silent on some ' adv' contexts, such as after "technological" or at text start.
result.label: ' adv' start of advancements

result.description: Fires on the word " vector" in linear-algebra text, mostly in the phrase "vector space(s)". It stays silent on some uses, such as "each vector in the row" and "vector representations". Members are mostly detectors of vector, scalar and linear tokens.
result.label: "vector" in vector spaces

result.description: Fires on ' environment' or ' atmosphere' right after "create/promotes an/a", as the object of creating a setting (e.g. "creates an environment that fosters"). It stays silent on "working environment" or "work environment" after a modifier noun.
result.label: Created environment/atmosphere after "an"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'om' in "boom"/"Boomers" (also "piezom-eters", "diastereom-ers"), plus 'c' in "cata-clysmic" and 'ion' in "explosion". Fires on the word piece inside a longer word, not on whole words.
result.label: Mid-word 'om' fragment (boom)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "rich" inside "enrich" (enriches, enriched, enrichment), after "en". It predicts suffixes like -ed, -es, -ment, -ing.
result.label: "rich" in "enrich" word piece

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' inter' when it is a prefix mid-word, mostly before "ference" (interference), also "play" and "personal". Silent on it at the start of a text. Predicts continuations like ference, play, connected.
result.label: ' inter' prefix mid-text

result.description: Fires on prepositions or words (on, in, to, the, with, of) right after verbs or nouns like "hinges", "lies", "tied", "requires understanding", in abstract expository prose. It is silent on "on" after data or depending. It predicts abstract nouns such as factors or strategies.
result.label: Dependency-verb prepositions in expository prose

result.description: Fires mostly on ' mit' in "to mit|igate" (verb-infinitive slot expecting a word continuation), with weaker hits on other word pieces (-ly, -ivity, 'be'). Silent on ' mit' in "mitigation" after a noun context.
result.label: ' mit' of "to mitigate"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' alk' when it starts chemistry words like alkene, alkyne, alkane or alkali, in organic or inorganic chemistry text. It stays silent on the capitalized, document-initial "Alkenes" in the contrast.
result.label: ' alk' chemistry word-start

result.description: Fires on the piece "re" / " Re", both as a prefix (un-re-liable, Virtual Re-ality, re-usable) and in contractions like you're/we're. It's silent on at least one "you're" example, so the condition is unclear. Predicts continuations like "levant", "present".
result.label: "re" word piece or prefix

result.description: Fires on " and" (or "or") directly after "costs" (reduced/higher costs and ...), in cost/efficiency business text. It stays quiet on "and" after other list items or verb phrases, and pushes toward time, duration, or schedule.
result.label: "and" right after "costs"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Ent"/" ent" (as in Entropy, Entanglement, entente, enthalpy) when it begins a word split into pieces. It is silent on other tokens in similar headings.
result.label: Ent- word-start piece
sustain-ability suffix in sustainability
result.description: Fires on the 'ability' piece completing "sustainability" (weaker on 'energy efficiency'), in eco-themed text about sustainable practices. It stays silent on 'ability' in other words such as accountability or durability.

Fires on the pronoun "it" (any case) as a clause subject, often after a conjunction or sentence start such as "because it", "When it comes", "While it". Members are mostly "it" detectors. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Subject pronoun "it"

result.description: Fires on abstract process nouns (selection, implementation, promotion, -ance) appearing as items in a comma- or semicolon-separated list of activities. Weakly predicts " of" next. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Process nouns in activity lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ip' in "dissipation" (also ' toler' in "tolerance"), where the word continues with a suffix like -ation/-ance. Mostly in physics and science text, and it predicts the suffix.
result.label: 'ip' in dissipation, word-piece

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments and hyphens inside multi-piece words or ranges, mainly 'nell' in Snell's, 'bit' in orbitals, and '-' in ranges like 18th-20th. Evidence is mixed, with a weak logit signal.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: nell, bit, hyphen

result.description: Fires on ' which' as a non-restrictive relative pronoun after a comma following a list or noun phrase, introducing a clause with a plural or explanatory verb. Silent on 'by which' and some other cases.
result.label: Relative ' which' after comma

result.description: Fires on ' integrated' (also 'unified', 'comprehensive', 'detailed') as an attributive adjective after "an"/"a" before a noun, like "an integrated approach". Silent on predicative "can be integrated with".
result.label: attributive 'integrated' adjective after article

result.description: Fires on word pieces right after "phot" (ov, och, od, ot, on, ography) inside words like photovoltaic, photochemistry, photodynamic, phototube. It needs the "phot" prefix context and pushes toward completions such as "olta" and "photo".
result.label: Piece after "phot" prefix

result.description: Fires on the last word of an international treaty or agreement name (Convention, treaty, Protocol, agreement) in diplomatic/UN contexts, predicting words like Convention, Conference, signed, nations.
result.label: International treaty/convention names

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' eth' at the start of words like ethics, ethical, ethnic, ethers, ethyl. It predicts continuations such as 'nic', 'yl', 'ical'. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' eth' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a compound noun like 'front'(ier), 'bed'(rock), 'fore'(front), 'corner'(stone), after 'the'/'a', when the word is unfinished and a suffix such as -ier or -rock is expected.
result.label: Compound-word start: front/bed/corner

result.description: Fires on " shown" in the passive perfect "has/have been shown (to)", mostly in research-claim text about music. Weaker on similar verbs like "demonstrated". Members detect shown/demonstrated/show-type verbs.
result.label: "been shown" research-claim verb

result.description: Fires on the word " feedback", especially in technology and control-system text such as "haptic feedback". Members are mostly feedback-token detectors plus interface and sensor topic latents. Weak activation on "inputs".
result.label: ' feedback' in tech contexts

result.description: Fires on the word " been" right after an auxiliary like had, has, have or would have, in the perfect-tense slot. It is silent on other tokens. Members are mostly detectors of " been" after auxiliaries.
result.label: ' been' after perfect auxiliary

result.description: Fires on the 'ed' piece inside the word "heredity" (her|ed|ity), predicting the 'ity' completion. It stays silent on 'ed' in words like "targeted" or "undoed", so it needs the 'her' prefix.
result.label: 'ed' inside "heredity"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ged' at the end of "emer-ged", where a movement, technology or field comes into being ("X emerged as..."). The contrast is the noun "emergence", where it stays silent.
result.label: 'ged' in "emerged"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ch" when it begins "chord" (music chords, circle chords), often after words like seventh, longest, least. Predicts continuations such as "ord", "ords". Mostly silent elsewhere.
result.label: " ch" starting "chord"

result.description: Fires on the adjectives " technical" and " practical" when they modify an upcoming abstract noun (aspects, skills, applications, issues). It predicts nouns like applications, sense, aspects, and -ity suffixes.
result.label: technical/practical adjective before noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ative' when it completes the word "narrative" (narr|ative), often before words like structure, prose or techniques. It stays silent on 'ative' in "creative" and "figurative".
result.label: 'ative' in "narrative"

result.description: Fires on verb suffix pieces -ate/-ated/-ates/-ating, mainly in "activate", "initiate", "accelerate" within biology or chemistry process text. Silent on "sophisticated", where the suffix is an adjective ending.
result.label: -ate verb suffix in activation processes

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' contrib', ' ens', ' distrib' that are incomplete and need a continuation such as 'utor', 'uring', 'uting'. It predicts those suffixes next.
result.label: Word stems before -utor/-uring

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ric' completing "Thermoelectric" in materials-science text. Members detect 'ric' pieces (ventric-, parametric, electric) plus energy and physics context. It is silent on other physics text without this word.
result.label: 'ric' in Thermoelectric

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'asing' in "purchasing", mostly in "purchasing power", and predicts ' power'. Members detect buy/purchase/-asing/-ying tokens in commerce contexts.
result.label: 'asing' in purchasing

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " purs" (pursue, pursuit), predicting a continuation like "ue", "uit" or "uits". It also fires weakly on "tack" in "tackle".
result.label: " purs" piece of pursue/pursuit

result.description: Fires on the '9' (occasionally '8') right after '1' in a four-digit year like 1910 or 1850, where the next digit is still to come. Silent when the 9 is a later digit, as in 1789 or 1870.
result.label: Second digit '9' of 19xx years

result.description: Fires on verbs of position or location (sit, sitting, lying, located, nestled, lies) that describe where something is. Predicts a following location word like ahead, nearby, beside, below. Members detect located/situated/lie/live.
result.label: Positional verbs: sit, lie, located

result.description: Fires on the token ' knowledge' (and the 'ledge' piece of 'Knowledge') in all contexts, including knowledge representation and epistemology text. Members are mostly detectors of the same word. It predicts continuations like base, about, management, sharing.
result.label: ' knowledge' token detector

result.description: Fires on negation words (never, neither, no, nothing, cannot) in a clause before a predicate, in abstract or technical prose. Members are detectors of "no", "never", "either" and "not".
result.label: Negation words: never, neither, no
'ics' ending "electronics"
result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ics' completing "electronics" (especially "power electronics"). It stays silent on 'ics' in analytics and mechanics. It pushes towards devices, industry and components.

Fires on varied tokens in a modifier slot after "The"/"the" or inside a century or number, such as "18th", "200", " long", " scientific", " early", before a noun. It is silent on many "1" tokens in years. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Pre-noun modifier and number tokens

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' decre' (decreasing/decreased), predicting the continuation 'asing'/'ased'. Members detect similar word-start fragments of incomplete words. Weak activation on 'alle-vi' (alleviating).
result.label: ' decre' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix 'ts' completing "experts" (weakly on "professionals", "analysts"), where the word refers to groups of people. Members detect 'exper' plus 'ts' and similar plural agent endings.
result.label: Plural 'experts' ending

result.description: Fires on "energy"/"Energy" when it completes a technical compound term, especially "Gibbs free energy" and other physical-chemistry phrases. It stays silent on sentence-initial "Energy" as a bare topic word. Minor weak firing on other word pieces.
result.label: Energy after "Gibbs free" terms

result.description: Fires on the word " half", mostly in "half-life" and "half the" in physics text. Its members are mostly detectors of " half". It predicts compound or measure words next, such as "-life", "way" and "percent".
result.label: ' half' token, as in half-life

result.description: Fires mainly on the word "jazz" (also "Jazz") as a music genre in descriptions of music styles and festivals. Also fires on a secondary piece 'kes'. Silent on "jazz age", a non-music use.
result.label: jazz music genre word

result.description: Fires on 'ical' at the end of "Critical" (and "Ethical") at the start of a title or heading, and on " for" after a sentence-initial "Respect". It stays silent on 'ical' in words like empirical or philosophical mid-sentence.
result.label: Critical/Respect-for at heading starts

result.description: Fires on verbs of investigation (study, explore, examine, analyzing, delves into) when a course or document summary describes what a section or work covers, e.g. "This study examines various...". Silent on plain value statements.
result.label: Study/explore/examine verbs in summaries

result.description: Fires on the 'oz' piece inside geological era names like Cenozoic, Paleozoic and Mesozoic (the "-zoic" split). It needs that word-internal position, with the preceding Cen-/Pale-/Mes- piece.
result.label: 'oz' in Cenozoic/Paleozoic/Mesozoic
' bl' word-start piece (blend)
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' bl' before it is completed, mostly where 'blend/blending' is expected (e.g. "ability to bl"). It also fires on bl- in blues, blind and blender. Silent on text without this piece.

Fires on the word " tools" itself, mostly as a plural noun for software or instruments, often sentence-initial or after "appropriate/specialized". Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of " tools" and of tool-like words (instruments, equipment).
result.label: ' tools' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' mirror' (noun or verb, including in compounds like 'shop mirrors' and 'mirror surfaces'). Upstream members detect 'mirror' and 'reflect' tokens. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' mirror' token detector

result.description: Fires on the leading digit '1' of a four-digit year, mainly a birth or death year in parentheses after a person's name (e.g. "Haydn (1788", "1848–1940"). It predicts '9' or another following digit. Silent on '1' in other number contexts.
result.label: Leading '1' of biographical years

result.description: Fires on the token 'h' when it is a mid-word piece after a prefix, as in "de|hydrogenase" or "Aest|hetic", where the word continues. It stays silent on 'h' at the start of a name.
result.label: 'h' inside split words (de-h-ydro)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'alt' inside longer words such as pen-alt-ies, roy-alt-ies, w-alt-z and asph-alt. It predicts suffixes like 'ies' and 'zing'.
result.label: 'alt' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' sust' (before -ainability/-ainable), typically after verbs or prepositions like promote, achieving, for. It predicts continuations such as 'ain' and 'ained'.
result.label: ' sust' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on "engine" in "engineer(s)/engineering" (Engine, engine, Engineering), and on "ym" in "Polymer" at document start. Predicts word-ending suffixes like -ers, -ered. Members are mostly engine-token detectors.
result.label: Engineer word-start piece (engine-)

result.description: Fires on the article ' a' (or ' an') right after verbs like "represents" or "marks" that introduce a significant change, shift or milestone. It predicts nouns such as transformation or division. Silent after "is", "are", "in" or "to".
result.label: 'a' after represents/marks (shift)

result.description: Fires on ' this' as a demonstrative determiner after a verb or preposition, in technical or explanatory text, where an abstract noun like process, type or effect comes next. Silent on sentence-initial ' this'.
result.label: ' this' before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on the verb " understand" (also "understands"), mostly after a subject like a team, member, or recipient in management or communication text, as in "ensure the receiver understands". Predicts the object or complement clause that follows.
result.label: verb 'understand' after subject

result.description: Fires on the token ' home'/' Home', most strongly when it is the start of a longer word split into pieces (homeomorphism, homeostasis, homeopathy, homogenetic). It also fires on ordinary 'home' nouns. Predicts continuations like 'ost' and 'omorph'.
result.label: ' home' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on " the" right after a sentence-opening temporal preposition (During, At, By, Towards) at the start of a document, in phrases like "At the end of" or "During the period". Silent on " the" after verbs like "marked" or "into".
result.label: "the" after opening temporal preposition

result.description: Fires mainly on the mid-word piece 'char' in saccharides (mono-/di-/polysaccharides), plus a few other word-internal fragments (ym, ary, mot, blank-et). Seems to predict a word-completing suffix. Mixed, weak evidence.
result.label: 'char' in saccharide words

result.description: Fires on ' that' (relative pronoun) right after the noun "ways" (e.g. "in ways that were once thought..."). It stays silent on ' that' after other nouns like "systems that" or "the fact that".
result.label: ' that' after "in ways"

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece " Be" (also " Ens", " Ac", " Me") when it begins a longer word or name, such as Firm Behavior, Becker, Beethoven, or Ensemble. It predicts the continuation piece, such as "havior".
result.label: Word-start " Be" fragment before continuation

result.description: Fires on the 'X' token in "UX" (user experience) after "U", in UI/UX design text. It weakly fires on similar interface acronyms like HCI and GUI. It pushes the next token toward "design".
result.label: X in UX (user experience)

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ion' completing "corros-ion" (also erosion), in materials-science text. It is weaker on lithium-ion and oxidation. It predicts continuations like resistance, rates, materials.
result.label: 'ion' ending corrosion/erosion

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "precision" or "precise" (of, and, measurement, a comma). It predicts measurement-related words such as measurement, calculation and timing. It stays silent on ' in' in other contexts.
result.label: Token after "precision"

result.description: Fires on the second word or word-piece of a "Language X" topic heading in a list of linguistics subfields (Pl-anning, Document-ation, Ass-essment, Education). Silent on similar tokens after other topics like "Power System" or "Incident Response".
result.label: Language-topic heading continuation

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a bare list of nouns (e.g. "treaties, wars, negotiations"), usually after the second or later item in an asyndetic list. It stays quiet on commas that introduce a clause or follow a single phrase.
result.label: Comma inside noun lists

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' le' when it begins a longer word split into pieces (leverage, leptons, leftover, leavening, leapfrog). It pushes toward continuations like 'verage', 'ap', 'aps'.
result.label: ' le' word-start piece (leverage)

result.description: Fires on the word " role" or " roles", most strongly in "plays a crucial/vital role" phrases. Members are mostly detectors of role/roles. The contrast text has no "role" token.
result.label: "role/roles" token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " solutions" (also "solution" and the piece "utions" in "Solutions"), mostly in mathematical or problem-solving text. Members are mostly detectors of solution(s) tokens. Weak activation on words like "methods" and "contributions".
result.label: ' solutions' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' top' and 'front' (in 'forefront') in positional/prominence phrases like 'at the top end', 'top-down', 'at the forefront of'. Weakly on 'peak'. Members detect 'top', 'fore', 'peak', and 'at the' level/point slots.
result.label: top / forefront position words

result.description: Fires on the word piece " tour" (also " Tour") at the start of tourism/tourist, in academic text about geography and economics. Members are mostly detectors of " tour" in tourism/tourist contexts.
result.label: "tour" in tourism/tourist
' the' after "founded on / born from"
result.description: Fires on ' the' following verbs or prepositions of origin or basis ("founded on the", "born from the", "builds upon the"). It predicts abstract nouns like idea, principles, notion. It stays quiet on ' the' after other verbs and prepositions.

Fires on the word " forces" (plural of force), mostly as a physics or mechanics noun like "forces and stresses" or "nuclear forces". Members are mainly detectors of "force/forces". Predicts continuations like "acting".
result.label: ' forces' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'back' when it completes a compound word, such as Feed|back or Flash|back. Members are mostly 'back' detectors inside those words. Weak activation on other word-internal pieces like 'corner' and 'ax'.
result.label: 'back' in Feedback/Flashback compounds

result.description: Fires on the curly apostrophe ’ when it comes after a word and is a possessive or contraction mark (nature’s, Alzheimer’s, 1940’s). It stays quiet when ’ closes a single quote or starts a word.
result.label: Curly apostrophe before s

result.description: Fires on the token " odd" (odd numbers, odds, odd patterns), in both the parity and "strange" senses, and occasionally on a few other tokens such as " Riemann". Many members are detectors of " odd" itself.
result.label: ' odd' token detector

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces (' Sc' in "Satisfaction Score/Scale", ' ac', ' dec', ' el', 'l' in "Lifetime") in business/metrics text, predicting a continuation piece of the word.
result.label: Word-initial fragment in business metrics

result.description: Fires on the word-ending piece 'ors' (also 'ness', 'ities') completing taste nouns like "flavors" or "sweetness" in food and cooking text. Members detect flavor/taste/cooking context and the 'ors' token.
result.label: Flavor/taste noun suffix in cooking

result.description: Fires on ' to' in the "from X to Y" construction, where X is a state, stage or period and the next word is the endpoint, e.g. "from one state of matter to another". It stays silent on ' to' after adjectives like "similar to" or "equivalent to".
result.label: 'to' in "from X to Y"

result.description: Fires on " from" right after "transition" or similar change/shift/move words (transition from X to Y). Silent on " from" after "resulting", "lasted", "varied", or "appearance", where it isn't a change-of-state source.
result.label: "from" after transition/shift

result.description: Fires on the word piece "re" inside "disag-re-ement" (disagreement), mid-word, in conflict/dispute text. Weaker on "gaps" in "bridge gaps". Predicts the word's continuation ("ements").
result.label: "re" in disagreement

result.description: Fires on passive-participle verbs, mostly " accompanied" (also "led", "driven", "reflected"), right where a "by" phrase is expected next, as in "was accompanied by". Members detect participles like followed, inspired, drawn, marked.
result.label: Passive participle before "by"

result.description: Fires on the preposition ' at' (location/time/state sense, e.g. "an island at the center", "applicable at low speed"). It stays silent on "look at", so it needs a non-"look at" use of the preposition.
result.label: preposition ' at' (not "look at")

result.description: Fires on the word right after "play(ed) a significant/important role in" (the, both, scientific, in), where the next word names the domain or area. Silent on "in the" in other constructions.
result.label: Slot after "role in"

result.description: Fires on ' by' introducing the agent after a passive verb of use or adoption (used by, adopted by, employed by), where a group of people or entities is expected next. Quieter on 'by' after other passives like powered/influenced and on 'by' + gerund.
result.label: Passive agent 'by' after used/adopted

result.description: Fires on commas and "and"/"or" that follow a quoted or mentioned word or affix in a list of quoted examples (e.g. 'un-', 'in-', and 'non-'), in grammar-discussion text. It predicts the next opening quote mark.
result.label: Separator between quoted list items

result.description: Fires on the passive/participial ' used' after an adverb or subject (often used, commonly used, originally used), as in describing how a term or tool is employed. Many members detect ' used' itself.
result.label: Passive ' used' after adverb

result.description: Fires on the word piece "plan" / "plans" (also "planning"), both as the noun (backup plans, insurance plans) and as the start of words like "planes" or "planarity". Silent on "plane" in geometry text.
result.label: plan / plans token detector

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after a verb like "navigate" (also balancing, embracing, maintaining), anticipating an abstract object such as "intricate landscape" or "complexities". Silent on ' the' after prepositions like "in" or "without".
result.label: ' the' after navigate-type verbs

result.description: Fires on consequence connectives like " thus", " therefore", " resulting", "thereby", " which means" that introduce a conclusion or result after a clause. Also weakly on some odd word pieces. The contrast shows it stays silent on some "thus" in parenthetical "and thus depend".
result.label: Consequence connectives (thus/therefore)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' val' (as in valve, valence, valued) when it is a split-off beginning of a longer word, with the model expecting a continuation like -ves or -ence. Strongest in heart valve text.
result.label: ' val' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "combination" (also union/intersection-like nouns), where the next word is the items being combined. Silent on ' of' after quantity or other nouns like "amounts of" or "safety of".
result.label: 'of' after combination

result.description: Fires on the word "speech" (and "disc-ourse") as a noun in linguistic or communication-studies text, such as speech acts, direct speech, and discourse analysis. Predicts compound continuations like patterns, structure, analysis.
result.label: speech / discourse noun

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ile' ending "missile" (e.g. "Cuban Missile Crisis", "ballistic missile") in Cold War or military text. It stays silent on 'ile' in "hostile". Members are military and Cold War context words such as arms, Soviet and German.
result.label: 'ile' in missile, Cold War

result.description: Fires on the 'ythm' piece in "rhythm" (after "rh"), in music and heart-rhythm contexts. It is silent when 'ythm' starts a document without the preceding "rh". Predicts suffixes like -ical, -ic, -mic.
result.label: rh-ythm word piece

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece ' Ar' (as in Arbitrage, Arctic, Arithmetic) when it begins a word that continues in the next token. Members detect ' Ar' and similar word-start fragments (Tri, Tre, IP, Old).
result.label: Word-initial ' Ar' fragment

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after causal verbs/phrases like "lead to", "resulted in", "enabled", "ensures", predicting a process noun (creation, formation, emergence). Silent on ' the' after locative "in the" or other prepositions.
result.label: ' the' after causal "lead to/result in"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' mar' at the start of a longer word (maritime, marvel, marbles, marinade), where a continuation piece is expected. It pushes toward 'itime' and similar suffixes.
result.label: ' mar' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the standalone token 'c' as a word piece or subscript (cres-c-endo, V_c, P_c, mole-c-ule, trans-c-end). It is silent on 'c' in some other words, such as recon-c-iliation, so the surrounding word matters.
result.label: 'c' piece inside words/subscripts

result.description: Fires on bare verbs (discuss, support, share, edit) inside comma-separated lists of activity verbs, e.g. "gather, share, exhibit, discuss, communicate". Silent when "discuss" is not a list item, such as "will discuss topics" or "discussions".
result.label: Verb in list of verbs

result.description: Fires on the piece 'rit' completing "Sanskrit", in text about languages, scripts and classical studies. Members detect Sans- and related word pieces (Hindu, Homer, Tamil, Latin) plus other 'rit' pieces.
result.label: 'rit' in Sanskrit

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ino' right after 'am' in "amino acid" and "amino groups". Members detect 'ino' and similar mid-word pieces in technical words (neutrino, Paleolithic, archaeologist).
result.label: 'ino' in "amino"

result.description: Fires on ' structure' or ' syntax' (also architecture) as the noun after a possessive like "its/their" or "the", in talk about language or form. Silent after compounds like "sentence structure" or "phrase structure".
result.label: structure/syntax after possessive

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece " combin" (combinatorics/combinatorial), where the next piece is predicted to complete the word. It also fires weakly on other incomplete word starts such as " simpl" and " handling". Members detect combinatorics word pieces.
result.label: combin- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word " further" (as adverb or adjective), most strongly after a semicolon or comma when it adds to a prior clause ("; further emphasis", "further increasing"). Weaker in "further research". Predicts "more" as in "furthermore".
result.label: ' further' token detector

result.description: Fires on plural action nouns like "policies", "decisions", "interventions", "actions" after "of"/"effects of" when the text is about assessing or evaluating their effects or efficacy. Silent on "policies" in political or regulatory descriptions.
result.label: Policies/interventions being evaluated

result.description: Fires on the token '2' when it begins a year or century like 2000s, 20th or 21st, especially after "the", "mid-" or "early". It stays silent when '2' is a middle digit of a year such as 1982 or 1827.
result.label: Leading '2' of 2000s/21st century

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' of', ' and', ' point', ' within', ' central', ' networks') in technical, math and statistics text, mostly mid-phrase. The same ' of' stays silent elsewhere, and the evidence for what it needs is weak.
result.label: Scattered tokens in technical math text

result.description: Fires on the piece 'le' in "inter-le-aving" (memory interleaving), after the prefix "inter". It stays silent on 'le' in other words such as Role, jungle, subtle and bottleneck. Members detect "inter" + piece and 'le' endings.
result.label: 'le' in interleaving

result.description: Fires on the word piece "vention" completing "intervention", mostly in "government/state intervention" in economics and policy text. Members are mostly detectors of the same "vention" token.
result.label: "vention" in "intervention"

result.description: Fires on the word " defense" (or " defence"), mostly as a modifier in "biological defense mechanisms/strategies". Silent on a network-security passage about firewalls that lacks the word. Members are mainly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' defense' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "cycle" (mostly in "lifecycle"/"life cycle", also Carnot cycle, water cycle), on the token ending a cycle compound. Predicts " cycle", " stages", " phases" as continuations.
result.label: cycle / lifecycle word

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a multi-piece name or acronym, such as 'CO' (CO2, COBE), 'Big' (Big O), and 'Fran' (Jean-François). It mostly needs the piece to be the start of a longer word or name.
result.label: Start of split names/acronyms (CO, Fran)

result.description: Fires on the word-initial prefix ' un' (unemployment, unreliability, uncontrolled, unseen), where a word continuation follows. Members are mostly ' un' detectors; it pushes toward stems like emp-, pre-, con-.
result.label: Prefix ' un' before word stem

result.description: Fires on the token " sampling", mainly in statistics text about sampling methods and distributions. Upstream members detect sampling/sample tokens. Logits favor distribution-like continuations only weakly.
result.label: ' sampling' token detector

result.description: Fires on 'hardware' and 'drivers'/'driver' in computing text about operating systems, devices and components, often as a modifier before a noun like components or conflicts. Predicts hardware-related continuations (bus, peri...).
result.label: Hardware / drivers in computing text

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' dis' as a standalone token, mostly when the next piece is likely "order(s)" (e.g. "genetic dis|orders"), and more weakly before "charge" or "sonance". Predicts "order/orders/ordered".
result.label: ' dis' prefix before 'order'

result.description: Fires on small cardinal number words (four, eight, two, three) that directly quantify a following plural noun, like "consists of eight major components". Silent when the number is part of a hyphenated adjective ("four-faced"). Predicts words like key, major, main.
result.label: Small number word before plural noun

result.description: Fires on the word "transfer" / "Transfer" (transfer learning, electron transfer, genetic transfer, negative transfer) across topics. Members are mostly detectors of "transfer" that predict suffixes like "ring" and "able".
result.label: ' transfer' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " multiple" (as a quantifier, e.g. "multiple linear regression", "multiple states"). Upstream members are mostly detectors of " multiple", " several", " many" and "Multi-". Silent on unrelated chemistry text.
result.label: " multiple" token detector
' typ' word-start piece (typography/typology)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' typ' when it begins a longer word such as typography, typographic or typology. Members are mostly ' typ' detectors, plus a few other word-start fragments. It predicts suffixes like 'ography' and 'ology'.

Fires on a linking verb (mostly ' is', also ' are', ' can', "'s") right after an abstract or generic plural/mass subject noun in expository essay text (e.g. "transparency is", "character names are"). Silent after pronouns, "It", or in other slots.
result.label: Copula after abstract subject noun

result.description: Fires on the piece 'm' completing the word "realm", mostly in "In the realm of ...". It is quiet on the plural "realms" in the contrast. The next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: 'm' ending "realm"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'istic' when it completes the word "linguistic" (lingu+istic) in language-science text. It stays silent on 'istic' in "sophisticated" and in "sociolinguistic".
result.label: 'istic' in "linguistic"

result.description: Fires on the token " sampling", mostly in statistical or probability-sampling text such as "sampling methods" and "probability sampling". Members are detectors of sampling/sample tokens plus statistics-context features.
result.label: ' sampling' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word or word piece right after "can be" (li- in "likened", both, over- in "overwhelming", en-, pot-), where an adjective or participle is expected. Silent on "may liken" without "can be".
result.label: Word start after "can be"

result.description: Fires on the word " own" after a possessive (your, their, its, our, very), as in "your own words". Predicts words like unique, way, thing. Many members are themselves " own" detectors in earlier layers.
result.label: possessive + "own"

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of a rare or multi-piece word (u|rethra, ins|idious, con|noisseur, cor|nea) right after "the" at the start of a noun phrase. Silent on similar pieces after other words such as "to", "of" or "a".
result.label: Word-start piece after "the"

result.description: Fires on the token ' process' when it is a noun following a determiner or modifier mid-sentence (e.g. "this process", "the recruitment process"). It stays silent when ' process' starts a sentence or follows "selection" in some contexts.
result.label: ' process' after determiner or modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece " treat" when it is the start of a longer word such as treatments, treaties or treatise, and pushes the next token towards "ments". It stays quiet on other words such as "therapies".
result.label: " treat" as word stem (treatments)

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-initial fragments such as ' prof', ' emp', ' pe', ' Fin' that begin a longer word (profound, proficient, empower, employs, peeling). It predicts the continuation pieces (ound, ower, oss).
result.label: Word-start fragments prof/emp/pe

result.description: Fires on the word "angular" / "Angular", mostly in physics text about angular momentum, velocity and displacement. Members are mostly detectors of "angular" and related physics words (scalar, thermal, gamma). The contrast text lacks the word itself.
result.label: "angular" in physics text

result.description: Fires on the token "level" in hyphenated compounds like "high-level", "low-level", "intermediate-level", mostly in technical text about languages, designs or wastes. Weak firing on "levels" and similar.
result.label: "-level" in high-level compounds
