result.description: Fires on function words in "both X and Y" / "either heads or tails" style constructions, where a pair of alternatives is being set up (e.g. "both the body part and", "resulting in either"). Evidence is weak and mixed; the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Both/either paired-alternative setup

result.description: Fires on ' understanding' (also analysis, grasp, explanation, knowledge) as a noun right after an adjective like thorough, deep, clear, nuanced. Silent when 'understanding' is a verb or follows 'for'/'mutual' or starts a clause.
result.label: Adjective-modified 'understanding' noun

result.description: Fires on the verb "follow" / "following" (and variants) when used as "obey or adhere to" (following steps, rules, practices), often after "by" or "to". Members are detectors of follow/following tokens.
result.label: follow / following (adhere to)

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: 'b' as a word-start piece (herb, hebdomad), ' flag', 'st', and function words like 'that', 'for', 'with'. Peaks are inconsistent. Logits favor word-continuation pieces. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered 'b' pieces and function words

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' care', ' knowledge', ' services', 'V', mid-word pieces like 'sur', 'dis') in abstract or technical prose. No single token dominates; peaks look like word-internal or noun slots. Evidence is mixed and the circuit's faithfulness is poor.
result.label: Scattered abstract-noun and word-piece peaks

result.description: Fires on data-like nouns (' data', ' image', ' text', ' values') when they are the object of a processing verb such as organizing, normalizing or transforming, in machine-learning and preprocessing text. It stays silent on ' data' as a subject or after "the" or adjectives.
result.label: Data noun as processing object

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'light' (sunlight, lighting) and a few other tokens like ' delay', ' electric', ' bass' in descriptive text on music, sound or light. Silent on 'light' in 'spotlight'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: 'light' piece in music/optics text

result.description: Fires on varied function words and verbs (commas, "becomes", "initially", "signals", "range") that come right after a subject in explanatory passages about stages or processes, such as language development. Silent on commas in statistics text. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Process-description connectives, language development

result.description: Fires on "transition" (and variants like "itions") and related change-of-state words such as "switch", mostly describing a shift from one state to another, often in physical or material science contexts. Predicts "from/between" style continuations.
result.label: transition / state-change word

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and adverbs (" the", " is", "essentially", "-ically", country names) in expository text, often after "of", "constitute", "regarded as", where a word like "same" or "essential" may follow. Silent on " the" after "of" in math contexts. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " infrastr" (start of "infrastructure"), mostly in lists of public spending or economic development topics. It is silent in one "development of infrastructure" context. Members are mostly infrastr detectors that predict "ucture".
result.label: ' infrastr' start of infrastructure

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces that need a continuation to form a compound or word, mainly ' back' (backbone, backups) and 'ru' in 'disruptions'. It predicts a suffix piece like 'bone' or 'drop'. Silent on 'back' in 'backpropagation'.
result.label: ' back' / 'dis-ru' word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the article ' a' right after a verb of offering or providing (offers a, provides a, offer a), where a noun like "unique opportunity" or "rich exploration" comes next. Silent on ' a' after prepositions or "serves as".
result.label: ' a' after offer/provide verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' counter' when it is the start of a word like counteract, especially after "to" or "can". Predicts continuations such as "act". Weaker on "countermeasure" and on the following "act".
result.label: ' counter' prefix before -act

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' cot' (as in cotton) when it comes mid-text, expecting a continuation like 'ton'. Silent when ' cot' is the first token of the document. Members detect similar incomplete word-start pieces (nit, foss, fab, fi).
result.label: ' cot' word-start piece (cotton)
Gen- word-start piece (genetic)
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Gen' / ' gen' (genetic, genes, genotype, genres), especially at the start of a line or heading. It predicts continuations like 'etic'. Weak activation on other word-initial fragments like 'engag' and 'mem'.

Fires on word pieces (-ater in theater, -ing in lighting, -ical in theatrical, -entation in presentation) completing theater/stage-production words in text about theatre, drama and storytelling. Silent on physics text.
result.label: Theatre/stage word suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Lor" in physics terms like Lorentz or Lorenz (force, transformation, attractor), predicting a continuation piece. Weak on other split technical word beginnings like "Param", "chem", "Ext".
result.label: ' Lor' in Lorentz/Lorenz

result.description: Fires on the space token between "ISO" and a standard number (ISO 9001), in text about standards and frameworks. It stays silent on spaces before other numbers, such as dates or "type 2".
result.label: Space after ISO before number

result.description: Fires on commas, "and", "or", "the" and repeated words inside lists or parallel items (e.g. "right speech, right action, right livelihood"; "inform or entertain"), where another list item or parallel term is expected next. Silent on commas in ordinary clauses.
result.label: List/coordination separator slot

result.description: Fires on the piece 'elf' when it follows 'w'/'W' to form "welfare" (social welfare, welfare economics). Silent on 'elf' in "oneself", so it needs the word-start 'w' + 'elf'.
result.label: 'elf' in "welfare"

result.description: Fires on function words (the, our, of, -ing, protect) right after verbs or nouns of protecting, preserving, or caring for something, such as "preserving the", "protecting the", "welfare of", where a beneficiary object is expected. Silent on "the" in other contexts.
result.label: Protect/preserve object-slot function words
'ag' mid-word piece
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ag' inside longer words, most strongly in ocean-zone terms like epipelagic, mesopelagic and abyssopelagic. It also fires more weakly in intaglio, pedagogy and Pythagorean. Members are 'ag' detectors.

Fires on the word "whether" (also "Whether" and the piece "ether" in wh-ether), especially when it opens an alternatives clause after a comma, as in ", whether physical or digital". Members detect whether, either and both.
result.label: "whether" alternatives clause

result.description: Fires on ' thanks' and ' due' when they begin a causal "thanks to" / "due to" phrase after a clause. It predicts "to" next. Members detect thanks, due, and similar "X to" words such as similar or liken.
result.label: causal "thanks to" / "due to"

result.description: Fires on ' to' in the causal preposition "due to" (also "because of", "owing to"), where a reason noun phrase like "their/its ability" follows. Silent on infinitive or verb-particle ' to'.
result.label: "due to" causal preposition

result.description: Fires on the verb (' is', ' are', ' be') closing the second clause of an "as ADJ as X is/are" comparison, e.g. "as light as they are strong", "as it is today". Silent on plain "it is" without the comparison.
result.label: Copula in as...as comparisons

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' and', digits in "1944", mid-word pieces like 'tt', 'etic') in texts about international economic institutions and treaties (IMF, Bretton Woods). Peaks are mixed and inconsistent; the logits favour word-prefix continuations.
result.label: International economics scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on the decade digit (8, 7, sometimes 6) in "19X0s" decade expressions after "late/early", such as "the late 1980s". It stays quiet on the same digit in specific years like 1982 or 1874.
result.label: Decade digit in "late 1980s"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ul' in the middle of multi-piece words such as hydra-ul-ic, cell-ul-ose, vocab-ul-ary and post-ul-ates. A few weaker peaks fall on other mid-word pieces such as 'ci' in speciation.
result.label: 'ul' mid-word piece (hydraulic, cellulose)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' eleg' (start of "elegance") after nouns like "grandeur and" or "subtle". Members detect word-start fragments that precede a suffix like "-ance". It is silent when ' eleg' starts the document.
result.label: ' eleg' in elegance

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' subt' at the start of "subtle/subtly", mainly after prepositions like "with", "through", "using". It is quieter on "subtleties" at the start of a text. The logits favor continuations like "le".
result.label: ' subt' in subtle

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' mult' (multi-) right after "a" or similar determiners, as in "a multidimensional/multifaceted". It is silent when ' mult' follows "and" in coordinated lists.
result.label: ' mult' prefix after "a"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'abol' in "metabolic" (met-abol-ic), mostly in biochemistry text such as glycolysis. It stays silent on 'abol' in "metabolism", so it needs the following "-ic" form.
result.label: 'abol' in "metabolic"

result.description: Fires on "lay"/"laid" (including "laying") in the idiom of laying a foundation or groundwork, typically after a subject like ancient civilizations or an early work. Members detect laid/lay/paved tokens that precede "the foundation/ground".
result.label: laid/lay the foundation

result.description: Fires mostly on the '|' in special markers like "<|output|>" or "<|heading|>" at the start of a document, and sometimes on other symbols such as '9' or repeated ",\". Members are mostly '|' detectors.
result.label: Pipe in <|heading|> markers

result.description: Fires on function words (were, to, the, state) in text about privateering and state-sanctioned pirates, just before words like "sanctioned" or "licensed". Silent on 'were' in other topics. Members are mostly generic attention latents.
result.label: Privateers state-sanctioned function words

result.description: Fires on the token ' Mother' in the phrase "Mother Nature", especially after a verb or preposition like "with", "from", "risk", "causing". Members mostly detect word-start fragments that expect a continuation.
result.label: Mother in "Mother Nature"

result.description: Fires on relative pronouns (' which', ' that') right after "a public key" in descriptions of key pairs in cryptography. Stays silent on ', which' after other cryptography nouns like encryption or hashes.
result.label: Relative 'which' after "public key"

result.description: Fires on the token " hub", mostly in the plural-forming "hubs of culture/skills" sense for cities or regions, as a centre of activity. Occasional weak firing on other words such as " land".
result.label: ' hub' as centre of activity

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: ' balance', ' Cy' in "Krebs Cycle", '/', and 's'. It is silent on ' balance' in many contexts, and the members are mostly generic. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed: balance, Cy (Krebs Cycle)

result.description: Fires on abstract organizational/planning nouns such as " strategy", " planning", " operations", " management", mostly after a modifier like "business" or "macroeconomic". Silent in unrelated scientific modeling text.
result.label: Strategy/planning nouns after modifier

result.description: Fires on ' the' right after verbs of recognizing or highlighting (recognized, realized, stressed, highlight), where an abstract noun like "importance" or "value" comes next. Silent on ' the' after prepositions like "During" or "in".
result.label: ' the' after recognize-type verbs

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a relative pronoun right after a plural or abstract noun, introducing a relative clause whose verb comes next (e.g. "steps that define"). Silent on some ' that' after nouns in other contexts, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Relative 'that' after noun
'and' after learning
result.description: Fires on ' and' joining two nouns or verbs when the first is "learning"/"learn" (e.g. "learning and memory", "learn and adapt"). It stays silent on ' and' after other words such as proficiency, classical or understand.

Fires on verbs of transformation or change (transformed, altered, changed, changing, redefined), mostly in historical or societal-impact text where something "changed the course of" things. Predicts an object like "the world" or "the landscape".
result.label: Transformed/altered change verbs

result.description: Fires on ' Nav' in "Navier-Stokes" and on ' equation' (especially after fluid-dynamics or math terms), in fluid dynamics/mathematical physics text. Members detect equation, flow, turbulence, and simulation tokens.
result.label: Navier-Stokes / equation tokens

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' py' when it begins a split word, mainly 'py' in 'pyramid(s)'. Members detect other word-start fragments (hier, hyper, cla, phot) that need a continuation.
result.label: ' py' fragment before 'ramid'

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on varied mid-phrase tokens (suffixes like 'ing'/'ous', 'and', 'or', 'that', commas) in abstract technical or academic prose, where the next word is a descriptive or technical term. No single token or clear condition.
result.label: Mid-phrase tokens in technical prose

result.description: Fires on the token " Natural" (capitalized, often at document start or heading, as in "Natural Language Processing"). Members detect "natural/Natural" across contexts. Contrast is silent because it lacks the token.
result.label: Natural token detector

result.description: Fires on ' a' (or ' an') right after a academic field name plus "is" or an appositive comma, where a definitional noun like "branch", "field" or "discipline" is expected. Silent on ' a' in other constructions like "there is a" or "on a".
result.label: "a" introducing field definition

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' of', ' an', ' for', 'unique', 'ust') inside technical or scientific explanatory text, mid-phrase before a technical noun. Peaks are inconsistent and the contrast shows no clear rule.
result.label: Scattered function words in technical prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ides' in "w|ides|pread" (widespread), after the "w" piece. It stays silent on 'ides' in "strides", so it needs that word-initial "w" context.
result.label: 'ides' in widespread

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word starts (' and', ' b', ' the', '),') inside lists of music styles, instruments or forms in Baroque/Renaissance music-history text. It predicts music terms such as 'asso' (basso). Members are music-topic detectors.
result.label: Music-history list continuation

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Sign' at the start of a word like Significance, Significant or Signal, often at document start or after a heading. It also fires weakly on some '1' list numbers and ' H'. Members detect sign/Sign pieces.
result.label: ' Sign' word-start (Signific-/Signal)

result.description: Fires on " of" after "heart" in "the heart of ..." (also center/core/essence-like nouns). Silent on " of" after growth, structure, realm or concept.
result.label: "of" after "heart"

result.description: Fires on an opening quotation mark that begins a quoted example word or phrase in a list of examples (e.g. "such as \"certainly,\"", "like \"buy now\""). Silent on quotes opening dialogue or speech.
result.label: Opening quote of quoted examples

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ed' in "branched" (branched polymers/structures), on "ing" in "branching", and on " Network" in "Neural Networks". Silent on 'ed' in other words like "altered" or "witnessed".
result.label: branch-ed/-ing and Network

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens in academic or expository text: the suffix 'ary' (especially after "evolution"), plus ' the', ' and', plural 's', and word pieces. Silent on 'ary' in other words like expansionary or revolutionary. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Mixed tokens, 'ary' in evolutionary

result.description: Fires on the word piece "and" inside a name or word, mainly "Bertr-and" (Bertrand competition) and also "merch-and-ise" and "P-and-ora". It stays silent on "and" as a conjunction.
result.label: "and" inside Bertrand / merchandise

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'orm' inside split words, mainly brainst-orm-ing/ation and h-orm-ones, also w-orm. Silent on whole-word contexts without this piece. Members are mostly 'orm' detectors plus other mid-word fragment detectors.
result.label: 'orm' mid-word piece (brainstorm, hormone)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'amin' (in "laminar", "Vitamin") and on ' Dec' in a repeated "Decolonization" heading. It stays silent when "amin" starts the text with no preceding piece, so it needs a word-start context.
result.label: 'amin' in laminar/vitamin, 'Dec' in Decolonization

result.description: Fires on the digit token '1' when it begins a multi-digit number (e.g. 10, 12, 1/4, years like 19xx) in measurements, fractions, and formulas. Members are mostly '1' detectors that predict following digits.
result.label: Digit '1' starting a number

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ir' as the start of a split word, mainly in "irony" and "irrigation". It predicts continuations like "rig", "rev" and "reducible".
result.label: ' ir' word-start piece (irony/irrigation)

result.description: Fires on chemistry structure words such as "carbon", "group" (functional group, -OH group), "formula" and word pieces like "carbonyl", mostly in organic chemistry text after a possessive/describing phrase. Silent on "carbon-carbon" in a figurative sentence.
result.label: Organic chemistry carbon/group words

result.description: Fires on " this" as a subject pronoun starting a new clause after a contrastive conjunction (but, although, however, yet, while). It stays quiet when " this" follows a preposition or verb, as in "in this context" or "use this".
result.label: clause-initial 'this' after contrast
IS inside CRISPR
result.description: Fires on the piece 'IS' in the acronym CRISPR (CR+IS+PR), right before 'PR'. Members detect 'IS' in acronyms and CRISPR-related gene-editing context. Weak activity on other words like Socratic.

Fires on " not" (also n't) after a modal or auxiliary such as may, might, does, are, in technical or math text. It anticipates continuations like "necessarily", "always" or "just". It stays quiet on some other "not" uses, such as "or not" and "and not".
result.label: Verb negation ' not' after auxiliary

result.description: Fires on 'domesticating/domesticated' word pieces and the following function word (' of', ' with', ' in') in text about domestication, early history and science. Silent on ' of' after other nouns. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: domesticating and following function words
Function words after "conflict" in essays
result.description: Fires on function words (the, from, of, about, involves, including) right after the word "conflict" in writing about stories and fiction. The same tokens stay silent in other creative-writing sentences that lack the conflict context.

result.label: ' hall' as start of hallmark
result.description: Fires on the piece ' hall' when it begins a longer word, mainly "hallmark" and also "hallucinatory" or "hallway". It predicts continuations like 'mark' and 'marks'. It is weaker on the standalone noun, as in "concert hall".

Fires on "order" (or "Order") in the hyphenated ordinal compounds "first-order" and "second-order", mostly in logic and differential-equation text. It stays silent on plain "first-order logic" descriptions that lack the word "order".
result.label: "order" in first-/second-order

result.description: Fires on the plural ending of "challenges" (also obstacles, difficulties) right after "face/encounter" for professionals or groups. It stays silent on "challenges" in other constructions, such as "new challenges have arisen" or "methods and challenges".
result.label: Challenges/obstacles after "face" verbs

result.description: Fires on the word " traffic" (road, air, data traffic), especially in traffic management/optimization text. It predicts continuations like light, lights, incident. Members are traffic, road and Tra-ffic detectors.
result.label: ' traffic' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb "perceive" (the 'ive' piece in "perce-ive") after "how we", and weakly on "experience" after "we". It stays silent on adjective endings like "distinctive" or "reflective". Context is abstract, philosophical or cognitive talk.
result.label: 'perceive' after "how we"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start a longer word, mainly ' We' before 'ibull'/'ight' (Weibull, Weight), and 'ator' in predator. Members detect We/we tokens whose continuation is a word piece (weaving, footwear).
result.label: We- word-start pieces (Weibull, predator)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " dr" that begins drill/drilling (also drought) after a preceding word in drilling or engineering text. It was silent on "horizontal drilling" in the contrast, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: ' dr' in drill/drilling

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'comp' inside "encompass(es/ed/ing)", after "en". Weaker on other uses. Silent on 'comp' in other words or contexts. Upstream members detect 'comp' and similar mid-word prefix pieces after a prefix.
result.label: 'comp' in encompass

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' nut' when it starts "nutrition/nutritional/nutrients", mostly after "the", "improved", "essential". It is quiet on some ' nut' tokens in similar food contexts (e.g. after "and" or "to"), so the extra condition is unclear.
result.label: ' nut' start of nutrition words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'icul' inside "meticulous(ly)", after "met", predicting a suffix like "ous/ously". Quiet on "icul" in other words, like "meticulously chosen" in some contexts or "iculators".
result.label: 'icul' in meticulous

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' opportun' (before "ities"), mostly after verbs like offer, provide, or create. It predicts the continuation "-ities" and similar suffixes.
result.label: ' opportun' word piece

result.description: Fires on the word " behavior" (or " behaviour"), most strongly in "the behavior of ..." in scientific or mathematical text. Weaker on "behaviors". Upstream members mostly detect the same token.
result.label: ' behavior' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'iling' in "bilingual" (b|iling|ual), predicting 'ual' next. It stays silent on 'iling' in "multilingual", so it needs the 'b' before it.
result.label: 'iling' in bilingual

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " convers" (start of conversation/conversational/conversely), typically after an adjective like everyday or formal. It pushes toward completions such as "ations".
result.label: ' convers' word piece

result.description: Fires on " witness" (as in "witnessed") when a period, era, decade or similar time span is the subject, as in "This era witnessed the...". It predicts the "-ed" suffix.
result.label: era/period "witnessed" verb

result.description: Fires on function words (of, with, into) and word pieces in science/engineering/materials text, where the next word is likely a technical or chemistry-related term. Silent on many 'of' tokens, and the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Science text function words before technical terms

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' bla' when it begins "blade" (e.g. "the bla|de", "razor-thin bla|de"). Silent on ' bla' at the very start of the text. Members are detectors of incomplete word-start pieces like bla, kn, fil, cal.
result.label: ' bla' piece of 'blade'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' anom' at the start of "anomalies"/"anomalous", mostly in data-science text about anomaly types. It predicts continuations like 'aly' and 'alous'. It was silent on one capitalised "anomalIES" example.
result.label: ' anom' word-piece in anomalies

result.description: Fires on the piece "itable" completing "equitable" (occasionally " equal" or " fair"), mostly in texts about fair distribution of resources, policy and justice. Predicts nouns like distribution or treatment.
result.label: "equitable" ending token

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-phrase tokens (word pieces, ' of', ' for', ' as', '.') in expository economics/social-science text, often just before a noun or modifier. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse mid-phrase tokens in expository text
istic in "sophisticated"
result.description: Fires on the piece "istic" in "soph|istic|ated/ation", especially after "more". It stays silent on "istic" in other words like "linguistic", so it needs the "soph" prefix context.

Fires on "ancient" (including the "cient" piece of "Ancient" at document start) when it describes old civilizations or cultures, such as Rome, Greece or Egypt. Members are mostly detectors of ancient/classical tokens. Predicts Greek/Rome-type nouns weakly.
result.label: Ancient (civilizations) word

result.description: Fires on the word " children" (also "Children", "child", "youth"), especially in education or young-people contexts. Upstream members detect "young", "child" and "children" tokens plus education words. Contrast evidence is thin.
result.label: children token detector

result.description: Fires on " process" when it begins a sentence or stands as the subject-like head after a full stop (e.g. ". Process begins with…"). Silent on " process" mid-sentence after "this", "business" or "step-by-step".
result.label: Sentence-initial " process"

result.description: Fires on the token ' subject' (including as the start of "subjectivity/subjective", "subject-object", "subject matter"). It is strongest when ' subject' is a word piece before an ending such as -ive or -ivity, and the predicted continuations match this.
result.label: ' subject' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' imp' at the start of "implication(s)" / "implicature", strongest after "logical" or "material" in logic and linguistics text. Weaker in "important implications". Silent when ' imp' starts the text or follows just "The".
result.label: imp- in "implication"

result.description: Fires on the verb ' move', most strongly in "as we move from/towards/beyond..." transitions in essay-like text. Members are mostly detectors of move/moving/go/transition. Weakly active on "We" and "wander".
result.label: "we move" transition verb

result.description: Fires on " The" that begins a title or proper name mid-sentence, such as band or publication names after "like" or "are", or a title after a colon. It stays quiet on sentence-initial "The" in ordinary prose.
result.label: "The" starting a title or name

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'enn' in "millennia/millennial" (and a few similar pieces like 'esian'), where more word pieces must follow. Members detect other mid-word fragments such as 'enn' in names, 'omial' and 'alle'.
result.label: 'enn' inside millennia/millennial

result.description: Fires on connectives like " and", " like", "," or " with" right after a tool or software noun in creative/technical software lists (e.g. "software like Corel Painter and Adobe"). Silent on many other " and" uses. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Connectives in software/tool example lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'atur' inside words like miniaturization, miniaturage and saturated, predicting a suffix such as -ization or -ation. Members detect 'atur', 'ature', and stems like mini, mod, Integr.
result.label: 'atur' piece in miniaturization

result.description: Fires on the verb suffix "-ing" (present-ing, document-ing, captur-ing, sharing, listing) in gerund lists about documenting, reporting and sharing information, where another gerund follows with "and". Silent on "-ing" in other contexts.
result.label: Gerund suffix in documenting/reporting lists

result.description: Fires mainly on the middle piece 'ril' in "quadrilaterals" (after "quad"), with a few weak firings on function words like "of", "is", "includes". Fires on the word piece, not on the topic in general.
result.label: 'ril' in quadrilaterals

result.description: Fires on ' value'/' values' and similar quantity nouns (size, measure, -ity) in math/logic contexts such as "truth values" or "equal in measure". It is silent on some ' value' tokens, e.g. "truth value assignment", so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Value/size nouns in math contexts

result.description: Fires on varied mid-phrase tokens (word endings like -ing, -acle, -al, and function words like "the", "a", "key") inside expository text, where a noun or abstract descriptor is expected next. Mixed evidence; the contrast shows silence on 'ing' in other words.
result.label: Mid-phrase tokens before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on the 'ass'/'a'/'A' piece right after a hyphen in "computer-assisted" / "computer-aided" (Computer-Aided Design), where the next piece is 'isted' or 'ided'. Weak on other word-initial fragments after hyphens or prefixes.
result.label: computer-assisted / computer-aided

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in technical/academic expository text (' fund', 'fin', 'ell', digits, ' capacity', ' mechanical'), often mid-word or mid-noun-phrase in science and engineering passages. No single token dominates; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered technical-text tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of abstract nouns or short phrases (e.g. "openness, collaboration, trust"), mostly in soft-skills/communication text. Silent on commas after a subject phrase or modifier that start a clause or follow an adjective.
result.label: Comma in lists of abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on function words and comparison words (different, between, of, among, estimated) in economics/finance text about income, costs, or taxes, where a quantity or category noun is expected next (levels, coverage, status). Silent on 'different' in general non-economic text.
result.label: Economics comparison words predicting quantity nouns

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments of a longer word, mainly ' Prag' in "Pragmatic/Pragmatism", also 'de' in "aldehydes" and 'rag' or 'br'. It is a mixed set of incomplete word pieces, and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Prag- word-piece fragments (pragmatic, aldehyde)

result.description: Fires on the token ' expert' (as in "expert systems", "expertise"), across contexts. Members are mostly ' expert' detectors that push toward the suffix "ise". Weak activity on other word-start pieces like 'mark' and 'imped'.
result.label: ' expert' token before -ise

result.description: Fires on the piece 'at' in the word "breathe" (bre|at|he), as in "breathe new life". It stays quiet on the ordinary word 'at' and is only weakly active on 'breathes' and 'breathing'.
result.label: 'at' inside "breathe"

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' and', ' to', commas, word-start pieces like ' philosoph', ' wind', ' tem') in texts about ancient civilizations, music and religion. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Ancient-history text, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on ' model'/' Model' when it is a noun stem that will be followed by the suffix "-ing" (e.g. "Mathematical Model|ing"). It stays silent when 'model' is used as a verb ("to model physical phenomena").
result.label: Model as stem of "modeling"

result.description: Fires on the first word piece after the hyphen in "self-" compounds (self-reliance, self-correction, self-reinforcing, self-efficacy, self-talk). Silent on 're' in contractions like "you're". Members detect "self-" and hyphens.
result.label: Word piece after "self-"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ict' (e.g. in pictorial, pictograms, traditions) and a few other mid-word fragments, often a token after a sentence-ending period where a word is split. Members are mostly 'ict' detectors.
result.label: 'ict' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces (e.g. 'ulsion' in repulsion, 'es' in taxes, 'tons' in protons, 'ive') in technical expository text. Peaks are scattered and inconsistent, and it is silent on 'ulsion' in 'vulvulsion'.
result.label: Word-ending pieces in technical text

result.description: Fires on the em dash used as a mid-sentence break after a noun or phrase, introducing an appositive, elaboration or aside. Earlier-layer members mostly detect the dash itself. Weaker on ' --' and en dashes.
result.label: Em dash mid-sentence break

result.description: Fires on 'cient' in "Ancient" at the start of a document (e.g. "Ancient Egypt"), and more weakly on ' ancient' or ' early' in phrases about ancient times. It is silent on 'cient' in other contexts. It pushes toward Greek/Greece-type continuations.
result.label: Ancient (cient) in civilization titles

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' emer' when it follows a noun or subject and starts a verb like "emerged" (something coming into being). It stays silent when ' emer' starts a document or follows "the" in "emergence".
result.label: ' emer' as verb start (emerged)

result.description: Fires on the 'op' piece inside the word "onomatopoeia" (and onomatopoeic), right after "onomat". It stays silent on 'op' in other words such as "Spusophora" or isotopes.
result.label: 'op' in onomatopoeia

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' tim' at the start of a split word, mostly in 'timeline(s)' or 'timely' in project-management text. It predicts continuations like 'eline', 'ely' and 'eless'. Weaker on 'timber' and 'timestamps'.
result.label: ' tim' word-start piece (timeline)

result.description: Fires on the newline/document-break token after a short title-like line (e.g. a list of subject or person names each ending in a period), where a new heading-like item follows. Silent on newlines after longer prose.
result.label: Newline after short title list items

result.description: Fires on the token ' direct' (direct sales, direct response, direct electron injection, and the start of 'directors' in 'board of directors'). Members are mostly detectors of ' direct'/'Direct' at earlier layers.
result.label: ' direct' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' recom' (as in recombination), mostly in genetics text, where the word is split into pieces and continues with 'bination'. Members are detectors of other word-start fragments.
result.label: ' recom' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' soil' when it begins a noun-compound after a comma in a list of factors (e.g. "coastal proximity, soil composition"). It stays silent on ' soil' after "of" or "the" as a plain object.
result.label: soil in factor lists

result.description: Fires on the split-off word piece ' w' right after "minimum", where the next piece would complete "wage(s)". It stays silent on ' w' after other words like "determine", "opposed", "enhanced" or "social".
result.label: ' w' after "minimum" (wage)

result.description: Fires on the word ' composition' as a noun, mostly in science contexts (chemical, mineral or material composition), and weakly on near-synonyms like ' content'. Members are mostly composition detectors.
result.label: ' composition' token detector

result.description: Fires on verb suffixes '-es'/'-ed' right after the stem "progress" (also evolve/shift-type verbs of gradual change), as in "technology progressed". Silent on 'es' in other words like thrives or challenges.
result.label: Suffix after 'progress' verb

result.description: Fires on the verb " aim" (aim to/at) after a plural or relative-pronoun subject such as "which", "that", or "policies", introducing a purpose clause. Members include detectors of aim, goal, seek and sought.
result.label: Verb "aim" introducing purpose

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces (cies, ptions, s, ing) completing plural nouns in technical lists, especially materials-science defect lists (vacancies, disruptions, substitutions). Peaks are mixed across suffixes; the circuit is diffuse and unreliable.
result.label: Plural suffix in technical defect lists

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " ped" (mostly before "agogy"/"agogical") and " bed" (bedrock, bedroom) in mid-sentence, when more word pieces are still to come. Silent when " ped" opens the document.
result.label: ped/bed word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' found' when it begins "foundation(s)/foundational/founding", especially after "the" or "a". It predicts suffixes like 'ational' and 'ations'. It stays silent when ' found' starts the text.
result.label: ' found' as start of foundation

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'qu' inside "earthquake" and on ' Tre' in "Binary Search Trees" or "Treaty". It is silent on 'qu' in "tranquil", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: 'qu' in earthquake, ' Tre' in Trees

result.description: Fires on the final word or piece of a short title-like topic heading in a list of line-separated headings (e.g. "Energy Storage", "Majolica Technique", "Stoneware"), at the end of the heading before the period.
result.label: End of list-heading topic phrase

result.description: Fires on the word-initial negating prefix ' un' (untamable, unemployment, unseen) as a separate token before the rest of the word. Silent on some cases like 'unmet' after 'meets' and a document-initial 'un'.
result.label: Negating prefix ' un'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'resol' at the start of "resolution", mainly in "high-resolution" / "low-resolution" / "super-resolution" image reconstruction text. Members are detectors of the 'resol' piece in earlier layers.
result.label: 'resol' piece in resolution

result.description: Fires mainly on " comes" in "when it comes to", and also on " Cir" at the start of a "Circles" heading. Weaker hits fall on mid-word pieces like "a" in Versailles. Mixed peaks, with a dominant "comes" family.
result.label: "when it comes to" comes

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after a noun of movement or spread (movement, transportation, dispersion, exchange of goods/people/information). It stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like incorporation, effects, balance or evolution.
result.label: 'of' after transport/spread nouns

result.description: Fires on the token ' intent' (also ' Intent'), mostly as the first piece of 'intentionality/intentional' in philosophy-of-mind text. Members are intent/intention/purpose detectors in earlier layers.
result.label: ' intent' word-start (intentionality)

result.description: Fires on the word " recent", most strongly in "in recent years", with weaker firing on similar time adjectives like "subsequent", "respective", "contemporary". Predicts time nouns such as years, times, history.
result.label: " recent" in "in recent years"

result.description: Fires on ' one' used as a pronoun after "the" (e.g. "the one with/that/in"), a relative-clause head. It stays silent on ' one' as a bare subject, or as a numeral before a noun ("in one place").
result.label: "the one" pronoun after determiner

result.description: Fires on connective function words (through, with, of, and, or, from, whether) following a noun like "visionaries" or "influence" in essays about leaders and influential people, where a continuation specifying how or what kind is expected. Weak and inconsistent.
result.label: Connectives after visionaries/leaders in essays

result.description: Fires on the word " competition" (and the "ition" piece of "Competition") in economics, law and biology text. Members are mostly detectors of competition tokens. The contrast text never contains the word.
result.label: ' competition' token detector

result.description: Fires on varied words in decision/choice contexts (making, treated, chosen, choices, effective) that follow a possessive or subject and precede an object noun or complement. Peaks are scattered and the circuit evidence is diffuse.
result.label: Decision/choice words before complement

result.description: Fires on the em dash '—' when it follows a noun phrase and introduces an elaboration, list, or appositive clause (e.g. "areas needing improvement—that's"). Members are mostly em-dash detectors in earlier layers.
result.label: Em dash introducing elaboration

result.description: Fires on the verb stem " maintain", mostly as a participle after "while" or "by/in" (e.g. "while maintaining"). It is silent on "create and maintain" as a plain coordinated verb. Predicts "ing" and similar continuations.
result.label: "while maintain(ing)" verb stem

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ac' when it follows "language" and begins "acquisition" (language ac|quisition). It stays silent on ' ac' in other contexts such as "acquire" or a bare "acquisition" after "of".
result.label: "ac" in "language acquisition"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('in', 'ced', 'ver', 'iv') inside longer words like pronominations, antecedents, vocabulary, in English-grammar text about pronouns and agreement. Likely predicts word-ending suffixes such as 'ent' or 'ant'.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in grammar terminology

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'est' in "livestock" (also 'ol', 'ell'), where a word is split into pieces and the 'est' piece comes after a prefix. Silent when 'est' starts the text. Members detect 'est' in Aesthetic, Underestimation.
result.label: mid-word 'est' piece (livestock)

result.description: Fires on function words (' the', ' one', ' with', ' of', ' another') in the middle of noun phrases, often after a name or in lists and coordinations (e.g. "Catherine the", "and the Gupta"). Silent on many ' the' tokens elsewhere. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Function words in coordinated noun phrases

result.description: Fires on the word piece " compreh" (start of comprehend/comprehension/comprehensive), strongest in "essential for comprehending". Members are mostly detectors of the same token. Predicts continuations like "ending".
result.label: ' compreh' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' and', ' to', ' or', ' possible', 'ating', commas) in expository science and academic text, often where a list or coordinated item continues. Peaks are inconsistent and it is silent on many ' and' tokens.
result.label: Scattered connectives in expository text

result.description: Fires on ' for' (sometimes ' of') right after a noun of striving or desire such as thirst, hunger, quest, pursuit, struggle or drive, where the object (knowledge, freedom) comes next. It stays silent on ordinary purpose or benefit 'for'.
result.label: 'for' after quest/desire nouns
' compos' in composite materials
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compos' in "composites", mostly after polymer, nanotube or carbon-fiber terms in materials-science text. It stays silent in one case where "composites" follows a verb ("enable composites"). Members are mostly ' compos' and similar-prefix detectors.

Fires on the piece 'rop' in "crop" (crop rotation, crop yields, crop failure) in agriculture text. It stays silent when 'rop' starts a document without the preceding 'c'. Upstream members detect 'rop' and farming words.
result.label: 'rop' in "crop"

result.description: Fires on the token ' sea' (also ' Sea'), strongest as the first piece of "seafood" and "SeaChoice", and more weakly in "sea level". Upstream members are sea/marine/ocean detectors. The word-start use in compounds seems to matter.
result.label: ' sea' as start of compounds

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces like 'od', 'ous', 'ate' and some function words, mostly in linguistics or technical expository text. The 'od' detectors in the members (Geodetic, Kodak, melodies) feed it, but the peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Scattered word-piece 'od'/'ous' in expository text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " chrom" (start of chromatography, chromatin, chromosome, chromatic), when it is an incomplete word that will continue with a suffix. Members detect chrom/rom pieces and nearby chromatography context.
result.label: ' chrom' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on ' gen' (of genetics) and ' inheritance' when directly after "Mendelian". It stays silent on ' gen' after other words like "field of", "developmental", "into", so it needs the preceding word "Mendelian".
result.label: Mendelian genetics/inheritance

result.description: Fires on 'World' in 'post-World War II' (after the prefix 'post-'), anticipating 'War'. Members detect 'World'/'Cold' before 'War' and post-/prefix pieces; silent on unrelated text.
result.label: post-World (War II)

result.description: Fires on ' is' (rarely ' are') in scientific text, mostly right after the relative pronoun "which" or after a comma-set-off noun phrase. It stays quiet on ' is' after "understanding X" gerund subjects.
result.label: ' is' after "which" in science text

result.description: Fires on ' with' after a concrete noun or past participle when it introduces a descriptive attribute or material (dresses with lace, made with tempera). Silent on ' with' in abstract or relational uses (fascination with, aligned with, compliance with).
result.label: ' with' introducing descriptive attributes

result.description: Fires on words in phrases about developing language or skill abilities (creative writing, communication skills, English, one's skills/ability), in educational self-improvement text. It is silent on some 'writing' tokens in other constructions, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Writing and communication skill phrases

result.description: Fires on the word " roots" (also "root", "ots") across senses: origins, word roots, math roots, plant roots. Members are mostly detectors of "roots"/"root" tokens. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' roots' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the degree sign '°' after a number in temperature or coordinate expressions (e.g. 2300°f, 80°F, 14°S). Occasional weak firing on ' River' and ' and'. Members are mostly '°' detectors plus number and separator detectors.
result.label: Degree sign after numbers

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Sem"/" sem" that begins words like Semantic(s), semiconductor, seminal. Strongest at the start of a document or heading on linguistics semantics; members are detectors of this token.
result.label: ' Sem' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing grammar-term words (pron-oun, ad-jective, conj-unction) in headings or lists of parts of speech in English grammar lessons. Silent on 'oun' in running prose about nouns.
result.label: Grammar term word-endings in headings

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a verb or preposition in mathematical or procedural explanations (replace the, where the, substituting the), where a specific previously mentioned item is expected. Silent on some ' the' in abstract or proof-style text.
result.label: ' the' after verb in math procedures

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after a noun in a compound like "problem-", "game-", "decision-", where a verbal/noun head such as "solving", "changer" or "making" comes next. Silent on hyphens after "graph", "data", "multi".
result.label: Hyphen in problem-solving style compounds

result.description: Fires on the digit '7' (occasionally '9') when it starts a number, such as at document start or a section number like "7.4", or in a leading digit slot. It stays silent on '7' in the middle of a year like 1750 or 1970s.
result.label: Digit 7 at number start

result.description: Fires on tokens within SMART-goal lists (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant), such as "urable", "ifiable", "levant" and "goals", in goal-setting and project-planning text. It stays silent on "measurable" in other goal contexts.
result.label: SMART goals criteria tokens

result.description: Fires on the adjective completing "stay/remain X" (relevant, competitive, focused, current) in business advice about staying competitive. Silent on "relevant" as a plain modifier after "and".
result.label: Predicate adjective after stay/remain
' Berlin' in Cold War context
result.description: Fires on the token ' Berlin', mainly in Cold War / post-WWII history (Berlin Blockade, Berlin Wall, divided Berlin). Members include Berlin detectors plus Soviet and Vienna detectors. Contrast text without the word stays silent.

Fires on a mid-word piece such as 'vent' or 'intent' inside longer words like unconventional, unintentional, interventions, where the word continues with an '-ional' or '-ions' suffix. Predicts the suffix 'ional'.
result.label: Mid-word 'vent' before -ional

result.description: Fires on ' variety' as the head noun in "a variety of" (also weakly "an array of"), after an article. Silent when 'variety' is a bare noun, as in "soft-hair variety" or "celebrate variety in".
result.label: "a variety of" quantifier noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' eng' when it begins "engagement", "engage" or "engaging", mostly in business or marketing text. It stays silent when 'eng' starts the document. Upstream members are ' eng' token detectors.
result.label: ' eng' start of engagement

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'c' piece inside "vis-c-ous/viscosity" (fluid viscosity), and on similar mid-word pieces like 'ist' or 'ity'. Silent on 'c' in other words such as "molecule", so it needs the word 'viscous/viscosity'.
result.label: 'c' inside "viscous/viscosity"

result.description: Fires on the word " abstract" (as adjective, in art and concept contexts such as abstract form, abstract concepts, abstract art). Members are mostly detectors of "abstract" and related words like theoretical and objective.
result.label: ' abstract' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'ash' piece in 'cash' (mostly 'cash flow') in finance and accounting text. Silent on 'ash' in 'splash'. Members detect c+ash and financial terms like flow, expenses, debt.
result.label: 'ash' in cash (finance)

result.description: Fires on ' of' (also ' for') right after "methods", "means", "techniques", where a gerund or process noun naturally follows (methods of shading, methods for determining). Silent on ' of' after "applications", "examples", "combinations".
result.label: 'of/for' after methods/techniques

result.description: Fires on varied tokens, mostly ' Plan' after Marshall and 'agan' in Reagan, in economic/policy text about government programs. Members mostly carry economy and policy themes. Evidence is mixed and only moderately consistent.
result.label: Economic-policy names (Marshall Plan, Reagan)

result.description: Fires on a comma closing a noun phrase in abstract, academic-style expository text (e.g. "a fundamental framework in mathematics,"), where a participle or elaborating clause usually follows. Silent on commas in other slots, such as after introductory phrases.
result.label: Comma after academic noun phrase

result.description: Fires mainly on the piece 'log' in the middle of a longer word (crystallography, phylogenetic, syllogism), where earlier word pieces like 'crystal' or 'phy' precede it. Occasionally fires on '2' in 'Level 2'.
result.label: 'log' inside multi-piece words

result.description: Fires on a full stop ending a sentence in academic or expository text about economics, geography and social topics. It is silent on many periods elsewhere, and the contrast does not show a clear difference.
result.label: Sentence-final period in academic economics text

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of a plural place-type noun (ecosystem-s, habit-ats, landsc-apes, areas) that is the object of "restore/restoring", right before "to their original/natural...". Silent on plural 's' elsewhere.
result.label: Plural ecosystem noun after restore

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " analyt" (as in analytical, analytics), especially after adjectives like "essential" or "powerful" in descriptions of analytical techniques. Predicts suffixes like "ical" and "ics". Members are mostly detectors of "analyt"/"Anal".
result.label: " analyt" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the final piece of a statistical or epidemiological term, mainly 'isk' in "Attributable Risk", also 'io' in "Odds Ratio" and 'ence'. Appears in statistics and epidemiology text, completing multi-token terms.
result.label: Statistics term endings (Risk, Ratio)

result.description: Fires on the 'bau' piece in 'Aufbau' and on assorted function words (in, the, new, through) in expository science or history passages. Peaks are mixed and the logits are unclear, so the evidence is thin.
result.label: Aufbau 'bau' plus scattered function words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " rib" when it begins "ribosomal"/"ribosome" words, mostly in molecular biology text. Members are mostly detectors of " rib" and similar word-start fragments. Weak firing on a few other words.
result.label: word-initial "rib" of ribosomal

result.description: Fires on the word piece " nut" when it begins "nutrition", "nutrients" or "nutritional", usually after words like valuable, essential or rich in. It is silent on the whole-word "nuts" sense and on other diet text.
result.label: ' nut' in nutrition/nutrient

result.description: Fires on the word " smallest" (rarely " tiny"), usually after "the", as in "the smallest unit/possible". Upstream members detect smallest/largest/lowest/small/tiny/single-type size and extreme adjectives.
result.label: " smallest" superlative detector

result.description: Fires on varied words inside "strategies include..." style lists about efficiency and management (reduce, energy, managing, implementing), in engineering/operations text. Silent on some "reduce" tokens, so the exact requirement is unclear.
result.label: Efficiency/management strategy verbs

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' recogn' (recognizes, recognizing, recognition), mostly in abstract academic text. It predicts suffixes like -ize/-ise. Members are detectors of ' recogn' and similar stems that take -ize/-ise endings (optim, distingu, acknowled).
result.label: ' recogn' stem before -ize suffix

result.description: Fires on the leading digit '2' of a four-digit year (2000s–2020s) in the middle of a sentence, typically after a prior decade or year mention. It is silent on '2' in other year contexts like "since 2010", "the 2000", or "21st".
result.label: Leading '2' of a year

result.description: Fires mostly on " historical" as a modifier in lists of causes shaping culture or cuisine (e.g. "shaped by historical traditions"). Occasional weaker hits on other tokens. Members are mostly history/historical detectors plus factor-type words.
result.label: "historical" as causal modifier

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' of', ' and', ' population', 'lacement') in academic or expository lists and topic headings. No consistent token or context; the contrast shows ' of' often silent. Evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Scattered function words in academic text

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (prepositions, word pieces like ' oppos', 'brace', ' Un') in expository academic or business text, mid-phrase before an abstract noun. Peaks are inconsistent; the logits favor abstract nouns such as elements, features and ideas. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered mid-phrase tokens before abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'am' inside "seamless/seamlessly" (also other 'am' pieces like "among", "contamination"), predicting a suffix like "lessly". Silent on other tokens.
result.label: 'am' in "seamless"

result.description: Fires on " but" after a "not limited to X" / "not just X" negated-scope clause, where "but also/rather" follows. It leans toward verbs like "encompasses/extends". Silent on other "not just... but" cases.
result.label: "but" in "not limited to X, but"

result.description: Fires on prepositions and verbs (of, into, in, to, shape, construct) that follow abstract academic nouns like "insights", "causes" or "trends", where a content noun phrase comes next. Silent on "of" right after a noun at document start. Members are mostly linguistics-topic detectors.
result.label: Academic abstract-noun connector words

result.description: Fires on " beyond" right after "extends/extended/expand" verbs, where influence or impact reaches past a domain ("extends beyond the realm of..."). It is quiet on "beyond" after other words like "investigating" or a noun.
result.label: "extends beyond" construction

result.description: Fires on the word "migration" (and pieces like "migr-", "igration") in demographic or population-movement text. Members are mostly detectors of the same token. Weakly on related words such as urbanization and assimilation.
result.label: migration word detector

result.description: Fires on ' each' after a preposition, strongest in "interact/communicate with each other", and weaker in "of each person". It is silent on clause-initial "each" after a colon. Predicts ' other'.
result.label: ' each' after preposition (each other)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'mc' in E=mc², 'ord' in words like Chord/primordial, and ' Past' in 'Past Perfect'. Peaks are mixed word pieces with no shared meaning; the circuit evidence is weak and scattered.
result.label: Mixed word pieces: mc, ord, Past

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' scal' at the start of words like scalability and scalable, mostly in networking and computing text. It also fires more weakly on scaling, scalene and scallop.
result.label: ' scal' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'etic' completing "genetic" (after "gen"/"Gen"), mostly in biology or genetics text. It stays silent in "epigenetic" and in "population genetic" in the contrast, and when 'etic' starts the text.
result.label: 'etic' in "genetic"

result.description: Fires on the 'r' piece in "nut|r|ition" / "nut|r|itional" when mid-sentence (e.g. "enhance the nutrition of"). It stays silent on the same word at document start and on 'r' in carbohydrates.
result.label: 'r' inside nutrition

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens, mostly hyphens (CRISPR-Cas9), commas, 'in' and ' defect', often in biology or science text. It is silent on many hyphens in compounds like child-rearing or fast-paced. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is only partly faithful.
result.label: Scattered hyphen and science-term firing

result.description: Fires on ' as' right after a topic noun (e.g. "Language as tool", "Truth as actionable") in title-like or framing phrases meaning "X viewed as Y". It stays silent on 'such as', 'known as', and 'serves as'.
result.label: ' as' framing a noun as something

result.description: Fires on " integral" in the sense "essential", mostly in "an integral part of", and predicts "part/component" next. Members are mostly detectors of "integral" and near-synonyms such as essential and intrinsic.
result.label: "integral" as in "integral part"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "ient" completing "ingredient" (e.g. "key ingred-ient", "secret ingred-ient"). Members are mostly detectors of "ient" and "ients". It is weakly active on similar phrases such as "secret weapon".
result.label: "ient" in "ingredient"

result.description: Fires on ' techniques' (also ' methods', ' procedures') when it follows a modifying noun naming a practice or domain, like "irrigation techniques" or "canning techniques". Mostly in historical or practical process text.
result.label: Technique/method nouns after domain modifier

result.description: Fires on the token ' cut' (also cuts, cutting) across both knife/food-cutting and reducing-costs uses. Members are mostly detectors of 'cut' and its word pieces. Predicts continuations like 'down', 'costs', 'outs'.
result.label: ' cut' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' the' after verbs like "refers to", "encompasses", "define X as" in definitional sentences about technical or academic concepts (topology, structure). Silent on ' the' after plain prepositions like "to the" or "as the" in other text.
result.label: ' the' in definitional statements

result.description: Fires on the digit '8' as the third digit of a 20th-century year, mainly in "198x" or "1980s" after "19". It stays silent on '8' in other positions, such as "1867" or "1928".
result.label: Decade digit 8 in 198x years
' of' after "set" (collection nouns)

Fires mostly on a leading ' -' at the very start of a document (list-like idiom entries such as "- Break the ice"), and on word pieces like 'mos' in "Atmospheric". Silent on ' -' after earlier text. Mixed, low-faithfulness circuit.

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ation' completing the word "Communication", mostly in heading-like lists of communication types or channels. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words (orchestration, elaboration, punctuation) and in "Group Communication Theory".

result.description: Fires on prepositions and weaving or metaphor words (' through', ' upon', ' by', ' threads') in abstract, figurative academic prose. It often sits where "which/whom" may follow, as in "through which" or "upon which". The peaks are mixed and fairly inconsistent.
result.label: Figurative 'through/upon which' prepositions

result.description: Fires on ' the' (also ' their', 'aping' in "shaping") after verbs/prepositions like "shaping", "crucial to", "imprint on", where an abstract object follows (economy, legacy, policies) in essays about influence. Silent on many other 'the' tokens.

result.description: Fires on the word " historical" (or "Historical"), mostly as an adjective after "the" before nouns like development, perspective, context. Members are detectors of historical/history/past words. Predicts nouns like Development, background.

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' when it completes "ethical", mostly when followed by nouns like standards, issues, or considerations. Silent on 'ical' in other words, and on some "ethical" uses, such as predicate use.

result.description: Fires on scattered function or generic words (' you', ' way', ' one', ' this', ' By') in mid-phrase positions, where the next word is a noun-like completion (logits favour part/letter/body/sheet). The same ' you' stays silent in other contexts. Evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on importance adjectives (crucial, essential, pivotal) in the predicate after "Understanding X is ...", right before "for/to/in". It stays quiet when "crucial" is used attributively (crucial tool, crucial roles, crucial insights).
result.label: Predicate "is crucial/essential" after understanding

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start a longer word, mainly " adjust" (before -ment) and " rou" (before -ters), plus a few odd tokens. Members are detectors of "adjust" and similar word-start pieces.

result.description: Fires on the noun "impact" (also "impress-ions", "imprint") when it is a noun after adjectives like lasting, emotional or enduring. It stays silent on "impact" used as a verb ("will impact their work").
result.label: Noun 'impact'/'impressions' after lasting

result.description: Fires on the word piece " gen" at the start of a word such as genetics, genres or genes. It is strongest mid-phrase after a modifier (music gen-res, Population gen-etics). It stays quiet in some contexts, such as after "comparing" or "large".
result.label: ' gen' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the end of change-noun plurals like "advancements", "changes", "challenges" in the opening phrase of a document ("Despite the challenges...", "With the pace of technological advancements..."). Silent on the same token later in the text or when it opens the sentence.

result.description: Fires on the token ' down' in all its uses, including 'comes down', 'up and down' and 'passed down', and weakly on ' up'. Members are mostly ' down'/' up' detectors. The logits are not clearly interpretable.
result.label: ' down' token detector

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in science/academic list-like text: " Environment" at document start, "lication" in DNA replication, commas in lists. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Mixed academic-topic tokens, diffuse

result.description: Fires on the word piece " real" (as in real-time, real-world, real estate, realm) at the token itself. Members are mostly detectors of " real". It stays silent on "reality" in a different word.
result.label: ' real' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word "Audio"/"audio", most strongly as a capitalized heading starting a line at document start or in a list of technique headings (e.g. "Audio Signal Processing"). Weaker on audio in running text.

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' and', ' of', ' in', ' during') and word pieces like ' Nak' inside lists or technical prose. Peaks are mixed, and ' and' is often silent in the contrast. The circuit is diffuse and its condition is unclear.

result.description: Fires on ' of' after a noun used in a metaphorical "the X of Y" role description (e.g. "the social butterflies of", "the heroes of", "the Sherlock Holmes of"). Stays silent on ' of' after quantity or abstract nouns like "myriad of" or "sense of".

result.description: Fires on scattered word-start fragments (' So' of "Soil" in topic lists, ' dimin', ' relev', 'form') where a longer word continues. Peaks are mixed, with no single token or topic dominating, and the evidence is weak.

result.description: Fires on commas, "and", and nouns inside lists or coordinated pairs in expository text (pests and diseases, happiness, anger, surprise, flavor, texture, content). Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. The contrast gives no clear condition.

result.description: Fires on ' English' (rarely French/Spanish) when it follows a preposition or article as the language name, e.g. "in English", "the English language", "Old English". Quiet when English starts a sentence or acts as a bare modifier.
result.label: ' English' after preposition/article

result.description: Fires on the word "integrated" (also "Integr-ated"), most strongly as a modifier before "circuit" in technology text. Members are detectors of integrated/integration/embedded. Weak on related words like "generation" and "interwoven".

result.description: Fires on connecting words (" in", "of", "ing", "with") right after a cooking-technique verb phrase such as "involves cooking food quickly in a small amount of...", where the next words describe the method's conditions. Silent on " in" in other food or general contexts.
result.label: Cooking method description connectors

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-start piece " nu" (as in "nuanced"), where the next piece is likely "anced"/"ance". It also fires weakly on scattered tokens such as " TCP" and commas. Silent on " nu" in "differing nuances".

result.description: Fires on the word piece " tack" at the start of "tackle" (to tackle problems/challenges), as a verb-stem fragment before "-le". Members detect other word-start fragments that continue into verb suffixes like -le/-ling.
result.label: "tack" in "tackle"

result.description: Fires on varied function words (" Now", " and", " to", " we", " or") at clause or list junctions in expository text, often where a new item or verb phrase is about to start. Peaks are inconsistent; the evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ver' inside words such as Adverbs, nonverbal, beverages and sovereign, where it is a non-final fragment. Weaker on Tversky and Lever. Silent in 'whichever'.
result.label: 'ver' word fragment (Ad-ver-bs)

result.description: Fires on ' being' right after a negating or contrasting preposition/connective, most strongly "without being", also "rather than being" and "not being". Silent on "being" after "from", "of" or "is".
result.label: "being" after without/rather than

result.description: Fires on scattered function or connecting words (' and', ' many', ' particularly', ' to') in expository text, where a content word or continuation is expected next. No dominant token, and it stays silent on many ' and' uses. Evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on the 'et' piece in "multifac|et|ed" (multifaceted), after the "multifac" fragment. It stays quiet on 'et' in other words such as "monetary". It weakly fires on similar 'et' pieces, such as in "spacetime".

result.description: Fires on comparative/superlative degree words (' more', ' most', ' less') right after a linking verb like "is/are/be", where an adjective or participle is expected next. Silent when 'more' directly modifies a noun or follows "even/of".

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'st' piece inside "crystallize/crystallization", where a word is split mid-way. It stays silent on 'st' in "workstations" and ordinal "21st". Other weak peaks are mid-word fragments.

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' may', commas, ' to', ' s') in finance and economics text about futures, hedging, interest rates and price changes. Peak token varies; the shared theme is financial/economic context, and it is silent on ' may' in other topics.

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ely" in "fin|ely", as in "finely-tuned" or "finely crafted". Weaker on "z" in "hazards". Members detect "fine"/"fin" and adverb suffixes, and it predicts "tun"-like continuations.

result.description: Fires on varied function words and suffixes (' of', ' offers', ' for', 'ized', ' behind') in blockchain/digital-technology text, mostly in early positions of documents. Silent on 'ized' in non-tech contexts like 'standardized' or 'specialized'.

result.description: Fires on abstract virtue or emotion nouns (pride, trust, confidence, gratitude, safety) and suffix pieces like -ness or -itude, when they sit inside comma-separated lists of positive qualities or values.

result.description: Fires on the word piece " By" when it begins "Byzantine" after a preceding word like "the" (mid-text). It stays silent when "Byzantine" opens the document or text. It predicts continuations like "z".

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word pieces, commas, ' in') in abstract academic text on economics, strategy and optimization, mid-phrase. Peaks are scattered and the contrast shows the same comma silent, so the condition is unclear.

result.description: Fires on the word " computer" (or "Computer"), mostly when it is a modifier before a hyphenated or noun continuation like "computer-aided" or "computer simulation". It stays silent on "computer vision" and "computer science".

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' coh' at the start of words like coherence, cohesive, cohesion and cohomology, in both linguistics and math contexts. Members are mostly ' coh' token detectors; it predicts a continuation such as 'er' or 'es'.

result.description: Fires on past-tense contribution verbs (introduced, contributed, played, -ered, created) right after a named historical figure as subject, in text about intellectual or artistic history. Silent on passive "pioneered by".

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' the', ' of', ' a', 'ound') in abstract academic text about arts, culture and society, in mid-phrase positions. It stays silent on ' the' before period names such as Renaissance. Evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires mainly on the mid-word piece 'ne' in "jour|ne|ys" (also "an|ne|aling"), where the word is unfinished and a suffix such as 'ys' comes next. Weaker on scattered tokens like ' Bang' and ' formed'.

result.description: Fires on wh-words (' what', ' where', ' who') that open an embedded clause right after verbs like know, determine, understand, identify. Silent on 'what' in comparisons ("from what") or sentence-initial questions.

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ab' inside "vocabulary" (split as voc-ab-ulary), expecting 'ulary' to follow. Weakly on similar mid-word pieces like syll-ab-aries. Members detect 'ab'/'ul' pieces in this word.

result.description: Fires on 'reflect' and its continuations (reflect, reflecting, reflects, depict) in text about culture or art reflecting values or beliefs. Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like drawing or challenging.

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' dr' (drilling, drought, drill) when it is a split word beginning, mostly in drilling engineering text. Members are mostly ' dr' detectors. Logits are mixed, with no clear next-token push.

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' di' when it begins a longer word (diphthongs, diets, diabetes, diary, diode). It's a mid-word fragment, and the next piece completes the word.
result.label: ' di' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on " rather" after a noun or clause where "rather than" is expected (contrasting one thing with another). It stays silent on "but rather", where "than" is not the next word.
result.label: "rather" in "rather than"

result.description: Fires on "improved" and "enhanced" (en|hanced) used as modifiers in lists of benefits or outcomes, e.g. "improved production efficiency, enhanced security". Members detect related comparatives like better, increased, improve.
result.label: improved/enhanced in benefit lists

result.description: Fires on the word " everything", especially as the subject of a clause after "that", "if" or "where" (e.g. "asserting that everything is..."). Members include detectors for everyone, anywhere, something, anything and nothing, and they push towards " else".
result.label: "everything" as clause subject

result.description: Fires on varied word-start or abbreviation pieces, mostly ' Electron' in headings (e.g. "Role of Electron-"), 'GB' in "UGB", and some commas. Looks like a mixed, polysemantic latent. Members are mostly generic context.
result.label: Electron / GB mixed pieces

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (commas, " of", " and", "including", partial word pieces) in abstract expository prose about regulation, economics or technique. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered connectives in expository prose

result.description: Fires on ' that' (also 'asserts', 'for') right after a verb or noun of claiming, such as emphasizes, posits, proposes, or the belief, in philosophy or theory text. It introduces a clause stating a doctrine's thesis. It stays silent on relative-clause 'that'.
result.label: Complement 'that' after doctrine-claiming verbs

result.description: Fires on the word " rather" (also "Rather" at document start) when it introduces a contrast, as in "rather than" or "; rather, ...". Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of " rather".
result.label: ' rather' contrast marker

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ism' ending philosophical doctrine names (Fallibilism, Foundationalism, Dualism, Rationalism), especially in lists of philosophy topics. Silent on 'ism' in 'Mechanism' (a chemistry context).
result.label: 'ism' in philosophy doctrine names

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'anc' inside "advancements" (also 'prov' in "Improvement"), predicting the suffix "ements". It needs the word to be split mid-word, and stays quiet on whole-word "innovations".
result.label: 'anc' in advancements

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments such as ' Hard' (Hardware), ' Har' (Harbor, Harland) and ' tren' (trench), where the word is still incomplete. Members mostly detect ' hard' and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: Hard-/Har-/tren- word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on ' has' (sometimes ' have') right after a short abstract subject noun, such as an art technique or field (stippling, glazing, etching), opening a present-perfect claim like "has become/been". Silent when ' has' follows a longer phrase or starts the text.
result.label: ' has' after topic noun subject

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' political', ' communication', ' and', ' of', ' language') in academic text on geography, language and communication, mid-phrase after a noun like "aspects of" or "impact of". Silent on some ' political' contexts; the condition is unclear.
result.label: Academic geography/communication mid-phrase tokens

result.description: Fires on prepositions (mostly "from", also "above", "for", "to") when they are quoted or listed as example words in grammar text about English prepositions. Silent on ordinary uses of "from".
result.label: Quoted prepositions in grammar lists

result.description: Fires on function words (' a', ' the', ' in', ' to') right after "results in / formation of / leads to" in chemistry text, where a noun for a reaction outcome is expected. Silent on 'of a' describing properties or definitions.
result.label: Chemistry result-phrase function words

result.description: Fires on the token ' Le' when it starts the word "Leadership" after a leadership-style adjective in a list of styles (Inclusive, Servant, Transactional, Laissez-faire). Silent on the full word "leadership" in running prose.
result.label: ' Le' in "[Style] Leadership" headings

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' dup' (and occasionally ' decl') when it begins a longer word like "duplication"/"duplicated", mostly in biology/genetics text. Members are detectors of other incomplete word-start fragments (rep, comp, frag, susp).
result.label: ' dup' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the piece 'al' completing "focal" (as in focal point/length), and weakly on ' quad' in quadrilaterals. It stays silent on 'al' in other words such as ideal, bilateral, ophthalmic.
result.label: 'al' in "focal"

result.description: Fires on function words or list items (" the", " and", commas, "other", "those") inside lists of issues or categories after "such as" or "like", in business or technical expository text. Peaks are scattered and silent on many " the" tokens, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Issue-list connectors in expository text

result.description: Fires mostly on ' ATP' in biochemistry text (ATP synthase, production, generation of ATP), and less often on ' Data' and list-item tokens. The peak token is mainly ' ATP', with a weaker secondary set of tokens.
result.label: ATP in biochemistry text
