result.description: Fires mainly on the word ' intellect' (also 'iz' in Leibniz, 'und', 'ly') in Enlightenment/humanism-style text, where the next piece is likely a suffix such as 'uals' or 'ually'. Silent on the philosophy-of-mind contrast text.
result.label: ' intellect' in Enlightenment text

result.description: Fires mainly on the suffix 'ist' completing "minimalist" (also ' column', ' multip', 'mos' in weaker cases). Silent on 'ist' after other stems like Marx-, Real-, Faulv-. Predicts art-movement continuations.
result.label: 'ist' in minimalist

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a mathematician's name split into word pieces, mostly ' Hil' in "Hilbert space", also ' Lie' and 'uther'. It predicts the continuation piece (e.g. 'bert'). Silent when "Hilbert" starts the document.
result.label: Hil- of Hilbert (math name start)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and verbs (to, of, as, the, considering, convey) in abstract expository prose, mostly where a content word or noun phrase is expected next. Peaks are inconsistent and the same tokens stay silent elsewhere, so the trigger is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository prose

result.description: Fires on varied word-ending or function pieces (-ness, -ing, -ier, ' of', passing, coming) in abstract expository text, often where a noun like changes, variations or connections could follow. Silent on ' of' after nouns like set, aspect, representations.
result.label: Suffix and 'of' before change-nouns

result.description: Fires on the token " trade" (also "Trade"), mostly in compounds like fair trade, free trade, trade-off, trade routes, trade policy. Members are mostly detectors of "trade" itself.
result.label: " trade" token detector

result.description: Fires on the adjective " fundamental" before a noun like aspect, component, principle or concept, as in "a fundamental aspect of". Members are mostly detectors of the same token, plus similar adjectives (essential, pivotal, radical).
result.label: ' fundamental' adjective detector

result.description: Fires on the end of an adjective (-ical, -atic, -ential, -ious, 'complex', 'significant') in the slot after "take(s)/play a (more/increasingly) ADJ", just before "approach/role/steps". Silent on the same suffix in other uses, such as "democratic process".
result.label: Adjective before 'approach/role' after take/play

result.description: Fires on words right after "[period/subject] saw" (e.g. "saw varying", "saw significant growth", "saw the flourishing"), in the slot where a noun phrase of development or growth follows. Predicts rise, emerge, develop, become.
result.label: Object slot after "era saw"

result.description: Fires on the "ats" piece completing "thre|ats" (threats), mostly in cybersecurity or risk text. It is quiet on other attack-related words, so it needs the "thre" prefix.
result.label: "ats" in "threats"

result.description: Fires on the token ' her' when it is the split-off first piece of "heritage", mostly after "cultural" or "intangible". It predicts the continuation "itage". It stays silent when "heritage" starts the text, and pronoun uses of ' her' are not the peaks.
result.label: ' her' as start of 'heritage'

result.description: Fires on varied function words and tokens (' (', ' down', ' tasks', ' with', ' is') inside academic or methodology text about task analysis, testing, and teaching. Peaks are mixed; the topic seems to matter more than the token. Weakly predicts words like 'simulation' and 'interactive'.
result.label: Task-analysis and methodology text, varied tokens

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' deriv' (as in "derivation") in linguistics/word-formation text, plus similar mid-word pieces like 'iv' and 'liqu'. Silent on other word-formation text without that piece.
result.label: 'deriv' of derivation, linguistics

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'iency' completing "proficiency" (also weakly "fluency"), mostly in language-skill text. Pushes toward nouns like rates/levels. Members include other 'iency' detectors and skill/competence tokens.
result.label: 'iency' in proficiency

result.description: Fires on " numbers" (or "Num|bers") when it names a named mathematical sequence or class, like Bell, Catalan or Stirling numbers, in math text. Members include detectors for number, numbers and coefficients.
result.label: Named mathematical 'numbers' (Bell, Catalan)

result.description: Fires on the infinitive marker ' to' right after "trying" or "attempting", mostly in analogies like "it's like trying to solve...". Silent on ' to' after other words such as "likened", "contribute", "able" and "need". Predicts a difficult-task verb next (solve, resolve, reverse).
result.label: 'to' after trying/attempting

result.description: Fires on the token " her" (pronoun and as the start of words like "herbs", "heritage", "herding"). Predicts word continuations such as "itage", "bs", "ald", "ring" more than ordinary possessive continuations.
result.label: " her" token, word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on ' only' (sometimes ' just') right after "not" in a "not only X but also Y" construction, often after verbs like "requires". Predicts a modifier or adjective such as careful, technical or extensive.
result.label: "not only" in not-only-but-also

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pot' at the start of a longer word (potatoes, potassium, pottery, potency), when more letters are expected to follow. Members are mostly ' pot' detectors. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' pot' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and modifiers (' to', ' through', ' by', commas, adjectives like 'significant') mid-clause, where the next word is an open continuation. It stays silent on many ' to' tokens, so the pattern is mixed and unclear.
result.label: Scattered mid-clause function words

result.description: Fires on commas and conjunctions (' and', ',', ' or', ' as') inside a list of examples of structures or engineered objects, such as "bridges, towers", predicting the next list item (buildings, railway). Silent on commas in other lists.
result.label: List separators in engineering structure lists

result.description: Fires on verb pieces meaning "improve/increase", mainly "enh-ance/-ancing", plus " increasing" and "elevate", in writing about stories, plots and characters. It stays silent on "enhance" in other contexts and on non-verb "-ance" words like "resonance".
result.label: enhance/increase verb in narrative writing

result.description: Fires on the word piece " strateg" (as in strategic, strategies) inside the word. It is silent when " strateg" is the first token of the document. Upstream members are mostly detectors of strateg/ateg pieces.
result.label: ' strateg' word piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'estone' completing the word "milestone" (e.g. "milestone points", "milestone descriptions"). Weakly fires on the related "ones" in "milestones". Members mostly detect 'estone' or milestone/step/breakthrough-like pieces.
result.label: 'estone' in milestone

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' philosoph' (philosophical, philosophers, philosophy) in essay-like text, often after adjectives such as new, later, medieval. It pushes toward suffixes like 'ers', 'ical' and 'ies'. Members are mostly ' philosoph' detectors.
result.label: philosoph word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after 'of' (e.g. 'plight of the', 'complexity of the', 'index of refraction of the'), where a noun phrase follows. Silent on ' the' after verbs or other prepositions like 'before', 'reveal', 'remains'.
result.label: ' the' after 'of'

result.description: Fires on " time" in the phrase "over time" (change or evolution gradually, across a period). Silent on "point in time" or "time point" where time is a noun in other constructions.
result.label: "time" in "over time"

result.description: Fires on ' in' right after "particularly" or "especially", introducing a domain or area ("particularly in areas such as"). Stays silent on ordinary ' in' after nouns. Pushes toward "regard", "relation", "terms".
result.label: ' in' after particularly/especially

result.description: Fires on the modifier piece in technical compound adjectives, mostly "time" in "real-time" and "speed" in "high-speed", where a noun like applications, systems or environments is expected next. Silent in at least one real-time rendering context.
result.label: Technical compound modifier before noun

result.description: Fires on "Keep" or "stay" (also keep/maintain/hit) at the start of a "keep up / stay ahead / keep pace" phrase, especially sentence-initial or before "-ing". Pushes toward "ing", "updated", and "master".
result.label: Keep/stay ahead verb

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' abandon' when it is a stem that continues into a suffix, such as "abandonment" or "abandoned". It pushes the next token towards 'ment' and similar suffixes.
result.label: ' abandon' stem before suffix

result.description: Fires on the last word of the first noun phrase after "between" (or "both"), where the next token should be "and". It predicts the conjunction joining the two items. It stays quiet on some abbreviation parentheses such as "(CDF)".
result.label: End of first item after "between"

result.description: Fires on the token ' root', mainly in "X is/are rooted in" where the word is expected to continue as "-ed". It is weaker on root as a plant part or math root.
result.label: ' root' in "rooted in"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'yth' inside "Pythagorean" (also rhythm) and on 'CF' in "CFD". It stays silent when 'yth' starts the text, without the preceding 'P'. Weaker hits on other mid-word fragments.
result.label: 'yth' in Pythagorean, 'CF' in CFD
'as' inside "par-as-itic" word
result.description: Fires on the piece 'as' (occasionally 's') within the word "parasit-" (parasitic, parasitology, parasitism), after the piece "par". Silent on 'as' in other words like "peas" or a word-initial "asitism".

Fires on ' were' (subjunctive) right after "as if they" or "as though it", in hypothetical comparisons like "treat X as if they were part of...". Weaker on "as though/if" themselves. Silent on ordinary "like" comparisons.
result.label: "were" after "as if they"

result.description: Fires on " associated" (also "associate") in the phrase "X is/was (often) associated with", where the next word is expected to be "with". Weaker on similar linking words like "linked" or "tied".
result.label: "associated" before "with"

result.description: Fires on the 'ory' piece ending "introductory", where it is followed by a noun like phrases or elements. It stays silent on 'ory' in "sensory", so it needs the word "introduct" before it.
result.label: 'ory' in "introductory"

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' to', ' for', ' can', 'than for') in explanatory academic text, where a verb or complement is expected next (aid, assist, able). Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, with no clear discriminating members.
result.label: Function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' app' at the start of a longer word (appetizer, appliances, apples, approximations, apposition), predicting a continuation like 'reh', 'rent', 'arel', 'rais'. It is silent on text without that piece.
result.label: ' app' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on function words (the, through, by, to) in essays on social change, gender and education history, where the next word is likely a policy or education noun such as suffrage, school, reform or legislation. Silent on 'the' in other history contexts.
result.label: Function words before education/reform nouns
' developers' after "allows"
result.description: Fires on ' developers' as the agent noun right after a verb like "allows/enables" (e.g. "allows developers to…") in software and programming text. Weakly fires on similar role nouns such as users or engineers.

Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the verb "presenting" (present+ing), predicting objects like information, ideas, stories. Silent on 'ing' after other stems such as establishing, seasoning, cooking.
result.label: 'ing' in "presenting"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ations' completing "adapt" (adaptations) in biology/evolution text. It stays silent on 'ations' in other words like "generations" or "interrelations".
result.label: adapt|ations suffix in biology

result.description: Fires on a bare space token that comes right before digits, such as a number at document start, a list number, or the start of a year like 19xx. It is silent on a space before a single digit in a heading ("Instruction 2").
result.label: Space token before digit sequence

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (words, in, the, their, of, for, with) in expository text about writing or analysis, where a noun like "these details" or "this" is likely next. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Mixed function words before demonstratives

result.description: Fires on prepositions like "to", "by", "of" after words of change or response (due to, responding to, adjusts to, shifts in) in economics text. It predicts nouns such as "changing", "external", "market". Silent on "to" in other constructions.
result.label: Preposition after change/response in economics
'ition' in 'practitioners'
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ition' inside 'practitioners' (pract|ition|ers), predicting the 'ers' ending. Weak activity on a few other mid-word pieces and ' trick'. Silent on ordinary text.

result.label: 'astic' in Scholastic
result.description: Fires on the piece 'astic' in "Scholastic/scholasticism", strongest after "Schol", in medieval philosophy text. Members also detect 'astic' in other words (elastic, monastic, plastic), but the target peaks on the Schol- case.
Fires on the word piece ' intr' (start of intricate/intricacies/intriguing) when it follows 'the' or 'an' mid-sentence. It is silent when ' intr' begins the text with no preceding word.
result.label: ' intr' after 'the' (intricate)

result.description: Fires on the letter piece " f" / "f" (or " F") when it begins a word split into pieces, such as f-allacies, f-itting, f-iscal, f-ission, and also on the variable f. Silent on a whole-word " f" before "allacies" in one contrast case.
result.label: Word-initial 'f' fragment

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after "expression" (also reflection, symbol, indicator, manifestation), where the phrase means one thing showing or representing another. Silent on ' of' after "one", "combination", "importance" or "components".
result.label: ' of' after expression/symbol nouns

result.description: Fires on the 'HC' piece completing the acronym MHC (Major Histocompatibility Complex) in immunology text, pushing toward 'Class', 'II', 'molecules'. Barely fires on other split acronyms.
result.label: HC in MHC acronym

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' em' when it starts a longer word (empathy, emissions, emotion, emulsification), most strongly in "cognitive em|pathy". Predicts continuations like 'path', 'ulation', 'blem'. Silent on one "emotionally" example.
result.label: ' em' word-start piece (empathy)

result.description: Fires on the copula ' is' (also ' are', ' be') right after a subject noun naming a technique or concept, in generic essay-style sentences ("glazing is considered to be…"). Silent on "is" after "feedback" or a bare pronoun.
result.label: Copula after concept-noun subject

result.description: Fires on the token 'u', both as a standalone math variable (u + v, u(x)) and as a letter inside words (Intuitionistic, vacuum, Altruism). Pushes toward continuations like 'ction', 'cc', 'istic', 'um'.
result.label: Letter 'u' token

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' facil' and ' simpl' (facilitates, simplifies) when they follow a subject like "it" or "tools" as a verb stem. Members predict verb-ending suffixes such as -itate and -ifies.
result.label: facil-/simpl- verb stems

result.description: Fires on the token "orders" completing the word "disorders", as in "language disorders" or "anxiety disorders", in medical text. Silent on other disease wording. Supported by members that detect "orders" after "dis" and by medical and disease context members.
result.label: "orders" in "disorders"

result.description: Fires mainly on the prefix ' hyper' (as in hyperbole, hyperboxes), predicting word pieces like 'b'/'bol'. Also fires weakly on scattered tokens in garbled Cyrillic text (' все', 'о'), which is noisy.
result.label: ' hyper' prefix before 'bol'

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns like truth, meaning, thoughts, messages, intentions right after verbs or adjectives about uncovering or revealing hidden things (e.g. "reveal hidden thoughts", "uncover unspoken truths"). Silent on plain plot description.
result.label: Hidden meanings/truths being uncovered

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'sc' when it is the start of a split word such as land|sc|apes (also city|sc|apes), predicting continuations like 'apes', 'apers', 'aped'. Silent on other text.
result.label: 'sc' in landscapes

result.description: Fires on ' million' after a number, strongest in geological time spans (e.g. "485 million to", "250 million year"). Weaker for money or quantities. Next-token logits favor ' years' and similar units.
result.label: ' million' after number (geologic time)

result.description: Fires on the token ' collaboration' in all 64 peak examples, mostly in workplace and software-tool contexts. It pushes next-token predictions towards 'tools', 'platforms', 'opportunities' and 'across'. Members are mostly collaboration and cooperation detectors.
result.label: ' collaboration' token detector

result.description: Fires on 'view' in the word "overview", especially in summary-style phrases like "a brief overview of". Weaker on similar summary nouns such as "breakdown" and "exploration". Members detect 'view', section/introduction words, and "provide a ... description" framing.
result.label: "overview" final token

result.description: Fires on the word right after "This section" (delves, aims, is, will, comma) in document-opening statements of a section's purpose. It pushes toward verbs like "dedicated" or "devoted". It stays silent on commas elsewhere.
result.label: Verb slot after "This section"

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and mid-sentence tokens (direct, language, and, of, equal, involves) in abstract expository prose about communication, society and academic topics. It predicts a following content noun, but the peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Scattered words in abstract expository prose

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Pro" (as in Probability) at the start of a line or title, especially in list-like headings of topics. Members are mostly detectors of Pro/pro tokens. Predicts continuations like "per", "pos", "bed".
result.label: ' Pro' word-start piece in headings

result.description: Fires on causal conjunctions, mainly " because" (also " as", " since"), especially after an evaluative predicate like "is significant/important/critical", where a clause explaining why follows. Predicts a subject pronoun like "it" or "they".
result.label: Because after importance claims

result.description: Fires on word pieces like ' agre' (agreements), ' enfor', and 'support' mid-phrase in legal, trade and regulatory text, where the next token continues a legal/regulatory word. Silent when ' agre' starts a document.
result.label: Legal/trade word-piece 'agre' in context

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'experience', word pieces like 'sens-ory', 'pal-ate') mostly in abstract descriptive prose about dining or sensory experience. Silent on commas in reasoning/understanding text. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Dining/sensory experience prose, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the "ises" ending of "premises" in logic and reasoning text about premises and conclusions. It stays silent on "ises" in "arises", so it needs the word "premises".
result.label: "premises" in logic text

result.description: Fires on plural category nouns (forms, types, parts, modes) right after a quantifier or adjective like "various", "different", "specific", "all", predicting "of". Silent when "forms" follows an ordinary adjective, such as "expressive forms".
result.label: Category nouns after "various/different"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ynt" in "Syntactic"/"syntatious", the split of "Syn-t-actic". It predicts continuations like "actic". Members are mostly detectors of the same piece.
result.label: "ynt" piece in "syntactic"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ap' inside "metaphor" and its derivatives (metaphorical, metaphoric), after "met". It stays silent when 'ap' starts a word. It predicts 'hor' next.
result.label: 'ap' inside "metaphor"

result.description: Fires on a single letter or short fragment that starts or continues an abbreviation or acronym, mainly the 'g' in "e.g.", capital 'N' or 'G' in acronyms (miRNAs, NGLP, GDPR) and 'ern' in names. It predicts acronym-like capital continuations.
result.label: Letters inside abbreviations and acronyms

result.description: Fires on the word "Language"/"language", most strongly as a capitalized heading at the start of a document or list item (e.g. "Language Assessment"). It also fires on lowercase "language" in running text. Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: Language token detector

result.description: Fires on the final digit '9' (sometimes '8') of a four-digit year in the 1900s, like 1939 or 1949, in historical text about wars and eras. It stays silent on the '9' in "1920s" or "1930s", where the 9 is the second digit.
result.label: Last digit 9 of a year

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' and' in a coordination, word endings like -ification/-ation, and abbreviation pieces, in academic or expository text. Peaks are scattered, and ' and' is often silent on the contrast, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered 'and' and suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on ' we' right after a sentence-initial "As" (e.g. "As we delve/move/turn…"), predicting progress verbs like move, advance, explore, proceed. Silent on ' we' after a comma or "where" and at sentence start without "As".
result.label: "As we" progression opener

result.description: Fires on 'and', 'the', 'like', 'including' right before a named industrial-revolution invention (spinning jenny, power loom, steam engine) in lists of examples. Silent on 'and' joining abstract nouns elsewhere.
result.label: Connector before named industrial inventions

result.description: Fires on the article ' a' after a verb or preposition like "envisioned", "fostered", "characterized by", "derived from", mostly in history and ancient-civilization text. It stays quiet on "is a" and "imagine a" predicates. It predicts abstract nouns like variety or series.
result.label: ' a' in historical descriptions

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ced' in "unprecedented", "antecedent" and "Procedures", where the next piece is likely 'ented'/'ent'. Weaker on ' surface' in "surface waves" and other mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'ced' in unprecedented

result.description: Fires on the token ' flow', most strongly in fluid dynamics text (laminar/turbulent flow, flow patterns, flow rate). Weaker for network flow or current flow. Predicts continuations like regime, conditions, patterns.
result.label: ' flow' in fluid dynamics
'og' in Van Gogh
result.description: Fires on the token 'og' in "Gogh" after "Vincent van G", in art-history text. Members detect 'og' and ' G' pieces and word-piece completions. Weak activations on other tokens.
Fires on the 'ip' piece in "Antiparticles" (Ant-ip-articles), after "Ant"/"ant". It stays silent on 'ip' in "Multiplication", so it needs the anti- word-start context.
result.label: 'ip' inside Antiparticles

result.description: Fires on varied function words and verbs (enh-ance, create, and, in) in texts about poetry and literary devices like assonance, where the next word is likely poetry-related (verse, poet, meter). Silent on 'the' after 'to' in general writing.
result.label: Poetry-device text, predicts poetry words

result.description: Fires on verbs like "providing", "provide", "add", "support" that introduce what something contributes (evidence, context, credibility), mostly in essays about how quotes, references or examples work. Predicts nouns like annotations, citations, explanations. Silent on "providing" in a general list context.
result.label: Contribution verbs: providing/add in essays

result.description: Fires on " of" right after nouns like rules, laws, code, or rule, where the next word is a field or domain (law, grammar, thought, conduct). It stays silent on " of" after generic nouns like world, art, form or process.
result.label: " of" after rules/laws nouns

result.description: Fires on prepositions like " at" or " in" after verbs of amusement or enjoyment (chuckle at, find joy in, one can observe) in humor and playfulness writing, where a noun phrase such as "the thought of" comes next. Silent on " at" in other contexts.
result.label: Preposition after chuckle/joy in humor
Adjective suffix before manner noun
result.description: Fires on adjective-ending pieces (-ical, -ional, -ive, 'personal') in descriptive phrases in arts/essay text, where a noun like approach, manner, or perspective comes next. Silent on 'ional' in 'emotional' and 'intentional'.

Fires on the suffix 'ional' completing "emot|ional" (also 'ological'), mostly when an emotional noun phrase like responses, connections or impact is expected next. It is silent in a few other emotional contexts, so the extra condition is unclear.
result.label: emot-ional suffix before responses

result.description: Fires on commas (occasionally " or"/" and") inside a list of emotion words, after an item like happiness or fear, where another emotion comes next. Predicts emotion words (anger, surprise, sad, joy). Weaker in other lists.
result.label: Comma in emotion-word lists
'mit' in neurotransmitter
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'mit' inside "neurotransmitters", where the following piece is expected to be "ter(s)". Members detect neuroscience and word-piece context, such as neuron and synapse words and 'mit' itself.

Fires on function words (the, to, of, by, for) in philosophy text, especially existentialism passages, just before an abstract philosophical term like "absurd" or "freedom". The same words are silent in other philosophy contexts.
result.label: Function words in existentialist philosophy text

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe token right after a name or noun, where an 's' (possessive or contraction) is expected next. Strongest after disease eponyms and algorithm names (Huntington', Prim'). Quiet after some plural or abstract nouns.
result.label: Apostrophe after name before 's

result.description: Fires on the word " live" (also "Live") as an adjective/adverb meaning real-time or in-person, e.g. "live music", "live streaming", "goes live", "live migration". Pushes towards nouns like performances, sessions and events.
result.label: 'live' as real-time adjective

result.description: Fires on the word "networks" (or "network") right after "neural", in machine learning text such as convolutional or recurrent neural networks. Members detect "neural" and "networks" tokens and related NN terms.
result.label: "networks" after "neural"

result.description: Fires on human/individual/cultural-type modifiers right after "independent of", "transcend", "irrespective of" in philosophical claims that something exists apart from human or individual views. Silent on "human" after "details of" or "aspects of".
result.label: Independent-of human/individual/cultural (philosophy)

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (of, in, comma, to, 'ator') mid-sentence in technical science and engineering text, such as nuclear, fusion and physics. Predicts technical continuations. Silent on 'ator' in combinatorics/stator.
result.label: Technical-science function-word slot

result.description: Fires on the first word or two after a contrastive discourse marker such as "On the other hand," or "conversely," (often ' a', ' the', ' in'). It is silent on ' the' in ordinary mid-sentence positions.
result.label: Word after contrastive "on the other hand"

result.description: Fires on ' (' that opens the next numbered item "(2)" in an inline enumerated list, after a separator like a comma or semicolon following "(1)". Silent on parentheses used for asides or examples; predicts the number "2".
result.label: Opening paren of next list number

result.description: Fires on prepositions and function words (to, for, with, about, in, how they) that follow a noun or verb about employees/people in workplace text, where a "their"/"safely"-type continuation about those people's actions is expected. Silent on infinitival "to" in other uses.
result.label: Function word after employee-related noun

result.description: Fires on ' about' (also ' into') right after information/insight nouns ("provides information about", "insight into"), where a clause or topic object follows. Silent on "care about".
result.label: "information about" preposition

result.description: Fires on commas, "and", and gerunds like "using"/"applying" that separate items in a list of writing or language techniques (e.g. "manipulating sentence length, blending…"). Predicts the next list item, such as a writing-technique noun.
result.label: List items in writing techniques

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period after abstract, technical or academic prose (science, materials, management), where a new sentence or paragraph begins next. Silent on periods in abbreviations like "e.g." or "etc."
result.label: Sentence-final period in expository text

result.description: Fires on ' will' (occasionally ' likely') when a noun-phrase subject, typically an abstract or technical topic, is followed by a future-tense prediction ("X will be explored / continue to shape"). Silent after pronouns like "we" or after "that" in relative clauses.
result.label: Future 'will' after abstract subject

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " sculpt" (as in sculpture/sculpting) inside art-technique text, and also on " Old" in "Old World", "Old English" and sometimes " New". It is silent on a document-initial "sculpt". Members are mostly sculpt and Old detectors.
result.label: sculpt and Old/New token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ights' of the word "insights", mostly in business/data text ("actionable insights", "valuable insights into"). Members are 'ights'/'insight' detectors; the next token is often "into".
result.label: 'ights' completing "insights"

result.description: Fires on the token " product" itself, mostly as a modifier before a noun (product development, features, analytics). Members are mostly " product" detectors. It also fires weakly on "product" in productivity. Silent on the contrast text, which has no "product" token.
result.label: ' product' token detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " trade"/" Trade", both in "trade-offs" and in commerce uses (trade policy, trade routes). Members are mostly detectors of this token. Occasional weak firing on digits and other tokens.
result.label: Word "trade" detector

result.description: Fires on the token " stem" (mostly "stem cell"), and also on " Cir" at the start of "Circles" headings and occasionally "heap". Members are mainly " stem" detectors. Silent on genetics text without the token.
result.label: stem token (stem cell) detector

result.description: Fires on forms of "lead" (led, lead, leading, leads) used causally, as in "X led to Y", right before "to". The one silent contrast ("led also to") suggests it needs the verb directly followed by "to".
result.label: Causal "led/lead to" verb

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "Proto" (Proto-Indo-European) in historical linguistics text. It stays silent on hyphens in other compounds such as Kordo-Farsi, pre-eminence and trans-regional.
result.label: Hyphen after Proto (Proto-Indo-European)

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer target that peaks on varied function words (and, the, like, with, important) and the piece 'ara' in lists or academic prose. Circuit failed faithfulness and has no clear dominant token or condition.
result.label: Diffuse function words in academic lists

result.description: Fires on varied function words and mid-phrase tokens (the, to, where, as, such as) in abstract academic or scientific prose, where the next word is likely a technical term. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is diffuse and low-faithfulness.
result.label: Function words before technical terms

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and verbs (the, by, both, making, reflect) in abstract expository prose, where the next word is a content noun. Peaks are inconsistent. It stays silent on ' the' after 'is' or 'that'. Evidence is weak.
result.label: Function words in expository prose

result.description: Fires on varied function words and connectors (of, to, their, commas, "beyond") in expository academic text, notably " of" after "presence", but silent on " of" after "use". Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Function words after "presence" (weak)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (the, of, this, with, beyond) and word pieces in expository academic text, where a noun or technical term is expected next. No dominant token; the circuit failed and members are diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on varied function words and verbs (and, terminate, involved, commas) inside text about bosons and particle physics, predicting physics terms like weak, neutral, force. Silent on ' particle' within 'particle physics'. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Boson/particle physics context, varied tokens

result.description: Fires on 'o', ' of', or punctuation right after "tri"-prefixed words (triad, trio, triangular) and on "urgency of". Silent on 'o' in other words like logos/pathos. Mixed, weakly consistent peaks; members include tri-token detectors.
result.label: Token after 'tri-' words

result.description: Attention-layer target that fires on scattered tokens: document-start tokens, conjunctions like ' and', semicolons, commas, and modifiers like ' different'. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed faithfulness, so the pattern is weak. Members hint at music-related next words.
result.label: Scattered function-word and doc-start attention

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and punctuation (' the', ',', '.', ' and') in passages about symbols, music and art conveying abstract ideas. Members are music/symbol/language-related; the peak pattern is diffuse and the circuit failed.
result.label: Diffuse function words in art/music text

result.description: Fires on digits (mostly '9' or '1') in year ranges like 1917-1918 and on some function words in WWI and Russian Revolution history text. It stays silent on the same digits in other decades, such as 1920s and 1970s.
result.label: WWI-era year digits in history

result.description: Fires on function words and verbs like "involves", "of", "." and "that" in text about cooking and mise en place, where a description of a process or its importance follows. Silent on "involves" in other, non-cooking contexts.
result.label: Cooking-text connectives like involves/of

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' of', ' with', 'ize', ' different', ' social') in music and education text, often mid-phrase before a noun or suffix. Peaks are inconsistent. Silent on many ' of' tokens, e.g. 'variety of'.
result.label: Scattered mid-phrase tokens in music text

result.description: Fires on function words and verbs (of, on, with, that, commas) in text about Taoism/Daoism and related Eastern religions, with members for Buddhist/Indian/Chinese vocabulary. Silent on 'of' in generic philosophy contexts like "flow of".
result.label: Function words in Taoism text

result.description: Fires on function words (of, the, for, that) in technical text about sensors and measurement, in the slot right before a noun phrase about sensors. It stays silent on 'of' in other technical contexts. Logits point weakly to sensor-like nouns.
result.label: Function words before sensor nouns

result.description: Fires on function words (for, to, of, "we", colon) inside English-grammar text about pronouns, plurals and sentence structure. It is silent on many of the same words (e.g. ' to') elsewhere in grammar text, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Function words in grammar explanations

result.description: Fires on varied connective tokens (hyphens, "of", "where", "how", commas) in academic-style text, often after nouns like "examples" or "instances" that introduce a following clause or topic. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Connectives in academic prose
Connectors after economic growth nouns
result.description: Fires on connectors (and, to, through, as, commas) and verbs in economics/business text about innovation, growth and job creation, where a noun like growth or innovation is expected next. Silent on 'and' in generic lists of business actions.

Fires on scattered function words and verbs (' of', ' introduced', ' the') in passages about mathematicians and their contributions (e.g. Hausdorff introduced a concept). Silent on ' of' after nouns like development/study. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Mathematician-introduced-concept function words

result.description: Fires on 'Defining' at the start of a document (the 'ining' piece) and on the next few tokens of such a title or opening, such as 'the', 'relative', and 'scope'. It stays silent on 'ining' inside 'determining' or 'examining'.
result.label: Document-initial 'Defining' opening

result.description: Fires on function words (the, where, to, then, if, from) in explanations of engine, combustion and thermodynamic processes, where the next word is expected to be a technical noun. It stays silent on 'the' in other science or engineering contexts.
result.label: Function words in engine-process text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mess' when it is the start of "messaging" or "messenger" (text mess-, voice mess-, instant mess-). Members detect the same fragment and predict continuations like -aging and -enger. Silent in one "ant mess-aging" case.
result.label: ' mess' piece before -aging/-enger

result.description: Fires on the leading '1' of a four-digit year that is the end of a date range, such as (1770-1850) or (1787–1899), usually a death year in a biography. It stays silent on '1' in century words like 1800s or 18th century.
result.label: Leading 1 of range end year

result.description: Fires on " that", " to" or " only" right after the noun "questions" (or "allow/aim"), where a relative clause or purpose clause follows, in text about communication and asking questions. Members track question/answer words.
result.label: Clause linker after "questions"

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on function tokens (commas, ' and', ' to') and word pieces in abstract expository text, mostly science or technical topics. It stays silent on commas after thermodynamics clauses. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered function tokens in expository text

result.description: Fires mostly on ' and' (also 'or', 'to', word pieces) in short title-like pairings of topics, e.g. "Music and Technology" in heading lists. It stays quiet on 'and' closing prose lists of clauses.
result.label: 'and' in topic-pair headings

result.description: Fires on the "it" piece inside "necessitates/necessitating" (necess|it|ates), after an abstract subject noun phrase. It stays silent on "it" inside other words like prioritize, gravitational, or exhibit.
result.label: "it" in necessitates

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' incred' (start of incredible/incredibly), usually after "it is/making it/also" before an adjective. Members are mostly ' incred' detectors plus similar prefix pieces like height, inn, une, da.
result.label: ' incred' prefix token

result.description: Fires on varied function words and "new" in text about genetics and reproduction (combining parent genetic material to create new offspring). Silent on "new" in non-biological contexts. Members are genetics/biology topic detectors.
result.label: Genetics/reproduction offspring-creation context

result.description: Fires on function words (to, and, the, their, an, another, among, while) in texts about intellectual property, law and rights, where the next word could be a noun like service, usage, third or technology. Silent on 'to' in general tech or research text.
result.label: Function words in IP/legal text

result.description: Fires on ' with' (also ' among', ' of', ' to') right after relationship or connection verbs and nouns like connect, communicate, engage, relationships, in marketing text, where a customer or audience is expected next. Silent on ' with' after combined, saturated or provide.
result.label: 'with' after connect/relationship words

result.description: Fires on the final '0' of a four-digit year ending in 0 (e.g. 1450, 1600) in a date range such as "from 1450 to 1600" or "between 1450 and". It predicts a following dash or range connector. It stays silent on zeros in other numbers.
result.label: Year-ending zero in date ranges

result.description: Fires on the verb "play" in its forms (played, playing, play), most strongly in "X played/playing a significant/crucial role" with an abstract subject such as technology or media. It also fires, more weakly, on literal uses.
result.label: play in "play a role"

result.description: Fires on ' rather' when it begins "rather than" after a noun phrase or clause (contrasting alternatives). Silent on ' rather' followed by a comma or at the start of a clause ("; rather, it..."). Members are mostly 'rather' detectors that predict "than".
result.label: 'rather' in "rather than"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' fer' (mostly the start of "fermentation"), and occasionally ' fib' (as in "fibers"). Members are mostly ' fer' detectors that predict the continuation "ment".
result.label: ' fer' piece in fermentation

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sequ' (start of sequential, sequencing, sequentially), often after "the" or "for". It predicts continuations like 'ential' and 'encing'. Members are mostly ' sequ' detectors.
result.label: ' sequ' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'lo' inside longer words like colloids, colloquial, parallelogram, balloon, diploidy, where a continuation piece is expected. Weak firing on a few other tokens like ' understanding' and ' close'.
result.label: 'lo' mid-word piece (colloid)

result.description: Fires mainly on ' less' as the piece of "lessons" (moral less-ons, life less-ons), and secondarily on ' Music' or ' Production' in lists of academic subject headings. Members are mostly ' less'-in-lesson detectors.
result.label: 'less' in 'lessons'; Music headings

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word endings like 'ers', commas, ' of', ' material') in physics/astronomy/materials science text, mid-phrase where a technical continuation is expected. Peaks are scattered and the same tokens stay silent elsewhere, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scientific text mid-phrase, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on the word "respect" and its pieces (" respect", "pect" in "Respect", respecting/respects) as a verb or value noun in ethics or values lists. Silent on "mutual respect" in the contrast. Predicts suffixes like -ful and -fully.
result.label: "respect" word and its pieces

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "branch" in definitions of academic fields ("a branch of the natural sciences/mechanics/logic"). Stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "details of", "understanding of", "concept of".
result.label: "branch of" academic field

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' of', ' the', ' for') and word pieces ('ile', 'ible') in technical expository text, often right before an adjective or noun. Peaks are inconsistent, and ' of' is often silent. The circuit is diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: Diffuse function words in technical prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece " adapt" (adaptability, adaptive, adapt to), mostly when it is a word stem. It predicts suffixes such as -ability, -ive and -ation. Weakly fires on " adjust" as well.
result.label: ' adapt' stem token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "oth" in "Hypothesis" (Hyp|oth|esis), e.g. Continuum, Riemann, Input Hypothesis. Also fires on "oth" in other split words like endothermic. Predicts "esis" next.
result.label: "oth" in Hypothesis

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'uous' in sinuous, ' introduced', ' R') mostly in art/music-history text, such as Art Nouveau or Rondo. Silent on commas elsewhere. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Art-history text mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on plural nouns like "studies", "examples", "cases", "scenarios" that follow "case" or similar words in textbook-style generated text, where the next word is likely "illustrate/demonstrate". It stays silent when "studies" starts a sentence.
result.label: Case studies/examples noun before 'illustrate'

result.description: Fires on the word ' market' when it follows a modifier like "global", "this", "active" or "art", in economics text. It predicts "place" next. It stays quiet when ' market' follows a possessive or verb and acts as a modifier, as in "market share" or "market control".
result.label: ' market' before 'place' / noun-phrase head

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (and, comma, parenthesis, cre-, primary, overall) in abstract passages about art, writers, creativity and meaning. Fires in some contexts but not others on the same ' and'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: Function words in creative/art prose

result.description: Fires on determiners (a, the, any, an) after "approaches" or "at" in calculus text about limits and function behavior at a point, anticipating "point". Quiet on determiners in other math contexts.
result.label: Determiner before "point" in limits

result.description: Fires on the verb ' translate' (also 'transl-ating') when it means turning something into something else, as in "practices translate theory into action". Members also detect transform, convert and turning. Next-token push is toward 'into'.
result.label: verb 'translate' (convert into)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and connectors (the, a, an, into, 's, include, situated, their) mid-sentence in technical or explanatory text, where a noun phrase is expected next. No clear single trigger; the same ' the' is often silent in contrast.
result.label: Scattered function words before noun

result.description: Fires on " vice" in the phrase "vice versa" (e.g. "and vice versa", "or vice versa"), where it anticipates "versa" next. Members mostly detect " vice" itself, plus other tokens that predict " vers".
result.label: "vice" in "vice versa"

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (of, to, -ing, commas) inside abstract, academic text about causes and effects, where a negative-outcome noun like "poor", "errors" or "outbreaks" may come next. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Function words before negative outcome nouns

result.description: Fires on function words (its, their, the, by, through) right after a verb like affects/determines/dictate, in text about protein three-dimensional structure and folding. It predicts shape-related words like hydro/geometric/geometry.
result.label: Function word before protein-structure noun
' bro' before 'adened' (broaden)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' bro' when it begins "broadened"/"broader", mostly after "have", "not only" or "also". It is silent on some "broader" cases after prepositions, so it needs a verb-like slot where "broadened" is expected.
Fires on the word piece ' genu' (start of "genuine"/"genuinely"), typically after a verb or article in essays about authenticity and communication. It predicts the continuation "ine"/"inen".
result.label: ' genu' word-piece (genuine)

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (in, of, that, -ify, consistent) in text about consistency, editing, and standardizing language or style. It seems to anticipate consistency/editing words such as "consistent" or "edit". Mixed evidence; silent on one "consistent" example.
result.label: Consistency/editing prediction slot

result.description: Fires on linking verbs or adverbs (" is", " are", " also", " was") right after a subject naming a historical period or decade (1970s, this period, Pleistocene), before "considered/known/recognized as". Silent on "what is" and other subjects.
result.label: Copula after period/decade subject

result.description: Fires on the last piece of an academic topic title or philosophy term in lists of subject headings (Subjectivity, Universals, Matter, substance), often just before a period or line break. Weak and mixed token pattern.
result.label: Ends of philosophy topic titles

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' resp' (occasionally 'abol') in biology text about cellular or aerobic respiration and metabolism, before 'iration'/'iratory'. Silent on other biochemistry text without such word pieces.
result.label: ' resp' in respiration

result.description: Fires on the piece "ament" completing "testament", almost always in the phrase "a testament to". It stays silent on "ament" inside "armament". Predicts " to" next.
result.label: "ament" in "testament to"

result.description: Fires on determiners and adjectives (a, as, the, essential, powerful, fundamental) right after "act/serve/function as", where a role description is about to be given. Silent on some "as a" cases, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Role-description slot after "serves as"

result.description: Fires on place names, mainly US states and cities (California, Angeles, York, Illinois, Boston), often inside lists of places or institution names like "University of California, Los Angeles". Peaks fall on the last piece of the name.
result.label: US place names in lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' laten' (start of "latency") in computing and networking text. Members are mostly detectors of ' laten' that predict completions like "cy". Nearly all peaks are the same token.
result.label: ' laten' (latency) token

result.description: Fires on connecting words (' equal', ' with', ' between', ' as', ' supporting', parentheses) in physics text about forces, motion and experiments, such as Newton's third law. It stays silent on ' equal' in social-justice and ethics text.
result.label: Physics-text connectives, e.g. 'equal and opposite'

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' pal' when it is an incomplete beginning of a longer word such as palate or palm, predicting a suffix continuation (-ate, -atable). Members detect other word-start fragments like leg, sym, vol, tang.
result.label: ' pal' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ' that' (and some other function words) linking a defined term to a relative clause in grammar and linguistics text, such as "conjunction is a statement that...". It stays quiet on 'that' in other topics. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: 'that' in grammar/linguistics definitions

result.description: Fires on varied tokens ('ing' in "positioning", ' careful', ' brand') inside business marketing and branding text. Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like "maintaining" or "crafting". Peak 'ing' is mainly in "positioning" within marketing and branding passages.
result.label: Marketing/branding positioning 'ing'

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens (mostly "inary" in "culinary", also " an", "ing", " can") in kitchen/cooking-themed text, where the next word is likely a cooking-related term. It is silent on "culinary" in some contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Culinary-context mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on copulas/auxiliaries and adverbs (is, be, remains, more, particularly) in technical comparison text, where an evaluative adjective like suitable/preferred/appropriate is expected next. Silent on 'more' before an adjective in plain comparatives.
result.label: Predicate slot before evaluative adjective

result.description: Fires on the verb "stand" and its forms (standing, stood), mostly in the physical or figurative sense of standing tall, upright or out. It pushes toward continuations like "alone", "out", "tall" and "point".
result.label: verb "stand" and forms

result.description: Fires mostly on ' incident' (as in incident detection/response) in security-flavored text, with scattered weaker hits on ' Effect', ' Friedrich' and function words. Silent on one 'An incident' example. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Incident in security text (mixed)

result.description: Fires on " the" right after a copula or comparison ("X are the", "as the", "like the", "making them the") that defines a subject metaphorically as the key or essential thing. Silent on " the" after prepositions or commas.
result.label: "the" after "are" in definitions

result.description: Fires on scattered function words, word endings and punctuation (periods, ' to', 'ing', ' the', ' their') mid-passage in abstract expository text. Predicts comparative words like 'bigger', 'larger', 'more'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Scattered function tokens before comparatives

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' intro' when it is the start of a longer word, mainly 'introductory' (e.g. in comma-placement grammar text). Members are mostly detectors of ' intro' and similar word-start pieces before 'duct'-like endings.
result.label: ' intro' in 'introductory'

result.description: Fires on the 'in' piece inside "scrutinizing/scrutinizes" (scrut-in-izing), after "scrut". It stays quiet on 'in' in other words like "Dworkin". Members detect the 'scrut' and 'in' pieces.
result.label: 'in' within "scrutinizing"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' econ' when it is the start of a split word such as "econometric(s)", predicting continuations like 'ometric'. Silent on the ordinary word "economic" in the contrast text.
result.label: ' econ' before -ometric
Chatelier 'atel' piece
result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'atel' in "Le Chatelier's" at the start of a document, and weakly on ' pod' and a few other tokens. Members detect 'atel' and 'ier' pieces and chemistry context.

Fires on ' the' directly after "before" (also "after"), as in "before the deadline" or "before the 1…". It stays silent on ' the' after "to". Members detect temporal "before" and push toward verbs like "begins" or "arrived".
result.label: ' the' after temporal 'before'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ther' inside the genus name Panthera (Pan|ther|a, Panther, Pantherales). Silent on word-initial 'ther' as in 'theran-like'. Also fires on 'ther' in Ethernet and therapy pieces, but most strongly after 'Pan'.
result.label: 'ther' after Pan- (Panthera)

result.description: Fires on the end of a plural noun naming a group of people (intellectuals, activists, professionals, authors, leaders) that is the subject of a "with/as/when X and Y" clause, where a verb like "increasingly ..." is expected next.
result.label: Plural people-group subject ending

result.description: Fires on forms of the verb "take" (take, taking, takes), mostly in business or risk-management text where a phrase like "take steps", "take risks" or "take into account" is expected next. Members are mostly detectors of "take" forms.
result.label: Verb "take" forms

result.description: Fires on varied connective or function words (as, and, system, various, specifying) in lists of security or policy measures, such as user access and asset protection. Silent on "such as" in cooking and other topics. Mostly topic-driven and diffuse.
result.label: Security policy connectives

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-sentence tokens (function words like " of", " a", " on", word pieces) in academic explanatory text. Peaks are inconsistent, and it stays silent on some " of" cases. The evidence is mixed, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words in academic text

result.description: Fires on the noun ' journey' and close synonyms (voyage, path, trip, route) when used as a metaphorical or literal trip, usually after "this/our/your". Silent on 'trek' in the contrast. Upstream members are mostly journey-token detectors.
result.label: journey / voyage noun

result.description: Fires on commas separating items in a list of abstract nouns or concepts (e.g. values like kindness, loyalty, trust), predicting another list item. It is silent on commas in ordinary clause or sentence structure.
result.label: Comma in lists of abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on prepositions (' in', ' of', ' into', ' during') after a noun phrase in historical or evolution-over-time text, where a time period phrase like "of today" or "in subsequent years" likely follows. Silent on 'in' after "progress/moment".
result.label: Preposition before time-period phrase

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (' be', ' and', ' midst', ' a', ' only') in passages about public/private keys and encryption. It stays silent on ' be' after 'can' in other contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: Function words in key-encryption text

result.description: Fires on the word piece " surr" at the start of "surroundings" (also "surround"), strongest after possessives like "its/our/their". Predicts continuations such as "ound". Members detect word-start fragments.
result.label: ' surr' start of surroundings

result.description: Fires on function words (the, are, their, from, greater) in expository text about urban areas, geography, and polymers/materials, where a noun or descriptive phrase is expected next. Silent on many 'the' tokens elsewhere. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Function words in urban/materials expository text

result.description: Fires on assorted function words (and, the, to, will, into) mid-sentence in expository or technical text, where a noun or verb is expected next. It stays silent on 'and' closing a list of items. Evidence is mixed and the logits are not clear.
result.label: Function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on "includes"/"include" and other function words (of, the, from) in expository text where a list or composition of components is about to follow, e.g. "materials include", "made up from". Silent on some "includes" in other contexts.
result.label: Include/composition list-introducing words

result.description: Fires on scattered function tokens and word pieces (',', ' of', ' personal', 'ous') in abstract academic prose, where the next word is likely a topical adjective or noun stem like legal, health, econom. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered tokens predicting domain stems

result.description: Fires on " since" (also "Since") introducing a time-origin phrase like "since the inception/dawn/early days", after a clause about humans, technology or fields having changed or existed over long periods. Predicts historical-start nouns.
result.label: "since" before historical origin phrase

result.description: Fires on the ordinal suffix "th" after a century number (early 20th, 18th, 19th), where "century" is expected next. Strongest in "early 20th century"; weaker for 18th.
result.label: Century ordinal suffix 'th'

result.description: Fires on 'and', commas or 'with' right after the word "dialogue" (or similar) when it is the first item in a "balance/interplay between dialogue and X" pairing in writing-craft text. Silent on 'and' in other lists.
result.label: Conjunction after 'dialogue' in narrative craft

result.description: Fires on a sentence-ending period, mostly in history, politics and society expository text, where the period is followed by a garbled or truncated next word. It stays silent on some other periods, and the contrast doesn't show a clear reason.
result.label: Sentence-final period in history text

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after a time-span or moment noun such as "periods of" or "moments of", where a state or feeling (calm, tension, stillness) comes next. It stays silent on ' of' after "pace of", "use of" or "intensity of".
result.label: 'of' after moments/periods

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' en' right after a comma or adverb, where a participle like "enabling", "enhancing" or "encompassing" follows. It stays silent on ' en' in "enhanced" after "have" and in "enzyme" after "as" or "fluctuating".
result.label: ' en' starting -ing participle

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'bre' in "groundbreaking", the token before 'aking'. Members mostly detect 'bre' in this word and boost the continuation 'aking'.
result.label: 'bre' in groundbreaking

result.description: Fires on the space token that comes right after "in" and before a year's digits (e.g. "established in [196]"), mostly for organizations or treaties. Silent when the space follows "the", "'s" or "late" or starts a document.
result.label: Space before year after "in"

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on assorted function words and word pieces (' more', ' or', ' of', commas, ' every') mid-sentence. It is silent on ' more' in several similar contexts, and the evidence doesn't show what separates them.
result.label: Scattered function-word peaks, unclear

result.description: Fires on varied tokens, mostly ending a noun phrase or modifier (' waste', ' conflicts', ' fuel', closing commas, 'with') in expository academic text. No single token dominates; the evidence is mixed and the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse noun-phrase-ending expository tokens

result.description: Fires on function words (' to', ' of', ' a') in abstract business or communication prose, where the next word is likely a negative or error-related term (mis-, poor, incorrect, failing). Silent on ' to' in neutral constructions.
result.label: Function words before negative outcomes

result.description: Fires on scattered, mixed tokens (a space before a number, a closing parenthesis, 'interval', 'Plant', function words like 'and' or 'on'). No clear shared meaning. It is silent on spaces before year digits. The logits are mixed word fragments.
result.label: Scattered mixed tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'age' piece of "engage" (also engaging/engages) and a few other word endings like 'ful'. Silent on 'age' in "camouflage". Members detect engage-forms that predict "with"/"in".
result.label: 'age' in "engage"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens that end a name or noun phrase, such as surnames in name lists (White, Wright, Davis), Columb-us, and some commas or relative words. It seems to predict a following surname or continuation. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Surnames and phrase-final tokens

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (of, by, using, -ates) inside text about cooking, cuisine and food culture or history. It stays silent on 'of' in non-culinary text. Logits favour culinary-style continuations, but evidence is mixed.
result.label: Culinary-topic function words

result.description: Fires on commas and 'and' inside a list of protected or affected parties or things (personnel, property, communities, public), in safety/protection text, anticipating the next list item. Silent on commas in other constructions.
result.label: List separators after protected parties

result.description: Fires on scattered function words (of, at, to, that, for) and word pieces in expository text, often where a bio/food/health-type noun phrase continues. Peaks are inconsistent and the target is silent on many ' of' contexts, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Scattered function words, unclear

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' w' (split from a longer word like wages) right after a modifier such as 'minimum' or 'higher'. It stays silent on ' w' in other contexts, such as 'widespread' after 'but'.
result.label: ' w' piece in 'minimum wages'

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' heavy', 'et', ' an', ' systems', ' high', 'er') mostly in the middle of a noun phrase where a descriptive noun is expected next. Mixed peaks with weak members; evidence is thin.
result.label: Mid-noun-phrase modifier tokens, mixed

result.description: Fires on the token ' present', mostly as the adjective meaning "in attendance/existing" after "is/are/been" (e.g. "is present in"). Weaker on 'present'-ing and other senses. Members are mostly ' present' detectors.
result.label: ' present' as predicate adjective

result.description: Fires weakly on varied function words and modifiers (' specific', ' of', ' certain', ' particular', ' like') in abstract academic prose about media, language and society. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered words in academic media prose

result.description: Fires on ' social' (also 'etal' in 'societal') as a modifier before a noun like critique, hierarchy, classes, structures, norms. Predicts nouns such as comment, critique, class, norm.
result.label: ' social' modifier before noun

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Art' at the start of a document or heading, as in "Art|istic Expression", plus scattered function words. It is silent on ' Art' in a later list heading ("Art and Aesthetics"). The members are mixed arts and creativity context.
result.label: Document-initial ' Art' heading

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (commas, 'auss' in Saussure, 'various', 'multiple', 'by', 'with') with no clear shared meaning. Peak consistency is low, and the circuit is diffuse, with no strong discriminative members.
result.label: Diffuse mixed-token latent

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (also 'isation') in "quantization" in quantum physics text, e.g. the Hall conductance. It stays silent on 'ization' in "synchronization". Members detect quant- and quantum/wave-particle context.
result.label: quantization suffix in physics
'rag' in pragmatic
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rag' (also ' Prag') in "pragmatic/pragmatism", where the next piece is expected to be 'mat'. Silent on unrelated text. Members are detectors of 'prag' and similar word-start pieces.

Fires on mixed function words and commas (into account, not, by, as their) mid-clause in expository academic text, where a verb or preposition is expected next. Members are math, science and music topic detectors. Peaks are inconsistent.
result.label: Function words in technical expository prose

result.description: Fires on the word piece 've' in "con-ve-ying" (also "conve-ction"), where the next piece is likely "ying". It stays silent on 've' in "conducive", "unraveled" and "they've".
result.label: 've' in "conveying"

result.description: Fires on mixed function words and commas (",", " as", " to", " given", " meaning") mid-sentence in abstract expository text about technical topics. The peak tokens are scattered and consistency is low. The commas stay silent in some contexts, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function words in expository text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "part" when it begins a longer word such as "particle" or "partners", mostly in "wave-particle duality". It predicts continuations like "icle", "icular" and "icip".
result.label: 'part' as start of 'particle'

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and commas (',', ' is', ' are', ' natural', verbs like 'secure') inside expository science, economics and government text, where a verb or noun phrase continues. Peaks are mixed, and the same commas stay silent elsewhere.
result.label: Mixed commas and verbs in expository text

result.description: Fires on the ending piece of precipitation-related words, mainly "itation" in "precipitation" and "all" in "rainfall", in weather/climate text. Weaker on moisture/humidity word endings.
result.label: precipitation / rainfall word endings

result.description: Fires on function words (' the', ' by', ' represented', ' between', ' that') in expository text about history, politics, or military topics (e.g. Iron Curtain, diplomacy), where a verb or preposition leads into an abstract noun. Silent on ', the' after a comma opening a clause.
result.label: Function words in historical-political exposition

result.description: Fires on the word ' be' right after the infinitive marker 'to' (e.g. "to be or not to be", "place to be", "needs to be"). It stays quiet after modals like can or could, and after "turns out to".
result.label: ' be' after infinitive 'to'

result.description: Fires on the ending of "threats" (mostly 'ats' after "thre") and on "attacks" in cybersecurity text, as in cyber threats, attacks and defense against them. Weaker on similar security nouns.
result.label: Cyber threats/attacks noun ending

result.description: Fires mainly on ' amb' (start of ambition/ambivalence) and scattered function or modifier words (' and', ' primary', ' the', ' numerous') in expository, encyclopedic text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the evidence is thin.
result.label: ' amb' plus scattered expository words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "au" inside names or words such as Chaucer, Gauguin, tau, Caupin, mostly after a first consonant piece (Ch, G, T, C). Silent when "au" starts a word-like fragment such as "aucier".
result.label: "au" piece inside names

result.description: Fires on the word " art" (as in "the art of", "an art form", "artistic") when it is a complete word or the start of art-related words. It was silent when " art" opened the text, with nothing before it. Output pushes toward -istry, -ifice, -form.
result.label: ' art' token, art-of / artistry

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' expl' when it is a verb stem about to be completed as "ores/ored/oring", especially in "This section/chapter expl-ores". Stays silent on noun uses like "exploration" and on "book expl".
result.label: ' expl' verb stem (explores)

result.description: Fires on the verb ' depend' (also 'depends', 'lies' in 'relies', 'dependent') when a subject is said to depend on something, right before 'on/upon'. Members detect depend/rely/solely tokens that promote 'on'.
result.label: depend / rely before 'on'

result.description: Fires weakly on varied function words and word pieces (' of', ' in', ' by', 'Plant') where a noun like value, index, role or approach is likely to come next. Silent on many ' of' tokens. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Scattered function words before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on the token ' art' right after the article "an" (e.g. "an art form", "an artistic..."), where "art" starts a noun or an "artistic" word. It stays silent on sentence-initial or "of art" uses.
result.label: ' art' after "an"

result.description: Fires on function words (include, and, of, the, with) inside text about corporate board structure and independent or executive directors. It seems to predict director or committee-type words next. The same words stay silent in general business text.
result.label: Function words in board governance text

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after "even" (e.g. "make even the most experienced..."), anticipating a superlative like "most". Silent on ' the' after other words such as verbs or prepositions.
result.label: ' the' after "even"

result.description: Fires on function words (mostly ' a', ' an', ' the') right after verbs like building, establishing or creating in branding and communication text, where a brand-related noun is expected next (identity, presence, connection). It stays quiet on ' a' in other slots.
result.label: Article before brand-related noun

result.description: Fires on words of avoidance or negation that introduce an unwanted outcome (avoid, without, risk of, from, prevent-ing), where the next word is likely a negative thing or a gerund like "being". Members detect avoid/prevent words and error/problem predictions.
result.label: Avoidance words predicting unwanted outcome

result.description: Fires on sentence-length descriptors like "longer", "shorter", "descriptive" in writing-style advice about varying sentence length. Members are writing, sentence and grammar topic detectors. One contrast "longer" in a conversation context was silent.
result.label: Sentence length descriptors in writing advice

result.description: Fires on function words (as, and, like, by, to) and word pieces right after a noun phrase like "asset protection" or "liability protection" in business/legal comparisons. Peaks are mixed, including 'medi'. Evidence is thin and scattered.
result.label: Function words after business protection phrases

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: 'ch' in "ever-changing"/"game-changer", plus function words (an, of, and, as, or) in abstract time-series/data prose. Logits favor "anging/anger" continuations. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is low-faithfulness.
result.label: 'ch' of changing, plus function words

result.description: Fires on ' the' after a locative preposition (on, along, of, from) in descriptions of where an ancient civilization was located, before a geographic term such as side, plains or river. Silent on ' the' in 'one of the' and 'part of the'.
result.label: 'the' in location phrases

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly commas inside lists of abstract nouns or terms, plus "including", "a", "to" and mid-word pieces. Peaks are mixed and the contrast has the same commas silent. The circuit failed and members are generic list-item detectors.
result.label: Scattered list-position commas, unclear

result.description: Fires on ' with' right after communication or relationship words (communicate, connect, conversation, ties, discussions) where a person or group comes next. Silent on ' with' after respond, follow up, or framing language with.
result.label: 'with' after communicate/connect verbs
Mixed function-word peaks, unclear
result.description: Peaks are scattered across ' replace', commas, ' a', and spaces in explanatory or academic text, with low consistency. Members are mostly generic context features. Only a 'replacing' detector is discriminative. No clear trigger.
Fires on ' past' (also ' present') in grammar-tense text, especially in "past participle" or "past tense" naming verb forms. It stays silent on "in the past" and "past simple" in some contexts.
result.label: "past" in grammar tense terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece " cred" as the start of a word like credibility, credible or credits. Members mostly detect " cred" itself, with some related pieces like " reli". Predicts suffixes such as -ibility and -ible.
result.label: ' cred' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on abstract technical head nouns like "spaces", "theory", "concepts", "metrics" after a modifier (metric spaces, probability theory) in "application/use of X" phrases. Silent on "spaces" after "of" or "normed". Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Technical concept nouns after modifier

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments after a prefix like "ex" or "re" (ex|ch|anging, ex|op|lanets, re|do|x, Bol|tzmann), mid-word where the word continues. Mostly 'ch' in "exchanging", also "arranging", "retreating".
result.label: Mid-word fragment in exchanging/changing

result.description: Fires mostly on the hyphen in "problem-solving" (before "solving"), plus scattered function words and ' medieval'. It is silent on hyphens in other compounds like well-being, hands-on and next-generation. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Hyphen in problem-solving, mixed

result.description: Fires on list-introducing connectives (commas, "such as", "including", "and", "from") right before an enumeration of sensor types (vision, tactile, lidar, cameras). It stays silent on commas in other technical text.
result.label: Sensor-type list introducers

result.description: Fires on the word " touch" / " Touch", especially as a modifier before words like screen, sensor, or points (touchscreen, touch technology). Members are mostly touch-token detectors. Predicts compound continuations such as screen, points, es, ing.
result.label: touch token (touchscreen compounds)

result.description: Fires on plural computing-object nouns or verbs (processed, executed, nodes, modules, files, processes) in operating-system, scheduling and memory text, where items are handled or allocated. Silent on generic system text.
result.label: Computing units being processed/executed

result.description: Fires on the piece 'il' inside "multilateral" and similar "multi-" words (multilanguages, multidisciplinary), and weakly on ' L'/' Id' word starts. Silent on 'il' at the start of a word or in other words like assimilate.
result.label: 'il' in "multilateral"

result.description: Fires on function words and word pieces (for, to, in, -izing, -able) inside lists of sustainability, energy-efficiency and waste-reduction practices. It is silent on the same words in other contexts, so the topic matters more than the token.
result.label: Sustainability practice list connectors

result.description: Fires on function words (the, which, that, who, as) right after a term being defined or explained in expository, definitional text, e.g. "is defined as", "an economy that", "means \"". Silent on many ordinary ' the' tokens.
result.label: Function words in definitions

result.description: Fires on the article ' a'/' an' (sometimes ' as') right after "language as" or similar "X as/serves as" role phrases in abstract linguistics-style text, where a noun like vehicle, tool or component is expected. It is silent on some "emerges as a" cases.
result.label: Article after "language as"

result.description: Fires on the word-initial prefix ' un' as a separate token, mostly in economics text where it begins "unemployment" (also unstructured, unpredictable). Predicts continuations like 'emp'. Silent on the whole word "unemployment" or related words.
result.label: ' un' prefix before 'employment'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ost' inside "compost" (composting, compostable, compost initiatives), in sustainability and recycling text. Upstream members are mostly 'ost' detectors after "comp", plus some recycling/harvest word-piece detectors.
result.label: 'ost' in compost
